et: Oi... mul on hea meel!

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode7
en: I don't wish to waste your time, so please advise me on this.
et: Ma ei soovi teie aega raisata, nii et palun andke mulle selles osas nõu.

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode7
en: I plan to take a BATTLE TOWER challenge soon.
et: Plaanin varsti võtta BATTLE TOWER väljakutse.

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode7
en: However, there are two levels…
et: Siiski on kaks taset...

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode7
en: Which would be most suitable for me? Level 50 or Open Level?
et: Milline oleks mulle kõige sobivam? Level 50 või Avatud Level?

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks7
en: {STR_VAR_1} is your choice! I see. I will do my best!
et: {STR_VAR_1} on sinu valik! Ma näen. Annan endast parima!

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks7
en: Thank you, {PLAYER}. I hope I can count on you again. Please take care!
et: Aitäh, {PLAYER}. Loodan, et saan sinuga taas arvestada. Palun hoolitsege!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach8
en: Eek! Eek! {PLAYER}! You spoke to me! I… I'm overjoyed!
et: Eek! Eek! {PLAYER}! Sa rääkisid minuga! Ma olen ülirõõmus!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach8
en: Me! My name is {STR_VAR_1}! I just became a TRAINER!
et: Mina! Minu nimi on {STR_VAR_1}! Minust sai just TRAINER!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach8
en: I'm delighted I met you, {PLAYER}, the big name in POKéMON circles!
et: Mul on hea meel, et kohtusin sinuga, {PLAYER}, suur nimi POKéMON ringis!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach8
en: Oh-oh-oh, I know! May I ask a huge favor, {PLAYER}?
et: Oh-oh-oh, tean! Kas ma võin küsida suurt teenet, {PLAYER}?

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach8
en: Please take me in as your apprentice! I want to learn from you!
et: Palun võta mind oma õpipoisiks! Ma tahan sinult õppida!

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching8
en: Waaaah! {PLAYER} turned me down… It… It's an invaluable experience!
et: Waaaaah! {PLAYER} ütles mulle ära... See on hindamatu kogemus!

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching8
en: {PLAYER}, please! I want to hear an affirmative answer this time!
et: {PLAYER}, palun! Tahan seekord kuulda jaatavat vastust!

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching8
en: I beg you for your guidance!
et: Palun teilt juhatust!

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode8
en: Hieeeeh! {PLAYER} said yes! {PLAYER} said yes!
et: Hieeeeh! {PLAYER} ütles jah! {PLAYER} ütles jah!

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode8
en: I won't be able to sleep tonight… Thank you ever so much!
et: Ma ei saa täna magada... tänan teid kunagi väga!

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode8
en: Then, here's my question!
et: Siis, siin on minu küsimus!

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode8
en: At the BATTLE TOWER, what is right for me, Level 50 or Open Level?
et: BATTLE TOWER juures, mis on minu jaoks õige, Level 50 või Avatud Level?

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks8
en: {STR_VAR_1}! Perfectly understood! I understand perfectly! I'm deliriously delighted!
et: {STR_VAR_1}! Täiuslikult mõistetav! Ma saan suurepäraselt aru! Olen delikaatselt rõõmus!

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks8
en: I hope you'll be willing to teach me some more another time.
et: Ma loodan, et sa oled nõus mind veel mõni kord õpetama.

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach9
en: Whoa! Could you be… Might you be… {PLAYER}{KUN}?! That strong and famous TRAINER? Well, hello, aren't I just the luckiest!
et: Vot! Võiksid sa olla... {PLAYER}{KUN}?! Et tugev ja kuulus TRAINER? No tere, kas ma pole mitte ainult kõige õnnelikum!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach9
en: Hello, the name's {STR_VAR_1}!
et: Tere, nimi on {STR_VAR_1}!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach9
en: I've been on the lookout for a POKéMON teacher.
et: Olen käinud otsimas POKéMON õpetajat.

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach9
en: And with impeccably good timing, along came you, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
et: Ja laitmatult hea ajastusega, kaasa tuli ka sina, {PLAYER}{KUN}!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach9
en: So, there you have it, {PLAYER}{KUN}! Let me apprentice under you!
et: Seega, seal sul on see olemas, {PLAYER}{KUN}! Las ma olen sinu all õpipoiss!

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching9
en: Gwaaaah! You're quite cool and tough…
et: Gwaaaaah! Sa oled üsna lahe ja karm...

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching9
en: Don't be that way, please. I'm asking you!
et: Ära ole nii, palun. Ma küsin teilt!

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode9
en: Oh, yeah! That's a solid reply! Excellent, I might add!
et: Ahjaa! See on kindel vastus! Suurepärane, võin lisada!

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode9
en: So how about a first piece of advice on the BATTLE TOWER?
et: Kuidas oleks siis esimese nõuandega BATTLE TOWER?

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode9
en: If I were to go, what would be better? Level 50 or Open Level?
et: Kui ma läheksin, siis mis oleks parem? Level 50 või Avatud Level?

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks9
en: Uh-huh, {STR_VAR_1} it is! OK, A-OK! I'll go show my mettle, like, jam!
et: Uh-huh, {STR_VAR_1} see on! OK, A-OK! Lähen näitan oma mett, nagu moos!

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks9
en: All right, I'll look to you as my mentor! Adios!
et: Olgu, ma vaatan sinu kui oma mentori poole! Adios!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach10
en: Oh, hey, {PLAYER}{KUN}, right? The police were looking for you!
et: Oh, kuule, {PLAYER}{KUN}, eks? Politsei otsis sind!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach10
en: … … … Of course I'm lying!
et: ... ... ... Muidugi ma valetan!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach10
en: Me, I'm {STR_VAR_1}. Despite the way I look, I'm the POKéMON CHAMPION! …That's a lie, too!
et: Mina olen {STR_VAR_1}. Vaatamata sellele, kuidas ma välja näen, olen mina see POKéMON TŠEMPION! ...see on ka vale!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach10
en: This is no lie, though. I'm not very good at battling.
et: See ei ole siiski vale. Ma ei oska eriti võidelda.

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach10
en: So, how about you becoming my master about all things POKéMON?
et: Niisiis, kuidas oleks, kui sa saaksid minu peremeheks kõigi asjade suhtes POKéMON?

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching10
en: If you're going to act cold like that, I'll show you what I'll do!
et: Kui sa hakkad niimoodi külmalt käituma, siis ma näitan, mida ma teen!

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching10
en: Waaah! Waaah! Waaah! Hiccup!
et: Waaah! Waaah! Waaah! Luksumine!

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching10
en: Hahaha, that was my FAKE TEARS!
et: Hahaha, see oli minu FAKE TEARS!

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching10
en: Come on, will you please be my POKéMON master?
et: Ole nüüd, kas sa palun oled minu POKéMON meister?

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode10
en: Yippee! I'll buy you a boat for that!
et: Yippee! Ma ostan sulle selle eest paadi!

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode10
en: Of course I'm lying again! But… Thank you, master!
et: Muidugi valetan jälle! Aga... aitäh, isand!

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode10
en: You know how there's Level 50 and Open Level at the BATTLE TOWER?
et: Teate, kuidas on tase 50 ja avatud tase BATTLE TOWER?

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode10
en: I'm having trouble deciding which level I should challenge…
et: Mul on raskusi otsustamisega, millisele tasemele peaksin väljakutse esitama...

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode10
en: Can you decide for me, master?
et: Kas sa saaksid minu eest otsustada, isand?

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks10
en: Okay, so {STR_VAR_1} is better! I'll go to the other level, then!
et: Okei, nii et {STR_VAR_1} on parem! Lähen siis teisele tasemele!

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks10
en: Just kidding! I'll obey your teaching, master!
et: Lihtsalt naljategemine! Ma allun su õpetusele, isand!

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks10
en: Thanks, master! I hope you'll keep teaching me!
et: Tänud, meister! Loodan, et õpetate mind edasi!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach11
en: A-H-O-Y! And that spells ahoy, and it means hi!
et: A-H-O-Y! Ja see loitsib ahoyd ja see tähendab tere!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach11
en: I'm {STR_VAR_1}, the rappin' SAILOR am I!
et: Mina olen {STR_VAR_1}, rappin' SAILOR olen mina!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach11
en: Your turn now, tell me a little about yourself, give it a try!
et: Sinu kord nüüd, räägi natuke endast, anna proovida!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach11
en: Uh-huh, uh-huh! {PLAYER}{KUN}'s your name, and POKéMON's your game!
et: Uh-huh, uh-huh! {PLAYER} {KUN} on sinu nimi ja POKéMON on sinu mäng!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach11
en: And you're at a delicate age when all the world's your stage!
et: Ja sa oled õrnas eas, kui kogu maailm on sinu lava!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach11
en: Anyway, I just want to say, that you're the tenth TRAINER I've spoken to today.
et: Igatahes ma tahan lihtsalt öelda, et sa oled kümnes TRAINER I'ga täna rääkinud.

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach11
en: Let's make that a celebration! Become my mentor for commemoration!
et: Teeme selle pidulikuks! Hakka mälestuseks minu mentoriks!

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching11
en: But! You have to work with me!
et: Aga! Sa pead minuga koostööd tegema!

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching11
en: Don't be such a tease! Become my mentor, please!
et: Ära ole selline õrritaja! Hakka minu mentoriks, palun!

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode11
en: That's it! {PLAYER}, you've got the spirit!
et: Nii ongi! {PLAYER}, sul on vaim!

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode11
en: So here's my first question that begs your suggestion!
et: Siit siis minu esimene küsimus, mis tekitab teie soovituse!

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode11
en: It's about the BATTLE TOWER, and it hinges on my power!
et: Asi on BATTLE TOWER ja see hingitseb mu väel!

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode11
en: Level 50 and Open Level there be, which is the one that's good for me?
et: Level 50 ja Open Level on olemas, kumb on see, mis mulle sobib?

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks11
en: Okay, {STR_VAR_1} it is, you say! I'll go and take it on my way!
et: Okei, {STR_VAR_1} see on, sa ütled! Lähen ja võtan asja ette!

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks11
en: If it's advice I ever need, {PLAYER}, your word I'll always heed!
et: Kui see on nõuanne, mida ma kunagi vajan, {PLAYER}, siis teie sõna võtan alati kuulda!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach12
en: Say, hey, aren't you {PLAYER}? What should I do? Talk to you? Why not? I'm already talking to you!
et: Ütle, et kuule, kas sa pole mitte {PLAYER}? Mida peaksin tegema? Räägi sinuga? Miks mitte? Ma juba räägin sinuga!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach12
en: {PLAYER}, are you surprised at me? I'd better tell you who I happen to be!
et: {PLAYER}, kas sa oled minu üle üllatunud? Ütlen parem, kes ma juhtun olema!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach12
en: {STR_VAR_1} is what you can call me. The brightest star in guitardom, that's me!
et: {STR_VAR_1} on see, mida võid mulle nimetada. Kõige säravam staar kitarris, see olen mina!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach12
en: Are you receiving me? You are receiving me!
et: Kas te võtate mind vastu? Sa võtad mind vastu!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach12
en: My luck's at its best, I'll hit you with a request!
et: Minu õnn on kõige paremas korras, ma löön teid palvega!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach12
en: {PLAYER}, let me be your underling! I want you to teach me everything!
et: {PLAYER}, las ma olen sinu alaling! Ma tahan, et sa õpetaksid mulle kõike!

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching12
en: You're turning me down, then? I'll just have to ask you again!
et: Sa siis ütled mulle ära? Ma lihtsalt pean uuesti küsima!

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching12
en: {PLAYER}, I beg to be your underling! I need you to teach me everything!
et: {PLAYER}, palun olla teie alaling! Ma vajan, et sa õpetaksid mulle kõike!

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode12
en: Lucky, yeah, woohoo! Should I pop a question to you?
et: Vedas jah, woohoo! Kas ma peaksin sulle küsimuse poppima?

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode12
en: Since we're near the BATTLE TOWER, how about a question about its power?
et: Kuna me oleme BATTLE TOWER lähedal, siis kuidas oleks küsimusega selle võimu kohta?

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode12
en: Of the choices you see, which is the right one for me?
et: Nendest valikutest, mida sa näed, milline on minu jaoks õige?

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks12
en: If {STR_VAR_1} is what you suggest, it must be the very best!
et: Kui {STR_VAR_1} on see, mida soovitate, peab see olema kõige parem!

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks12
en: Well, {PLAYER}, I have to roam free, but don't you forget about me.
et: Nojah, {PLAYER}, ma pean tasuta hulkuma, aga ärge mind unustage.

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks12
en: See you again, my smart friend!
et: Kohtumiseni veel, mu tark sõber!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach13
en: Oh, hi! You there! Can I get you to massage my shoulder?
et: Oi, tere! Sina seal! Kas ma saan su õlale masseerida?

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach13
en: …Yes, there! That's it! Ouch, ouch! Oooh, that feels great!
et: ...Jah, seal! Nii ongi! Ouch, ouch! Ooh, see tundub suurepärane!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach13
en: My name's {STR_VAR_1}. I take karate training, but my body's not built to take the abuse…
et: Minu nimi on {STR_VAR_1}. Võtan ette karatetreeninguid, aga mu keha ei ole üles ehitatud väärkohtlemise võtmiseks...

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach13
en: I decided I'll battle POKéMON and toughen myself up.
et: Otsustasin, et võitlen POKéMON ja karmistan ennast.

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach13
en: You're {PLAYER}{KUN}, aren't you? The POKéMON LEAGUE CHAMP?
et: Sa oled ju {PLAYER}{KUN}? POKéMON LIIGA TŠEMPION?

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach13
en: Listen, can I get you to give me advice?
et: Kuule, kas ma saan sulle nõu anda?

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching13
en: Oh, why?
et: Oh, miks?

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching13
en: I won't be a big bother, I promise! Please?
et: Ma ei hakka suurt viitsima, luban! Palun?

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode13
en: Thank you. Mighty good of you! …Cough! Cough!
et: Aitähh. Vägev hea sinust! ...köha! Köha!

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode13
en: Oogh, I have to toughen up quick…
et: Oogh, ma pean kiiresti karmistama...

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode13
en: I'll be heading off to the BATTLE TOWER right away, but what would be better for me? Level 50 or Open Level?
et: Suundun kohe BATTLE TOWER peale, aga mis oleks minu jaoks parem? Level 50 või Avatud Level?

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks13
en: Hm, all right. That's {STR_VAR_1}. I'll go there right away.
et: Hm, olgu. See on {STR_VAR_1}. Lähen kohe sinna.

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks13
en: I hope I can keep hitting you up for help--after all, you're my mentor!
et: Ma loodan, et ma saan sind aidata. Lõppude lõpuks, sa oled mu mentor!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach14
en: Er… Um… {PLAYER}{KUN}…?
et: Er... Um... {PLAYER}{KUN}...?

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach14
en: Please, don't look at me that way. You're making me all self-conscious.
et: Palun, ära vaata mind nii. Te teete mind kõik eneseteadlikuks.

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach14
en: I… I'm {STR_VAR_1}.
et: Ma olen {STR_VAR_1}.

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach14
en: I'm really embarrassed to say this, but I explore ancient ruins and such.
et: Mul on tõesti piinlik seda öelda, aga ma uurin iidseid varemeid ja selliseid.

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach14
en: I'm even more embarrassed to admit I'm interested in the BATTLE FRONTIER.
et: Mul on veelgi piinlikum tunnistada, et mind huvitab BATTLE FRONTIER.

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach14
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}, you have a reputation as a tough TRAINER…
et: {PLAYER} {KUN}, teil on maine karm TRAINER...

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach14
en: It's hard for me to say this, but I want to ask something.
et: Mul on seda raske öelda, aga ma tahan midagi küsida.

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach14
en: Could you become my teacher and give me advice?
et: Kas sa võiksid saada minu õpetajaks ja anda mulle nõu?

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching14
en: Please don't brush me off like this! I can't live with the humiliation.
et: Palun ärge mind niimoodi maha harjake! Ma ei saa alandusega elada.

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching14
en: Please become my teacher! I need your advice!
et: Palun saage minu õpetajaks! Ma vajan teie nõuandeid!

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode14
en: Th-thank you…
et: Tänan teid...

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode14
en: But please don't look at me like that. It makes me all flustered.
et: Aga palun ära vaata mind nii. See teeb mind kõik lõõmavaks.

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode14
en: Please, answer me without looking at my eyes.
et: Palun, vastake mulle, ilma et te vaataksite mu silmi.

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode14
en: At the BATTLE TOWER… Which level should I attempt?
et: BATTLE TOWER... Millist taset peaksin proovima?

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks14
en: Oh… Okay! I'll try my hand at that.
et: Ok! Ma proovin selle peale kätt.

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks14
en: I hope I can make a valiant challenge without getting all flustered…
et: Loodan, et suudan teha vahva väljakutse, saamata kõik paugutatud...

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks14
en: Thank you, {PLAYER}{KUN}. If we meet again, I hope you will be as helpful.
et: Aitäh, {PLAYER}{KUN}. Kui kohtume veel, siis loodan, et olete sama abivalmis.

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach15
en: Hm? You appear to be {PLAYER}{KUN}… But are you really real?
et: Hm? Sa paistad olevat {PLAYER}{KUN}... Aga kas sa oled tõesti reaalne?

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach15
en: You may call me {STR_VAR_1}.
et: Sa võid mulle helistada {STR_VAR_1}.

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach15
en: I have been toying with the idea of apprenticing under a strong TRAINER.
et: Olen käinud rügamas mõttega õpipoisiks saada tugeva TRAINER all.

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach15
en: So, I must say I'm lucky you came along! …You really are {PLAYER}{KUN}, yes?
et: Seega, ma pean ütlema, et mul on vedanud, et sa kaasa tulid! ...Te olete tõesti {PLAYER}{KUN}, jah?

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach15
en: No, no, if you are real, it's fine. I merely want you to recognize me as your apprentice.
et: Ei, ei, kui sa oled päris, siis on kõik korras. Ma lihtsalt tahan, et sa tunnustaksid mind oma õpipoisina.

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching15
en: Oh? But what would compel you to refuse?
et: Oh? Aga mis sunniks sind keelduma?

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching15
en: I apologize for being skeptical about your identity.
et: Vabandan, et olen skeptiline teie identiteedi suhtes.

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching15
en: Please accept my apology and accept me as your apprentice.
et: Palun võta mu vabandus vastu ja võta mind oma õpipoisiks vastu.

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode15
en: You really are accepting me? I don't wish to celebrate prematurely.
et: Kas sa tõesti aktsepteerid mind? Ma ei soovi ennatlikult tähistada.

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode15
en: If it is true, I apologize. But now, I need your advice.
et: Kui see on tõsi, siis vabandan. Aga nüüd, ma vajan teie nõuandeid.

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode15
en: If I were to enter the BATTLE TOWER, what would be worthy of me? Level 50 or Open Level?
et: Kui ma siseneksin BATTLE TOWER, siis mis oleks minu vääriline? Level 50 või Avatud Level?

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks15
en: {STR_VAR_1}? Are you certain?
et: {STR_VAR_1}? Oled sa kindel?

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks15
en: I see. If that's the case, that's fine. I thank you for your time.
et: Ma näen. Kui see nii on, siis on kõik korras. Ma tänan teid aja eest.

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks15
en: I realize I can annoy, but it delights me that you have accepted me.
et: Ma saan aru, et ma võin pahandada, aga see rõõmustab mind, et te olete mind vastu võtnud.

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks15
en: Let us meet again!
et: Kohtugem taas!

label: gText_ApprenticeWhatHeldItem0
en: Sigh… Sob… Oh, {PLAYER}!
et: Ohh... sob... ohh, {PLAYER}!

label: gText_ApprenticeWhatHeldItem0
en: I'm all tangled up in a dilemma that I can't decide.
et: Ma olen kõik sassis dilemmaga, mida ma ei suuda otsustada.

label: gText_ApprenticeWhatHeldItem0
en: I can't decide what I should make my {STR_VAR_1} hold.
et: Ma ei suuda otsustada, mida ma peaksin oma {STR_VAR_1} hoidma.

label: gText_ApprenticeWhatHeldItem0
en: Please tell me, {PLAYER}. What item should I make it hold?
et: Palun ütle mulle, {PLAYER}. Mis ese peaks selle pidama panema?

label: gText_ApprenticeHoldNothing0
en: Oh, really? I shouldn't make my {STR_VAR_1} hold anything?
et: Kas tõesti? Ma ei tohiks panna oma {STR_VAR_1} midagi hoidma?

et: Ahjaah, kui see pole {PLAYER}!

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichMove12
en: What should I do? Get your advice? Why not? I'm already talking to you!
et: Mida peaksin tegema? Võta nõu? Miks mitte? Ma juba räägin sinuga!

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichMove12
en: {PLAYER}, are you surprised by me? I want your advice, can't you see?
et: {PLAYER}, kas sa oled minu poolt üllatunud? Ma tahan su nõuandeid, kas sa ei näe?

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichMove12
en: Are you receiving me? You are receiving me!
et: Kas te võtate mind vastu? Sa võtad mind vastu!

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichMove12
en: My {STR_VAR_1}--what should it use? It's {STR_VAR_2} or {STR_VAR_3}, what do you choose?
et: Minu {STR_VAR_1}--mida see peaks kasutama? See on {STR_VAR_2} või {STR_VAR_3}, mida te valite?

label: gText_ApprenticeMoveThanks12
en: If that {STR_VAR_1} is the best, I'll do as you suggest!
et: Kui see {STR_VAR_1} on parim, siis teen nii nagu soovitate!

label: gText_ApprenticeMoveThanks12
en: Well, {PLAYER}, I have to roam free, but don't you forget about me.
et: Nojah, {PLAYER}, ma pean tasuta hulkuma, aga ärge mind unustage.

label: gText_ApprenticeMoveThanks12
en: See you again, my smart friend!
et: Kohtumiseni veel, mu tark sõber!

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichMove13
en: Gahack! Gaah! Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}… I have this lousy cold, I do…
et: Gahack! Gaah! Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}... mul on see vilets külm, ma teen...

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichMove13
en: I want to pick a move for my POKéMON, but I'm not up to it…
et: Ma tahan oma POKéMON jaoks käigu valida, aga ma ei ole selle järgi...

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichMove13
en: So, things being this way, I need you to decide for me.
et: Nii et, asjad on nii, ma vajan, et sa otsustaksid minu eest.

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichMove13
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}, if I had to choose between {STR_VAR_2} and {STR_VAR_3} for my {STR_VAR_1}, which would it be?
et: {PLAYER} {KUN}, kui ma peaksin valima {STR_VAR_2} ja {STR_VAR_3} vahel oma {STR_VAR_1}, mis see oleks?

label: gText_ApprenticeMoveThanks13
en: Hm, {STR_VAR_1}, all right. Cough! I'll go teach it when I get better.
et: Hm, {STR_VAR_1}, kõik korras. Köha! Ma lähen seda õpetama, kui paremaks saan.

label: gText_ApprenticeMoveThanks13
en: I hope I can keep hitting you up for help like this.
et: Ma loodan, et ma saan sind niimoodi aidata.

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichMove14
en: Er… Um… {PLAYER}{KUN}…?
et: Er... Um... {PLAYER}{KUN}...?

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichMove14
en: Please, don't look at me that way. I'm getting all flustered… I… I need your advice.
et: Palun, ära vaata mind nii. Mul läheb kõik lõhki... mul on su nõuandeid vaja.

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichMove14
en: I… I'm really embarrassed, but I can't decide what move I should teach my POKéMON.
et: Mul on väga piinlik, aga ma ei suuda otsustada, mis võtet ma peaksin oma POKéMON õpetama.

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichMove14
en: It's for my {STR_VAR_1}. If the choices were {STR_VAR_2} or {STR_VAR_3}, which would be better?
et: See on minu {STR_VAR_1} jaoks. Kui valikud oleksid {STR_VAR_2} või {STR_VAR_3}, siis kumb oleks parem?

label: gText_ApprenticeMoveThanks14
en: Oh… Okay! I'll try that {STR_VAR_1}.
et: Ok! Ma proovin seda {STR_VAR_1}.

label: gText_ApprenticeMoveThanks14
en: I hope I can teach that move… This is so nerve-racking…
et: Loodan, et saan seda võtet õpetada... see on nii närvesööv...

label: gText_ApprenticeMoveThanks14
en: Thank you, {PLAYER}{KUN}. If we meet again, I hope you will be as helpful.
et: Aitäh, {PLAYER}{KUN}. Kui kohtume veel, siis loodan, et olete sama abivalmis.

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichMove15
en: Hm? You appear to be {PLAYER}{KUN}… But are you really real?
et: Hm? Sa paistad olevat {PLAYER}{KUN}... Aga kas sa oled tõesti reaalne?

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichMove15
en: Perhaps you're one of those popular mimics?
et: Võib-olla oled sa üks neist populaarsetest miimikatest?

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichMove15
en: No, no, if you are real, it's fine. No need to be upset, I assure you!
et: Ei, ei, kui sa oled päris, siis on kõik korras. Pole vaja ärrituda, kinnitan!

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichMove15
en: Incidentally, I would like to obtain your advice.
et: Muuseas, ma tahaksin teie nõu saada.

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichMove15
en: It's about my {STR_VAR_1}.
et: See on minu {STR_VAR_1} kohta.

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichMove15
en: Which move would be better for it to use, {STR_VAR_2} or {STR_VAR_3}?
et: Kumba võtet oleks parem kasutada, kas {STR_VAR_2} või {STR_VAR_3}?

label: gText_ApprenticeMoveThanks15
en: {STR_VAR_1}? There's no question about that?
et: {STR_VAR_1}? Selle kohta pole küsimustki?

label: gText_ApprenticeMoveThanks15
en: I see. If that's the case, that's fine. I thank you for your time.
et: Ma näen. Kui see nii on, siis on kõik korras. Ma tänan teid aja eest.

label: gText_ApprenticeMoveThanks15
en: I do hope it is something even my POKéMON can learn.
et: Ma loodan, et see on midagi, mida isegi minu POKéMON saab õppida.

label: gText_ApprenticeMoveThanks15
en: Let us meet again!
et: Kohtugem taas!

et: Ma... kui ma võitlen, muutun ma nii närviliseks, et ma ei suuda nutta isegi siis, kui ma võidan...

et: Soovin, et saaksin võidu puhul midagi lahedat öelda...

en: Please, please, {PLAYER}! Could you maybe teach me something cool to say when I win so I don't cry?
et: Palun, palun, {PLAYER}! Kas sa äkki õpetaksid mulle midagi lahedat ütlema, kui ma võidan, et ma ei nutaks?

et: Snivel... {PLAYER}! Suured tänud kõige eest!

et: Ma võitlen parimaga, mida ma saan sinu pärast, {PLAYER}!

et: {PLAYER}... Järgmine kord peaksime võitlema!

en: Yay! It's {PLAYER}! Hello! I wanted to ask you something!
et: Yay! See on {PLAYER}! Tere! Tahtsin sinult midagi küsida!

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech1
en: I want to say something cool when I win a match.
et: Tahan öelda midagi lahedat, kui võidan matši.

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech1
en: Do you have a cool saying that you could recommend?
et: Kas sul on lahe ütlus, mida võiksid soovitada?

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks1
en: {STR_VAR_1}
et: {STR_VAR_1}

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks1
en: Oh, wow! That is so cool! Okay, I'll say that!
et: Oh, vau! See on nii lahe! Olgu, ma ütlen seda!

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks1
en: Thanks for teaching me all this time! I'm going to do the best I can wherever I go from now on!
et: Tänud, et mind kogu selle aja õpetasid! Ma annan endast parima, kuhu iganes ma nüüdsest lähen!

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks1
en: When we meet again, it'll be for a battle!
et: Kui kohtume uuesti, on see lahinguks!

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech2
en: {PLAYER}, hello!
et: {PLAYER}, tere!

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech2
en: My POKéMON and I are ready for anything, except for one thing.
et: Minu POKéMON ja ma olen kõigeks valmis, välja arvatud üks asi.

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech2
en: I think it would be good if I had something to shout when I win.
et: Ma arvan, et oleks hea, kui mul oleks võidu puhul midagi karjuda.

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech2
en: Could you think up something good to say?
et: Kas sa võiksid midagi head välja mõelda?

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks2
en: {STR_VAR_1}
et: {STR_VAR_1}

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks2
en: …Cool! I will use that!
et: ...lahe! Ma kasutan seda!

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks2
en: I'm going out to battle all over the place.
et: Lähen igal pool välja lahingusse.

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks2
en: Who knows, I may even get to battle you one day, {PLAYER}.
et: Kes teab, ma võin isegi ühel päeval sinuga lahingusse jõuda, {PLAYER}.

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks2
en: Next time, let's meet at a place of battle!
et: Järgmine kord kohtume lahingupaigas!

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech3
en: Hello, {PLAYER}… I'm sorry to bug you, but I'm hopeless…
et: Tere, {PLAYER}... vabandan, et veate, aga olen lootusetu...

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech3
en: Even when… Even when I win, I don't have anything special to say…
et: Isegi siis, kui ma võidan, pole mul midagi erilist öelda...

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech3
en: I know that it doesn't mean anything to you, {PLAYER}.
et: Ma tean, et see ei tähenda sulle midagi, {PLAYER}.

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech3
en: But it means a lot to me…
et: Aga see tähendab minu jaoks palju...

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech3
en: Please, {PLAYER}, what should I say if I win a battle?
et: Palun, {PLAYER}, mida ma peaksin ütlema, kui ma võidan lahingu?

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks3
en: {STR_VAR_1}
et: {STR_VAR_1}

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks3
en: That's inspired…
et: See on inspireeritud...

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks3
en: Uh… Is it okay for someone like me to even say that?
et: Kas minusugusel on seda üldse võimalik öelda?

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks3
en: No! I'll do my best!
et: Ei! Annan endast parima!

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks3
en: {PLAYER}, thank you so much for putting up with me for so long…
et: {PLAYER}, suur tänu, et mind nii kaua talusid...

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks3
en: I promise to do my best from now on.
et: Luban nüüdsest endast parima anda.

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks3
en: I'm sure you'll quickly forget about someone like me, but let's meet somewhere again!
et: Kindlasti unustad minusuguse kiiresti ära, aga kohtume jälle kuskil!

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech4
en: Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}. There's something I want you to hear.
et: Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}. Ma tahan, et sa kuuleksid midagi.

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech4
en: I know that I don't always sound nice or polite…
et: Ma tean, et ma ei kõla alati kenasti ega viisakalt...

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech4
en: When I win a battle, I think I come across as being arrogant.
et: Kui ma võidan lahingu, siis ma arvan, et satun ülbeks.

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech4
en: I don't want people to dislike me, so I want to say something nice to someone I beat.
et: Ma ei taha, et inimesed mind ei salliks, nii et ma tahan öelda midagi toredat kellelegi, keda ma peksan.

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech4
en: But I can't think of anything good! Could you think something up for me?
et: Aga ma ei suuda midagi head välja mõelda! Kas sa võiksid midagi minu jaoks välja mõelda?

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks4
en: {STR_VAR_1}
et: {STR_VAR_1}

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks4
en: Not bad! Yup, that's what I'll go with!
et: Pole paha! Yup, sellega ma lähen!

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks4
en: I'm going to hit the road and do what I can with what you taught me in my head and heart.
et: Sõidan vastu teed ja teen, mis võimalik, sellega, mida sa mulle pähe ja südamesse õpetasid.

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks4
en: I'm sorry that I've been so pushy with you!
et: Mul on kahju, et ma olen sinuga nii kihvt olnud!

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks4
en: Next time, we battle, okay? See you!
et: Järgmine kord me võitleme, eks? Kohtumiseni!

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech5
en: Oh, I can't get over how busy I am! Oh, hey, I was looking for you, {PLAYER}{KUN}.
et: Oh, ma ei saa üle, kui hõivatud ma olen! Oi, kuule, ma otsisin sind, {PLAYER}{KUN}.

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech5
en: Are you well as usual? Things haven't changed for me at all.
et: Kas sa oled hästi nagu tavaliselt? Minu jaoks pole asjad üldse muutunud.

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech5
en: I've got running, fighting, and mapping to do. Why am I so busy?
et: Mul on jooksmist, kaklemist ja kaardistamist, mida teha. Miks mul nii kiire on?

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech5
en: But even though I'm busy, it'd be rude to just turn on my heels and walk away from a win without saying a word.
et: Aga kuigi mul on kiire, oleks ebaviisakas lihtsalt kandadele keerata ja sõnagi lausumata võidust minema jalutada.

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech5
en: So, what would be a cool saying to underline my coolness when I'm done and walking away? {PLAYER}{KUN}, help me!
et: Mis oleks siis lahe ütlus, et mu jahedust alla kriipsutada, kui ma olen lõpetanud ja minema jalutanud? {PLAYER} {KUN}, aita mind!

et: {STR_VAR_1}

en: Okay, gotcha. I can find time to say that!

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks5
en: Honestly, I'm glad I met a good mentor like you.
et: Ausalt, mul on hea meel, et kohtasin sinusugust head mentorit.

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks5
en: I'm going to make time somehow so I can get into battling.
et: Teen kuidagi aega parajaks, et saaks kaklema minna.

et: Tänud kõige eest, {PLAYER}{KUN}! Me peame ühel päeval võitlema, sina ja mina!

et: Mul läks jälle õnneks! {PLAYER}! Mul on hea meel sind näha! Nagu ikka, vajan ka mina teie nõuandeid!

et: Trummirull, palun! Viimane küsimus on mul...

en: If I win a battle and want to end it with a cool flourish, what should I say?
et: Kui ma võidan lahingu ja tahan selle lõpetada jaheda õitsenguga, siis mida ma peaksin ütlema?

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks6
en: {STR_VAR_1}
et: {STR_VAR_1}

en: {PLAYER}, your advice really helped me.
et: {PLAYER}, sinu nõuanded tõesti aitasid mind.

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks6
en: Maybe one day, there'll be a time when we battle!
et: Võib-olla tuleb ühel päeval aeg, mil me võitleme!

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks6
en: Thank you for everything!
et: Aitäh kõige eest!

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech7
en: Oh, {PLAYER}. I'm so glad I met you!
et: Oh, {PLAYER}. Mul on nii hea meel, et ma sinuga kohtusin!

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech7
en: I no longer have any concerns with regard to my POKéMON.
et: Mul ei ole enam mingeid muresid seoses oma POKéMON-ga.

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks7
en: I must use that right away!
et: Ma pean seda kohe kasutama!

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks7
en: And now, I must take my leave, {PLAYER}…
et: Ja nüüd, ma pean oma puhkuse võtma, {PLAYER}...

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks7
en: I will go out to battle many others, but never will I forget your teachings.
et: Ma lähen välja lahingusse paljude teistega, kuid mitte kunagi ei unusta ma teie õpetusi.

en: Eek! I spotted {PLAYER}! I… I'm overjoyed to see you!
et: Eek! Märkasin {PLAYER}! Mul on ülirõõm sind näha!

et: Oh-oh-oh! On midagi, mida ma lihtsalt pidin sinult küsima!

et: Veidi aega tagasi võitsin lahingu. See osa oli uimerdamine!

en: So now, {PLAYER}, please, I want you to think up an exit line for when I win!
et: Nii et nüüd, {PLAYER}, palun, ma tahan, et te mõtleksite välja väljumisliini, milleks ma võidan!

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks8
en: {STR_VAR_1}
et: {STR_VAR_1}

et: Waaaaaah! Ma ütlen seda?! Ma... ma olen rõõmust delikaatne!

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks8
en: Th-th-thank you! I have nothing left to regret now!
et: Th-th-th-thanks! Mul ei ole nüüd enam midagi kahetseda!

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks8
en: I'm going to travel now and battle all sorts of people.
et: Lähen nüüd reisile ja võitlen igasugu inimestega.

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks8

et: Ma pean nüüd minema, aga kohtume lahingus ühel päeval!

et: Tead, mul hakkab sügelema, et hulkuda ja võidelda seal, kus tohib.

et: Aga enne kui ma seda teen, tahan ma veel kord teie nõuandeid, palun!

en: If I were to win a battle, what would be a good boast I could say to my fallen TRAINER opponent?
et: Kui ma võidaksin lahingu, siis mis oleks hea kiitlemine, mida võiksin öelda oma langenud TRAINER vastasele?

en: {STR_VAR_1}
et: {STR_VAR_1}

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks9
en: Uh-huh, that's sweet! Si, bueno! I'll try saying that, like, ham!
et: Uh-huh, see on magus! Si, bueno! Üritan öelda, et sink!

et: Ja nüüd on aeg hüvasti jätta! Tänud igasuguste asjade eest!

et: {PLAYER} {KUN}, seal on suur jama!

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech10
en: When I win a battle, I brag about it for an hour at least!
et: Kui võidan lahingu, hooplen sellega vähemalt tund aega!

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech10
en: Of course I'm lying! Wahahaha!
et: Muidugi ma valetan! Wahahaha!

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech10
en: This is no lie, though. I'm not very good at chatting.
et: See ei ole siiski vale. Ma ei oska eriti lobiseda.

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech10
en: So, how about deciding for me what I should say after winning a battle, master?
et: Niisiis, kuidas oleks minu eest otsustada, mida ma peaksin ütlema pärast lahingu võitmist, meister?

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks10
en: {STR_VAR_1}
et: {STR_VAR_1}

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks10
en: That's what I should say, huh? Then, I'll stay away from that!
et: Seda ma peaks ütlema, mis? Siis hoian sellest eemale!

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks10
en: Just kidding! I'll obey your teaching, master!
et: Lihtsalt naljategemine! Ma allun su õpetusele, isand!

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks10
en: Thanks for teaching me all this time, master!
et: Tänud, et mind kogu selle aja õpetasid, meister!

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks10
en: I'm finally understanding what being a TRAINER is about.
et: Ma saan lõpuks aru, milles seisneb TRAINER olemine.

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks10
en: I'm going to go out and win battles against any TRAINER.
et: Lähen välja ja võidan lahingud ükskõik millise TRAINER vastu.

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks10
en: Maybe it'll be you one day, master!
et: Võib-olla oled ühel päeval sina, isand!

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks10
en: That's all! Farewell, my master!
et: Muud ei midagi! Hüvasti, mu isand!

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech11
en: A-H-O-Y! And that spells ahoy!
et: A-H-O-Y! Ja see loitsub ahoy!

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech11
en: The rappin' SAILOR am I! This will be my last question, don't you cry!
et: Rappin' SAILOR olen mina! See jääb minu viimaseks küsimuseks, kas sa ei nuta!

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech11
en: It's a saying question that begs your suggestion!
et: See on ütluslik küsimus, mis tekitab su soovituse!

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech11
en: If I win a match, what can I say in a real cool way?
et: Kui ma võidan matši, siis mida ma oskan öelda päris lahedalt?

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks11
en: {STR_VAR_1}
et: {STR_VAR_1}

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks11
en: Perfect! That's what I'll use. I was right to make you choose!
et: Täiuslik! Seda ma ka kasutan. Mul oli õigus panna sind valima!

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks11
en: And now, I think it'd be best, if I were to fly the nest!
et: Ja nüüd oleks vist kõige parem, kui ma lendaks pesaga!

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks11
en: Thanks for all you taught me. I'll be off on a battle spree!
et: Tänan kõige eest, mida sa mulle õpetasid. Tulen maha lahingutriibule!

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks11
en: B-O-N-V-O-Y-A-G-E! And that spells bon voyage, to you this is my homage!
et: B-O-N-V-O-Y-A-G-E! Ja see loitsud bon merereis, sinu jaoks on see minu austusavaldus!

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech12
en: Oh, yeah, {PLAYER}! I found you again today!
et: Ahjaa, {PLAYER}! Leidsin su täna jälle üles!

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech12
en: What should I do? Ask you again? Why not? I'm already asking you!
et: Mida peaksin tegema? Küsi uuesti? Miks mitte? Ma juba küsin!

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech12
en: Anyways, {PLAYER}… Are you receiving me? You are receiving me! I need some more advice for me!
et: Igal juhul, {PLAYER}... Kas te võtate mind vastu? Sa võtad mind vastu! Vajan veel nõu minu jaoks!

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech12
en: It's about what I should yell. Something cool to holler when a battle ends well.
et: Asi on selles, mida ma peaksin karjuma. Midagi lahedat hurjutada, kui lahing hästi lõpeb.

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech12
en: Come on, I wanna hear you say it!
et: Ma tahan kuulda, kuidas sa seda ütlesid!

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks12
en: {STR_VAR_1}
et: {STR_VAR_1}

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks12
en: All right, all right! I'll use that because it's so tight!
et: Olgu, olgu peale! Kasutan seda, sest see on nii tihe!

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks12
en: I'm out of things to ask you. Waving bye is all that's left to do.
et: Mul on asjad otsas, mida küsida. Lehvitamine on kõik, mis teha jääb.

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks12
en: But maybe one day we'll meet, with one destined to go down in defeat.
et: Aga võib-olla saame ühel päeval kokku, üks on määratud kaotusseisust alla minema.

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks12
en: But, it really is time to say farewell.
et: Aga, tõesti on aeg hüvasti jätta.

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks12
en: Well, {PLAYER}, I have to roam free, but don't you forget about me!
et: Nojah, {PLAYER}, ma pean tasuta hulkuma, aga ärge mind unustage!

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks12
en: Take care, {PLAYER}! Love ya!
et: Hoolitsege, {PLAYER}! Armasta sind!

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech13
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}, I'm finished… My nose won't stop dripping…
et: {PLAYER} {KUN}, olen lõpetanud... mu nina ei lõpeta tilkumist...

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech13
en: I was trying to think up something cool to say when I win a battle.
et: Üritasin välja mõelda midagi lahedat, mida öelda, kui võidan lahingu.

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech13
en: It inspired me so much, it made me cry, and now my nose won't stop running…
et: See inspireeris mind nii palju, et ajas nutma ja nüüd ei lõpeta nina jooksmist...

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech13
en: So, things being this way, I need you to decide for me, {PLAYER}{KUN}.
et: Seega, asjad on nii, mul on vaja, et sa otsustaksid minu eest, {PLAYER} {KUN}.

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech13
en: When I win a battle, what should I say?
et: Kui ma võidan lahingu, siis mida ma peaksin ütlema?

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks13
en: {STR_VAR_1}
et: {STR_VAR_1}

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks13
en: … … …That's good. No, it's awe inspiring! It's bringing fresh tears to my eyes!
et: ... ... ...see on hea. Ei, see on aukartustäratav! See toob mulle silma värsked pisarad!

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks13
en: But in spite of my tears and runny nose, I will use that saying!
et: Aga hoolimata oma pisaratest ja nohust kasutan seda ütlust!

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks13
en: I'm plumb out of things to ask you, {PLAYER}{KUN}.
et: Ma olen asjadest välja plärtsunud, et küsida, {PLAYER}{KUN}.

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks13
en: From now on, we're rivals! Thanks for everything!
et: Nüüdsest oleme rivaalid! Tänud kõige eest!

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech14
en: Er… Um… {PLAYER}{KUN}…
et: Er... Um... {PLAYER}{KUN}...

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech14
en: Please, don't look at me that way. You're making me all nervous.
et: Palun, ära vaata mind nii. Te ajate mind kõik närvi.

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech14
en: I… I need your advice again. I'll make it my last, though…
et: Ma vajan su nõuandeid. Jätan selle siiski viimaseks...

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech14
en: It's really embarrassing to ask, but what if I win a battle? What should I say?
et: Väga piinlik on küsida, aga mis siis, kui võidan lahingu? Mida ma peaksin ütlema?

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks14
en: {STR_VAR_1}
et: {STR_VAR_1}

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks14
en: Oh… Okay! I'll try to say that! I might be too nervous to say it…
et: Ok! Ma püüan seda öelda! Ma võin olla liiga närvis, et seda öelda...

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks14
en: Thank you, {PLAYER}{KUN}. I have to say good-bye now.
et: Aitäh, {PLAYER}{KUN}. Pean nüüd hüvasti jätma.

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks14
en: I'll obey all that you've taught me, {PLAYER}{KUN}, and do the best I can.
et: Ma allun kõigele sellele, mida sa oled mulle õpetanud, {PLAYER} {KUN} ja annan endast parima.

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech15
en: Hm? You appear to be {PLAYER}{KUN}… But are you really? Perhaps a clever {PLAYER} DOLL?
et: Hm? Sa paistad olevat {PLAYER}{KUN}... Aga kas sa oled tõesti? Ehk kaval {PLAYER} DOLL?

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech15
en: Oh, no, no, no, don't worry! If you really are real, please forget about my rudeness.
et: Oh ei, ei, ei, ärge muretsege! Kui sa tõesti oled tõeline, siis palun unusta minu ebaviisakus.

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech15
en: No need to be so angry. All I wish for is more of your fine advice.
et: Pole vaja nii vihane olla. Soovin vaid rohkem teie toredaid nõuandeid.

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech15
en: It concerns a saying.
et: See puudutab ütlust.

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech15
en: More precisely, what should I say if I win a battle?
et: Täpsemalt, mida ma peaksin ütlema, kui ma võidan lahingu?

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks15
en: {STR_VAR_1}
et: {STR_VAR_1}

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks15
en: … … … … … … When I win a match…
et: ... ... ... ... ... kui võidan matši...

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks15
en: {STR_VAR_1}
et: {STR_VAR_1}

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks15
en: …Are you serious?
et: ...kas sa oled tõsine?

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks15
en: I see. If you are serious, that's fine. I thank you for your time.
et: Ma näen. Kui tõsiselt võtta, siis on kõik korras. Ma tänan teid aja eest.

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks15
en: I do hope even I will be able to put that saying to good use.
et: Ma loodan, et isegi mina suudan selle ütluse heale kasutamisele panna.

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks15
en: I seem to have run dry on what advice I need.
et: Tundub, et olen jooksnud kuivalt, mis nõu mul vaja on.

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks15
en: I do believe it's high time I bid you farewell and strike out on my own.
et: Ma usun, et on viimane aeg sulle hüvasti jätta ja omal käel streikida.

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks15
en: Thank you, my mentor! I apologize for my skepticism!
et: Aitäh, mu mentor! Vabandan oma skeptilisuse pärast!

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_BeenWaitingForYou
en: Before we resume your challenge, I must save the game.
et: Enne, kui me jätkame teie väljakutset, pean ma mängu päästma.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_DidntSaveBeforeQuitting
en: I'm sorry to say this, but you didn't save before you quit playing last time.
et: Mul on kahju seda öelda, aga sa ei säästnud enne, kui sa eelmine kord mängimisest loobusid.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_DidntSaveBeforeQuitting
en: As a result, you have been disqualified from your challenge.
et: Selle tulemusena olete oma väljakutsest diskvalifitseeritud.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ReturnPersonalMons
en: We'll return your personal POKéMON.
et: Me tagastame teie isikliku POKéMON.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ReceivedPrize
en: {PLAYER} received the prize {STR_VAR_1}.
et: {PLAYER} sai auhinna {STR_VAR_1}.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_RulesAreListed
en: The Battle Swap rules are listed.
et: Lahinguvahetuse reeglid on loetletud.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ReadWhichHeading
en: Which heading do you want to read?
et: Kumba poolt sa tahad lugeda?

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainBasicRules
en: In a Battle Swap event, you may use only three POKéMON.
et: Battle Swap üritusel võid kasutada ainult kolme POKéMON.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainBasicRules
en: Whether you are renting or swapping, your team may not have two or more of the same POKéMON.
et: Olenemata sellest, kas sa rendid või vahetad, ei pruugi su meeskonnal olla kaks või enam sama POKéMON.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainSwapPartnerRules
en: You may swap POKéMON only with the TRAINER you have just defeated.
et: Võite vahetada POKéMON ainult TRAINER-ga, mille olete äsja alistanud.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainSwapPartnerRules
en: You may swap for only those POKéMON used by the beaten TRAINER.
et: Võite vahetada ainult nende POKéMON vastu, mida pekstud TRAINER kasutab.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainSwapNumberRules
en: After every battle you win, you may swap for one of your defeated opponent's POKéMON.
et: Pärast igat võitvat lahingut võite vahetada ühe oma alistatud vastase POKéMON vastu.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainSwapNumberRules
en: You will not be able to swap POKéMON with the third TRAINER in the event.
et: Teil ei ole võimalik vahetada POKéMON kolmanda TRAINER korral.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainSwapNotes
en: There are two key points to be aware of when swapping POKéMON.
et: On kaks võtmepunkti, millest POKéMON vahetamisel teadlik olla.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainSwapNotes
en: First, when swapping, you can't check the stats of the POKéMON you are about to receive.
et: Esiteks ei saa vahetades kontrollida POKéMON statse, mida olete saamas.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainSwapNotes
en: Second, the POKéMON on your team are lined up in sequence, depending on the order in which you rented them.
et: Teiseks, POKéMON teie meeskond on rivistatud järjestikku, sõltuvalt tellimusest, kus te neid rentisite.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainSwapNotes
en: This sequence remains unchanged even when swaps are made.
et: See jada püsib muutumatuna ka vahetuste tegemisel.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainMonRules
en: The POKéMON of the SLATEPORT BATTLE TENT are all rentals.
et: POKéMON SLATEPORT BATTLE TENT on kõik rendid.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainMonRules
en: All rental POKéMON are kept at Level 30.
et: Kogu rent POKéMON hoitakse tasemel 30.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_RulesAreListed2
en: The VERDANTURF BATTLE TENT rules are listed.
et: Loetletud on VERDANTURF BATTLE TENT reeglid.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ReadWhichHeading
en: Which heading do you want to read?
et: Kumba poolt sa tahad lugeda?

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainBasicRules
en: Here at the VERDANTURF BATTLE TENT, POKéMON are required to think and battle by themselves.
et: Siin VERDANTURF BATTLE TENT, POKéMON on vaja mõelda ja võidelda ise.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainBasicRules
en: Unlike in the wild, POKéMON that live with people behave differently depending on their nature.
et: Erinevalt vabas looduses käituvad POKéMON, mis elavad koos inimestega sõltuvalt nende olemusest erinevalt.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainNatureRules
en: Depending on its nature, a POKéMON may prefer to attack no matter what.
et: Olenevalt oma olemusest võib POKéMON eelistada rünnata ükskõik mida.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainNatureRules
en: Another POKéMON may prefer to protect itself from any harm.
et: Teine POKéMON võib eelistada enda kaitsmist mis tahes kahju eest.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainNatureRules
en: Yet another may enjoy vexing or confounding its foes.
et: Ometi võib teine nautida vekseldamist või oma vaenlaste segamist.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainNatureRules
en: Depending on its nature, a POKéMON will have favorite moves that it is good at using.
et: Olenevalt oma olemusest on POKéMON-l lemmikvõtted, mida ta on hea kasutada.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainNatureRules
en: It may also dislike certain moves that it has trouble using.
et: Samuti ei pruugi see meeldida teatud käikudele, mille kasutamisega on tal raskusi.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainMoveRules
en: There are offensive moves that inflict direct damage on the foe.
et: On ründavaid käike, mis tekitavad vaenlasele otsest kahju.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainMoveRules
en: There are defensive moves that are used to prepare for enemy attacks or used to heal HP and so on.
et: On kaitsevõtteid, mida kasutatakse vaenlase rünnakute ettevalmistamiseks või kasutatakse tervendamiseks HP ja nii edasi.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainMoveRules
en: There are also other somewhat-odd moves that may enfeeble the foes with stat problems including poison and paralysis.
et: On ka teisi mõnevõrra väikeseid käike, mis võivad fännata vargaid, kellel on statistilised probleemid, sealhulgas mürk ja halvatus.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainMoveRules
en: POKéMON will consider using moves in these three categories.
et: POKéMON kaalub käikude kasutamist nendes kolmes kategoorias.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainUnderpoweredRules
en: When not under command by its TRAINER, a POKéMON may be unable to effectively use certain moves.
et: Kui see ei ole oma TRAINER käsu all, ei pruugi POKéMON teatud käike tõhusalt kasutada.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainUnderpoweredRules
en: A POKéMON is not good at using any move that it dislikes.
et: A POKéMON ei ole hea kasutada ühtegi võtet, mis talle ei meeldi.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainUnderpoweredRules
en: If a POKéMON only knows moves that do not match its nature, it will often be unable to live up to its potential.
et: Kui POKéMON teab ainult käike, mis ei vasta tema olemusele, ei suuda ta sageli oma potentsiaali järgi elada.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainWhenInDangerRules
en: Depending on its nature, a POKéMON may start using moves that don't match its nature when it is in trouble.
et: Olenevalt oma olemusest võib POKéMON hakata kasutama käike, mis ei vasta tema olemusele, kui ta on hädas.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainWhenInDangerRules
en: If a POKéMON begins behaving oddly in a pinch, watch it carefully.
et: Kui POKéMON hakkab näpuotsaga veidralt käituma, jälgi seda hoolikalt.

label: BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainLevelRules
en: At this BATTLE TENT, the levels of your opponents will be adjusted to match the levels of your POKéMON.
et: Selle BATTLE TENT juures kohandatakse teie vastaste taset vastavalt teie POKéMON tasemetele.

label: BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainLevelRules
en: However, no TRAINER you face will have any POKéMON below Level 30.
et: Kuid no TRAINER te nägu on iga POKéMON alla tase 30.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_RulesAreListed
en: The VERDANTURF BATTLE TENT rules are listed.
et: Loetletud on VERDANTURF BATTLE TENT reeglid.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GiveEnigmaBerry
en: DAD: Hi, {PLAYER}!
et: DAD: Tere, {PLAYER}!

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GiveEnigmaBerry
en: I just received a very rare BERRY. I'd like you to have it.
et: Sain just väga haruldase BERRY. Ma tahaksin, et sul oleks see olemas.

label: Route104_Text_PlantBerriesInSoilTakeThis
en: If you see BERRIES growing in loamy soil, feel free to take them.
et: Kui näed BERRIES kasvamas savisel pinnasel, võta neid julgelt.

label: Route104_Text_PlantBerriesInSoilTakeThis
en: But make sure you plant a BERRY in the same spot. That's common courtesy.
et: Aga veenduge, et istutate BERRY samasse kohta. See on tavaline viisakus.

label: Route104_Text_PlantBerriesInSoilTakeThis
en: Here, I'll share this with you.
et: Siin ma jagan seda teiega.

label: Route104_Text_TrainersOftenMakeMonHoldBerries
en: The way you look, you must be a TRAINER, no?
et: Kuidas sa välja näed, sa pead olema TRAINER, ei?

label: Route104_Text_TrainersOftenMakeMonHoldBerries
en: TRAINERS often make POKéMON hold BERRIES.
et: TRAINERS sageli teha POKéMON hoida BERRIES.

label: Route104_Text_TrainersOftenMakeMonHoldBerries
en: It's up to you whether to grow BERRIES or use them.
et: Iseasi, kas kasvatada BERRIES või kasutada neid.

label: Route111_Text_WateredPlantsEveryDayTakeBerry
en: I watered the plants every day. They grew lots of flowers.
et: Kastsin taimi iga päev. Nad kasvatasid palju lilli.

label: Route111_Text_WateredPlantsEveryDayTakeBerry
en: And they gave me lots of BERRIES, too.
et: Ja nad andsid mulle palju BERRIES ka.

label: Route111_Text_WateredPlantsEveryDayTakeBerry
en: Here you go! You can have it!
et: Siia sa lähed! Sa võid selle endale saada!

label: Route111_Text_GoingToTryToMakeDifferentColorBerries
en: I'm going to try really hard and make BERRIES in different colors.
et: Ma proovin väga kõvasti ja teen BERRIES erinevates värvides.

label: Route111_Text_GoingToTryToMakeDifferentColorBerries
en: I hope you try hard, too!
et: Loodan, et püüad ka kõvasti!

label: Route111_Text_WhatColorBerriesToLookForToday
en: I wonder what color BERRIES I'll look for today?
et: Huvitav, mis värvi BERRIES I'l täna otsitakse?

label: Route114_Text_LoveUsingBerryCrushShareBerry
en: I love using the BERRY CRUSH machine, so I'm collecting BERRIES.
et: Mulle meeldib kasutada BERRY CRUSH masinat, seega kogun BERRIES.

label: Route114_Text_LoveUsingBerryCrushShareBerry
en: I'll share one with you, if you'd like.
et: Ma jagan teiega ühte, kui soovite.

label: Route114_Text_TryBerryCrushWithFriends
en: You should try the BERRY CRUSH machine with your friends.
et: Sa peaksid proovima BERRY CRUSH masinat oma sõpradega.

label: Route114_Text_FunToThinkAboutBerries
en: Which BERRY should be planted? Should you use or hoard BERRIES?
et: Milline BERRY tuleks istutada? Kas peaks kasutama või varuma BERRIES?

label: Route114_Text_FunToThinkAboutBerries
en: It's fun to think about.
et: Mõelda on lõbus.

label: Route120_Text_BerriesExpressionOfLoveIsntIt
en: BERRIES grow by soaking up sunlight.
et: BERRIES kasvavad, leotades päikesevalgust.

label: Route120_Text_BerriesExpressionOfLoveIsntIt
en: We help the BERRIES grow by watering them regularly.
et: Aitame BERRIES kasvada, kastes neid regulaarselt.

label: Route120_Text_BerriesExpressionOfLoveIsntIt
en: It's an expression of love, isn't it?
et: See on ju armastuse väljendus?

label: Route120_Text_YesYouUnderstand
en: Yes, yes. You understand what I mean.
et: Jah, jah. Sa saad aru, mida ma mõtlen.

label: Route120_Text_YesYouUnderstand
en: You should take this.
et: Sa peaksid seda võtma.

label: Route120_Text_MakeYourOwnImpressions
en: Oh… But it is important to make your own impressions, I guess…
et: Aga oluline on teha ise muljeid, ma arvan...

label: Route120_Text_MakeYourOwnImpressions
en: You can have this.
et: Sa võid seda saada.

label: Route120_Text_BerryIsRareRaiseItWithCare
en: I think that BERRY is rare. I hope you raise it with loving care.
et: Ma arvan, et BERRY on haruldane. Loodan, et kasvatad seda armastava hoolega.

label: Route120_Text_IllGetMoreBerriesFromBerryMaster
en: I'll get more BERRIES from the BERRY MASTER.
et: Ma saan rohkem BERRIES BERRY MASTER-st.

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BerrySuitsYou
en: When it gets right down to it…
et: Kui see jõuab otse alla...

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BerrySuitsYou
en: The same way suits suit me perfectly, a crisp breeze suits the sea.
et: Sama moodi sobib mulle suurepäraselt, karge tuuleiil sobib merele.

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BerrySuitsYou
en: And you, a BERRY suits you to a “T”…
et: Ja sina, a BERRY sobib sulle "T"...

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BerrySuitsYou
en: Why should that be so?
et: Miks see nii peaks olema?

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BecauseYoureTrainer
en: When it gets right down to it…
et: Kui see jõuab otse alla...

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BecauseYoureTrainer
en: It's because you're a TRAINER!
et: See on sellepärast, et sa oled TRAINER!

label: LilycoveCity_Text_PokeblocksSuitPokemon
en: When it gets right down to it…
et: Kui see jõuab otse alla...

label: LilycoveCity_Text_PokeblocksSuitPokemon
en: The way dignified simplicity suits me, {POKEBLOCK}S perfectly suit POKéMON.
et: See, kuidas väärikas lihtsus mulle sobib, {POKEBLOCK}S sobib ideaalselt POKéMON.

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_YoureDeservingOfBerry
en: You may call me the BERRY MASTER.
et: Sa võid mind kutsuda BERRY MASTER.

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_YoureDeservingOfBerry
en: I dream of filling the world with beautiful flowers, so I raise BERRIES and hand them out to everyone.
et: Unistan maailma täitumisest ilusate lilledega, seega tõstan BERRIES ja jagan need kõigile välja.

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_YoureDeservingOfBerry
en: You're deserving of one!
et: Sa oled ühe ära teeninud!

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_WhyBeStingyTakeAnother
en: Why be stingy? Take another!
et: Miks olla kipitav? Võta teine!

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_VisitPrettyPetalFlowerShop
en: Be sure to visit the PRETTY PETAL flower shop near RUSTBORO.
et: Kindlasti külasta PRETTY PETAL lillepoodi RUSTBORO lähedal.

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_VisitPrettyPetalFlowerShop
en: Let flowers fill the world!
et: Las lilled täidavad maailma!

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_DoneForToday
en: I'm done for today. Come again another day.
et: Tänaseks olen valmis. Tule veel üks päev.

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_DoneForToday
en: Let flowers fill the world!
et: Las lilled täidavad maailma!

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_HeardAGoodSayingLately
en: The way my husband grows BERRIES, oh, he's the best in the world.
et: See, kuidas mu mees kasvab BERRIES, oh, ta on maailma parim.

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_HeardAGoodSayingLately
en: He makes me proud, that he does.
et: Ta teeb mind uhkeks, et teeb.

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_HeardAGoodSayingLately
en: Incidentally, child, have you heard a good saying lately?
et: Muide, laps, kas sa oled viimasel ajal kuulnud head ütlust?

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_InspirationalTakeThis
en: Ah! What a remarkable saying! Inspirational, it is!
et: Ah! Milline tähelepanuväärne ütlus! Inspireeriv, on küll!

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_InspirationalTakeThis
en: I want you to have this.
et: Ma tahan, et sul oleks see olemas.

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_GoodSayingTakeThis
en: Oh! A good saying it is. You're quite remarkable.
et: Oh! Hea ütlemine on. Sa oled üsna tähelepanuväärne.

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_GoodSayingTakeThis
en: I want you to have this.
et: Ma tahan, et sul oleks see olemas.

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_JoyNeverGoesOutOfMyLife
en: Our four grandchildren should become more accomplished than my husband.
et: Meie neli lapselast peaksid saama kordaläinumaks kui minu mees.

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_JoyNeverGoesOutOfMyLife
en: Joy never goes out of my life!
et: Rõõm ei lähe kunagi mu elust välja!

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_Ah
en: Ah…
et: Ah...

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_ThisIsPrettyPetalFlowerShop
en: Hello!
et: Tere!

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_ThisIsPrettyPetalFlowerShop
en: This is the PRETTY PETAL flower shop. Spreading flowers all over the world!
et: See on PRETTY PETAL lillepood. Lillede laialivalgumine üle kogu maailma!

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_LearnAboutBerries
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}, would you like to learn about BERRIES?
et: {PLAYER} {KUN}, kas soovite õppida BERRIES kohta?

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_IntroLearnAboutBerries
en: Your name is?
et: Sinu nimi on?

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_IntroLearnAboutBerries
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}. That's a nice name.
et: {PLAYER} {KUN}. See on kena nimi.

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_IntroLearnAboutBerries
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}, would you like to learn about BERRIES?
et: {PLAYER} {KUN}, kas soovite õppida BERRIES kohta?

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_BerriesExplanation
en: BERRIES grow on trees that thrive only in soft, loamy soil.
et: BERRIES kasvavad puudel, mis õitsevad ainult pehmel, savisel pinnasel.

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_BerriesExplanation
en: If you take some BERRIES, be sure to plant one in the loamy soil again.
et: Kui võtad mõne BERRIES, istuta üks kindlasti uuesti savisesse mulda.

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_BerriesExplanation
en: A planted BERRY will soon sprout, grow into a plant, flower beautifully, then grow BERRIES again.
et: Istutatud BERRY varsti tärkab, kasvab taimeks, õitseb ilusti, siis kasvab jälle BERRIES.

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_BerriesExplanation
en: I want to see the whole wide world filled with beautiful flowers. That's my dream.
et: Tahan näha kogu laia maailma, mis on täidetud ilusate lilledega. See on minu unistus.

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_BerriesExplanation
en: Please help me, {PLAYER}{KUN}. Plant BERRIES and bring more flowers into the world.
et: Palun aidake mind, {PLAYER}{KUN}. Istutage BERRIES ja tooge maailma rohkem lilli.

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_FlowersBringHappiness
en: Flowers bring so much happiness to people, don't they?
et: Lilled toovad ju inimestele nii palju õnne?

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_YouCanHaveThis
en: Hello!
et: Tere!

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_YouCanHaveThis
en: The more attention you give to flowers, the more beautifully they bloom.
et: Mida rohkem tähelepanu lilledele annad, seda kaunimalt nad õitsevad.

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_YouCanHaveThis
en: You'll like tending flowers. I'm sure of it. You can have this.
et: Sulle meeldivad lillede kallutamine. Olen selles kindel. Sa võid seda saada.

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_WailmerPailExplanation
en: While BERRY plants are growing, water them with the WAILMER PAIL.
et: Samal ajal kui BERRY taimed kasvavad, kasta neid WAILMER PAIL-ga.

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_WailmerPailExplanation
en: Oh, another thing.
et: Oh, veel üks asi.

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_WailmerPailExplanation
en: If you don't pick BERRIES for a while, they'll drop off onto the ground. But they'll sprout again.
et: Kui sa mõnda aega ei vali BERRIES, siis nad kukuvad maa peale. Aga need võrsuvad jälle.

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_WailmerPailExplanation
en: Isn't that awesome? It's like they have the will to live.
et: Kas see pole mitte äge? Neil oleks justkui elutahe.

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_ImGrowingFlowers
en: I'm trying to be like my big sisters. I'm growing flowers, too!
et: Ma püüan olla nagu mu suured õed. Ma kasvatan ka lilli!

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_ImGrowingFlowers
en: Here you go! It's for you!
et: Siia sa lähed! See on sinu jaoks!

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_MachineMixesBerries
en: You can plant a BERRY and grow it big, or you can make a POKéMON hold it.
et: Sa võid istutada BERRY ja kasvatada seda suureks, või siis panna POKéMON seda hoidma.

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_MachineMixesBerries
en: But now they have a machine that mixes up different BERRIES and makes candies for POKéMON.
et: Aga nüüd on neil masin, mis segab kokku erinevad BERRIES ja teeb kommid POKéMON jaoks.

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_MachineMixesBerries
en: I want some candy, too.
et: Ma tahan ka kommi.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_NameIsKiriHaveOneOfThese
en: Hi, what's your name?
et: Tere, mis su nimi on?

label: SootopolisCity_Text_NameIsKiriHaveOneOfThese
en: … … … … … … … … … Okay. That's nice!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_NameIsKiriHaveOneOfThese
en: My name is KIRI.
et: Minu nimi on KIRI.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_NameIsKiriHaveOneOfThese
en: My mommy and daddy named me that so I would grow healthy and warmhearted. That's what they wished.
et: Minu emme ja issi panid mulle nimeks, et ma kasvaksin terveks ja sooja südamega. Seda nad soovisidki.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_NameIsKiriHaveOneOfThese
en: You can have one of these.
et: Teil võib olla üks selline.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_GiveYouThisBerryToo
en: KIRI will give you this BERRY, too! I really like it lots!
et: KIRI annab sulle selle BERRY ka! Mulle väga meeldib see palju!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_WhatKindOfWishInYourName
en: I wonder what kind of wish is included in your name.
et: Huvitav, milline soov on sinu nimes sees.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_LikeSeasonBornIn
en: Spring, summer, autumn, and winter.
et: Kevad, suvi, sügis ja talv.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_LikeSeasonBornIn
en: If you're born in springtime, do you like the spring, and if you're born in the summer, do you like the summer?
et: Kui oled sündinud kevadisel ajal, kas sulle meeldib kevad ja kui oled sündinud suvel, kas sulle meeldib suvi?

label: SootopolisCity_Text_ThenILoveAutumn
en: Then KIRI was born in the autumn, so I love the autumn!
et: Siis sündis sügisel KIRI, seega armastan sügist!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_ThenILoveAutumn
en: Which season do you like?
et: Milline hooaeg sulle meeldib?

label: SootopolisCity_Text_OhDoesntMatter
en: Oh… It doesn't matter…
et: See pole tähtis...

label: SootopolisCity_Text_OhDoesntMatter
en: There's so much that I want to know…
et: Seda on nii palju, et ma tahan teada...

label: gText_Birch_Welcome
en: Hi! Sorry to keep you waiting!
et: Tere! Vabandust, et teid ootel hoida!

label: gText_Birch_Welcome
en: Welcome to the world of POKéMON!
et: Tere tulemast maailma POKéMON!

label: gText_Birch_Welcome
en: My name is BIRCH.
et: Minu nimi on BIRCH.

label: gText_Birch_Welcome
en: But everyone calls me the POKéMON PROFESSOR.
et: Aga kõik kutsuvad mind POKéMON PROFESSOR.

label: gText_Birch_Pokemon
en: This is what we call a “POKéMON.”
et: Seda me nimetamegi "POKéMON".

label: gText_Birch_MainSpeech
en: This world is widely inhabited by creatures known as POKéMON.
et: Selles maailmas elavad laialdaselt olendid, keda tuntakse nime all POKéMON.

label: gText_Birch_MainSpeech
en: We humans live alongside POKéMON, at times as friendly playmates, and at times as cooperative workmates.
et: Meie, inimesed, elame POKéMON kõrval, kohati sõbralike mängukaaslastena ja kohati koostööaltide töökaaslastena.

label: gText_Birch_MainSpeech
en: And sometimes, we band together and battle others like us.
et: Ja vahel me bännime koos ja võitleme teiste meiesugustega.

label: gText_Birch_MainSpeech
en: But despite our closeness, we don't know everything about POKéMON.
et: Kuid vaatamata lähedusele ei tea me kõike POKéMON kohta.

label: gText_Birch_MainSpeech
en: In fact, there are many, many secrets surrounding POKéMON.
et: Tegelikult on palju, palju saladusi ümbritsevad POKéMON.

label: gText_Birch_MainSpeech
en: To unravel POKéMON mysteries, I've been undertaking research. That's what I do.
et: Et lahti harutada POKéMON müsteeriume, olen teinud uurimistööd. Seda ma teengi.

label: gText_Birch_AndYouAre
en: And you are?
et: Ja sina oled?

label: gText_Birch_BoyOrGirl
en: Are you a boy? Or are you a girl?
et: Kas sa oled poiss? Või oled tüdruk?

label: gText_Birch_WhatsYourName
en: All right. What's your name?
et: Hea küll. Mis su nimi on?

label: gText_Birch_SoItsPlayer
en: So it's {PLAYER}{KUN}?
et: See on siis {PLAYER}{KUN}?

label: gText_Birch_YourePlayer
en: Ah, okay!
et: Ah, okei!

label: gText_Birch_YourePlayer
en: You're {PLAYER}{KUN} who's moving to my hometown of LITTLEROOT. I get it now!
et: Sa oled {PLAYER}{KUN} kes kolib minu kodulinna LITTLEROOT. Ma saan nüüd aru!

label: gText_Birch_AreYouReady
en: All right, are you ready?
et: Olgu, kas oled valmis?

label: gText_Birch_AreYouReady
en: Your very own adventure is about to unfold.
et: Sinu enda seiklus hakkab avanema.

label: gText_Birch_AreYouReady
en: Take courage, and leap into the world of POKéMON where dreams, adventure, and friendships await!
et: Võta julgus ja hüppa maailma POKéMON kus ootavad unistused, seiklused ja sõprussuhted!

label: gText_Birch_AreYouReady
en: Well, I'll be expecting you later. Come see me in my POKéMON LAB.
et: Eks ma ootan sind hiljem. Tule vaata mind minu POKéMON LAB.

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendWithTheBlendMaster
en: BLEND MASTER: Indeed I am! The BLEND MASTER am I!
et: BLEND MASTER: Tõepoolest olen! BLEND MASTER olen mina!

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendWithTheBlendMaster
en: Blend with me, and you shall witness the mastery I bring to blending!
et: Segu minuga ja sa oled tunnistajaks meisterlikkusele, mille ma segamiseni toon!

label: BerryBlender_Text_SeeMyMasteryInAction
en: BLEND MASTER: Hmmm! So, you wish to see my mastery in action?
et: BLEND MASTER: Hmmm! Nii et, te soovite näha minu meisterlikkust tegevuses?

label: BerryBlender_Text_TooBusyNowIsee
en: Hmmm!
et: Hmmm!

label: BerryBlender_Text_TooBusyNowIsee
en: So, you are too busy now, I see!
et: Nii et, teil on nüüd liiga kiire, ma näen!

label: BerryBlender_Text_TooBusyNowIsee
en: But fear not! I shall be here all day! Hurry back from your errand!
et: Aga karda mitte! Ma olen siin terve päeva! Kiirusta oma errandist tagasi!

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterNoBerries
en: Hmmm!
et: Hmmm!

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterNoBerries
en: You haven't got a single BERRY!
et: Sa ei ole saanud ühtegi BERRY!

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterNoBerries
en: I shall be here all day! Hurry back with some BERRIES!
et: Ma olen siin terve päeva! Kiirustage tagasi mõne BERRIES!

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterKnowHowToMakePokeblocks
en: Of course! Of course!
et: Muidugi! Muidugi!

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterKnowHowToMakePokeblocks
en: Incidentally… You do know how to blend {POKEBLOCK}S from BERRIES?
et: Muide, sa tead, kuidas {POKEBLOCK}S BERRIES?

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterExplainBerryBlending
en: Hmmm!
et: Hmmm!

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterExplainBerryBlending
en: Ah, but it is a simple process!
et: Ah, aga see on lihtne protsess!

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterExplainBerryBlending
en: When the BLENDER's arrow comes to your marker, just press the A Button.
et: Kui BLENDER nool tuleb teie markerile, vajutage lihtsalt A-nuppu.

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterExplainBerryBlending
en: That's all you have to do.
et: Muud polegi vaja teha.

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterExplainBerryBlending
en: When you see how precisely I press the A Button, you will understand.
et: Kui sa näed, kui täpselt ma A-nuppu vajutan, siis saad aru.

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterLetsBerryBlender
en: Fine!
et: Hea küll!

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterLetsBerryBlender
en: Let's get started, then!
et: Alustame siis!

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterLetsBerryBlender
en: All together with the BLEND MASTER, let's BERRY BLENDER!
et: Kõik koos BLEND MASTER, teeme BERRY BLENDER!

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterNoPokeblockCase
en: Hmmm!
et: Hmmm!

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterNoPokeblockCase
en: You don't appear to have gotten the {POKEBLOCK} CASE!
et: Sa ei paista olevat saanud {POKEBLOCK} CASE!

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterNoPokeblockCase
en: I shall be here all day! Obtain the {POKEBLOCK} CASE and hurry back!
et: Ma olen siin terve päeva! Saada {POKEBLOCK} CASE ja kiirusta tagasi!

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterPokeblockCaseFull
en: Hmmm!
et: Hmmm!

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterPokeblockCaseFull
en: Your {POKEBLOCK} CASE appears to be full!
et: Sinu {POKEBLOCK} CASE tundub olevat täis!

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterPokeblockCaseFull
en: I shall be here all day! Use some {POKEBLOCK}S and hurry back!
et: Ma olen siin terve päeva! Kasuta mõnda {POKEBLOCK}S ja kiirusta tagasi!

label: BerryBlender_Text_WhoaAwesome
en: Whoa! Awesome!
et: Vot! Äge!

label: BerryBlender_Text_WickedlyFast
en: Wickedly fast!
et: Kurjalt kiire!

label: BerryBlender_Text_WhatAnExpert
en: What an expert!
et: Milline ekspert!

label: BerryBlender_Text_MadeAmazingPokeblocksWithMaster
en: When I blended with the MASTER, we made amazing {POKEBLOCK}S!
et: Kui ma segunesin MASTER-ga, siis tegime hämmastava {POKEBLOCK}S!

label: BerryBlender_Text_QualitiesOfBlendMaster
en: Eyes that track the arrow with machinelike intensity…
et: Silmad, mis jälgivad noolt mahhineelse intensiivsusega...

label: BerryBlender_Text_QualitiesOfBlendMaster
en: A hand that taps the A Button with clockwork-like precision…
et: Käsi, mis koputab A-nuppu kellavärgilaadse täpsusega...

label: BerryBlender_Text_QualitiesOfBlendMaster
en: Possessing these qualities makes the BLEND MASTER truly great.
et: Nende omaduste valdamine muudab BLEND MASTER tõeliselt suureks.

label: BerryBlender_Text_MasterWorksOnSkillsInMountains
en: The BLEND MASTER's supposed to work on his skills deep in the mountains.
et: BLEND MASTER peaks töötama oma oskuste kallal sügaval mägedes.

label: BerryBlender_Text_MasterWorksOnSkillsInMountains
en: Sometimes, he comes to LILYCOVE to blend BERRIES all day long.
et: Vahel tuleb ta LILYCOVE juurde, et terve päev BERRIES seguneda.

label: EventTicket_Text_ShowOldSeaMap
en: The ferry to SLATEPORT is…
et: Praam SLATEPORT on...

en: I beg your pardon? Can we sail to this place on the map?
et: Ma anun su armu? Kas me võime selle koha peale kaardil seilata?

label: EventTicket_Text_ShowOldSeaMap
en: I know someone who will help you better. Please wait.
et: Tean kedagi, kes aitab sind paremini. Palun oodake.

en: The ferry to SLATEPORT is…
et: Praam SLATEPORT on...

et: Oh? Et PASS...

label: EventTicket_Text_ShowEonTicket
en: Aye, mate, are you the one who brought that mighty odd PASS?
et: Aye, mate, kas sina oled see, kes tõi selle vägeva veidra PASS?

label: EventTicket_Text_ShowEonTicket
en: I'll tell you, you're trying to reach a tiny spit of an island far in the south.
et: Ma ütlen teile, et te püüate jõuda pisikese süldini, mis asub kaugel lõunas.

label: EventTicket_Text_ShowEonTicket
en: There's no telling what we'll encounter once we reach there, aye. That shivers my timbers!
et: Pole mingit ütlemist, mida me kohtame, kui me sinna jõuame, aye. See väristab mu tämbreid!

label: EventTicket_Text_ShowEonTicket
en: All aboard!
et: Kõik pardal!

label: EventTicket_Text_SouthernIslandSailBack
en: Aye, mate, there's nothing here to see or do on this forgettable island.
et: Aye, mate, siin ei ole siin midagi näha ega teha sellel unustataval saarel.

label: EventTicket_Text_SouthernIslandSailBack
en: What say we sail back to LILYCOVE?
et: Mis ütleb, et me purjetame tagasi LILYCOVE?

label: EventTicket_Text_SailHome
en: Aye, right, then! Sail home we will!
et: Aye, eks siis! Purje koju me teeme!

label: EventTicket_Text_AsYouLike
en: Aye, right, as you like, then.
et: Aye, eks, nii nagu tahad, siis.

label: SouthernIsland_Interior_Text_Sign
en: “All dreams are but another reality. Never forget…”
et: "Kõik unistused on vaid teine reaalsus. Ära kunagi unusta..."

label: SouthernIsland_Exterior_Text_Sign
en: “Those whose memories fade seek to carve them in their hearts…”
et: "Need, kelle mälestused hääbuvad, püüavad neid oma südamesse nikerdada..."

label: EventTicket_Text_OldSeaMapTooFar
en: What's up, youngster?
et: Mis värk on, nooruk?

label: EventTicket_Text_OldSeaMapTooFar
en: What, it's you who's supposed to have a tattered old map?
et: Mis, see oled sina, kellel peaks olema räsitud vana kaart?

label: EventTicket_Text_OldSeaMapTooFar
en: Let's have a look. … … … … … …

label: EventTicket_Text_OldSeaMapTooFar
en: Boy, this is quite a ways away. I'm afraid I can't help you…
et: Poiss, see on üsna kaugel. Ma kardan, et ma ei saa sind aidata...
