et: BRINEY: Hoia sekundit!

label: EventTicket_Text_BrineyHoldOnASecond
en: What's the idea of turning down someone that I owe so much to?
et: Mis mõte on kellelegi ära öelda, kellele ma nii palju võlgu olen?

label: EventTicket_Text_BrineyLetsSail
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}, I'm terribly sorry.
et: {PLAYER} {KUN}, mul on kohutavalt kahju.

label: EventTicket_Text_BrineyLetsSail
en: You came to me seeking my help, and we almost turned you away.
et: Sa tulid minu juurde minu abi otsima ja me peaaegu pöörasime su eemale.

label: EventTicket_Text_BrineyLetsSail
en: Well, let me make things right.
et: No las ma teen asjad korda.

label: EventTicket_Text_BrineyLetsSail
en: We'll sail right away, of course!
et: Purjetame muidugi kohe!

label: EventTicket_Text_BrineyLetsSail
en: Let's find this island on this OLD SEA MAP!
et: Leiame selle saare siit OLD SEA MAP!

label: EventTicket_Text_OddTicketGetOnBoard
en: Is it you who brought that odd ticket?
et: Kas teie tõite selle veidra pileti?

label: EventTicket_Text_OddTicketGetOnBoard
en: Where you're trying to go is an island that's far, far away.
et: Kuhu sa püüad minna, on saar, mis on kaugel, kaugel.

label: EventTicket_Text_OddTicketGetOnBoard
en: No one knows what awaits there…
et: Keegi ei tea, mis seal ees ootab...

label: EventTicket_Text_OddTicketGetOnBoard
en: The very thought excites my blood as a sailing man!
et: Just see mõte erutab mu verd kui purjetaja!

label: EventTicket_Text_OddTicketGetOnBoard
en: Get on board, youngster!
et: Astuge pardale, nooruk!

et: CAPT. BRINEY võib olla nii hullult heitlik...

label: FarawayIsland_Entrance_Text_SailorReturn
en: Do you want to return to LILYCOVE?
et: Kas soovite naasta LILYCOVE?

label: BirthIsland_Harbor_Text_SailorReturn

et: Milline veidra kujuga saar, eh? Kas soovite naasta LILYCOVE?

et: Need piletid viivad teid saartele, mis on kaugel, kaugel.

label: EventTicket_Text_OddTicketsWhereTo
en: No one knows what awaits there, or what may happen there.
et: Keegi ei tea, mis seal ees ootab või mis seal juhtuda võib.

en: The very thought excites my blood as a sailing man!
et: Just see mõte erutab mu verd kui purjetaja!

et: Astuge pardale, nooruk! Kuhu me kõigepealt purjetame?

label: MatchCall_Text_Steven4
en: STEVEN: Hello? {PLAYER}{KUN}?
et: STEVEN: Tere? {PLAYER} {KUN}?

label: MatchCall_Text_Steven4
en: I'm involved in a spot of trouble at the SPACE CENTER.
et: Olen seotud probleemide kohaga SPACE CENTER.

label: MatchCall_Text_Steven4
en: I'm sorry, but I can't talk now. Bye!
et: Vabandust, aga ma ei saa nüüd rääkida. Bye!

label: MatchCall_Text_Steven5
en: STEVEN: Oh! {PLAYER}{KUN}!
et: STEVEN: Oh! {PLAYER}{KUN}!

label: MatchCall_Text_Steven5
en: There's no need to talk. It's past time for talking.
et: Pole vaja rääkida. On viimane aeg rääkida.

label: MatchCall_Text_Steven5
en: You have to believe in yourself and do what's right.
et: Tuleb uskuda endasse ja teha seda, mis on õige.

label: MatchCall_Text_Steven6
en: STEVEN appears not to be getting the call…
et: STEVEN tundub, et ei saada kõne...

label: MatchCall_Text_Steven7
en: STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}… Congratulations for entering the HALL OF FAME.
et: STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}... Palju õnne HALL OF FAME sisenemiseks.

label: MatchCall_Text_Steven7
en: I hope we can meet again somewhere!
et: Loodan, et saame kuskil jälle kokku!

label: MatchCall_Text_BirchRegisterCall
en: PROF. BIRCH: Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}! I've already heard about you!
et: PROF. BIRCH: Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}! Ma olen sinust juba kuulnud!

label: MatchCall_Text_BirchRegisterCall
en: It seems your POKéNAV's been upgraded with MATCH CALL.
et: Tundub, et sinu POKéNAV on täiendatud MATCH CALL-ga.

label: MatchCall_Text_BirchRegisterCall
en: Well, I should register, too!
et: No ma peaks ka registreeruma!

label: MatchCall_Text_BirchRegisterCall
en: That way, I'd be able to examine your POKéDEX even while you're out in the field.
et: Nii oleks mul võimalik uurida sinu POKéDEX ka siis, kui oled väljakul.

label: MatchCall_Text_RegisteredBirch
en: Registered PROF. BIRCH in the POKéNAV.
et: Registreerunud PROF. BIRCH in POKéNAV.

label: MatchCall_Text_UnusedProfBirch
en: PROF. BIRCH: When one has both the POKéDEX and POKéNAV, studying POKéMON becomes more fun, eh?
et: PROF. BIRCH: Kui ühel on nii POKéDEX kui ka POKéNAV, muutub õppimine POKéMON lõbusamaks, eh?

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone1
en: MR. STONE: Oh? {PLAYER}{KUN}!
et: MR. STONE: Oh? {PLAYER}{KUN}!

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone1
en: Since you called me, the POKéNAV must be working properly!
et: Kuna sa mulle helistasid, siis peab POKéNAV korralikult töötama!

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone1
en: Other people will be registered, so try calling them up, too!
et: Registreeritakse ka teisi inimesi, nii et proovi neid ka üles kutsuda!

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone1
en: Good! Good! You seem to be quite happy!
et: Tubli! Tubli! Tundub, et oled üsna õnnelik!

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone1
en: Hm… How could I know that?
et: Kuidas ma seda teada sain?

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone1
en: It's because I'm looking down at you from my office window!
et: Põhjuseks see, et ma vaatan sulle oma kontoriaknast alla!

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone1
en: Wahahaha! See you again!
et: Wahahaha! Kohtumiseni veel kord!

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone2
en: MR. STONE: Oh? {PLAYER}{KUN}!
et: MR. STONE: Oh? {PLAYER}{KUN}!

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone2
en: What's wrong? Have you forgotten about that little errand of mine?
et: Mis viga on? Kas sa oled selle minu väikese eksituse unustanud?

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone2
en: I need you to deliver my letter to STEVEN in DEWFORD.
et: Mul on vaja, et annaksite minu kirja STEVEN DEWFORD-sse.

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone2
en: After that, deliver our parcel to CAPT. STERN in SLATEPORT.
et: Pärast seda toimetage meie pakk CAPT-le. STERN in SLATEPORT.

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone2
en: You remember, don't you?
et: Mäletate, kas pole?

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone2
en: Now, since I am a busy PRESIDENT, I have to go! Bye-bye!
et: Nüüd, kuna olen hõivatud PRESIDENT, siis pean minema! Nägemist!

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone3
en: MR. STONE: Oh! {PLAYER}{KUN}!
et: MR. STONE: Oh! {PLAYER}{KUN}!

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone3
en: Ah, so you've met STEVEN! I'd better reward you, then!
et: Ah, nii et oled kohanud STEVEN! Ma parem premeerin sind siis!

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone3
en: When you visit RUSTBORO again, come see me at my office.
et: Kui külastad uuesti RUSTBORO, tule vaata mind minu kontoris.

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone3
en: I'll be waiting for you!
et: Jään sind ootama!

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone4
en: MR. STONE: Oh! {PLAYER}{KUN}!
et: MR. STONE: Oh! {PLAYER}{KUN}!

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone4
en: Did you know that DEVON was digging the RUSTURF TUNNEL?
et: Kas teadsid, et DEVON kaevas RUSTURF TUNNEL?

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone4
en: But we shut down the operation to protect the POKéMON in the area.
et: Aga me sulgesime operatsiooni, et kaitsta POKéMON piirkonnas.

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone4
en: It's a no-brainer, really.
et: See on ajuvaba, tõesti.

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone4
en: It's more important to let POKéMON live in peace than worry about our own convenience.
et: Olulisem on lasta POKéMON elada rahus, kui muretseda oma mugavuse pärast.

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone5
en: MR. STONE: Hello, hello, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
et: MR. STONE: Tere, tere, {PLAYER}{KUN}!

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone5
en: I heard from someone in PETALBURG that you're NORMAN's child!
et: Kuulsin kelleltki PETALBURG, et oled NORMAN laps!

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone5
en: No wonder you're such a capable being!
et: Pole ime, et sa nii võimekas olend oled!

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone6
en: MR. STONE: What's that?
et: MR. STONE: Mis see on?

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone6
en: You battled your own father and defeated him?
et: Võitlesid omaenda isaga ja võitsid teda?

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone6
en: That's astounding!
et: See on hämmastav!

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone6
en: I had no idea that I befriended someone so special! Wahaha!
et: Mul polnud aimugi, et sõbrunesin kellegi nii erilisega! Wahaha!

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone7
en: Hello! This is DEVON CORPORATI… Oh, hello, {PLAYER}!
et: Tere! See on DEVON CORPORATI... Oh, tere, {PLAYER}!

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone7
en: Our PRESIDENT was here a little while ago, but he's gone out.
et: Meie PRESIDENT oli siin natuke aega tagasi, aga ta on välja läinud.

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone7
en: Our PRESIDENT is busy, but you seem to be just as busy, {PLAYER}.
et: Meie PRESIDENT on hõivatud, kuid tundub, et teil on sama kiire, {PLAYER}.

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone8
en: …Huh? …What's that?
et: ...Huh? ...mis see on?

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone8
en: GROU… Yes? …DON?
et: GROU... Jah? ...DON?

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone8
en: You're breaking up… …can't hear…
et: Sa lähed lahku... ... ei kuule...

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone8
en: BZZZZ…
et: BZZZZ...

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone9
en: …Huh? …What's that?
et: ...Huh? ...mis see on?

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone9
en: Seaflo… Yes? …Caver…?
et: Seaflo... jah? ...kaver...?

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone9
en: You're breaking up… …can't hear…
et: Sa lähed lahku... ... ei kuule...

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone9
en: BZZZZ…
et: BZZZZ...

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone10
en: MR. STONE: {PLAYER}{KUN}! It's me!
et: MR. STONE: {PLAYER}{KUN}! See olen mina!

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone10
en: You were apparently involved in all sorts of things, but I, being busy, haven't a clue exactly what!
et: Sa olid ilmselt seotud igasuguste asjadega, aga mina, olles hõivatud, ei ole aimugi, mida täpselt!

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone10
en: However, I urge you to take the road you believe in and walk it.
et: Siiski kutsun teid üles võtma ette tee, millesse te usute ja kõndima.

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone10
en: I'll always be in your corner! Take care!
et: Ma olen alati sinu nurgas! Hoolitsege!

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone11
en: MR. STONE: … … … … … … Is this maybe {PLAYER}{KUN}?
et: MR. STONE: ... ... ... ... ... Kas see on ehk {PLAYER} {KUN}?

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone11
en: Your voice is so full of confidence, I didn't recognize you right off!
et: Su hääl on nii enesekindlust täis, et ma ei tundnud sind kohe ära!

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone11
en: Hm! You must come visit us at DEVON sometime!
et: Hm! Sa pead meile külla tulema DEVON millalgi!

label: GiddyText_SoPretty
en: so pretty!
et: nii ilus!

label: GiddyText_SoDarling
en: so darling!
et: nii kallis!

label: GiddyText_SoRelaxed
en: so relaxed!
et: nii lõdvestunud!

label: GiddyText_SoSunny
en: so sunny!
et: nii päikseline!

label: GiddyText_SoDesirable
en: so desirable!
et: nii soovitav!

label: GiddyText_SoExciting
en: so exciting!
et: nii põnev!

label: GiddyText_SoAmusing
en: so amusing!
et: nii lõbus!

label: GiddyText_SoMagical
en: so magical!
et: nii maagiline!

label: GiddyText_Is
en: is
et: on

label: GiddyText_DontYouAgree
en: Don't you agree?
et: Kas te ei ole nõus?

label: GiddyText_ISoWantToGoOnAVacation
en: I so want to go on a vacation. Would you happen to know a nice place?
et: Ma nii väga tahan puhkusele minna. Kas sa juhtuksid mõnda toredat kohta teadma?

label: GiddyText_IBoughtCrayonsWith120Colors
en: I bought crayons with 120 colors! Don't you think that's nice?
et: Ostsin 120 värviga värvipliiatsid! Kas te ei arva, et see on tore?

label: GiddyText_WouldntItBeNiceIfWeCouldFloat
en: Wouldn't it be nice if we could float away on a cloud of bubbles?
et: Kas poleks tore, kui saaks mullipilve peal ära ujuda?

label: GiddyText_WhenYouWriteOnASandyBeach
en: When you write on a sandy beach, they wash away. It makes me sad.
et: Liivarannale kirjutades pesevad nad end ära. See teeb mind kurvaks.

label: GiddyText_WhatsTheBottomOfTheSeaLike
en: What's the bottom of the sea like? Just once I would so love to go!
et: Milline on mere põhi? Lihtsalt üks kord ma nii väga tahaks minna!

label: GiddyText_WhenYouSeeTheSettingSunDoesIt
en: When you see the setting sun, does it make you want to go home?
et: Kui näed loojuvat päikest, kas see tekitab tahtmise koju minna?

label: GiddyText_LyingBackInTheGreenGrass
en: Lying back in the green grass… Oh, it's so, so nice!
et: Lamades tagasi rohelises rohus... Oh, see on nii, nii tore!

label: GiddyText_SecretBasesAreSoWonderful
en: SECRET BASES are so wonderful! Can't you feel the excitement?
et: SECRET BASES on nii imelised! Kas põnevust ei saa tunda?

label: MoveTutor_Text_ThisMoveCanOnlyBeLearnedOnce
en: This move can be learned only once. Is that okay?
et: Seda käiku saab õppida vaid üks kord. Kas sellega on kõik korras?

label: MoveTutor_Text_SwaggerTeach
en: Heh! My POKéMON totally rules! It's cooler than any POKéMON!
et: Heh! Minu POKéMON täiesti reeglid! See on lahedam kui mõni POKéMON!

label: MoveTutor_Text_SwaggerTeach
en: I was lipping off with a swagger in my step like that when the CHAIRMAN chewed me out.
et: Ma lippasin oma sammus sellise kiiksuga maha, kui CHAIRMAN mind välja näris.

label: MoveTutor_Text_SwaggerTeach
en: That took the swagger out of my step.
et: See võttis kiige minu sammust välja.

label: MoveTutor_Text_SwaggerTeach
en: If you'd like, I'll teach the move SWAGGER to a POKéMON of yours.
et: Kui soovid, siis õpetan võtte SWAGGER sinu POKéMON juurde.

label: MoveTutor_Text_SwaggerDeclined
en: What, no? Can't you get into the spirit of things?
et: Mida, ei? Kas asjade vaimu sisse ei saa?

label: MoveTutor_Text_SwaggerWhichMon
en: All right, which POKéMON wants to learn how to SWAGGER?
et: Hea küll, mis POKéMON tahab õppida SWAGGER?

label: MoveTutor_Text_SwaggerTaught
en: I'll just praise my POKéMON from now on without the swagger.
et: Kiidan lihtsalt oma POKéMON nüüdsest ilma swaggerita.

label: MoveTutor_Text_RolloutTeach
en: Did you know that you can go from here a long way in that direction without changing direction?
et: Kas teadsid, et siit võib minna kaugele selles suunas ilma suunda muutmata?

label: MoveTutor_Text_RolloutTeach
en: I might even be able to roll that way.
et: Ma võin isegi nii veereda.

label: MoveTutor_Text_RolloutTeach
en: Do you think your POKéMON will want to roll, too?
et: Kas sa arvad, et ka sinu POKéMON tahab veereda?

label: MoveTutor_Text_RolloutTeach
en: I can teach one the move ROLLOUT if you'd like.
et: Ma võin õpetada ühte võtet ROLLOUT kui soovite.

label: MoveTutor_Text_RolloutDeclined
en: You don't need to be shy about it. Let's roll!
et: Selle üle pole vaja häbelik olla. Rullime!

label: MoveTutor_Text_RolloutWhichMon
en: Ehehe, sure thing! It'd be great if the POKéMON looked like me.
et: Ehehe, kindel asi! Oleks tore, kui POKéMON näeks välja nagu mina.

label: MoveTutor_Text_RolloutTaught
en: Rolling around in the grass makes me happy. Come on, let's roll!
et: Rohus ringi veeremine teeb mind õnnelikuks. Ole nüüd, veereme!

label: MoveTutor_Text_FuryCutterTeach
en: There's a move that gets stronger when you keep using it in a row.
et: On üks võte, mis muutub tugevamaks, kui seda järjest pidevalt kasutada.

label: MoveTutor_Text_FuryCutterTeach
en: It's a BUG-type move, and it is wickedly cool.
et: See on Putuk tüüpi käik ja see on kurjalt lahe.

label: MoveTutor_Text_FuryCutterTeach
en: It's called FURY CUTTER. Want me to teach it to a POKéMON?
et: Selle nimi on FURY CUTTER. Tahad, et õpetaksin seda POKéMON?

label: MoveTutor_Text_FuryCutterDeclined
en: We're not on the same wavelength.
et: Me ei ole samal lainepikkusel.

label: MoveTutor_Text_FuryCutterWhichMon
en: Yay! Show me which POKéMON I should teach.
et: Yay! Näita mulle, millist POKéMON peaksin õpetama.

label: MoveTutor_Text_FuryCutterTaught
en: I get a thrill watching to see if the move keeps hitting in succession!
et: Mul tekib põnevus vaadata, kas käik muudkui lööb järjest!

label: MoveTutor_MimicTeach
en: Ah, young one!
et: Ah, noor!

label: MoveTutor_MimicTeach
en: I am also a young one, but I mimic the styles and speech of the elderly folks of this town.
et: Olen ka noor, kuid matkin selle linna eakate inimeste stiile ja kõnepruuki.

label: MoveTutor_MimicTeach
en: What do you say, young one? Would you agree to it if I were to offer to teach the move MIMIC?
et: Mida sa ütled, noor? Kas te oleksite sellega nõus, kui ma pakuksin, et õpetaksin kolimist MIMIC?

label: MoveTutor_MimicDeclined
en: Oh, boo! I wanted to teach MIMIC to your POKéMON!
et: Oi, virise! Tahtsin õpetada MIMIC oma POKéMON!

label: MoveTutor_Text_MimicWhichMon
en: Fwofwo! And so I shall! Let me see the POKéMON you wish me to teach.
et: Fwofwo! Ja nii ma teengi! Lubage mul näha POKéMON te soovite, et ma õpetaksin.

label: MoveTutor_Text_MimicTaught
en: MIMIC is a move of great depth.
et: MIMIC on suure sügavusega võte.

label: MoveTutor_Text_MimicTaught
en: Could you execute it to perfection as well as me…?
et: Kas sa saaksid selle täide viia nii täiuslikkuseni kui ka minuni...?

label: MoveTutor_Text_MetronomeTeach
en: I want all sorts of things! But I used up my allowance…
et: Ma tahan igasuguseid asju! Aga ma kasutasin ära oma toetuse...

label: MoveTutor_Text_MetronomeTeach
en: Wouldn't it be nice if there were a spell that made money appear when you waggle a finger?
et: Kas poleks tore, kui oleks loits, mis pani näpuga vehkides raha ilmuma?

label: MoveTutor_Text_MetronomeTeach
en: If you want, I can teach your POKéMON the move METRONOME.
et: Kui soovite, võin õpetada teie POKéMON võtet METRONOME.

label: MoveTutor_Text_MetronomeTeach
en: Money won't appear, but your POKéMON will waggle a finger. Yes?
et: Raha ei paista, aga sinu POKéMON liputab näpuga. Jah?

label: MoveTutor_Text_MetronomeDeclined
en: Okay. I'll be here if you change your mind.
et: Olgu. Ma olen siin, kui sa meelt muudad.

label: MoveTutor_Text_MetronomeWhichMon
en: Okay! I'll teach it! Which POKéMON should I teach?
et: Olgu! Õpetan seda! Millist POKéMON peaksin õpetama?

label: MoveTutor_Text_MetronomeTaught
en: When a POKéMON waggles its finger like a METRONOME, all sorts of nice things happen.
et: Kui POKéMON liputab oma sõrme nagu METRONOME, juhtub igasuguseid toredaid asju.

label: MoveTutor_Text_MetronomeTaught
en: Wouldn't it be nice if we could use it, too?
et: Kas poleks tore, kui me seda ka kasutaksime?

label: MoveTutor_Text_SleepTalkTeach
en: Humph! My wife relies on HIDDEN POWER to stay awake.
et: Humph! Minu naine toetub HIDDEN POWER ärkvel püsimisele.

label: MoveTutor_Text_SleepTalkTeach
en: She should just take a nap like I do, and SLEEP TALK.
et: Ta peaks lihtsalt uinaku tegema nagu mina ja SLEEP TALK.

label: MoveTutor_Text_SleepTalkTeach
en: I can teach your POKéMON how to SLEEP TALK instead. Interested?
et: Ma saan õpetada oma POKéMON kuidas SLEEP TALK asemel. Huvilised?

label: MoveTutor_Text_SleepTalkDeclined
en: Oh, fine, fine. You want to stay awake with HIDDEN POWER, too…
et: Oh, hea küll, hea küll. Tahad ärkvel olla HIDDEN POWER ka...

label: MoveTutor_Text_SleepTalkWhichMon
en: Ah, an appreciative child! Which POKéMON should I teach?
et: Ah, hindav laps! Millist POKéMON peaksin õpetama?

label: MoveTutor_Text_SleepTalkTaught
en: I've never once gotten my wife's coin trick right.
et: Ma pole kordagi oma naise münditrikki õigeks saanud.

label: MoveTutor_Text_SleepTalkTaught
en: I would be happy if I got it right even as I SLEEP TALK…
et: Oleksin õnnelik, kui saaksin asja korda ka siis, kui ma SLEEP TALK...

label: MoveTutor_Text_SubstituteTeach
en: When I see the wide world from up here on the roof…
et: Kui ma näen laia maailma siit ülevalt katusel...

label: MoveTutor_Text_SubstituteTeach
en: I think about how nice it would be if there were more than just one me so I could enjoy all sorts of lives.
et: Mõtlen, kui tore oleks, kui mind oleks rohkem kui ainult üks, et saaksin nautida igasuguseid elusid.

label: MoveTutor_Text_SubstituteTeach
en: Of course it's not possible. Giggle…
et: Muidugi pole see võimalik. Giggle...

label: MoveTutor_Text_SubstituteTeach
en: I know! Would you be interested in having a POKéMON learn SUBSTITUTE?
et: Ma tean! Kas oleksite huvitatud, et teil oleks POKéMON õppida SUBSTITUTE?

label: MoveTutor_Text_SubstituteDeclined
en: Oh, no?
et: Oh ei?

label: MoveTutor_Text_SubstituteDeclined
en: A POKéMON can make a copy of itself using it, you know.
et: POKéMON saab teha koopia ise kasutades seda, tead.

label: MoveTutor_Text_SubstituteWhichMon
en: Giggle… Which POKéMON do you want me to teach SUBSTITUTE?
et: Kumba POKéMON kas sa tahad, et ma õpetaks SUBSTITUTE?

label: MoveTutor_Text_SubstituteTaught
en: We human beings should enjoy our own lives to the utmost!
et: Meie, inimesed, peaksime nautima oma elu täiel rinnal!

label: MoveTutor_Text_SubstituteTaught
en: I hope you'll get that way, too!
et: Loodan, et saad ka nii!

label: MoveTutor_Text_DynamicPunchTeach
en: I can't do this anymore!
et: Ma ei saa seda enam teha!

label: MoveTutor_Text_DynamicPunchTeach
en: It's utterly hopeless!
et: See on täiesti lootusetu!

label: MoveTutor_Text_DynamicPunchTeach
en: I'm a FIGHTING-type TRAINER, so I can't win at the MOSSDEEP GYM no matter how hard I try!
et: Olen Kaklus-tüüpi TRAINER, seega ei suuda ma võita MOSSDEEP SAAL ükskõik kui kõvasti ma ka ei prooviks!

label: MoveTutor_Text_DynamicPunchTeach
en: Argh! Punch! Punch! Punch! Punch! Punch! Punch!
et: Argh! Punn! Punn! Punn! Punn! Punn! Punn!

label: MoveTutor_Text_DynamicPunchTeach
en: What, don't look at me that way! I'm only hitting the ground!
et: Mida, ära vaata mind nii! Ma löön ainult vastu maad!

label: MoveTutor_Text_DynamicPunchTeach
en: Or do you want me to teach your POKéMON DYNAMICPUNCH?
et: Või tahad, et õpetaksin sinu POKéMON DYNAMICPUNCH?

label: MoveTutor_Text_DynamicPunchDeclined
en: Darn! You're even making fun of me? Punch! Punch! Punch!
et: Darn! Te isegi teete minu üle nalja? Punn! Punn! Punn!

label: MoveTutor_Text_DynamicPunchWhichMon
en: What? You do? You're a good person! Which POKéMON should I teach?
et: Mida? Kas sa teed? Sa oled hea inimene! Millist POKéMON peaksin õpetama?

label: MoveTutor_Text_DynamicPunchTaught
en: I want you to win at the MOSSDEEP GYM using that DYNAMICPUNCH!
et: Ma tahan, et sa võidaksid MOSSDEEP SAAL kasutades seda DYNAMICPUNCH!

label: MoveTutor_Text_DoubleEdgeTeach
en: Sigh…
et: Ohates...

label: MoveTutor_Text_DoubleEdgeTeach
en: SOOTOPOLIS's GYM LEADER is really lovably admirable.
et: SOOTOPOLIS's SAALI JUHT on tõesti armastusväärselt imetlusväärne.

label: MoveTutor_Text_DoubleEdgeTeach
en: But that also means I have many rivals for his attention.
et: Aga see tähendab ka seda, et mul on tema tähelepanu eest palju rivaale.

label: MoveTutor_Text_DoubleEdgeTeach

en: Seriously, I'm going to cause a huge EXPLOSION of popularity!

label: MoveTutor_Text_ExplosionTaught

en: Maybe it's because deep down, I would rather stay here…

label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan20

label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan30

en: There're a lot of places where you can make a SECRET BASE.
et: On palju kohti, kus saab teha SECRET BASE.

en: But I like this spot best. Don't you think it's nice?

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer5Intro
en: Oh, would you like to have a battle?

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer5AcceptBattle
en: Okay, here goes!
et: Olgu, siin läheb!

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer5DeclineBattle
en: Oh… You can't now, okay.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer5PostBattle

en: This is a popular spot. It's always taken.
et: See on populaarne koht. Seda on alati vaja.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer1Intro
en: Oh! Were you thinking about taking this spot, too?
et: Oh! Kas sa mõtlesid ka selle koha peale võtta?

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer1Intro

en: I can't keep going! I surrender!
et: Ma ei saa edasi minna! Ma alistun!

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer1PostBattle
en: Okay, when I move one day, this place will be yours!
et: Okei, kui ma ühel päeval liigun, on see koht sinu päralt!

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer1PreChampion
en: This is a popular spot. It's always taken.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer1PreChampion
en: I waited a long time for it to open. I finally got to use it!
et: Ootasin kaua, et see avaneks. Lõpuks ometi sain seda kasutada!

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer6Intro
en: Welcome to my POKéMON LAB.
et: Tere tulemast minu POKéMON LAB.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer6Intro
en: I carry out research on battling in secrecy.
et: Teen uurimistööd saladuses võitlemisest.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer6Intro
en: Would you like to see how strong I am?
et: Tahaksite näha, kui tugev ma olen?

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer6AcceptBattle
en: I'm going to go all out!
et: Ma lähen kõik välja!

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer6DeclineBattle
en: Oh. Some other time, then!
et: Oh. Mõni teine kord siis!

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer6Defeated
en: Hmm… I've still got lots to learn. I have to study some more.
et: Hmm... mul on veel palju õppida. Ma pean veel uurima.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer6PostBattle
en: Thanks for battling with me. Please come back again tomorrow.
et: Tänan, et võitlesid minuga. Palun tulge homme uuesti tagasi.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer6PreChampion
en: Welcome to my POKéMON LAB.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer2Intro
en: A big mansion is nice, but I like this sort of place more.
et: Suur mõis on tore, aga mulle meeldib selline koht rohkem.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer2Intro
en: I like it because all kinds of people come visit me.
et: Mulle meeldib, sest igasugused inimesed tulevad mulle külla.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer2Intro
en: So, how would you like a battle?
et: Kuidas sa siis lahingut tahaksid?

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer2AcceptBattle
en: That's the way!
et: Nii see on!

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer2DeclineBattle
en: When you're ready, give me a shout!
et: Kui oled valmis, anna mulle hõige!

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer2Defeated
en: Aww! Done in! But it's still fun to battle!
et: Aww! Tehtud sisse! Aga lahingut on ikka lõbus teha!

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer2PostBattle
en: Well, anyway, I should go buy some decorations and furniture.
et: No igatahes peaks ma minema ostma mingeid kaunistusi ja mööblit.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer2PostBattle
en: I want my SECRET BASE to be a place other people can enjoy.
et: Ma tahan, et mu SECRET BASE oleks koht, mida teised inimesed saaksid nautida.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer2PreChampion
en: A big mansion is nice, but I like this sort of place more.
et: Suur mõis on tore, aga mulle meeldib selline koht rohkem.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer2PreChampion
en: I like it because all kinds of people come visit me.
et: Mulle meeldib, sest igasugused inimesed tulevad mulle külla.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer7Intro
en: I simply adore shopping for decorations and furniture.
et: Ma lihtsalt jumaldan dekoratsioonide ja mööbli ostlemist.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer7Intro
en: I also love raising POKéMON just as much.
et: Mulle meeldib ka tõsta POKéMON sama palju.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer7Intro
en: If you would be so kind, will you battle with my POKéMON?
et: Kui sa oleksid nii lahke, kas sa võitled minu POKéMON?

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer7AcceptBattle
en: Thank you. Shall we begin?
et: Aitähh. Kas alustame?

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer7DeclineBattle
en: Oh. How disappointing…
et: Oh. Kui pettumust valmistav...

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer7Defeated
en: I concede…
et: Ma möönan...

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer7PostBattle
en: That was all in good fun! I should go enjoy shopping now.
et: See kõik oli väga lõbus! Peaksin nüüd shoppamist nautima minema.

en: I also love raising POKéMON just as much.
et: Mulle meeldib ka tõsta POKéMON sama palju.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer3Intro
en: Some people make their SECRET BASES in hard-to-find places. Do they want to just lie low?
et: Mõned inimesed teevad oma SECRET BASES raskesti leitavates kohtades. Kas nad tahavad lihtsalt madalal lamada?

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer3Intro
en: But since you found me, how about we have a battle?
et: Aga kuna sa mu leidsid, siis kuidas oleks, kui meil oleks lahing?

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer3AcceptBattle
en: I'm not going down easily!
et: Ma ei lähe lihtsalt alla!

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer3DeclineBattle
en: Oh… Are you maybe tired from searching for this place?
et: Kas sa oled ehk väsinud selle koha otsimisest?

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer3Defeated
en: I went down…
et: Läksin alla...

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer3PostBattle
en: Where's your SECRET BASE? I should go visit you there.
et: Kus on sinu SECRET BASE? Ma peaks sulle külla minema.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer8Intro
en: People have told me that you can get decorations in several ways.
et: Inimesed on mulle öelnud, et kaunistusi saab mitut moodi.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer8Intro
en: We should have a race to see who can get nicer decorations and furniture!
et: Meil peaks olema võistlus, et näha, kes saab ilusamaid kaunistusi ja mööblit!

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer8Intro
en: In the meantime, want to battle?
et: Vahepeal tahate lahingut pidada?

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer8AcceptBattle
en: This is my SECRET BASE. I can't lose!
et: See on minu SECRET BASE. Ma ei saa kaotada!

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer8DeclineBattle
en: I'll battle with you anytime.

en: I raise my favorite POKéMON and grow stronger with it.
et: Tõstan oma lemmiku POKéMON ja kasvatan sellega tugevamaks.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer4Intro
en: That's what I do. Want to battle with me?
et: Seda ma teengi. Tahad minuga võidelda?

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer4AcceptBattle
en: Show me what you're made of!
et: Näita, millest sa tehtud oled!

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer4DeclineBattle
en: I guess there are times when you're not into it.
et: Küllap on aegu, mil sa ei ole sellesse süvenenud.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer4Defeated
en: I know exactly what you're made of now.
et: Ma tean täpselt, millest sa nüüd tehtud oled.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer4PostBattle
en: We can both become stronger. Let's keep at it!

en: I can make you something good if you bring me the ingredients.
et: Ma võin sulle midagi head teha, kui sa mulle koostisosad kaasa võtad.

label: ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_BringMe4ShoalSaltAndShells
en: If you bring me four each of the SHOAL SALT and SHOAL SHELLS, I can make you a SHELL BELL…
et: Kui sa tood mulle neli iga SHOAL SALT ja SHOAL SHELLS, siis ma võin sulle teha SHELL BELL...

label: ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_BringMe4ShoalSaltAndShells
en: You can get those ingredients every day.
et: Neid koostisosi saab iga päev.

label: ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_WouldYouLikeShellBell
en: Oh, hey! SHOAL SALT and SHOAL SHELLS! And enough of them, too!
et: Oh, kuule! SHOAL SALT ja SHOAL SHELLS! Ja aitab ka neist!

label: ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_WouldYouLikeShellBell
en: Would you like me to make you a SHELL BELL with them?
et: Kas sa tahaksid, et ma teeks sulle SHELL BELL nendega?

label: ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_MakeShellBellRightAway
en: All righty, then! I'll make you a SHELL BELL right away.
et: Hea küll, siis! Teen sulle kohe SHELL BELL.

label: ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_MakeShellBellRightAway
en: There! Done!
et: Seal! Tehtud!

label: ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_ExplainShellBell
en: Have a POKéMON hold on to that. It'll love it, that's for certain.
et: Hoida sellest kinni POKéMON. See meeldib, see on kindel.

label: ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_ExplainShellBell
en: Why, the SHELL BELL's chime… It's simply sublime!
et: Miks, SHELL BELL on chime... See on lihtsalt ülev!

label: ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_ExplainShellBell
en: You can get its ingredients every day, so I can make you more.
et: Selle koostisosad saad kätte iga päev, nii et ma saan sind rohkem teha.

label: ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_WantedToMakeShellBell
en: Oh… Is that so… I wanted to make a SHELL BELL…
et: Kas see on nii... ma tahtsin teha SHELL BELL...

label: ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_NoSpaceInYourBag
en: You don't have space in your BAG if I were to make it for you.
et: Sinu BAG's pole ruumi, kui ma selle sinu jaoks teeksin.

label: ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_NoSpaceInYourBag
en: You should make room and come back for a SHELL BELL.
et: Peaksid ruumi tegema ja tagasi tulema SHELL BELL.

label: ShoalCave_Text_WasShoalSaltNowNothing
en: There was some SHOAL SALT here. But, there's nothing here now.
et: Siin oli mingi SHOAL SALT. Aga, nüüd pole siin midagi.

label: ShoalCave_Text_WasShoallShellNowNothing
en: There was a SHOAL SHELL here. But, there's nothing here now.
et: Siin oli SHOAL SHELL. Aga, nüüd pole siin midagi.

label: gText_WantToUseSurf
en: The water is dyed a deep blue… Would you like to SURF?
et: Vesi on värvitud sügavsiniseks... Sooviks SURF?

label: gText_PlayerUsedSurf
en: {STR_VAR_1} used SURF!
et: {STR_VAR_1} kasutatud SURF!

label: Route102_Text_CalvinIntro
en: If you have POKéMON with you, then you're an official POKéMON TRAINER! You can't say no to my challenge!
et: Kui sul on kaasas POKéMON, siis oled ametlik POKéMON TRAINER! Minu väljakutsele ei saa ei öelda!

label: Route102_Text_CalvinDefeated
en: Arrgh, I lost… I should have trained mine more…
et: Arrgh, ma kaotasin... ma oleks pidanud enda oma rohkem treenima...

label: Route102_Text_CalvinPostBattle
en: Listen, you. If you're strong, you should have told me before!
et: Kuule, sina. Kui sa oled tugev, siis oleksid pidanud seda mulle ka varem ütlema!

label: Route102_Text_CalvinRegister
en: I've been working hard at this since I saw you before.
et: Ma olen selle kallal palju vaeva näinud, sest olen sind varem näinud.

label: Route102_Text_CalvinRegister
en: I'd like to battle you again, so can you register me in your POKéNAV?
et: Tahaks sinuga uuesti võidelda, et kas sa saaksid mind registreerida oma POKéNAV?

label: Route102_Text_CalvinRegisterShort
en: I'd like to battle you again, so can you register me in your POKéNAV?
et: Tahaks sinuga uuesti võidelda, et kas sa saaksid mind registreerida oma POKéNAV?

label: Route102_Text_CalvinRematchIntro
en: Ever since I lost to you, I desperately trained my POKéMON. You can't say no to my challenge!
et: Sellest ajast peale, kui ma sulle kaotasin, treenisin ma meeleheitlikult oma POKéMON. Minu väljakutsele ei saa ei öelda!

label: Route102_Text_CalvinRematchDefeated
en: Arrgh, I lost… Is my training method not right?
et: Arrgh, ma kaotasin... kas mu treeningmeetod ei ole õige?

label: Route102_Text_CalvinRematchPostBattle
en: If you're going to get stronger, I'll get stronger, too.
et: Kui sa lähed tugevamaks, siis muutun ka mina tugevamaks.

label: Route102_Text_AllenIntro
en: Did you just become a TRAINER? We're both beginners!
et: Kas sinust sai lihtsalt TRAINER? Oleme mõlemad algajad!

label: Route102_Text_AllenDefeated
en: I called you because I thought I could beat you…
et: Ma helistasin sulle, sest arvasin, et suudan sind võita...

label: Route102_Text_AllenPostBattle
en: I haven't won once yet… I wish I would win soon…
et: Ma pole veel kordagi võitnud... soovin, et võidaksin varsti...

label: Route102_Text_RickIntro
en: Hahah! Our eyes met! I'll take you on with my BUG POKéMON!
et: Hahah! Meie silmad kohtusid! Võtan teid oma BUG POKéMON!

label: Route102_Text_RickDefeated
en: Ow! Down and out!
et: Ow! Alla ja välja!

label: Route102_Text_RickPostBattle
en: If you lock eyes with a TRAINER, you have to challenge! It's a rule!
et: Kui lukud silmad TRAINER-ga, pead väljakutse tegema! See on reegel!

label: Route102_Text_TianaIntro
en: I'm going to keep winning and aim to be the best TRAINER.
et: Ma jätkan võitu ja eesmärgiks on olla parim TRAINER.

label: Route102_Text_TianaIntro
en: Help me further my career!
et: Aita mul karjääri jätkata!

label: Route102_Text_TianaDefeated
en: I ended up furthering your career…
et: Ma lõpetasin su karjääri jätkamise...

label: Route102_Text_TianaPostBattle
en: To keep winning my way up, I see that I have to catch more POKéMON.
et: Et oma teed edasi võita, näen, et pean rohkem püüdma POKéMON.

label: Route103_Text_DaisyIntro
en: Did you feel the tug of our soul-soothing fragrance?
et: Kas sa tundsid meie hinge rahustava lõhna puksiiri?

label: Route103_Text_DaisyDefeated
en: You weren't led astray by our aroma…
et: Sind ei juhtinud eksiteele meie aroom...

label: Route103_Text_DaisyPostBattle
en: Aromatherapy is a form of mental healing that works with fragrances.
et: Aroomiteraapia on vaimse tervenemise vorm, mis toimib lõhnaainetega.

label: Route103_Text_AmyIntro
en: AMY: I'm AMY. And this is my little sister LIV. We battle together!
et: AMY: Olen AMY. Ja see on minu väike õde LIV. Me võitleme koos!

label: Route103_Text_AmyDefeated
en: AMY: Uh-oh, we lost.
et: AMY: Uh-oh, me kaotasime.

label: Route103_Text_AmyPostBattle
en: AMY: You have to think about all kinds of things when you're battling against two TRAINERS.
et: AMY: Sa pead mõtlema igasugustele asjadele, kui võitled kahe TRAINERS vastu.

label: Route103_Text_AmyNotEnoughPokemon
en: AMY: Uh-oh, you have only one POKéMON with you. You can't battle us like that.
et: AMY: Uh-oh, sul on ainult üks POKéMON kaasas. Sa ei saa meiega niimoodi võidelda.

label: Route103_Text_LivIntro
en: LIV: We battle together as one team.
et: LIV: Me võitleme koos ühe meeskonnana.

label: Route103_Text_LivDefeated
en: LIV: Oh, we lost, big sister…
et: LIV: Oh, me kaotasime, suur õde...

label: Route103_Text_LivPostBattle
en: LIV: We work perfectly together, me and my big sister…
et: LIV: Me töötame suurepäraselt koos, mina ja mu suur õde...

label: Route103_Text_LivPostBattle
en: But we still lost…
et: Aga me ikkagi kaotasime...

label: Route103_Text_AmyLivRegister
en: LIV: Really, we're a lot better… It's true! We'll show you next time!
et: LIV: Tõesti, me oleme palju paremad... see on tõsi! Näitame teile järgmine kord!

label: Route103_Text_LivNotEnoughPokemon
en: LIV: If you want to battle us, you have to have two POKéMON! It's not fair if you don't!
et: LIV: Kui soovite meiega võidelda, peab teil olema kaks POKéMON! See ei ole aus, kui sa seda ei tee!

label: Route103_Text_AmyRematchIntro
en: AMY: I'm AMY. And this is my little sister LIV. We battle together!
et: AMY: Olen AMY. Ja see on minu väike õde LIV. Me võitleme koos!

label: Route103_Text_AmyRematchDefeated
en: AMY: Aww, boo! We couldn't win again…
et: AMY: Aww, boo! Me ei suutnud enam võita...

label: Route103_Text_AmyRematchPostBattle
en: AMY: You have to think about all kinds of things when you're battling against two TRAINERS.
et: AMY: Sa pead mõtlema igasugustele asjadele, kui võitled kahe TRAINERS vastu.

label: Route103_Text_AmyRematchNotEnoughPokemon
en: AMY: Uh-oh, you have only one POKéMON with you. You can't battle us like that.
et: AMY: Uh-oh, sul on ainult üks POKéMON kaasas. Sa ei saa meiega niimoodi võidelda.

label: Route103_Text_LivRematchIntro
en: LIV: We battle together as one team.
et: LIV: Me võitleme koos ühe meeskonnana.

label: Route103_Text_LivRematchDefeated
en: LIV: Awww, we lost again… Big sister…
et: LIV: Awww, kaotasime jälle... suur õde...

label: Route103_Text_LivRematchPostBattle
en: LIV: We work perfectly together, me and my big sister…
et: LIV: Me töötame suurepäraselt koos, mina ja mu suur õde...

label: Route103_Text_LivRematchPostBattle
en: But why did we lose again?
et: Aga miks me jälle kaotasime?

label: Route103_Text_LivRematchNotEnoughPokemon
en: LIV: If you want to battle us, you have to have two POKéMON! It's not fair if you don't!
et: LIV: Kui soovite meiega võidelda, peab teil olema kaks POKéMON! See ei ole aus, kui sa seda ei tee!

label: Route103_Text_AndrewIntro
en: Gah! My fishing line's all snarled up! I'm getting frustrated and mean! That's it! Battle me!
et: Gah! Minu õngenöör on kõik üles snorgeldatud! Ma muutun pettumuseks ja õelaks! Nii ongi! Võitle minuga!

label: Route103_Text_AndrewDefeated
en: Gah! Lost it! I'm even more annoyed now!
et: Gah! Kaotas selle! Ma olen nüüd veel rohkem pahane!

label: Route103_Text_AndrewPostBattle
en: Gah, I'm still boiling mad… Grrrrr…
et: Gah, ma keedan ikka hullult... Grrrrr...

label: Route103_Text_MiguelIntro
en: My POKéMON is delightfully adorable! Don't be shy--I'll show you!
et: Minu POKéMON on veetlevalt võluv! Ära häbene - ma näitan sulle!

label: Route103_Text_MiguelDefeated
en: Oh, my gosh! My darling POKéMON!
et: Oh issand! Minu kallis POKéMON!

label: Route103_Text_MiguelPostBattle
en: My delightful POKéMON looks darling even when it's fainted!
et: Minu veetlev POKéMON näeb kallis välja ka siis, kui see on minestatud!

label: Route103_Text_MiguelRegister
en: I'll get you to come out and look in on my delightful POKéMON again!
et: Ma lasen sul välja tulla ja oma veetleva POKéMON uuesti sisse vaadata!

label: Route103_Text_MiguelRematchIntro
en: Hi, you! My delightfully adorable POKéMON has become more darling!
et: Tere, sina! Minu veetlevalt võluv POKéMON on muutunud kallimaks!

label: Route103_Text_MiguelRematchDefeated
en: Oh! My darling POKéMON!
et: Oh! Minu kallis POKéMON!

label: Route103_Text_MiguelRematchPostBattle
en: The more I spend time with it, the more adorable my POKéMON becomes.
et: Mida rohkem ma sellega aega veedan, seda armsamaks mu POKéMON muutub.

label: Route103_Text_PeteIntro
en: This sort of distance… You should just swim it!
et: Selline distants, sa peaksid selle lihtsalt ära ujuma!

label: Route103_Text_PeteDefeated
en: Oh, that's good going!
et: Oi, see on hea minek!

label: Route103_Text_PetePostBattle
en: Oh, I understand where you're coming from now.
et: Oh, ma saan aru, kust sa nüüd tuled.

label: Route103_Text_PetePostBattle
en: If I had a POKéMON that trusty, I'd want to SURF on it, too!
et: Kui mul oleks POKéMON see usalduslik, siis tahaks ka SURF peale panna!

label: Route103_Text_IsabelleIntro
en: Watch where you're going! We're going to crash!
et: Vaata, kuhu sa lähed! Me kukume kokku!

label: Route103_Text_IsabelleDefeated
en: Groan…
et: Groan...

label: Route103_Text_IsabellePostBattle
en: I'm a poor swimmer so I was practicing… Sorry for almost crashing into you.
et: Ma olen vaene ujuja, nii et ma harjutasin... Sorry, et ma sulle peaaegu otsa sõitsin.

label: Route103_Text_RhettIntro
en: Whoa! How'd you get into a space this small?
et: Vot! Kuidas sa nii väikesesse ruumi sattusid?

label: Route103_Text_RhettDefeated
en: Whoa! The kid can rock!
et: Vot! Laps võib rokkida!

label: Route103_Text_RhettPostBattle
en: Do you like cramped quarters like this?
et: Kas sulle meeldivad sellised kitsad kvartalid?

label: Route103_Text_MarcosIntro
en: Did my guitar's wailing draw you in?
et: Kas minu kitarri vassimine tõmbas su sisse?

label: Route103_Text_MarcosDefeated
en: My one-man show is ruined…
et: Minu ühemehesaade on rikutud...

label: Route103_Text_MarcosPostBattle
en: I was playing my guitar where few people were around, but a lot of fans have gathered.
et: Mängisin oma kitarri, kus oli vähe inimesi, aga palju fänne on kogunenud.

label: Route103_Text_MarcosPostBattle
en: Heh, maybe I should turn pro.
et: Heh, äkki peaksin profiks keerama.

label: Route104_Text_GinaIntro
en: GINA: Okay, let's battle with our POKéMON!
et: GINA: Okei, võitleme oma POKéMON!

label: Route104_Text_GinaDefeat
en: GINA: Losing upsets me!
et: GINA: Kaotamine ärritab mind!

label: Route104_Text_GinaPostBattle
en: GINA: You are strong! We have to train lots more!
et: GINA: Sa oled tugev! Me peame palju rohkem treenima!

label: Route104_Text_GinaNotEnoughMons
en: GINA: Oh? Only one POKéMON? Then, we don't battle with you.
et: GINA: Oh? Ainult üks POKéMON? Siis me ei võitle sinuga.

label: Route104_Text_GinaNotEnoughMons
en: If there's only one POKéMON, it will be lonesome. That's not nice.
et: Kui on ainult üks POKéMON, siis on see üksildane. See ei ole tore.

label: Route104_Text_MiaIntro
en: MIA: We are twins, so we battle POKéMON together.
et: MIA: Me oleme kaksikud, nii et me võitleme POKéMON koos.

label: Route104_Text_MiaDefeat
en: MIA: We battled together, but we both lost…
et: MIA: Me võitlesime koos, aga me mõlemad kaotasime...

label: Route104_Text_MiaPostBattle
en: MIA: We will train our POKéMON more and be strong like you.
et: MIA: Me koolitame oma POKéMON rohkem ja oleme tugevad nagu teie.

label: Route104_Text_MiaNotEnoughMons
en: MIA: You want to battle with us?
et: MIA: Tahad meiega võidelda?

label: Route104_Text_MiaNotEnoughMons
en: It's a big no-no if you don't have two POKéMON with you. We're too strong for you!
et: See on suur ei-ei, kui sul pole kaasas kahte POKéMON. Me oleme sinu jaoks liiga tugevad!

label: Route104_Text_IvanIntro
en: Why keep it a secret? I'm the WATER POKéMON expert!
et: Miks seda saladuses hoida? Mina olen WATER POKéMON ekspert!

label: Route104_Text_IvanIntro
en: Huh? You don't know me?
et: Huh? Sa ei tunne mind?

label: Route104_Text_IvanDefeat
en: I thought I wasn't too bad, if I may say so, but I guess not… Bleah…
et: Ma arvasin, et mul pole viga, kui ma nii võin öelda, aga ma arvan, et mitte... Bleah...

label: Route104_Text_IvanPostBattle
en: I got too into fishing. I forgot I had to raise my POKéMON…
et: Sattusin liiga palju kala püüdma. Unustasin, et pean tõstma oma POKéMON...

label: Route104_Text_BillyIntro
en: Leaving footprints in the sand is so fun!
et: Jalajälgede liiva alla jätmine on nii lõbus!

label: Route104_Text_BillyDefeat
en: Waah! I got sand in my runners! They're all gritty!
et: Waah! Mul on jooksikutes liiv! Need on kõik sünged!

label: Route104_Text_BillyPostBattle
en: I want to leave my footprints in the sand everywhere, but they disappear quickly…
et: Tahan igal pool oma jalajäljed liiva sisse jätta, aga need kaovad kiiresti...

label: Route104_Text_HaleyIntro
en: Should I… Or shouldn't I?
et: Kas ma peaksin... või ei peaks?

label: Route104_Text_HaleyIntro
en: Okay, sure, I will battle!
et: Olgu, ma võitlen!

label: Route104_Text_HaleyDefeat
en: I shouldn't have battled…
et: Ma ei oleks pidanud võitlema...

label: Route104_Text_HaleyPostBattle
en: If you're faced with a decision and you let someone else choose for you, you will regret it, however things turn out.
et: Kui sind ootab ees otsus ja sa lased kellelgi teisel enda eest valida, siis sa kahetsed seda, aga asjad tulevad välja.

label: Route104_Text_HaleyRegister1
en: You're strong, but should I register you in my POKéNAV? Maybe I shouldn't…
et: Sa oled tugev, aga kas ma peaksin sind registreerima oma POKéNAV? Võib-olla ma ei peaks...

label: Route104_Text_HaleyRegister1
en: Okay, sure, I will register you!
et: Olgu, ma registreerin su!

label: Route104_Text_HaleyRegister2
en: You're strong, but should I register you in my POKéNAV? Maybe I shouldn't…
et: Sa oled tugev, aga kas ma peaksin sind registreerima oma POKéNAV? Võib-olla ma ei peaks...

label: Route104_Text_HaleyRegister2
en: Okay, sure, I will register you!
et: Olgu, ma registreerin su!

label: Route104_Text_HaleyRematchIntro
en: Come on, battle with me!
et: Ole nüüd, võitle minuga!

label: Route104_Text_HaleyRematchDefeat
en: Ohh… I thought I could win…
et: Ohh... mõtlesin, et võiks võita...

label: Route104_Text_HaleyPostRematch
en: I made the decision to battle, so I can accept this loss with grace.
et: Tegin otsuse lahinguks, nii et võin selle kaotuse armuga vastu võtta.

label: Route104_Text_HaleyPostRematch
en: I am still upset about losing!
et: Kaotuse pärast olen ikka pahane!

label: Route104_Text_WinstonIntro
en: Oh, sure, I'll accept your challenge. I have a lot of money.
et: Oh, kindlasti, ma võtan su väljakutse vastu. Mul on palju raha.

label: Route104_Text_WinstonDefeat
en: Why couldn't I win?
et: Miks ma ei suutnud võita?

label: Route104_Text_WinstonPostBattle
en: There are some things money can't buy. That's POKéMON…
et: On asju, mida raha ei saa osta. See on POKéMON...

label: Route104_Text_WinstonRegister1
en: Hm? Ah, you've obtained a POKéNAV.
et: Hm? Ah, sa oled saanud POKéNAV.

label: Route104_Text_WinstonRegister1
en: I will gladly register you. After all, I have plenty of money.
et: Ma hea meelega registreerin teid. Mul on ju raha küllaga.

label: Route104_Text_WinstonRegister2
en: Hm? Ah, you've obtained a POKéNAV.
et: Hm? Ah, sa oled saanud POKéNAV.

label: Route104_Text_WinstonRegister2
en: I will gladly register you. After all, I have plenty of money.
et: Ma hea meelega registreerin teid. Mul on ju raha küllaga.

label: Route104_Text_WinstonRematchIntro
en: After I lost to you, I learned a bunch of things about POKéMON.
et: Pärast seda, kui olin sulle kaotanud, sain teada hunniku asju POKéMON kohta.

label: Route104_Text_WinstonRematchDefeat
en: I lost again? Why couldn't I win?
et: Kaotasin jälle? Miks ma ei suutnud võita?

label: Route104_Text_WinstonPostRematch
en: I'm fabulously wealthy, but I can't seem to win at POKéMON…
et: Ma olen muinasjutuliselt jõukas, aga ma ei saa tunduda, et võidaksin POKéMON...

label: Route104_Text_WinstonPostRematch
en: It's so deep, the world of POKéMON…
et: See on nii sügav, maailm POKéMON...

label: Route104_Text_CindyIntro
en: We must have been fated to meet. May I ask you for a battle?
et: Me olime vist saatuses, et kohtuda. Kas ma võin sinult lahingut paluda?

label: Route104_Text_CindyDefeat
en: Oh, my!
et: Oh, minu!

label: Route104_Text_CindyPostBattle
en: “Hello” is the beginning of “good-bye.” I hope we meet again.
et: "Tere" on "head aega" algus. Loodan, et kohtume taas.

label: Route104_Text_CindyRegister1
en: Hello, we meet again.
et: Tere, kohtume uuesti.

label: Route104_Text_CindyRegister1
en: We seem to be drawn together. Let's register each other in our POKéNAVS.
et: Tundub, et meid tõmmatakse kokku. Registreerime üksteist oma POKéNAVS.

label: Route104_Text_CindyRegister2
en: We should commemorate how we seem to be drawn to each other.
et: Me peaksime mälestama, kuidas meile tundub, et meid tõmmatakse üksteise poole.

label: Route104_Text_CindyRegister2
en: Let's register each other in our POKéNAVS.
et: Registreerime üksteist oma POKéNAVS.

label: Route104_Text_CindyRematchIntro
en: Hello, we meet again. May I ask you for a battle?
et: Tere, kohtume uuesti. Kas ma võin sinult lahingut paluda?

label: Route104_Text_CindyRematchDefeat
en: Oh, my… I did the best that I could…
et: Oh, mu... ma andsin endast parima, et ma saaksin...

label: Route104_Text_CindyPostRematch
en: “Hello” is the beginning of “good-bye.” I hope we meet again.
et: "Tere" on "head aega" algus. Loodan, et kohtume taas.

label: Route104_Text_DarianIntro
en: I fished up a tough-looking POKéMON!
et: Õngitsesin karmi välimusega POKéMON!

label: Route104_Text_DarianIntro
en: It has this magical quality to it! It surely looks tough, yes it does!
et: Sellel on see maagiline omadus! See näeb kindlasti karm välja, jah.

label: Route104_Text_DarianDefeat
en: What the…
et: Mis...

label: Route104_Text_DarianPostBattle
en: Hey, MAGIKARP, you sure don't live up to your name, do you?
et: Hei, MAGIKARP, sa kindlasti ei ela oma nime järgi?

label: Route105_Text_FosterIntro
en: There's supposed to be a mystical rock around here. Do you know anything about it?
et: Siinkandis peaks olema müstiline kivi. Kas sa tead sellest midagi?

label: Route105_Text_FosterDefeated
en: I was thinking too much about that rock, while my POKéMON remained weak…
et: Ma mõtlesin liiga palju selle kivi peale, samas kui mu POKéMON jäi nõrgaks...

label: Route105_Text_FosterPostBattle
en: I can spend hours and hours staring at a nice rock without growing bored.
et: Võin veeta tunde ja tunde vahtides mõnusat kivi, ilma et igav hakkaks.

label: Route105_Text_LuisIntro
en: Whew! I was worried that a kid was drowning when I saw you.
et: Whew! Muretsesin, et üks laps uppus, kui sind nägin.

label: Route105_Text_LuisIntro
en: You seem to be okay, so what do you say to a battle?
et: Tundub, et sinuga on kõik korras, mis sa siis lahingule ütled?

label: Route105_Text_LuisDefeated
en: Glub… Glub…
et: Glub... Glub...

label: Route105_Text_LuisPostBattle
en: If you are drowning, the signal is to wave one arm toward the beach.
et: Uppudes on signaaliks ühe käe lainetamine ranna poole.

label: Route105_Text_DominikIntro
en: Swimming the deep blue sea… It feels the greatest!
et: Sügava sinise mere ujumine... see tundub kõige suurem!

label: Route105_Text_DominikDefeated
en: I lost… Now I'm feeling blue…
et: Ma kaotasin... nüüd tunnen end sinisena...

label: Route105_Text_DominikPostBattle
en: Why is the sea blue?
et: Miks on meri sinine?

label: Route105_Text_DominikPostBattle
en: I learned about that at the MUSEUM in SLATEPORT, but I forgot.
et: Sain sellest teada MUSEUM juures SLATEPORT aga unustasin.

label: Route105_Text_BeverlyIntro
en: My body feels lighter in the water. It's as if I've gotten slimmer!
et: Mu keha tunneb end vees kergemalt. Ma olen justkui saledamaks muutunud!

label: Route105_Text_BeverlyDefeated
en: I'm floating…
et: Ma hõljun...

label: Route105_Text_PostBattle
en: Your body weight is reduced to just one tenth in the water.
et: Sinu kehakaal väheneb vaid kümnendikuni vees.

label: Route105_Text_PostBattle
en: That would make me… Whoops! I'm not telling you my weight!
et: See teeks mind... Whoops! Ma ei ütle sulle oma kaalu!

label: Route105_Text_ImaniIntro
en: The blue, blue sky… The vast sea… It's so peaceful…
et: Sinine, sinine taevas... tohutu meri... see on nii rahulik...

label: Route105_Text_ImaniDefeated
en: I lost while I was lounging!
et: Kaotasin lamamise ajal!

label: Route105_Text_ImaniPostBattle
en: I want to be told I'm relaxing to be with. Giggle.
et: Ma tahan, et mulle öeldakse, et ma lõõgastun, et olla koos. Giggle.

label: Route105_Text_AndresIntro
en: I'm convinced that the sea keeps secrets from us.
et: Olen veendunud, et meri hoiab meie eest saladusi.

label: Route105_Text_AndresDefeated
en: Yes… I am no good at battling…
et: Jah... ma ei oska võidelda...

label: Route105_Text_AndresPostBattle
en: I'm sure there are many secrets to be discovered in the world's seas.
et: Kindlasti on maailma meredes palju saladusi, mida avastada.

label: Route105_Text_AndresPostBattle
en: I mean to find them all!
et: Ma tahan neid kõiki leida!

label: Route105_Text_AndresRegister
en: Huh? I'm so weak, but you're willing to register me in your POKéNAV?
et: Huh? Ma olen nii nõrk, aga sa oled nõus mind registreerima oma POKéNAV?

label: Route105_Text_AndresRematchIntro
en: I've told you that I'm weak… Are you sure you want to do this?
et: Ma olen sulle öelnud, et ma olen nõrk... oled sa kindel, et sa tahad seda teha?

label: Route105_Text_AndresRematchDefeated
en: Yes… I didn't think I could win.
et: Jah... ma ei arvanud, et suudan võita.

label: Route105_Text_AndresRematchPostBattle
en: I may be weak at battling, but my drive to explore can't be bested.
et: Võitlemises olen ehk nõrk, aga minu sõitu uurida ei saa bestida.

label: Route105_Text_AndresRematchPostBattle
en: I will travel the seas all around the world!
et: Ma rändan meredel üle kogu maailma!

label: Route105_Text_JosueIntro
en: I'm exhausted from swimming. I'm just not used to it.
et: Olen ujumisest kurnatud. Ma lihtsalt ei ole sellega harjunud.

label: Route105_Text_JosueIntro
en: I need a battle for a change of pace!
et: Vajan lahingut tempomuutuse nimel!

label: Route105_Text_JosueDefeated
en: I lost because I battled at sea.
et: Kaotasin, sest võitlesin merel.

label: Route105_Text_JosuePostBattle
en: Yeah, for me, the sky is a much better match than the sea.
et: Jah, minu jaoks on taevas palju parem vaste kui meri.

label: Route106_Text_ElliotIntro
en: Which do you prefer, fishing in the sea or a stream?
et: Kumba eelistate, kas kalapüüki meres või oja?

label: Route106_Text_ElliotDefeated
en: Like in deep-sea fishing, I lost spectacularly!
et: Nagu süvamerepüügil, kaotasin ka mina suurejooneliselt!

label: Route106_Text_ElliotPostBattle
en: Fishing is the greatest whether it's in the sea or a stream. You agree with me, right?
et: Kalapüük on suurim, kas see on meres või ojas. Sa oled minuga nõus, eks?

label: Route106_Text_ElliotRegister
en: Fishing's great, but so is battling. If you don't mind, can we meet again?
et: Kalapüük on suurepärane, aga ka võitluslik. Kui sul pole midagi selle vastu, kas me saame uuesti kohtuda?

label: Route106_Text_ElliotRematchIntro
en: I caught a bunch of POKéMON fishing. I'll show you an impressive battle!
et: Püüdsin hunniku POKéMON kalapüüki. Näitan muljetavaldavat lahingut!

label: Route106_Text_ElliotRematchDefeated
en: I lost again spectacularly!
et: Kaotasin taas suurejooneliselt!

label: Route106_Text_ElliotRematchPostBattle
en: Win or lose, POKéMON are the greatest! You agree with me, right?
et: Võida või kaotada, POKéMON on kõige suurem! Sa oled minuga nõus, eks?

label: Route106_Text_NedIntro
en: What do people do if they need to go to a washroom?
et: Mida inimesed teevad, kui neil on vaja pesuruumi minna?

label: Route106_Text_NedIntro
en: What if my ROD hooks a big one while I'm in the washroom? I just can't go…
et: Aga kui mu ROD haakub pesuruumis olles suurega? Ma lihtsalt ei saa minna...

label: Route106_Text_NedDefeated
en: I lost because I'm trying to not go to the washroom…
et: Kaotasin, sest üritan mitte pesuruumi minna...

label: Route106_Text_NedPostBattle
en: Oh, no! I've got this feeling I'll hook a big one!
et: Oh ei! Mul on selline tunne, et haakun suure!

label: Route106_Text_DouglasIntro
en: Hahahah! I'm a lousy runner, but in the water you can't catch me!
et: Hahahah! Olen vilets jooksja, aga vees mind kätte ei saa!

label: Route106_Text_DouglasDefeated
en: I give up!
et: Ma annan alla!

label: Route106_Text_DouglasPostBattle
en: I wouldn't lose in a swim race…
et: Ujumisvõistlusel ma ei kaotaks...

label: Route106_Text_KylaIntro
en: The sea is my backyard. I'm not going to take it easy because you're a kid!
et: Meri on minu tagahoov. Ma ei võta seda rahulikult, sest sa oled laps!

label: Route106_Text_KylaDefeated
en: Did you take it easy on me by any chance?
et: Kas sa võtsid mind igaks juhuks rahulikult?

label: Route106_Text_KylaPostBattle
en: Drifting along with the waves… I love it! Why don't you give it a try?
et: Koos lainetega driftimine... ma armastan seda! Äkki annaksid proovida?

label: Route107_Text_DarrinIntro
en: Yawn…
et: Jawn...

label: Route107_Text_DarrinIntro
en: I must have drifted off to sleep while I was drifting in the waves.
et: Ilmselt triivisin lainetes triivimise ajal magama.

label: Route107_Text_DarrinDefeated
en: Ahaha, I lost… I'll take a snooze, I think…
et: Ahaha, ma kaotasin... ma võtan tuka, ma arvan...

label: Route107_Text_DarrinPostBattle
en: Floating and being rocked by the waves--it's like sleeping in a plush, comfy bed.
et: Ujumine ja lainete poolt kõigutamine-see on nagu magamine plögases mugavas voodis.

label: Route107_Text_TonyIntro
en: The sea is like my backyard. Let's battle!
et: Meri on nagu minu tagahoov. Võitleme!

label: Route107_Text_TonyDefeated
en: I lost on my home field… I'm in shock!
et: Kaotasin koduväljakul... olen šokis!

label: Route107_Text_TonyPostBattle
en: I swim the seas with a heart full of dreams…
et: Ujun unenägusid täis südamega meredes...

label: Route107_Text_TonyPostBattle
en: It's a song! Anyways, I'm swimming some more.
et: See on laul! Igal juhul ujun veel.

label: Route107_Text_TonyRegister
en: You've shocked me to the bone! Well, so you won't forget me…
et: Sa oled mind luule šokeerinud! Noh, et sa mind ei unustaks...

label: Route107_Text_TonyRematchIntro
en: Swimming in the big, wide sea, my POKéMON has grown stronger!
et: Ujumine suures, laias meres, minu POKéMON on muutunud tugevamaks!

label: Route107_Text_TonyRematchDefeated
en: What a shock!
et: Milline šokk!

label: Route107_Text_TonyRematchDefeated
en: My POKéMON has gotten stronger, but I stayed weak as a TRAINER!
et: Minu POKéMON on muutunud tugevamaks, kuid jäin nõrgaks kui TRAINER!

label: Route107_Text_TonyRematchPostBattle
en: What you learn in battle makes you a stronger TRAINER. The waves taught me that.
et: See, mida sa lahingus õpid, muudab sind tugevamaks TRAINER. Lained õpetasid mulle seda.

label: Route107_Text_DeniseIntro
en: Do you know a little town called DEWFORD?
et: Kas tead mõnda väikest linna nimega DEWFORD?

label: Route107_Text_DeniseDefeated
en: I hate this!
et: Ma vihkan seda!

label: Route107_Text_DenisePostBattle
en: A weird saying is getting really trendy at DEWFORD HALL.
et: Veider ütlus muutub tõeliselt trendikaks DEWFORD HALL juures.

label: Route107_Text_BethIntro
en: Did you want to battle me? Sure, I'll go with you!
et: Kas sa tahtsid minuga võidelda? Muidugi, ma lähen sinuga kaasa!

label: Route107_Text_BethDefeated
en: I wasn't good enough for you.
et: Ma ei olnud sulle piisavalt hea.

label: Route107_Text_BethPostBattle
en: I think you're going to keep getting better. I'll go for it, too!
et: Ma arvan, et sa lähed aina paremaks. Ma lähen ka selle järele!

label: Route107_Text_LisaIntro
en: LISA: We challenge you as a sister and brother!
et: LISA: Me vaidlustame sind õe ja vennana!

label: Route107_Text_LisaDefeated
en: LISA: Awesome. You're in a different class of tough.
et: LISA: Äge. Sa oled teises karmimas klassis.

label: Route107_Text_LisaPostBattle
en: LISA: Do you have any friends who would go to the beach with you?
et: LISA: Kas sul on sõpru, kes sinuga randa läheksid?

label: Route107_Text_LisaNotEnoughPokemon
en: LISA: If you want to battle with us, bring more POKéMON.
et: LISA: Kui soovite meiega lahingut pidada, võtke kaasa rohkem POKéMON.

label: Route107_Text_RayIntro
en: RAY: We always battle POKéMON, me and my sister.
et: RAY: Me võitleme alati POKéMON, mina ja mu õde.

label: Route107_Text_RayIntro
en: I always lose, but we can beat you 2-on-2!
et: Ma kaotan alati, aga me võime sind võita 2-on-2!

label: Route107_Text_RayDefeated
en: RAY: Wowee, you're at a higher level than us!
et: RAY: Wowee, sa oled kõrgemal tasemel kui meie!

label: Route107_Text_RayPostBattle
en: RAY: My sister gave me my POKéMON. I raised it, and now it's my important partner!
et: RAY: Mu õde andis mulle minu POKéMON. Tõstsin selle üles ja nüüd on see minu oluline elukaaslane!

label: Route107_Text_RayNotEnoughPokemon
en: RAY: If you want to battle us, go bring some more POKéMON!
et: RAY: Kui soovite meiega võidelda, minge tooge veel mõned POKéMON!

label: Route107_Text_CamronIntro
en: I'm in the middle of a triathlon, but I'm nowhere near tired!
et: Mul on käsil triatlon, aga ma ei ole kuskil väsinud!

label: Route107_Text_CamronDefeated
en: That exhausted me…
et: See ammendas mind...

label: Route107_Text_CamronPostBattle
en: I still have swimming and running left to do after this.
et: Mul on pärast seda veel ujumine ja jooksmine pooleli.

label: Route107_Text_CamronPostBattle
en: Am I going to be okay?
et: Kas ma saan terveks?

label: Route108_Text_JeromeIntro
en: My dream is to swim the world's seven seas!
et: Minu unistus on ujuda maailma seitset merd!

label: Route108_Text_JeromeDefeated
en: I won't be able to swim the seven seas like this…
et: Ma ei suuda seitset merd niimoodi ujuda...

label: Route108_Text_JeromePostBattle
en: Playing with marine POKéMON is one of the pleasures of swimming!
et: Meresõiduga mängimine POKéMON on üks ujumise naudinguid!

label: Route108_Text_MatthewIntro
en: Ahoy, there! Are you going out to the ABANDONED SHIP, too?
et: Ahoy, seal! Kas lähed ka ABANDONED SHIP välja?

label: Route108_Text_MatthewDefeated
en: I'm sinking! Glub… Glub…
et: Ma vajun! Glub... Glub...

label: Route108_Text_MatthewPostBattle
en: Some people even go inside that ABANDONED SHIP.
et: Mõned inimesed käivad isegi selle ABANDONED SHIP sees.

label: Route108_Text_TaraIntro
en: My liar of a boyfriend told me that I look great in a bikini…
et: Minu valetaja poiss-sõbrast ütles mulle, et ma näen bikiinides suurepärane välja...

label: Route108_Text_TaraDefeated
en: Oh, boo!
et: Oi, virise!

label: Route108_Text_TaraPostBattle
en: Even if it's a lie, I love being told I look great… We girls are so complex…
et: Isegi kui see on vale, siis ma armastan, et mulle öeldakse, et ma näen suurepärane välja... Me tüdrukud oleme nii keerulised...

label: Route108_Text_MissyIntro
en: I love the sea! I forget all my worries when I swim!
et: Ma armastan merd! Unustan ujudes kõik oma mured!

label: Route108_Text_MissyDefeated
en: When I lose a battle, I get all stressed out!
et: Kui ma kaotan lahingu, siis ma olen kõik stressis!

label: Route108_Text_MissyPostBattle
en: Work off your stress by swimming! It's so healthy!
et: Tööta oma stressi välja ujudes! See on nii tervislik!

label: Route108_Text_CoryIntro
en: I love WATER-type POKéMON. I love other POKéMON, too!
et: Armastan Vee-tüüpi POKéMON. Armastan ka teisi POKéMON!

label: Route108_Text_CoryDefeated
en: Waaah! I lost! Waaah! Waaah!
et: Waaah! Kaotasin! Waaah! Waaah!

label: Route108_Text_CoryPostBattle
en: Shouting is good for me! It uplifts me!
et: Karjumine on minu jaoks hea! See tõstab mind üles!

label: Route108_Text_CoryRegister
en: I love tough TRAINERS, too! Register me in your POKéNAV!
et: Ma armastan sitket TRAINERS ka! Registreeri mind oma POKéNAV!

label: Route108_Text_CoryRematchIntro
en: Win or lose, I love battling at sea!
et: Võida või kaotada, mulle meeldib merel võidelda!

label: Route108_Text_CoryRematchDefeated
en: Waaah! I lost again! Waaah! Waaah!
et: Waaah! Kaotasin jälle! Waaah! Waaah!

label: Route108_Text_CoryRematchPostBattle
en: If you're faced with a challenge, try shouting at the sea!
et: Kui sind ootab ees väljakutse, siis proovi mere ääres karjuda!

label: Route108_Text_CarolinaIntro
en: I take huge pride in my POKéMON. We'll show you one speedy battle!
et: Tunnen tohutut uhkust oma POKéMON üle. Näitame teile ühte kiiret lahingut!

label: Route108_Text_CarolinaDefeated
en: That wasn't cute at all.
et: See polnud üldse armas.

label: Route108_Text_CarolinaPostBattle
en: Since I'm at sea like this, I wouldn't mind putting on a pink, frilly swimsuit…
et: Kuna ma olen nii merel, siis mul poleks midagi selle vastu, kui paneksin selga roosa ja satsilise ujumistrikoo...

label: Route109_Text_DavidIntro
en: Hiyah! Look at my chiseled abs! This is what you call “cut”!
et: Hiyah! Vaata mu peitsitud abs! Seda nimetad sa "lõikamiseks"!

label: Route109_Text_DavidDefeated
en: Aiyah! Flubbed out!
et: Aiyah! Lõhnab välja!

label: Route109_Text_DavidPostBattle
en: Hiyah!
et: Hiyah!

label: Route109_Text_DavidPostBattle
en: My sculpted abs have nothing to do with POKéMON battles!
et: Minu skulptureeritud abs ei ole kuidagi seotud POKéMON lahingutega!

label: Route109_Text_AliceIntro
en: Are you properly protected against the sun?
et: Kas oled korralikult päikese eest kaitstud?

label: Route109_Text_AliceDefeated
en: Ouch, ouch, ouch!
et: Ouch, ouch, ouch!

label: Route109_Text_AlicePostBattle
en: Cheeks are the most prone to burning!
et: Põsed on kõige põlemisaltimad!

label: Route109_Text_HueyIntro
en: I've laid anchor in ports around the world, but SLATEPORT's the best.
et: Olen pannud ankru üle maailma sadamatesse, aga SLATEPORT on parim.

label: Route109_Text_HueyDefeated
en: You're the best!
et: Sa oled parim!

label: Route109_Text_HueyPostBattle
en: In the best port was the best TRAINER…
et: Parimas pordis oli parim TRAINER...

label: Route109_Text_EdmondIntro
en: Urrrrppp… Battle? With me?
et: Urrrrppp... lahing? Kas minuga?

label: Route109_Text_EdmondDefeated
en: Urp… Ooooooohhhhhh… Urrrrpppp…
et: Urp... Ooooohhhhhhhhh... Urrrrpppp...

label: Route109_Text_EdmondPostBattle
en: I'm usually stronger than this! I'm just seasick as a dog!
et: Ma olen tavaliselt tugevam kui see! Ma olen lihtsalt merehaige kui koer!

label: Route109_Text_EdmondPostBattle
en: I'm a SAILOR, but…
et: Ma olen SAILOR, aga...

label: Route109_Text_RickyIntro
en: I'm thirsty… I could go for a SODA POP at the SEASHORE HOUSE…
et: Mul on janu... võiksin minna SODA POP juurde SEASHORE HOUSE...

label: Route109_Text_RickyDefeated
en: Groan…
et: Groan...

label: Route109_Text_RickyPostBattle
en: I'm getting famished… My inner tube looks like a giant doughnut…
et: Minu sisemine toru näeb välja nagu hiiglaslik sõõrik...

label: Route109_Text_RickyRegister
en: Will you have another match with me when I'm not all thirsty?
et: Kas sul on minuga veel üks vaste, kui ma kõik janune ei ole?

label: Route109_Text_RickyRematchIntro
en: I'm hungry, but I've got enough pep in me for a battle!
et: Mul on kõht tühi, aga mul on piisavalt peppi sees lahinguks!

label: Route109_Text_RickyRematchDefeated
en: I lost… It's because I'm hungry…
et: Ma kaotasin, sest mul on kõht tühi...

label: Route109_Text_RickyRematchPostBattle
en: When you eat on a beach, everything seems to taste a little better.
et: Rannas süües tundub kõik veidi paremini maitsevat.

label: Route109_Text_LolaIntro
en: Doesn't a beach umbrella look like a giant flower?
et: Kas ranna vihmavari ei näe välja nagu hiiglaslik lill?

label: Route109_Text_LolaDefeated
en: Mommy!
et: Emme!

label: Route109_Text_LolaPostBattle
en: If you look at the beach from the sky, it looks like a big flower garden!
et: Kui taevast randa vaadata, näeb see välja nagu suur lilleaed!

label: Route109_Text_LolaRegister
en: Me? I'm here every day!
et: Mina? Ma olen siin iga päev!

label: Route109_Text_LolaRematchIntro
en: I'm not losing to you again! That's why I have my inner tube!
et: Ma ei kaota sulle enam! Sellepärast on mul oma sisemine toru!

label: Route109_Text_LolaRematchDefeated
en: Mommy!
et: Emme!

label: Route109_Text_LolaRematchPostBattle
en: If I have an inner tube, me and my POKéMON's cuteness goes way up!
et: Kui mul on sisemine toru, siis minu ja minu POKéMON armsus läheb üles!

label: Route109_Text_AustinaIntro
en: I can't swim without my inner tube, but I won't lose at POKéMON!
et: Ilma oma sisemise toruta ma ujuda ei saa, aga ma ei kaota POKéMON juures!

label: Route109_Text_AustinaDefeated
en: Did I lose because I have an inner tube?
et: Kas ma kaotasin, sest mul on sisemine toru?

label: Route109_Text_AustinaPostBattle
en: My inner tube is a fashion item. I can't be seen without it.
et: Minu sisemine toru on moeese. Ilma selleta mind näha ei ole.

label: Route109_Text_GwenIntro
en: Hi, big TRAINER. Will you battle with me?
et: Tere, suur TRAINER. Kas sa võitled minuga?

label: Route109_Text_GwenDefeated
en: Oh, you're strong.
et: Oh, sa oled tugev.

label: Route109_Text_GwenPostBattle
en: How did you get to be so strong?
et: Kuidas sa nii tugevaks said?

label: Route109_Text_CarterIntro
en: Wahahah! This dude's going to catch himself a big one!
et: Wahahah! See kutt püüab endale suure!

label: Route109_Text_CarterDefeated
en: This dude just lost one…
et: See kutt lihtsalt kaotas ühe...

label: Route109_Text_CarterPostBattle
en: This dude thinks you're a big one. No, you're a big-one-to-be!
et: See kutt arvab, et sa oled suur. Ei, sa oled suur-üks-olemas!

label: Route109_Text_PaulIntro
en: PAUL: Well, this is a mood-breaker.
et: PAUL: Noh, see on tujurikkuja.

label: Route109_Text_PaulIntro
en: I wish you wouldn't disturb our precious time together.
et: Ma soovin, et te ei segaks meie kallist koosolemise aega.

label: Route109_Text_PaulDefeated
en: PAUL: Well, I give up.
et: PAUL: Noh, ma annan alla.

label: Route109_Text_PaulPostBattle
en: PAUL: Well, don't tell anyone that we're here. This is just our private world of two!
et: PAUL: No ärge öelge kellelegi, et me siin oleme. See on lihtsalt meie kaheliikmeline eramaailm!

label: Route109_Text_PaulNotEnoughPokemon
en: PAUL: We're totally, deeply in love. That's why we make our POKéMON battle together.
et: PAUL: Me oleme täiesti, sügavalt armunud. Seepärast teemegi koos oma POKéMON lahingu.

label: Route109_Text_MelIntro
en: MEL: We're, like, totally in love. Our romance is heating up all of HOENN!
et: MEL: Me oleme nagu täiesti armunud. Meie romantika kütab üles kõik HOENN!

label: Route109_Text_MelDefeated
en: MEL: We lost, and it's my fault! PAUL will hate me!
et: MEL: Kaotasime ja see on minu süü! PAUL hakkab mind vihkama!

label: Route109_Text_MelPostBattle
en: MEL: Um, PAUL, are you angry with me? Please don't be angry.
et: MEL: Um, PAUL, kas sa oled minu peale vihane? Palun ärge vihastage.

label: Route109_Text_MelNotEnoughPokemon
en: MEL: We're, like, deeply and truly in love. That's why we make our POKéMON battle together.
et: MEL: Me oleme nagu sügavalt ja tõeliselt armunud. Seepärast teemegi koos oma POKéMON lahingu.

label: Route109_Text_ChandlerIntro
en: Tadaah! See? My inner tube's round!
et: Tadaah! Näete? Minu sisemine toru on ümmargune!

label: Route109_Text_ChandlerDefeated
en: Oh, oh! Too bad!
et: Oh, oh! Kahju!

label: Route109_Text_ChandlerPostBattle
en: After I showed you my round inner tube, too…
et: Pärast näitasin sulle oma ümmargust sisemist toru ka...

label: Route109_Text_HaileyIntro
en: I can't swim, so I'm pretending to swim.
et: Ujuda ei saa, seega teesklen ujumist.

label: Route109_Text_HaileyDefeated
en: I thought so! I didn't think we could win.
et: Ma arvasin nii! Ma ei uskunud, et me võidame.

label: Route109_Text_HaileyPostBattle
en: When I learn how to swim, I think my POKéMON will become tougher.
et: Ujuma õppides arvan, et minu POKéMON muutub karmimaks.

label: Route109_Text_ElijahIntro
en: For a guy as macho as me, this kind of POKéMON is the perfect match!
et: Nii macho kui minu jaoks on selline POKéMON ideaalne vaste!

label: Route109_Text_ElijahDefeated
en: I'm cool even in defeat, hey?
et: Ma olen lahe isegi kaotuses, hei?

label: Route109_Text_ElijahPostBattle
en: For a guy as macho as me, a port is the perfect setting!
et: Nii macho-mehe jaoks kui mina, on port ideaalne seadistus!

label: Route109_Text_ElijahPostBattle
en: I guess I'll head for SLATEPORT.
et: Peatun vist SLATEPORT.

label: Route110_Text_JacobIntro
en: Whoa! Watch it! I guess you're not used to BIKE racing.
et: Vot! Vaata seda! Ma arvan, et sa pole harjunud BIKE võidusõiduga.

label: Route110_Text_JacobDefeated
en: Whoa! My brakes failed!
et: Vot! Minu pidurid ebaõnnestusid!

label: Route110_Text_JacobPostBattle
en: Flat tires and brake problems can cause serious injury! Inspect your BIKE for problems!
et: Lamedad rehvid ja piduriprobleemid võivad põhjustada tõsiseid vigastusi! Kontrolli oma BIKE probleeme!

label: Route110_Text_AnthonyIntro
en: Yo, you! Can you keep up with my speed?
et: Kuule, sa! Kas suudate minu kiirusega sammu pidada?

label: Route110_Text_AnthonyDefeated
en: Crash and burn!
et: Täielik läbikukkumine!

label: Route110_Text_AnthonyPostBattle
en: Speed alone won't let me win at POKéMON. I need to reconsider this…
et: Kiirus üksi ei lase mul võita POKéMON. Ma pean selle uuesti läbi mõtlema...

label: Route110_Text_BenjaminIntro
en: Don't panic if your BIKE's going fast!
et: Ärge paanitsege, kui teie BIKE läheb kiiresti!

label: Route110_Text_BenjaminDefeated
en: I shouldn't panic during POKéMON battles…
et: Ma ei tohiks paanikasse sattuda POKéMON lahingute ajal...

label: Route110_Text_BenjaminPostBattle
en: There's no need to panic or stress. Take it easy. There's plenty of time.
et: Pole vaja paanikat ega stressi tekitada. Võta rahulikult. Aega jagub.

label: Route110_Text_BenjaminRegister
en: I'll keep chugging on without stressing. Give me a shout if you're up to it.
et: Jätkan pingutamist, ilma et see stressi tekitaks. Anna mulle hõige, kui sa oled selleks valmis.

label: Route110_Text_BenjaminRematchIntro
en: Aren't you going a little too fast? Take it easy and let's battle.
et: Kas sa ei lähe natuke liiga kiiresti? Võta rahulikult ja võitleme.

label: Route110_Text_BenjaminRematchDefeated
en: I didn't panic, but I still lost…
et: Ma ei paanitsenud, aga ikkagi kaotasin...

label: Route110_Text_BenjaminRematchPostBattle
en: There's no need to panic or stress. Take it easy. There's plenty of time.
et: Pole vaja paanikat ega stressi tekitada. Võta rahulikult. Aega jagub.

label: Route110_Text_AbigailIntro
en: The triathlon is hard in the extreme.
et: Triatlon on äärmisel juhul raske.

label: Route110_Text_AbigailIntro
en: You have to complete the three events of swimming, cycling, and running.
et: Tuleb läbida kolm ujumise, rattasõidu ja jooksmise üritust.

label: Route110_Text_AbigailDefeated
en: POKéMON battles are hard, too!
et: POKéMON lahingud on ka rasked!

label: Route110_Text_AbigailPostBattle
en: I'm exhausted, so I need a break. It's important to get proper rest.
et: Olen kurnatud, seega vajan puhkust. Oluline on saada korralik puhkus.

label: Route110_Text_AbigailRegister
en: You know, I like you! Let's have a rematch on CYCLING ROAD.
et: Tead, sa meeldid mulle! Teeme kordusmängu CYCLING ROAD peal.

label: Route110_Text_AbigailRematchIntro
en: Isn't it neat to hold a battle while cycling?
et: Kas pole mitte korralik rattasõidu ajal lahingut pidada?

label: Route110_Text_AbigailRematchDefeated
en: Wow… How could you be so strong?
et: Kuidas sa said nii tugev olla?

label: Route110_Text_AbigailRematchPostBattle
en: Were you going after a record?
et: Kas läksid rekordit jahtima?

label: Route110_Text_AbigailRematchPostBattle
en: I'm sorry if I held you up!
et: Andke andeks, kui ma teid üleval pidasin!

label: Route110_Text_JasmineIntro
en: I've been riding without stopping. My thighs are like rocks!
et: Olen sõitnud peatumata. Mu reied on nagu kivid!

label: Route110_Text_JasmineDefeated
en: I'm worried about muscle cramps…
et: Olen mures lihaskrampide pärast...

label: Route110_Text_JasminePostBattle
en: Oh, you have some GYM BADGES? No wonder you're so strong!
et: Oh, sul on mingi SAAL MÄRGID? Pole ime, et sa nii tugev oled!

label: Route110_Text_EdwardIntro
en: I have foreseen your intentions! I cannot possibly lose!
et: Ma olen teie kavatsusi ette näinud! Ma ei saa kaotada!

label: Route110_Text_EdwardDefeated
en: I failed to prophesize my own demise!
et: Mul ei õnnestunud omaenese hukku ennustada!

label: Route110_Text_EdwardPostBattle
en: I see your future…
et: Ma näen su tulevikku...

label: Route110_Text_EdwardPostBattle
en: Hmm… I see a shining light…
et: Hmm... ma näen säravat valgust...

label: Route110_Text_JaclynIntro
en: Ahahahaha! I'll dazzle you with my wonders!
et: Ahahahaha! Ma pimestan sind oma imedega!

label: Route110_Text_JaclynDefeated
en: I wondrously lost!
et: Kaotasin imekombel!

label: Route110_Text_JaclynPostBattle
en: You managed to win only because it was a wonder! Yes, a wonder! Don't think you can win all the time!
et: Sul õnnestus võita ainult sellepärast, et see oli ime! Jah, ime! Ärge arvake, et kogu aeg võite võita!

label: Route110_Text_EdwinIntro
en: Could I see your POKéMON? Just one look, please?
et: Kas ma võiksin näha teie POKéMON? Ainult üks pilk, palun?

label: Route110_Text_EdwinDefeated
en: I wanted to complete my collection…
et: Tahtsin oma kollektsiooni valmis saada...

label: Route110_Text_EdwinPostBattle
en: When I see a POKéMON that I don't know, my passion as a collector is ignited!
et: Kui ma näen POKéMON mida ma ei tea, siis süttib mu kirg kollektsionäärina!

label: Route110_Text_EdwinRegister
en: I like collecting MATCH CALL registrations, too…
et: Mulle meeldib koguda MATCH CALL registreeringuid ka...

label: Route110_Text_EdwinRematchIntro
en: Hi, have you caught any new POKéMON?
et: Tere, kas olete tabanud mõne uue POKéMON?

label: Route110_Text_EdwinRematchIntro
en: Could I see your POKéMON? Just one look, please?
et: Kas ma võiksin näha teie POKéMON? Ainult üks pilk, palun?

label: Route110_Text_EdwinRematchDefeated
en: Your POKéMON… I envy you.
et: Sinu POKéMON... ma kadestan sind.

label: Route110_Text_EdwinRematchPostBattle
en: Oh, I long to make all rare POKéMON mine!
et: Oi, ma igatsen teha kõik haruldased POKéMON minu omad!

label: Route110_Text_DaleIntro
en: Hey! Don't sneak up behind me like that!
et: Hei! Ärge hiilige minu taha nii!

label: Route110_Text_DaleDefeated
en: I lost! Drat!
et: Kaotasin! Drat!

label: Route110_Text_DalePostBattle
en: Fishing is all about concentration. You have to focus on the floater.
et: Kalapüük on seotud keskendumisega. Tuleb keskenduda ujukile.

label: Route110_Text_IsabelIntro
en: Ahahaha! I would go anywhere to show off my delightful POKéMON.
et: Ahahaha! Läheksin kuhu iganes, et oma rõõmustavat POKéMON eputada.

label: Route110_Text_IsabelDefeated
