label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeCorridor_Text_YourChallengeHasBegun
en: Your Battle Choice challenge has now begun…
et: Teie Battle Choice'i väljakutse on nüüd alanud...

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: Hey, how's it going, CHAMPIONbound {PLAYER}?
et: Hei, kuidas läheb, TŠEMPIONbound {PLAYER}?

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: WATTSON, the LEADER of MAUVILLE GYM, uses ELECTRIC-type POKéMON.
et: WATTSON, LEADER MAUVILLE SAAL, kasutab Elektri-tüüpi POKéMON.

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: If you challenge him with WATER-type POKéMON, he'll zap them! Bzzt!
et: Kui te esitate talle väljakutse Vee-tüüpi POKéMON-ga, siis ta zap neid! Bzzt!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: And, he's put in switch-controlled doors all over his GYM! Eccentric!
et: Ja, ta on pandud üle kogu oma SAAL! Ekstsentriline!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: Hey, go for it!
et: Hei, mine järele!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictory
en: Whoa, you're electrifying! You've powered the door open!
et: Sa elektrifitseerid! Sa toitsid ukse lahti!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_KirkIntro
en: My electric soul, it'll shatter your dreams whole, whoa-yeahah!
et: Mu elektrihing, see purustab su unistused terveks, whoa-yeah!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_KirkDefeat
en: That was plugged in, amped up, over-driven electric, man!
et: See oli ühendatud, amped up, ülejuhitav elektriline, mees!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_KirkPostBattle
en: POKéMON and rock, it's all about heart, whoa-yeah!
et: POKéMON ja rock, asi on südames, whoa-yeah!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ShawnIntro
en: I trained under WATTSON! There ain't no way I'll lose easily!
et: Treenisin WATTSON all! Ma ei kaota kuidagi kergelt!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ShawnDefeat
en: Unplugged and turned off…
et: Ühendamata ja välja lülitatud...

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ShawnPostBattle
en: WATTSON, our GYM LEADER, has been around for a long, long time.
et: WATTSON, meie SAALI JUHT, on olnud kaua, kaua.

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ShawnPostBattle
en: He was battling even before your daddy was born, that tough coot.
et: Ta võitles juba enne, kui su isa sündis, selle karmi koopaga.

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_BenIntro
en: This GYM's got puzzles! Isn't it fun?
et: Sellel SAAL on mõistatused! Kas pole lõbus?

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_BenDefeat
en: It's no fun to lose…
et: Ei ole lõbus kaotada...

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_BenPostBattle
en: WATTSON says he likes setting up little traps with switches.
et: WATTSON ütleb, et talle meeldib väikeste püüniste seadistamine lülititega.

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_VivianIntro
en: With my charm and my POKéMON's moves, you'll be shocked!
et: Minu võlu ja minu POKéMON käikudega saad šoki!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_VivianDefeat
en: I'm shocked by your power!
et: Ma olen su väest šokeeritud!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_VivianPostBattle
en: I've heard that MAUVILLE was founded by WATTSON.
et: Olen kuulnud, et MAUVILLE asutati WATTSON poolt.

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_VivianPostBattle
en: He was a TRAINER long before we became TRAINERS. He must know all sorts of things!
et: Ta oli TRAINER ammu enne meie saamist TRAINERS. Ta peab teadma igasuguseid asju!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_AngeloIntro
en: I love shiny things!
et: Mulle meeldivad läikivad asjad!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_AngeloDefeat
en: Oh… My eyes are frazzled…
et: Mu silmad on purunenud...

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_AngeloPostBattle
en: MAUVILLE GYM's WATTSON has a shiny forehead. It makes me happy!
et: MAUVILLE SAAL on WATTSON on läikiv laup. See teeb mind õnnelikuks!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonIntro
en: I've given up on my plans to convert the city, I have.
et: Ma olen loobunud oma plaanidest linna konverteerida, mul on.

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonIntro
en: And so, I put my time into making door traps in my GYM.
et: Ja nii, ma panin oma aja oma SAAL ukselõksude tegemisse.

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonIntro
en: Oh? Now, what are you doing here?
et: Oh? Mida sa siin teed?

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonIntro
en: What's that? You say you've gotten past all my rigged doors?
et: Mis see on? Ütled, et oled kõigist mu taglaseist ustest mööda saanud?

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonIntro
en: Wahahahah! Now, that is amusing!
et: Wahahahah! See on lõbus!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonIntro
en: Then, I, WATTSON, the LEADER of MAUVILLE GYM, shall electrify you!
et: Siis, mina, WATTSON, LEADER MAUVILLE SAAL, elektrifitseerin teid!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonDefeat
en: Wahahahah! Fine, I lost!
et: Wahahahah! Olgu, ma kaotasin!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonDefeat
en: You ended up giving me a thrill! Take this BADGE!
et: Sa lõpuks andsid mulle põnevust! Võta see MÄRK!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedDynamoBadge
en: {PLAYER} received the DYNAMO BADGE from WATTSON.
et: {PLAYER} sai DYNAMO MÄRK alates WATTSON.

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ExplainDynamoBadgeTakeThis
en: With the DYNAMO BADGE, POKéMON can use ROCK SMASH out of battle.
et: Koos DYNAMO MÄRK, POKéMON saab kasutada ROCK SMASH lahingust välja.

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ExplainDynamoBadgeTakeThis
en: And, it will make your POKéMON a little bit faster, too.
et: Ja, see teeb su POKéMON natuke kiiremaks ka.

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ExplainDynamoBadgeTakeThis
en: Hmm… You should take this, too!
et: Sa peaksid seda ka võtma!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ExplainShockWave
en: That TM34 there contains SHOCK WAVE.
et: Et TM34 seal sisaldab SHOCK WAVE.

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ExplainShockWave
en: It's a trustworthy move that never misses! You can count on it!
et: See on usaldusväärne samm, millest kunagi puudust ei tunta! Selle peale võib loota!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_RegisteredWattson
en: Registered GYM LEADER WATTSON in the POKéNAV.
et: Registreerunud SAALI JUHT WATTSON POKéNAV.

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonPostBattle
en: I swell with optimism, seeing a promising young TRAINER like you!
et: Ma paisun optimismiga, nähes sinusugust paljutõotavat noort TRAINER!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonGoForthAndEndeavor
en: Wahahahah! Go forth and endeavor, youngster!
et: Wahahahah! Minge edasi ja püüdke, nooruk!

et: WATTSON: Ah-ha! Siin lõpuks ometi! Ma tean, mida sa tahad. Sa tahad võidelda minu POKéMON!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonPreRematch
en: Wahahahaha!
et: Wahahahaha!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonPreRematch
en: I'll make sparks fly from you! Don't say I didn't warn you!

en: Oof… Our batteries ran dry…
et: Meie patareid jooksid kuivalt...

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonPostRematch
en: WATTSON: We'll have to recharge our batteries again.
et: WATTSON: Me peame oma patareid uuesti laadima.

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonPostRematch
en: When we're fully charged up, we'll gladly accept your challenge.
et: Kui meid täielikult laetakse, siis võtame hea meelega teie väljakutse vastu.

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonPostRematch
en: So, come back again sometime, won't you?
et: Tule siis millalgi jälle tagasi, kas pole?

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonRematchNeedTwoMons
en: WATTSON: Ah-ha! Here at last! I know what you want. You want to battle my POKéMON!
et: WATTSON: Ah-ha! Siin lõpuks ometi! Ma tean, mida sa tahad. Sa tahad võidelda minu POKéMON!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonRematchNeedTwoMons
en: Wahahahaha!

en: Oops! Wait! You've only one POKéMON with you!
et: Oops! Oota! Sul on kaasas ainult üks POKéMON!

en: Come see me with two or more POKéMON, all right?
et: Tule vaata mind kahe või enama POKéMON-ga, eks?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_RetireFromChallenge
en: Would you like to retire from your Set KO Tourney challenge?
et: Soovid pensionile minna oma Set KO Teurney väljakutsest?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_SavingPleaseWait
en: I am saving your game data. Please wait.
et: Ma salvestan teie mänguandmeid. Palun oodake.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_RecordLastBattle
en: Would you like to record your last battle on your FRONTIER PASS?
et: Kas soovite salvestada oma viimase lahingu oma FRONTIER PASS?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_NowFaceTycoon
en: My dear challenger!
et: Mu kallis väljakutsuja!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_NowFaceTycoon
en: Your skill level is truly astounding!
et: Sinu oskuste tase on tõeliselt hämmastav!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_NowFaceTycoon
en: We now would like you to face our leader, the ARENA TYCOON!
et: Soovime nüüd, et te seisaksite silmitsi meie juhiga ARENA TYCOON!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_PreparedForTycoon
en: A battle with the ARENA TYCOON! Are you prepared?
et: Lahing ARENA TYCOON! Kas olete valmis?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_MakeWayForGreta
en: REFEREE: The ARENA TYCOON! Make way for GRETA!
et: REFEREE: ARENA TYCOON! Tee teed GRETA!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_GretaYoureChallenger
en: GRETA: Hey! Howdy!
et: GRETA: Hei! Howdy!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_GretaYoureChallenger
en: …Wait, are you the challenger?
et: ...Oota, kas oled väljakutsuja?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_IsThatRight
en: Is that right? Hmm… Hmhm…
et: Kas see on õige? Hmm... Hmhm...

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_YouLookWeakTakeThingsEasy
en: I don't know how to say it, but… To put it bluntly, you look pretty weak. Are you sure you're up for me?
et: Ma ei oska seda öelda, aga... otsekoheselt öeldes näed sa päris nõrk välja. Oled sa kindel, et oled minu eest väljas?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_YouLookWeakTakeThingsEasy
en: Hmm…
et: Hmm...

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_YouLookWeakTakeThingsEasy
en: Well, all right! We'll take things easy to start with!
et: No olgu! Võtame asju rahulikult, millest alustada!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_IgniteMyPassionForBattle
en: Okay! Let's see you ignite my passion for battle!
et: Olgu! Näeme, et sütitad mu kire lahingu vastu!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_GretaYoureToughAfterAll
en: GRETA: Ow, wait a second! You are tough after all!
et: GRETA: Ow, oota korraks! Sa oled ju karm!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_GretaYoureToughAfterAll
en: I like you! Let's see your FRONTIER PASS.
et: Sa meeldid mulle! Vaatame teie FRONTIER PASS.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_ReceivedGutsSymbol
en: The Guts Symbol was embossed on the FRONTIER PASS!
et: Guts Symbol oli reljeefne FRONTIER PASS!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_GoingToBeFunNextTime
en: Hmm…
et: Hmm...

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_GoingToBeFunNextTime
en: It's going to be fun the next time! I'm looking forward to it!
et: Järgmisel korral läheb lõbusaks! Ootan seda väga!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_GretaLookingForwardToSeeingAgain
en: GRETA: Hey! Howdy! You finally won your way up to me!
et: GRETA: Hei! Howdy! Lõpuks ometi võitsid oma tee minu poole!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_GretaLookingForwardToSeeingAgain
en: I was getting worried waiting for you! I was really looking forward to seeing you again!
et: Ma hakkasin sind oodates muretsema! Ootasin väga, et teid taas näha!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_SoAreYouReady
en: … … … So, are you ready?
et: ... ... ... Niisiis, kas olete valmis?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_WontAllowHalfheartedEffort
en: I won't allow a halfhearted effort! Be ready for a thrashing!
et: Ma ei luba poolikut pingutust! Ole valmis põnevuseks!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_LetsGetThisStarted
en: Come on, REFEREE! Let's get this started!
et: Ole nüüd, REFEREE! Hakkame pihta!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_GretaBlownAway
en: GRETA: Gaaah! Blown away! Let's see your FRONTIER PASS!
et: GRETA: Gaaah! Puhu minema! Vaatame teie FRONTIER PASS!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_GutsSymbolTookGoldenShine
en: The Guts Symbol took on a golden shine!
et: Guttsi sümbol võttis kuldse sära!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_IfWeBattleAgainWontLose
en: Arrrgh! This is so infuriating!
et: Arrgh! See on nii vihastav!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_IfWeBattleAgainWontLose
en: If we ever battle again, I won't lose! Don't you forget it! Bye-bye!
et: Kui me veel kunagi võitleme, siis ma ei kaota! Ära unusta seda! Nägemist!

label: Route114_FossilManiacsHouse_Text_HaveThisToDigLikeMyBrother
en: My big brother's the FOSSIL MANIAC… He's a nice guy who loves FOSSILS…
et: Minu suur vend on see FOSSIL MANIAC... Ta on tore mees, kes armastab FOSSILS...

label: Route114_FossilManiacsHouse_Text_HaveThisToDigLikeMyBrother
en: He loves digging holes, too… He dug this hole by himself…
et: Talle meeldib ka aukude kaevamine... ta kaevas selle augu ise...

label: Route114_FossilManiacsHouse_Text_HaveThisToDigLikeMyBrother
en: You can have this, so you can DIG holes just like my big brother…
et: Sul võib see olla, nii et sa saad DIG augud täpselt nagu mu suur vend...

label: Route114_FossilManiacsHouse_Text_DigReturnsYouToEntrance
en: If you make a POKéMON DIG inside a cave, you're returned to the entrance…
et: Kui teed POKéMON DIG koopa sees, siis oled tagasi sissepääsu juures...

label: Route114_FossilManiacsHouse_Text_RocksFillDisplayCase
en: Rocks in peculiar shapes fill the display case…
et: Omapäraste kujudega rokid täidavad vitriini...

label: Route114_FossilManiacsHouse_Text_CrammedWithBooks
en: THE COMPOSITION OF STRATA… HOW RAIN SHAPES THE LAND… STONES, SOIL, AND ROCK…
et: THE COMPOSITION OF STRATA... HOW RAIN SHAPES THE LAND... STONES, SOIL, AND ROCK...

label: Route114_FossilManiacsHouse_Text_CrammedWithBooks
en: It's crammed with books.
et: See on kimpus raamatutega.

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_WishIHadAllDolls
en: Oh, they're so nice! I wish I had them! Cute cushions! Big plush DOLLS! Little plush DOLLS! I wish I had them all!
et: Oi, nad on nii toredad! Ma soovin, et mul oleks neid! Armsad padjad! Suur pluss DOLLS! Väike plüüs DOLLS! Ma soovin, et mul oleksid need kõik olemas!

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_GetYouAnythingYouWant
en: Leave it to your mommy!
et: Jäta see oma emmele!

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_GetYouAnythingYouWant
en: If it's anything you want, I'll go through anything to get it, honey!
et: Kui see on midagi, mida sa tahad, siis ma elan kõik läbi, et seda saada, kallis!

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_ItemsWillGetMonTougher
en: If I can get hold of the items here, my POKéMON will get tougher.
et: Kui saan siinsetest esemetest kätte, siis mu POKéMON läheb karmimaks.

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_ItemsWillGetMonTougher
en: You bet they will! No question about it!
et: Vean kihla, et nad seda teevad! Pole küsimustki selle kohta!

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_GoGetYourOwnDoll
en: Hah? What are you gawking at?
et: Hah? Mida sa haigutad?

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_GoGetYourOwnDoll
en: I don't like you staring at my plush doll like that.
et: Mulle ei meeldi, et sa niimoodi mu plüüsinukku vahid.

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_GoGetYourOwnDoll
en: If you want it, go get one yourself! Isn't that right, SMOOCHUM?
et: Kui sa seda tahad, siis mine hangi üks ise! Kas pole õige, SMOOCHUM?

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_MoreBattlePointsForRecord

et: Tõstab stat ATTACK ühe POKéMON.

en: Raises the stat SP. ATK of one POKéMON.
et: Tõstab stat SP. ATK ühest POKéMON.

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_IronDesc
en: Raises the stat DEFENSE of one POKéMON.
et: Tõstab stat DEFENSE ühe POKéMON.

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_ZincDesc
en: Raises the stat SP. DEF of one POKéMON.

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_CarbosDesc
en: Raises the stat SPEED of one POKéMON.

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_HPUpDesc
en: Raises the HP of one POKéMON.
et: Tõstab HP ühe POKéMON.

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_LeftoversDesc
en: A hold item that gradually restores HP in battle.
et: Hold ese, mis taastab järk-järgult HP lahingus.

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_WhiteHerbDesc
en: A hold item that restores any lowered stat.
et: Hold ese, mis taastab mis tahes langetatud stat.

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_QuickClawDesc
en: A hold item that occasionally allows the first strike.
et: Holding ese, mis võimaldab aeg-ajalt esimest streiki.

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_MentalHerbDesc
en: A hold item that snaps POKéMON out of infatuation.
et: Hold ese, mis klõpsib POKéMON infaturatsioonist.

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_BrightpowderDesc
en: A hold item that casts a glare to reduce accuracy.
et: Hold ese, mis heidab pimestuse, et vähendada täpsust.

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_ChoiceBandDesc
en: Raises a move's power, but permits only that move.
et: Tõstab kolimise võimu, aga lubab ainult seda võtet.

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_KingsRockDesc
en: A hold item that may cause flinching when the foe is hit.
et: Holding ese, mis võib põhjustada flirtimist, kui vaenlane on tabatud.

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_FocusBandDesc
en: A hold item that occasionally prevents fainting.
et: Holding ese, mis aeg-ajalt takistab minestamist.

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_ScopeLensDesc
en: A hold item that raises the critical-hit rate.
et: Holding ese, mis tõstab kriitilise löögi määra.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: Yo, how's it going, CHAMPIONbound {PLAYER}?
et: Yo, kuidas läheb, TŠEMPIONbound {PLAYER}?

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: FORTREE GYM LEADER WINONA is a master of FLYING-type POKéMON.
et: FORTREE SAALI JUHT WINONA on meister Lendav-tüüpi POKéMON.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: She's waiting at the back of this GYM, behind the rotating doors.
et: Ta ootab selle SAAL taga, pöörlevate uste taga.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: She's waiting for new challengers who are trying to take wing!
et: Ta ootab uusi väljakutsujaid, kes üritavad tiibadesse saada!

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: Okay, go for it!
et: Olgu, mine järele!

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictory
en: You did it! You've achieved liftoff!
et: Sa tegid seda! Sa oled saavutanud liftoffi!

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_JaredIntro
en: Behold the elegant battle style of BIRD POKéMON!
et: Vaata elegantset lahingustiili BIRD POKéMON!

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_JaredDefeat
en: You… You're strong…
et: Sa oled tugev...

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_JaredPostBattle
en: A TRAINER has to be smart to keep up with unexpected turns of events.
et: A TRAINER peab olema tark, et olla kursis ootamatute sündmuste pööretega.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_JaredPostBattle
en: Do you have the smarts to get to our LEADER?
et: Kas teil on tarkusi, et jõuda meie LEADER?

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_EdwardoIntro
en: The lovers of BIRD POKéMON aspire to join this GYM.
et: Armastajad BIRD POKéMON soovivad liituda selle SAAL.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_EdwardoIntro
en: As a member of the FORTREE GYM, I'm not allowed to lose!
et: FORTREE SAAL liikmena ei tohi ma kaotada!

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_EdwardoDefeat
en: It was too much of a load for me to bear…
et: See oli minu jaoks liiga suur koormus, mida kanda...

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_EdwardoPostBattle
en: The world is huge, and there are countless tough TRAINERS.
et: Maailm on tohutu ja sitkeid TRAINERS on lugematul hulgal.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_EdwardoPostBattle
en: I'm going to keep training and make myself even stronger.
et: Jätkan treeninguid ja teen end veelgi tugevamaks.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_FlintIntro
en: There's no need for WINONA, our GYM LEADER, to deal with you!
et: Pole vaja WINONA, meie SAALI JUHT, et teiega tegeleda!

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_FlintIntro
en: I'm plenty good enough for you!
et: Ma olen sulle piisavalt hea!

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_FlintDefeat
en: WINONA, I… I lost!
et: WINONA, ma... ma kaotasin!

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_FlintPostBattle
en: WINONA is cute and she's strong. She's the ultimate LEADER!
et: WINONA on armas ja ta on tugev. Ta on ülim LEADER!

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_FlintPostBattle
en: Blush…
et: Põsepuna...

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_AshleyIntro
en: WINONA taught me personally! You can't beat me easily!
et: WINONA õpetas mind isiklikult! Sa ei saa mind lihtsalt võita!

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_AshleyDefeat
en: I was beaten…
et: Mind peksti...

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_AshleyPostBattle
en: Thanks to WINONA, the people of FORTREE can live without fear.
et: Tänu WINONA-le saavad FORTREE inimesed elada kartmatult.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_HumbertoIntro
en: When WINONA takes to battle, her face shines with beautiful determination…
et: Kui WINONA võtab lahingu, tema nägu särab ilus kindlameelsus...

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_HumbertoIntro
en: I'm not letting you witness that lovely sight!
et: Ma ei lase sul seda armsat vaatepilti pealt näha!

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_HumbertoDefeat
en: Urk! I couldn't stop you.
et: Urk! Ma ei suutnud sind takistada.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_HumbertoPostBattle
en: You'd better watch it! Don't get distracted staring at WINONA or you'll go crashing down in a heap!
et: Vaata parem seda! Ära lase end häirida WINONA vahtimast, muidu lähed kuhjaga alla kraaksuma!

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_DariusIntro
en: You'd better know that there are all sorts of FLYING-type POKéMON.
et: Parem oleks teada, et on olemas igasugu Lendav-tüüpi POKéMON.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_DariusIntro
en: You do know that, right?
et: Sa tead seda, eks?

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_DariusDefeat
en: You seem to know your stuff!
et: Tundub, et sa tead oma asju!

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_DariusPostBattle
en: Sure, you beat me all right. But you'd better watch it! Our LEADER WINONA's POKéMON are all business.
et: Muidugi, sa peksid mind hästi. Aga parem jälgige seda! Meie LEADER WINONA on POKéMON on kõik äri.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaIntro
en: I am WINONA. I am the LEADER of the FORTREE POKéMON GYM.
et: Olen WINONA. Mina olen LEADER FORTREE POKéMON SAAL.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaIntro
en: I have become one with BIRD POKéMON and have soared the skies…
et: Olen saanud üheks BIRD POKéMON ja hüppeliselt taevalaotust tõstnud...

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaIntro
en: However grueling the battle, we have triumphed with grace…
et: Kui tahes kurnav lahing, oleme võidutsenud armuga...

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaIntro
en: Witness the elegant choreography of BIRD POKéMON and I!
et: Tunnista elegantset koreograafiat BIRD POKéMON ja mina!

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaDefeat
en: Never before have I seen a TRAINER command POKéMON with more grace than I…
et: Mitte kunagi varem pole ma näinud TRAINER käsku POKéMON millel on rohkem armu kui mul...

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaDefeat
en: In recognition of your prowess, I present to you this GYM BADGE.
et: Tunnustades teie osavust, esitan teile selle SAAL MÄRK.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedFeatherBadge
en: {PLAYER} received the FEATHER BADGE from WINONA.
et: {PLAYER} sai FEATHER MÄRK alates WINONA.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_ExplainFeatherBadgeTakeThis
en: With the FEATHER BADGE, all POKéMON up to LV 70, even those received through trades, will obey your every command.
et: FEATHER MÄRK, kõik POKéMON kuni LV 70, isegi need, mis on saadud läbi kauplemiste, kuuletuvad teie iga käsu.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_ExplainFeatherBadgeTakeThis
en: You will also be able to use the HM move FLY outside of battle.
et: Samuti saate kasutada HM liikuda FLY väljaspool lahingut.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_ExplainFeatherBadgeTakeThis
en: And this… This is a gift from me.
et: Ja see... see on minu kingitus.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_ExplainAerialAce
en: TM40 contains AERIAL ACE.
et: TM40 sisaldab AERIAL ACE.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_ExplainAerialAce
en: Its speed… No POKéMON should be able to avoid it.
et: Selle kiirus... no POKéMON peaks suutma seda vältida.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_RegisteredWinona
en: Registered GYM LEADER WINONA in the POKéNAV.
et: Registreerunud SAALI JUHT WINONA POKéNAV.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaPostBattle
en: Though I fell to you, I will remain devoted to BIRD POKéMON.
et: Kuigi ma langesin sinu juurde, jään ma pühendunud BIRD POKéMON.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
en: FORTREE CITY POKéMON GYM
et: FORTREE CITY POKéMON SAAL

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertified
en: FORTREE CITY POKéMON GYM
et: FORTREE CITY POKéMON SAAL

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertified
en: WINONA'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS: {PLAYER}
et: WINONA'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS: {PLAYER}

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaPreRematch
en: WINONA: We humans can never escape gravity's pull on the ground.
et: WINONA: Meie, inimesed, ei pääse kunagi gravitatsioonitõmbest maapinnale.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaPreRematch
en: But by striving for excellence, we have the power to soar!
et: Kuid püüdledes tipptaseme poole, on meil võim hüppeliselt tõusta!

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaPreRematch
en: You have scaled the pinnacle as the reigning CHAMPION.
et: Sa oled tipu skaleerinud kui valitsev TŠEMPION.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaPreRematch
en: Please, allow me to see your power at full flight!
et: Palun, lubage mul näha oma väge täislennul!

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaRematchDefeat
en: I failed to reach your height again…
et: Mul ei õnnestunud jälle teie kõrgust saavutada...

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaPostRematch
en: WINONA: Even though I have lost, the wings of my heart remain unbroken.
et: WINONA: Kuigi olen kaotanud, jäävad mu südame tiivad katki.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaPostRematch
en: I can rise and soar again and yet again.
et: Võin ikka ja jälle tõusta ja hüppeliselt kerkida.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaPostRematch
en: I am convinced of it!
et: Olen selles veendunud!

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaRematchNeedTwoMons
en: WINONA: We humans can never escape gravity's pull on the ground.
et: WINONA: Meie, inimesed, ei pääse kunagi gravitatsioonitõmbest maapinnale.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaRematchNeedTwoMons
en: But by striving for excellence, we have the power to soar!
et: Kuid püüdledes tipptaseme poole, on meil võim hüppeliselt tõusta!

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaRematchNeedTwoMons
en: You have scaled the pinnacle as the reigning CHAMPION.
et: Sa oled tipu skaleerinud kui valitsev TŠEMPION.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaRematchNeedTwoMons
en: Please, allow me to see your power at full flight!
et: Palun, lubage mul näha oma väge täislennul!

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaRematchNeedTwoMons
en: Oh, no… Do you have but one POKéMON with you?
et: Kas sul on kaasas ainult üks POKéMON?

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaRematchNeedTwoMons
en: Please return with two POKéMON at the very least.
et: Palun naasege vähemalt kahe POKéMON-ga.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ThisIsExhibitHall
en: This is our special exhibit hall.
et: See on meie eriline näitusesaal.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ExplainExhibitHall
en: As you can plainly see, there is not a single painting on exhibit.
et: Nagu selgelt näha, ei ole eksponaadil ainsatki maali.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ExplainExhibitHall
en: Here, I don't wish to exhibit works of so-called classical art.
et: Siin ei soovi ma eksponeerida nn klassikalise kunsti teoseid.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ExplainExhibitHall
en: Such classical works you can see on our ground floor.
et: Selliseid klassikalisi teoseid näete meie esimesel korrusel.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ExplainExhibitHall
en: I wish to exhibit work that is far different from the classics.
et: Soovin eksponeerida klassikast kaugelt erinevat tööd.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ExplainExhibitHall
en: Art, after all, is not restricted to old, famous works!
et: Kunst ei piirdu ju ainult vanade, kuulsate teostega!

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ExplainExhibitHall
en: This exhibit hall, I wish to fill it with…
et: See eksponaatide saal, soovin seda täita...

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ExplainExhibitHall
en: Modern and vibrant artworks of POKéMON seemingly ready to spring forth into glorious life!
et: Nüüdisaegsed ja elavad kunstiteosed POKéMON näiliselt valmis välja voolama kuulsusrikkasse ellu!

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_PleaseObtainPaintingsForExhibit
en: I beg your pardon. I didn't intend to monopolize the conversation.
et: Ma anun su armu. Ma ei kavatsenud vestlust monopoliseerida.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_PleaseObtainPaintingsForExhibit
en: Now, as you are young, and yet obviously well traveled…
et: Nüüd, kui sa oled noor, ja ometi ilmselgelt hästi reisitud...

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_PleaseObtainPaintingsForExhibit
en: You must encounter lively POKéMON and works of art depicting them.
et: Tuleb kokku puutuda elavate POKéMON ja neid kujutavate kunstiteostega.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_PleaseObtainPaintingsForExhibit
en: If you were to come across such a painting, may we ask you to obtain the artist's permission to exhibit it here?
et: Kui sa peaksid sellise maaliga kokku puutuma, kas me palume sul saada kunstniku luba seda siin eksponeerida?

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_WishToFillExhibit
en: I wish to fill this exhibit hall with modern and vibrant paintings of POKéMON.
et: Soovin täita selle eksponaadisaali kaasaegsete ja elavate maalidega POKéMON.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ThanksAddedNewPainting
en: Thanks to you, we've added a new painting to our collection!
et: Tänu teile oleme lisanud oma kollektsiooni uue maali!

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ThanksAddedNewPainting
en: I've heard it depicts your POKéMON. Truly magnificent!
et: Olen kuulnud, et see kujutab sinu POKéMON. Tõeliselt võrratu!

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ThanksAddedNewPainting
en: Thank you so very, very much!
et: Suured-suured tänud!

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ItsYouPlayer
en: Ah! It's you! {PLAYER}!
et: Ah! See oled sina! {PLAYER}!

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_PaintingsAttractedMoreGuests
en: Isn't this marvelous? This collection of paintings!
et: Kas see pole mitte imeline? See maalide kogu!

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_PaintingsAttractedMoreGuests
en: Each one of them flawless! None better than another!
et: Igaüks neist veatu! Ei midagi paremat kui teine!

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_PaintingsAttractedMoreGuests
en: These paintings have attracted more guests to our ART MUSEUM.
et: Need maalid on meelitanud rohkem külalisi meie ART MUSEUM.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_PaintingsAttractedMoreGuests
en: Sincerely, I thank you, {PLAYER}. This is my dream come true!
et: Siiralt tänan, {PLAYER}. See on minu unistus!

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_TokenOfGratitude
en: This is merely a token of my gratitude.
et: See on lihtsalt minu tänulikkuse märk.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_KeepThisForYou
en: I will keep this for you until we meet again.
et: Ma hoian seda teie eest, kuni me uuesti kohtume.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_HonorToHaveYouVisit
en: Ah, so good to see you, {PLAYER}!
et: Ah, nii hea sind näha, {PLAYER}!

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_HonorToHaveYouVisit
en: It's an honor to have you visit us on your busy journeys.
et: On auasi, kui külastate meid oma tihedatel reisidel.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_HonorToHaveYouVisit
en: Please, relax and do enjoy your visit with us.
et: Palun lõõgastuge ja nautige koos meiega oma külastust.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ItsPinkPictureFrame
en: It's a picture frame with pink-colored adornments.
et: See on roosavärviliste kaunistustega pildiraam.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ItsYellowPictureFrame
en: It's a picture frame with yellow-colored adornments.
et: See on kollast värvi kaunistustega pildiraam.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ItsBluePictureFrame
en: It's a picture frame with blue-colored adornments.
et: See on sinisevärviliste kaunistustega pildiraam.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ItsRedPictureFrame
en: It's a picture frame with red-colored adornments.
et: See on punase värvi kaunistustega pildiraam.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ItsGreenPictureFrame
en: It's a picture frame with green-colored adornments.
et: See on rohelist värvi kaunistustega pildiraam.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ItsPaintingOfPokemon
en: It's a painting of POKéMON.
et: See on maal POKéMON.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_NewPaintingsSurprisedMe
en: I've been away awhile, so the new paintings up here surprised me.
et: Ma olen ära ahastanud, nii et siin üleval olevad uued maalid üllatasid mind.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_NewPaintingsSurprisedMe
en: I wish someone would paint my POKéMON this pretty.
et: Soovin, et keegi värviks mu POKéMON selle ilusaks.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_NewPaintingsRatherAmusing
en: Well… So this is where they show the topical POKéMON paintings.
et: See on koht, kus nad näitavad aktuaalseid POKéMON maale.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_NewPaintingsRatherAmusing
en: I see, these new paintings are indeed rather amusing.
et: Ma näen, need uued maalid on tõepoolest üsna lõbusad.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ThesePaintingsOfYourPokemon
en: Wow, is that right? These paintings are of your POKéMON.
et: Kas see on õige? Need maalid on sinu POKéMON.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ThesePaintingsOfYourPokemon
en: Isn't that just the ultimate joy for a TRAINER?
et: Kas see pole mitte ainult ülim rõõm TRAINER jaoks?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge8_Text_WhatATrainerNeeds
en: What a TRAINER needs…
et: Mida TRAINER vajab...

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge8_Text_WhatATrainerNeeds
en: Knowledge… Strategy… Luck… Guts… Spirit… Bravery… And ability…
et: Teadmised... Strateegia... Õnne... Gutts... Vaim... Vaprus... Ja võime...

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge8_Text_WhatATrainerNeeds
en: Well, I'm all set in every way! I'll be unstoppable at every building!
et: No ma olen kõik igas mõttes sätitud! Olen peatamatu igas hoones!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge8_Text_WhatATrainerNeeds
en: Huh? POKéMON? What's that?
et: Huh? POKéMON? Mis see on?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge8_Text_KnowAboutFrontierBrains
en: Do you know about the FRONTIER BRAINS?
et: Kas tead FRONTIER BRAINS kohta?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge8_Text_KnowAboutFrontierBrains
en: That's what SCOTT calls the seven special TRAINERS that run the seven facilities in the BATTLE FRONTIER.
et: Nii nimetab SCOTT seitset spetsiaalset TRAINERS, mis käivitavad seitse rajatist BATTLE FRONTIER.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge8_Text_ToldMeIHaveTalentForBattling
en: At the BATTLE TOWER, an older girl told me that I have a lot of talent for battling!
et: BATTLE TOWER juures ütles üks vanem tüdruk mulle, et mul on palju annet võidelda!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge8_Text_ToldMeIHaveTalentForBattling
en: I like POKéMON CONTESTS more!
et: Mulle meeldib POKéMON CONTESTS rohkem!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge8_Text_ToldMeIHaveTalentForBattling
en: But I'm no good at CONTESTS!
et: Aga ma ei ole hea CONTESTS!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge8_Text_ToldMeIHaveTalentForBattling
en: I guess having talent and liking something aren't the same.
et: Ma arvan, et andekus ja millegi meeldimine ei ole sama.

label: LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_ICanMakeMonForgetMove
en: Uh… Oh, yes, I'm the MOVE DELETER.
et: Ahjaa, mina olen see MOVE DELETER.

label: LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_ICanMakeMonForgetMove
en: I can make POKéMON forget their moves.
et: Ma võin teha POKéMON unustada nende käigud.

label: LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_ICanMakeMonForgetMove
en: Would you like me to do that?
et: Kas sa tahaksid, et ma seda teeksin?

label: LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_WhichMonShouldForget
en: Which POKéMON should forget a move?
et: Milline POKéMON peaks kolimise unustama?

label: LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_WhichMoveShouldBeForgotten
en: Which move should be forgotten?
et: Millise võtte unustame?

label: LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_MonOnlyKnowsOneMove
en: {STR_VAR_1} knows only one move so it can't be forgotten…
et: {STR_VAR_1} teab ainult ühte võtet, et seda ei saaks unustada...

label: LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_MonsMoveShouldBeForgotten
en: Hm! {STR_VAR_1}'s {STR_VAR_2}? That move should be forgotten?
et: Hm! {STR_VAR_1} on {STR_VAR_2}? See käik tuleks unustada?

label: LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_MonHasForgottenMove
en: It worked to perfection!
et: See toimis täiuslikkuseni!

label: LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_MonHasForgottenMove
en: {STR_VAR_1} has forgotten {STR_VAR_2} completely.
et: {STR_VAR_1} on unustanud {STR_VAR_2} täielikult.

label: LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_ComeAgain
en: Come again if there are moves that need to be forgotten.
et: Tule uuesti, kui on käike, mis tuleb unustada.

label: LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_EggCantForgetMoves
en: What? No EGG should know any moves.
et: Mida? No EGG peaks teadma mingeid käike.

label: LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_CantForgetSurf
en: Hm!
et: Hm!

label: LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_CantForgetSurf
en: Your {STR_VAR_1} doesn't seem willing to forget SURF.
et: Sinu {STR_VAR_1} ei tundu olevat valmis unustama SURF.

label: Route110_SeasideCyclingRoadSouthEntrance_Text_GoAllOutOnCyclingRoad
en: On CYCLING ROAD, you can go all out and cycle as fast as you'd like.
et: CYCLING ROAD peal saad kõik välja minna ja nii kiiresti tsüklit teha, kui tahaksid.

label: Route110_SeasideCyclingRoadSouthEntrance_Text_GoAllOutOnCyclingRoad
en: It feels great to go that fast, but try not to crash into anyone!
et: On suurepärane tunne minna nii kiiresti, kuid proovige mitte kellelegi otsa sõita!

label: Route110_SeasideCyclingRoadSouthEntrance_Text_TooDangerousToWalk
en: Sorry, you can't walk on CYCLING ROAD. It's too dangerous.
et: Sorry, ei saa jalutada CYCLING ROAD peal. See on liiga ohtlik.

label: Route110_SeasideCyclingRoadSouthEntrance_Text_TooDangerousToWalk
en: Please come back with a BIKE.
et: Palun tule tagasi BIKE-ga.

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieHoldItRightThere
en: ARCHIE: Hold it right there.
et: ARCHIE: Hoidke seda sealsamas.

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieSoItWasYou
en: ARCHIE: Fufufu… So it was you, after all.
et: ARCHIE: Fufufu... Nii et see olid ju sina.

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieBeholdKyogre
en: ARCHIE: Behold!
et: ARCHIE: Vaata!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieBeholdKyogre
en: See how beautiful it is, the sleeping form of the ancient POKéMON KYOGRE!
et: Vaata, kui ilus see on, iidse POKéMON KYOGRE magamisvorm!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieBeholdKyogre
en: I have waited so long for this day to come…
et: Ma olen nii kaua oodanud, et see päev tuleb...

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieYouMustDisappear
en: ARCHIE: It surprises me, how you've managed to chase me here.
et: ARCHIE: See üllatab mind, kuidas teil on õnnestunud mind siin taga ajada.

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieYouMustDisappear
en: But that's all over now.
et: Aga see on nüüd kõik läbi.

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieYouMustDisappear
en: For the realization of my dream, you must disappear now!
et: Minu unistuse realiseerimiseks pead sa nüüd kaduma!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieDefeat
en: What?! I lost to a mere child like you?!
et: Mida?! Kaotasin sinusugusele pelgale lapsele?!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWithThisRedOrb
en: ARCHIE: Fufufu…
et: ARCHIE: Fufufufu...

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWithThisRedOrb
en: I commend you. I must recognize that you are truly gifted.
et: Kiidan. Ma pean tunnistama, et sa oled tõeliselt andekas.

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWithThisRedOrb
en: But! I have this in my possession!
et: Aga! See on minu valduses!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWithThisRedOrb
en: With this RED ORB, I can make KYOGRE…
et: Selle RED ORB-ga saan teha KYOGRE...

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_RedOrbShinesByItself
en: The RED ORB suddenly began shining by itself!
et: RED ORB hakkas äkki iseenesest särama!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWhereDidKyogreGo
en: ARCHIE: What?!
et: ARCHIE: Mida?!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWhereDidKyogreGo
en: I didn't do anything. Why did the RED ORB…
et: Ma ei teinud midagi. Miks RED ORB...

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWhereDidKyogreGo
en: Where did KYOGRE go?
et: Kuhu läks KYOGRE?

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieAMessageFromOutside
en: ARCHIE: Hm? It's a message from our members outside…
et: ARCHIE: Hm? See on sõnum meie liikmete poolt väljastpoolt...

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWhatRainingTooHard
en: ARCHIE: Yes, what is it?
et: ARCHIE: Jah, mis see on?

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWhatRainingTooHard
en: Hm… It's raining heavily?
et: Hm... sajab kõvasti vihma?

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWhatRainingTooHard
en: Good… That should have happened. That is why we awakened KYOGRE, to realize TEAM AQUA's vision of expanding the sea.
et: Hea, see oleks pidanud juhtuma. Seepärast ärkasimegi KYOGRE, et realiseerida TEAM AQUA nägemus mere laiendamisest.

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWhatRainingTooHard
en: What?!
et: Mida?!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWhatRainingTooHard
en: It's raining far harder than we envisioned? You're in danger?
et: Vihma sajab palju kõvemini, kui me ette kujutasime? Oled ohus?

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWhatRainingTooHard
en: That can't be… That's just not possible…
et: See ei saa olla... see pole lihtsalt võimalik...

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWhatRainingTooHard
en: Hold your position and monitor the situation!
et: Hoia oma positsiooni ja jälgi olukorda!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWhyDidKyogreDisappear
en: ARCHIE: There's something wrong…
et: ARCHIE: Midagi on valesti...

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWhyDidKyogreDisappear
en: The RED ORB is supposed to awaken and control KYOGRE…
et: RED ORB peaks äratama ja kontrollima KYOGRE...

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWhyDidKyogreDisappear
en: But… Why? Why did KYOGRE disappear?
et: Aga... miks? Miks kadus KYOGRE?

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWhyDidKyogreDisappear
en: Why?!
et: Miks?!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_MaxieWhatHaveYouWrought
en: MAXIE: What have you wrought?
et: MAXIE: Mida olete teinud?

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_MaxieWhatHaveYouWrought
en: ARCHIE… You've finally awoken KYOGRE, haven't you?
et: ARCHIE... Sa oled lõpuks ärganud KYOGRE, kas pole?

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_MaxieWhatHaveYouWrought
en: What will happen to the world if this downpour continues for all eternity?
et: Mis saab maailmast, kui see paduvihm jätkub terveks igavikuks?

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_MaxieWhatHaveYouWrought
en: The world's landmass will drown in the deepening sea…
et: Maailma maamass upub süvenevasse merre...

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieDontGetAllHighAndMighty
en: ARCHIE: W-what?! Don't get all high and mighty with me!
et: ARCHIE: W-what?! Ärge saage minuga kõik kõrgeks ja vägevaks!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieDontGetAllHighAndMighty
en: Wasn't it you, TEAM MAGMA, that infuriated GROUDON?
et: Kas see polnud mitte sina, TEAM MAGMA, mis vihastas GROUDON?

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieDontGetAllHighAndMighty
en: So long as I have this RED ORB, I should be able to control KYOGRE…
et: Niikaua kui mul on see RED ORB, peaksin suutma kontrollida KYOGRE...

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieDontGetAllHighAndMighty
en: I should be able to control it…
et: Peaksin suutma seda kontrollida...

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_MaxieWeDontHaveTimeToArgue
en: MAXIE: We don't have the time to argue about it here!
et: MAXIE: Meil ei ole siin aega selle üle vaielda!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_MaxieWeDontHaveTimeToArgue
en: Get outside and see for yourself!
et: Minge õue ja vaadake ise!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_MaxieWeDontHaveTimeToArgue
en: See if what you've wrought is the world that we desired!
et: Vaata, kas see, mida sa oled teinud, on maailm, mida me soovisime!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_MaxieComeOnPlayer
en: MAXIE: {PLAYER}, come on, you have to get out of here, too!
et: MAXIE: {PLAYER}, tule, sa pead ka siit ära minema!

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_ManTryingToDigTunnel
en: My papa told me.
et: Mu papa ütles mulle.

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_ManTryingToDigTunnel
en: He says this tunnel is full of timid POKéMON.
et: Ta ütleb, et see tunnel on täis arglikku POKéMON.

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_ManTryingToDigTunnel
en: They get all scared of loud noise and make a big uproar.
et: Nad kõik kardavad valju lärmi ja teevad suurt möllu.

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_ManTryingToDigTunnel
en: So they had to stop the big tunnel project.
et: Nii tuli neil suur tunneliprojekt peatada.

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_ManTryingToDigTunnel
en: But there's one man. He's trying to dig the tunnel by himself!
et: Aga on üks mees. Ta üritab tunnelit ise kaevata!

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_ManDugTunnelForLove
en: There was a man who dug a tunnel for a lady he loved.
et: Oli mees, kes kaevas tunneli talle armsale daamile.

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_ManDugTunnelForLove
en: I don't really get it, but hey!
et: Ma tõesti ei saa sellest aru, aga hei!

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_AirCleanHere
en: The way the winds blow, volcanic ash is never blown in this direction.
et: Seda, kuidas tuuled puhuvad, vulkaanilist tuhka selles suunas kunagi ei puhuta.

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_AirCleanHere
en: The air is clean and delicious here. Living here should do wonders for even frail and sickly people.
et: Õhk on siin puhas ja maitsev. Siin elamine peaks tegema imet isegi nõrkadele ja haigetele inimestele.

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_MakeBattleTentDebut
en: My POKéMON and I, we've been riding a hot winning streak.
et: Minu POKéMON ja mina, oleme sõitnud kuuma võiduseeriaga.

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_MakeBattleTentDebut
en: So I decided to make my BATTLE TENT debut in this town.
et: Seega otsustasin teha oma BATTLE TENT debüüdi siin linnas.

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_GuyTryingToBustThroughCave
en: Did you see the cave next to the POKéMON MART?
et: Kas te nägite koobast POKéMON MART kõrval?

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_GuyTryingToBustThroughCave
en: There's a guy in there who's trying to bust up boulders so he can bust out through to the other side.
et: Seal on üks mees, kes üritab rahnusid lõhkuda, et ta saaks teisele poole läbi pugeda.

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_GuyTryingToBustThroughCave
en: It'd be great if we could go through… It'll make it easy to visit RUSTBORO.
et: See oleks suurepärane, kui me suudaksime läbi elada... See teeb külastamise lihtsaks RUSTBORO.

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_EasyToGetToRustboroNow
en: That cave next to the POKéMON MART is now a tunnel to the other side.
et: See koobas POKéMON MART kõrval on nüüd tunnel teisele poole.

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_EasyToGetToRustboroNow
en: It's great--it's easy to go shop for new DEVON products in RUSTBORO now.
et: See on suurepärane--on lihtne minna ostma uusi DEVON tooteid RUSTBORO nüüd.

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_TownSign
en: VERDANTURF TOWN
et: VERDANTURF TOWN

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_TownSign
en: “The windswept highlands with the sweet fragrance of grass.”
et: "Tuulepealsed kõrgustikud koos rohu magusa lõhnaga."

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_WandasHouse
en: WANDA'S HOUSE
et: WANDA'S HOUSE

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_BattleTentSign
en: BATTLE TENT VERDANTURF SITE “Feast Your Eyes on Battles!”
et: BATTLE TENT VERDANTURF SITE "Feast Your Eyes on Battles!"

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_RusturfTunnelSign
en: RUSTURF TUNNEL “Linking RUSTBORO and VERDANTURF
et: RUSTURF TUNNEL "Linkimine RUSTBORO ja VERDANTURF

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_RusturfTunnelSign
en: “The tunnel project has been canceled.”
et: "Tunneliprojekt on tühistatud."

label: OldaleTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TrainersCanUsePC
en: That PC in the corner there is for any POKéMON TRAINER to use.
et: Et PC nurgas on iga POKéMON TRAINER kasutada.

label: OldaleTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TrainersCanUsePC
en: Naturally, that means you're welcome to use it, too.
et: Loomulikult tähendab see, et ka sina oled oodatud seda kasutama.

label: OldaleTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PokemonCentersAreGreat
en: POKéMON CENTERS are great!
et: POKéMON CENTERS on suurepärane!

label: OldaleTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PokemonCentersAreGreat
en: You can use their services as much as you like, and it's all for free. You never have to worry!
et: Nende teenuseid saad kasutada nii palju kui soovid ja seda kõike tasuta. Sa ei pea kunagi muretsema!

label: OldaleTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_WirelessClubNotAvailable
en: The POKéMON WIRELESS CLUB on the second floor was built recently.
et: Teisel korrusel asuv POKéMON WIRELESS CLUB ehitati hiljuti.

label: OldaleTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_WirelessClubNotAvailable
en: But they say they're still making adjustments.
et: Aga nad ütlevad, et teevad ikka korrektiive.

label: OldaleTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TradedInWirelessClub
en: The POKéMON WIRELESS CLUB on the second floor was built recently.
et: Teisel korrusel asuv POKéMON WIRELESS CLUB ehitati hiljuti.

label: OldaleTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TradedInWirelessClub
en: I traded POKéMON right away.
et: Kauplesin kohe POKéMON.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneIHaveFavor
en: I'm MR. STONE, the PRESIDENT of the DEVON CORPORATION.
et: Olen MR. STONE, PRESIDENT DEVON CORPORATION.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneIHaveFavor
en: I'd just got word about you!
et: Ma oleks sinust lihtsalt sõna saanud!

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneIHaveFavor
en: You saved our staff not just once, but twice!
et: Sa päästsid meie töötajaid mitte ainult üks kord, vaid kaks korda!

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneIHaveFavor
en: I have a favor to ask of an amazing person like you.
et: Mul on teene küsida sinusuguselt hämmastavalt inimeselt.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneIHaveFavor
en: I understand that you're delivering a package to SLATEPORT's SHIPYARD.
et: Ma saan aru, et sa toimetad paki SLATEPORT's SHIPYARD'sse.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneIHaveFavor
en: Well, on the way, could you stop off in DEWFORD TOWN?
et: Noh, teel olles, kas saaks DEWFORD TOWN-s seisma jääda?

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneIHaveFavor
en: I was hoping that you'd deliver a LETTER to STEVEN in DEWFORD.
et: Lootsin, et toimetad LETTER STEVEN  in DEWFORD.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneWantYouToHaveThis
en: MR. STONE: Now, you should know that I am a great PRESIDENT.
et: MR. STONE: Nüüd peaksite teadma, et ma olen suurepärane PRESIDENT.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneWantYouToHaveThis
en: So, I'd never be so cheap as to ask a favor for nothing in return.
et: Seega, ma ei oleks kunagi nii odav, et ei küsiks vastutasuks mitte midagi teenet.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneWantYouToHaveThis
en: That's why I want you to have this!
et: Sellepärast ma tahan, et sul oleks see olemas!

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ReceivedPokenav
en: {PLAYER} received a POKéNAV.
et: {PLAYER} sai POKéNAV.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneExplainPokenavRestUp
en: MR. STONE: That device…
et: MR. STONE: See seade...

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneExplainPokenavRestUp
en: It's a POKéMON NAVIGATOR, or POKéNAV for short.
et: See on POKéMON NAVIGATOR või POKéNAV lühidalt.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneExplainPokenavRestUp
en: It's an indispensable tool for any TRAINER on an adventure.
et: See on asendamatu vahend iga TRAINER seikluse jaoks.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneExplainPokenavRestUp
en: It has a map of the HOENN region.
et: Sellel on HOENN piirkonna kaart.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneExplainPokenavRestUp
en: You can check the locations of DEWFORD and SLATEPORT easily!
et: Saate hõlpsalt kontrollida DEWFORD ja SLATEPORT asukohti!

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneExplainPokenavRestUp
en: By the way, I've heard that sinister criminals--MAGMA and AQUA, I believe-have been making trouble far and wide.
et: Muide, ma olen kuulnud, et võikad kurjategijad--MAGMA ja AQUA, ma usun-on teinud probleeme kaugele ja laiaks.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneExplainPokenavRestUp
en: I think it would be best if you rested up before you go on your way.
et: Ma arvan, et kõige parem oleks, kui sa enne teele asumist välja puhkaksid.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneGoWithCautionAndCare
en: MR. STONE: Well, then, {PLAYER}{KUN}, go with caution and care!
et: MR. STONE: Noh, siis {PLAYER}{KUN}, mine ettevaatlikult ja ettevaatlikult!

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_CountingOnYou
en: MR. STONE: I'm counting on you!
et: MR. STONE: Ma loodan sulle!

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ThankYouForDeliveringLetter
en: MR. STONE: You delivered my LETTER? Thank you kindly!
et: MR. STONE: Sa toimetasid minu LETTER? Aitäh lahkesti!

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ThankYouForDeliveringLetter
en: This is my way of thanking you. It should help you, a TRAINER.
et: See on minu tänamise viis. See peaks sind aitama, a TRAINER.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ExplainExpShare
en: MR. STONE: A POKéMON holding that EXP. SHARE will be given some of the EXP Points from battle.
et: MR. STONE: A POKéMON hoides, et EXP. SHARE antakse mõned EXP P võidud lahingust.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ExplainExpShare
en: It will get EXP Points even if it didn't actually battle.
et: See saab EXP P võided ka siis, kui see tegelikult ei võidelnud.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ExplainExpShare
en: I would say EXP. SHARE is quite useful for raising weak POKéMON.
et: Ütleksin, et EXP. SHARE on üsna kasulik nõrga POKéMON tõstmiseks.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_NotFamiliarWithTrends
en: MR. STONE: Since my youth, I've immersed myself in work.
et: MR. STONE: Alates noorusest olen ma sukeldunud töösse.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_NotFamiliarWithTrends
en: Consequently, I'm not familiar with trends and that sort of thing.
et: Järelikult ei ole ma kursis trendide ja sellise asjaga.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_NotFamiliarWithTrends
en: But do young people all want to be TRAINERS in the POKéMON LEAGUE?
et: Aga kas noored kõik tahavad olla TRAINERS POKéMON LIIGA?

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ThisIs3rdFloorWaitHere
en: This is the DEVON CORPORATION's third floor.
et: See on DEVON CORPORATION kolmas korrus.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ThisIs3rdFloorWaitHere
en: Our PRESIDENT's OFFICE is on this floor.
et: Meie PRESIDENT on OFFICE on sellel korrusel.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ThisIs3rdFloorWaitHere
en: Anyway, I can't tell you how much I'm grateful for what you've done.
et: Igatahes ma ei oska öelda, kui palju ma olen tänulik selle eest, mida te olete teinud.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ThisIs3rdFloorWaitHere
en: Um… By the way, that parcel you got back for us…
et: Muide, see pakk, mille sa meile tagasi said...

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ThisIs3rdFloorWaitHere
en: Could I get you to deliver that to the SHIPYARD in SLATEPORT?
et: Kas ma saaksin su viia selle SHIPYARD  sisse SLATEPORT?

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ThisIs3rdFloorWaitHere
en: It would be awful if those robbers tried to take it again.
et: See oleks kohutav, kui need röövlid üritaksid seda uuesti võtta.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ThisIs3rdFloorWaitHere
en: Uh… Hehehe, so, uh, could I count on you to do that for me?
et: Hehehe, kas ma võiksin loota, et sa seda minu heaks teed?

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ThisIs3rdFloorWaitHere
en: Oh, that's right. Could you wait here a second?
et: See on õige. Kas sa võiksid siin korraks oodata?

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_WordWithPresidentComeWithMe
en: Our PRESIDENT would like to have a word with you.
et: Meie PRESIDENT sooviks teiega sõna sekka öelda.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_WordWithPresidentComeWithMe
en: Please come with me.
et: Palun tulge minuga kaasa.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_PleaseGoAhead
en: Please, go ahead.
et: Palun, lase käia.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_VisitCaptSternShipyard
en: If you visit the SHIPYARD in SLATEPORT, you should go see CAPT. STERN.
et: Kui külastate SHIPYARD in SLATEPORT, peaksite vaatama CAPT. STERN.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_RepeatAndTimerHugelyPopular
en: DEVON's new products, the REPEAT BALL and TIMER BALL, have become hugely popular among TRAINERS.
et: DEVON uued tooted, REPEAT BALL ja TIMER BALL, on muutunud tohutult populaarseks TRAINERS seas.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_RareRocksDisplay
en: It's a collection of rare rocks and stones assembled by the PRESIDENT.
et: See on haruldaste kivide ja kivide kollektsioon, mille on kokku pannud PRESIDENT.

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_5F_Text_PlaceFullOfCuteDolls
en: This place is full of cute DOLLS.
et: See koht on täis armsaid DOLLS.

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_5F_Text_PlaceFullOfCuteDolls
en: I should buy some for me, instead of just for my children.
et: Peaksin mõned endale ostma, selle asemel, et lihtsalt oma lastele.

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_5F_Text_GettingDollInsteadOfPokemon
en: I'm not big enough to raise POKéMON, so I'm getting a cute DOLL instead.
et: Ma ei ole piisavalt suur, et tõsta POKéMON, seega saan hoopis armsa DOLL.

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_5F_Text_SellManyCuteMatsHere
en: They sell many cute MATS here.
et: Nad müüvad siin palju armsaid MATS.

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_5F_Text_SellManyCuteMatsHere
en: I wonder which one I should get? Maybe I'll buy them all…
et: Huvitav, kumba ma peaks saama? Ehk ostan need kõik ära...

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_5F_Text_ClosedRooftopForWeather
en: I think they closed the rooftop because the weather is wild today.
et: Ma arvan, et nad sulgesid katuse, sest ilm on täna metsik.

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: Hey, how's it going, CHAMPIONbound {PLAYER}?
et: Hei, kuidas läheb, TŠEMPIONbound {PLAYER}?

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: DEWFORD's GYM LEADER BRAWLY commands FIGHTING-type POKéMON.
et: DEWFORD on SAALI JUHT BRAWLY käsud Kaklus-tüüpi POKéMON.

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: Going against him with NORMAL-type POKéMON is asking for trouble.
et: Tema vastu minek Tava-tüüpi POKéMON küsib probleeme.

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: FIGHTING POKéMON will lay a serious smack down on NORMAL POKéMON, so be careful!
et: FIGHTING POKéMON paneb tõsiselt lömastama NORMAL POKéMON, nii et olge ettevaatlikud!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: What's worse, the GYM is as dark as the ocean floor.
et: Mis veel hullem, SAAL on sama tume kui ookeanipõrand.

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: But it will get brighter after defeating the TRAINERS in your way.
et: Kuid see muutub heledamaks pärast TRAINERS alistamist teie teel.

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: Hey, okay, go for it!
et: Hei, okei, mine järele!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictory
en: Whoah! It's turned too bright in here!
et: Wooah! Siin on see liiga heledaks muutunud!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictory
en: Your future is bright, too!
et: Ka sinu tulevik on helge!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_TakaoIntro
en: Might is right! Come on!
et: Võib-olla on õigus! Tule nüüd!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_TakaoDefeat
en: Not enough power…
et: Mitte piisavalt võimsust...

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_TakaoPostBattle
en: Your skill overcame my strength! Your technique is commendable!
et: Sinu oskus sai mu jõust võitu! Sinu tehnika on kiiduväärt!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_JocelynIntro
en: There's no need for BRAWLY to be involved!
et: Pole vaja BRAWLY kaasata!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_JocelynIntro
en: I'll crush you!
et: Ma purustan su!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_JocelynDefeat
en: But… How? How could I lose so easily?
et: Aga... kuidas? Kuidas ma sain nii lihtsalt kaotada?

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_JocelynPostBattle
en: I'm not going to waste this loss. I'll use it to motivate me to train!
et: Ma ei hakka seda kaotust raiskama. Kasutan seda selleks, et motiveerida mind treenima!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_JocelynPostBattle
en: One day I'll become a GYM LEADER…
et: Ühel päeval saan SAALI JUHT...

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_JocelynPostBattle
en: No, I'll become the POKéMON LEAGUE CHAMPION!
et: Ei, minust saab POKéMON LIIGA TŠEMPION!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LauraIntro
en: Don't you dare brush me off! It's not my fault if you cry!
et: Kas sa ei julge mind ära harjata! See pole minu süü, kui sa nutad!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LauraDefeat
en: Waaaaaaah! I lost!
et: Waaaaaaaah! Kaotasin!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LauraPostBattle
en: I battle in the dark to make my heart stronger.
et: Ma võitlen pimedas, et mu süda oleks tugevam.

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LauraPostBattle
en: But because it's so dark, I can never see BRAWLY's face…
et: Aga kuna see on nii pime, siis ma ei näe kunagi BRAWLY nägu...

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LilithIntro
en: Ufufu… Are you stumbling around in the dark?
et: Ufufu... kas komistad pimedas ringi?

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LilithDefeat
en: Oh, you… I don't want to know you!
et: Oh sa... ma ei taha sind tunda!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LilithPostBattle
en: You deserve to stay lost and end up back at the entrance again!
et: Sa väärid eksinud olemist ja lõpetad taas sissepääsu juures tagasi!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrendenIntro
en: I'll show you the gumption of a sailing man!
et: Näitan purjetaja nätsu!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrendenDefeat
en: How'd this happen? It's not like me to lose this way!
et: Kuidas see juhtus? Ei ole nii, et ma kaotan niiviisi!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrendenPostBattle
en: Oh, aye! You're worthy of seeing our GYM LEADER.
et: Oh, aye! Sa oled väärt nägema meie SAALI JUHT.

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_CristianIntro
en: If you mean to pass, it has to be through me!
et: Kui sa tahad mööduda, siis see peab olema läbi minu!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_CristianDefeat
en: Grrrrr! Vastly overpowered!
et: Grrrrr! Vastikult üle jõu käiv!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_CristianPostBattle
en: You win! Go after that BADGE!
et: Sa võidad! Mine peale seda MÄRK!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyIntro
en: I'm BRAWLY! DEWFORD's GYM LEADER!
et: Olen BRAWLY! DEWFORD on SAALI JUHT!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyIntro
en: I've been churned in the rough waves of these parts, and I've grown tough in the pitch-black cave!
et: Mind on nende osade karedates lainetes kirutud ja pigimustas koopas sitkeks kasvanud!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyIntro
en: So you wanted to challenge me? Let me see what you're made of!
et: Sa tahtsid mulle väljakutset esitada? Las ma vaatan, millest sa tehtud oled!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyDefeat
en: Whoah, wow! You made a much bigger splash than I expected!
et: Wooah, vau! Tegid palju suurema pritsungi, kui ootasin!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyDefeat
en: You swamped me!
et: Sa sokutasid mind!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyDefeat
en: Okay, you've got me. Take this GYM BADGE!
et: Olgu, sa oled mu kätte saanud. Võta see SAAL MÄRK!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_ReceivedKnuckleBadge
en: {PLAYER} received the KNUCKLE BADGE from BRAWLY.
et: {PLAYER} sai KNUCKLE MÄRK alates BRAWLY.

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_KnuckleBadgeInfoTakeThis
en: The KNUCKLE BADGE makes all POKéMON up to Level 30, even those you get in trades, obey without question.
et: KNUCKLE MÄRK muudab kõik POKéMON kuni 30. tasemeni, isegi need, mida te saate ametites, kuuletuvad ilma kahtluseta.

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_KnuckleBadgeInfoTakeThis
en: And, you'll be able to use the HM move FLASH outside of battle.
et: Ja, siis on võimalik kasutada HM võtet FLASH väljaspool lahingut.

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_KnuckleBadgeInfoTakeThis
en: If you'd like, use this TECHNICAL MACHINE, too.
et: Kui soovid, kasuta seda TECHNICAL MACHINE ka.

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_ExplainBulkUp
en: That TM08 contains BULK UP.
et: Et TM08 sisaldab BULK UP.

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_ExplainBulkUp
en: It's a move that raises both ATTACK and DEFENSE stats.
et: See on käik, mis tõstab nii ATTACK kui ka DEFENSE statse.

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_RegisteredBrawly
en: Registered GYM LEADER BRAWLY in the POKéNAV.
et: Registreerunud SAALI JUHT BRAWLY POKéNAV.

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyPostBattle
en: I can see your talent becoming a giant wave to cause a storm of astonishment among TRAINERS one day!
et: Ma näen, kuidas teie talent muutub hiiglaslikuks laineks, et tekitada ühel päeval TRAINERS seas hämmastustormi!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_GymStatue
en: DEWFORD TOWN POKéMON GYM
et: DEWFORD TOWN POKéMON SAAL

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertified
en: DEWFORD TOWN POKéMON GYM
et: DEWFORD TOWN POKéMON SAAL

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertified
en: BRAWLY'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS: {PLAYER}
et: BRAWLY'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS: {PLAYER}

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyPreRematch
en: BRAWLY: A wave may draw back, but it always returns to the shore.
et: BRAWLY: Laine võib tagasi tõmbuda, kuid see naaseb alati kaldale.

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyPreRematch
en: A giant wave of a talent like you… I knew you would return!
et: Sinusuguse talendi hiiglaslik laine... ma teadsin, et sa naased!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyPreRematch
en: Show me how much higher you've gone!
et: Näita, kui palju kõrgemale oled läinud!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyRematchDefeat
en: Wow! Swamped again!
et: Vau! Soostunud jälle!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyPostRematch
en: BRAWLY: Battling is vast and it's deep. You can't see the bottom. It's just like the sea of HOENN!
et: BRAWLY: Võitlus on tohutu ja see on sügav. Põhja ei näe. See on täpselt nagu meri HOENN!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyRematchNeedTwoMons
en: BRAWLY: A wave may draw back, but it always returns to the shore.
et: BRAWLY: Laine võib tagasi tõmbuda, kuid see naaseb alati kaldale.

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyRematchNeedTwoMons
en: A giant wave of a talent like you… I knew you would return!
et: Sinusuguse talendi hiiglaslik laine... ma teadsin, et sa naased!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyRematchNeedTwoMons
en: Oh? You only have one POKéMON that can battle.
et: Oh? Sul on ainult üks POKéMON mis saab võidelda.

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyRematchNeedTwoMons
en: I'm sorry, but I'd like you to come back with at least two POKéMON.
et: Andke andeks, aga ma tahaksin, et te tuleksite tagasi vähemalt kahe POKéMON-ga.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge6_Text_WouldYouLikeToTrade
en: My POKéMON is a {STR_VAR_2}. Do you know it? It's quite cute and rather nice.
et: Minu POKéMON on {STR_VAR_2}. Kas sa tead seda? See on üsna armas ja pigem tore.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge6_Text_WouldYouLikeToTrade
en: This little one, I could trade with pride!
et: See väike, ma võiksin uhkusega kaubelda!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge6_Text_WouldYouLikeToTrade
en: Would you like to trade me a {STR_VAR_1} for my {STR_VAR_2}?
et: Kas sa tahaksid minuga kaubelda {STR_VAR_1} minu {STR_VAR_2} vastu?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge6_Text_PromiseIllBeGoodToIt
en: Oh, it's adorable! Thank you! I promise I'll be good to it!
et: Oi, see on jumaldav! Aitäh! Luban, et saan sellega hästi hakkama!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge6_Text_PromiseIllBeGoodToIt
en: Oh! I hope you'll be good to my {STR_VAR_2}, too!
et: Oh! Loodan, et oled ka minu {STR_VAR_2} vastu hea!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge6_Text_DontTradeForAnythingButMon
en: Oh, I'm sorry! I don't intend to trade for anything but a {STR_VAR_1}.
et: Oh, andke andeks! Ma ei kavatsegi midagi peale {STR_VAR_1} vahetada.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge6_Text_WellThatsFineToo
en: Oh, you won't? Well, that's fine, too. Please come visit us again.
et: Sa ei tee seda? No sobib ka. Palun tule meile uuesti külla.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge6_Text_SkittySoMuchCuterThanImagined
en: Giggle! A SKITTY is so much cuter than I had imagined. I'm delighted!
et: Giggle! A SKITTY on nii palju armsam, kui olin ette kujutanud. Mul on hea meel!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_PokemonBreederIntro
en: For 70 years I have raised POKéMON! I am the man they revere as the legendary top POKéMON BREEDER!
et: Olen 70 aastat kasvatanud POKéMON! Mina olen mees, keda nad austavad kui legendaarset tippu POKéMON BREEDER!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_PokemonBreederIntro
en: If you ever become as seasoned as me, you'll see the abilities of POKéMON at a glance.
et: Kui kunagi saad sama maitsestatud kui mina, siis näed POKéMON võimeid silmapilkselt.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_PokemonBreederIntro
en: You're a TRAINER. Doesn't it interest you to know your own POKéMON's abilities?
et: Sa oled TRAINER. Kas sind ei huvita teadmine enda POKéMON võimetest?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_PokemonBreederIntro
en: Here! Let's have a look at your POKéMON!
et: Siin! Vaatame teie POKéMON!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_AverageAbility
en: …Hmm…

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_AverageAbility
en: This one, overall, I would describe as being of average ability.
et: Seda ühte, kokkuvõttes kirjeldaksin kui keskmise võimekusega olemist.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_BetterThanAverageAbility
en: …Hmm…

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_BetterThanAverageAbility
en: This one, overall, I would describe as having better-than-average ability.
et: Seda ühte, kokkuvõttes kirjeldaksin, et mul on keskmisest parem võime.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_ImpressiveAbility
en: …Hmm…

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_ImpressiveAbility
en: This one, overall, I would say is quite impressive in ability!
et: See üks, kokkuvõttes ütleksin, on võimekuselt üsna muljetavaldav!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_OutstandingAbility
en: …Hmm…

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_OutstandingAbility
en: This one, overall, I would say is wonderfully outstanding in ability!
et: See üks, kokkuvõttes ütleksin, on imeliselt silmapaistev võimekuse poolest!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_BestAspectHP
en: Incidentally, the best aspect of it, I would say, is its HP…
et: Muuseas, selle parim aspekt, ma ütleks, on selle HP...

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_BestAspectAtk
en: Incidentally, the best aspect of it, I would say, is its ATTACK…
et: Muuseas, selle parim aspekt, ma ütleks, on selle ATTACK...

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_BestAspectDef
en: Incidentally, the best aspect of it, I would say, is its DEFENSE…
et: Muuseas, selle parim aspekt, ma ütleks, on selle DEFENSE...

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_BestAspectSpAtk
en: Incidentally, the best aspect of it, I would say, is its SPECIAL ATTACK…
et: Muuseas, selle parim aspekt, ma ütleks, on selle SPECIAL ATTACK...

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_BestAspectSpDef
en: Incidentally, the best aspect of it, I would say, is its SPECIAL DEFENSE…
et: Muuseas, selle parim aspekt, ma ütleks, on selle SPECIAL DEFENSE...

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_BestAspectSpeed
en: Incidentally, the best aspect of it, I would say, is its SPEED…
et: Muuseas, selle parim aspekt, ma ütleks, on selle SPEED...

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_StatRelativelyGood
en: That stat is relatively good. …Hm… That's how I call it.
et: See stat on suhteliselt hea. ...Hm... nii ma seda nimetan.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_StatImpressive
en: That stat is quite impressive. …Hm… That's how I call it.
et: See stat on üsna muljetavaldav. ...Hm... nii ma seda nimetan.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_StatOutstanding
en: That stat is outstanding! …Hm… That's how I call it.
et: See stat on silmapaistev! ...Hm... nii ma seda nimetan.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_StatFlawless
en: It's flawless! A thing of perfection! …Hm… That's how I call it.
et: See on veatu! Täiuslikkuse asi! ...Hm... nii ma seda nimetan.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_NoTimeForMyAdvice
en: What? You have no time for my advice?
et: Mida? Sul ei ole aega minu nõuannete jaoks?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_NoTimeForMyAdvice
en: You should always be eager to learn from the experiences of your elders!
et: Sa peaksid alati innukalt õppima oma vanemate kogemustest!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_HaveBusinessNeedsTending
en: Yes, what is it now?
et: Jah, mis see nüüd on?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_HaveBusinessNeedsTending
en: I have business that needs tending! Save it for next time!
et: Mul on äri, mis vajab kaldumist! Säästa see järgmiseks korraks!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_LetsLookAtYourPokemon
en: Ah, youngster! Do your POKéMON's abilities intrigue you?
et: Ah, nooruk! Kas sinu POKéMON võimed intrigeerivad sind?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_LetsLookAtYourPokemon
en: Here, here! Let's have a look at your POKéMON!
et: Siin, siin! Vaatame teie POKéMON!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_EvenICantTell
en: An expert I am, but even I can't tell anything about an unhatched POKéMON!
et: Ekspert ma olen, aga isegi mina ei oska midagi öelda püüdmatu POKéMON kohta!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_EvenICantTell
en: Show me a POKéMON! A POKéMON is what I need to see!
et: Näita mulle POKéMON! A POKéMON on see, mida ma pean nägema!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_SaidMyMonIsOutstanding
en: He said my POKéMON is outstanding! I'm glad I raised it carefully!
et: Ta ütles, et minu POKéMON on silmapaistev! Mul on hea meel, et ma selle hoolega üles tõstsin!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_DidntDoAnythingSpecialRaisingIt
en: He said my POKéMON is outstanding! But I didn't do anything special raising it…
et: Ta ütles, et minu POKéMON on silmapaistev! Aga ma ei teinud midagi erilist seda tõstes...

label: MossdeepCity_Text_WantKingsRockStevenGaveMe
en: I got this from STEVEN, but I don't know what it's good for.
et: Selle sain STEVEN-st, aga ma ei tea, milleks see hea on.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_WantKingsRockStevenGaveMe
en: I think it's called KING'S ROCK. Do you want it?
et: Ma arvan, et seda nimetatakse KING'S ROCK. Kas sa tahad seda?

label: MossdeepCity_Text_YouCanKeepIt
en: Why would you want it? You're weird.
et: Miks sa peaksid seda tahtma? Sa oled imelik.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_YouCanKeepIt
en: You can keep it, but keep it a secret from STEVEN.
et: Sa võid seda hoida, kuid hoia seda saladuses STEVEN eest.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_StevensHouseOverThere
en: STEVEN's house is right over there!
et: STEVEN maja on sealsamas!

label: MossdeepCity_Text_WhatToDoWithWeirdRock
en: Yeah, you think so, too! What are you supposed to do with some weird rock?
et: Jah, sa arvad ka nii! Mida sa peaksid mingi veidra kiviga peale hakkama?

label: MossdeepCity_Text_WailmerWatching
en: Around MOSSDEEP, you can see wild WAILMER.
et: Umbes MOSSDEEP, näete metsik WAILMER.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_WailmerWatching
en: It's called, uh… What was it now…
et: Seda kutsutakse, uh... Mis see nüüd oli...

label: MossdeepCity_Text_WailmerWatching
en: WAI, WAI, WAI…
et: WAI, WAI, WAI...

label: MossdeepCity_Text_WailmerWatching
en: WAILMER watching!
et: WAILMER vaatamine!

label: MossdeepCity_Text_SpaceCenterReceivedLetter
en: The island's SPACE CENTER has been launching huge rockets.
et: Saare SPACE CENTER on käivitanud tohutuid rakette.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_SpaceCenterReceivedLetter
en: There's been some kind of an uproar over a letter they received recently.
et: On tekkinud mingi möll hiljuti saadud kirja üle.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_SpaceCenterLaunchingRockets
en: The island's SPACE CENTER has been launching huge rockets.
et: Saare SPACE CENTER on käivitanud tohutuid rakette.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_MossdeepTargetedByMagma
en: I heard from a SAILOR buddy that TEAM AQUA set up shop in LILYCOVE.
et: Kuulsin SAILOR sõbra käest, et TEAM AQUA seadista pood LILYCOVE.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_MossdeepTargetedByMagma
en: I also heard that someone came along and wiped the floor with them!
et: Kuulsin ka, et keegi tuli kaasa ja pühkis nendega põrandat!

label: MossdeepCity_Text_MossdeepTargetedByMagma
en: But MOSSDEEP here's been targeted by that TEAM MAGMA.
et: Aga MOSSDEEP siin on sihikule võetud see TEAM MAGMA.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_MossdeepTargetedByMagma
en: If you want to know what they're up to, go visit the SPACE CENTER.
et: Kui tahad teada, mis neil plaanis on, mine külasta SPACE CENTER.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_FeelReliefOnLand
en: I'm a SAILOR, so the sea's obviously more important to me.
et: Olen SAILOR, seega meri on minu jaoks ilmselgelt olulisem.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_FeelReliefOnLand
en: But you know? When I get back on land after a long voyage, I do feel relief!
et: Aga tead? Pärast pikka reisi tagasi maale jõudes tunnen küll kergendust!

label: MossdeepCity_Text_NiceIfWorldCoveredByFlowers
en: Wouldn't it be nice?
et: Kas poleks tore?

label: MossdeepCity_Text_NiceIfWorldCoveredByFlowers
en: If the whole world was covered in plants and flowers like this island?
et: Kui kogu maailm oleks kaetud selliste taimede ja lilledega nagu see saar?

label: MossdeepCity_Text_LifeNeedsSeaToLive
en: All life needs the sea to live, even though it makes its home on the land.
et: Kogu elu vajab elamiseks merd, kuigi teeb maal oma kodu.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_LifeNeedsSeaToLive
en: Life, having run its course, becomes soil and returns to the land.
et: Elu, olles kulgenud oma rada, muutub pinnaseks ja naaseb maale.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_LifeNeedsSeaToLive
en: And the sea is always connected to the land.
et: Ja meri on alati maaga ühendatud.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_LifeNeedsSeaToLive
en: Yes, like the very shoreline here.
et: Jah, nagu siinne kallasrada.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_SurfExhilarating
en: A voyage on a ship is fine.
et: Reisiga laeval on kõik korras.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_SurfExhilarating
en: But crossing the sea with POKéMON using SURF…
et: Aga mere ületamine POKéMON abil SURF...

label: MossdeepCity_Text_SurfExhilarating
en: Now that's an exhilarating trip! Wouldn't you agree, youngster?
et: Nüüd on see vaimustav reis! Kas sa poleks nõus, nooruk?

label: MossdeepCity_Text_SpecialSpaceCenterRock
en: This rock has a special meaning to the people at the SPACE CENTER.
et: Sellel kaljul on rahvale eriline tähendus SPACE CENTER juures.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_SpecialSpaceCenterRock
en: They put it here as their wish for their rockets to fly safely.
et: Nad panid selle siia oma sooviks, et nende raketid ohutult lendaksid.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_SpecialSpaceCenterRock
en: When you make a wish, what do you use? Do you wish upon a star?
et: Mida sa soovi avaldades kasutad? Kas soovid staarile?

label: MossdeepCity_Text_SpecialSpaceCenterRock
en: I use a wish tag to make it happen. That's what I do.
et: Kasutan soovisilti, et see teoks saaks. Seda ma teengi.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_ItsAWhiteRock
en: It's a white rock.
et: See on valge kivi.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_GymSign
