en: MOSSDEEP CITY POKéMON GYM LEADERS: LIZA & TATE
et: MOSSDEEP CITY POKéMON SAALI JUHT S: LIZA & TATE

label: MossdeepCity_Text_GymSign
en: “The mystic combination!”
et: "Müstiline kombinatsioon!"

label: MossdeepCity_Text_CitySign
en: MOSSDEEP CITY “Our slogan: Cherish POKéMON!”
et: MOSSDEEP CITY "Meie loosung: Cherish POKéMON!"

label: MossdeepCity_Text_SpaceCenterSign
en: MOSSDEEP SPACE CENTER “The closest place to space.”
et: MOSSDEEP SPACE CENTER "Lähim koht ruumile".

label: MossdeepCity_Text_ScottSomethingWrongWithTown
en: SCOTT: {PLAYER}{KUN}, feeling good? I'm doing great!
et: SCOTT: {PLAYER}{KUN}, hea enesetunne? Mul läheb suurepäraselt!

label: MossdeepCity_Text_ScottSomethingWrongWithTown
en: I'd heard MOSSDEEP's GYM LEADER is pretty strong, so I decided to come take a look-see for myself.
et: Olin kuulnud MOSSDEEP's SAALI JUHT on päris tugev, seega otsustasin tulla vaatama-vaatama ise.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_ScottSomethingWrongWithTown
en: But there's something wrong about this town.
et: Aga selles linnas on midagi valesti.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_ScottSomethingWrongWithTown
en: People are going on about a warning letter and the SPACE CENTER…
et: Inimesed käivad hoiatuskirja ja SPACE CENTER...

label: MossdeepCity_Text_ScottSomethingWrongWithTown
en: I don't think it concerns me in any way, though.
et: Ma arvan, et see ei puuduta mind siiski kuidagi.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_SootopolisNewGymLeader
en: Ahh… It feels great letting the waves wash over my feet…
et: See tundub suurepärane lastes lainetel üle jalgade pesta...

label: MossdeepCity_Text_SootopolisNewGymLeader
en: Speaking of the waves, you know that island city SOOTOPOLIS?
et: Rääkides lainetest, siis tead seda saarelinna SOOTOPOLIS?

label: MossdeepCity_Text_SootopolisNewGymLeader
en: I think the GYM there had a new LEADER come in.
et: Ma arvan, et SAAL seal oli uus LEADER sisse tulnud.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_SootopolisNewGymLeader
en: People tell me the new LEADER once mentored WALLACE.
et: Inimesed ütlevad mulle uue LEADER kunagi juhendatud WALLACE.

label: FallarborTown_Text_ShadyCharactersCozmosHome
en: Something's happening, and I don't like it!
et: Midagi toimub ja mulle ei meeldi!

label: FallarborTown_Text_ShadyCharactersCozmosHome
en: I've seen shady characters wandering in and out of PROF. COZMO's home…
et: Olen näinud varjulisi tegelasi PROF sisse ja välja rändamas. COZMO on kodus...

label: FallarborTown_Text_RegionKnownForMeteors
en: This region's been known for meteors since the olden days.
et: See piirkond on meteooride poolest tuntud juba vanadest aegadest.

label: FallarborTown_Text_RegionKnownForMeteors
en: They say METEOR FALLS was gouged out by a falling meteorite long ago.
et: Öeldakse, et METEOR FALLS oli langeva meteoriidi poolt ammu välja kougitud.

label: FallarborTown_Text_MyPreciousAzurill
en: See! Take a look! This is my precious AZURILL!
et: Näete! Viska pilk peale! See on minu hinnaline AZURILL!

label: FallarborTown_Text_MyPreciousAzurill
en: It's slick and smooth and plushy, too!
et: Ka see on libe ja sile ja plushiline!

label: FallarborTown_Text_Azurill
en: AZURILL: Rooreelooo.
et: AZURILL: Rooreelooo.

label: FallarborTown_Text_HaveYouChallengedFlannery
en: Have you already challenged FLANNERY, the LEADER of LAVARIDGE GYM?
et: Kas olete juba vaidlustanud FLANNERY, LEADER LAVARIDGE SAAL?

label: FallarborTown_Text_HaveYouChallengedFlannery
en: The girl's grandfather was famous. He was one of the ELITE FOUR in the POKéMON LEAGUE at one point.
et: Tüdruku vanaisa oli kuulus. Ta oli üks ELITE FOUR POKéMON LIIGA ühel hetkel.

label: FallarborTown_Text_HaveYouChallengedFlannery
en: It wouldn't surprise me to see FLANNERY become a great TRAINER in her own right.
et: See ei üllataks mind, kui näen, et FLANNERY muutub suurepäraseks TRAINER omaette.

label: FallarborTown_Text_BattleTentSign
en: BATTLE TENT FALLARBOR SITE “May the Greatest Teams Gather!”
et: BATTLE TENT FALLARBOR SITE "Suuremad meeskonnad kogunegu!"

label: FallarborTown_Text_TownSign
en: FALLARBOR TOWN “A farm community with small gardens.”
et: FALLARBOR TOWN "Väikeste aedadega talukooslus".

label: FallarborTown_Text_MoveTutorSign
en: MOVE TUTOR'S HOUSE “New moves taught to POKéMON.”
et: MOVE TUTOR'S HOUSE "Uued käigud õpetatakse POKéMON".

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_WelcomeToLilycoveMuseum
en: Welcome to LILYCOVE MUSEUM.
et: Tere tulemast LILYCOVE MUSEUM.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_WelcomeToLilycoveMuseum
en: Please take the time to enjoy our collection of fantastic artwork featuring POKéMON.
et: Palun võtke aega, et nautida meie fantastilise kunstiteose kollektsiooni, millel on POKéMON.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_ImCuratorHaveYouViewedOurPaintings
en: I'm the CURATOR of this MUSEUM of fine arts.
et: Mina olen selle CURATOR MUSEUM kaunite kunstide.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_ImCuratorHaveYouViewedOurPaintings
en: It's heartening to see someone so young as you in our MUSEUM.
et: Südantsoojendav on näha kedagi nii noort nagu sina meie MUSEUM.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_ImCuratorHaveYouViewedOurPaintings
en: Have you viewed our collection of paintings already?
et: Kas olete meie maalikogu juba vaadanud?

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_NotDisturbYouTakeYourTime
en: Ah, then let me not disturb you. Please, do take your time.
et: Ah, las ma siis ei sega sind. Palun, võtke aega.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_HaveYouAnInterestInPaintings
en: Oh? I do believe that you seem to be a POKéMON TRAINER.
et: Oh? Usun küll, et tundub, et oled POKéMON TRAINER.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_HaveYouAnInterestInPaintings
en: Have you an interest in paintings, too?
et: Kas teil on huvi ka maalide vastu?

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_HonoredYoudVisitInSpiteOfThat
en: I see…
et: Ma näen...

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_HonoredYoudVisitInSpiteOfThat
en: I'm honored that you would visit us in spite of that.
et: Mul on au, et te meile sellest hoolimata külla tuleksite.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_ExcellentCanYouComeWithMe
en: Ah, excellent! You do like paintings!
et: Ah, suurepärane! Sulle meeldivad maalid!

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_ExcellentCanYouComeWithMe
en: Then, may I ask you to come with me?
et: Kas ma võin siis paluda, et tuleksite minuga kaasa?

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_VeryOldPainting
en: It's a very old painting. The paint is peeling here and there.
et: See on väga vana maal. Värv koorub siin-seal.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_OddLandscapeFantasticScenery
en: It's an odd landscape with bizarre and fantastic scenery.
et: See on veider maastik, millel on veider ja fantastiline maastik.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_PaintingOfBeautifulWoman
en: It's a painting of a beautiful, smiling woman with a POKéMON on her lap.
et: See on maal ilusast naeratavast naisest, kelle süles on POKéMON.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_PaintingOfLegendaryPokemon
en: It's a painting of a legendary POKéMON from long ago.
et: See on maal legendaarsest POKéMON juba ammu.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_PaintingOfLegendaryPokemon
en: The artist painted this from imagination.
et: Kunstnik maalis selle kujutlusvõimest.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_PaintingOfGrassPokemon
en: It's a painting of GRASS POKéMON swaying in a breeze.
et: See on maal GRASS POKéMON kõigub tuule käes.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_PaintingOfGrassPokemon
en: They appear to be enjoying the wind's gentle caress.
et: Tundub, et nad naudivad tuule õrna hellitust.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_PaintingOfBerries
en: It's a delicious-looking painting of BERRIES.
et: See on maitsva välimusega maal BERRIES.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_PaintingOfBerries
en: This painting could make you hungry!
et: See maal võib näljaseks teha!

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_Text_BirdPokemonSculptureReplica
en: It's a replica of a famous sculpture.
et: See on kuulsa skulptuuri koopia.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_Text_BirdPokemonSculptureReplica
en: It depicts an ancient BIRD POKéMON.
et: See kujutab iidset BIRD POKéMON.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_BigPokeBallCarvedFromStone
en: It's a big POKé BALL carved from a black stone.
et: See on suur POKé BALL nikerdatud mustast kivist.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_BigPokeBallCarvedFromStone
en: It was apparently used in festivals in the olden days.
et: Ilmselt kasutati seda vanasti festivalidel.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_StoneTabletWithAncientText
en: It's a huge stone tablet inscribed with POKéMON and dense text in the small characters of an ancient, unreadable language.
et: See on hiigelsuur kivitahvel, millele on kirjutatud POKéMON ja tihe tekst iidse, loetamatu keele väikestes tegelastes.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_WorksOfMagnificence
en: Hmmm… What works of great magnificence…
et: Hmmm... Mis mõjub suurejooneliselt...

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_MustntForgetLoveForFineArts
en: Battling with POKéMON is fun, I'll grant you that.
et: Võitlus POKéMON-ga on lõbus, ma annan sulle selle.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_MustntForgetLoveForFineArts
en: But one mustn't forget our love for the fine arts.
et: Aga ei tohi unustada meie armastust kaunite kunstide vastu.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_ThisMuseumIsInspiration
en: This ART MUSEUM… Well, you could see many fantastic paintings.
et: See ART MUSEUM... Noh, sa võiksid näha palju fantastilisi maale.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_ThisMuseumIsInspiration
en: And the CURATOR is a wonderful person.
et: Ja CURATOR on imeline inimene.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_ThisMuseumIsInspiration
en: Among artists like myself, this MUSEUM is an inspiration.
et: Minusuguste artistide seas on see MUSEUM inspiratsiooniks.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_ThisLadyIsPretty
en: This lady is pretty! She's like Mommy!
et: See daam on ilus! Ta on nagu emme!

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_ThisPokemonIsAdorable
en: This POKéMON is adorable! Just like our little boy!
et: See POKéMON on võluv! Täpselt nagu meie väike poiss!

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_HeardMuseumGotNewPaintings
en: I'd heard that this ART MUSEUM got in some new paintings.
et: Ma olin kuulnud, et see ART MUSEUM sai sisse mõned uued maalid.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_HeardMuseumGotNewPaintings
en: So, naturally I hurried over.
et: Seega, loomulikult kiirustasin üle.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_HeardMuseumGotNewPaintings
en: Are the new paintings up on the second floor?
et: Kas uued maalid on teisel korrusel üleval?

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_CuratorHasBeenCheerful
en: Lately, the CURATOR has been unusually cheerful.
et: Viimasel ajal on CURATOR olnud ebatavaliselt rõõmsameelne.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_CuratorHasBeenCheerful
en: I bet something good happened for him. Definitely.
et: Vean kihla, et tema jaoks juhtus midagi head. Kindlasti.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_AimToSeeGreatPaintings
en: I aim to see many great paintings here and learn from them.
et: Minu eesmärk on näha siin palju vahvaid maale ja neist õppida.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_AimToSeeGreatPaintings
en: I have this dream of one day having my artwork exhibited here.
et: Mul on see unistus, et ühel päeval laseks oma kunstiteoseid siin eksponeerida.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_MuseumTouristDestination
en: The ART MUSEUM has become a favorite tourist destination.
et: ART MUSEUM on muutunud lemmik turismisihtkohaks.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_MuseumTouristDestination
en: It's great for LILYCOVE… No, great for the HOENN region!
et: See on suurepärane LILYCOVE... Ei, suurepärane HOENN piirkonna jaoks!

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_MuseumTouristDestination
en: This is what I've heard--a lone TRAINER procured all the paintings upstairs.
et: Seda olen kuulnud--üksik TRAINER hankis kõik maalid üleval.

label: MauvilleCity_House2_Text_BuyHarborMailAtSlateport
en: If I had a BIKE, it'd be easy to cycle to SLATEPORT for some shopping.
et: Kui mul oleks BIKE, siis oleks lihtne jalgrattaga SLATEPORT mõne shoppamise jaoks.

label: MauvilleCity_House2_Text_BuyHarborMailAtSlateport
en: I'd be able to buy HARBOR MAIL at the POKéMON MART in SLATEPORT…
et: Mul oleks võimalik osta HARBOR MAIL POKéMON MART in SLATEPORT...

label: MauvilleCity_House2_Text_TradeHarborMailForCoinCase
en: Oh! You have HARBOR MAIL? Will you trade it for a COIN CASE?
et: Oh! Sul on HARBOR MAIL? Kas vahetad selle COIN CASE vastu?

label: MauvilleCity_House2_Text_IllTradeYouCoinCase
en: Oh, I'm so happy! Okay, I'll trade you a COIN CASE!
et: Oi, ma olen nii õnnelik! Okei, ma vahetan sulle COIN CASE!

label: MauvilleCity_House2_Text_UseCoinCaseAtGameCorner
en: That COIN CASE can be used at the GAME CORNER.
et: Et COIN CASE saab kasutada GAME CORNER juures.

label: MauvilleCity_House2_Text_ThatsDisappointing
en: Oh, that's disappointing.
et: See on pettumus.

label: MauvilleCity_House2_Text_ThatsDisappointing
en: A COIN CASE is needed for the GAME CORNER.
et: COIN CASE on vaja GAME CORNER jaoks.

label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_ExplainRankingHall
en: This is the RANKING HALL.
et: See on RANKING HALL.

label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_ExplainRankingHall
en: This is where we recognize the immortal TRAINERS who left great records in BATTLE FRONTIER events.
et: See on koht, kus me tunneme ära surematu TRAINERS kes jättis suured kirjed BATTLE FRONTIER üritustele.

label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_DomePikeFactoryRecords
en: BATTLE DOME, BATTLE PIKE, and BATTLE FACTORY Records
et: BATTLE DOME, BATTLE PIKE ja BATTLE FACTORY Records

label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_PalaceArenaPyramidRecords
en: BATTLE PALACE, BATTLE ARENA, and BATTLE PYRAMID Records
et: BATTLE PALACE, BATTLE ARENA ja BATTLE PYRAMID Records

label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_IsYourNameOnThisList
en: Hi, is your name on this list?
et: Tere, kas teie nimi on selles nimekirjas?

label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_WowThatsSuper
en: Wow, that's super! I'll have to try harder, too!
et: Vau, see on super! Eks ma pean ka rohkem proovima!

label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_WorkHarderIfYouSawFriendsName
en: Oh, is that right?
et: Kas see on õige?

label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_WorkHarderIfYouSawFriendsName
en: If you saw your friend's name up here, I bet it would make you work harder!
et: Kui sa näeksid siin üleval oma sõbra nime, siis ma vean kihla, et see paneks sind rohkem pingutama!

label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_MyNamesNotUpThere
en: Hmm… My name's not up there…
et: Hmm... minu nimi pole seal üleval...

label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_MyNamesNotUpThere
en: Well, it's only natural since I haven't taken any challenges yet.
et: Noh, see on loomulik, kuna ma pole veel mingeid väljakutseid vastu võtnud.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BattleDomeSign
en: This is the BATTLE DOME! Your path to the invincible superstar!
et: See on BATTLE DOME! Sinu tee võitmatu superstaarini!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BattleFactorySign
en: This is the BATTLE FACTORY! Seek out the toughest POKéMON!
et: See on BATTLE FACTORY! Otsi välja kõige karmim POKéMON!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BattlePikeSign
en: This is the BATTLE PIKE! Choose one of three paths!
et: See on BATTLE PIKE! Vali üks kolmest teest!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_ThisIsBattleTower
en: This is the BATTLE TOWER.
et: See on BATTLE TOWER.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_ThisIsBattleTower
en: TRAINERS bring their best-raised POKéMON for elimination-style matches.
et: TRAINERS tuua oma kõige paremini tõstetud POKéMON eliminatsiooni stiilis vasteid.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MayISeeYourTicket
en: Hello, are you here for the ferry? May I see your TICKET?
et: Tere, kas olete siin praami pärast? Kas ma võin näha sinu TICKET?

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MustHaveTicketToBoard
en: {PLAYER} doesn't have the TICKET…
et: {PLAYER} ei ole TICKET...

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MustHaveTicketToBoard
en: I'm terribly sorry.
et: Mul on kohutavalt kahju.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MustHaveTicketToBoard
en: You must have a TICKET to board the ferry.
et: Sul peab olema TICKET praamile minekuks.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WhereWouldYouLikeToGo
en: {PLAYER} flashed the TICKET.
et: {PLAYER} vilgutas TICKET.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WhereWouldYouLikeToGo
en: Perfect! That's all you need!
et: Täiuslik! Muud polegi vaja!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WhereWouldYouLikeToGo
en: And where would you like to go?
et: Ja kuhu tahaksid minna?

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_SlateportItIs
en: SLATEPORT CITY it is, then!
et: SLATEPORT CITY see on siis!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_LilycoveItIs
en: LILYCOVE CITY it is, then!
et: LILYCOVE CITY see on siis!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_SailWithUsAnotherTime
en: Please sail with us another time!
et: Palun purjetage meiega veel üks kord!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_PleaseBoardFerry
en: Please board the ferry and wait for departure.
et: Palun astuge praamile ja oodake ärasõitu.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_ThenWhereWouldYouLikeToGo
en: Then, where would you like to go?
et: Kuhu sa siis minna tahaksid?

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BestOutOfAllMyFriends
en: I'm the best out of all my friends. But here… I've been useless!
et: Olen kõigist oma sõpradest parim. Aga siin... ma olen kasutu olnud!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_CantFindBattleTower
en: I want to go to the BATTLE TOWER, but I can't find it even though I have a map of the BATTLE FRONTIER.
et: Ma tahan minna BATTLE TOWER, aga ma ei leia seda, kuigi mul on kaart BATTLE FRONTIER.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_CantFindBattleTower
en: This place is just too big!
et: See koht on lihtsalt liiga suur!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_GotSeasickOnWayHere
en: I wanted to take a challenge as soon as I arrived here.
et: Tahtsin väljakutse vastu võtta kohe, kui siia jõudsin.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_GotSeasickOnWayHere
en: But on the way, I got seasick… Urrrrp…
et: Aga teel jäin merehaigeks... Urrrrp...

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_OnlyToughTrainersBroughtHere
en: It's not as if just anyone can come here, you know?
et: Ei ole nii, et lihtsalt keegi võib siia tulla.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_OnlyToughTrainersBroughtHere
en: Only those TRAINERS who've been recognized as tough are brought here.
et: Siia tuuakse ainult need TRAINERS, kes on tunnistatud karmiks.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_OnlyToughTrainersBroughtHere
en: That's why many TRAINERS don't even know about the BATTLE FRONTIER.
et: Sellepärast paljud TRAINERS ei teagi BATTLE FRONTIER kohta.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_SureWeCanChallengeWithNoMons
en: Hey, bro…
et: Hei, bro...

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_SureWeCanChallengeWithNoMons
en: Are you sure we can make challenges even if we don't have any POKéMON?
et: Oled sa kindel, et suudame teha väljakutseid ka siis, kui meil pole ühtegi POKéMON?

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BigGuySaidIllLendYouMons
en: Uh… I'm sure it'll be okay.
et: Ma olen kindel, et kõik saab korda.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BigGuySaidIllLendYouMons
en: I think…
et: Arvan, et...

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BigGuySaidIllLendYouMons
en: But remember that big scary guy? He said, “I'll lend you POKéMON!”
et: Aga mäletad seda suurt hirmutavat meest? Ta ütles: "Ma laenan sulle POKéMON!"

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WhosRaisingThoseRentalMons
en: That's the BATTLE FACTORY. You can rent strong POKéMON there.
et: See on see BATTLE FACTORY. Seal saab rentida tugevat POKéMON.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WhosRaisingThoseRentalMons
en: But it makes me wonder. Who's raising those rental POKéMON?
et: Aga see paneb mind imestama. Kes neid rentijaid tõstab POKéMON?

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_ScaredOfPikeBecauseSeviper
en: I'm scared of going into the BATTLE PIKE because of SEVIPER…
et: Mul on hirm minna BATTLE PIKE  tõttu SEVIPER...

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_ScaredOfPikeBecauseSeviper
en: B-but I came all the way here, so I will try to conquer everything! …Shudder…
et: B-aga ma tulin siia lõpuni, nii et ma püüan kõike vallutada! ...ohver...

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_LetsPlayRockPaperScissors
en: Let's play rock, paper, scissors! One, two, three!
et: Mängime rokki, paberit, kääre! Üks, kaks, kolm!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WonIllTakePikeChallenge
en: Yay! I won! I will take the BATTLE PIKE challenge!
et: Yay! Võitsin! Võtan vastu BATTLE PIKE väljakutse!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_LostIllPutOffPikeChallenge
en: Oh, no… I lost.
et: Oh ei... ma kaotasin.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_LostIllPutOffPikeChallenge
en: I guess I'm not very lucky today. I'll put off my BATTLE PIKE challenge until tomorrow.
et: Ju mul siis täna väga ei vedanud. Ma lükkan oma BATTLE PIKE väljakutse homseni edasi.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_ChooseFishingOverBattling
en: I believe I'm the only person here who, for some unknown reason, would choose fishing over battling.
et: Usun, et olen siin ainus inimene, kes mingil teadmata põhjusel valiks võitluse asemel kalapüügi.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_ChooseFishingOverBattling
en: Huh? You can't catch anything here? That's disappointing…
et: Huh? Siin ei saa midagi püüda? See on pettumus...

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_KeepBattlingUntilIGetSymbol
en: Today, I'm going to keep battling, no matter what, until I get a Symbol.
et: Täna võitlen edasi, ükskõik mis, kuni saan Sümboli.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_YoureOffToChallengeDome
en: Oh? You're off to challenge the BATTLE DOME?
et: Oh? Sa oled väljas, et vaidlustada BATTLE DOME?

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_YoureOffToChallengeDome
en: I'll wish you the best of luck. Let us both win our way up and meet in challenges.
et: Soovin teile parimat õnne. Võitkem mõlemad end üles ja kohtugem väljakutsetes.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_DomeIsHereGrandpa
en: Grandpa, over here! The BATTLE DOME is here! Go get 'em, Grandpa!
et: Vanaisa, siin! BATTLE DOME on siin! Mine võta "em, vanaisa!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WontLetGentlemenBeatMe
en: Ah, so this here is the BATTLE DOME? I won't let GENTLEMEN beat me!
et: Ah et see siin on siis BATTLE DOME? Ma ei lase GENTLEMEN mind võita!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WontLetGentlemenBeatMe
en: But where is the entrance?
et: Aga kus on sissepääs?

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_NothingHereNotLongAgo
en: There used to be nothing here not all that long ago.
et: Kunagi polnud siin midagi nii ammu.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_NothingHereNotLongAgo
en: But, now look at this place! Amazing! I'll bring my mother out to see this.
et: Aga, vaadake nüüd seda kohta! Hämmastav! Toon ema välja, et seda näha.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_FinallyArrivedAtFrontier
en: I've finally arrived at the BATTLE FRONTIER!
et: Jõudsin lõpuks kohale BATTLE FRONTIER!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_FinallyArrivedAtFrontier
en: I'm sure to grab attention with my looks and ability!
et: Kindlasti haaran tähelepanu oma välimuse ja võimekusega!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_SquareFilledWithToughPeople
en: Munch, munch…
et: Munch, munch...

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_SquareFilledWithToughPeople
en: It looks like this square's filled with tough people.
et: Tundub, et see väljak on täis karme inimesi.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_SquareFilledWithToughPeople
en: Munch, munch…
et: Munch, munch...

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MetOlderGirlAtPike
en: Crunch, munch…
et: Krõbistamine, mugimine...

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MetOlderGirlAtPike
en: A while back, I met this older girl at the BATTLE PIKE.
et: Mõnda aega tagasi kohtasin seda vanemat tüdrukut BATTLE PIKE juures.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MetOlderGirlAtPike
en: She had these eyes that were scary in a real ornery way.
et: Tal olid need silmad, mis olid hirmuäratavad päris ornery viisil.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MetOlderGirlAtPike
en: Crunch, munch…
et: Krõbistamine, mugimine...

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MetOlderGirlAtPike
en: She got all furious: “Will you quit eating!” Then she whaled on me.
et: Ta sai kõik maruvihaseks: "Kas sa jätad söömise maha!" siis ta valas mulle peale.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MetOlderGirlAtPike
en: It was a hair-raising kind of scary experience, sure enough.
et: See oli juukseid tõstev omamoodi hirmus kogemus, piisavalt kindel.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MetOlderGirlAtPike
en: Crunch, munch…
et: Krõbistamine, mugimine...

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_LastTimeOurEyesMet
en: Huh? Will you listen to yourself? That's nothing!
et: Huh? Kas te kuulate ennast? See pole midagi!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_LastTimeOurEyesMet
en: Why, the last time I cheered for him, our eyes met and sparks flew!
et: Miks, viimati kui ma talle hõiskasin, kohtusid meie silmad ja lendasid sädemed!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_DomeAceLookedBecauseOfMyCheering
en: Whaaaaaat?! Pfft!
et: Waaaaaaaaaat?! Pfft!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_DomeAceLookedBecauseOfMyCheering
en: That only happened because I happened to be sitting next to you!
et: See juhtus ainult sellepärast, et ma juhtusin sinu kõrval istuma!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_DomeAceLookedBecauseOfMyCheering
en: The DOME ACE only looked our way because my cheering was so loud!
et: DOME ACE vaatas ainult meie teed, sest mu hõiskamine oli nii vali!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_DomeAceIsMine
en: Oh, shush! Keep that racket down!
et: Oh, shush! Hoia seda reketit all!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_DomeAceIsMine
en: You fair-weather fans should stick to cheering for some GYM LEADER!
et: Sa õiglase ilmaga fännid peaksid jääma rõõmustama mõne SAALI JUHT!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_DomeAceIsMine
en: The DOME ACE is mine! The only idol for me!
et: DOME ACE on minu! Ainus iidol minu jaoks!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_FansOverThereUsedToBeTrainers
en: Those people squabbling over there…
et: Need inimesed näägutavad seal...

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_FansOverThereUsedToBeTrainers
en: It's hard to believe, but they once were TRAINERS, and good ones, too.
et: Seda on raske uskuda, aga need olid kunagi TRAINERS ja head ka.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_FansOverThereUsedToBeTrainers
en: They used to be incredibly tough, and they were famous, too.
et: Vanasti olid nad uskumatult karmid ja olid ka kuulsad.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_FansOverThereUsedToBeTrainers
en: But they were obliterated by this certain TRAINER at a tournament.
et: Aga neid tõrjus see kindel TRAINER turniiril.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_FansOverThereUsedToBeTrainers
en: They were so thoroughly whipped, they became smitten by the TRAINER.
et: Nad olid nii põhjalikult piitsutatud, et said TRAINER löödud.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_FansOverThereUsedToBeTrainers
en: Now they're just fans of the TRAINER. They go cheer for their idol at the BATTLE DOME every day now.
et: Nüüd on nad lihtsalt TRAINER fännid. Nad lähevad rõõmustama oma iidoli pärast BATTLE DOME iga päev nüüd.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MonWithLongTailInFrontier
en: I heard a rumor that someone saw a POKéMON with an unusually long tail somewhere in the BATTLE FRONTIER.
et: Kuulsin kuulujuttu, et keegi nägi POKéMON ebatavaliselt pika sabaga kuskil BATTLE FRONTIER.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MonWithLongTailInFrontier
en: It must be adorable. I'm sure of it…
et: See peab olema võluv. Olen selles kindel...

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MonWithLongTailInFrontier
en: Oh, challenges can wait. I feel driven to find the delightful creature!
et: Oh, väljakutsed võivad oodata. Tunnen, et olen aetud leidma veetlevat olendit!

label: SootopolisCity_Mart_Text_PPUpIsGreat
en: PP UP is great!
et: PP UP on suurepärane!

label: SootopolisCity_Mart_Text_PPUpIsGreat
en: It raises the POWER POINTS, the PP, of a POKéMON move.
et: See tõstab POWER POINTS, PP, POKéMON võtte.

label: SootopolisCity_Mart_Text_TooScaryOutside
en: What… What is happening?
et: Mis toimub?

label: SootopolisCity_Mart_Text_TooScaryOutside
en: I really want to know, but it's too scary to go outside.
et: Ma tõesti tahan teada, aga õue minek on liiga hirmus.

label: SootopolisCity_Mart_Text_FullRestoreItemOfDreams
en: Do you know FULL RESTORE?
et: Kas tead FULL RESTORE?

label: SootopolisCity_Mart_Text_FullRestoreItemOfDreams
en: Full restoration of HP! Eradication of all status problems!
et: Täielik restaureerimine HP! Kõigi staatuseprobleemide eristamine!

label: SootopolisCity_Mart_Text_FullRestoreItemOfDreams
en: It's truly an item of your dreams!
et: See on tõeliselt sinu unistuste ese!

label: SootopolisCity_Mart_Text_DidSomethingAwaken
en: This weather… Did something awaken?
et: Kas see ilm äratas midagi?

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_CouldntFindMonForMe
en: So, like, I couldn't find myself any POKéMON that were, like, for me.
et: Seega ei leidnud ma endale ühtegi POKéMON mis oleks nagu minu jaoks.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_CouldntFindMonForMe
en: So, I figured, like, hey, I should file a complaint to the guy there?
et: Niisiis, ma mõtlesin, et kuule, ma peaksin esitama kaebuse sellele tüübile seal?

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_CouldntFindMonForMe
en: And he wouldn't hear me out, like, hey! So, like, total bummer, man!
et: Ja ta ei kuuleks mind, nagu, kuule! Nii et, nagu, totaalne bummer, mees!

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_CouldntFindMonForMe
en: Hey, like, you! Zip it, you know? Just, you know, take this!
et: Kuule, nagu, sina! Zip it, kas tead? Lihtsalt, tead, võta see!

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainTorment
en: That's, like, TM41, you know? Hey, it's TORMENT, you hearing me?
et: See tähendab, et TM41, tead? Hei, see on TORMENT, sa kuuled mind?

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainTorment
en: Like, it won't let the other guy use the same move twice in a row, see?
et: Nagu ei lase see teisel tüübil kaks korda järjest sama võtet kasutada, näed?

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainTorment
en: Hey, now, you listen here, like, I'm not laying a torment on you!
et: Kuule, nüüd, sa kuulad siin, nagu ma ei pane sulle piina!

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_IllTryUsingBugMons
en: I don't really like BUG POKéMON, but maybe I'll try using some for a change of pace.
et: Mulle väga ei meeldi BUG POKéMON, aga ehk proovin mõnda kasutada tempomuutuseks.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_IllTryUsingBugMons
en: Who knows, I might even get to like them!
et: Kes teab, mulle võivad need isegi meeldida!

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_BattleEvenWithoutToughMons
en: You can battle all you want here even if you don't have any tough POKéMON.
et: Võite siin võidelda kõigega, mida soovite, isegi kui teil ei ole ühtegi karmi POKéMON.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_NiceIfMoreSelection
en: Wouldn't it be nice if they had more of a selection?
et: Kas poleks tore, kui neil oleks rohkem valikut?

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_RydelGreeting
en: Well, well, what have we here? A most energetic customer!
et: No mis meil siin siis on? Kõige energilisem klient!

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_RydelGreeting
en: Me? You may call me RYDEL. I'm the owner of this cycle shop.
et: Mina? Sa võid mulle helistada RYDEL. Olen selle tsüklipoe omanik.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_DidYouComeFromFarAway
en: RYDEL: Your RUNNING SHOES… They're awfully filthy.
et: RYDEL: Teie RUNNING SHOES... Nad on kohutavalt räpased.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_DidYouComeFromFarAway
en: Did you come from far away?
et: Kas tulid kaugelt?

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_GuessYouDontNeedBike
en: RYDEL: Is that right?
et: RYDEL: Kas see on õige?

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_GuessYouDontNeedBike
en: Then, I guess you have no need for any of my BIKES.
et: Siis pole sul vist mingit vajadust minu BIKES järele.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ExplainBikesChooseWhichOne
en: RYDEL: Hm, hm… … … … …

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ExplainBikesChooseWhichOne
en: You're saying that you came all this way from LITTLEROOT?
et: Sa väidad, et tulid terve tee LITTLEROOT?

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ExplainBikesChooseWhichOne
en: My goodness! That's ridiculously far!
et: Minu headus! See on naeruväärselt kaugel!

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ExplainBikesChooseWhichOne
en: If you had one of my BIKES, you could go anywhere easily while feeling the gentle caress of the wind!
et: Kui sul oleks üks minu BIKES, siis võiksid minna kuhu iganes kergelt, tundes samas tuule õrna hellitust!

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ExplainBikesChooseWhichOne
en: I'll tell you what! I'll give you a BIKE!
et: Ma ütlen, mida! Annan sulle BIKE!

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ExplainBikesChooseWhichOne
en: Oh, wait a second!
et: Oh, oota korraks!

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ExplainBikesChooseWhichOne
en: I forgot to tell you that there are two kinds of BIKES!
et: Unustasin öelda, et on kahte sorti BIKES!

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ExplainBikesChooseWhichOne
en: They are the MACH BIKE and the ACRO BIKE!
et: Need on MACH BIKE ja ACRO BIKE!

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ExplainBikesChooseWhichOne
en: The MACH BIKE is for cyclists who want to feel the wind with their bodies!
et: MACH BIKE on mõeldud jalgratturitele, kes soovivad tunda tuult oma kehaga!

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ExplainBikesChooseWhichOne
en: And an ACRO BIKE is for those who prefer technical rides!
et: Ja ACRO BIKE on neile, kes eelistavad tehnilisi sõite!

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ExplainBikesChooseWhichOne
en: I'm a real sweetheart, so you can have whichever one you like!
et: Ma olen tõeline kallim, nii et sul võib olla, kumb sulle meeldib!

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ExplainBikesChooseWhichOne
en: Which one will you choose?
et: Kumba te valite?

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ChoseMachBike
en: {PLAYER} chose the MACH BIKE.
et: {PLAYER} valis MACH BIKE.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ChoseAcroBike
en: {PLAYER} chose the ACRO BIKE.
et: {PLAYER} valis ACRO BIKE.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ComeBackToSwitchBikes
en: RYDEL: If you get the urge to switch BIKES, just come see me!
et: RYDEL: Kui sul tekib tung vahetada BIKES, tule lihtsalt minuga tutvuma!

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_WantToSwitchBikes
en: RYDEL: Oh? Were you thinking about switching BIKES?
et: RYDEL: Oh? Kas mõtlesid vahetada BIKES?

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_IllSwitchBikes
en: RYDEL: Okay, no problem! I'll switch BIKES for you!
et: RYDEL: Okei, pole probleemi! Vahetan BIKES sinu jaoks!

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ExchangedMachForAcro
en: {PLAYER} got the MACH BIKE exchanged for an ACRO BIKE.
et: {PLAYER} sai MACH BIKE vahetatud ACRO BIKE vastu.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ExchangedAcroForMach
en: {PLAYER} got the ACRO BIKE exchanged for a MACH BIKE.
et: {PLAYER} sai ACRO BIKE vahetatud MACH BIKE vastu.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_HappyYouLikeIt
en: RYDEL: Good, good! I'm happy that you like it!
et: RYDEL: Hea, hea! Olen õnnelik, et see sulle meeldib!

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_OhYourBikeIsInPC
en: Oh? What happened to that BIKE I gave you?
et: Oh? Mis sellest BIKE I'st sai?

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_OhYourBikeIsInPC
en: Oh, I get it, you stored it using your PC.
et: Oh, ma saan aru, sa salvestasid selle oma PC abil.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_OhYourBikeIsInPC
en: Well, take it out of PC storage, and I'll be happy to exchange it!
et: No võta see PC salvestusest välja ja vahetan hea meelega ära!

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_OhYourBikeIsInPC
en: May the wind always be at your back on your adventure!
et: Tuul olgu sinu seiklusel alati selja taga!

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_HandbooksAreInBack
en: I'm learning about BIKES while I work here.
et: Ma õpin BIKES kohta, kuni ma siin töötan.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_HandbooksAreInBack
en: If you need advice on how to ride your BIKE, there're a couple handbooks in the back.
et: Kui vajad nõu, kuidas oma BIKE sõita, on taga paar käsiraamatut.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_MachHandbookWhichPage
en: It's a handbook on the MACH BIKE.
et: See on käsiraamat MACH BIKE kohta.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_MachHandbookWhichPage
en: Which page do you want to read?
et: Millist lehekülge soovite lugeda?

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_HowToRideMachBike
en: A BIKE moves in the direction that the + Control Pad is pressed.
et: A BIKE liigub selles suunas, et vajutatakse + Control Pad.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_HowToRideMachBike
en: It will speed up once it gets rolling.
et: See kiirendab, kui see veerema hakkab.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_HowToRideMachBike
en: To stop, release the + Control Pad. The BIKE will slow to a stop.
et: Peatamiseks vabasta + Control Pad. BIKE aeglustub peatuseni.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_HowToRideMachBike
en: Want to read a different page?
et: Soovid lugeda teist lehte?

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_HowToTurnMachBike
en: A MACH BIKE is speedy, but it can't stop very quickly.
et: A MACH BIKE on kiire, kuid see ei saa väga kiiresti peatuda.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_HowToTurnMachBike
en: It gets a little tricky to get around a corner.
et: Nurga taha jõudmine muutub veidi keeruliseks.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_HowToTurnMachBike
en: Release the + Control Pad a little before the corner and slow down.
et: Vabasta + Control Pad veidi enne nurka ja aeglusta.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_HowToTurnMachBike
en: Want to read a different page?
et: Soovid lugeda teist lehte?

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_SandySlopes
en: There are small sandy slopes throughout the HOENN region.
et: Kogu HOENN piirkonnas on väikesed liivased nõlvad.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_SandySlopes
en: The loose, crumbly sand makes it impossible to climb normally.
et: Lahtine, murenenud liiv muudab normaalselt ronimise võimatuks.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_SandySlopes
en: But if you have a MACH BIKE, you can zip up a sandy slope.
et: Aga kui sul on MACH BIKE, siis võid zippida üles liivase nõlva.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_SandySlopes
en: Want to read a different page?
et: Soovid lugeda teist lehte?

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_AcroHandbookWhichPage
en: It's a handbook on the ACRO BIKE.
et: See on käsiraamat ACRO BIKE kohta.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_AcroHandbookWhichPage
en: Which page do you want to read?
et: Millist lehekülge soovite lugeda?

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_Wheelies
en: Press the B Button while riding, and the front wheel lifts up.
et: Vajutage ratsutamise ajal B-nuppu ja esiratas tõstab üles.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_Wheelies
en: You can zip around with the front wheel up using the + Control Pad.
et: Esirattaga saab ringi tõmbuda, kasutades + Control Padi.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_Wheelies
en: This technique is called a wheelie.
et: Seda tehnikat nimetatakse wheelieks.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_Wheelies
en: Want to read a different page?
et: Soovid lugeda teist lehte?

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_BunnyHops
en: Keeping the B Button pressed, your BIKE can hop on the spot.
et: Hoides B-nuppu vajutatuna, võib teie BIKE kohapeal hüpata.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_BunnyHops
en: This technique is called a bunny hop.
et: Seda tehnikat nimetatakse jänkuhopiks.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_BunnyHops
en: You can ride while hopping, too.
et: Sõita saab ka hoppamise ajal.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_BunnyHops
en: Want to read a different page?
et: Soovid lugeda teist lehte?

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_Jumps
en: Press the B Button and the + Control Pad at the same time to jump.
et: Vajutage hüppamiseks samal ajal B-nuppu ja + kontrollpadi.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_Jumps
en: Press the + Control Pad to the side to jump sideways.
et: Vajutage + juhtpadi küljele, et külili hüpata.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_Jumps
en: Press it backwards to make the BIKE change directions while jumping.
et: Vajutage seda tagurpidi, et BIKE muuta suundi hüpates.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_Jumps
en: Want to read a different page?
et: Soovid lugeda teist lehte?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LeftTutorIntro
en: Buhahaha!
et: Buhahaha!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LeftTutorIntro
en: You couldn't tell it from looking now, but I used to be one tough TRAINER.
et: Vaatamisest ei saanud seda nüüd küll öelda, aga kunagi olin üks karm TRAINER.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LeftTutorIntro
en: I had a reputation as the toughest BEAUTY around, I tell you!
et: Mul oli reputatsioon kui kõige kõvem BEAUTY ümberringi, ma ütlen!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LeftTutorIntro
en: What is it now? You don't believe me.
et: Mis see nüüd on? Sa ei usu mind.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LeftTutorIntro
en: I'm not like that blowhard woman over there. I'm actually talented!
et: Ma ei ole nagu see bushhard naine seal. Ma olen tegelikult andekas!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LeftTutorIntro
en: Let me prove it to you. I can teach your POKéMON special and yet cute moves.
et: Lubage mul seda teile tõestada. Võin õpetada teie POKéMON erilisi ja samas armsaid käike.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LeftTutorIntro
en: But my lessons don't come free. How about paying for the moves I teach with a wee bit of Battle Points?
et: Aga minu õppetunnid ei tule tasuta. Kuidas oleks maksta nende käikude eest, mida õpetan natuke Battle Pointsidega?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LeftTutorWelcomeBack
en: Buhahaha!
et: Buhahaha!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LeftTutorWelcomeBack
en: Are you back to learn special and yet cute POKéMON moves?
et: Kas oled tagasi, et õppida erilisi ja samas armsaid POKéMON võtteid?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_TeachWhichMove
en: Fine, fine, look here! Which move should I teach?
et: Olgu, olgu, vaadake siia! Millist võtet peaksin õpetama?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_MoveWillBeXBattlePoints
en: The move {STR_VAR_1}, is it? That will be {STR_VAR_2} Battle Points, okay?
et: Kolimine {STR_VAR_1}, kas pole? See on {STR_VAR_2} Battle Points, eks?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_TeachMoveToWhichMon
en: Fine, fine, now pick the POKéMON I should teach the move to.
et: Fine, fine, vali nüüd POKéMON Ma peaksin õpetama kolimist.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_HaventGotEnoughPoints
en: What the… You haven't got enough Battle Points!
et: Sa ei ole piisavalt Battle Points!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_IllTakeBattlePoints
en: Do you see how skilled I am now? I'll take your Battle Points, thanks!
et: Kas sa näed, kui osav ma nüüd olen? Võtan teie Battle Points, tänud!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_YouDontWantTo
en: What's that? You don't want to…
et: Mis see on? Sa ei taha...

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_YouDontWantTo
en: If you want to see how skilled I am, you come see me anytime!
et: Kui sa tahad näha, kui osav ma olen, siis sa tuled mind igal ajal vaatama!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_RightTutorIntro
en: Ihihihi!
et: Ihihihi!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_RightTutorIntro
en: I know it's hard to see now, but I used to be one fantastic TRAINER.
et: Ma tean, et seda on nüüd raske näha, aga ma olin kunagi üks fantastiline TRAINER.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_RightTutorIntro
en: I had a reputation as the most invincible SWIMMER around, I tell you!
et: Mul oli maine kui kõige võitmatumal SWIMMER ümberringi, ma ütlen teile!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_RightTutorIntro
en: What's wrong? You don't believe me.
et: Mis viga on? Sa ei usu mind.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_RightTutorIntro
en: I'm not like that buffoonish woman over there. I'm actually experienced!
et: Ma ei ole nagu see bufooniline naine seal. Olen tegelikult kogenud!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_RightTutorIntro
en: I can prove it to you. I can teach your POKéMON hard and yet pretty moves.
et: Ma võin seda sulle tõestada. Ma saan õpetada oma POKéMON kõva ja samas ilus võtteid.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_RightTutorIntro
en: But my lessons don't come free. How about paying for the moves I teach with a wee bit of Battle Points?
et: Aga minu õppetunnid ei tule tasuta. Kuidas oleks maksta nende käikude eest, mida õpetan natuke Battle Pointsidega?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_RightTutorWelcomeBack
en: Ihihihi!
et: Ihihihi!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_RightTutorWelcomeBack
en: Have you come to learn hard and yet pretty POKéMON moves?
et: Kas oled tulnud õppima kõvasti ja samas päris POKéMON võtteid?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_ThinkLadiesDontGetAlong
en: Those ladies, the way they bad-mouth each other, you probably think that they don't get along.
et: Need neiud, nii nagu nad omavahel halvasuulised on, te ilmselt arvate, et nad ei saa omavahel läbi.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_ThinkLadiesDontGetAlong
en: But if that were true, they wouldn't stay out here together, would they?
et: Aga kui see oleks tõsi, siis nad ju ei püsiks siin koos?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LadiesWereStrongAndBeautiful
en: When I was just a wee YOUNGSTER, those ladies were strong and beautiful.
et: Kui ma olin lihtsalt pisike YOUNGSTER, olid need daamid tugevad ja ilusad.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LadiesWereStrongAndBeautiful
en: They were idols among us TRAINERS.
et: Nad olid iidolid meie seas TRAINERS.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LadiesWereStrongAndBeautiful
en: Even now, age hasn't dulled their abilities.
et: Ka praegu pole vanus nende võimeid tümitanud.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LadiesWereStrongAndBeautiful
en: In fact, their POKéMON moves have grown even more polished.
et: Tegelikult on nende POKéMON käigud veelgi rohkem lihvitud.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LadiesWereStrongAndBeautiful
en: But… For some reason, I can't help but feel this…
et: Aga... millegipärast ei saa ma jätta seda tundmata...

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LadiesWereStrongAndBeautiful
en: Time is so cruel…
et: Aeg on nii julm...

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_SoftboiledDesc
en: Recovers up to half the user's maximum HP.
et: Taastab kuni poole kasutaja maksimum HP.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_SeismicTossDesc
en: Inflicts damage identical to the user's level.
et: Rikub kasutaja tasemega identseid kahjustusi.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_DreamEaterDesc
en: Recovers half the damage inflicted on a sleeping foe.
et: Pöörab poole magavale vaenlasele tekitatud kahjust.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_MegaPunchDesc
en: A strong punch thrown with incredible power.
et: Tugev löök, mis on visatud uskumatu jõuga.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_MegaKickDesc
en: An extremely powerful kick with intense force.
et: Äärmiselt võimas löök intensiivse jõuga.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_BodySlamDesc
en: A full-body slam that may cause paralysis.
et: Täiskehaga slämm, mis võib põhjustada halvatust.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_RockSlideDesc
en: Large boulders are hurled. May cause flinching.
et: Suured rahnud on loobitud. Võib põhjustada flirtimist.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_CounterDesc
en: Retaliates any physical hit with double the power.
et: Tagastab igasuguse füüsilise löögi, mille võimsus on kahekordne.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_ThunderWaveDesc
en: A weak jolt of electricity that paralyzes the foe.
et: Nõrk elektrijõnks, mis halvab vaenlase.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_SwordsDanceDesc
en: A fighting dance that sharply raises ATTACK.
et: Võitlev tants, mis tõstab järsult ATTACK.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_DefenseCurlDesc
en: Curls up to conceal weak spots and raise DEFENSE.
et: Lokid kuni varjata nõrgad kohad ja tõsta DEFENSE.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_SnoreDesc
en: A loud attack that can be used only while asleep.
et: Valju rünnak, mida saab kasutada ainult magades.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_MudSlapDesc
en: Hurls mud in the foe's face to reduce its accuracy.
et: Hurritab vaenlasele muda näkku, et selle täpsust vähendada.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_SwiftDesc
en: Sprays starshaped rays that never miss.
et: Spreid tähekujulised kiired, millest kunagi puudust ei tunta.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_IcyWindDesc
en: A chilling attack that lowers the foe's SPEED.
et: Jahutav rünnak, mis langetab vaenlase SPEED.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_EndureDesc
en: Endures any attack for 1 turn, leaving 1HP.
et: Kestab igasuguse rünnaku 1 pöörde, jättes 1HP.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_PsychUpDesc
en: Copies the foe's effect(s) and gives to the user.
et: Kopeerib vaenlase efekti (d) ja annab kasutajale.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_IcePunchDesc
en: An icy punch that may freeze the foe.
et: Jäine punn, mis võib külmutada vaenlase.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_ThunderPunchDesc
en: An electrified punch that may paralyze the foe.
et: Elektrifitseeritud punn, mis võib vaenlase halvata.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_FirePunchDesc
en: A fiery punch that may burn the foe.
et: Tuline punn, mis võib vaenlase ära põletada.

label: RustboroCity_House1_Text_IllTradeIfYouWant
en: Huh? My POKéMON is cute? Sure, I knew that.
et: Huh? Minu POKéMON on armas? Muidugi ma teadsin seda.

label: RustboroCity_House1_Text_IllTradeIfYouWant
en: But if you really want, I'm willing to trade it to you.
et: Aga kui sa tõesti tahad, siis ma olen nõus selle sulle välja vahetama.

label: RustboroCity_House1_Text_IllTradeIfYouWant
en: I'll trade you my {STR_VAR_2} for a {STR_VAR_1} if you want.
et: Vahetan sulle oma {STR_VAR_2}  {STR_VAR_1} vastu, kui soovid.

label: RustboroCity_House1_Text_PleaseBeGoodToMyPokemon
en: Eheheh… Please be good to my POKéMON.
et: Eheheh... Palun ole hea minu POKéMON vastu.

label: RustboroCity_House1_Text_DoesntLookLikeMonToMe
en: Huh? That doesn't look anything like a {STR_VAR_1} to me.
et: Huh? See ei näe minu jaoks välja midagi {STR_VAR_1} sarnast.

label: RustboroCity_House1_Text_YouDontWantToThatsOkay
en: Oh, if you don't want to, that's okay. But my POKéMON is cute, you know…
et: Oh, kui ei taha, siis pole hullu. Aga minu POKéMON on armas, tead...

label: RustboroCity_House1_Text_AnyPokemonCanBeCute
en: Any POKéMON can be cute if you raise it with care and kindness.
et: Iga POKéMON võib olla armas, kui te tõsta seda hoole ja heatahtlikkusega.

label: RustboroCity_House1_Text_AllSortsOfPlaces
en: In all sorts of places, there are all sorts of POKéMON and people.
et: Igasugustes kohtades on igasuguseid POKéMON ja inimesi.

label: RustboroCity_House1_Text_AllSortsOfPlaces
en: I find that fascinating, so I go to all sorts of places.
et: Ma leian, et see on põnev, nii et ma käin kõikvõimalikes kohtades.

label: SeafloorCavern_Room1_Text_Grunt1Intro
en: We don't need a kid around! Go on home already!
et: Me ei vaja last ümber! Mine juba koju!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room1_Text_Grunt1Defeat
en: I want to go home…
et: Ma tahan koju minna...

label: SeafloorCavern_Room1_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
en: I want to get a promotion so I can boss around the GRUNTS…
et: Tahan saada promo, et saaksin GRUNTS ümber bossida...

label: SeafloorCavern_Room1_Text_Grunt2Intro
en: That submarine… It's tiny inside. I'm sore all over!
et: See allveelaev on seest pisike. Mul on valus üleni!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room1_Text_Grunt2Defeat
en: Losing makes me sore!
et: Kaotamine teeb mind valusaks!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room1_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
en: That submarine we jacked, man, it's brutal as a ride. It's way too tight in there!
et: See allveelaev, mida me peksasime, mees, on jõhker kui sõit. See on seal liiga tihe!

label: Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_MySonIsStrongerThanYou
en: You're the first TRAINER I've seen who deploys POKéMON so masterfully.
et: Sa oled esimene TRAINER I's näinud, kes juurutab POKéMON nii meisterlikult.

label: Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_MySonIsStrongerThanYou
en: But, I should tell you--my son is stronger than you.
et: Aga, ma peaks sulle ütlema, et mu poeg on sinust tugevam.

label: Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_MySonIsStrongerThanYou
en: He even took the POKéMON LEAGUE challenge, I'll have you know.
et: Ta võttis isegi POKéMON LIIGA väljakutse, ma tean.

label: Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_LikeYouToHaveMachoBrace
en: We use this MACHO BRACE to more effectively strengthen our POKéMON in training.
et: Me kasutame seda MACHO BRACE, et tõhusamalt tugevdada oma POKéMON koolitusel.

label: Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_LikeYouToHaveMachoBrace
en: Since you've beaten all of us here, I don't know if you need it, but we would like you to have our MACHO BRACE.
et: Kuna te olete meid kõiki siin peksnud, siis ma ei tea, kas teil seda vaja on, aga me tahaksime, et teil oleks meie MACHO BRACE.

label: Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_PassionateAboutBattles
en: When it comes to POKéMON battles, we tend to be pretty passionate.
et: Mis puutub POKéMON lahingutesse, siis kipume olema päris kirglikud.

label: Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_StrongerFamilyMembers
en: Mommy is stronger than Daddy.
et: Emme on tugevam kui issi.

label: Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_StrongerFamilyMembers
en: I'm stronger than Mommy.
et: Ma olen tugevam kui emme.

label: Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_StrongerFamilyMembers
en: And Grandma's stronger than me!
et: Ja vanaema on minust tugevam!

label: Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_StrongerFamilyMembers
en: But my big brother is even stronger than Grandma.
et: Aga mu suur vend on veel tugevam kui vanaema.

label: Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_GrandsonStrong
en: There's no question that you're strong.
et: Pole küsimustki, et oled tugev.

label: Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_GrandsonStrong
en: But if you were to battle my grandson, you'd end up crying in frustration.
et: Aga kui sa võitleksid mu lapselapsega, siis sa lõpuks nutaksid pettunult.

label: Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_GrandsonStrong
en: He's much stronger than any TRAINER our family knows.
et: Ta on palju tugevam kui ükski TRAINER meie pere teab.

label: Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_GrandsonStrong
en: He must be challenging the POKéMON LEAGUE CHAMPION by now.
et: Ta peab olema väljakutse POKéMON LIIGA TŠEMPION praeguseks.

label: Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_GrandsonStrong
en: Knowing my grandson, he could be the CHAMPION already!
et: Teades mu pojapoega, võiks ta olla juba TŠEMPION!

label: Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_GrandsonStrongShort
en: My grandson must be challenging the POKéMON LEAGUE CHAMPION by now.
et: Minu lapselaps peab olema väljakutse POKéMON LIIGA TŠEMPION nüüdseks.

label: Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_GrandsonStrongShort
en: Knowing my grandson, he could be the CHAMPION already!
et: Teades mu pojapoega, võiks ta olla juba TŠEMPION!

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_WallaceStory
en: Ah, so you are {PLAYER}{KUN}? I've heard tales of your exploits.
et: Ah et sa oled siis {PLAYER}{KUN}? Olen kuulnud jutte teie ärakasutamistest.

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_WallaceStory
en: My name is WALLACE.
et: Minu nimi on WALLACE.

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_WallaceStory
en: I was once the GYM LEADER of SOOTOPOLIS, but something came up.
et: Olin kunagi SAALI JUHT SOOTOPOLIS, aga midagi tuli ette.

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_WallaceStory
en: So now, I've entrusted my mentor JUAN with the GYM's operation.
et: Nüüd siis olen usaldanud oma mentori JUAN SAAL operatsioonile.

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_WallaceStory
en: GROUDON and KYOGRE, the two POKéMON wreaking havoc here, are considered to be super-ancient POKéMON.
et: GROUDON ja KYOGRE, kaks POKéMON laastavat hävingut siin, peetakse üliarmsaks POKéMON.

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_WallaceStory
en: But there aren't just two superancient POKéMON.
et: Aga ei ole ainult kaks superance POKéMON.

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_WallaceStory
en: There is one more somewhere.
et: Kuskil on veel üks.

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_WallaceStory
en: Somewhere, there is a superancient POKéMON named RAYQUAZA.
et: Kuskil on superance POKéMON nimega RAYQUAZA.

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_WallaceStory
en: It's said that it was RAYQUAZA that becalmed the two combatants in the distant past.
et: Öeldakse, et just RAYQUAZA oli see, mis bekatas kaks võitlejat kauges minevikus.

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_WallaceStory
en: But even I have no clue as to RAYQUAZA's whereabouts…
et: Aga isegi mul pole õrna aimugi RAYQUAZA asukoha kohta...

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_WhereIsRayquaza
en: WALLACE: {PLAYER}{KUN}, do you perhaps know where RAYQUAZA is now?
et: WALLACE: {PLAYER}{KUN}, kas sa ehk tead, kus on nüüd RAYQUAZA?

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_WhereIsRayquaza
en: If you do, please tell me.
et: Kui sa seda teed, siis palun ütle mulle.

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_ButWereInCaveOfOrigin
en: WALLACE: The CAVE OF ORIGIN?
et: WALLACE: CAVE OF ORIGIN?

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_ButWereInCaveOfOrigin
en: But that's right here! I need you to do better than that!
et: Aga see on siinsamas! Ma vajan, et sa sellest paremini teeksid!

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_ButWereInCaveOfOrigin
en: Please, I need you to think about where RAYQUAZA might be right now.
et: Palun, mul on vaja, et mõtleksite, kus RAYQUAZA võiks praegu olla.

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_OldLadyDidntMentionThat
en: WALLACE: MT. PYRE?
et: WALLACE: MT. PYRE?

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_OldLadyDidntMentionThat
en: But when I met the old lady there earlier, she made no mention of it.
et: Aga kui ma seal vanaprouaga varem kohtusin, ei jätnud ta sellest mainimata.

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_OldLadyDidntMentionThat
en: I very much doubt that the old lady would try to hide something from me…
et: Ma väga kahtlen, et vanaproua üritab minu eest midagi varjata...

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_OldLadyDidntMentionThat
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}, could you think about this more carefully for me?
et: {PLAYER} {KUN}, kas sa võiksid sellele minu jaoks hoolikamalt mõelda?

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_CantYouRememberSomehow
en: WALLACE: Huh? You don't remember? Hmm… That's a problem…
et: WALLACE: Huh? Sa ei mäleta? Hmm... see on probleem...

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_CantYouRememberSomehow
en: Can't you remember somehow?
et: Kas kuidagi ei mäleta?

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_WellHeadToSkyPillar
en: WALLACE: The SKY PILLAR?
et: WALLACE: SKY PILLAR?

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_WellHeadToSkyPillar
en: That's it! It must be the SKY PILLAR!
et: Nii ongi! See peab olema SKY PILLAR!

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_WellHeadToSkyPillar
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}, there's not a moment to lose! We'll head to the SKY PILLAR right away!
et: {PLAYER} {KUN}, pole hetkegi kaotada! Suundume kohe SKY PILLAR juurde!

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_WilliamIntro
en: The rich atmosphere of the mountain has elevated my psychic power!
et: Mäe rikkalik atmosfäär on tõstnud mu psüühilist jõudu!

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_WilliamIntro
en: A mere child like you… You dream of winning?
et: Pelgalt sinusugune laps, sa unistad võidust?

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_WilliamDefeat
en: I drown in self-pity…
et: Uputan enesehaletsusse...

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_WilliamPostBattle
en: My psychic powers have surely grown several times, but…
et: Minu psüühilised võimed on kindlasti mitu korda kasvanud, aga...

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_KaylaIntro
en: Ahahahaha!
et: Ahahahaha!

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_KaylaIntro
en: This is no place for children, least of all you!
et: See ei ole koht lastele, kõige vähem teile!

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_KaylaDefeat
en: I lost that cleanly…
et: Ma kaotasin selle puhtalt...

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_KaylaPostBattle
en: This means my training is still not enough…
et: See tähendab, et minu treeningust ikka ei piisa...

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_KaylaPostBattle
en: I've got to keep working toward the summit…
et: Ma pean jätkama tööd tippkohtumise nimel...

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_KaylaPostBattle
en: Go, me!
et: Mine, mina!

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_GabrielleIntro
en: Why have you come here?
et: Miks sa siia tulid?

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_GabrielleDefeat
en: That was amazing! You're a very special TRAINER.
et: See oli hämmastav! Sa oled väga eriline TRAINER.

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_GabriellePostBattle
en: POKéMON no longer of this world. POKéMON that are with you now.
et: POKéMON mitte enam sellest maailmast. POKéMON mis on sinuga nüüd.

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_GabriellePostBattle
en: And the POKéMON that you will meet in the future…
et: Ja see POKéMON mida te tulevikus kohtate...

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_GabriellePostBattle
en: They are all to be equally cherished. Please remember that.
et: Neid kõiki tuleb võrdselt kalliks pidada. Palun pidage seda meeles.

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_GabrielleRegister
en: I would like to see your POKéMON when they grow up some more…
et: Tahaksin näha oma POKéMON kui nad kasvavad veel...

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_GabrielleRegister
en: Please, I need to see your POKéNAV.
et: Palun, ma pean teie POKéNAV nägema.

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_GabrielleRematchIntro
en: Oh, it's you…
et: Oh, see oled sina...

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_GabrielleRematchIntro
en: Have you come to show me your grown POKéMON?
et: Kas sa oled tulnud mulle näitama oma kasvatatud POKéMON?

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_GabrielleRematchDefeat
en: How amazing! You are a special person.
et: Kui hämmastav! Sa oled eriline inimene.

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_GabriellePostRematch
en: POKéMON no longer of this world. POKéMON that are with you now.
et: POKéMON mitte enam sellest maailmast. POKéMON mis on sinuga nüüd.

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_GabriellePostRematch
en: And the POKéMON that you will meet in the future…
et: Ja see POKéMON mida te tulevikus kohtate...

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_GabriellePostRematch
en: They are all to be equally cherished. I see that you've remembered that.
et: Neid kõiki tuleb võrdselt kalliks pidada. Ma näen, et teile on see meelde jäänud.

label: Route102_Text_WatchMeCatchPokemon
en: WALLY: {PLAYER}… POKéMON hide in tall grass like this, don't they?
et: WALLY: {PLAYER}... POKéMON peida end sellises kõrges rohus, kas pole?

label: Route102_Text_WatchMeCatchPokemon
en: Please watch me and see if I can catch one properly.
et: Palun jälgige mind ja vaadake, kas saan ühe korralikult kätte.

label: Route102_Text_WatchMeCatchPokemon
en: …Whoa!
et: ...Whoa!

label: Route102_Text_WallyIDidIt
en: WALLY: I did it… It's my… My POKéMON!
et: WALLY: Ma tegin seda... See on minu... Minu POKéMON!

label: Route102_Text_LetsGoBack
en: {PLAYER}, thank you! Let's go back to the GYM!
et: {PLAYER}, aitäh! Lähme tagasi SAAL!

label: Route102_Text_ImNotVeryTall
en: I'm…not very tall, so I sink right into tall grass.
et: Ma ei ole väga pikk, nii et vajun otse kõrgesse rohtu.

label: Route102_Text_ImNotVeryTall
en: The grass goes up my nose and… Fwafwafwafwafwa…
et: Rohi läheb mu ninast üles ja... Fwafwafwafwa...

label: Route102_Text_ImNotVeryTall
en: Fwatchoo!
et: Fwatchoo!

label: Route102_Text_CatchWholeBunchOfPokemon
en: I'm going to catch a whole bunch of POKéMON!
et: Püüan terve hunniku POKéMON!

label: Route102_Text_RouteSignOldale
en: ROUTE 102 {RIGHT_ARROW} OLDALE TOWN
et: ROUTE 102 {RIGHT_ARROW} OLDALE TOWN

label: Route102_Text_RouteSignPetalburg
en: ROUTE 102 {LEFT_ARROW} PETALBURG CITY
et: ROUTE 102 {LEFT_ARROW} PETALBURG CITY

label: Route104_Text_DadPokenavCall
en: DAD: Oh, {PLAYER}?
et: DAD: Oh, {PLAYER}?

label: Route104_Text_DadPokenavCall
en: … … … … … … Where are you now? It sounds windy wherever you are.
et: ... ... ... ... ... ... Kus sa nüüd oled? See kõlab tuuliselt kõikjal, kus sa oled.

label: Route104_Text_DadPokenavCall
en: I just heard from DEVON's MR. STONE about your POKéNAV, so I decided to give you a call.
et: Kuulsin just DEVON'st MR. STONE umbes oma POKéNAV, nii et ma otsustasin teile helistada.

label: Route104_Text_DadPokenavCall
en: It sounds like you're doing fine, so that's fine with me.
et: Kõlab nii, et sul läheb hästi, nii et mulle sobib.

label: Route104_Text_DadPokenavCall
en: You take care now.
et: Sa hoolitsed nüüd.

label: Route104_Text_RegisteredDadInPokenav
en: Registered DAD NORMAN in the POKéNAV.
et: Registreerunud DAD NORMAN POKéNAV.

label: VerdanturfTown_Mart_Text_XSpecialIsCrucial
en: For any POKéMON match, X SPECIAL is crucial.
et: Iga POKéMON vaste puhul on X SPECIAL ülioluline.

label: VerdanturfTown_Mart_Text_XSpecialIsCrucial
en: It jacks up the power of some moves even though it's only for one battle.
et: See lööb mõne võtte jõu kokku, kuigi see on ainult üheks lahinguks.

label: VerdanturfTown_Mart_Text_NoStrategyGuidesForBattleTent
en: They don't seem to sell any winning strategy guides for the BATTLE TENT…
et: Tundub, et nad ei müü ühtegi võidustrateegia juhendit BATTLE TENT...

label: VerdanturfTown_Mart_Text_NoStrategyGuidesForBattleTent
en: It seems one must rely on one's own wits after all…
et: Tundub, et tuleb toetuda oma tarkustele ju...

label: VerdanturfTown_Mart_Text_NestBallOnWeakenedPokemon
en: The NEST BALL works better on weakened POKéMON.
et: NEST BALL töötab paremini nõrgestatud POKéMON.

label: VerdanturfTown_Mart_Text_NestBallOnWeakenedPokemon
en: VERDANTURF is the only place you can buy it.
et: VERDANTURF on ainus koht, kust seda osta saab.

label: SootopolisCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_WallaceToughestInHoenn
en: WALLACE is rumored to be the toughest TRAINER in the whole HOENN region.
et: WALLACE on kuuldavasti kõige karmim TRAINER kogu HOENN piirkonnas.

label: SootopolisCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_WallaceToughestInHoenn
en: This town's GYM is led by the TRAINER who taught WALLACE.
et: Selle linna SAAL juhib TRAINER kes õpetas WALLACE.

label: SootopolisCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_WallaceToughestInHoenn
en: But the ELITE FOUR… They're said to be even stronger than WALLACE's mentor.
et: Aga ELITE FOUR... Nad olevat veel tugevamad kui WALLACE mentor.

label: SootopolisCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_WallaceToughestInHoenn
en: How strong could they be?
et: Kui tugevad need võiksid olla?

label: SootopolisCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_EveryoneTakenRefuge
en: Everyone in town has taken refuge and won't come out of their homes.
et: Kõik linnas on varjunud ega tule kodudest välja.

label: SootopolisCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_EveryoneTakenRefuge
en: Even I would rather not venture outside.
et: Isegi õue ma pigem ei julgeks.

label: SootopolisCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_AlwaysBeFriendsWithPokemon
en: Whenever, wherever, and whatever happens, I will always be friends with POKéMON.
et: Alati, kus iganes, ja mis iganes juhtub, olen alati sõber POKéMON.

label: SootopolisCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_AlwaysBeFriendsWithPokemon
en: Because it's fun to be with POKéMON!
et: Sest tore on olla koos POKéMON!

label: SootopolisCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ArentPokemonOurFriends
en: Aren't POKéMON our friends?
et: Kas mitte POKéMON meie sõbrad?

label: SootopolisCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ArentPokemonOurFriends
en: Why are they going wild this way?
et: Miks nad niimoodi metsikult lähevad?

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt15Intro
en: I don't have a bone to pick with you. I'm just following orders!
et: Mul ei ole konti, mida sinuga norida. Ma lihtsalt täidan käske!

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt15Defeat
en: I may have lost, but…
et: Võib-olla kaotasin, aga...

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt15PostBattle
en: We dug up something beyond belief! And, we got the BLUE ORB!
et: Kaevasime midagi uskumatust üles! Ja, me saime BLUE ORB!

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt15PostBattle
en: All that's left is for our leader to… Fufufu… Fwahahaha!
et: Jääb üle vaid, et meie juht... Fufufu... Fwahaha!

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt6Intro
en: I can't stand heat. Maybe I should've joined TEAM AQUA instead…
et: Ma ei talu kuumust. Võib-olla oleksin pidanud hoopis TEAM AQUA liituma...

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt6Defeat
en: Yeah, I really may not be right for TEAM MAGMA…
et: Jah, ma tõesti ei pruugi olla õige TEAM MAGMA...

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt6PostBattle
en: Don't you get lonely for the sea being in a place like this?
et: Kas sa ei jää üksikuks, sest meri on sellises kohas?

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt7Intro
en: You can hear tremors here sometimes.
et: Siin võib vahel kuulda värinaid.

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt7Intro
en: Could it be the volcano rattling? Or is it GROU…
et: Kas see võib olla vulkaan ragiseb? Või on see GROU...

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt7Intro
en: Whoops! No, no, never mind!
et: Whoops! Ei, ei, vahet pole!

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt7Defeat
en: You're a fiery battler. Just like a volcano!
et: Sa oled tuline võitleja. Täpselt nagu vulkaan!

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt7PostBattle
en: You just happened to win this time, but that doesn't matter.
et: Sa lihtsalt juhtusid seekord võitma, aga see pole oluline.

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt7PostBattle
en: TEAM MAGMA's goal is about to be reached!
et: TEAM MAGMA eesmärk on kohe-kohe saavutatav!

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt8Intro
en: One of our guys was freaking out that he lost his MAGMA EMBLEM…
et: Üks meie meestest ehmatas ära, et ta kaotas oma MAGMA EMBLEM...

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt8Intro
en: Wait a minute! Was it you who found it?
et: Oota nüüd! Kas sina olid see, kes selle leidis?

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt8Defeat
en: I'm having trouble believing this…
et: Mul on raskusi selle uskumisega...

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt8PostBattle
en: I'm getting this feeling that our plan is going to end in failure…
et: Mul tekib selline tunne, et meie plaan lõpeb läbikukkumisega...

label: FortreeCity_House5_Text_TreeHousesAreGreat
en: The tree houses of FORTREE are great!
et: FORTREE puumajad on suurepärased!

label: FortreeCity_House5_Text_TreeHousesAreGreat
en: I think it's the number one town for living together with POKéMON.
et: Ma arvan, et see on number üks linn koos elamiseks POKéMON-ga.

label: FortreeCity_House5_Text_AdaptedToNature
en: POKéMON and people have adapted to nature for survival.
et: POKéMON ja inimesed on kohanenud loodusega ellujäämiseks.

label: FortreeCity_House5_Text_AdaptedToNature
en: There's no need to make nature conform to the way we want to live.
et: Pole vaja panna loodust vastama sellele, kuidas me elada tahame.

label: FortreeCity_House5_Text_Zigzagoon
en: ZIGZAGOON: Bufuu!
et: ZIGZAGOON: Bufuu!

label: MagmaHideout_3F_2R_Text_Grunt10Intro
en: I understand everything our leader says. But you know what?
et: Ma saan aru kõigest, mida meie juht ütleb. Aga sa tead, mida?

label: MagmaHideout_3F_2R_Text_Grunt10Intro
en: Doing stuff like digging up a superancient POKéMON and ripping off someone's METEORITE…
et: Teeb asju nagu kaevab välja superance POKéMON ja rebib kellegi METEORITE...

label: MagmaHideout_3F_2R_Text_Grunt10Intro
en: I think we're going a little too far. What do you think?
et: Ma arvan, et me läheme natuke liiga kaugele. Mis sa arvad?

label: MagmaHideout_3F_2R_Text_Grunt10Defeat
en: Yeah, I think we are doing something wrong somehow.
et: Jah, ma arvan, et me teeme midagi valesti.

label: MagmaHideout_3F_2R_Text_Grunt10PostBattle
en: You know, losing to you cleared my mind.
et: Sa tead, et sinu kaotamine puhastas mu mõtte.

label: MagmaHideout_3F_2R_Text_Grunt10PostBattle
en: The next time I see our leader, I'm going to ask him about what we do.
et: Järgmine kord, kui näen meie juhti, küsin temalt, mida me teeme.

label: SlateportCity_House_Text_NatureToDoWithStatGains
en: My POKéMON has a HASTY nature.
et: Minu POKéMON on HASTY loodus.

label: SlateportCity_House_Text_NatureToDoWithStatGains
en: It has higher SPEED compared to my other POKéMON.
et: See on kõrgem SPEED võrreldes minu teiste POKéMON.

label: SlateportCity_House_Text_NatureToDoWithStatGains
en: Maybe their nature has something to do with the stat gains of POKéMON.
et: Võib-olla on nende loomusel midagi pistmist POKéMON stat kasumiga.

label: SlateportCity_House_Text_MustBeGoingToBattleTent
en: You're a TRAINER, aren't you?
et: Sa oled ju TRAINER?

label: SlateportCity_House_Text_MustBeGoingToBattleTent
en: Since you came to SLATEPORT CITY, you must be going to the BATTLE TENT.
et: Kuna sa tulid SLATEPORT CITY, siis sa pead minema BATTLE TENT.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_WouldYouLikeToEnter
en: Welcome to the OCEANIC MUSEUM.
et: Tere tulemast OCEANIC MUSEUM.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_WouldYouLikeToEnter
en: The entrance fee is ¥50. Would you like to enter?
et: Sissepääsutasu on $50. Soovid siseneda?

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_PleaseEnjoyYourself
en: Please enjoy yourself.
et: Palun nautige ennast.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_NotEnoughMoney
en: Oh? I'm sorry, but you don't seem to have enough money.
et: Oh? Vabandust, aga tundub, et sul pole piisavalt raha.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_CatchUpWithYourGroup
en: Oh? You're with that group that went in earlier?
et: Oh? Sa oled selle grupiga, kes varem sisse läks?

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_CatchUpWithYourGroup
en: You're the only one who's late. You'd better go catch up to them!
et: Sina oled ainus, kes hiljaks jääb. Läheksid parem neile järgi!

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_AquaExistForGoodOfAll
en: We, TEAM AQUA, exist for the good of all!
et: Meie, TEAM AQUA, eksisteerime kõigi hüvanguks!

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_OurBossIsntHere
en: We were told to assemble here, so we did, but…
et: Meil kästi siin kokku panna, nii me tegimegi, aga...

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_OurBossIsntHere
en: Our BOSS, the linchpin, isn't here.
et: Meie BOSS, linikut, ei ole siin.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_WouldStuffHereMakeMeRich
en: If I ripped off the stuff here, would it make me rich?
et: Kui ma siin asjad ära rebiksin, kas see teeks mind rikkaks?

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_CanLearnForNefariousDeeds
en: What I learn here, I can put to use on nefarious deeds…
et: Mida ma siin õpin, seda võin panna kasutama pahelistele tegudele...

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_RustboroBungled
en: If our goons didn't bungle things in RUSTBORO, we wouldn't be here!
et: Kui meie tohid RUSTBORO-s asju ei bungeldaks, siis me ei oleks siin!

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_DidntHaveMoney
en: I didn't have ¥50, so it took a long time getting by the receptionist.
et: Mul ei olnud $50, nii et administraatori käest saamine võttis kaua aega.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_LearnAboutSeaForBattling
en: I want to learn about the sea and use that knowledge for battling.
et: Tahan õppida tundma merd ja kasutada seda teadmist võitluseks.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_SternIsRoleModel
en: I get all giddy and gooey when I see the sea!
et: Ma muutun merd nähes üleni uimaseks ja gooeyks!

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_SternIsRoleModel
en: For me, CAPT. STERN is the number one role model!
et: Minu jaoks CAPT. STERN on number üks eeskuju!

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_MustBePokemonWeDontKnow
en: The sea is vast without end, and infinitely deep…
et: Meri on lõputult suur ja lõpmatult sügav...

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_MustBePokemonWeDontKnow
en: There must be many POKéMON that we don't know about.
et: Seal peab olema palju POKéMON millest me ei tea.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_WantSeaPokemon
en: I want a sea POKéMON.
et: Tahan merd POKéMON.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_WantSeaPokemon
en: I think it would feel cool and nice to hug.
et: Ma arvan, et oleks lahe ja mõnus kallistada.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_RememberMeTakeThis
en: Aiyeeeh! What are you doing here?
et: Aiyeeeh! Mida sa siin teed?

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_RememberMeTakeThis
en: Me? I'm the TEAM AQUA member you thumped before, remember? Back in RUSTURF TUNNEL?
et: Mina? Mina olen see TEAM AQUA liige, keda sa ennem tümitasid, mäletad? Tagasi RUSTURF TUNNEL?

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_RememberMeTakeThis
en: Here, take this! You have to forgive me!
et: Võta see ette! Sa pead mulle andestama!

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_HopeINeverSeeYouAgain
en: That TM, it suits you more than it does me.
et: Et TM, see sobib sulle rohkem kui mulle.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_HopeINeverSeeYouAgain
en: Hope I never see you again! Wahahaha!
et: Loodetavasti ei näe ma sind enam kunagi! Wahahaha!

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_YouHaveToTakeThis
en: Awww, come on! You have to take this and let me go!
et: Awww, tule nüüd! Sa pead selle võtma ja laskma mul minna!

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_WhirlpoolExperiment
en: A blue fluid is spiraling inside a glass vessel.
et: Klaasnõu sees spiraalib sinine vedelik.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_WhirlpoolExperiment
en: “This is an experiment to create a WHIRLPOOL artificially using wind.”
et: "See on eksperiment, et luua WHIRLPOOL kunstlikult kasutades tuult."

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_WaterfallExperiment
en: A red ball is bobbing up and down inside a glass vessel.
et: Punane pall koliseb klaasist anuma sees üles-alla.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_WaterfallExperiment
en: “This is an experiment simulating a WATERFALL using the ball's buoyancy.”
et: "See on eksperiment, mis simuleerib WATERFALL kasutades palli ujuvust."

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_OceanSoilDisplay
en: It's a sample of soil from the ocean floor.
et: See on mullaproov ookeanipõhjast.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_OceanSoilDisplay
en: “Over many years, the remains of life-forms settle at the bottom of the sea, making sedimentary layers.
et: "Paljude aastate jooksul settivad eluvormide jäänused merepõhja, tehes settekihte.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_OceanSoilDisplay
en: “By analyzing these layers, the ancient past is revealed.”
et: "Neid kihte analüüsides selgub iidne minevik."

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_BeachSandDisplay
en: It's a sample of beach sand.
et: See on rannaliiva proov.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_BeachSandDisplay
en: “Stones from mountains are washed down by rivers where they are chipped and ground down.
et: "Mägedest tulevaid kive uhuvad alla jõed, kus neid raiutakse ja maandatakse.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_BeachSandDisplay
en: “They are reduced to grains and end up as sand on beaches.”
et: "Need taanduvad teradele ja lõpevad liivana randades."

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_OceanicMinifact1
en: “OCEANIC MINIFACT 1 Why is seawater blue?
et: "OCEANIC MINIFACT 1 Why on merevesi sinine?

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_OceanicMinifact1
en: “Light is composed of many colors.
et: "Valgus koosneb paljudest värvidest.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_OceanicMinifact1
en: “When light passes through water, most kinds of light lose color.
et: "Kui valgus läbib vett, kaotab enamik valguse liike värvi.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_OceanicMinifact1
