en: “However, blue light retains its color, making the sea appear blue.”
et: "Siiski säilitab sinine valgus oma värvi, muutes mere siniseks."

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_OceanicMinifact2
en: “OCEANIC MINIFACT 2 Why is the sea salty?
et: "OCEANIC MINIFACT 2 Why kas meri on soolane?

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_OceanicMinifact2
en: “Seawater contains dissolved salt in the form of sodium and chlorine ions.
et: "Merevesi sisaldab lahustunud soola naatriumi ja kloori ioonide kujul.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_OceanicMinifact2
en: “These ions leech out of rocks and are carried out to sea by rain.
et: "Need ioonid kaanivad kividest välja ja viiakse vihmaga merele.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_OceanicMinifact2
en: “The concentration of dissolved salt makes the sea salty.”
et: "Lahenenud soola kontsentratsioon muudab mere soolaseks."

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_OceanicMinifact3
en: “OCEANIC MINIFACT 3 Which is bigger? The sea or land?
et: "OCEANIC MINIFACT 3 Which on suurem? Meri või maa?

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_OceanicMinifact3
en: “The sea covers about 70% of the planet, and the rest is land.
et: "Meri katab umbes 70% planeedist ja ülejäänud on maa.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_OceanicMinifact3
en: “The sea is therefore more than twice the size of land.”
et: "Meri on seega üle kahe korra suurem kui maa."

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_FossilDisplay
en: It's a fossil with wavy ridges on it.
et: See on fossiil, mille peal on lainelised harjased.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_FossilDisplay
en: “Soil on the ocean floor gets scoured by the tide.
et: "Ookeanipõrandal olev õli saab mõõnast.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_FossilDisplay
en: “The flowing seawater marks the soil with small ridges and valleys.
et: "Voolav merevesi tähistab mulda väikeste seljandite ja orgudega.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_FossilDisplay
en: “If this soil becomes fossilized, it is called a ripple mark.”
et: "Kui see pinnas kivistub, nimetatakse seda virvendusjäljeks."

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_DepthMeasuringMachine
en: A strange machine is rotating under a glass dome.
et: Klaaskupli all pöörleb kummaline masin.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_DepthMeasuringMachine
en: Maybe it's for measuring the depth of something…
et: Võib-olla on see millegi sügavuse mõõtmiseks...

label: FortreeCity_House2_Text_HiddenPowersArousedByNature
en: People… POKéMON…
et: Inimesed... POKéMON...

label: FortreeCity_House2_Text_HiddenPowersArousedByNature
en: Their hidden powers are aroused by living in natural environments…
et: Nende varjatud võimeid äratab looduslikes keskkondades elamine...

label: FortreeCity_House2_Text_CoinInWhichHand
en: Let this old woman see if your hidden power has awoken…
et: Las see vana naine vaatab, kas su varjatud vägi on ärganud...

label: FortreeCity_House2_Text_CoinInWhichHand
en: I hold a coin in my hand.
et: Hoian käes münti.

label: FortreeCity_House2_Text_CoinInWhichHand
en: Now, tell me, have I palmed it in the right hand? Or in the left?
et: Öelge nüüd, kas ma olen selle paremasse kätte palminud? Või vasakul?

label: FortreeCity_House2_Text_CorrectTryAgainWhichHand
en: Oh! Yes, correct!
et: Oh! Jah, õige!

label: FortreeCity_House2_Text_CorrectTryAgainWhichHand
en: We shall try again.
et: Me proovime uuesti.

label: FortreeCity_House2_Text_CorrectTryAgainWhichHand
en: In which hand have I palmed the coin? The right or left?
et: Millises käes olen münti palminud? Paremal või vasakul?

label: FortreeCity_House2_Text_CorrectTryAgainWhichHand2
en: Oh! Yes, correct!
et: Oh! Jah, õige!

label: FortreeCity_House2_Text_CorrectTryAgainWhichHand2
en: We shall try again.
et: Me proovime uuesti.

label: FortreeCity_House2_Text_CorrectTryAgainWhichHand2
en: In which hand have I palmed the coin? The right or left?
et: Millises käes olen münti palminud? Paremal või vasakul?

label: FortreeCity_House2_Text_YourHiddenPowerHasAwoken
en: Oh! Splendid! Your hidden power has awoken!
et: Oh! Splendid! Teie varjatud jõud on ärganud!

label: FortreeCity_House2_Text_YourHiddenPowerHasAwoken
en: Here, take this and awaken the hidden power of your POKéMON.
et: Võta see ja ärata oma POKéMON varjatud jõud.

label: FortreeCity_House2_Text_ExplainHiddenPower
en: HIDDEN POWER is a move that changes with the POKéMON.
et: HIDDEN POWER on võte, mis muutub POKéMON abil.

label: FortreeCity_House2_Text_YouGuessedWrong
en: No, too bad. You guessed wrong.
et: Ei, liiga halb. Sa arvasid valesti.

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_StillGettingReady
en: This is the TRAINER HILL where you may enjoy tag battles with many TRAINERS.
et: See on TRAINER HILL kus võite nautida sildilahinguid paljude TRAINERS-ga.

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_StillGettingReady
en: Unfortunately, we're still getting things ready. Please come back later!
et: Paraku saame asjad ikka valmis. Palun tulge hiljem tagasi!

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_WelcomeToTrainerHill
en: Welcome!
et: Tere tulemast!

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_WelcomeToTrainerHill
en: This is the TRAINER HILL where you may enjoy tag battles with many TRAINERS!
et: See on TRAINER HILL kus võite nautida sildilahinguid paljude TRAINERS!

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_SaveGameBeforeEnter
en: Is this your first visit here?
et: Kas see on teie esimene visiit siin?

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_SaveGameBeforeEnter
en: Before you enter, please save your game.
et: Enne sisenemist palun salvestage oma mäng.

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_TrainersUpToFloorX
en: Let's see… The TRAINERS here now are…
et: Vaatame... TRAINERS siin on nüüd...

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_TrainersUpToFloorX
en: Up to floor no. {STR_VAR_1}.
et: Kuni korruseni nr. {STR_VAR_1}.

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_TrainersInEveryRoom
en: Let's see… The TRAINERS here now are…
et: Vaatame... TRAINERS siin on nüüd...

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_TrainersInEveryRoom
en: There appear to be TRAINERS gathered in every room.
et: Tundub, et igas toas on TRAINERS kogunenud.

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_LikeToChallengeTrainers
en: Would you like to challenge the waiting TRAINERS?
et: Soovid vaidlustada ootamist TRAINERS?

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_TimeProgessGetSetGo
en: I will time your progress. Best of luck!
et: Ma ajastan teie edusamme. Parim õnn!

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_TimeProgessGetSetGo
en: On your marks…
et: Oma märkidel...

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_TimeProgessGetSetGo
en: Get set…
et: Saada komplekt...

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_TimeProgessGetSetGo
en: Go!
et: Mine!

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_PleaseVisitUsAgain
en: Please do visit us again!
et: Palun külastage meid veel!

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_TooBadTremendousEffort
en: That was too bad.
et: See oli liiga halb.

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_TooBadTremendousEffort
en: I think you put in a tremendous effort in your battling.
et: Ma arvan, et sa pingutasid oma võitluses tohutult.

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_TooBadTremendousEffort
en: Please come back and try again!
et: Palun tulge tagasi ja proovige uuesti!

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_HopeYouGiveItYourBest
en: I hope you give it your best.
et: Loodan, et annad endast parima.

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_MovedReceptionHereForSwitch
en: When the TRAINERS switch places, the movement can be hectic.
et: Kui TRAINERS lüliti kohad, võib liikumine olla kirev.

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_MovedReceptionHereForSwitch
en: To avoid the stampede, we moved the reception counter here.
et: Tembeldamise vältimiseks viisime vastuvõtuleti siia.

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_MovedReceptionHereForSwitch
en: I'm sorry for the inconvenience.
et: Vabandan ebamugavuste pärast.

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_ThankYouForPlaying
en: Thank you for playing!
et: Aitäh mängimast!

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_ExplainTrainerHill
en: Here at the TRAINER HILL, we conduct an event called the Time Attack.
et: Siin TRAINER HILL läbiviime sündmuse nimega Time Rünnak.

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_ExplainTrainerHill
en: It is a race that measures how long you take to reach our owner on the rooftop from this counter.
et: Tegemist on võidujooksuga, mis mõõdab, kui kaua sa võtad aega, et sellest letist meie omanikuni katusel jõuda.

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_ExplainTrainerHill
en: The fastest times are posted on the Time Board--try competing with your friends.
et: Kõige kiiremad ajad on postitatud Time Boardile--proovi sõpradega võistelda.

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_ExplainTrainerHill
en: In TRAINER battles along the way, neither Exp. Points nor money will be awarded.
et: In TRAINER lahingud teel, kumbki Exp. Punkte ega raha antakse.

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_NeedAtLeastTwoPokemon
en: Oh, I'm sorry, but you appear to have only one POKéMON with you.
et: Oh vabandust, aga tundub, et sul on ainult üks POKéMON kaasas.

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_NeedAtLeastTwoPokemon
en: You will need at least two POKéMON to enter this event.
et: Selle sündmuse sisenemiseks on vaja vähemalt kahte POKéMON.

label: TrainerHill_Roof_Text_YouFinallyCameBravo
en: Hm! Hm!
et: Hm! Hm!

label: TrainerHill_Roof_Text_YouFinallyCameBravo
en: You finally came! Yes, you have arrived!
et: Sa tulid lõpuks! Jah, sa oled kohale jõudnud!

label: TrainerHill_Roof_Text_YouFinallyCameBravo
en: Wait! Don't say it! I know why you came all the way here by yourself!
et: Oota! Ära ütle! Ma tean, miks sa siia üksi tulid!

label: TrainerHill_Roof_Text_YouFinallyCameBravo
en: You wanted to see me, the owner of the TRAINER HILL, because…
et: Sa tahtsid mind näha, TRAINER HILL omanik, sest...

label: TrainerHill_Roof_Text_YouFinallyCameBravo
en: You want to form a tag team with me! Wa-hoo!
et: Sa tahad minuga tag-tiimi moodustada! Wa-hoo!

label: TrainerHill_Roof_Text_YouFinallyCameBravo
en: …Uh? That's not it?
et: ...Uh? See ei ole nii?

label: TrainerHill_Roof_Text_YouFinallyCameBravo
en: Anyway, I watched you on your way up. Marvelous battling! Bravo, indeed!
et: Igatahes jälgisin sind üles minnes. Imeline võitlus! Bravo, tõepoolest!

label: TrainerHill_Roof_Text_HaveTheMostMarvelousGift
en: For a marvelous someone like you, I have the most marvelous gift!
et: Sinusugusele imelisele inimesele on mul kõige imelisem kingitus!

label: TrainerHill_Roof_Text_FullUpBeBackLaterForThis
en: Oh, no, full up with things! You'll be back later for this!
et: Oh ei, täis asju! Tuled hiljem selle eest tagasi!

label: TrainerHill_Roof_Text_GotHereMarvelouslyQuickly
en: Oh, hold on here! Did you possibly get here marvelously quickly?
et: Oh, pea siin vastu! Kas sa jõudsid siia imekiiresti?

label: TrainerHill_Roof_Text_GotHereMarvelouslyQuickly
en: How splendid! You needn't have hurried so to see me!
et: Kui suurepärane! Sa ei pea kiirustama, et mind näha!

label: TrainerHill_Roof_Text_GotHereMarvelouslyQuickly
en: That is so delightful. I'll have the Time Board at the reception updated!
et: See on nii veetlev. Lasen vastuvõtul Ajaametit uuendada!

label: TrainerHill_Roof_Text_YouWerentVeryQuick
en: But, oh… You weren't very quick getting here.
et: Aga oh, sa ei olnud väga kiire siia jõudmisega.

label: TrainerHill_Roof_Text_ArriveZippierNextTime
en: Perhaps it would please me more if you arrived zippier next time.
et: Võib-olla oleks see mulle rohkem meeltmööda, kui sa järgmisel korral zipieri saabuksid.

label: TrainerHill_Roof_Text_ArriveZippierNextTime
en: Then, I should be pleased to form a tag team with you!
et: Siis peaks mul olema hea meel teiega tag-tiimi moodustada!

label: TrainerHill_Roof_Text_ArriveZippierNextTime
en: Until we meet again, amigo!
et: Kuni me jälle kohtume, amigo!

label: TrainerHill_Roof_Text_BuiltTrainerHillToFindPartner
en: I had the TRAINER HILL built for but one reason and one only!
et: Mul oli TRAINER HILL ehitatud aga üks põhjus ja üks ainult!

label: TrainerHill_Roof_Text_BuiltTrainerHillToFindPartner
en: To find the most suitable partner with whom I may form a tag team!
et: Leidmaks sobivaimat partnerit, kellega koos võib-olla moodustan tagitiimi!

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_ChallengeTime
en: {STR_VAR_1} min. {STR_VAR_2}.{STR_VAR_3} sec.
et: {STR_VAR_1} min. {STR_VAR_2}.{STR_VAR_3} sek.

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_WhatSortOfTrainersAreAhead
en: Who knows what sort of TRAINERS and POKéMON combos are ahead?
et: Kes teab, missugused TRAINERS ja POKéMON kombod ees ootavad?

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_WhatSortOfTrainersAreAhead
en: All I know is that I'll knock aside anyone that stands in my way!
et: Tean vaid seda, et löön kõrvale kõik, kes mu teele ette jäävad!

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_CantWaitToTestTheWaters
en: I heard tough TRAINERS come to this TRAINER HILL from all over.
et: Kuulsin, et sitke TRAINERS tuleb selle TRAINER HILL juurde kõikjalt.

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_CantWaitToTestTheWaters
en: I can't wait to test the waters!
et: Ma ei jõua ära oodata vete katsetamist!

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_CantWaitToTestTheWaters
en: I'll knock aside anyone that stands in my way!
et: Koputan kõrvale kõik, kes mu teele ette jäävad!

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_FriendsTryingToReachTimeBoardTop
en: Do you see the Time Board over there?
et: Kas te näete seal ajateenistust?

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_FriendsTryingToReachTimeBoardTop
en: My friends and I are trying to see who can reach the top in the least time.
et: Püüame sõpradega näha, kes kõige vähem ajaga tippu jõuab.

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_DoYouKnowWhenTheyOpen
en: Do you know when they're opening this place up?
et: Kas sa tead, millal nad selle koha avavad?

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_DoYouKnowWhenTheyOpen
en: I'm waiting here to be the first challenger ever!
et: Ootan siin, et olla esimene väljakutsuja üldse!

label: TrainerHill_Elevator_Text_ReturnToReception
en: Would you like to return to the reception counter?
et: Soovite pöörduda tagasi vastuvõtu leti juurde?

label: Route112_CableCarStation_Text_CableCarReadyGetOn
en: The CABLE CAR is ready to go up. Would you like to be on it?
et: CABLE CAR on valmis üles minema. Kas tahaksid selle peal olla?

label: Route112_CableCarStation_Text_StepThisWay
en: Please step this way.
et: Palun astuge siiapoole.

label: Route112_CableCarStation_Text_RideAnotherTime
en: Please ride with us another time.
et: Palun sõida meiega veel üks kord.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_HoldMonsChooseFromSelection
en: First, we will hold your POKéMON for safekeeping.
et: Esiteks hoiame teie POKéMON hoiustamiseks.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_HoldMonsChooseFromSelection
en: You may then choose from our selection of POKéMON.
et: Seejärel võite valida meie valiku POKéMON vahel.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_LetUsRestoreMons
en: Thank you for competing! Let us restore your POKéMON!
et: Aitäh võistlemise eest! Taastagem oma POKéMON!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor2ndOpponent
en: The 2nd match is next! Are you ready?
et: 2. matš on järgmine! Kas oled valmis?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor3rdOpponent
en: The 3rd match is next! Are you ready?
et: 3. matš on järgmine! Kas oled valmis?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor4thOpponent
en: The 4th match is next! Are you ready?
et: 4. matš on järgmine! Kas oled valmis?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor5thOpponent
en: The 5th match is next! Are you ready?
et: 5. matš on järgmine! Kas oled valmis?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor6thOpponent
en: The 6th match is next! Are you ready?
et: 6. matš on järgmine! Kas oled valmis?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor7thOpponent
en: Finally, the 7th match is next! Are you ready?
et: Lõpuks on 7. matš järgmine! Kas oled valmis?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_SaveAndQuitGame
en: Would you like to save and quit the game?
et: Soovid mängu salvestada ja pooleli jätta?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_RetireFromChallenge
en: Would you like to retire from your Battle Swap challenge?
et: Kas tahaksid oma Battle Swap'i väljakutsest pensionile jääda?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_InvestigatedUpcomingOpponent
en: I've conducted a little investigation about your upcoming opponent.
et: Olen viinud läbi väikese uurimise teie eelseisva vastase kohta.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_TrainerSkilledInNormalType
en: The TRAINER is apparently skilled in the handling of the NORMAL type.
et: TRAINER on ilmselt osav Tava tüüpi käsitsemisel.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_TrainerSkilledInFireType
en: The TRAINER is apparently skilled in the handling of the FIRE type.
et: TRAINER on ilmselt osav Tule tüüpi käsitsemisel.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_TrainerSkilledInWaterType
en: The TRAINER is apparently skilled in the handling of the WATER type.
et: TRAINER on ilmselt osav Vee tüüpi käsitsemisel.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_TrainerSkilledInElectricType
en: The TRAINER is apparently skilled in the handling of the ELECTRIC type.
et: TRAINER on ilmselt osav Elektri tüüpi käsitsemisel.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_TrainerSkilledInGrassType
en: The TRAINER is apparently skilled in the handling of the GRASS type.
et: TRAINER on ilmselt osav Rohu tüüpi käsitsemisel.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_TrainerSkilledInIceType
en: The TRAINER is apparently skilled in the handling of the ICE type.
et: TRAINER on ilmselt osav Jää tüüpi käsitsemisel.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_TrainerSkilledInFightingType
en: The TRAINER is apparently skilled in the handling of the FIGHTING type.
et: TRAINER on ilmselt osav Kaklus tüüpi käsitsemisel.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_TrainerSkilledInPoisonType
en: The TRAINER is apparently skilled in the handling of the POISON type.
et: TRAINER on ilmselt osav Mürgi tüüpi käsitsemisel.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_TrainerSkilledInGroundType
en: The TRAINER is apparently skilled in the handling of the GROUND type.
et: TRAINER on ilmselt osav Maa tüüpi käsitsemisel.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_TrainerSkilledInFlyingType
en: The TRAINER is apparently skilled in the handling of the FLYING type.
et: TRAINER on ilmselt osav Lendav tüüpi käsitsemisel.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_TrainerSkilledInPsychicType
en: The TRAINER is apparently skilled in the handling of the PSYCHIC type.
et: TRAINER on ilmselt osav Vaimne tüüpi käsitsemisel.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_TrainerSkilledInBugType
en: The TRAINER is apparently skilled in the handling of the BUG type.
et: TRAINER on ilmselt osav Putuk tüüpi käsitsemisel.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_TrainerSkilledInRockType
en: The TRAINER is apparently skilled in the handling of the ROCK type.
et: TRAINER on ilmselt osav Kivi tüüpi käsitsemisel.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_TrainerSkilledInGhostType
en: The TRAINER is apparently skilled in the handling of the GHOST type.
et: TRAINER on ilmselt osav Kummitus tüüpi käsitsemisel.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_TrainerSkilledInDragonType
en: The TRAINER is apparently skilled in the handling of the DRAGON type.
et: TRAINER on ilmselt osav Draakon tüüpi käsitsemisel.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_TrainerSkilledInDarkType
en: The TRAINER is apparently skilled in the handling of the DARK type.
et: TRAINER on ilmselt osav Pime tüüpi käsitsemisel.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_TrainerSkilledInSteelType
en: The TRAINER is apparently skilled in the handling of the STEEL type.
et: TRAINER on ilmselt osav Teras tüüpi käsitsemisel.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_TrainerHasNoClearFavorite
en: The TRAINER appears to have no clear favorites when it comes to type.
et: TRAINER tundub, et ei ole selgeid lemmikuid, kui tegemist on tüübiga.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_StyleSlowAndSteady
en: The favorite battle style appears to be slow and steady.
et: Lemmik lahingustiil näib olevat aeglane ja püsiv.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_StyleEndurance
en: The favorite battle style appears to be one of endurance.
et: Lemmik lahingustiil näib olevat üks vastupidavusest.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_StyleHighRisk
en: The favorite battle style appears to be high risk, high return.
et: Lemmik lahingustiil näib olevat suur risk, kõrge tootlus.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_StyleDependsOnFlow
en: The favorite battle style appears to depend on the battle's flow.
et: Lemmik lahingustiil näib sõltuvat lahingu voolust.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_StyleTotalPreparation
en: The favorite battle style appears to be one based on total preparation.
et: Lemmik lahingustiil näib olevat üks, mis põhineb totaalsel ettevalmistusel.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_StyleWeakenFoe
en: The favorite battle style appears to be weakening the foe to start.
et: Lemmik lahingustiil näib olevat vaenlast nõrgendamas, et alustada.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_StyleFlexible
en: The favorite battle style appears to be flexibly adaptable to the situation.
et: Lemmik lahingustiil näib olevat olukorraga paindlikult kohandatav.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_StyleImpossibleToPredict
en: The favorite battle style appears to be impossible to predict.
et: Lemmikut lahingustiili paistab olevat võimatu ennustada.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_StyleUnrestrained
en: The favorite battle style appears to be free-spirited and unrestrained.
et: Lemmik lahingustiil näib olevat vabameelne ja ohjeldamatu.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_LikeToSwapMon
en: Before starting the battle, would you like to swap a POKéMON?
et: Enne lahingu alustamist, kas soovite vahetada POKéMON?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_YourSwapIsComplete
en: Thank you! Your POKéMON swap is complete.
et: Aitäh! Teie POKéMON swap on täielik.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_RightThisWay
en: Right this way, please!
et: Just nii, palun!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_SavingDataPleaseWait
en: I am saving your data. Please wait.
et: Ma salvestan teie andmeid. Palun oodake.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_RecordLatestBattle
en: Would you like to record your latest battle on your FRONTIER PASS?
et: Kas soovite salvestada oma viimase lahingu oma FRONTIER PASS?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_WaitFewMoments
en: Excuse me! Excuse me, please! May I get you to wait a few moments?
et: Vabandage mind! Vabandust, palun! Kas ma võin sind mõne hetke ootama panna?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_UnderstoodSirWillDo
en: …Uh-huh? What?! …Whoa! Understood, sir! Will do!
et: ...uh-huh? Mida?! ...Whoa! Arusaadav, härra! Saab hakkama!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_MessageFromHeadComeRightNow
en: Oh, my… Sorry to keep you waiting!
et: Vabandust, et sind ootel hoida!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_MessageFromHeadComeRightNow
en: I have a message from this facility's boss, the FACTORY HEAD.
et: Mul on sõnum selle asutuse bossilt, FACTORY HEAD.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_MessageFromHeadComeRightNow
en: He says, “We're going to do it! Come here right now!”
et: Ta ütleb: "Me kavatseme seda teha! Tule kohe siia!"

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_PreparedToFaceHead
en: The FACTORY HEAD is demanding you. Are you prepared to face him?
et: FACTORY HEAD on sulle nõudlik. Kas oled valmis temaga silmitsi seisma?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_CantTellAnythingAboutHead
en: I'm terribly sorry, but I can't tell you anything about the FACTORY HEAD.
et: Mul on kohutavalt kahju, aga ma ei oska sulle midagi öelda FACTORY HEAD kohta.

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_ScottBattleFrontierInvite
en: SCOTT: Well, hi, hi! {PLAYER}{KUN}, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
et: SCOTT: Noh, tere, tere! {PLAYER} {KUN}, {PLAYER}{KUN}!

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_ScottBattleFrontierInvite
en: Something's come up, so I have to disembark, but am I glad to see you!
et: Midagi on ette tulnud, nii et ma pean minema, aga kas ma olen rõõmus, et teid näen!

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_ScottBattleFrontierInvite
en: Congratulations, LEAGUE CHAMPION!
et: Palju õnne, LIIGA TŠEMPION!

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_ScottBattleFrontierInvite
en: There's a place I'd like to invite someone like you.
et: On koht, kuhu tahaks sinusuguse kutsuda.

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_ScottBattleFrontierInvite
en: It's the… BATTLE FRONTIER!
et: See on... BATTLE FRONTIER!

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_ScottBattleFrontierInvite
en: What's the place like? You'll understand when you see it!
et: Milline on koht? Saad aru, kui seda näed!

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_ScottBattleFrontierInvite
en: I've spoken with the ship's CAPTAIN about this.
et: Olen sellest rääkinud laeva CAPTAIN-ga.

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_ScottBattleFrontierInvite
en: The next time you take a ferry, you should be able to sail to the BATTLE FRONTIER.
et: Järgmine kord, kui sõidate praamiga, peaksite saama sõita BATTLE FRONTIER.

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_ScottBattleFrontierInvite
en: Okay, {PLAYER}{KUN}, I'll be waiting for you at the BATTLE FRONTIER!
et: Okei, {PLAYER}{KUN}, ma ootan sind BATTLE FRONTIER!

label: SSTidal_Text_FastCurrentsHopeYouEnjoyVoyage
en: This ferry is built to plow through fast-running currents.
et: See praam on ehitatud selleks, et künda läbi kiiresti kulgevate hoovuste.

label: SSTidal_Text_FastCurrentsHopeYouEnjoyVoyage
en: We hope you enjoy your voyage with us. Feel free to explore the ship.
et: Loodame, et naudite koos meiega oma reisi. Uurige julgelt laeva.

label: SSTidal_Text_HopeYouEnjoyVoyage
en: We hope you enjoy your voyage on our ferry.
et: Loodame, et naudite oma reisi meie praamil.

label: SSTidal_Text_MadeLandInSlateport
en: We have made land in SLATEPORT CITY. Thank you for sailing with us.
et: Oleme teinud maa sisse SLATEPORT CITY. Aitäh, et meiega purjetasid.

label: SSTidal_Text_MadeLandInLilycove
en: We have made land in LILYCOVE CITY. Thank you for sailing with us.
et: Oleme teinud maa sisse LILYCOVE CITY. Aitäh, et meiega purjetasid.

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_CanRestInCabin2
en: It'll be some time before we make land, I reckon.
et: Läheb veel aega, enne kui me maa teeme, arvestan.

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_CanRestInCabin2
en: You can rest up in your cabin if you'd like. Your cabin's No. 2.
et: Sa võid oma kajutis puhata, kui soovid. Sinu majake on nr. 2.

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_CanRestInCabin2
en: The bed in there is soft and plushy. I can attest to how comfy it is!
et: Voodi seal on pehme ja plushiline. Võin kinnitada, kui mugav see on!

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_WeveArrived
en: We've arrived!
et: Jõudsime kohale!

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_VisitOtherCabins
en: Go visit other cabins. TRAINERS bored of the boat trip will be itching to battle.
et: Mine külasta teisi kajuteid. TRAINERS igav paadireis sügeleb lahingusse.

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_EnjoyYourCruise
en: Enjoy your cruise!
et: Nautige oma kruiisi!

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_HorizonSpreadsBeyondPorthole
en: The horizon spreads beyond the porthole.
et: Horisont levib üle portrooli.

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_BrineyWelcomeAboard
en: MR. BRINEY: Welcome aboard, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
et: MR. BRINEY: Tere tulemast pardale, {PLAYER}{KUN}!

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_BrineyWelcomeAboard
en: They made me honorary captain of the S.S. TIDAL!
et: Nad tegid minust S.S. aukapteni TIDAL!

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_BrineyWelcomeAboard
en: You can call me CAPTAIN BRINEY now!
et: Võite mulle nüüd helistada CAPTAIN BRINEY!

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_BrineyWelcomeAboard
en: You know, I retired once before, but when I saw this majestic ship…
et: Tead, ma läksin kunagi varem pensionile, aga kui ma nägin seda majesteetlikku laeva...

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_BrineyWelcomeAboard
en: Let me just say, it stirred my sleeping soul as a sailor!
et: Lubage mul lihtsalt öelda, et see ajas mu magava hinge meremehena segamini!

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_Peeko
en: PEEKO: Pihyo pihyohyo…
et: PEEKO: Pihyo pihyohyo...

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_Cabin1
en: Cabin 1
et: Kabiin 1

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_Cabin2
en: Cabin 2
et: Kabiin 2

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_Cabin3
en: Cabin 3
et: Kabiin 3

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_Cabin4
en: Cabin 4
et: Kabiin 4

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_MonsReluctantToUseDislikedMoves
en: If it doesn't like a certain move, a POKéMON will be reluctant to use it.
et: Kui see ei meeldi teatud võttele, on POKéMON selle kasutamine vastumeelne.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_MonsReluctantToUseDislikedMoves
en: It doesn't matter how strong it is, either.
et: Pole ka vahet, kui tugev see on.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_MonsReluctantToUseDislikedMoves
en: For example, a POKéMON with a GENTLE nature probably won't enjoy hurting its opponents.
et: Näiteks POKéMON koos GENTLE loodusega ilmselt ei naudi oma vastastele haiget tegemist.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_MonsReluctantToUseDislikedMoves
en: If it can't seem to live up to its potential, it's probably failing at using a disliked move against its will.
et: Kui see ei paista oma potentsiaali järgi elavat, siis tõenäoliselt ebaõnnestub see vastu tahtmist mittemeeldiva võtte kasutamisel.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_GentleMonsScaryIfAngry
en: My big sister is gentle usually. But when she gets angry, she's really, really scary!
et: Minu suur õde on õrn tavaliselt. Aga kui ta vihastab, siis on ta tõesti-väga hirmus!

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_GentleMonsScaryIfAngry
en: I bet a gentle POKéMON will be scary if it gets angry!
et: Vean kihla, et õrn POKéMON on hirmus, kui see vihastab!

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_AttractionRunsDeep
en: My feelings toward my POKéMON… The attraction runs deep…
et: Minu tunded minu POKéMON... külgetõmme jookseb sügavale...

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_AttractionRunsDeep
en: Oh, hi, you didn't see that, did you? Well, it doesn't matter.
et: Oh, tere, sa ju ei näinud seda? No vahet pole.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_AttractionRunsDeep
en: How would you like this TM for your POKéMON?
et: Kuidas teile meeldiks see TM oma POKéMON?

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_AttractionMutual
en: My feelings toward my POKéMON… I'm sure the attraction is mutual!
et: Minu tunded minu POKéMON suhtes... olen kindel, et külgetõmme on vastastikune!

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_AttractionMutual
en: They battle exactly the way I want them to!
et: Nad võitlevad täpselt nii, nagu mina tahan!

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_TaughtWhatKindsOfMoves
en: What kind of moves have you taught your POKéMON?
et: Milliseid käike olete õpetanud oma POKéMON?

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_TaughtWhatKindsOfMoves
en: I think you would give yourself an advantage if they knew how to heal or protect themselves.
et: Ma arvan, et sa annaksid endale eelise, kui nad oskaksid ennast tervendada või kaitsta.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ScottCanMeetToughTrainers
en: SCOTT: Hey there, {PLAYER}{KUN}! I thought I might see you here.
et: SCOTT: Hei sinna, {PLAYER}{KUN}! Mõtlesin, et võib-olla näen sind siin.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ScottCanMeetToughTrainers
en: A BATTLE TENT's a place where you can meet tough TRAINERS.
et: A BATTLE TENT on koht, kus saab kohtuda kõva TRAINERS.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ScottCanMeetToughTrainers
en: It doesn't matter what the rules are, or how battles are waged, either.
et: Vahet pole, millised on reeglid või kuidas peetakse lahinguid ka.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ScottCanMeetToughTrainers
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}, I expect you to do the best you can!
et: {PLAYER} {KUN}, eeldan, et annad endast parima!

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ScottVisitRegularly
en: SCOTT: I visit here regularly in hopes of seeing tough TRAINERS in action in whatever the situation.
et: SCOTT: Külastan siin regulaarselt, lootuses näha karmi TRAINERS tegevust mis iganes olukorras.

label: SSTidalLowerDeck_Text_PhillipIntro
en: Arrrgh! I'm fed up and dog-tired of cleaning this huge place!
et: Arrgh! Olen tüdinud ja koeraväsinud koristamast seda tohutut kohta!

label: SSTidalLowerDeck_Text_PhillipIntro
en: Let's have a quick battle!
et: Teeme kiire lahingu!

label: SSTidalLowerDeck_Text_PhillipDefeat
en: Little bro, I lost!
et: Väike bro, ma kaotasin!

label: SSTidalLowerDeck_Text_PhillipPostBattle
en: We're the CLEANUP BROTHERS!
et: Meie oleme CLEANUP BROTHERS!

label: SSTidalLowerDeck_Text_PhillipPostBattle
en: The old one dumps the detergent, and the young one does the scrubbing!
et: Vana viskab pesuvahendi maha ja noor teeb nühkimist!

label: SSTidalLowerDeck_Text_LeonardIntro
en: This is the bottom of the ship's hull. There's plenty of room. It'll be alright for a POKéMON battle.
et: See on laeva kere põhi. Ruumi on piisavalt. Kõik on korras POKéMON lahingu jaoks.

label: SSTidalLowerDeck_Text_LeonardDefeat
en: Big bro, I lost!
et: Suur bro, ma kaotasin!

label: SSTidalLowerDeck_Text_LeonardPostBattle
en: We're the CLEANUP BROTHERS!
et: Meie oleme CLEANUP BROTHERS!

label: SSTidalLowerDeck_Text_LeonardPostBattle
en: The old one dumps the detergent, and the young one does the scrubbing!
et: Vana viskab pesuvahendi maha ja noor teeb nühkimist!

label: VerdanturfTown_ContestHall_Text_WhichContestYouEntering
en: Which CONTEST are you entering? Want a piece of advice?
et: Millisesse CONTEST sa sisened? Tahad nõu?

label: VerdanturfTown_ContestHall_Text_WhichContestYouEntering
en: In any CONTEST, for example, a CUTE CONTEST, I don't think they judge you only on cuteness in the first round.
et: Mingis CONTEST-s näiteks CUTE CONTEST ei hinda nad vist sind ainult esimeses voorus armsuse üle.

label: VerdanturfTown_ContestHall_Text_WhichContestYouEntering
en: You need to work out ways for raising POKéMON better.
et: Sa pead välja töötama viise, kuidas tõsta POKéMON parem.

label: VerdanturfTown_ContestHall_Text_RaisedMonToBeCute
en: I raised my POKéMON to be cute.
et: Tõstsin oma POKéMON armsaks.

label: VerdanturfTown_ContestHall_Text_RaisedMonToBeCute
en: I found out you can put POKéMON in a CONTEST for cuteness!
et: Sain teada, et võid panna POKéMON CONTEST armsuse eest!

label: VerdanturfTown_ContestHall_Text_RaisedMonToBeCute
en: I'm so glad I raised my POKéMON with loving care…
et: Mul on nii hea meel, et tõstsin oma POKéMON armastava hoolega...

label: VerdanturfTown_ContestHall_Text_MyMonRules
en: My POKéMON rules!
et: Minu POKéMON reeglid!

label: VerdanturfTown_ContestHall_Text_MyMonRules
en: It's cool, tough yet beautiful, cute, and smart. It's complete!
et: See on lahe, karm, samas ilus, armas ja tark. See on täielik!

label: VerdanturfTown_ContestHall_Text_MyMonRules
en: I may as well go for wins in every single CONTEST.
et: Samahästi võin minna võitudele igas CONTEST.

label: VerdanturfTown_ContestHall_Text_NormalRankStage
en: POKéMON CONTESTS NORMAL RANK STAGE!
et: POKéMON CONTESTS NORMAL RANK STAGE!

label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_SeashoreHouseIntro
en: I'm the owner of the SEASHORE HOUSE. But you can call me MR. SEA!
et: Olen SEASHORE HOUSE omanik. Aga sa võid mulle helistada MR. SEA!

label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_SeashoreHouseIntro
en: What I love above all is to see hot POKéMON battles.
et: Mida ma eelkõige armastan, on näha kuumi POKéMON lahinguid.

label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_SeashoreHouseIntro
en: Let me see that your heart burns hot!
et: Las ma näen, et su süda põleb kuumalt!

label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_SeashoreHouseIntro
en: If you can defeat all the TRAINERS here, I'll reward your efforts.
et: Kui suudad siin kõik TRAINERS alistada, siis premeerin sinu pingutusi.

label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_ShowMeSomeHotMatches
en: Show me some hot matches!
et: Näita mulle kuumi vasteid!

label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_ShowMeSomeHotMatches
en: I run this SEASHORE HOUSE just for that reason alone!
et: Ma käivitan selle SEASHORE HOUSE lihtsalt sel põhjusel üksi!

label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_TakeTheseSodaPopBottles
en: You're scorching hot! Those battles blazed! I'm more than just satisfied!
et: Sa kõrvetad kuumalt! Need lahingud lõõmasid! Olen rohkem kui lihtsalt rahul!

label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_TakeTheseSodaPopBottles
en: As thanks for showing me your hot streak, I want you to take these.
et: Tänutäheks selle eest, et te mulle oma kuuma triipu näitate, tahan ma, et te need võtaksite.

label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_TakeTheseSodaPopBottles
en: It's half a dozen bottles of SODA POP!
et: See on pool tosinat pudelit SODA POP!

label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_BagFull
en: Oh, but hey, your BAG's jammed full. I'll hang on to these for you.
et: Oh, aga kuule, su BAG on täis kiilunud. Ma jään sinu jaoks nende juurde.

label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_WantToBuySodaPop
en: Want to buy some SODA POP? POKéMON love it!
et: Tahad osta mõnda SODA POP? POKéMON armastan seda!

label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_WantToBuySodaPop
en: Just ¥300 a bottle! Buy some!
et: Lihtsalt $300 pudel! Osta mõned!

label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_HereYouGo
en: Here you go!
et: See on sulle!

label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_NotEnoughMoney
en: You don't have the money.
et: Sul pole raha.

label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_ThatsTooBad
en: No? That's too bad.
et: Ei? See on liiga halb.

label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_DwayneIntro
en: If you're looking for a battle in the SEASHORE HOUSE, you'll find no hotter TRAINER than me, matey!
et: Kui otsid lahingut SEASHORE HOUSE, siis ei leia sa kuumemat TRAINER kui mina, matey!

label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_DwayneDefeated
en: That was a hot battle! I can accept that loss, matey!
et: See oli kuum lahing! Võin selle kaotusega leppida, matey!

label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_DwaynePostBattle
en: Whenever I'm in SLATEPORT, I enjoy hot battles and ice-cold SODA POP!
et: Alati, kui olen SLATEPORT, naudin kuumi lahinguid ja jääkülma SODA POP!

label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_JohannaIntro
en: Boring battles aren't worth the effort.
et: Igavad lahingud pole vaeva väärt.

label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_JohannaIntro
en: Fiery hot battles are what toughen up TRAINERS and POKéMON!
et: Tulised kuumad lahingud on need, mis karmistavad TRAINERS ja POKéMON!

label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_JohannaDefeated
en: That's hot!
et: See on kuum!

label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_JohannaPostBattle
en: Whew, I'm all thirsty. Maybe I'll have a SODA POP.
et: Whew, mul on kõik janu. Ehk siis mul on SODA POP.

label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_SimonIntro
en: I'm going to show you how great my POKéMON are, but don't cry!
et: Näitan, kui vahvad mu POKéMON on, aga ära nuta!

label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_SimonDefeated
en: …I lost, but I won't cry…
et: ...ma kaotasin, aga ma ei nuta...

label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_SimonPostBattle
en: If one of my POKéMON knew the move for carrying me across water on its back, I could get rid of this inner tube.
et: Kui üks mu POKéMON teaks seda võtet, et ta kannab mind üle vee selili, saaksin ma sellest sisemisest torust lahti.

label: RustboroCity_Flat2_2F_Text_DevonWasTinyInOldDays
en: Way back in the old days, DEVON was just a teeny, tiny company.
et: Tagasitee vanasti, DEVON oli lihtsalt teismeline pisike seltskond.

label: RustboroCity_Flat2_2F_Text_MyDaddyMadeThisYouCanHaveIt
en: My daddy's working at the CORPORATION.
et: Minu issi töötab CORPORATION.

label: RustboroCity_Flat2_2F_Text_MyDaddyMadeThisYouCanHaveIt
en: My daddy made this! But I can't use it, so you can have it.
et: Mu isa tegi seda! Aga ma ei saa seda kasutada, nii et sa võid seda endale saada.

label: RustboroCity_Flat2_2F_Text_GoingToWorkAtDevonToo
en: My daddy's working at the CORPORATION.
et: Minu issi töötab CORPORATION.

label: RustboroCity_Flat2_2F_Text_GoingToWorkAtDevonToo
en: When I grow up, I'm going to work for DEVON, too.
et: Kui suureks saan, siis hakkan tööle DEVON ka.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: Hey, how's it going, CHAMPIONbound {PLAYER}?
et: Hei, kuidas läheb, TŠEMPIONbound {PLAYER}?

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: LAVARIDGE's GYM LEADER FLANNERY uses FIRE-type POKéMON.
et: LAVARIDGE on SAALI JUHT FLANNERY kasutab Tule-tüüpi POKéMON.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: Her passion for POKéMON burns stronger and hotter than a volcano.
et: Tema kirg POKéMON põleb tugevam ja kuumem kui vulkaan.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: Don't get too close to her--you'll burn! Hose her down with water and then go for it!
et: Ära lähe talle liiga lähedale - sa põled! Voola ta veega alla ja mine siis järele!

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_GymGuidePostVictory
en: Yow! That was a scorching-hot battle!
et: Yow! See oli kõrvetav-kuum lahing!

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_ColeIntro
en: Owowowowow! Yikes, it's hot!
et: Owowowowowowow! Yikes, palav on!

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_ColeDefeat
en: I'm blinded by sweat in my eyes…
et: Mind pimestab higi silmis...

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_ColePostBattle
en: Being buried in hot sand promotes circulation.
et: Kuuma liiva sisse mattumine soodustab ringlust.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_ColePostBattle
en: It's effective for healing pain in your joints.
et: See on tõhus valu tervendamiseks liigestes.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_AxleIntro
en: I'm trying to relieve my stress. Don't come along and stress me out!
et: Püüan oma stressi maandada. Ära tule kaasa ja rõhuta mind välja!

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_AxleDefeat
en: I hope FLANNERY flames you good!
et: Loodan, et FLANNERY leegib sind hästi!

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_AxlePostBattle
en: Haaah… Whew…
et: Haah... Whew...

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_AxlePostBattle
en: If you spend too much time buried in hot sand, it tuckers you out…
et: Kui sa veedad liiga palju aega kuuma liiva sisse mattununa, siis see sikutab sind välja...

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_KeeganIntro
en: You must be getting tired by now. You'd like to rest in the hot sand, wouldn't you?
et: Nüüdseks oled vist väsinud. Soovid ju kuumas liivas puhata?

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_KeeganIntro
en: But you should know that maintaining your willpower is an important ability for all TRAINERS.
et: Aga sa peaksid teadma, et oma tahtejõu säilitamine on oluline võime kõigile TRAINERS.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_KeeganDefeat
en: Play with fire, and be burned…
et: Mängi tulega ja ole põlenud...

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_KeeganPostBattle
en: Your skill is real… But our LEADER FLANNERY is strong.
et: Sinu oskus on tõeline, aga meie LEADER FLANNERY on tugev.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_KeeganPostBattle
en: If you don't watch yourself, you'll be burned seriously.
et: Kui sa ise ei vaata, siis sind põletatakse tõsiselt.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_GeraldIntro
en: Can your POKéMON withstand 392-degree heat?
et: Kas teie POKéMON suudab vastu pidada 392-kraadisele kuumusele?

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_GeraldDefeat
en: It didn't burn hotly enough…
et: See ei põlenud piisavalt palavalt...

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_GeraldPostBattle
en: The temperature of magma is 392 degrees.
et: Magma temperatuur on 392 kraadi.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_GeraldPostBattle
en: Your POKéMON beat me, so they should easily survive in magma.
et: Sinu POKéMON peksid mind, seega peaksid nad magmas kergesti ellu jääma.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_DanielleIntro
en: Um… Okay, I'll battle with you.
et: Olgu, ma võitlen sinuga.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_DanielleDefeat
en: Oh, but you're too strong.
et: Oh, aga sa oled liiga tugev.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_DaniellePostBattle
en: I'm going to be a pretty and strong TRAINER just like FLANNERY.
et: Minust saab ilus ja tugev TRAINER täpselt nagu FLANNERY.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_JaceIntro
en: Come on, get with it! Let's go before my feelings cool!
et: Ole nüüd, võta kaasa! Lähme enne, kui mu tunded lahenevad!

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_JaceDefeat
en: It's so hot, and yet my heart is clutched by ice…
et: Nii palav on ja ometi on mu süda jääst kinni...

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_JacePostBattle
en: The way the battling spirit burns within you, you may stand a chance against our LEADER.
et: See, kuidas võitlusvaim sinu sees põleb, võib sul olla võimalus meie LEADER vastu.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_JeffIntro
en: See how the flames blaze wildly? They flare in anticipation of my win!
et: Näed, kuidas leegid metsikult leegitsevad? Nad ägestuvad minu võidu ootuses!

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_JeffDefeat
en: Something didn't go right.
et: Midagi ei läinud õieti.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_JeffPostBattle
en: Well, so what? I say so what? I can walk on hot coals barefoot!
et: No mis siis? Ma ütlen nii mis? Ma võin käia paljajalu kuumadel sütel!

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_JeffPostBattle
en: …Don't even think about trying it!
et: ...ära mõtlegi proovida!

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_EliIntro
en: As much as I love mountains, I especially love volcanoes.
et: Nii palju kui ma mägesid armastan, armastan ma eriti vulkaane.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_EliDefeat
en: Well, it seems to me I lost without ever being in control.
et: Mulle tundub, et ma kaotasin, ilma et oleksin kunagi kontrolli all olnud.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_EliPostBattle
en: I stay here because I became a fan of FLANNERY's power.
et: Jään siia, sest minust sai FLANNERY võimu fänn.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_EliPostBattle
en: Hehehehe.
et: Hehehehe.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryIntro
en: Welcome… No, wait.
et: Tere tulemast... ei, oodake.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryIntro
en: Puny TRAINER, how good to see you've made it here!
et: Puny TRAINER, kui hea on näha, et oled siia jõudnud!

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryIntro
en: I have been entrusted with the… No, wait.
et: Mulle on usaldatud... Ei, oota.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryIntro
en: I am FLANNERY, and I'm the GYM LEADER here!
et: Olen FLANNERY ja olen SAALI JUHT siin!

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryIntro
en: Uh… Dare not underestimate me, though I have been LEADER only a short time!
et: Ehh... ärge alahinnake mind, kuigi olen olnud LEADER ainult lühikest aega!

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryIntro
en: With skills inherited from my grandfather, I shall, uh…demonstrate the hot moves we have honed on this land!
et: Oma vanaisalt päritud oskustega demonstreerin ma kuumi käike, mida me siin maal oleme lihvinud!

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryDefeat
en: Oh… I guess I was trying too hard…
et: Ma vist püüdsin liiga palju...

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryDefeat
en: I… I've only recently become a GYM LEADER.
et: Minust on alles hiljuti saanud SAALI JUHT.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryDefeat
en: I tried too hard to be someone I'm not.
et: Ma püüdsin liiga palju olla keegi, kes ma ei ole.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryDefeat
en: I have to do things my natural way. If I don't, my POKéMON will be confused.
et: Ma pean tegema asju oma loomulikul viisil. Kui ma seda ei tee, siis läheb mu POKéMON segamini.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryDefeat
en: Thanks for teaching me that. For that, you deserve this.
et: Tänud, et mulle seda õpetasid. Selle eest oled sa selle ära teeninud.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_ReceivedHeatBadge
en: {PLAYER} received the HEAT BADGE from FLANNERY.
et: {PLAYER} sai HEAT MÄRK alates FLANNERY.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_ExplainHeatBadgeTakeThis
en: If you have a HEAT BADGE, all POKéMON up to Level 50, even those you get in trades from other people, will obey you completely.
et: Kui teil on HEAT MÄRK, kõik POKéMON kuni tase 50, isegi need, mida saate kauplemisel teistelt inimestelt, kuuletuvad teile täielikult.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_ExplainHeatBadgeTakeThis
en: And, it lets POKéMON use the HM move STRENGTH outside of battle.
et: Ja, see laseb POKéMON kasutada HM liikuda STRENGTH väljaspool lahingut.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_ExplainHeatBadgeTakeThis
en: This is a token of my appreciation. Don't be shy about taking it!
et: See on minu tunnustuse märk. Ära häbene seda võtta!

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_ExplainOverheat
en: That TM50 contains OVERHEAT.
et: Et TM50 sisaldab OVERHEAT.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_ExplainOverheat
en: That move inflicts serious damage on the opponent.
et: See võte tekitab vastasele tõsiseid kahjustusi.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_ExplainOverheat
en: But it also sharply cuts the SP. ATK of the POKéMON using it. It might not be suitable for longer battles.
et: Aga see lõikab järsult ka SP. ATK POKéMON kasutades seda. See ei pruugi sobida pikemateks lahinguteks.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_RegisteredFlannery
en: Registered GYM LEADER FLANNERY in the POKéNAV.
et: Registreerunud SAALI JUHT FLANNERY POKéNAV.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryPostBattle
en: Your power reminds me of someone…
et: Sinu vägi meenutab mulle kedagi...

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryPostBattle
en: Oh! I know! You battle like NORMAN, the GYM LEADER of PETALBURG.
et: Oh! Ma tean! Sa võitled nagu NORMAN, SAALI JUHT PETALBURG.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_GymStatue
en: LAVARIDGE TOWN POKéMON GYM
et: LAVARIDGE TOWN POKéMON SAAL

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_GymStatueCertified
en: LAVARIDGE TOWN POKéMON GYM
et: LAVARIDGE TOWN POKéMON SAAL

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_GymStatueCertified
en: FLANNERY'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS: {PLAYER}
et: FLANNERY'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS: {PLAYER}

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryPreRematch
en: FLANNERY: Losing a battle isn't going to deflate me.
et: FLANNERY: Lahingu kaotamine ei deflateeri mind.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryPreRematch
en: I love POKéMON. I love to battle. And… I love this GYM!
et: Mulle meeldib POKéMON. Armastan võidelda. Ja... ma armastan seda SAAL!

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryPreRematch
en: Let's exchange superhot moves in another battle!
et: Vahetame superhot võtteid järjekordses lahingus!

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryRematchDefeat
en: Whew! On the verge of eruption!
et: Whew! Purske äärel!

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryPostRematch
en: FLANNERY: I lost the match, but I'm completely satisfied.
et: FLANNERY: Ma kaotasin matši, aga olen täiesti rahul.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryPostRematch
en: It's not often I get to enjoy a battle this heated.
et: Mitte tihti ei saa ma nautida nii soojendatud lahingut.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryPostRematch
en: Let's have another one like this again sometime!
et: Teeme veel ühe sellise millalgi uuesti!

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryRematchNeedTwoMons
en: FLANNERY: Losing a battle isn't going to deflate me.
et: FLANNERY: Lahingu kaotamine ei deflateeri mind.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryRematchNeedTwoMons
en: I love POKéMON. I love to battle. And… I love this GYM!
et: Mulle meeldib POKéMON. Armastan võidelda. Ja... ma armastan seda SAAL!

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryRematchNeedTwoMons
en: Let's exchange superhot moves in another battle!
et: Vahetame superhot võtteid järjekordses lahingus!

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryRematchNeedTwoMons
en: Oh, wait. Do you only have one POKéMON that can battle?
et: Oo, oota. Kas teil on ainult üks POKéMON mis saab võidelda?

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryRematchNeedTwoMons
en: I hate to say this, but when you come see me, bring at least two POKéMON.
et: Ma ei tahaks seda öelda, aga kui sa tuled mind vaatama, siis too vähemalt kaks POKéMON.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_WillRestoreToFullHealth
en: Welcome… You must be commended for your luck…
et: Tere tulemast... Sind tuleb kiita õnne eest...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_WillRestoreToFullHealth
en: Your POKéMON shall be restored to full health…
et: Teie POKéMON taastatakse täieliku tervise...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_EnjoyRestOfChallenge
en: I urge you to enjoy the rest of your Battle Choice challenge…
et: Kutsun teid üles nautima ülejäänud oma Battle Choice'i väljakutset...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_WillRestoreOneMon
en: Ah, you're a lucky one. I'm in somewhat-good spirits now.
et: Ah, sa oled õnnelik. Olen nüüd mõneti heas tujus.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_WillRestoreOneMon
en: I will restore one of your POKéMON to full health.
et: Ma taastan ühe sinu POKéMON täie tervise juurde.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_BestOfLuckFarewell
en: The best of luck to you. Farewell.
et: Parim õnn sulle. Hüvasti.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_CareForBattleWillRestoreMons
en: Excuse me…
et: Vabandage mind...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_CareForBattleWillRestoreMons
en: Would you care for a battle? I'll restore your POKéMON if you win.
et: Kas sa hooliksid lahingust? Ma taastan sinu POKéMON kui võidad.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_NowShallWe
en: Very well… Now, shall we?
et: Väga hästi... nüüd, eks?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_HowUnsportingOfYou
en: I see… How unsporting of you…
et: Ma näen, kui ebasportlik sa oled...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_WillRestoreMonsAsPromised
en: Magnificent…
et: Suurepärane...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_WillRestoreMonsAsPromised
en: As promised, I shall restore your POKéMON to full health.
et: Nagu lubatud, taastan teie POKéMON täieliku tervise.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_BestOfLuckFarewell2
en: The best of luck to you. Farewell.
et: Parim õnn sulle. Hüvasti.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_WatchOut
en: Oh, my!
et: Oh, minu!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_WatchOut
en: Watch out!
et: Ettevaatust!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_KirliaStop
en: Now, now! KIRLIA, stop that!
et: Nüüd, kohe! KIRLIA, lõpetage see!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_DusclopsStop
en: Now, now! DUSCLOPS, stop that!
et: Nüüd, kohe! DUSCLOPS, lõpetage see!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_KirliaUsedToxic
en: KIRLIA used TOXIC!
et: KIRLIA kasutatud TOXIC!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_KirliaUsedHypnosis
en: KIRLIA used HYPNOSIS!
et: KIRLIA kasutatud HYPNOSIS!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_KirliaUsedThunderWave
en: KIRLIA used THUNDER WAVE!
et: KIRLIA kasutatud THUNDER WAVE!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_KirliaUsedWillOWisp
en: KIRLIA used WILL-O-WISP!
et: KIRLIA kasutatud WILL-O-WISP!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_DusclopsUsedWillOWisp
en: DUSCLOPS used WILL-O-WISP!
et: DUSCLOPS kasutatud WILL-O-WISP!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_DusclopsUsedIceBeam
en: DUSCLOPS used ICE BEAM!
et: DUSCLOPS kasutatud ICE BEAM!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_ThatsEnough
en: Look here! That's quite enough!
et: Vaata siia! Sellest täiesti piisab!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_ApologizeForKirlia
en: I must apologize to you…
et: Ma pean sinu ees vabandama...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_ApologizeForKirlia
en: My KIRLIA has a TIMID nature…
et: Minu KIRLIA on TIMID loodus...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_ApologizeForDusclops
en: I must apologize to you…
et: Ma pean sinu ees vabandama...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_ApologizeForDusclops
en: My DUSCLOPS has a TIMID nature…
et: Minu DUSCLOPS on TIMID loodus...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_AttacksWhenStartled
en: It attacks without warning if it is startled by another person…
et: See ründab hoiatamata, kui see on teise inimese poolt ehmunud...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_AttacksWhenStartled
en: Are you and your POKéMON all right?
et: Kas teil ja teie POKéMON on kõik korras?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_ApologizeHopeMonsAreFine
en: I do apologize for what happened… I do hope your POKéMON are fine.
et: Ma vabandan juhtunu pärast... ma loodan, et su POKéMON on korras.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_BattleSomewhatToughTrainer
en: Welcome…
et: Tere tulemast...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_BattleSomewhatToughTrainer
en: Here, we will have you battle a somewhat-tough TRAINER…
et: Siin, me laseme teil võidelda mõnevõrra raske TRAINER...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_RestoreToFullHealth
en: How wonderful…
et: Kui imeline...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_RestoreToFullHealth
en: To honor your victory, your POKéMON shall be restored to full health…
et: Oma võidu auks taastatakse sinu POKéMON täie tervise juures...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_EnjoyRestOfChallenge2
en: I urge you to enjoy the rest of your Battle Choice challenge…
et: Kutsun teid üles nautima ülejäänud oma Battle Choice'i väljakutset...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_ImThePikeQueen
en: I am LUCY… I am the law here… For I am the PIKE QUEEN…
et: Ma olen LUCY... Ma olen siin seadus... Sest ma olen PIKE QUEEN...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_ImThePikeQueen
en: You already know it, but to advance, you must defeat me…
et: Sa juba tead seda, aga edasiliikumiseks pead sa minust jagu saama...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_ImThePikeQueen
en: …I'm not one for idle chatter. Hurry. Come on…
et: ...ma ei ole üks tühikäigujutu jaoks. Kiirusta. Tule nüüd...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_HopeYouDidntUseUpLuck
en: Your luck… I hope you didn't use it all up here…
et: Sinu õnn... loodan, et sa ei kasutanud seda kõike siin üleval...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_LucyShowMeFrontierPass
en: LUCY: … … … … … … Show me your FRONTIER PASS…
et: LUCY: ... ... ... ... ... Näita mulle oma FRONTIER PASS...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_ReceivedLuckSymbol
en: The Luck Symbol was embossed on the FRONTIER PASS!
et: Õnnesümbol oli reljeefne FRONTIER PASS!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_AllThereIsDisappear
en: …That's all there is… Disappear already…
et: See on kõik, mis seal on... Kaduda juba...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_LucyYouAgain
en: LUCY: …You again…
et: LUCY: ...Sa jälle...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_LucyYouAgain
en: …I've trampled flowers and braved storms to get to where I am…
et: ...olen tallanud lilli ja julgeid torme, et jõuda sinna, kus ma olen...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_LucyYouAgain
en: I don't feel any compulsion to keep losing to the same opponent…
et: Ma ei tunne mingit sundi sellele samale vastasele pidevalt kaotama hakata...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_LucyYouAgain
en: … … … … … … Fine… I'll do it…
et: ... ... ... ... ... fine... ma teen seda...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_NowComeOn
en: Now! Come on!
et: Nüüd! Tule nüüd!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_LucyFrontierPass
en: …FRONTIER PASS…
et: ...FRONTIER PASS...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_LuckSymbolTookGoldenShine
en: The Luck Symbol took on a golden shine!
et: Õnnesümbol võttis kuldse sära!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_IWontForget
en: …You, I won't forget… …Ever…
et: ...Sina, ma ei unusta... ...ever...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_ChoseRoomNoHeal
en: I welcome you…
et: Ma tervitan sind...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_ChoseRoomNoHeal
en: Giggle… You seem to be bereft of luck…
et: Tundub, et sa oled õnnest vaba...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_ChoseRoomNoHeal
en: If only you hadn't chosen this room, your POKéMON could have been healed…
et: Kui sa poleks seda tuba valinud, oleks võinud su POKéMON terveks teha...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_ChoseRoomHealOne
en: I welcome you…
et: Ma tervitan sind...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_ChoseRoomHealOne
en: Since you have chosen this room, I will restore one POKéMON to full health…
et: Kuna olete selle toa valinud, taastan ühe POKéMON täie tervise juurde...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_ChoseRoomHealTwo
en: I welcome you…
et: Ma tervitan sind...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_ChoseRoomHealTwo
en: Since you have chosen this room, I will restore two POKéMON to full health…
et: Kuna sa oled selle toa valinud, siis taastan kaks POKéMON täie tervise juurde...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_WillRestoreAllMons
en: I welcome you…
et: Ma tervitan sind...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_WillRestoreAllMons
en: Giggle… You should thank your lucky stars…
et: Sa peaksid tänama oma õnnelikke tähti...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_WillRestoreAllMons
en: Since you have chosen this room, all your POKéMON will be restored…
et: Kuna olete selle toa valinud, siis taastatakse kõik teie POKéMON...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_ShallFetchOurMaster
en: I shall go fetch our master…
et: Ma lähen toon meie isanda...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_WillRestoreTwoMons
en: Ah, you're a lucky one! I'm in good spirits now.
et: Ah, sa oled õnnelik! Olen nüüd heas tujus.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_WillRestoreTwoMons
en: I will restore two of your POKéMON to full health!
et: Ma taastan kaks teie POKéMON täie terviseni!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_GymSign
en: SOOTOPOLIS CITY POKéMON GYM LEADER: JUAN
et: SOOTOPOLIS CITY POKéMON SAALI JUHT: JUAN

label: SootopolisCity_Text_GymSign
en: “The GYM LEADER with the beauty of pure water!”
et: "The SAALI JUHT koos puhta vee iluga!"

label: SootopolisCity_Text_CitySign
en: SOOTOPOLIS CITY
et: SOOTOPOLIS CITY

label: SootopolisCity_Text_CitySign
en: “The mystical city where history slumbers.”
et: "Müstiline linn, kus ajalugu uinutab."

label: SootopolisCity_Text_DoorIsClosed
en: The door is closed.
et: Uks on suletud.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_PhysicallyFitLivingHere
en: Diving in the sea. Climbing up and down stairs all the time…
et: Sukeldumine meres. Ronides kogu aeg trepist üles-alla...

label: SootopolisCity_Text_PhysicallyFitLivingHere
en: If you live in this town, you end up getting physically fit.
et: Kui te elate selles linnas, siis lõpuks saate füüsiliselt sobivaks.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_GiantPokemonSuddenlyAppeared
en: These giant POKéMON suddenly appeared in the middle of the city!
et: Need hiiglased POKéMON ilmusid äkki keset linna!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_GiantPokemonSuddenlyAppeared
en: And, I've never seen them before!
et: Ja, ma pole neid varem näinud!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_GiantPokemonSuddenlyAppeared
en: Why are they smashing into each other like that?
et: Miks nad niimoodi üksteise vastu lömastavad?

label: SootopolisCity_Text_GiantPokemonSuddenlyAppeared
en: Why can't they be friends, those POKéMON?
et: Miks nad ei võiks olla sõbrad, need POKéMON?

label: SootopolisCity_Text_WhatIsThatGreenPokemon
en: What? What? What? What is that green POKéMON?!
et: Mida? Mida? Mida? Mis on see roheline POKéMON?!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_WhereDidLegendariesGo
en: GROUDON and KYOGRE… Where did they go?
et: GROUDON ja KYOGRE... Kuhu nad läksid?

label: SootopolisCity_Text_WhereDidLegendariesGo
en: Will they cause droughts or downpours somewhere else?
et: Kas need põhjustavad põudasid või paduvihmasid kuskil mujal?

label: SootopolisCity_Text_TwoPokemonArentAngry
en: I just get this sense somehow that the two POKéMON aren't angry.
et: Mul lihtsalt tekib kuidagi selline tunne, et need kaks POKéMON ei ole vihased.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_TwoPokemonArentAngry
en: I think… They probably can't control their own power…
et: Ma arvan, et nad ei suuda oma võimu kontrollida.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_FlyingMonStoppedRampage
en: That flying POKéMON came down from the sky and stopped the rampaging POKéMON…
et: See lendamine POKéMON tuli taevast alla ja peatas rammiva POKéMON...

label: SootopolisCity_Text_WonderWhatWorldIsLike
en: I… I've never been out of this city.
et: Ma pole kunagi siit linnast väljas käinud.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_WonderWhatWorldIsLike
en: I wonder what the world is like on the other side of this round sky?
et: Huvitav, milline on maailm teisel pool seda ümmargust taevast?

label: SootopolisCity_Text_ThisIsWicked
en: Wow! This is wicked!
et: Vau! See on kuri!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_ThatWasWicked
en: Wow! That was wicked!
et: Vau! See oli kuri!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_GoRedAndBlueMon
en: Go for it, red POKéMON! Don't back off, blue POKéMON!
et: Mine selle järele, punane POKéMON! Ära tagane, sinine POKéMON!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_DoYouKnowMonNames
en: Hi, do you know the names of those POKéMON fighting over there?
et: Tere, kas teate nende POKéMON nimetusi, kes seal kaklevad?

label: SootopolisCity_Text_GreenOneSettlesThings
en: I was wondering which one would win, the red one or the blue one, but, oh no, it's the green one that settles things!
et: Mõtlesin, et kumb võidab, kas punane või sinine, aga oh ei, see on see roheline, mis asju lahendab!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_GreenOneSettlesThings
en: Talk about a huge turn of events!
et: Räägi tohutust sündmuste keerdkäigust!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_SeeingLegendWithOwnEyes
en: There's an ancient legend that claims the land and sea were shaped by a colossal battle between POKéMON.
et: On iidne legend, mis väidab, et maad ja merd kujundas kolossaalne lahing POKéMON vahel.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_SeeingLegendWithOwnEyes
en: Well, I'm seeing that happen with my very own eyes!
et: No ma näen, et see juhtub minu enda silmadega!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_SeeingLegendWithOwnEyes
en: Whoa! I never expected to be witness to something this huge!
et: Vot! Ma ei oodanudki, et olen tunnistajaks millelegi nii tohutule!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_SawLegendWithOwnEyes
en: There's an ancient legend that claims the land and sea were shaped by a colossal battle between POKéMON.
et: On iidne legend, mis väidab, et maad ja merd kujundas kolossaalne lahing POKéMON vahel.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_SawLegendWithOwnEyes
en: Well, I saw that happen with my very own eyes!
et: No ma nägin, et see juhtus minu enda silmadega!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_SawLegendWithOwnEyes
en: Whoa! I never expected to be witness to something this huge!
et: Vot! Ma ei oodanudki, et olen tunnistajaks millelegi nii tohutule!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_BigPokemonFighting
en: A big POKéMON is fighting with another big POKéMON!
et: Suur POKéMON võitleb veel ühe suure POKéMON!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_BigPokemonFighting
en: Please, someone make them stop!
et: Palun, keegi paneks nad seisma!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_PrettyMonCameFromSky
en: A pretty POKéMON came down from the sky…
et: Päris POKéMON tuli taevast alla...

label: SootopolisCity_Text_SootopolisWillBeWrecked
en: Oh, no! SOOTOPOLIS CITY will get wrecked!
et: Oh ei! SOOTOPOLIS CITY saab rusutud!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_SootopolisDidntGetWrecked
en: SOOTOPOLIS CITY didn't get wrecked!
et: SOOTOPOLIS CITY ei saanud rusutud!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_NoOrdinaryTourist
en: Hm! You've come all the way to SOOTOPOLIS? You're no ordinary tourist.
et: Hm! Oled jõudnud lõpuni SOOTOPOLIS? Sa ei ole tavaline turist.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_NoOrdinaryTourist
en: But I suppose that doesn't make you an extraordinary tourist, either.
et: Aga ma oletan, et see ei tee sinust ka erakordset turisti.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_CityRegainedCalm
en: The city has regained its calm…
et: Linn on oma rahuliku...

label: SootopolisCity_Text_CaveOfOriginPleaseLeave
en: Who might you be?
et: Kes sa võiksid olla?

label: SootopolisCity_Text_CaveOfOriginPleaseLeave
en: This is the CAVE OF ORIGIN.
et: See on CAVE OF ORIGIN.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_CaveOfOriginPleaseLeave
en: The spirits of POKéMON, becalmed at MT. PYRE, are said to be revived here.
et: Vaimud POKéMON, becalmed juures MT. PYRE, väidetavalt taaselustatakse siin.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_CaveOfOriginPleaseLeave
en: Please leave.
et: Palun lahkuge.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_LeadSuperiorTrainerToCave
en: A person with a strong will and superior talent…
et: Tugeva tahtega ja ülima andega inimene...

label: SootopolisCity_Text_LeadSuperiorTrainerToCave
en: A TRAINER who has knowledge and experience of many kinds of POKéMON…
et: A TRAINER kellel on teadmisi ja kogemusi palju erinevaid POKéMON...

label: SootopolisCity_Text_LeadSuperiorTrainerToCave
en: If such a person were to appear, I was instructed by WALLACE to lead that TRAINER to this CAVE.
et: Kui selline inimene peaks ilmuma, siis mind juhendas WALLACE juhtima, et TRAINER selle CAVE juurde.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_AwakenedPokemonClash
en: Oh, my…
et: Oh, mu...

label: SootopolisCity_Text_AwakenedPokemonClash
en: The clash between the two awakened POKéMON was quelled by the awakening of a third POKéMON…
et: Kahe ärganud POKéMON kokkupõrget summutas kolmanda POKéMON ärkamine...

label: SootopolisCity_Text_CaveOfOriginSleepsToo
en: This is the CAVE OF ORIGIN…
et: See on CAVE OF ORIGIN...

label: SootopolisCity_Text_CaveOfOriginSleepsToo
en: With the passing of the crisis, the cave, too, shall sleep…
et: Kriisi möödumisega jääb ka koobas magama...

label: SootopolisCity_Text_SootopolisSkyBeautiful
en: SOOTOPOLIS sprang up as a town in the crater of a volcano.
et: SOOTOPOLIS tärkas linnana vulkaani kraatris.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_SootopolisSkyBeautiful
en: If you look up at the sky, the lip of the crater is also visible. So, all you see is the sky in a circle.
et: Kui vaadata üles taevasse, siis on näha ka kraatri huul. Seega, näed vaid taevast ringis.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_SootopolisSkyBeautiful
en: But that's what makes the sky above SOOTOPOLIS the most beautiful.
et: Aga see teebki taeva üleval SOOTOPOLIS kõige ilusamaks.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_GiganticPokemonFight
en: When two POKéMON that gigantic are fighting that savagely, there's not much that we can do.
et: Kui kaks POKéMON seda gigantset kaklevad, et metsikult, siis ei saa me suurt midagi teha.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_FearedWorstWhenPokemonFlewDown
en: When that third POKéMON flew down, I feared the worst.
et: Kui see kolmas POKéMON alla lendas, kartsin kõige hullemat.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_NightSkyFavoriteScenery
en: A circle of a night sky framed by the crater of a volcano…
et: Vulkaani kraatri poolt raamitud öötaeva ring...

label: SootopolisCity_Text_NightSkyFavoriteScenery
en: And in that ring, stars flicker and blink as if they were alive… It's my favorite scenery.
et: Ja selles sõrmuses vilksatavad ja vilksatavad tähed, nagu nad oleksid elus... See on mu lemmikmaastik.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_WeatherWentWild
en: The weather was clear this morning, but…
et: Ilm oli täna hommikul selge, aga...

label: SootopolisCity_Text_WeatherWentWild
en: All of a sudden, dark clouds brewed up, rain started falling in sheets, and there was thunder and lightning, too.
et: Ühtäkki pruulisid üles tumedad pilved, vihma hakkas linades sadama ja oli äikest ja välku ka.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_WeatherWentWild
en: The weather just went completely wild!
et: Ilm läks lihtsalt täiesti metsikuks!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_WeatherWentWild
en: Is all of this because of those POKéMON?
et: Kas see kõik on tingitud nendest POKéMON?

label: SootopolisCity_Text_YouBroughtFlyingMon
en: Oh?
et: Oh?

label: SootopolisCity_Text_YouBroughtFlyingMon
en: It was you who brought that flying POKéMON here?
et: Just sina tõid selle lendamise POKéMON siia?

label: SootopolisCity_Text_YouBroughtFlyingMon
en: Well, aren't you amazing!
et: No kas sa pole hämmastav!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_GroudonPleaseStop
en: MAXIE: G… GROUDON… Please! Stop what you're doing!
et: MAXIE: G... GROUDON... Palun! Lõpeta see, mida sa teed!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_GroudonPleaseStop
en: I know the extent of your power now!
et: Ma tean nüüd teie võimu ulatust!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_GroudonPleaseStop
en: If you keep going, all HOENN, not just SOOTOPOLIS, will be utterly ruined!
et: Kui edasi minna, siis kõik HOENN, mitte ainult SOOTOPOLIS, on täiesti rikutud!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_AfterAllOurScheming
en: MAXIE: So the super-ancient POKéMON weren't only GROUDON and KYOGRE…
et: MAXIE: Nii et ülientusiastlik POKéMON ei olnud ainult GROUDON ja KYOGRE...

label: SootopolisCity_Text_AfterAllOurScheming
en: After all our fruitless scheming and frantic efforts, that one POKéMON's simple action puts everything right again as if nothing had happened…
et: Pärast kõiki meie viljatuid skeemitamisi ja meeletuid pingutusi paneb see üks POKéMON lihtne tegevus kõik jälle paika, nagu poleks midagi juhtunud...

label: SootopolisCity_Text_AfterAllOurScheming
en: Fu… Fuhahaha…
et: Fu... Fuhahaha...

label: SootopolisCity_Text_KyogreCalmDown
en: ARCHIE: KYOGRE! What's wrong?! Look over here! It's the RED ORB! Calm down! KYOGRE!
et: ARCHIE: KYOGRE! Mis viga on?! Vaata siia! See on RED ORB! Rahune maha! KYOGRE!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_KyogreCalmDown
en: It's no good! It's not responding at all!
et: Sellest pole kasu! See ei vasta üldse!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_TryingMeaninglessToPokemon
en: ARCHIE: KYOGRE and GROUDON both flew off to who knows where.
et: ARCHIE: KYOGRE ja GROUDON mõlemad lendasid minema, kes teab kuhu.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_TryingMeaninglessToPokemon
en: The weather in HOENN has returned to its normal state…
et: Ilm HOENN on naasnud oma normaalsesse olekusse...

label: SootopolisCity_Text_TryingMeaninglessToPokemon
en: Haha… Hahaha…
et: Haha... Hahaha...

label: SootopolisCity_Text_TryingMeaninglessToPokemon
en: Maybe what we were trying to do was something small, even meaningless, to POKéMON…
et: Võib-olla see, mida me üritasime teha, oli midagi väikest, isegi mõttetut, et POKéMON...

label: SootopolisCity_Text_InvolvedWithCrisisComeWithMe
en: STEVEN: Those POKéMON fighting… GROUDON… And KYOGRE…
et: STEVEN: Need POKéMON võitlus... GROUDON... Ja KYOGRE...

label: SootopolisCity_Text_InvolvedWithCrisisComeWithMe
en: The two super-ancient POKéMON were awakened from a long sleep…
et: Kaks üliägedat POKéMON ärkasid pikast unest...

label: SootopolisCity_Text_InvolvedWithCrisisComeWithMe
en: And now they are smashing each other with their uncontrollable energy…
et: Ja nüüd nad purustavad üksteist oma kontrollimatu energiaga...

label: SootopolisCity_Text_InvolvedWithCrisisComeWithMe
en: …{PLAYER}{KUN}.
et: ...{PLAYER} {KUN}.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_InvolvedWithCrisisComeWithMe
en: You being here now I'll take to mean that you're prepared to become involved in this crisis.
et: Sa oled nüüd siin, ma pean silmas seda, et sa oled valmis sellesse kriisi sekkuma.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_InvolvedWithCrisisComeWithMe
en: Well, then, there's someone that I'd like you to meet.
et: Noh, siis on keegi, kellega tahaks kohtuda.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_InvolvedWithCrisisComeWithMe
en: Come with me, please.
et: Tule minuga, palun.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_DoesThisMakeYourFearPokemon
en: STEVEN: Listen, {PLAYER}{KUN}.
et: STEVEN: Kuula, {PLAYER}{KUN}.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_DoesThisMakeYourFearPokemon
en: Does seeing GROUDON and KYOGRE make you think POKéMON are to be feared?
et: Kas GROUDON ja KYOGRE nägemine paneb mõtlema POKéMON on karta?

label: SootopolisCity_Text_DoesThisMakeYourFearPokemon
en: But that's not true. POKéMON are really more…
et: Aga see ei vasta tõele. POKéMON on tõesti rohkem...

label: SootopolisCity_Text_DoesThisMakeYourFearPokemon
en: …Why am I asking you this? You already know.
et: ...Miks ma seda küsin? Sa juba tead.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_HereWereAreHelpWallace
en: STEVEN: Okay, here we are!
et: STEVEN: Okei, siin me oleme!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_HereWereAreHelpWallace
en: Inside here you'll find someone named WALLACE.
et: Siit seest leiad kellegi nimega WALLACE.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_HereWereAreHelpWallace
en: I think you have what's needed to help him…
et: Ma arvan, et sul on seda, mida on vaja, et teda aidata...

label: SootopolisCity_Text_KnowWhatsNeededToHelpHim
en: STEVEN: I think you have what's needed to help him…
et: STEVEN: Ma arvan, et sul on seda, mida on vaja, et teda aidata...

label: SootopolisCity_Text_NeverBeenToSkyPillar
en: STEVEN: The SKY PILLAR…
et: STEVEN: SKY PILLAR...

label: SootopolisCity_Text_NeverBeenToSkyPillar
en: I've never been there. I wonder where it could be?
et: Ma pole seal kunagi käinud. Huvitav, kus see võiks olla?

label: SootopolisCity_Text_SoThatsRayquaza
en: STEVEN: So that's RAYQUAZA…
et: STEVEN: See on siis RAYQUAZA...

label: SootopolisCity_Text_SoThatsRayquaza
en: It's incredible how the two rampaging POKéMON would flee from it in fear…
et: See on uskumatu, kuidas kaks rammivat POKéMON selle eest hirmuga põgeneksid...

label: SootopolisCity_Text_MaxieArchieLeft
en: STEVEN: It looks like both MAXIE and ARCHIE have gone away somewhere.
et: STEVEN: Tundub, et nii MAXIE kui ARCHIE on kuhugi ära läinud.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_MaxieArchieLeft
en: Perhaps they've gone to MT. PYRE to return those ORBS…
et: Ehk on nad läinud MT peale. PYRE et tagastada need ORBS...

label: SootopolisCity_Text_HaventYouScaledSkyPillar
en: WALLACE: Oh? {PLAYER}{KUN}?
et: WALLACE: Oh? {PLAYER} {KUN}?

label: SootopolisCity_Text_HaventYouScaledSkyPillar
en: Haven't you scaled the SKY PILLAR yet?
et: Kas sa pole juba SKY PILLAR skaleerinud?

label: SootopolisCity_Text_HaventYouScaledSkyPillar
en: I'm sure that you can make it to the top of the SKY PILLAR…
et: Olen kindel, et saad jõuda SKY PILLAR tippu...

label: SootopolisCity_Text_AquaMagmaDidntMeanHarm
en: WALLACE: {PLAYER}{KUN}…
et: WALLACE: {PLAYER}{KUN}...

label: SootopolisCity_Text_AquaMagmaDidntMeanHarm
en: The leaders of TEAM MAGMA and AQUA, I don't think they meant harm.
et: TEAM MAGMA ja AQUA eestvedajad, ma arvan, et nad ei mõelnud kahju.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_AquaMagmaDidntMeanHarm
en: It wouldn't hurt to hear what they have to say for themselves.
et: Ei teeks paha kuulda, mis neil enda jaoks öelda on.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_ThankYouForHelpAcceptThis
en: WALLACE: {PLAYER}{KUN}… My eyes didn't deceive me.
et: WALLACE: {PLAYER}{KUN}... Mu silmad ei petnud mind.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_ThankYouForHelpAcceptThis
en: Thanks to your help, SOOTOPOLIS… No, all of HOENN was saved.
et: Tänu teie abile, SOOTOPOLIS... Ei, kõik HOENN oli salvestatud.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_ThankYouForHelpAcceptThis
en: On behalf of the people, I thank you.
et: Rahva nimel ma tänan.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_ThankYouForHelpAcceptThis
en: This is a gift from me. Please accept it.
et: See on kingitus minu poolt. Palun võtke see vastu.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_ExplainWaterfallGoToGym
