en: But, rules are rules! Here, take this.
et: Aga, reeglid on reeglid! Võta see ette.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedBalanceBadge
en: {PLAYER} received the BALANCE BADGE from DAD!
et: {PLAYER} sai BALANCE MÄRK alates DAD!

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ExplainBalanceBadgeTakeThis
en: DAD: With that BADGE, the DEFENSE of all your POKéMON will increase.
et: DAD: Selle MÄRK abil suureneb DEFENSE kõik oma POKéMON.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ExplainBalanceBadgeTakeThis
en: POKéMON that know the HM move SURF will be able to travel over water.
et: POKéMON mis teavad HM liikuda SURF saab reisida üle vee.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ExplainBalanceBadgeTakeThis
en: This is my gift to you. {PLAYER}, I'm sure you can use it correctly.
et: See on minu kingitus teile. {PLAYER}, kindlasti saab seda õigesti kasutada.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ExplainFacade
en: DAD: TM42 contains FACADE.
et: DAD: TM42 sisaldab FACADE.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ExplainFacade
en: It doubles the power of moves if the POKéMON is poisoned, paralyzed, or burned.
et: See kahekordistab võtete jõudu, kui POKéMON on mürgitatud, halvatud või põletatud.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ExplainFacade
en: It might be able to turn a bad situation into an advantage.
et: See suudaks ehk halva olukorra eeliseks muuta.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadHappyAndSad
en: DAD: As the GYM LEADER, I can't express how upset I am…
et: DAD: Kui SAALI JUHT, ei saa ma väljendada, kui ärritunud ma olen...

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadHappyAndSad
en: But as a father, it makes me both happy and a little sad. It's odd…
et: Aga isana teeb see mind nii õnnelikuks kui ka veidi kurvaks. See on veider...

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_PleaseComeWithMe
en: Ah, there you are, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
et: Ah, seal sa oled, {PLAYER}{KUN}!

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_PleaseComeWithMe
en: Please come with me. I have something I want you to have.
et: Palun tulge minuga kaasa. Mul on midagi, mida ma tahan, et sul oleks.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_LetMeBorrowPlayer
en: NORMAN, you don't mind, do you?
et: NORMAN, sul pole ju midagi selle vastu?

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_LetMeBorrowPlayer
en: Let me borrow your {PLAYER}{KUN} for a minute or two.
et: Lubage mul laenata oma {PLAYER}{KUN} minutiks-paariks.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadGoingToKeepTraining
en: DAD: {PLAYER}, you should go visit your mother every so often.
et: DAD: {PLAYER}, sa peaksid minema külastada oma ema iga nii sageli.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadGoingToKeepTraining
en: I'm going to stay here and redouble my training.
et: Ma jään siia ja kahekordistan oma treeninguid.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadGoingToKeepTraining
en: It would bother me as a TRAINER to not avenge my loss to you, {PLAYER}!
et: See häiriks mind kui TRAINER et mitte maksta kätte minu kaotust sulle, {PLAYER}!

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadNoAmountOfTrainingIsEnough
en: DAD: {PLAYER}, how are things going?
et: DAD: {PLAYER}, kuidas asjad käivad?

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadNoAmountOfTrainingIsEnough
en: The world of POKéMON is deep.
et: Maailm POKéMON on sügav.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadNoAmountOfTrainingIsEnough
en: I honestly think that no amount of training would ever be enough.
et: Ma ausalt arvan, et ühestki koolitusest ei piisaks kunagi.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: Hey, how's it going, CHAMPIONbound {PLAYER}?
et: Hei, kuidas läheb, TŠEMPIONbound {PLAYER}?

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: The doors in this GYM open when you beat the awaiting TRAINERS.
et: Uksed selles SAAL avanevad, kui peksate ootavat TRAINERS.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: Whoops! The doors in this room are already open, so don't attack me!
et: Whoops! Uksed siin ruumis on juba lahti, nii et ärge rünnake mind!

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: The TRAINERS of PETALBURG GYM use all kinds of items.
et: TRAINERS PETALBURG SAAL kasutada igasuguseid esemeid.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: The door at the left leads to the SPEED ROOM.
et: Vasakul olev uks viib SPEED ROOM.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: The door at the right leads to the ACCURACY ROOM.
et: Paremal olev uks viib ACCURACY ROOM.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: The room's name will be on the door, so choose carefully.
et: Ruumi nimi jääb uksele, seega vali hoolikalt.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: Once you've chosen the door… Well, hey, go for it!
et: Kui oled ukse välja valinud... no kuule, mine järele!

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictory
en: {PLAYER}! Whoa! You've overcome even your own father!
et: {PLAYER}! Vot! Sa oled üle saanud isegi oma isast!

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictory
en: Like, whoa! What a stunning turn of events!
et: Nagu, whoa! Milline vapustav sündmuste pööre!

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_RandallIntro
en: The ability to attack before the opponent…
et: Võime rünnata enne vastast...

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_RandallIntro
en: Just that alone puts me at a great advantage, don't you agree?
et: Ainuüksi see paneb mulle suure eelise, kas pole nõus?

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_RandallDefeat
en: That was a magnificent battle!
et: See oli suurepärane lahing!

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_RandallPostBattle
en: Go on to the next room where a new challenge awaits you.
et: Mine edasi järgmisesse tuppa, kus ootab sind ees uus väljakutse.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_RandallPostBattle
en: At the left is the CONFUSION ROOM.
et: Vasakul on CONFUSION ROOM.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_RandallPostBattle
en: The right door leads to the DEFENSE ROOM.
et: Õige uks viib DEFENSE ROOM.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_RandallPostBadge
en: Whomever you beat, and whomever you may lose to, you never shirk from training yourself and your POKéMON.
et: Kellele iganes sa ka ei peksaks ja kellele iganes sa ka ei kaotaks, ei hiiliks sa kunagi enda ja oma POKéMON treenimisest kõrvale.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_RandallPostBadge
en: That's what I think being a GYM LEADER is all about.
et: See ongi minu meelest SAALI JUHT olemine.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ParkerIntro
en: This is the CONFUSION ROOM.
et: See on CONFUSION ROOM.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ParkerIntro
en: Let me see how well bonded you are with your POKéMON!
et: Lubage mul näha, kui hästi olete seotud oma POKéMON!

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ParkerDefeat
en: I couldn't confuse your team enough… You share a strong bond together.
et: Ma ei suutnud su meeskonda piisavalt segadusse ajada, sa jagad tugevat sidet.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ParkerPostBattle
en: The next room is the STRENGTH ROOM. Can you withstand brute force?
et: Järgmine tuba on STRENGTH ROOM. Kas sa talud toorest jõudu?

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ParkerPostBadge
en: After you beat our LEADER, the training has become a lot tougher.
et: Pärast meie LEADER peksmist on koolitus muutunud palju karmimaks.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GeorgeIntro
en: Just when you think you're going to win, your opponent restores HP…
et: Just siis, kui arvad, et võidad, taastab vastane HP...

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GeorgeIntro
en: Can you just imagine how awful that must feel?
et: Kas te kujutate lihtsalt ette, kui kohutavalt see peab tunduma?

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GeorgeIntro
en: I'll show you exactly how awful it feels!
et: Näitan täpselt, kui kohutavalt tundub!

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GeorgeDefeat
en: I couldn't restore HP enough… What ATTACK power…
et: Ma ei suutnud taastada HP piisavalt... Mis ATTACK võimsus...

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GeorgePostBattle
en: I should have expected no less from our LEADER's kid.
et: Oleks pidanud meie LEADER lapselt mitte vähem ootama.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GeorgePostBattle
en: No, wait! A TRAINER's abilities are earned only through effort.
et: Ei, oota! TRAINER võimeid teenitakse ainult läbi pingutuse.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GeorgePostBattle
en: I lost because my own efforts weren't enough.
et: Kaotasin, sest enda pingutustest ei piisanud.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GeorgePostBattle
en: Go on! The ONE-HIT KO ROOM is next.
et: Mine edasi! ONE-HIT KO ROOM on järgmine.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GeorgePostBadge
en: I'm going to keep training at GYMS. One day, I'll become a LEADER.
et: Jätkan treeninguid SAALS. Ühel päeval saan LEADER.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_BerkeIntro
en: I'm not going to take it easy just because you're our LEADER's kid.
et: Ma ei võta seda rahulikult lihtsalt sellepärast, et sa oled meie LEADER laps.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_BerkeIntro
en: I'll show you how horrid it is for a POKéMON to take a critical hit!
et: Näitan, kui õudne on POKéMON kriitilise tabamuse saamine!

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_BerkeDefeat
en: Your power… You're the real deal.
et: Sa oled tõeline kokkulepe.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_BerkePostBattle
en: Your father really is strong. He's a TRAINER worth my respect.
et: Su isa on tõesti tugev. Ta on TRAINER väärt minu austust.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_BerkePostBattle
en: And, I sense the same glow coming from you as your father.
et: Ja ma tajun, et sult tuleb sama kuma, mis su isalt.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_BerkePostBattle
en: I hope that you'll stage a terrific battle with your father!
et: Loodan, et lavate hirmuäratava lahingu oma isaga!

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_BerkePostBadge
en: Since your dad became the LEADER, the TRAINERS of PETALBURG CITY have become a lot tougher.
et: Kuna su isa sai LEADER, siis TRAINERS PETALBURG CITY on muutunud palju karmimaks.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_MaryIntro
en: Giggle… This is the ACCURACY ROOM.
et: See on ACCURACY ROOM.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_MaryIntro
en: It's pretty nasty when every attack lands without fail.
et: See on päris vastik, kui iga rünnak maandub läbikukkumata.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_MaryDefeat
en: You were a cut above me…
et: Sa olid minu kohal lõigatud...

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_MaryPostBattle
en: There are some even stronger TRAINERS waiting for you.
et: Sind ootavad mõned veel tugevamad TRAINERS.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_MaryPostBattle
en: The left is the DEFENSE ROOM, and the right is the RECOVERY ROOM.
et: Vasakul on DEFENSE ROOM ja paremal on RECOVERY ROOM.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_MaryPostBattle
en: Your POKéMON's ATTACK power will be on trial either way.
et: Teie POKéMON's ATTACK võim on nii või teisiti kohtu all.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_MaryPostBadge
en: Do you know what we're trying to achieve as TRAINERS?
et: Kas sa tead, mida me üritame saavutada kui TRAINERS?

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_MaryPostBadge
en: We're striving to become soul mates with our POKéMON.
et: Püüame saada hingesugulasteks oma POKéMON-ga.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_AlexiaIntro
en: The higher the DEFENSE, the more reckless I can be in attack.
et: Mida kõrgem on DEFENSE, seda hoolimatum saan olla rünnakul.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_AlexiaDefeat
en: Our defenses weren't enough…
et: Meie kaitsest ei piisanud...

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_AlexiaPostBattle
en: I think you've taught me a valuable lesson here.
et: Ma arvan, et sa oled mulle siin väärtusliku õppetunni andnud.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_AlexiaPostBattle
en: Now, go on! The left door goes to the STRENGTH ROOM.
et: Nüüd, mine edasi! Vasak uks läheb STRENGTH ROOM.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_AlexiaPostBattle
en: The right door opens to the ONE-HIT KO ROOM.
et: Parempoolne uks avaneb ONE-HIT KO ROOM.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_AlexiaPostBattle
en: Both of them have TRAINERS who are skilled at offense.
et: Mõlemal on TRAINERS, kes on solvumises osavad.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_AlexiaPostBadge
en: Hi! Have you tried using SURF?
et: Tere! Oled proovinud kasutada SURF?

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_JodyIntro
en: Our GYM LEADER told us to go all out and beat you.
et: Meie SAALI JUHT käskis meil kõik välja minna ja sind peksta.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_JodyIntro
en: Even if you happen to be the LEADER's kid!
et: Isegi kui juhtute olema LEADER laps!

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_JodyDefeat
en: But… I went all out!
et: Aga... ma läksin kõik välja!

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_JodyPostBattle
en: The way you use your POKéMON… It's like your father's style.
et: See, kuidas sa kasutad oma POKéMON... See on nagu su isa stiil.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_JodyPostBattle
en: Go on through! The GYM LEADER, your father, is waiting!
et: Mine edasi! SAALI JUHT, teie isa, ootab!

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_JodyPostBadge
en: Sure, it's fine to make your POKéMON stronger.
et: Muidugi on hea oma POKéMON tugevamaks muuta.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_JodyPostBadge
en: But what decides the winner?
et: Aga mis otsustab võitja?

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_JodyPostBadge
en: Why, it's the feelings TRAINERS have for their POKéMON.
et: Miks, see on tunded TRAINERS on nende POKéMON jaoks.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DoorAppearsLocked
en: This door appears to be locked right now…
et: See uks paistab praegu lukus olevat...

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterSpeedRoom
en: “SPEED ROOM,” the sign says.
et: "SPEED ROOM", öeldakse märgis.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterSpeedRoom
en: Do you want to go through?
et: Kas tahad läbi elada?

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DoorAppearsLocked2
en: This door appears to be locked right now…
et: See uks paistab praegu lukus olevat...

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterAccuracyRoom
en: “ACCURACY ROOM,” the sign says.
et: "ACCURACY ROOM", öeldakse märgis.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterAccuracyRoom
en: Do you want to go through?
et: Kas tahad läbi elada?

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterConfusionRoom
en: “CONFUSION ROOM,” the sign says.
et: "CONFUSION ROOM", öeldakse märgis.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
en: PETALBURG CITY POKéMON GYM
et: PETALBURG CITY POKéMON SAAL

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertified
en: PETALBURG CITY POKéMON GYM
et: PETALBURG CITY POKéMON SAAL

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertified
en: NORMAN'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS: {PLAYER}
et: NORMAN'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS: {PLAYER}

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanPreRematch
en: DAD: {PLAYER}… I had a feeling that you would come.
et: DAD: {PLAYER}... mul oli tunne, et sa tuled.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanPreRematch
en: I would never refuse to accept a challenge from you.
et: Ma ei keelduks kunagi teilt väljakutset vastu võtmast.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanPreRematch
en: You do understand, don't you?
et: Sa saad aru, kas pole?

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanPreRematch
en: Inside a GYM, it doesn't matter that we are a parent and child.
et: SAAL sees ei ole vahet, et oleme lapsevanem ja laps.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanPreRematch
en: …No, because we are parent and child, we owe it to each other to do the best we can. Isn't that right, {PLAYER}?
et: ...ei, kuna oleme lapsevanem ja laps, võlgneme teineteisele parima, mida suudame. Kas pole õige, {PLAYER}?

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanRematchDefeat
en: Uh… Haha… Maybe that was going too hard…
et: Haha... Võib-olla läks see liiga raskeks...

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanPostRematch
en: DAD: {PLAYER}… What is your dream?
et: DAD: {PLAYER}... Mis on sinu unistus?

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanPostRematch
en: My dream… Hahaha… It has already come true, actually.
et: Minu unistus... Hahaha... see on juba täitunud, tegelikult.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanRematchNeedTwoMons
en: DAD: {PLAYER}… I had a feeling that you would come.
et: DAD: {PLAYER}... mul oli tunne, et sa tuled.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanRematchNeedTwoMons
en: I would never refuse to accept a challenge from you.
et: Ma ei keelduks kunagi teilt väljakutset vastu võtmast.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanRematchNeedTwoMons
en: You do understand, don't you?
et: Sa saad aru, kas pole?

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanRematchNeedTwoMons
en: Inside a GYM, it doesn't matter that we are a parent and child.
et: SAAL sees ei ole vahet, et oleme lapsevanem ja laps.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanRematchNeedTwoMons
en: Hm? Wait a second, {PLAYER}.
et: Hm? Oota korraks, {PLAYER}.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanRematchNeedTwoMons
en: Do you only have one POKéMON that is capable of battle?
et: Kas sul on ainult üks POKéMON mis on lahinguvõimeline?

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanRematchNeedTwoMons
en: Sorry, but you'll have to come back with at least two POKéMON.
et: Sorry, aga tagasi tuleb tulla vähemalt kahe POKéMON-ga.

label: FortreeCity_House4_Text_BringsWorldCloserTogether
en: By being together with POKéMON, people make more and more friends.
et: Olles koos POKéMON, leiavad inimesed üha rohkem sõpru.

label: FortreeCity_House4_Text_BringsWorldCloserTogether
en: And that brings the world closer together. I think it's wonderful!
et: Ja see lähendab maailma. Ma arvan, et see on imeline!

label: FortreeCity_House4_Text_GoBirdPokemon
en: There! Go, BIRD POKéMON!
et: Seal! Mine, BIRD POKéMON!

label: FortreeCity_House4_Text_AskedWingullToRunErrand
en: Heheh, I asked my WINGULL to run an errand for me.
et: Heheh, ma palusin oma WINGULL juhtida minu jaoks errandit.

label: FortreeCity_House4_Text_WelcomeWingullTakeMentalHerb
en: Good! Welcome back, WINGULL!
et: Tubli! Tere tulemast tagasi, WINGULL!

label: FortreeCity_House4_Text_WelcomeWingullTakeMentalHerb
en: Huh? What is this? What is it holding?
et: Huh? Mis see on? Mida see hoiab?

label: FortreeCity_House4_Text_WelcomeWingullTakeMentalHerb
en: A MENTAL HERB? It must have picked it up somewhere.
et: A MENTAL HERB? See võttis selle vist kuskilt üles.

label: FortreeCity_House4_Text_WelcomeWingullTakeMentalHerb
en: But I'm not a TRAINER, so you can have it.
et: Aga ma ei ole TRAINER, nii et sa võid selle endale saada.

label: FortreeCity_House4_Text_FriendsFarAwayThanksToWingull
en: Thanks to my WINGULL, I have friends who live far away.
et: Tänu oma WINGULL-le on mul sõpru, kes elavad kaugel.

label: FortreeCity_House4_Text_Wingull
en: WINGULL: Pihyoh!
et: WINGULL: Pihyoh!

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_MayNiceBadgesTakeThis
en: MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}! Long time no see!
et: MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}! Kaua ei näe!

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_MayNiceBadgesTakeThis
en: Oh? While I visited the hot springs, you got the LAVARIDGE GYM BADGE.
et: Oh? Kusjuures ma külastasin kuumavedrusid, siis said LAVARIDGE SAAL MÄRK.

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_MayNiceBadgesTakeThis
en: You must have collected good POKéMON… No, I believe you raised some.
et: Sa vist kogusid hea POKéMON... Ei, ma usun, et sa tõstsid mõned.

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_MayNiceBadgesTakeThis
en: I guess it would be okay for you to have this.
et: Ma arvan, et see oleks sinu jaoks okei.

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_MayExplainGoGogglesChallengeDad
en: MAY: With those GO-GOGGLES, you'll have no trouble getting through the desert near ROUTE 111.
et: MAY: Nendega GO-GOGGLES ei ole teil raskusi läbi kõrbe saada ROUTE 111 lähedal.

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_MayExplainGoGogglesChallengeDad
en: But, wow, {PLAYER}{KUN}… Challenging GYMS…
et: Aga, vau, {PLAYER}{KUN}... väljakutse SAALS...

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_MayExplainGoGogglesChallengeDad
en: You're trying hard because you don't want to lose to me, I bet!
et: Sa püüad kõvasti, sest sa ei taha mulle kaotada, ma panustan!

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_MayExplainGoGogglesChallengeDad
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}, I think I should challenge your dad in PETALBURG GYM.
et: {PLAYER}{KUN}, ma arvan, et ma peaksin teie isale väljakutse esitama PETALBURG SAAL

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_MayExplainGoGogglesChallengeDad
en: See you again!
et: Kohtumiseni veel kord!

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_BrendanNiceBadgesTakeThis
en: BRENDAN: {PLAYER}, hey, it's been a while. How's it going?
et: BRENDAN: {PLAYER}, kuule, sellest on juba tükk aega möödas. Kuidas läheb?

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_BrendanNiceBadgesTakeThis
en: Hmm… That's a decent collection of BADGES.
et: Hmm... see on korralik MÄRGID kollektsioon.

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_BrendanNiceBadgesTakeThis
en: All right, then. You may as well have this.
et: Olgu siis. Sama hästi võib sul see olla.

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_BrendanExplainGoGogglesChallengeDad
en: BRENDAN: Keep those with you if you're planning on going into that desert near ROUTE 111.
et: BRENDAN: Hoidke neid kaasas, kui teil on plaanis minna sinna kõrbesse ROUTE 111 lähedal.

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_BrendanExplainGoGogglesChallengeDad
en: There should be some POKéMON that are exclusively desert-dwellers. You might look around for those.
et: Seal peaks olema mingi POKéMON mis on eranditult kõrbe-elanikud. Võib-olla vaatate neid ringi.

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_BrendanExplainGoGogglesChallengeDad
en: As for me… I'm considering challenging NORMAN, the GYM LEADER of PETALBURG.
et: Mis minusse puutub... kaalun väljakutset NORMAN, SAALI JUHT PETALBURG.

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_BrendanExplainGoGogglesChallengeDad
en: Unlike you, {PLAYER}, your dad looks like he really is tough.
et: Erinevalt sinust, {PLAYER}, näeb su isa välja, nagu oleks ta tõesti karm.

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_BrendanExplainGoGogglesChallengeDad
en: See you around!
et: Kohtume ümberringi!

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_HaveEggWillYouTakeIt
en: I have here an EGG.
et: Mul on siin EGG.

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_HaveEggWillYouTakeIt
en: I'd hoped to hatch it by covering it in hot sand by the hot springs. But that doesn't seem to be enough…
et: Lootsin seda kooruda kuumaveeallikate poolt kuuma liivaga kattes. Aga sellest ei paista piisavat...

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_HaveEggWillYouTakeIt
en: I've heard it would be best if it were kept together with POKéMON and carried about.
et: Olen kuulnud, et kõige parem oleks, kui seda hoiaks koos POKéMON ja kannaks umbes.

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_HaveEggWillYouTakeIt
en: You are a TRAINER, yes? And your POKéMON radiate vitality.
et: Sa oled TRAINER jah? Ja sinu POKéMON kiirgavad elujõudu.

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_HaveEggWillYouTakeIt
en: So, what say you? Will you take this EGG to hatch?
et: Mis sa siis ütled? Kas sa võtad selle EGG koorumiseks?

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_HopeYoullWalkPlentyWithEgg
en: Good! I hope you'll walk plenty with this here EGG!
et: Tubli! Loodan, et kõnnid sellega siin rohkelt EGG!

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_ReceivedTheEgg
en: {PLAYER} received the EGG.
et: {PLAYER} sai EGG.

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_NoRoomForThisEgg
en: Oh? You've too many POKéMON. There's no room for this EGG…
et: Oh? Sul on liiga palju POKéMON. Selle EGG jaoks pole ruumi...

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_AsYouWishThen
en: As you wish, then…
et: Nagu soovid, siis...

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_AsYouWishThen
en: If you have a change of heart about hatching this EGG, I will be here.
et: Kui sul on südamemuutus selle EGG koorumise suhtes, siis ma olen siin.

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_EverySoOftenEggFoundAtDayCare
en: Every so often, an EGG will be found at the POKéMON DAY CARE.
et: Igati tihti leitakse EGG  juures POKéMON DAY CARE.

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_EverySoOftenEggFoundAtDayCare
en: Or at least that's how the rumor goes.
et: Või vähemalt nii see kuulujutt käib.

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_HotSpringsNeverRunDry
en: We draw as much hot water as we need, and yet the hot springs never run dry.
et: Tõmbame nii palju kuuma vett kui vaja ja ometi ei jookse kuumaveeallikad kunagi kuivalt.

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_HotSpringsNeverRunDry
en: Isn't it magical?
et: Kas pole maagiline?

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_HotSpringsNeverRunDry
en: These hot springs appear near active volcanoes. Veins of water under the ground are heated by magma to well up as hot springs.
et: Need kuumaveeallikad ilmuvad aktiivsete vulkaanide lähedusse. Veeveine maa all kuumutab magma kuumade allikatena hästi üles.

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_PokemonNippedBackside
en: Being buried in this hot sand is… Sigh…
et: Selle kuuma liiva sisse mattumine on...

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_PokemonNippedBackside
en: So warm and heavenly…
et: Nii soe ja taevalik...

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_PokemonNippedBackside
en: Eh? Gyaah! Ouch!
et: Eh? Gyaah! Ouch!

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_PokemonNippedBackside
en: A POKéMON nipped my backside!
et: A POKéMON nipsutas mu tagakülge!

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_OhYouLikeHotSprings
en: Oh, you like hot springs, do you?
et: Sulle meeldivad ju kuumaveeallikad?

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_OhYouLikeHotSprings
en: That's surprising for one as young as you.
et: See on üllatav ühele nii noorele kui sina.

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_BatheInHotSpringsEveryDay
en: I bathe in the hot springs every day.
et: Suplen iga päev kuumaveeallikates.

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_BatheInHotSpringsEveryDay
en: I want to become a beautiful and strong GYM LEADER like FLANNERY.
et: Tahan saada ilusaks ja tugevaks SAALI JUHT nagu FLANNERY.

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_IfPokemonInHotSprings
en: If people put POKéMON in hot springs, it might be seriously strange.
et: Kui inimesed panevad POKéMON kuumaveeallikatesse, siis võib see olla tõsiselt kummaline.

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_IfPokemonInHotSprings
en: Why, it might be an electric bath, or a bubble bath, or even a lava bath…
et: Miks, see võib olla elektrivann või mullivann või isegi laavavann...

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_HotSpringsClaims
en: They're claiming that these hot springs are good for calming nervous tension, relieving aching muscles, solving romantic problems, and attracting money…
et: Nad väidavad, et need kuumaveeallikad on head närvipingete rahustamiseks, valutavate lihaste leevendamiseks, romantiliste probleemide lahendamiseks ja raha ligimeelitamiseks...

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_TownSign
en: LAVARIDGE TOWN
et: LAVARIDGE TOWN

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_TownSign
en: “POKéMON CENTER HOT SPRINGS An excellent place for relaxing!”
et: "POKéMON CENTER HOT SPRINGS An suurepärane koht lõõgastumiseks!"

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_GymSign
en: LAVARIDGE TOWN POKéMON GYM LEADER: FLANNERY “One with a fiery passion that burns!”
et: LAVARIDGE TOWN POKéMON SAALI JUHT: FLANNERY "Üks tulise kirega, mis põleb!"

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_HerbShopSign
en: POKéMON HERB SHOP “Bitter taste--better cure!”
et: POKéMON HERB SHOP "Mõru maitse--parem ravi!"

label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_1F_Text_CharlieIntro
en: What's so funny about having my inner tube aboard the ship?
et: Mis selles nii naljakat on, et mu sisemine toru laeva pardal on?

label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_1F_Text_CharlieDefeat
en: Whoa, you overwhelmed me!
et: Sa valdasid mind!

label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_1F_Text_CharliePostBattle
en: It's not easy throwing POKé BALLS while hanging on to an inner tube!
et: See ei ole lihtne visata POKé BALLS samal ajal riputada sisemise toru!

label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_1F_Text_IsntItFunHere
en: Isn't it fun here? I get excited just being here!
et: Kas siin pole lõbus? Ma erutun lihtsalt siin olemisest!

label: MauvilleCity_Mart_Text_ItemsToTemporarilyElevateStats
en: There are items that temporarily elevate the stats of POKéMON.
et: On esemeid, mis ajutiselt tõstavad POKéMON statsid.

label: MauvilleCity_Mart_Text_ItemsToTemporarilyElevateStats
en: The ones I know you use in battle are X ATTACK and X DEFEND…
et: Need, mida ma tean, et sa lahingus kasutad, on X ATTACK ja X DEFEND...

label: MauvilleCity_Mart_Text_ItemsToTemporarilyElevateStats
en: I do believe that there are others like them.
et: Ma usun küll, et selliseid on teisigi.

label: MauvilleCity_Mart_Text_DecisionsDetermineBattle
en: Use a certain move, or use an item instead…
et: Kasuta teatud võtet või kasuta hoopis eset...

label: MauvilleCity_Mart_Text_DecisionsDetermineBattle
en: The TRAINER's decisions determine how battles turn out, I think.
et: TRAINER otsused määravad, kuidas lahingud välja tulevad, ma arvan.

label: FortreeCity_Text_SawGiganticPokemonInSky
en: No one believes me, but I saw this gigantic POKéMON in the sky.
et: Keegi ei usu mind, aga ma nägin seda gigantset POKéMON taevas.

label: FortreeCity_Text_SawGiganticPokemonInSky
en: It seemed to squirm as it flew toward ROUTE 131.
et: See tundus kisklevat, kui see lendas ROUTE 131 poole.

label: FortreeCity_Text_SawGiganticPokemonInSky
en: By the way… Sniff… Um… You, uh…smell singed.
et: Muide, nuusuta... sa, uh...lõhn laulis.

label: FortreeCity_Text_SawGiganticPokemonInSky
en: Were you at a volcano or something?
et: Kas sa olid vulkaani juures vms?

label: FortreeCity_Text_SomethingBlockingGym
en: I want to go to the POKéMON GYM, but something's blocking the way.
et: Tahan minna POKéMON SAAL aga miski blokeerib teed.

label: FortreeCity_Text_SomethingBlockingGym
en: After all the bother I went through training on ROUTE 120…
et: Peale kõike viitsimist läbisin koolituse ROUTE 120...

label: FortreeCity_Text_ThisTimeIllBeatWinona
en: I've got my pride-and-joy POKéMON with me. This time, I'll beat WINONA.
et: Mul on oma uhkus-ja-rõõm POKéMON kaasas. Seekord võidan WINONA.

label: FortreeCity_Text_TreesGrowByDrinkingRainwater
en: The ground absorbs rainwater, and trees grow by drinking that water…
et: Maapind imab vihmavett ja puud kasvavad seda vett juues...

label: FortreeCity_Text_TreesGrowByDrinkingRainwater
en: Our FORTREE CITY exists because there's both water and soil.
et: Meie FORTREE CITY on olemas, sest seal on nii vett kui mulda.

label: FortreeCity_Text_EveryoneHealthyAndLively
en: The CITY consists of homes built on trees.
et: CITY koosneb puudele ehitatud kodudest.

label: FortreeCity_Text_EveryoneHealthyAndLively
en: Perhaps because of that lifestyle, everyone is healthy and lively.
et: Ehk selle elustiili tõttu on kõik terved ja elavad.

label: FortreeCity_Text_EveryoneHealthyAndLively
en: Why, even myself--I feel as if I've grown thirty years younger.
et: Miks, isegi mina ise--mul on tunne, nagu oleksin kolmkümmend aastat nooremaks saanud.

label: FortreeCity_Text_BugPokemonComeThroughWindow
en: Living on top of trees is okay.
et: Puude peal elamine on okei.

label: FortreeCity_Text_BugPokemonComeThroughWindow
en: But sometimes BUG POKéMON come in through windows. It can be really startling.
et: Aga vahel tuleb BUG POKéMON läbi akende sisse. See võib olla tõesti ehmatav.

label: FortreeCity_Text_PokemonThatEvolveWhenTraded
en: There are POKéMON that evolve when you trade them! That's what I heard.
et: On olemas POKéMON, mis arenevad, kui nendega kaubelda! Seda ma kuulsin.

label: FortreeCity_Text_SomethingUnseeable
en: Something unseeable is in the way.
et: Midagi nähtamatut on ees.

label: FortreeCity_Text_UnseeableUseDevonScope
en: Something unseeable is in the way.
et: Midagi nähtamatut on ees.

label: FortreeCity_Text_UnseeableUseDevonScope
en: Want to use the DEVON SCOPE?
et: Tahad kasutada DEVON SCOPE?

label: FortreeCity_Text_UsedDevonScopePokemonFled
en: {PLAYER} used the DEVON SCOPE.
et: {PLAYER} kasutas DEVON SCOPE.

label: FortreeCity_Text_UsedDevonScopePokemonFled
en: An invisible POKéMON became completely visible!
et: Nähtamatu POKéMON muutus täiesti nähtavaks!

label: FortreeCity_Text_UsedDevonScopePokemonFled
en: The startled POKéMON fled!
et: Ehmunud POKéMON põgenes!

label: FortreeCity_Text_CitySign
en: FORTREE CITY “The treetop city that frolics with nature.”
et: FORTREE CITY "Loodusega hullav puulatvalinn".

label: FortreeCity_Text_GymSign
en: FORTREE CITY POKéMON GYM LEADER: WINONA
et: FORTREE CITY POKéMON SAALI JUHT: WINONA

label: FortreeCity_Text_GymSign
en: “The bird user taking flight into the world.”
et: "Linnukasutaja, kes lendab maailma."

label: MtPyre_5F_Text_AtsushiIntro
en: Teacher… Please watch over my progress!
et: Õpetaja... Palun jälgige minu edusamme!

label: MtPyre_5F_Text_AtsushiDefeat
en: Teacher… Please forgive me!
et: Õpetaja... palun andesta mulle!

label: MtPyre_5F_Text_AtsushiPostBattle
en: Until I improve, my teacher, who rests here, will never find true peace…
et: Kuni ma paranen, ei leia mu õpetaja, kes siin puhkab, kunagi tõelist rahu...

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_WelcomeToBattleFrontier
en: SCOTT: Well, hello and welcome! Heheh… Sorry about the cramped space.
et: SCOTT: Noh, tere ja tere tulemast! Vabandust kitsa ruumi pärast.

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_WelcomeToBattleFrontier
en: Anyway, {PLAYER}{KUN}, let me formally welcome you to the BATTLE FRONTIER.
et: Igatahes {PLAYER}{KUN}, las ma ametlikult tervitan sind BATTLE FRONTIER.

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_WelcomeToBattleFrontier
en: This is my dream come true. It took me years and years, but I've finally given shape to my dream.
et: See on minu unistus. See võttis mul aega aastaid ja aastaid, aga ma olen lõpuks oma unistusele kuju andnud.

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_HowMuchEffortItTookToMakeReal
en: On reflection, it was a terribly long journey…
et: Mõttekäigul oli see kohutavalt pikk teekond...

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_HowMuchEffortItTookToMakeReal
en: I left home alone on a quest to find strong TRAINERS.
et: Jätsin kodu üksi otsingule, et leida tugev TRAINERS.

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_HowMuchEffortItTookToMakeReal
en: No one can imagine how much effort or time it took to make this real.
et: Keegi ei kujuta ette, kui palju vaeva või aega kulus selle reaalseks tegemiseks.

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_HaveThisAsMementoOfOurPathsCrossing
en: But that's all in the past. No point dwelling on that!
et: Aga see on kõik minevikus. Pole mõtet selle peale elada!

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_HaveThisAsMementoOfOurPathsCrossing
en: All I want for you is to enjoy battling to your heart's content here.
et: Ma tahan, et sa võitleksid oma südame sisuga.

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_HaveThisAsMementoOfOurPathsCrossing
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}, I want you to have this as a memento for all the time our paths crossed on our journeys.
et: {PLAYER} {KUN}, ma tahan, et teil oleks see meene kogu aeg meie teed ristusid meie reisidel.

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_ObtainedXBattlePoints
en: {PLAYER} obtained {STR_VAR_1} Battle Point(s).
et: {PLAYER} saadud {STR_VAR_1} Battle Point (id).

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_ExplainBattlePoints
en: SCOTT: You can check your Battle Points on your FRONTIER PASS.
et: SCOTT: Te saate kontrollida oma lahingupunkte oma FRONTIER PASS.

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_ExplainBattlePoints
en: The more success you have here at the BATTLE FRONTIER, the more Battle Points you will collect.
et: Mida rohkem edu teil siin on BATTLE FRONTIER, seda rohkem Battle Points te kogute.

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_ExplainBattlePoints
en: Use your Battle Points the way you see fit, like trading them for items.
et: Kasutage oma Battle Points'i nii, nagu peate sobivaks, näiteks kauplege nendega esemete vastu.

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_ExpectingGreatThings
en: I'm expecting great things from you!
et: Ootan sinult suuri asju!

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_WhyIGoSeekingTrainers
en: SCOTT: Every TRAINER is an individual. They all lead lives of their own.
et: SCOTT: Iga TRAINER on indiviid. Nad kõik juhivad oma elu.

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_WhyIGoSeekingTrainers
en: But when they're in a battle, it doesn't matter who they are.
et: Aga kui nad on lahingus, siis pole vahet, kes nad on.

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_WhyIGoSeekingTrainers
en: They're all the same!
et: Need on kõik ühesugused!

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_WhyIGoSeekingTrainers
en: I love the purity of battle, where everyone is equal.
et: Armastan lahingu puhtust, kus kõik on võrdsed.

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_WhyIGoSeekingTrainers
en: That's why I go everywhere seeking TRAINERS who are serious about battling, and invite them here.
et: Sellepärast käin ma igal pool otsimas TRAINERS kes tõsiselt võitlevad, ja kutsun nad siia.

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_HaveYouMetFrontierBrain
en: SCOTT: Have you met any of the FRONTIER BRAINS?
et: SCOTT: Kas olete kohanud mõnda FRONTIER BRAINS?

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_HaveYouMetFrontierBrain
en: Better yet, have you obtained any symbols from them?
et: Veel parem, kas olete neilt mingeid sümboleid saanud?

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_HaveYouMetFrontierBrain
en: I handpicked the FRONTIER BRAINS as the toughest TRAINERS anywhere.
et: Võtsin kätte FRONTIER BRAINS kui kõige kõvema TRAINERS igal pool.

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_HaveYouMetFrontierBrain
en: But I'm sure that seeing how tough you are will startle even them!
et: Aga ma olen kindel, et nägemine, kui karm sa oled, ehmatab isegi neid!

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_MayFindWildMonsInFrontier
en: SCOTT: You don't just train for battle, right?
et: SCOTT: Sa ei treeni ainult lahinguks, eks?

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_MayFindWildMonsInFrontier
en: I think I remember you working on a POKéDEX as well.
et: Ma arvan, et ma mäletan, et sa töötasid ka POKéDEX peal.

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_MayFindWildMonsInFrontier
en: Well, guess what?
et: No arvake ära, mis?

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_MayFindWildMonsInFrontier
en: You may run into wild POKéMON in the BATTLE FRONTIER somewhere… Fufufu!
et: Sa võid sattuda metsikusse POKéMON BATTLE FRONTIER kuskile... Fufufu!

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_YouveCollectedAllSilverSymbols
en: SCOTT: Are you enjoying things in the BATTLE FRONTIER?
et: SCOTT: Kas te naudite asju BATTLE FRONTIER?

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_YouveCollectedAllSilverSymbols
en: …Wait a second… Oh!
et: ...oota korraks... oh!

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_YouveCollectedAllSilverSymbols
en: Your FRONTIER PASS! You've collected the full set of silver symbols!
et: Sinu FRONTIER PASS! Sa oled kogunud täiskomplekti hõbesümboleid!

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_YouveCollectedAllSilverSymbols
en: That's more than impressive! You are tough, just as I suspected!
et: See on enam kui muljetavaldav! Sa oled karm, nii nagu ma kahtlustasin!

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_YouveCollectedAllSilverSymbols
en: Normally, I wouldn't do something like this, but this is a special time!
et: Tavaliselt ma midagi sellist ei teeks, aga praegu on eriline aeg!

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_YouveCollectedAllSilverSymbols
en: I want you to have this. I'm sure you can put it to proper use.
et: Ma tahan, et sul oleks see olemas. Kindlasti saab panna korralikku kasutusse.

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_YouveCollectedAllGoldSymbols
en: SCOTT: I hope you're enjoying everything in the BATTLE FRONTIER.
et: SCOTT: Loodan, et naudite kõike BATTLE FRONTIER.

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_YouveCollectedAllGoldSymbols
en: …Wait a second… Oh, my disbelieving eyes!
et: ...oota teist...oh, mu uskmatud silmad!

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_YouveCollectedAllGoldSymbols
en: Your FRONTIER PASS! You've gathered up the full set of gold symbols!
et: Sinu FRONTIER PASS! Olete kokku kogunud kuldsümbolite täiskomplekti!

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_YouveCollectedAllGoldSymbols
en: That's more than stupendous! You're incredible, just as I suspected!
et: See on enam kui uimane! Sa oled uskumatu, nii nagu ma kahtlustasin!

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_YouveCollectedAllGoldSymbols
en: {PLAYER}, you've got to accept this!
et: {PLAYER}, sa pead sellega leppima!

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_YouveCollectedAllGoldSymbols
en: I think you will be able to appreciate the value of my gift!
et: Ma arvan, et te oskate hinnata minu kingituse väärtust!

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_SoGladIBroughtYouHere
en: I must say I have the gift of knowing a good TRAINER when I see one.
et: Ma pean ütlema, et mul on kingitus teada head TRAINER kui ma näen seda.

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_SoGladIBroughtYouHere
en: I'm so glad I had the foresight to bring you here!
et: Mul on nii hea meel, et mul oli ettenägelikkus teid siia tuua!

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_BerryPocketStuffed
en: Your BERRY POCKET seems to be stuffed.
et: Sinu BERRY POCKET tundub olevat topitud.

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_Beat50TrainersInARow
en: SCOTT: Oh, I heard about you! How you ruled the BATTLE TOWER! You beat over 50 TRAINERS in a row?
et: SCOTT: Oh, ma kuulsin sinust! Kuidas sa valitsesid BATTLE TOWER! Sa peksid üle 50 TRAINERS järjest?

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_Beat50TrainersInARow
en: That's fantastic! I want you to have this!
et: See on fantastiline! Ma tahan, et sul oleks see olemas!

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_Beat100TrainersInARow
en: SCOTT: Oh, my! I heard about you! How you overwhelmed the BATTLE TOWER! You beat over 100 TRAINERS in a row?
et: SCOTT: Oh, minu! Ma kuulsin sinust! Kuidas sa BATTLE TOWER ülekoormatud olid! Sa peksid üle 100 TRAINERS järjest?

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_Beat100TrainersInARow
en: That's ridiculously spectacular! You've got to have this!
et: See on naeruväärselt suurejooneline! Sul peab see olema!

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_ExpectingToHearEvenGreaterThings
en: I'll be expecting to hear even greater things about you now!
et: Ootan teie kohta nüüd veel suuremaid asju kuulda!

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_ComeBackForThisLater
en: Oops, well, if you have too much stuff, come back for this later.
et: Oops, no kui sul on liiga palju asju, siis tule selleks hiljem tagasi.

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_MeteoriteWillNeverBeMineNow
en: PROF. COZMO: Oh… I never should have let myself be conned into telling TEAM MAGMA where you can find METEORITES…
et: PROF. COZMO: Oh... ma ei oleks kunagi pidanud laskma end konutada jutustama TEAM MAGMA kust leiad METEORITES...

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_MeteoriteWillNeverBeMineNow
en: That METEORITE from METEOR FALLS… It's never going to be mine now…
et: See METEORITE alates METEOR FALLS... See ei saa nüüd kunagi minu...

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_IsThatMeteoriteMayIHaveIt
en: Oh! Hah?
et: Oh! Hah?

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_IsThatMeteoriteMayIHaveIt
en: That item…
et: See ese...

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_IsThatMeteoriteMayIHaveIt
en: Could it be?
et: Kas võib olla?

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_IsThatMeteoriteMayIHaveIt
en: Is it the METEORITE that TEAM MAGMA took from METEOR FALLS?
et: Kas see on METEORITE, mille TEAM MAGMA võttis METEOR FALLS?

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_IsThatMeteoriteMayIHaveIt
en: Please, may I have it?
et: Palun, kas ma võin seda saada?

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_IsThatMeteoriteMayIHaveIt
en: I'm not asking for it for free. How about in exchange for this TM?
et: Ma ei küsi seda tasuta. Kuidas oleks selle TM vastu?

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_PleaseUseThisTM
en: PROF. COZMO: This TM, it represents my feeling of gratitude. Please use it!
et: PROF. COZMO: See TM, see esindab minu tänutunnet. Palun kasutage seda!

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_ReallyGoingToHelpMyResearch
en: PROF. COZMO: Oh, I can't believe it. This is really, really great!
et: PROF. COZMO: Oh, ma ei suuda seda uskuda. See on tõesti, tõesti suurepärane!

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_ReallyGoingToHelpMyResearch
en: This is really going to help my research!
et: See aitab tõesti mu uurimistööd teha!

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_CrushedWithDisappointment
en: PROF. COZMO: Oh, but… I'm crushed with disappointment…
et: PROF. COZMO: Oh, aga... ma olen pettunud...

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_MayIHaveMeteorite
en: PROF. COZMO: Please, may I have that METEORITE?
et: PROF. COZMO: Palun, kas mul võib olla see METEORITE?

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_MayIHaveMeteorite
en: I'm not asking for it for free. How about in exchange for this TM?
et: Ma ei küsi seda tasuta. Kuidas oleks selle TM vastu?

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_CozmoWentToMeteorFalls
en: PROF. COZMO went off to METEOR FALLS on ROUTE 114 with some people from TEAM MAGMA.
et: PROF. COZMO läks METEOR FALLS peale ROUTE 114 mõne inimesega TEAM MAGMA peale.

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_FeelSorryForCozmo
en: Poor PROF. COZMO… He's so depressed… I feel sorry for him.
et: Vaene PROF. COZMO... Ta on nii masenduses... mul on temast kahju.

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_CozmoIsSoHappy
en: Look at PROF. COZMO… He's so happy! I think it's cute.
et: Vaata PROF. COZMO... Ta on nii õnnelik! Minu meelest on see armas.

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt11Intro
en: I want to see GROUDON, too, but they won't let me see even its tail…
et: Ma tahan ka GROUDON näha, aga nad ei lase mul isegi selle saba näha...

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt11Intro
en: It's got me feeling really frustrated.
et: Mul on tunne, et olen väga pettunud.

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt11Intro
en: Oh, no! I blabbed about GROUDON!
et: Oh ei! Lömastasin umbes GROUDON!

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt11Defeat
en: I guess it's impossible to win if one doesn't have a calm mind…
et: Ilmselt on võimatu võita, kui ühel pole rahulikku meelt...

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt11PostBattle
en: I wonder if GROUDON even has a tail?
et: Huvitav, kas GROUDON on isegi saba?

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt12Intro
en: Fuhahaha! Soon! Very soon! Our grand objective will be achieved!
et: Fuhahaha! Varsti! Väga varsti! Meie suur eesmärk saavutatakse!

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt12Defeat
en: Grrr… I've come so far, but now this?
et: Grrr... ma olen nii kaugele jõudnud, aga nüüd see?

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt12PostBattle
en: MAXIE, sir! An intruder is headed your way!
et: MAXIE, sir! Sissetungija suundub sinu poole!

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt13Intro
en: You're not finished yet! You're not getting by me easily!
et: Sa ei ole veel lõpetanud! Sa ei saa minust lihtsalt mööda!

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt13Defeat
en: Was I that easy to knock down?
et: Kas mind oli nii lihtne maha lüüa?

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt13PostBattle
en: C-come on, one more match…
et: C-tule, üks vaste veel...

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_TabithaIntro
en: Hehehe! You made it this far, so I'll tell you!
et: Hehehe! Sa jõudsid siiamaani, nii et ma ütlen!

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_TabithaIntro
en: That's right! Up ahead, GROUDON is sleeping!
et: See on õige! Üleval, GROUDON magab!

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_TabithaIntro
en: MAXIE went to GROUDON just seconds ago!
et: MAXIE läks GROUDON vaid sekundeid tagasi!

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_TabithaIntro
en: It's going to awaken real soon! Hehe! Hehehe!
et: See ärkab õige pea! Hehe! Hehehe!

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_TabithaDefeat
en: Taken down again… Hehe…
et: Jälle maha võetud... hehe...

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_TabithaPostBattle
en: …And while you wasted time with me, MAXIE should have awakened GROUDON…
et: ...Ja samas kui sa minuga aega raiskasid, siis MAXIE oleks pidanud ärkama GROUDON...

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieAwakenGroudon
en: MAXIE: GROUDON…
et: MAXIE: GROUDON...

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieAwakenGroudon
en: Nothing could awaken you from your sleep bathed in magma…
et: Miski ei suutnud sind unest äratada, mis sukeldus magmas...

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieAwakenGroudon
en: This BLUE ORB is what you sought. Wasn't it?
et: See BLUE ORB on see, mida otsisite. Kas polnud?

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieAwakenGroudon
en: I have brought you the BLUE ORB. Let its shine awaken you!
et: Olen toonud teile BLUE ORB. Las selle sära äratab sind!

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieAwakenGroudon
en: And show me… Show me the full extent of your power!
et: Ja näita mulle... näita mulle oma võimu täielikku ulatust!

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieGroudonWhatsWrong
en: MAXIE: GROUDON! What's wrong?
et: MAXIE: GROUDON! Mis viga on?

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieGroudonWhatsWrong
en: Wasn't the BLUE ORB the key?
et: Kas võti polnud mitte BLUE ORB?

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieGroudonWhatsWrong
en: GROUDON! Where have you gone…
et: GROUDON! Kuhu sa läinud oled...

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieOhItWasYou
en: MAXIE: Oh, so it was you?
et: MAXIE: Oh, nii et see olid sina?

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieOhItWasYou
en: I've seen you poking around uninvited here and there…
et: Ma olen sind siin-seal kutsumata ringi tuhnimas näinud...

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieOhItWasYou
en: I get it now! You must have pulled a cheap stunt!
et: Ma saan nüüd aru! Ilmselt tõmbasid odava triki!

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieDefeat
en: What makes you so adept at handling POKéMON?
et: Mis teeb sind nii osavaks POKéMON käsitsemisel?

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieImGoingAfterGroudon
en: MAXIE: There has to be some reason why GROUDON fled…
et: MAXIE: Peab olema mingi põhjus, miks GROUDON põgenes...

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieImGoingAfterGroudon
en: That's what you're trying to say, aren't you?
et: Seda sa ju püüadki öelda?

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieImGoingAfterGroudon
en: Humph… You think I didn't know that?
et: Sa arvad, et ma ei teadnud seda?

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieImGoingAfterGroudon
en: With GROUDON gone, there is no longer any need for this blasted volcano.
et: Mis GROUDON läinud, ei ole enam vaja seda lõhkanud vulkaani.

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieImGoingAfterGroudon
en: I am going after GROUDON, so this is where we part!
et: Ma lähen pärast GROUDON, nii et siin me osaleme!

label: RustboroCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PokemonHavePersonalities
en: My POKéMON has a NAIVE nature, and my friend's has a JOLLY nature.
et: Minu POKéMON on NAIVE loodus ja minu sõbral on JOLLY loodus.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PokemonHavePersonalities
en: It's fascinating how POKéMON have personalities!
et: See on põnev, kuidas POKéMON on isiksused!

label: RustboroCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_MaleAndFemalePokemon
en: Just like people, there are male and female POKéMON.
et: Nii nagu inimesed, on ka mees ja naine POKéMON.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_MaleAndFemalePokemon
en: But no one seems to have any idea how they're different.
et: Aga tundub, et kellelgi pole aimugi, kuidas nad teistmoodi on.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HMCutNextDoor
en: The man next door gave me an HM!
et: Kõrvalolev mees andis mulle HM!

label: RustboroCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HMCutNextDoor
en: I used it to teach my POKéMON how to CUT down skinny trees.
et: Kasutasin seda selleks, et õpetada oma POKéMON kuidas CUT alla kõhnasid puid.

label: Route121_Text_OkayMoveOutToMtPyre
en: Okay! We're to move out to MT. PYRE!
et: Olgu! Me peame välja kolima MT. PYRE!

label: Route121_Text_AheadLoomsMtPyre
en: Ahead looms MT. PYRE…
et: Pea kangastub MT. PYRE...

label: Route121_Text_AheadLoomsMtPyre
en: It is a natural monument to the spirits of departed POKéMON…
et: See on loodusmälestis lahkunud POKéMON vaimudele...

label: Route121_Text_MtPyrePierSign
en: MT. PYRE PIER
et: MT. PYRE PIER

label: Route121_Text_MtPyrePierSign
en: …The sign is old and worn out. The words are barely legible…
et: ...märk on vana ja kulunud. Sõnad on vaevu loetavad...

label: Route121_Text_SafariZoneSign
en: “Filled with rare POKéMON!” SAFARI ZONE
et: "Täidetud haruldase POKéMON!" SAFARI ZONE

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_2F_Text_ShipDesignMoreLikeBuilding
en: Designing a large ship is more like making a big building than putting together a transportation vehicle.
et: Suure laeva projekteerimine on pigem suure hoone tegemine kui transpordivahendi kokkupanek.

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_2F_Text_FloatsBecauseBuoyancy
en: Don't you think it's strange that a ship made of heavy iron floats?
et: Kas te ei pea imelikuks, et raskest rauast valmistatud laev hõljub?

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_2F_Text_FloatsBecauseBuoyancy
en: It floats because of a principle called buoyancy.
et: See hõljub põhimõtte pärast, mida nimetatakse ujuvuseks.

label: Route119_Text_MayIntro
en: MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}! Where were you? I was looking for you!
et: MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}! Kus sa olid? Ma otsisin sind!

label: Route119_Text_MayIntro
en: How much stronger have you gotten? Let me check for you!
et: Kui palju tugevamaks oled saanud? Las ma kontrollin sind!

label: Route119_Text_MayIntro
en: Ready with your POKéMON? Of course you are! Go!
et: Valmis oma POKéMON? Muidugi oled! Mine!

label: Route119_Text_MayDefeat
en: Achah! {PLAYER}{KUN}, you're strong!
et: Ahhah! {PLAYER} {KUN}, sa oled tugev!

label: Route119_Text_MayDefeat
en: I was worried that you might be struggling with your training.
et: Ma muretsesin, et sa võid oma treeningutega hädas olla.

label: Route119_Text_MayPresentForYou
en: MAY: But I had absolutely nothing to worry about! Keep it up!
et: MAY: Aga mul polnud absoluutselt midagi muretseda! Hoidke seda üleval!

label: Route119_Text_MayPresentForYou
en: And, here! I have a present for you.
et: Ja, siin! Mul on teile kingitus.

label: Route119_Text_MayExplainFly
en: MAY: Use FLY, and your POKéMON will instantly carry you to any town you've already visited.
et: MAY: Kasutage FLY ja teie POKéMON kannab teid koheselt igasse linna, mida olete juba külastanud.

label: Route119_Text_MayExplainFly
en: But, to use FLY, you have to get the GYM BADGE from FORTREE CITY. That's important, so don't forget.
et: Aga FLY kasutamiseks tuleb SAAL MÄRK saada FORTREE CITY pealt. See on oluline, nii et ära unusta.

label: Route119_Text_MayExplainFly
en: You should FLY home and visit LITTLEROOT for a change.
et: Peaksite FLY koju ja külastama LITTLEROOT vahelduseks.

label: Route119_Text_MayExplainFly
en: I bet your mom's worried about you, {PLAYER}{KUN}.
et: Ma vean kihla, et su ema muretseb sinu pärast, {PLAYER} {KUN}.

label: Route119_Text_MayExplainFly
en: Well, let's meet again somewhere!
et: No kohtume jälle kuskil!

label: Route119_Text_BrendanIntro
en: BRENDAN: {PLAYER}! So this is where you've been looking for POKéMON?
et: BRENDAN: {PLAYER}! Siit siis oled otsinud POKéMON?

label: Route119_Text_BrendanIntro
en: Let me see how good you got. I'll test you!
et: Las ma vaatan, kui hea sul oli. Ma katsetan sind!

label: Route119_Text_BrendanIntro
en: Now! It's a battle, so battle!
et: Nüüd! See on lahing, nii et lahing!

label: Route119_Text_BrendanDefeat
en: Hmm… You've gotten pretty darn decent.
et: Sa oled päris korralikuks muutunud.

label: Route119_Text_BrendanIllGiveYouThis
en: BRENDAN: I'd say you're good enough to search for POKéMON anywhere.
et: BRENDAN: Ma ütleks, et sa oled piisavalt hea, et otsida POKéMON kuskilt.

label: Route119_Text_BrendanIllGiveYouThis
en: Here, I'll give you this. Try it out.
et: Siin ma annan sulle selle. Proovi järgi.

label: Route119_Text_BrendanExplainFly
en: BRENDAN: Use FLY, and your POKéMON instantly carries you to any town you've already visited.
et: BRENDAN: Kasutage FLY ja teie POKéMON kannab teid koheselt igasse linna, mida olete juba külastanud.

label: Route119_Text_BrendanExplainFly
en: But you need the FORTREE GYM BADGE to do that.
et: Aga selleks on vaja FORTREE SAAL MÄRK selleks.

label: Route119_Text_BrendanExplainFly
en: Anyway, I have to move along.
et: Igatahes pean kaasa liikuma.

label: Route119_Text_ScottWayToGoBeSeeingYou
en: SCOTT: Hahahah! Way to go, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
et: SCOTT: Hahahah! Tee minna, {PLAYER}{KUN}!

label: Route119_Text_ScottWayToGoBeSeeingYou
en: I just passed by a TRAINER riding a BIKE.
et: Möödusin just TRAINER ratsutamisest BIKE.

label: Route119_Text_ScottWayToGoBeSeeingYou
en: You just beat that TRAINER, didn't you? It was pretty obvious that you did.
et: Sa lihtsalt peksid seda TRAINER, kas pole? See oli päris ilmne, et sa tegid.

label: Route119_Text_ScottWayToGoBeSeeingYou
en: The kid looked really upset with a face all red from anger.
et: Laps nägi vihast üleni punase näoga väga pahane välja.

label: Route119_Text_ScottWayToGoBeSeeingYou
en: I sure seem to run into you often. Are you off to FORTREE GYM next?
et: Kindlasti tundub, et satud tihti kokku. Kas oled järgmisena väljas FORTREE SAAL?

label: Route119_Text_ScottWayToGoBeSeeingYou
en: I expect that you'll do well at the GYM. Well, I'll be seeing you!
et: Eeldan, et sul läheb hästi SAAL. Eks ma siis kohtume!

label: Route119_Text_ScottYouWonAtFortreeGym
en: SCOTT: Hiya, {PLAYER}{KUN}, it's me!
et: SCOTT: Hiya, {PLAYER}{KUN}, see olen mina!

label: Route119_Text_ScottYouWonAtFortreeGym
en: Just as I thought, you won at the FORTREE GYM.
et: Nii nagu ma arvasin, võitsid sa FORTREE SAAL.

label: Route119_Text_ScottYouWonAtFortreeGym
en: Your strength… Perhaps you really are the TRAINER that I've been searching for.
et: Võib-olla oled sa tõesti see TRAINER, mida ma olen otsinud.

label: Route119_Text_ScottYouWonAtFortreeGym
en: Remember, you have a fan in me. I'll be cheering from the sidelines. Keep up the great work!
et: Pea meeles, et sul on minus fänn. Rõõmustan kõrvalt. Hoidke suurt tööd edasi!

label: Route119_Text_StayAwayFromWeatherInstitute
en: We're standing lookout here.
et: Me seisame siin valvel.

label: Route119_Text_StayAwayFromWeatherInstitute
en: Hey, you! Stay away from the WEATHER INSTITUTE. It's not safe.
et: Hei, sina! Hoia eemale WEATHER INSTITUTE. See ei ole ohutu.

label: Route119_Text_DontGoNearWeatherInstitute
en: Lookout duty is surprisingly boring.
et: Lookimiskohustus on üllatavalt igav.

label: Route119_Text_DontGoNearWeatherInstitute
en: Hey, you! Please don't go near the WEATHER INSTITUTE.
et: Hei, sina! Palun ärge minge WEATHER INSTITUTE lähedale.

label: Route119_Text_ThoughtFlyByCatchingBirdMons
en: I thought you FLY by catching a whole flock of BIRD POKéMON, and then hanging on to them somehow.
et: Ma arvasin, et sa FLY püüdes terve karja BIRD POKéMON ja siis rippus nende küljes kuidagi.

label: Route119_Text_ThoughtFlyByCatchingBirdMons
en: But it turns out there's an HM move called FLY!
et: Aga tuleb välja, et on olemas HM võte nimega FLY!

label: Route119_Text_ThoughtFlyByCatchingBirdMons
en: I wish I'd known about that a long time ago…
et: Oleks tahtnud sellest juba ammu teada...

label: Route119_Text_TallGrassSnaresBikeTires
en: Tch… It's a no-go…
et: Tch... see on ei-mine...

label: Route119_Text_TallGrassSnaresBikeTires
en: The tall grass snares BIKE tires. There's no way you can cycle here.
et: Kõrge rohi naelutab BIKE rehve. Siin ei saa kuidagi jalgrattaga sõita.

label: Route119_Text_CanYourMonMakeSecretBase
en: Can your POKéMON use its SECRET POWER on a big pile of grass and make a SECRET BASE?
et: Kas teie POKéMON saab kasutada oma SECRET POWER suurel rohuhunnikul ja teha SECRET BASE?

label: Route119_Text_RouteSignFortree
en: ROUTE 119 {RIGHT_ARROW} FORTREE CITY
et: ROUTE 119 {RIGHT_ARROW} FORTREE CITY

label: Route119_Text_WeatherInstitute
en: WEATHER INSTITUTE
et: WEATHER INSTITUTE

label: Route119_Text_TrainerTipsDecoration
en: TRAINER TIPS
et: TREENERI NIPID

label: Route119_Text_TrainerTipsDecoration
en: Up to sixteen decorations and furniture items can be placed in a SECRET BASE.
et: Kuni kuusteist kaunistust ja mööblieset saab paigutada SECRET BASE.

label: Route119_Text_TrainerTipsDecoration
en: Pick your favorite items and create your very own SECRET BASE exactly the way you want.
et: Vali oma lemmikesemed ja loo oma päris oma SECRET BASE täpselt nii, nagu soovid.

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_YouveEarnedHMDive
en: STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}…
et: STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}...

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_YouveEarnedHMDive
en: As you can see, there's not much here, but this is my home.
et: Nagu näha, pole siin suurt midagi, aga see on minu kodu.

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_YouveEarnedHMDive
en: Thank you for all that you've done.
et: Tänan teid kõige selle eest, mida olete teinud.

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_YouveEarnedHMDive
en: This is my token of appreciation. It's the HIDDEN MACHINE DIVE.
et: See on minu tunnustuse märk. See on HIDDEN MACHINE DIVE.

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_YouveEarnedHMDive
en: No need to be shy--you've earned this HM.
et: Pole vaja häbelik olla--sa oled selle HM ära teeninud.

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_ExplainDive
en: STEVEN: While you're using SURF, you should notice dark patches of water.
et: STEVEN: SURF kasutamise ajal peaksite märkama tumedaid veelaike.

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_ExplainDive
en: Use DIVE if you come to deep water like it. You'll drop to the seafloor.
et: Kasutage DIVE kui tulete sügavasse vette nagu see. Te langete merepõhja.

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_ExplainDive
en: When you want to come back up, use DIVE again.
et: Kui soovite tagasi tulla, kasutage uuesti DIVE.

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_ExplainDive
en: In some places, it won't be possible for you to surface, though.
et: Mõnes kohas ei ole sul siiski võimalik pinnale tõusta.

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_UnderwateCavernBetweenMossdeepSootopolis
en: STEVEN: Apparently, there's an underwater cavern between MOSSDEEP and SOOTOPOLIS.
et: STEVEN: Ilmselt on veealune koobas MOSSDEEP ja SOOTOPOLIS vahel.

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_UnderwateCavernBetweenMossdeepSootopolis
en: You know, the one that CAPT. STERN found in his submarine.
et: Tead küll, see, mis CAPT. STERN leiti tema allveelaevast.

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_TakeBallContainingBeldum
en: {PLAYER} checked the POKé BALL.
et: {PLAYER} kontrollis POKé BALL.

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_TakeBallContainingBeldum
en: It contained the POKéMON BELDUM.
et: See sisaldas POKéMON BELDUM.

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_TakeBallContainingBeldum
en: Take the POKé BALL?
et: Võta POKé BALL?

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_ObtainedBeldum
en: {PLAYER} obtained a BELDUM.
et: {PLAYER} sai BELDUM.

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_NoSpaceForAnotherMon
en: There is no space for another POKéMON.
et: Pole ruumi teise POKéMON jaoks.

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_LeftPokeBallWhereItWas
en: {PLAYER} left the POKé BALL where it was.
et: {PLAYER} jättis POKé BALL kus see oli.

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_LetterFromSteven
en: It's a letter.
et: See on kiri.

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_LetterFromSteven
en: To {PLAYER}{KUN}…
et: Et {PLAYER}{KUN}...

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_LetterFromSteven
en: I've decided to do a little soulsearching and train on the road.
et: Olen otsustanud teha väikese hingeotsingu ja treenida teel.

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_LetterFromSteven
en: I don't plan to return home for some time.
et: Ma ei plaani juba mõnda aega koju naasta.

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_LetterFromSteven
en: I have a favor to ask of you.
et: Mul on teene teilt küsida.

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_LetterFromSteven
en: I want you to take the POKé BALL on the desk.
et: Tahan, et võtaksite laual oleva POKé BALL.

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_LetterFromSteven
en: Inside it is a BELDUM, my favorite POKéMON.
et: Sees on BELDUM, minu lemmik POKéMON.

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_LetterFromSteven
en: I'm counting on you.
et: Ma loodan sulle.

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_LetterFromSteven
en: May our paths cross someday.
et: Kunagi ristugu meie teed.

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_LetterFromSteven
en: STEVEN STONE
et: STEVEN STONE

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_CollectionOfRareRocks
en: It's a collection of rare rocks and stones assembled by STEVEN.
et: See on haruldaste kivide ja kivide kollektsioon, mille on kokku pannud STEVEN.

label: SootopolisCity_House4_Text_AncientTreasuresWaitingInSea
en: Listen up, and I'll tell you something good.
et: Kuulake ja ma ütlen teile midagi head.

label: SootopolisCity_House4_Text_AncientTreasuresWaitingInSea
en: There's supposed to be an ancient ruin in the sea around here.
et: Siinkandis peaks olema iidne varemeis.

label: SootopolisCity_House4_Text_AncientTreasuresWaitingInSea
en: There could be treasures just waiting to be discovered down there.
et: Seal all võiks olla aarded, mis lihtsalt ootavad avastamist.

label: SootopolisCity_House4_Text_StrollUnderwaterWithPokemon
en: Ancient treasures…
et: Iidsed aarded...

label: SootopolisCity_House4_Text_StrollUnderwaterWithPokemon
en: It would be nice if they existed, but even if they didn't, it would be so beautiful to take an underwater stroll with my POKéMON.
et: Oleks tore, kui nad olemas oleksid, aga isegi kui nad seda ei teeks, oleks nii ilus võtta veealune jalutuskäik minu POKéMON-ga.

label: SootopolisCity_House4_Text_Azumarill
en: AZUMARILL: Marurii.
et: AZUMARILL: Marurii.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: Yo! How's it going, CHAMPIONbound {PLAYER}?
et: Yo! Kuidas läheb, TŠEMPIONbound {PLAYER}?

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: SOOTOPOLIS's GYM LEADER JUAN is a master of WATER-type POKéMON.
et: SOOTOPOLIS on SAALI JUHT JUAN on meister Vee-tüüpi POKéMON.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: And, to get to JUAN, an icy floor will hamper your progress…
et: Ja et jõuda JUAN juurde, takistab jäine põrand teie edusamme...

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: Listen, I'm sorry, but that's all the advice that I have for you.
et: Kuule, anna andeks, aga see on kõik see nõuanne, mis mul sinu jaoks on.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: The rest of the way, you have to go for it yourself!
et: Ülejäänud tee tuleb ise järgi minna!

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_GymGuidePostVictory
en: Yow! You've beaten even JUAN, who was supposedly the best in all HOENN!
et: Yow! Sa oled peksa saanud isegi JUAN, kes oli väidetavalt parim kõigis HOENN!

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_GymGuidePostVictory
en: Okay! Check out your TRAINER CARD.
et: Olgu! Vaata üle oma TRAINER CARD.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_GymGuidePostVictory
en: If you've gotten all the BADGES, you're set for the POKéMON LEAGUE challenge!
et: Kui oled saanud kõik MÄRGID, siis oled seatud POKéMON LIIGA väljakutsele!

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanIntro
en: Let me ask you. Did you know? Ah, I should not be so coy.
et: Las ma küsin. Kas teadsid? Ah, ma ei tohiks nii kobe olla.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanIntro
en: It was I who taught WALLACE everything there is to know about POKéMON.
et: Just mina õpetasin WALLACE kõike seal on teada POKéMON kohta.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanIntro
en: Once, I had given up my position as the GYM LEADER.
et: Kord olin loobunud oma positsioonist SAALI JUHT.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanIntro
en: In my place, I had entrusted WALLACE with the GYM.
et: Minu asemel olin usaldanud WALLACE SAAL.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanIntro
en: However, a compelling reason arose for me to make a comeback.
et: Siiski tekkis mul kaalukas põhjus comeback'i tegemiseks.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanIntro
en: Ah, but enough chatter. Let us begin our match, shall we?
et: Ah, aga piisavalt lobisemist. Alustagem oma vastet, kas pole?

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanIntro
en: Please, you shall bear witness to our artistry.
et: Palun, te annate tunnistust meie kunstilisusest.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanIntro
en: A grand illusion of water sculpted by POKéMON and myself!
et: Suurejooneline illusioon veest, mille skulptuuriks on POKéMON ja mina ise!

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanDefeat
en: Ahahaha, excellent! Very well, you are the winner.
et: Ahahaha, suurepärane! Väga hästi, sa oled võitja.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanDefeat
en: From you, I sense the brilliant shine of skill that will overcome all.
et: Sinust tajun hiilgavat vilumuse sära, mis saab kõigist üle.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanDefeat
en: However, compared with me or even WALLACE, you are lacking in elegance.
et: Kuid võrreldes minuga või isegi WALLACE, teil puudub elegants.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanDefeat
en: Perhaps I should make you a loan of my outfit?
et: Võib-olla peaksin sulle oma riietuse laenu tegema?

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanDefeat
en: Hahaha, I merely jest!
et: Hahaha, ma lihtsalt naljatlen!

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanDefeat
en: Rather than my clothes, I shall reward you with this, the RAIN BADGE!
et: Selle asemel, et oma riided, premeerin ma teid sellega, RAIN MÄRK!

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_ReceivedRainBadge
en: {PLAYER} received the RAIN BADGE from JUAN.
et: {PLAYER} sai RAIN MÄRK alates JUAN.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_ExplainRainBadgeTakeThis
en: Having the RAIN BADGE shall assure you the full obedience of all your POKéMON to your every command.
et: Omades RAIN MÄRK tagab teile täieliku kuulekuse kogu oma POKéMON igale käsule.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_ExplainRainBadgeTakeThis
en: The RAIN BADGE also allows the use of the HM move WATERFALL to scale walls of cascading water.
et: RAIN MÄRK võimaldab kasutada ka HM liikuda WATERFALL skaleerida seinad kaskaadvee.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_ExplainRainBadgeTakeThis
en: And, so that you never forget the battle we shared, take this…
et: Ja nii, et sa ei unusta kunagi lahingut, mida me jagasime, võta seda...

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_ExplainWaterPulse
en: The TECHNICAL MACHINE I handed you contains WATER PULSE.
et: TECHNICAL MACHINE I ulatatud sisaldab WATER PULSE.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_ExplainWaterPulse
en: In use, it will occasionally confuse the target with ultrasonic waves.
et: Kasutamisel ajab see sihtmärgi aeg-ajalt segamini ultrahelilainetega.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_RegisteredJuan
en: Registered GYM LEADER JUAN in the POKéNAV.
et: Registreerunud SAALI JUHT JUAN POKéNAV.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanPostBattle
en: The TRAINERS who have gathered all the GYM BADGES of HOENN should make way to the ultimate destination.
et: TRAINERS kes on kogunud kõik SAAL MÄRGID HOENN peaks tegema tee lõppsihtkohta.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanPostBattle
en: The POKéMON LEAGUE.
et: POKéMON LIIGA.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanPostBattle
en: Travel to the easternmost reaches of HOENN, to the island EVER GRANDE.
et: Reisi idapoolseimatesse sihtkohtadesse HOENN, saarele EVER GRANDE.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanPostBattle
en: There, you shall find the POKéMON LEAGUE.
et: Sealt leiad POKéMON LIIGA.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_GoGetFortreeBadge
en: There remains but one BADGE to obtain in HOENN.
et: Jääb üle vaid üks MÄRK saada sisse HOENN.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_GoGetFortreeBadge
en: If you wish to challenge the POKéMON LEAGUE, you must obtain the last BADGE from the GYM in FORTREE.
et: Kui soovite vaidlustada POKéMON LIIGA, peate hankima viimase MÄRK SAAL FORTREE.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_GymStatue
en: SOOTOPOLIS CITY POKéMON GYM
et: SOOTOPOLIS CITY POKéMON SAAL

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_GymStatueCertified
en: SOOTOPOLIS CITY POKéMON GYM
et: SOOTOPOLIS CITY POKéMON SAAL

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_GymStatueCertified
en: JUAN'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS: {PLAYER}
et: JUAN'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS: {PLAYER}

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanPreRematch
en: JUAN: Ah, this GYM had returned to its usual state of serenity…
et: JUAN: Ah, see SAAL oli naasnud oma tavapärasesse rahuolekusse...

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanPreRematch
en: But our young typhoon has returned to put us to the test again!
et: Aga meie noor taifuun on tagasi tulnud, et meid taas proovile panna!

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanPreRematch
en: Well, my friend, most certainly!
et: Noh, mu sõber, kõige kindlamalt!

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanPreRematch
en: I shall be delighted to dance with you as often as you wish!
et: Mul on hea meel tantsida koos teiega nii tihti, kui soovite!

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanRematchDefeat
en: Ahahaha, you are the winner! You have defeated me again!
et: Ahahaha, sa oled võitja! Te olete mind jälle võitnud!

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanPostRematch
en: JUAN: If I told you to become my apprentice, you will refuse, I am sure.
et: JUAN: Kui ma ütlen teile, et saage minu õpipoisiks, siis te keeldute, ma olen kindel.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanPostRematch
en: I would like to make a gift of my coat to you.
et: Sooviksin teile teha kingituse oma mantlist.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanPostRematch
en: But again, you will refuse. I imagine that to be so.
et: Aga jällegi, te keeldute. Ma kujutan ette, et nii on.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanPostRematch
en: And that, my friend, is a certain sign of nobility!
et: Ja see, mu sõber, on teatud märk aadelkonnast!

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanRematchNeedTwoMons
en: JUAN: Ah, this GYM had returned to its usual state of serenity…
et: JUAN: Ah, see SAAL oli naasnud oma tavapärasesse rahuolekusse...

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanRematchNeedTwoMons
en: But our young typhoon has returned to put us to the test again!
et: Aga meie noor taifuun on tagasi tulnud, et meid taas proovile panna!

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanRematchNeedTwoMons
en: Well, my friend, most certainly! I shall be delighted to dance with you…
et: Noh, mu sõber, kõige kindlamalt! Mul on hea meel tantsida koos teiega...

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanRematchNeedTwoMons
en: Ah, no, no, no. You have with you but one POKéMON.
et: Ah ei, ei, ei. Sul on kaasas vaid üks POKéMON.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanRematchNeedTwoMons
en: I wish that you would return with two, perhaps more, POKéMON, please.
et: Soovin, et naaseksite kahe, võib-olla enamaga, POKéMON, palun.

label: Route110_Text_WeCantTalkAboutAquaActivities
en: TEAM AQUA's activities… We can't talk about them yet.
et: TEAM AQUA tegevus... Me ei saa neist veel rääkida.

label: Route110_Text_KickUpARuckus
en: I want to get going to SLATEPORT and kick up a ruckus!
et: Ma tahan minna SLATEPORT ja lüüa üles mürgel!

label: Route110_Text_MyFirstJobInAqua
en: This is my first job after joining TEAM AQUA. It's a little scary.
et: See on minu esimene töökoht pärast liitumist TEAM AQUA. See on natuke hirmutav.

label: Route110_Text_AquaActionsBringSmiles
en: TEAM AQUA's actions should bring smiles to people's faces!
et: TEAM AQUA tegevus peaks tooma naeratused inimeste näole!

label: Route110_Text_MayLetsBattle
en: MAY: Hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}, long time no see!
et: MAY: Tere, {PLAYER}{KUN}, kaua ei näe!

label: Route110_Text_MayLetsBattle
en: While I was searching for other POKéMON, my POKéMON grew stronger.
et: Samal ajal kui ma otsisin teisi POKéMON, muutus mu POKéMON tugevamaks.

label: Route110_Text_MayLetsBattle
en: So… How about a little battle?
et: Kuidas oleks väikese lahinguga?

label: Route110_Text_MayDefeated
en: Yikes! You're better than I expected!
et: Yikes! Sa oled parem, kui ootasin!

label: Route110_Text_MayTakeThis
en: MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}, you've been busy training, too, haven't you?
et: MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}, sa oled olnud hõivatud treeninguga ka, kas pole?

label: Route110_Text_MayTakeThis
en: I think you deserve a reward! This is from me!
et: Ma arvan, et sa väärid tasu! See on minu poolt!

label: Route110_Text_MayExplainItemfinder
en: MAY: That's an ITEMFINDER.
et: MAY: See on ITEMFINDER.

label: Route110_Text_MayExplainItemfinder
en: Try it out. If there is an item that's not visible, it emits a sound.
et: Proovi järgi. Kui on ese, mida ei ole näha, kiirgab see heli.

label: Route110_Text_MayExplainItemfinder
en: Okay, {PLAYER}{KUN}, let's meet again!
et: Okei, {PLAYER}{KUN}, kohtume uuesti!

label: Route110_Text_MayExplainItemfinder
en: I know it's a little silly coming from me, but I think you should train a lot harder for the next time.
et: Ma tean, et see on minu poolt natuke tobe tulek, aga ma arvan, et järgmiseks korraks peaks palju kõvemini treenima.

label: Route110_Text_BrendanLetsBattle
en: BRENDAN: Hey, {PLAYER}. So this is where you were. How's it going?
et: BRENDAN: Hei, {PLAYER}. Siin sa siis olidki. Kuidas läheb?

label: Route110_Text_BrendanLetsBattle
en: Have you been raising your POKéMON? I'll check for you.
et: Kas oled oma POKéMON tõstnud? Ma kontrollin sind.

label: Route110_Text_BrendanDefeated
en: Hmm… You're pretty good.
et: Sa oled päris hea.

label: Route110_Text_BrendanTakeThis
en: BRENDAN: {PLAYER}, you've trained without me noticing…
et: BRENDAN: {PLAYER}, sa oled treeninud ilma, et ma märkaksin...

label: Route110_Text_BrendanTakeThis
en: Good enough! Here, take this.
et: Piisavalt hea! Võta see ette.

label: Route110_Text_BrendanExplainItemfinder
en: BRENDAN: That's an ITEMFINDER.
et: BRENDAN: See on ITEMFINDER.

label: Route110_Text_BrendanExplainItemfinder
en: Use it to root around for items that aren't visible.
et: Kasuta seda selleks, et juurduda ümber esemete jaoks, mida ei ole näha.

label: Route110_Text_BrendanExplainItemfinder
en: If it senses something, it emits a sound.
et: Kui see midagi tajub, kiirgab see heli.

label: Route110_Text_BrendanExplainItemfinder
en: Anyway, I'm off to look for new POKéMON.
et: Igatahes olen ära, et uusi POKéMON otsida.

label: Route110_Text_RideBikeAtFullSpeed
en: Wouldn't it be great to ride a BIKE at full speed on CYCLING ROAD?
et: Kas poleks tore sõita BIKE täiskiirusel CYCLING ROAD?

label: Route110_Text_HairStreamsBehindMe
en: How do you like the way my ravencolored hair streams behind me?
et: Kuidas sulle meeldib see, kuidas mu ravencolored juuksed mu selja taga voogavad?

label: Route110_Text_HairStreamsBehindMe
en: I grew my hair out just for that.
et: Kasvatasin juuksed välja just selleks.

label: Route110_Text_YouGotBikeFromRydel
en: Oh, hey, you got that BIKE from RYDEL!
et: Oi, kuule, sa said selle BIKE alates RYDEL!

label: Route110_Text_YouGotBikeFromRydel
en: Oh, it's glaringly obvious. It says right on your bike…
et: Oh, see on silmipimestavalt ilmne. See ütleb otse su rattal...

label: Route110_Text_YouGotBikeFromRydel
en: RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,
et: RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,

label: Route110_Text_YouGotBikeFromRydel
en: RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,
et: RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,

label: Route110_Text_YouGotBikeFromRydel
en: RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,
et: RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,

label: Route110_Text_YouGotBikeFromRydel
en: RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,
et: RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,

label: Route110_Text_YouGotBikeFromRydel
en: RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL… That name's everywhere.
et: RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL... See nimi on kõikjal.

label: Route110_Text_YouGotBikeFromRydel
en: You should ride it around all over the place--it's good advertising!
et: Sellega peaks igal pool ringi sõitma-see on hea reklaam!

label: Route110_Text_TwoRoads
en: The two roads, one above, one below…
et: Kaks teed, üks eespool, üks allpool...

label: Route110_Text_TwoRoads
en: A road each for people and POKéMON. Perhaps that is right and fair.
et: Igaühe tee inimestele ja POKéMON. Võib-olla on see õige ja õiglane.

label: Route110_Text_WalkOnTheLowRoad
en: I don't have a BIKE, so I'll take a leisurely walk on the low road.
et: Mul ei ole BIKE, seega teen rahulikult jalutuskäigu madalal teel.

label: Route110_Text_BikeTechniques
en: Learning techniques will make BIKE riding even more fun.
et: Õppimisvõtted muudavad BIKE ratsutamise veelgi lõbusamaks.

label: Route110_Text_BikeTechniques
en: There are some places that you can reach only by using a BIKE technique.
et: On mõned kohad, kuhu jõuad ainult BIKE tehnika abil.

label: Route110_Text_WhichShouldIChoose
en: Which should I choose?
et: Kumba peaksin valima?

label: Route110_Text_WhichShouldIChoose
en: Make a beeline for MAUVILLE on CYCLING ROAD, or take the low road and look for POKéMON?
et: Tee beeline MAUVILLE peale CYCLING ROAD või võta madal tee ja otsi POKéMON?

label: Route110_Text_CyclingChallengeResultSummary
