en: Number of collisions: … … {STR_VAR_1}!
et: Kokkupõrgete arv: ... {STR_VAR_1}!

label: Route110_Text_CyclingChallengeResultSummary
en: Total time: … … {STR_VAR_2}!
et: Kogu aeg: ... {STR_VAR_2}!

label: Route110_Text_ChallengeReactionBest
en: Bravo! Splendid showing!
et: Bravo! Splendid näitamine!

label: Route110_Text_ChallengeReactionBest
en: Your love of cycling comes from deep within your heart. You've shaken me to my very soul!
et: Sinu armastus rattasõidu vastu tuleb sügavast südamest. Sa raputasid mind mu hingele!

label: Route110_Text_ChallengeReactionGood
en: Your technique is remarkable.
et: Sinu tehnika on tähelepanuväärne.

label: Route110_Text_ChallengeReactionGood
en: I suggest you speed up a bit while still avoiding collisions.
et: Soovitan teil natuke kiirendada, vältides siiski kokkupõrkeid.

label: Route110_Text_ChallengeReactionOk
en: I would consider you a work in progress.
et: Ma peaksin teid pooleliolevaks teoseks.

label: Route110_Text_ChallengeReactionOk
en: Still, I hope you don't forget the sheer pleasure of cycling.
et: Siiski loodan, et te ei unusta rattasõidu hõngu.

label: Route110_Text_ChallengeReactionBad
en: My word… Your cycling skills border on terrifying.
et: Sinu rattasõiduoskus piirneb hirmuäratavaga.

label: Route110_Text_ChallengeReactionBad
en: Most certainly, you need much more practice riding.
et: Kõige kindlamalt on vaja palju rohkem harjutada ratsutamist.

label: Route110_Text_ChallengeReactionWorst
en: …I am aghast…
et: ...olen ahastus...

label: Route110_Text_ChallengeReactionWorst
en: You're perhaps not cut out for this unfortunate cycling business.
et: Sa ei ole võib-olla välja lõigatud selle õnnetu jalgrattaäri jaoks.

label: Route110_Text_ChallengeReactionWorst
en: You ought to give serious thought to returning that BIKE to RYDEL.
et: Sa peaksid tõsiselt mõtlema tagasi, et BIKE to RYDEL.

label: Route110_Text_RatedForNumberOfCollisions
en: This is CYCLING ROAD.
et: See on CYCLING ROAD.

label: Route110_Text_RatedForNumberOfCollisions
en: If you were to ride from MAUVILLE to SLATEPORT on a MACH BIKE, you would be rated for the number of collisions and your total time.
et: Kui te sõidaksite MAUVILLE kuni SLATEPORT a MACH BIKE, siis oleks teil hinnatud kokkupõrgete arv ja kogu aeg.

label: Route110_Text_AlwaysAimHigher
en: Regardless of the results, I count on seeing more challenges from you. Always aim higher!
et: Olenemata tulemustest arvestan, et näen teilt rohkem väljakutseid. Sihi alati kõrgemale!

label: Route110_Text_AcroBikesDoNotQualify
en: On this CYCLING ROAD, those riding MACH BIKES are rated for their number of collisions and their total times.
et: Selle CYCLING ROAD alusel hinnatakse ratsutajaid MACH BIKES nende kokkupõrgete arvu ja nende üldaegade järgi.

label: Route110_Text_AcroBikesDoNotQualify
en: ACRO BIKES do not qualify for rating. They are easy to turn, so it's not fair.
et: ACRO BIKES ei kvalifitseeru reitingule. Neid on lihtne pöörata, nii et see ei ole õiglane.

label: Route110_Text_SlateportCitySign
en: ROUTE 110 {DOWN_ARROW} SLATEPORT CITY
et: ROUTE 110 {DOWN_ARROW} SLATEPORT CITY

label: Route110_Text_CyclingRoadSign
en: SEASIDE CYCLING ROAD
et: SEASIDE CYCLING ROAD

label: Route110_Text_AquaWasHere
en: “TEAM AQUA was here!”
et: "TEAM AQUA oli kohal!"

label: Route110_Text_AquaWasHere
en: Someone painted that onto this sign, but then someone else painted over it.
et: Keegi maalis selle sildi peale, aga siis maalis keegi teine selle üle.

label: Route110_Text_AquaWasHere
en: “TEAM MAGMA rules!” is what it says now.
et: "TEAM MAGMA reeglid!" on see, mida ta praegu ütleb.

label: Route110_Text_Route103Sign
en: ROUTE 110 {LEFT_ARROW} ROUTE 103
et: ROUTE 110 {LEFT_ARROW} ROUTE 103

label: Route110_Text_SeasideParkingSign
en: SEASIDE PARKING
et: SEASIDE PARKING

label: Route110_Text_MauvilleCitySign
en: ROUTE 110 {UP_ARROW} MAUVILLE CITY
et: ROUTE 110 {UP_ARROW} MAUVILLE CITY

label: Route110_Text_TrainerTipsPrlzSleep
en: TRAINER TIPS
et: TREENERI NIPID

label: Route110_Text_TrainerTipsPrlzSleep
en: The foe can be made helpless by paralyzing it or causing it to sleep.
et: Vaenlase võib muuta abituks, halvates selle või põhjustades selle magamise.

label: Route110_Text_TrainerTipsPrlzSleep
en: It is an important technique for POKéMON battles.
et: See on oluline tehnika POKéMON lahingute jaoks.

label: Route110_Text_TrainerTipsRegisterItems
en: TRAINER TIPS
et: TREENERI NIPID

label: Route110_Text_TrainerTipsRegisterItems
en: The items in the BAG can be reorganized by pressing SELECT.
et: Esemeid BAG saab ümber korraldada vajutades SELECT.

label: Route110_Text_TrickHouseSign
en: “Three steps {RIGHT_ARROW} and two steps {UP_ARROW} to reach the wondrous TRICK HOUSE.”
et: "Kolm sammu {RIGHT_ARROW} ja kaks sammu {UP_ARROW}, et jõuda imelise TRICK HOUSE".

label: Route110_Text_BestRecord
en: THE BEST RECORD TO DATE…
et: THE BEST RECORD TO DATE...

label: Route110_Text_BestRecord
en: No. of collisions: {STR_VAR_1}
et: Ei. kokkupõrgetest: {STR_VAR_1}

label: Route110_Text_BestRecord
en: Elapsed time: {STR_VAR_2}
et: Läinud aeg: {STR_VAR_2}

label: Route110_Text_ThereIsNoRecord
en: THE BEST RECORD TO DATE…
et: THE BEST RECORD TO DATE...

label: Route110_Text_ThereIsNoRecord
en: No one seems to have taken the challenge. There is no record…
et: Tundub, et keegi pole väljakutset vastu võtnud. Mingit arvestust ei ole...

label: Route110_Text_ImagineSeeingYouHere
en: PROF. BIRCH: Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}! Imagine seeing you here!
et: PROF. BIRCH: Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}! Kujutage ette, et näete siin!

label: Route110_Text_ImagineSeeingYouHere
en: And where might my {RIVAL} be?
et: Ja kus võiks olla minu {RIVAL}?

label: Route110_Text_HeardYouInstallMatchCall
en: Oh, I see! You two are running separately. Well, that's fine.
et: Oh, ma näen! Teie kaks jooksete eraldi. No sobib küll.

label: Route110_Text_HeardYouInstallMatchCall
en: Oh, yes, I heard that your POKéNAV had the MATCH CALL system installed.
et: Ahjaa, ma kuulsin, et su POKéNAV lasi paigaldada MATCH CALL süsteemi.

label: Route110_Text_HeardYouInstallMatchCall
en: Well, then, I should register you in my POKéNAV as well.
et: Noh, siis ma peaks sind registreerima ka oma POKéNAV-s.

label: Route110_Text_HeardYouInstallMatchCall
en: That way, even when we're apart, I can rate your POKéDEX anytime.
et: Nii, isegi kui me oleme lahus, saan ma hinnata teie POKéDEX igal ajal.

label: Route110_Text_RegisteredBirchInPokenav
en: Registered PROF. BIRCH in the POKéNAV.
et: Registreerunud PROF. BIRCH in POKéNAV.

label: Route110_Text_KeepAnEyeOutForRival
en: PROF. BIRCH: {PLAYER}{KUN}…
et: PROF. BIRCH: {PLAYER}{KUN}...

label: Route110_Text_KeepAnEyeOutForRival
en: Please keep an eye out for my {RIVAL}. … … … … … …
et: Palun hoidke silma peal minu {RIVAL}. ... ... ... ... ... ...

label: Route110_Text_KeepAnEyeOutForRival
en: Well, I had better get going. See you again, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
et: Noh, mul oli parem minna. Kohtumiseni taas, {PLAYER}{KUN}!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattleTowerSign
en: This is the BATTLE TOWER! Keep the win streak as the toughest TRAINER!
et: See on BATTLE TOWER! Hoia võidurõõmu kui kõige kõvemat TRAINER!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattlePalaceSign
en: This is the BATTLE PALACE! Keep your eyes on POKéMON battles!
et: See on BATTLE PALACE! Hoia silmad peal POKéMON lahingutel!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattleArenaSign
en: This is the BATTLE ARENA! Let the toughest teams gather!
et: See on BATTLE ARENA! Las kogunevad kõige kõvemad meeskonnad!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattlePyramidSign
en: This is the BATTLE PYRAMID! Advance through the Battle Quest!
et: See on BATTLE PYRAMID! Advance läbi Battle Quest!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_RankingHallSign
en: BATTLE FRONTIER RANKING HALL Set your sights on new records!
et: BATTLE FRONTIER RANKING HALL Set oma vaatamisväärsused uutel kirjetel!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ExchangeCornerSign
en: BATTLE POINT EXCHANGE SERVICE CORNER Exchange your Battle Points!
et: BATTLE POINT EXCHANGE SERVICE CORNER Exvahetage oma lahingupunkte!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattleTowerFeelsSpecial
en: Wow! It's huge!
et: Vau! See on tohutu!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattleTowerFeelsSpecial
en: The BATTLE TOWER feels special. It's different from the others.
et: BATTLE TOWER tundub eriline. See erineb teistest.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ConquerLeagueAndFrontier
en: My grand ambition is to conquer both the BATTLE FRONTIER and the POKéMON LEAGUE.
et: Minu suur ambitsioon on vallutada nii BATTLE FRONTIER kui ka POKéMON LIIGA.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ConquerLeagueAndFrontier
en: And if my dream comes true…
et: Ja kui mu unistus täitub...

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ConquerLeagueAndFrontier
en: I… I'm going to ask MIMI next door if she will be friends with me!
et: Ma... ma küsin MIMI kõrval, kas ta saab minuga sõbraks!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PyramidTooHarsh
en: The BATTLE PYRAMID's too harsh! I just can't make it to the top!
et: BATTLE PYRAMID on liiga karm! Ma lihtsalt ei jõua tippu!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PyramidTooHarsh
en: Since I'm out of options, maybe I can climb the outside…
et: Kuna mul võimalused otsas, siis ehk saan ka väljapoole ronida...

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ThriveInDarkness
en: I thrive in darkness… Yes… What is worthy of me? None other than the BATTLE PYRAMID…
et: Ma edenen pimeduses... Jah, mis on minu vääriline? Ei muud kui BATTLE PYRAMID...

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ThriveInDarkness
en: What say you to wandering in darkness and in utter and total desperation?
et: Mis sa ütled, et uitad pimeduses ja täielikus ja täielikus meeleheites?

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PutTogetherUltimateTeam
en: I didn't sleep for a week, but then I put together the ultimate team!
et: Nädal aega ei maganud, aga siis panin kokku ülima meeskonna!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PutTogetherUltimateTeam
en: I can't see myself losing, no joke. We're storming the BATTLE ARENA!
et: Ma ei näe ennast kaotamas, ei mingit nalja. Me tormame BATTLE ARENA!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_DidScottBringYouHere
en: Did SCOTT bring you here, too? What is it with that guy?
et: Kas SCOTT tõi sind ka siia? Mis värk selle tüübiga on?

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_DidScottBringYouHere
en: It sounds like he really does know how to spot talented TRAINERS, but…
et: Kõlab nagu ta tõesti oskaks märgata andekat TRAINERS, aga...

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_DidScottBringYouHere
en: I've never seen him battling in person ever.
et: Ma pole kunagi näinud teda isiklikult võitlemas.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BelieveInYouBuddy
en: ZIGG! I believe in you, little buddy!
et: ZIGG! Ma usun sinusse, väike semu!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BelieveInYouBuddy
en: I'll make my little ZIGG any favorite tasty treats you like if you win!
et: Teen oma väikse ZIGG iga lemmiku maitsva maiuse, mis sulle meeldib, kui võidad!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ZigzagoonLooksVacant
en: ZIGZAGOON looks vacant…
et: ZIGZAGOON tundub vaba...

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PeopleCallMeBusybody
en: People call me a busybody, but I can't help it.
et: Inimesed kutsuvad mind tegusaks kehaks, aga ma ei saa sinna midagi parata.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PeopleCallMeBusybody
en: Your hat's on crooked! Oh, no, trash on the ground! Oops, it's almost dinnertime!
et: Su müts on kõveras! Oh ei, prügi maas! Oops, see on peaaegu dinnertime!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PeopleCallMeBusybody
en: I don't know if I can stand to just watch at the BATTLE PALACE…
et: Ma ei tea, kas ma suudan seista selle eest, et vaadata lihtsalt BATTLE PALACE...

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_OnceBeatGymLeader
en: I may not look that impressive now, but I once beat a GYM LEADER.
et: Ma ei pruugi nüüd nii muljetavaldav välja näha, aga kunagi võitsin SAALI JUHT.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_OnceBeatGymLeader
en: Who knows, maybe I should give it another shot at glory.
et: Kes teab, võib-olla peaksin sellele veel ühe hoobi andma hiilgusest.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_FastOnBikeAndBattles
en: I'm fast on my BIKE, and that goes for the way I battle, too.
et: Ma olen kiire oma BIKE ja see läheb nii nagu ma võitlen ka.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_FastOnBikeAndBattles
en: I win matches in the blink of an eye!
et: Võidan silmapilkselt matše!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BetterThanDaddyAtPokemon
en: I'm better than my daddy at POKéMON.
et: Ma olen parem kui mu issi POKéMON juures.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_GoRackUpSomeWinsForDaddy
en: Go on, my baby sweetie! Go rack up some wins for Daddy!
et: Mine, mu väike kullake! Mine riisu mõned võidud issile!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_GoRackUpSomeWinsForDaddy
en: You're just like your mother, so you'll be dominating!
et: Sa oled täpselt nagu su ema, nii et sa hakkad domineerima!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_HeardPrettyGirlAtBattleArena
en: It wasn't easy getting here, but I'd heard about this knockout pretty girl at the BATTLE ARENA.
et: Ei olnud lihtne siia saada, aga ma olin kuulnud sellest nokaudist ilusat tüdrukut BATTLE ARENA juures.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_HeardPrettyGirlAtBattleArena
en: Instead of her, do you know what I found?
et: Kas sa tema asemel tead, mida ma leidsin?

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_HeardPrettyGirlAtBattleArena
en: A whole teeming mob of sweaty, stinky, and primitive martial artists!
et: Terve kihav higiste, haisvate ja primitiivsete võitluskunstnike maffia!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_SometimesImportantOldManInThere
en: I sometimes see this really importantlooking old man going in there.
et: Ma näen vahel, et see tõeliselt tähtis välimusega vanamees läheb sinna sisse.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_SometimesImportantOldManInThere
en: He has these really awesome POKéMON. He seems really nice, though.
et: Tal on need väga vinged POKéMON. Ta tundub siiski väga tore.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_LegendOfBattlePyramid
en: Do you know it? The legend of the BATTLE PYRAMID?
et: Kas sa tead seda? Legend BATTLE PYRAMID?

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_LegendOfBattlePyramid
en: When there comes a confident TRAINER reaching for the golden pinnacle, there shall appear a man among men.
et: Kui tuleb enesekindel TRAINER, mis ulatub kuldse tipu poole, ilmub meeste sekka mees.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_LegendOfBattlePyramid
en: Don't know that legend? Well, of course not! I just made it up!
et: Ei tea seda legendi? No muidugi mitte! Ma just mõtlesin välja!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_LegendOfBattlePyramid
en: What's it supposed to mean? That, my friend, I can't say!
et: Mida see peaks tähendama? Et, mu sõber, ma ei oska öelda!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_GotWipedOut
en: Man! Oh man! I've never lost once before!
et: Mees! Oh mees! Ma pole kunagi varem kaotanud!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_GotWipedOut
en: But I got wiped out with no saving grace at all!
et: Aga mind pühiti ilma päästva armuta üldse ära!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_GotWipedOut
en: And then I'm told I don't have any talent?! Man!
et: Ja siis öeldakse mulle, et mul pole annet?! Mees!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ToughTrainerInBattleTower
en: This guy ran into a horribly tough TRAINER while he was on the BATTLE TOWER challenge.
et: See tüüp sattus õudselt karmi TRAINER otsa, kui ta oli BATTLE TOWER väljakutsel.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ToughTrainerInBattleTower
en: Now look at him…
et: Vaata nüüd teda...

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ToughTrainerInBattleTower
en: You need to be cautious if you ever decide to go to the BATTLE TOWER.
et: Sa pead olema ettevaatlik, kui sa kunagi otsustad minna BATTLE TOWER.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_EnoughBattlePointsForDoll
en: Yes! I've finally got enough Battle Points!
et: Jah! Sain lõpuks piisavalt Battle Points!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_EnoughBattlePointsForDoll
en: I guess I'll trade for another giant plush DOLL!
et: Vahetan vist veel ühe hiiglasliku plöga vastu DOLL!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_LikeToHaveNameRecordedHere
en: Oh, yeah, okay! So this is the RANKING HALL!
et: Ahjaa, okei! See on siis RANKING HALL!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_LikeToHaveNameRecordedHere
en: I'd like to go down in history as a super champ and have my name recorded here for posterity.
et: Tahaks minna ajalukku superšempionina ja lasta oma nimi siia kirja panna järelpõlveks.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_CanDoAnythingWithYou
en: With you by my side, I can do anything.
et: Sinuga minu kõrval saan ma kõike teha.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PowerOfOurLoveWillOvercome
en: Ooh, darling, you are so wonderful!
et: Oh, kallis, sa oled nii imeline!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PowerOfOurLoveWillOvercome
en: Ooh, I just can't wait anymore!
et: Oo, ma lihtsalt ei jõua enam oodata!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PowerOfOurLoveWillOvercome
en: Let's go to a MULTI BATTLE ROOM right this instant!
et: Lähme kohe MULTI BATTLE ROOM juurde!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PowerOfOurLoveWillOvercome
en: If we get together in the BATTLE SALON, the power of our love will overcome everyone we meet.
et: Kui me saame kokku BATTLE SALON, saab meie armastuse vägi üle kõigist, keda kohtame.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PowerOfOurLoveWillOvercome
en: Why, before us, darling, everything will topple like dominoes!
et: Miks, enne meid, kallis, kukub kõik nagu doomino!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_FrontierNotExclusivelyForToughTrainers
en: The BATTLE FRONTIER isn't exclusively for tough TRAINERS.
et: BATTLE FRONTIER ei ole ainult karm TRAINERS.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_FrontierNotExclusivelyForToughTrainers
en: Many people with special abilities have been invited, it seems.
et: Kutsutud on palju eriliste võimetega inimesi, tundub.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_FrontierNotExclusivelyForToughTrainers
en: That man SCOTT…
et: See mees SCOTT...

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_FrontierNotExclusivelyForToughTrainers
en: He may have built this place to serve a bigger objective…
et: Ta võib-olla ehitas selle koha, et teenida suuremat eesmärki...

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_OddTreeHereSeemsToWiggle
en: Excuse me, young one. Have you good eyesight?
et: Vabandust, noor. Kas sul on hea nägemine?

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_OddTreeHereSeemsToWiggle
en: There is an odd tree past here, and to my tired eyes it seems to wiggle.
et: Siin on üks veider puu möödanik ja minu väsinud silmadele tundub see vingerdavat.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_OnceAnOddTreePastHere
en: Excuse me, young one. Have you a good memory?
et: Vabandust, noor. Kas sul on hea mälu?

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_OnceAnOddTreePastHere
en: I have this feeling there once was an odd tree past here.
et: Mul on selline tunne, et siin oli kunagi üks veider puu.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_StickyMonWithLongTail
en: I… I saw it!
et: Ma nägin seda!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_StickyMonWithLongTail
en: There was a sticky sort of a POKéMON with a long tail up ahead!
et: Seal oli kleepuvat sorti POKéMON, mille ees oli pikk saba!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_StickyMonWithLongTail
en: It was hiding under a boulder, and it kept staring at me!
et: See oli peidus rahnu all ja muudkui vahtis mind!

label: Route117_Text_DayCarePokemonHadNewMove
en: I left my POKéMON at the DAY CARE.
et: Jätsin oma POKéMON DAY CARE peale.

label: Route117_Text_DayCarePokemonHadNewMove
en: When I got it back, it had a new move that I didn't teach it. I was really, really surprised.
et: Kui ma selle tagasi sain, oli sellel uus käik, mida ma ei õpetanud. Ma olin tõesti, väga üllatunud.

label: Route117_Text_ArentTheseFlowersPretty
en: What do you think? Aren't these flowers pretty?
et: Mis sa arvad? Kas need õied pole ilusad?

label: Route117_Text_ArentTheseFlowersPretty
en: I planted them all!
et: Istutasin need kõik!

label: Route117_Text_AirIsTastyHere
en: The air is tasty here!
et: Õhk on siin maitsev!

label: Route117_Text_RouteSignVerdanturf
en: ROUTE 117 {LEFT_ARROW} VERDANTURF TOWN
et: ROUTE 117 {LEFT_ARROW} VERDANTURF TOWN

label: Route117_Text_RouteSignMauville
en: ROUTE 117 {RIGHT_ARROW} MAUVILLE CITY
et: ROUTE 117 {RIGHT_ARROW} MAUVILLE CITY

label: Route117_Text_DayCareSign
en: POKéMON DAY CARE “Let us raise your POKéMON.”
et: POKéMON DAY CARE "Tõstkem oma POKéMON".

label: SootopolisCity_House3_Text_JuanHasManyFansDoYou
en: You're a POKéMON TRAINER, aren't you?
et: Sa oled ju POKéMON TRAINER?

label: SootopolisCity_House3_Text_JuanHasManyFansDoYou
en: SOOTOPOLIS's JUAN has many fans. Even more than his student WALLACE!
et: SOOTOPOLIS on JUAN on palju fänne. Isegi rohkem kui tema õpilane WALLACE!

label: SootopolisCity_House3_Text_JuanHasManyFansDoYou
en: Do you have any?
et: Kas teil on?

label: SootopolisCity_House3_Text_YouMustBePrettyStrong
en: Oh, then you must be pretty strong.
et: Oh, siis sa oled vist päris tugev.

label: SootopolisCity_House3_Text_LonesomeTryWorkingHarder
en: Oh, dear… That's a little lonesome.
et: Oh, kallis, see on natuke üksildane.

label: SootopolisCity_House3_Text_LonesomeTryWorkingHarder
en: Try working a little harder to get a fan following.
et: Proovi natuke rohkem tööd teha, et fänn järgneks.

label: SootopolisCity_House3_Text_TrainerFanClubWasWild
en: Dedicated fans come over from even outside of HOENN.
et: Pühendunud fännid tulevad üle isegi väljastpoolt HOENN.

label: SootopolisCity_House3_Text_TrainerFanClubWasWild
en: It was really wild when I went to the TRAINER FAN CLUB in LILYCOVE.
et: See oli tõesti metsik, kui ma läksin TRAINER FAN CLUB in LILYCOVE.

label: Route128_Text_ArchieWhatHappened
en: ARCHIE: What happened… What is this wretched scene…
et: ARCHIE: Mis juhtus... Mis see armetu stseen on...

label: Route128_Text_ArchieWhatHappened
en: Did I…make a horrible mistake?
et: Kas ma...tegin jubeda vea?

label: Route128_Text_ArchieIOnlyWanted
en: I… I only wanted…
et: Ma tahtsin ainult...

label: Route128_Text_MaxieDoYouUnderstandNow
en: MAXIE: Do you understand now, ARCHIE?
et: MAXIE: Kas te saate nüüd aru, ARCHIE?

label: Route128_Text_MaxieDoYouUnderstandNow
en: Do you finally see how disastrous your dream turned out to be?
et: Kas sa näed lõpuks, kui hukatuslikuks su unistus osutus?

label: Route128_Text_MaxieDoYouUnderstandNow
en: We have to hurry! We have to do something before the situation goes completely out of control!
et: Me peame kiirustama! Me peame midagi ette võtma, enne kui olukord täielikult kontrolli alt väljub!

label: Route128_Text_MaxieResposibilityFallsToArchieAndMe
en: MAXIE: {PLAYER}, don't say anything.
et: MAXIE: {PLAYER}, ei ütle midagi.

label: Route128_Text_MaxieResposibilityFallsToArchieAndMe
en: I know that I have no right to be critical of ARCHIE…
et: Ma tean, et mul ei ole õigust olla kriitiline ARCHIE...

label: Route128_Text_MaxieResposibilityFallsToArchieAndMe
en: But the way things are now, I doubt that we humans will be capable of doing anything about it.
et: Aga nii, nagu asjad praegu on, ma kahtlen, kas meie, inimesed, oleme võimelised midagi ette võtma.

label: Route128_Text_MaxieResposibilityFallsToArchieAndMe
en: But neither can we stand by and just watch helplessly.
et: Aga ega me ei saa ka kõrval seista ja lihtsalt abitult pealt vaadata.

label: Route128_Text_MaxieResposibilityFallsToArchieAndMe
en: The responsibility for putting an end to this falls to ARCHIE and me…
et: Vastutus selle lõpetamise eest langeb ARCHIE ja mulle...

label: Route128_Text_MaxieThisDefiesBelief
en: MAXIE: This defies belief…
et: MAXIE: See trotsib usku...

label: Route128_Text_MaxieThisDefiesBelief
en: Those super-ancient POKéMON…
et: Need üliarmsad POKéMON...

label: Route128_Text_MaxieThisDefiesBelief
en: Their power is unbelievable. They've upset the balance of nature…
et: Nende jõud on uskumatu. Nad on ärritanud looduse tasakaalu...

label: Route128_Text_StevenWhatIsHappening
en: STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}! What is happening?
et: STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}! Mis toimub?

label: Route128_Text_StevenWholeWorldWillDrown
en: This is terrible…
et: See on kohutav...

label: Route128_Text_StevenWholeWorldWillDrown
en: After the scorching heat wave ended, this deluge began.
et: Pärast kõrvetava kuumalaine lõppu algas see veeuputus.

label: Route128_Text_StevenWholeWorldWillDrown
en: If this doesn't stop, all of HOENN… No, the whole world will drown.
et: Kui see ei lõpe, siis kõik HOENN... Ei, kogu maailm upub.

label: Route128_Text_StevenWholeWorldWillDrown
en: This huge rain cloud is spreading from above SOOTOPOLIS…
et: See tohutu vihmapilv levib ülevalt SOOTOPOLIS...

label: Route128_Text_StevenWholeWorldWillDrown
en: What in the world is taking place there?
et: Mis seal maailmas toimub?

label: Route128_Text_StevenWholeWorldWillDrown
en: There's no point arguing here… SOOTOPOLIS might provide answers…
et: Siin pole mõtet vaielda... SOOTOPOLIS võib anda vastuseid...

label: Route128_Text_StevenImGoingToSootopolis
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}… I don't know what you intend to do, but don't do anything reckless.
et: {PLAYER} {KUN}... ma ei tea, mida sa kavatsed teha, aga ära tee midagi hoolimatut.

label: Route128_Text_StevenImGoingToSootopolis
en: Okay. I'm going to SOOTOPOLIS.
et: Olgu. Ma lähen SOOTOPOLIS.

label: LittlerootTown_Text_OurNewHomeLetsGoInside
en: MOM: {PLAYER}, we're here, honey!
et: MOM: {PLAYER}, me oleme siin, kallis!

label: LittlerootTown_Text_OurNewHomeLetsGoInside
en: It must be tiring riding with our things in the moving truck.
et: See on vist väsitav sõitmine meie asjadega liikuvas veokis.

label: LittlerootTown_Text_OurNewHomeLetsGoInside
en: Well, this is LITTLEROOT TOWN.
et: No see on LITTLEROOT TOWN.

label: LittlerootTown_Text_OurNewHomeLetsGoInside
en: How do you like it? This is our new home!
et: Kuidas sulle meeldib? See on meie uus kodu!

label: LittlerootTown_Text_OurNewHomeLetsGoInside
en: It has a quaint feel, but it seems to be an easy place to live, don't you think?
et: Omapärane tunne on, aga tundub, et see on lihtne elupaik, kas pole?

label: LittlerootTown_Text_OurNewHomeLetsGoInside
en: And, you get your own room, {PLAYER}! Let's go inside.
et: Ja, sa saad oma toa, {PLAYER}! Lähme sisse.

label: LittlerootTown_Text_WaitPlayer
en: MOM: Wait, {PLAYER}!
et: MOM: Oota, {PLAYER}!

label: LittlerootTown_Text_WearTheseRunningShoes
en: MOM: {PLAYER}! {PLAYER}! Did you introduce yourself to PROF. BIRCH?
et: MOM: {PLAYER}! {PLAYER}! Kas sa tutvustasid ennast PROF. BIRCH?

label: LittlerootTown_Text_WearTheseRunningShoes
en: Oh! What an adorable POKéMON! You got it from PROF. BIRCH. How nice!
et: Oh! Milline võluv POKéMON! Sa said selle PROF pealt. BIRCH. Kui tore!

label: LittlerootTown_Text_WearTheseRunningShoes
en: You're your father's child, all right. You look good together with POKéMON!
et: Sa oled oma isa laps. Sa näed hea välja koos POKéMON!

label: LittlerootTown_Text_WearTheseRunningShoes
en: Here, honey! If you're going out on an adventure, wear these RUNNING SHOES.
et: Siin, kallis! Kui lähed seiklema, siis kanna neid RUNNING SHOES.

label: LittlerootTown_Text_WearTheseRunningShoes
en: They'll put a zip in your step!
et: Nad panevad sinu sammu zipi!

label: LittlerootTown_Text_SwitchShoesWithRunningShoes
en: {PLAYER} switched shoes with the RUNNING SHOES.
et: {PLAYER} vahetatud kingad RUNNING SHOES-ga.

label: LittlerootTown_Text_ExplainRunningShoes
en: MOM: {PLAYER}, those shoes came with instructions.
et: MOM: {PLAYER}, need kingad tulid koos juhistega.

label: LittlerootTown_Text_ExplainRunningShoes
en: “Press the B Button while wearing these RUNNING SHOES to run extra-fast!
et: "Vajuta B-nuppu, kandes neid RUNNING SHOES, et joosta ekstra-kiiresti!

label: LittlerootTown_Text_ExplainRunningShoes
en: “Slip on these RUNNING SHOES and race in the great outdoors!”
et: "Libise neile RUNNING SHOES ja rassi suurepärases õues!"

label: LittlerootTown_Text_ComeHomeIfAnythingHappens
en: To think that you have your very own POKéMON now… Your father will be overjoyed.
et: Arvata, et sul on oma POKéMON nüüd... Su isa on ülirõõmus.

label: LittlerootTown_Text_ComeHomeIfAnythingHappens
en: …But please be careful. If anything happens, you can come home.
et: ...aga olge palun ettevaatlikud. Kui midagi juhtub, võid koju tulla.

label: LittlerootTown_Text_ComeHomeIfAnythingHappens
en: Go on, go get them, honey!
et: Mine võta need kaasa, kullake!

label: LittlerootTown_Text_CanUsePCToStoreItems
en: If you use a PC, you can store items and POKéMON.
et: Kui kasutate PC, saate salvestada esemeid ja POKéMON.

label: LittlerootTown_Text_CanUsePCToStoreItems
en: The power of science is staggering!
et: Teaduse vägi on vapustav!

label: LittlerootTown_Text_BirchSpendsDaysInLab
en: PROF. BIRCH spends days in his LAB studying, then he'll suddenly go out in the wild to do more research…
et: PROF. BIRCH veedab päevi oma LAB õppides, siis ta äkki läheb välja looduses, et teha rohkem uuringuid...

label: LittlerootTown_Text_BirchSpendsDaysInLab
en: When does PROF. BIRCH spend time at home?
et: Millal teeb PROF. BIRCH kodus aega veeta?

label: LittlerootTown_Text_IfYouGoInGrassPokemonWillJumpOut
en: Um, um, um!
et: Um, um!

label: LittlerootTown_Text_IfYouGoInGrassPokemonWillJumpOut
en: If you go outside and go in the grass, wild POKéMON will jump out!
et: Kui lähed õue ja lähed rohu sisse, siis metsik POKéMON hüppab välja!

label: LittlerootTown_Text_DangerousIfYouDontHavePokemon
en: It's dangerous if you don't have your own POKéMON.
et: See on ohtlik, kui sul ei ole oma POKéMON.

label: LittlerootTown_Text_CanYouGoSeeWhatsHappening
en: Um, hi!
et: Hei, tere!

label: LittlerootTown_Text_CanYouGoSeeWhatsHappening
en: There are scary POKéMON outside! I can hear their cries!
et: Õues on hirmus POKéMON! Ma kuulen nende hüüdeid!

label: LittlerootTown_Text_CanYouGoSeeWhatsHappening
en: I want to go see what's going on, but I don't have any POKéMON…
et: Ma tahan minna vaatama, mis toimub, aga mul ei ole ühtegi POKéMON...

label: LittlerootTown_Text_CanYouGoSeeWhatsHappening
en: Can you go see what's happening for me?
et: Kas sa võiksid minna vaatama, mis minu jaoks toimub?

label: LittlerootTown_Text_YouSavedBirch
en: You saved PROF. BIRCH! I'm so glad!
et: Sa salvestasid PROF. BIRCH! Mul on nii hea meel!

label: LittlerootTown_Text_GoodLuckCatchingPokemon
en: Are you going to catch POKéMON? Good luck!
et: Kas kavatsed püüda POKéMON? Edu!

label: LittlerootTown_Text_TownSign
en: LITTLEROOT TOWN “A town that can't be shaded any hue.”
et: LITTLEROOT TOWN "Linn, mida ei saa varjutada mingit tooni".

label: LittlerootTown_Text_ProfBirchsLab
en: PROF. BIRCH'S POKéMON LAB
et: PROF. BIRCH'S POKéMON LAB

label: LittlerootTown_Text_PlayersHouse
en: {PLAYER}'s HOUSE
et: {PLAYER} on HOUSE

label: LittlerootTown_Text_ProfBirchsHouse
en: PROF. BIRCH'S HOUSE
et: PROF. BIRCH'S HOUSE

label: LittlerootTown_Text_BirchSomethingToShowYouAtLab
en: PROF. BIRCH: Well, well, {PLAYER}{KUN}! That was good work out there!
et: PROF. BIRCH: Noh, noh, {PLAYER}{KUN}! See oli seal hea töö!

label: LittlerootTown_Text_BirchSomethingToShowYouAtLab
en: I knew there was something special about you when I first saw you, but I never expected this.
et: Ma teadsin, et sinus on midagi erilist, kui ma sind esimest korda nägin, aga ma ei oodanudki seda.

label: LittlerootTown_Text_BirchSomethingToShowYouAtLab
en: Oh, yes. Do you still have the POKéDEX I gave you?
et: Ahjaa, jah. Kas sul on ikka see POKéDEX mis ma sulle andsin?

label: LittlerootTown_Text_BirchSomethingToShowYouAtLab
en: I have something to show you. Let's go to my LAB.
et: Mul on teile midagi näidata. Lähme minu LAB juurde.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerMultiBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor2ndOpponentSet
en: The 2nd set of opponents is next. Are you ready?
et: Vastaste 2. sett on järgmine. Kas oled valmis?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerMultiBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor3rdOpponentSet

et: Järgmisena on vastaste 3. sett. Kas oled valmis?

en: The 7th set of opponents is next. Are you ready?

en: The 2nd set of opponents is next. Do your best!
et: Vastaste 2. sett on järgmine. Anna endast parim!

label: gText_LinkStandby3
en: Link standby…
et: Link ooteseisund...

label: gText_YourPartnerHasRetired
en: Your partner has retired.
et: Su elukaaslane on pensionile läinud.

label: gText_YourPartnerHasRetired
en: Your BATTLE ROOM challenge will be canceled.
et: Teie BATTLE ROOM väljakutse tühistatakse.

label: PetalburgCity_Text_WhereIsWally
en: Where has our WALLY gone?
et: Kuhu on kadunud meie WALLY?

label: PetalburgCity_Text_WhereIsWally
en: We have to leave for VERDANTURF TOWN very soon…
et: Me peame lahkuma VERDANTURF TOWN väga varsti...

label: PetalburgCity_Text_AreYouRookieTrainer
en: Hiya! Are you maybe… A rookie TRAINER?
et: Hiya! Kas sa oled äkki... algaja TRAINER?

label: PetalburgCity_Text_AreYouRookieTrainer
en: Do you know what POKéMON TRAINERS do when they reach a new town?
et: Kas teate, mida teevad POKéMON TRAINERS kui nad jõuavad uude linna?

label: PetalburgCity_Text_AreYouRookieTrainer
en: They first check what kind of GYM is in the town.
et: Esmalt kontrollitakse, milline SAAL on linnas.

label: PetalburgCity_Text_ThisIsPetalburgGym
en: See? This is PETALBURG CITY's GYM.
et: Näete? See on PETALBURG CITY SAAL.

label: PetalburgCity_Text_ThisIsGymSign
en: This is the GYM's sign. Look for it whenever you're looking for a GYM.
et: See on SAAL märk. Otsi seda alati, kui otsid SAAL.

label: PetalburgCity_Text_WaterReflection
en: My face is reflected in the water.
et: Mu nägu peegeldub vees.

label: PetalburgCity_Text_WaterReflection
en: It's a shining grin full of hope…
et: See on särav irve täis lootust...

label: PetalburgCity_Text_WaterReflection
en: Or it could be a look of somber silence struggling with fear…
et: Või võiks see olla ilme sombusest vaikusest, mis võitleb hirmuga...

label: PetalburgCity_Text_WaterReflection
en: What do you see reflected in your face?
et: Mida sa näed oma näos peegeldumas?

label: PetalburgCity_Text_FullPartyExplanation
en: Let's say you have six POKéMON. If you catch another one…
et: Oletame, et sul on kuus POKéMON. Kui sa tabad veel ühe...

label: PetalburgCity_Text_FullPartyExplanation
en: It is automatically sent to a STORAGE BOX over a PC connection.
et: See saadetakse automaatselt STORAGE BOX üle PC ühenduse.

label: PetalburgCity_Text_GymSign
en: PETALBURG CITY POKéMON GYM LEADER: NORMAN “A man in pursuit of power!”
et: PETALBURG CITY POKéMON SAALI JUHT: NORMAN "Inimene võimu taga ajamas!"

label: PetalburgCity_Text_CitySign
en: PETALBURG CITY “Where people mingle with nature.”
et: PETALBURG CITY "Kus inimesed loodusega semmivad".

label: PetalburgCity_Text_WallyHouseSign
en: WALLY'S HOUSE
et: WALLY'S HOUSE

label: PetalburgCity_Text_AreYouATrainer
en: Excuse me!
et: Oi, vabandust!

label: PetalburgCity_Text_AreYouATrainer
en: Let me guess, from the way you're dressed, are you a POKéMON TRAINER?
et: Las ma arvan, et alates sellest, kuidas sa riides oled, oled sa POKéMON TRAINER?

label: PetalburgCity_Text_WellMaybeNot
en: Well, maybe not. Your clothes aren't all that dirty.
et: Noh, võib-olla mitte. Su riided ei ole kõik nii räpased.

label: PetalburgCity_Text_WellMaybeNot
en: You're either a rookie TRAINER, or maybe you're just an ordinary kid.
et: Sa oled kas algaja TRAINER või siis lihtsalt tavaline laps.

label: PetalburgCity_Text_ImLookingForTalentedTrainers
en: I'm roaming the land in search of talented TRAINERS.
et: Ma rändlen maal, otsides andekaid TRAINERS.

label: PetalburgCity_Text_ImLookingForTalentedTrainers
en: I'm sorry to have taken your time.
et: Mul on kahju, et sul aega kulus.

label: FortreeCity_DecorationShop_Text_MerchandiseSentToPC
en: Merchandise you buy here is sent to your own PC.
et: Kauplus, mille te siit ostate, saadetakse teie enda PC-le.

label: FortreeCity_DecorationShop_Text_MerchandiseSentToPC
en: That's fantastic! I wish they could also deliver me home like that.
et: See on fantastiline! Soovin, et nad suudaksid mind ka niimoodi koju toimetada.

label: FortreeCity_DecorationShop_Text_BuyingDeskForDolls
en: I'm buying a pretty desk and I'm putting my cute DOLLS on it.
et: Ostan päris kirjutuslaua ja panen oma armsa DOLLS peale.

label: FortreeCity_DecorationShop_Text_BuyingDeskForDolls
en: If I don't, when I decorate my SECRET BASE, my DOLLS will get dirty or poked with splinters.
et: Kui ma seda ei tee, siis kui ma kaunistan oma SECRET BASE, siis mu DOLLS määrdub või torkab kildudega.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AndreaIntro
en: I'll show you the sublime techniques I learned from our LEADER JUAN!
et: Näitan teile meie LEADER JUAN-st õpitud ülevaid võtteid!

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AndreaDefeat
en: Please forgive me, JUAN…
et: Palun andestage mulle, JUAN...

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AndreaPostBattle
en: Watch what happens if you crack all the floor tiles.
et: Vaata, mis juhtub, kui praod kõik põrandaplaadid.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_CrissyIntro
en: You came all the way here, but you won't get to see JUAN.
et: Sa tulid siia terve tee, aga sa ei saa näha JUAN.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_CrissyIntro
en: Not if you lose to me, you won't!
et: Mitte siis, kui sa mulle kaotad, siis sa seda ei tee!

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_CrissyDefeat
en: You're strong! I was fooled by your cute looks!
et: Sa oled tugev! Mind petsid su armsad ilmed!

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_CrissyPostBattle
en: You might be good enough to avoid being wiped out in one hit by JUAN.
et: Sa võid olla piisavalt hea, et vältida ühe löögiga JUAN väljapühkimist.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_DaphneIntro
en: The sight of JUAN conducting a battle…
et: Vaatepilt JUAN viib läbi lahingu...

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_DaphneIntro
en: The very beauty of it compelled me to become a TRAINER.
et: Selle ilu sundis mind saama TRAINER.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_DaphneDefeat
en: You battled with more beauty than I could muster…
et: Sa võitlesid rohkem iluga, kui ma suutsin...

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_DaphnePostBattle
en: The grace you bring to battle is fabulous.
et: Arm, mille sa lahingusse tood, on vapustav.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_DaphnePostBattle
en: Oh… I'm so fortunate to have found POKéMON.
et: Mul on nii vedanud, et olen leidnud POKéMON.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_ConnieIntro
en: I should teach you how harsh battles can be.
et: Ma peaksin õpetama, kui karmid lahingud võivad olla.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_ConnieDefeat
en: Oh. You're strong.
et: Oh. Sa oled tugev.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_ConniePostBattle
en: I'll tell you something good.
et: Ma ütlen sulle midagi head.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_ConniePostBattle
en: If you want to reach JUAN, you need to walk on each floor tile once.
et: Kui soovite jõuda JUAN, peate kõndima igal põrandaplaadil üks kord.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BridgetIntro
en: The POKéMON GYM of the highest level in the HOENN region…
et: POKéMON SAAL kõrgeima taseme HOENN piirkonnas...

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BridgetIntro
en: That's the SOOTOPOLIS GYM.
et: See on see SOOTOPOLIS SAAL.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BridgetDefeat
en: What a high level you are!
et: Milline kõrge tase sa oled!

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BridgetPostBattle
en: Rather than being satisfied by being in a strong GYM, I imagine training in other places will make you stronger. But above all, it looks more fun.
et: Selle asemel, et olla rahul, olles tugevas SAAL, kujutan ette, et teistes kohtades treenimine muudab sind tugevamaks. Aga eelkõige näeb see lõbusam välja.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_OliviaIntro
en: I train my POKéMON together with JUAN.
et: Treenin oma POKéMON koos JUAN-ga.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_OliviaIntro
en: Don't think I'm a pushover.
et: Ära arva, et ma olen tõukaja.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_OliviaDefeat
en: I was beaten…
et: Mind peksti...

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_OliviaPostBattle
en: I think you have potential. Why don't you stay and train with us?
et: Ma arvan, et sul on potentsiaali. Miks sa ei võiks meie juurde jääda ja treenida?

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_TiffanyIntro
en: A graceful glide across the ice while crossing no lines…
et: Nõtke liuglemine üle jää, ületades samas mitte ühtegi joont...

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_TiffanyIntro
en: A TRAINER putting on that performance would be elegantly beautiful!
et: A TRAINER selle etenduse pealepanek oleks elegantselt ilus!

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_TiffanyDefeat
en: Well, excuse me?!
et: No vabandage mind?!

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_TiffanyPostBattle
en: This is really obvious, but how strong you are as a TRAINER has nothing to do with how young or old you are.
et: See on tõesti ilmne, kuid kui tugev sa oled kui TRAINER ei ole seotud sellega, kui noor või vana sa oled.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BethanyIntro
en: When I'm with my POKéMON, the time flies by before you can say, “Oops!”
et: Kui olen oma POKéMON-ga koos, lendab aeg mööda, enne kui saab öelda: "Oops!"

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BethanyDefeat
en: Oops!
et: Oops!

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BethanyPostBattle
en: I wish I could forget about lost causes before I can manage an “Oops!”
et: Soovin, et saaksin kaotatud põhjused unustada enne, kui saan hakkama "Oopsiga!"

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AnnikaIntro
en: I can battle with really rare POKéMON if you'd like.
et: Võin võidelda tõeliselt haruldase POKéMON-ga, kui soovite.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AnnikaDefeat
en: Oh, there now! Did you have a good look at my POKéMON?
et: Oh, seal nüüd! Kas sul oli hea pilk minu POKéMON?

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AnnikaPostBattle
en: I came to this GYM because JUAN praised me for my darling POKéMON.
et: Tulin selle SAAL juurde, sest JUAN kiitis mind oma kalli POKéMON eest.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AnnikaPostBattle
en: Oh, if only I'd met JUAN years ago when I was younger…
et: Oh, kui ma vaid oleks nooremana kohtunud JUAN aastat tagasi...

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BriannaIntro
en: Giggle… Your grim look is so charming.
et: Sinu sünge välimus on nii võluv.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BriannaDefeat
en: Oh, dear. I went much too easy on you.
et: Oh, kallis. Ma läksin sinu peale liiga kergelt.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BriannaPostBattle
en: You couldn't lay a finger on JUAN, I'm sure. Giggle…
et: Sõrme ei saanud panna JUAN peale, olen kindel. Giggle...

label: LilycoveCity_House1_Text_PokemonPartnersNotTools
en: POKéMON are partners to people. They aren't our tools.
et: POKéMON on partnerid inimestele. Need ei ole meie töövahendid.

label: LilycoveCity_House1_Text_PokemonPartnersNotTools
en: Unfortunately, there are some people who fail to understand that…
et: Paraku on mõned inimesed, kes ei suuda sellest aru saada...

label: LilycoveCity_House1_Text_Kecleon
en: KECLEON: Ruroro?
et: KECLEON: Ruroro?

label: SkyPillar_Top_Text_RayquazaFlewOff
en: The awakened RAYQUAZA flew off…
et: Ärkanud RAYQUAZA lendas minema...

label: OldaleTown_House2_Text_PokemonLevelUp
en: When POKéMON battle, they eventually level up and become stronger.
et: Kui POKéMON lahing, nad lõpuks tasandavad ja muutuvad tugevamaks.

label: OldaleTown_House2_Text_YoullGoFurtherWithStrongPokemon
en: If the POKéMON with you become stronger, you'll be able to go farther away from here.
et: Kui POKéMON koos sinuga muutub tugevamaks, siis saad siit kaugemale minna.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_WelcomeToBattleArena
en: Where the battling spirit of TRAINERS is put to the test!
et: Kus pannakse proovile TRAINERS võitlusvaim!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_WelcomeToBattleArena
en: I welcome you to the BATTLE ARENA!
et: Ma tervitan sind BATTLE ARENA!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_WelcomeToBattleArena
en: I am your guide to the Set KO Tourney!
et: Olen Sinu teejuht komplekti KO Teurney!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_WishToTakeChallenge
en: Now, do you wish to take the BATTLE ARENA challenge?
et: Kas soovite nüüd võtta BATTLE ARENA väljakutse?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_AwaitAnotherChallenge
en: We await your challenge on another occasion!
et: Ootame teie väljakutset veel ühel korral!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainChallenge
en: In the BATTLE ARENA, we undertake the Set KO Tourney.
et: BATTLE ARENA raames võtame ette komplekti KO Teurney.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainChallenge
en: All participants enter with a team of three POKéMON.
et: Kõik osalejad sisenevad kolmeliikmelise meeskonnaga POKéMON.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainChallenge
en: The three POKéMON must be lined up in the order in which they are to appear.
et: Kolm POKéMON tuleb rivistada järjekorras, kus nad peavad ilmuma.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainChallenge
en: During battle, the POKéMON will appear one at a time in the preset order.
et: Lahingu ajal kuvatakse POKéMON üks korraga eelseadistatud järjekorras.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainChallenge
en: Once a POKéMON enters battle, it must remain out until the match is decided.
et: Kui POKéMON astub lahingusse, peab see jääma välja, kuni mäng on otsustatud.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainChallenge
en: If a match remains undecided in three turns, it goes to judging.
et: Kui vaste jääb otsustamata kolmel pöördel, läheb see otsustamisele.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainChallenge
en: If you wish to interrupt your challenge, please save the game.
et: Kui soovite oma väljakutse katkestada, siis palun salvestage mäng.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainChallenge
en: If you don't save, you will not be able to continue with your challenge.
et: Kui sa ei säästa, siis ei ole sul võimalik oma väljakutsega jätkata.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainChallenge
en: If you pull off the feat of beating seven TRAINERS in succession, we will present you with Battle Points.
et: Kui tõmbate seitsme TRAINERS järjestikku peksmise saavutuse maha, siis esitame teile Battle Points'i.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_OkayToSave
en: Before showing you to the BATTLE ARENA, you must save. Is that okay?
et: Enne BATTLE ARENA-le näitamist tuleb salvestada. Kas sellega on kõik korras?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_WhichLevelMode
en: The BATTLE ARENA offers two levels of challenge, Level 50 and Open Level. Which is your choice?
et: BATTLE ARENA pakub kahte taset väljakutse, tase 50 ja avatud tase. Milline on teie valik?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_SelectThreeMons
en: Very well, now select your three POKéMON, please.
et: Väga hästi, vali nüüd oma kolm POKéMON, palun.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen
en: My dear challenger!
et: Mu kallis väljakutsuja!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen
en: You do not have the three POKéMON required for entry.
et: Teil ei ole sisenemiseks vajalikku kolme POKéMON.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen
en: To qualify, you must bring three different kinds of POKéMON.
et: Kvalifitseerumiseks tuleb kaasa võtta kolm erinevat sorti POKéMON.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen
en: They also must not hold the same kinds of items.
et: Samuti ei tohi nad hoida samasuguseid esemeid.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen
en: EGGS{STR_VAR_1} ineligible.
et: EGGS{STR_VAR_1} kõlbmatu.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen
en: When you have made your preparations, please do return.
et: Kui oled oma ettevalmistused teinud, siis palun pöördu tagasi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
en: My dear challenger!
et: Mu kallis väljakutsuja!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
en: You do not have the three POKéMON required for entry.
et: Teil ei ole sisenemiseks vajalikku kolme POKéMON.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
en: To qualify, you must bring three different kinds of POKéMON.
et: Kvalifitseerumiseks tuleb kaasa võtta kolm erinevat sorti POKéMON.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
en: The three different POKéMON must all be Level 50 or lower.
et: Kolm erinevat POKéMON peavad kõik olema tase 50 või madalam.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
en: They also must not hold the same kinds of items.
et: Samuti ei tohi nad hoida samasuguseid esemeid.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
en: EGGS{STR_VAR_1} ineligible.
et: EGGS{STR_VAR_1} kõlbmatu.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
en: When you have made your preparations, please do return.
et: Kui oled oma ettevalmistused teinud, siis palun pöördu tagasi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_GuideYouToArena
en: I shall now guide you to the BATTLE ARENA.
et: Ma juhatan teid nüüd BATTLE ARENA juurde.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_DidntSaveBeforeShuttingDown
en: My dear challenger!
et: Mu kallis väljakutsuja!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_DidntSaveBeforeShuttingDown
en: You did not save the game before shutting down, did you?
et: Sa ei päästnud ju mängu enne sulgemist?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_DidntSaveBeforeShuttingDown
en: It is unfortunate, but that has resulted in your disqualification from your challenge.
et: See on kahetsusväärne, kuid see on toonud kaasa teie diskvalifitseerimise teie väljakutsest.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_DidntSaveBeforeShuttingDown
en: You may, of course, start with a fresh challenge.
et: Alustada võib muidugi värske väljakutsega.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_CongratsOnSevenWins
en: We congratulate you for your splendid string of wins over seven TRAINERS!
et: Õnnitleme teid suurepärase võidukihutamise eest üle seitsme TRAINERS!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_RecordAchievement
en: Your achievement will be recorded. Please wait while I save the game.
et: Teie saavutus salvestatakse. Palun oodake, kuni ma mängu salvestan.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_PresentYouWithPrize
en: In commemoration of your 7-win streak, we present you with this prize.
et: Teie 7-võidulise triibu mälestuseks kingime teile selle auhinna.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ReceivedPrize
en: {PLAYER} received the prize {STR_VAR_1}.
et: {PLAYER} sai auhinna {STR_VAR_1}.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_BagFullReturnForPrize
en: Oh? Your BAG seems to be full.
et: Oh? Sinu BAG tundub täis olevat.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_BagFullReturnForPrize
en: I urge you to clear space and return for your prize.
et: Kutsun teid üles avastama ruumi ja naasma auhinnale.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ThankYouWaitWhileSave
en: Thank you so much for participating!
et: Suured tänud osalemast!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ThankYouWaitWhileSave
en: Please wait while I save the game.
et: Palun oodake, kuni ma mängu salvestan.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_AwaitAnotherChallenge2
en: We await your challenge on another occasion!
et: Ootame teie väljakutset veel ühel korral!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_LookingForwardToArrivalSaveGame
en: We have been looking forward to your arrival.
et: Ootasime teie saabumist.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_LookingForwardToArrivalSaveGame
en: Before I show you to the BATTLE ARENA, I must save the game. Please wait.
et: Enne kui ma näitan sulle BATTLE ARENA, pean ma mängu salvestama. Palun oodake.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_RecordLastMatch
en: Shall I record your last BATTLE ARENA match on your FRONTIER PASS?
et: Kas ma salvestan teie viimase BATTLE ARENA vaste teie FRONTIER PASS?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_BadIdeaToNotAttack
en: I lost on the REFEREE's decision…
et: Kaotasin REFEREE otsuse peale...

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_BadIdeaToNotAttack
en: I don't think it was a good idea to only use defensive moves and not attack…
et: Ma arvan, et ei olnud hea mõte kasutada ainult kaitsevõtteid ja mitte rünnata...

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_LandingHitsWorked
en: I won in judging!
et: Võitsin kohtumõistmisel!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_LandingHitsWorked
en: Landing hits consistently on the opponent's POKéMON worked!
et: Maandumine tabab järjekindlalt vastase POKéMON töötas!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_MatchWasDeclaredDraw
en: Our match was declared a draw.
et: Meie matš kuulutati viigiks.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_MatchWasDeclaredDraw
en: When we ran out of time, both my POKéMON and the opponent's had about the same amount of HP left.
et: Kui meil aeg otsa sai, oli nii minu POKéMON kui ka vastase oma umbes sama palju HP alles.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_OrderOfMonsImportant
en: In the BATTLE ARENA, the order of POKéMON is totally important.
et: BATTLE ARENA-s on POKéMON järjekord täiesti oluline.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_OrderOfMonsImportant
en: For example, if your first POKéMON has certain type disadvantages, try making your second POKéMON one with moves that are super effective against the first one.
et: Näiteks kui teie esimesel POKéMON-l on teatud tüüpi miinused, proovige teha oma teine POKéMON üks, mille käigud on esimese vastu üliefektiivsed.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_OrderOfMonsImportant
en: I think that will be a good way of making an effective team.
et: Ma arvan, et see saab olema hea viis efektiivse meeskonna loomiseks.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_RulesAreListed
en: The Set KO Tourney's rules are listed.
et: Loetletud on Set KO Tourney reeglid.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ReadWhichHeading
en: Which heading do you want to read?
et: Kumba poolt sa tahad lugeda?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainBattleRules
en: The Set KO Tourney has special rules, unlike standard battles.
et: Komplektil KO Teurney on erireeglid, erinevalt standardlahingutest.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainBattleRules
en: First, one battle lasts only three turns.
et: Esiteks kestab üks lahing vaid kolm pööret.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainBattleRules
en: If the outcome is not decided after three turns, it goes to judging.
et: Kui kolme pöörde järel tulemust ei otsustata, läheb see otsustamisele.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainBattleRules
en: The REFEREE will choose the winner based on how the POKéMON battled.
et: REFEREE valib võitja selle põhjal, kuidas POKéMON võitles.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainBattleRules
en: Also, a POKéMON cannot be switched out until its battle's outcome is decided.
et: Samuti ei saa POKéMON välja lülitada enne, kui selle lahingu tulemus on otsustatud.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainMindRules
en: The first judging factor is “Mind.” This factor evaluates how aggressive the battlers were.
et: Esimene otsustav tegur on "Mind". See tegur hindab, kui agressiivsed võitlejad olid.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainMindRules
en: The judging is based on how often the TRAINERS ordered the use of offensive moves.
et: Kohtumõistmisel lähtutakse sellest, kui tihti tellis TRAINERS ründevõtete kasutamise.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainSkillRules
en: The second judging factor is “Skill.” This factor evaluates how effectively POKéMON moves were used.
et: Teine otsustav tegur on "Skill". See tegur hindab, kui tõhusalt kasutati POKéMON käike.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainSkillRules
en: If a move worked successfully, the Skill rating goes up.
et: Kui käik töötas edukalt, tõuseb Skilli reiting.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainSkillRules
en: If a move failed, the Skill rating is lowered.
et: Kui käik ebaõnnestus, langetatakse Skilli reitingut.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainSkillRules
en: If it was an offensive move, the Skill rating goes up if the move was “super effective” and goes down if it was “not very effective.”
et: Kui tegu oli ründevõttega, siis Skilli reiting tõuseb, kui käik oleks "üliefektiivne" ja läheb alla, kui see oleks "mitte väga efektiivne".

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainSkillRules
en: The Skill rating will not go up for moves such as PROTECT and DETECT.
et: Skill reiting ei lähe üles selliste käikude puhul nagu PROTECT ja DETECT.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainSkillRules
en: If the opponent used PROTECT or DETECT, and your POKéMON failed to hit with a move, its Skill rating will not go down.
et: Kui vastane kasutas PROTECT või DETECT ning sinu POKéMON ei õnnestunud käiguga tabada, ei lähe tema Skilli hinnang alla.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainBodyRules
en: The third judging factor is “Body.” This factor is based on how much HP remained at the end of a battle.
et: Kolmas otsustav tegur on "Keha". See tegur põhineb sellel, kui palju HP jäi lahingu lõppu.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainBodyRules
en: The rating takes into account how much HP a POKéMON had at the start of battle, and what remained at the end.
et: Hinnangus võetakse arvesse, kui palju HP a POKéMON oli lahingu alguses ja mis jäi lõppu.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_CongratsOnDefeatingTycoon
en: A victory snatched from the ARENA TYCOON, and a seven-TRAINER sweep!
et: ARENA TYCOON pealt napsatud võit ja seitsme-TRAINER pühkimine!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_CongratsOnDefeatingTycoon
en: We congratulate you on your most splendid challenge!
et: Õnnitleme Teid kõige toredama väljakutse puhul!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_PleaseAcceptBattlePoints
en: My dear challenger, in recognition of your indefatigable spirit, please accept these Battle Point(s).
et: Mu kallis väljakutsuja, tunnustades teie alistamatut vaimu, palun võtke need Battle Point (d) vastu.

label: EverGrandeCity_Text_CitySign
en: EVER GRANDE CITY
et: EVER GRANDE CITY

label: EverGrandeCity_Text_CitySign
en: “The paradise of flowers, the sea, and POKéMON.”
et: "Lillede paradiis, meri ja POKéMON".

label: SootopolisCity_House2_Text_DidYouKnowAboutMtPyreOrbs
en: MT. PYRE…
et: MT. PYRE...

label: SootopolisCity_House2_Text_DidYouKnowAboutMtPyreOrbs
en: At its peak are two orbs placed side by side. Did you know?
et: Selle tipus on kõrvuti asetatud kaks orbu. Kas teadsid?

label: SootopolisCity_House2_Text_YesTwoOrbsSideBySide
en: Yes, two orbs side by side…
et: Jah, kaks orbu kõrvuti...

label: SootopolisCity_House2_Text_YesTwoOrbsSideBySide
en: The sight of them together… It is somehow soothing…
et: Nende nägemine koos... see on kuidagi rahustav...

label: SootopolisCity_House2_Text_OughtToVisitAndSee
en: Is that so? Perhaps you ought to visit and see…
et: On see nii? Võib-olla peaksid külastama ja nägema...

label: Route116_Text_ScoundrelMadeOffWithPeeko
en: Ohhh, what am I to do?
et: Ohhh, mida ma tegema pean?

label: Route116_Text_ScoundrelMadeOffWithPeeko
en: We were on our walk, PEEKO and I, when we were jumped by an odd thug…
et: Olime jalutamas, PEEKO ja mina, kui meid hüppas üks veider pätt...

label: Route116_Text_ScoundrelMadeOffWithPeeko
en: The scoundrel made off with my darling PEEKO!
et: Scounder tegi mu kalliga ära PEEKO!

label: Route116_Text_ScoundrelMadeOffWithPeeko
en: Wrrrooooooaaaar! PEEKO!
et: Wrrooooaaaar! PEEKO!

label: Route116_Text_WantToDigTunnel
en: Nnn… Roar!
et: Nnn... Roar!

label: Route116_Text_WantToDigTunnel
en: I want to dig that tunnel!
et: Ma tahan seda tunnelit kaevata!

label: Route116_Text_DiggingTunnelWhenGoonOrderedMeOut
en: Nnn… Roar! What's going on?
et: Nnn... Roar! Mis toimub?

label: Route116_Text_DiggingTunnelWhenGoonOrderedMeOut
en: I was digging the tunnel without any tools when some goon ordered me out!
et: Kaevasin tunnelit ilma tööriistadeta, kui mingi tola mind välja tellis!

label: Route116_Text_DiggingTunnelWhenGoonOrderedMeOut
en: That tunnel's filled with POKéMON that react badly to loud noises. They could cause an uproar.
et: See tunnel on täis POKéMON mis reageerivad valjudele müradele halvasti. Need võivad tekitada möllu.

label: Route116_Text_DiggingTunnelWhenGoonOrderedMeOut
en: That's why we stopped using heavy equipment for tunneling…
et: Seetõttu lõpetasime rasketehnika kasutamise tunneliehituseks...

label: Route116_Text_DiggingTunnelWhenGoonOrderedMeOut
en: I'm worried that the goon will do something stupid and startle the POKéMON into an uproar.
et: Olen mures, et goon teeb midagi rumalat ja ehmatab POKéMON mölluks.

label: Route116_Text_GoonHightailedItOutOfTunnel
en: Nnn… Roar!
et: Nnn... Roar!

label: Route116_Text_GoonHightailedItOutOfTunnel
en: That goofy goon hightailed it out of the tunnel! I can go back to digging!
et: See tobe tont hurjutas selle tunnelist välja! Ma võin minna tagasi kaevama!

label: Route116_Text_ThankYouTokenOfAppreciation
en: Oh! It's you!
et: Oh! See oled sina!

label: Route116_Text_ThankYouTokenOfAppreciation
en: You're that person who not only helped me in PETALBURG WOODS, but also got back my stolen package and then even graciously delivered it to SLATEPORT!
et: Sa oled see inimene, kes mitte ainult ei aidanud mind PETALBURG WOODS, vaid sai ka tagasi minu varastatud paki ja siis isegi armulikult toimetas selle SLATEPORT!

label: Route116_Text_ThankYouTokenOfAppreciation
en: CAPT. STERN informed us that the package arrived, too!
et: CAPT. STERN teatas meile, et pakk saabus ka!

label: Route116_Text_ThankYouTokenOfAppreciation
en: I thank you very, very much!
et: Ma tänan teid väga, väga!

label: Route116_Text_ThankYouTokenOfAppreciation
en: Why, if I were a rain cloud, I would shower you with gratitude and hail you as a hero!
et: Miks, kui ma oleksin vihmapilv, siis ma duššitaks sind tänuga ja rahestaks sind kui kangelast!

label: Route116_Text_ThankYouTokenOfAppreciation
en: For you, the most wonderful TRAINER, I bear good news!
et: Sinu jaoks kõige imelisem TRAINER, kannan häid uudiseid!

label: Route116_Text_ThankYouTokenOfAppreciation
en: Recently, our company developed a new kind of POKé BALL.
et: Hiljuti töötas meie ettevõte välja uut tüüpi POKé BALL.

label: Route116_Text_ThankYouTokenOfAppreciation
en: As a token of our appreciation, this is our gift to our wonderful TRAINER!
et: Meie väärtustamise märgiks on see meie kingitus meie imelisele TRAINER!

label: Route116_Text_NewBallAvailableAtMart
en: Our new POKé BALL will be available at the POKéMON MART in RUSTBORO.
et: Meie uus POKé BALL on saadaval POKéMON MART in RUSTBORO.

label: Route116_Text_NewBallAvailableAtMart
en: Please do try it out! Thank you and bye-bye!
et: Palun proovige järele! Aitäh ja nägemist!

label: Route116_Text_BagIsJamPacked
en: Your BAG is jam-packed. I can't give you this REPEAT BALL.
et: Sinu BAG on moosipakendis. Ma ei saa sulle seda REPEAT BALL anda.

label: Route116_Text_TokenOfAppreciation
en: As a token of our appreciation for your delivering our package, I have a gift of a new kind of POKé BALL for our most wonderful TRAINER!
et: Nagu märk meie tunnustus teie tarne meie pakett, mul on kingitus uut tüüpi POKé BALL meie kõige imelisem TRAINER!

label: Route116_Text_CanYouHelpMeFindGlasses
en: I dropped my glasses… Can you help me find them?
et: Kas sa aitad mul neid leida?

label: Route116_Text_MayISeeThoseGlasses
en: Those glasses! May I see them for a second?
et: Need prillid! Kas ma võin neid korraks näha?

label: Route116_Text_NotWhatImLookingForMaybeTheyArentHere
en: Hmm… These are BLACKGLASSES. They're not what I'm looking for…
et: Hmm... need on BLACKGLASSES. Need ei ole need, mida ma otsin...

label: Route116_Text_NotWhatImLookingForMaybeTheyArentHere
en: Maybe my glasses aren't around here…
et: Võib-olla pole mu prille siinkandis...

label: Route116_Text_CantFindGlassesNotHere
en: Hmm… I can't find my glasses anywhere… Maybe they're not around here…
et: Hmm... ma ei leia oma prille kuskilt...ehk pole neid siinkandis...

label: Route116_Text_NotWhatImLookingFor
en: Hmm… These are BLACKGLASSES. They're not what I'm looking for…
et: Hmm... need on BLACKGLASSES. Need ei ole need, mida ma otsin...

label: Route116_Text_RouteSignRustboro
en: ROUTE 116 {LEFT_ARROW} RUSTBORO CITY
et: ROUTE 116 {LEFT_ARROW} RUSTBORO CITY

label: Route116_Text_RusturfTunnelSign
en: RUSTURF TUNNEL “Linking RUSTBORO and VERDANTURF
et: RUSTURF TUNNEL "Linkimine RUSTBORO ja VERDANTURF

label: Route116_Text_RusturfTunnelSign
en: “The tunnel project has been canceled.”
et: "Tunneliprojekt on tühistatud."

label: Route116_Text_TunnelersRestHouse
en: TUNNELER'S REST HOUSE
et: TUNNELER'S REST HOUSE

label: Route116_Text_TrainerTipsBToStopEvolution
en: TRAINER TIPS
et: TREENERI NIPID

label: Route116_Text_TrainerTipsBToStopEvolution
en: If you want to stop a POKéMON from evolving, press the B Button while it is trying to evolve. The startled POKéMON will stop.
et: Kui soovite peatada POKéMON arenemise, vajutage B-nuppu, kuni see püüab areneda. Ehmunud POKéMON jääb seisma.

label: Route116_Text_TrainerTipsBToStopEvolution
en: This is called an evolution cancel.
et: Seda nimetatakse evolutsiooni tühistamiseks.

label: Route116_Text_TrainerTipsBagHasPockets
en: TRAINER TIPS
et: TREENERI NIPID

label: Route116_Text_TrainerTipsBagHasPockets
en: Your BAG has several POCKETS.
et: Sinu BAG-l on mitu POCKETS.

label: Route116_Text_TrainerTipsBagHasPockets
en: Items you obtain are automatically placed in the appropriate POCKETS.
et: Saadud esemed paigutatakse automaatselt sobivasse POCKETS.

label: Route116_Text_TrainerTipsBagHasPockets
en: No TRAINER can afford to be without a BAG of their own.
et: No TRAINER võib lubada olla ilma BAG oma.

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_CantMakeHeadsOrTails
en: Umm… If this goes here, and that goes over there…
et: Umm... kui see läheb siia ja see läheb sinna...

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_CantMakeHeadsOrTails
en: Then where does this thing go? And what about that doohickey?
et: Kuhu see asi siis läheb? Ja kuidas selle doohickeyga on?

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_CantMakeHeadsOrTails
en: Aaargh! I can't make heads or tails of this!
et: Aaargh! Ma ei saa sellest päid ega sabasid teha!

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_MeetDockDeliverToStern
en: Hm? Hi, I'm DOCK.
et: Hm? Tere, olen DOCK.

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_MeetDockDeliverToStern
en: CAPT. STERN commissioned me to design a ferry.
et: CAPT. STERN tellis minult praami projekteerimise.

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_MeetDockDeliverToStern
en: Oh! That there… Are they DEVON GOODS?
et: Oh! Kas nad on DEVON GOODS?

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_MeetDockDeliverToStern
en: But, hmm… This won't do…
et: Aga, hmm... see ei tee...

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_MeetDockDeliverToStern
en: CAPT. STERN went off somewhere. He said he had some work to do.
et: CAPT. STERN läks kuskilt lahti. Ta ütles, et tal on vaja tööd teha.

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_MeetDockDeliverToStern
en: Could I get you to go find CAPT. STERN and deliver that to him?
et: Kas ma saaksin su minna otsima CAPT. STERN ja toimeta see talle?

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_CouldYouFindStern
en: DOCK: Where could CAPT. STERN have gone off to?
et: DOCK: Kus võiks CAPT. STERN on läinud?

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_CouldYouFindStern
en: Could you go find CAPT. STERN and deliver that parcel to him?
et: Kas sa võiksid minna otsima CAPT. STERN ja toimetage see pakk talle?

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_CouldUseAdviceFromVeteran
en: DOCK: Shipbuilding is an art.
et: DOCK: Laevaehitus on kunst.

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_CouldUseAdviceFromVeteran
en: A lot of things can't be figured out just by calculating.
et: Paljusid asju ei saa välja mõelda ainult arvutades.

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_CouldUseAdviceFromVeteran
en: I really could use advice from a veteran who knows the seas…
et: Mulle kuluks tõesti nõu veteranilt, kes tunneb meresid...

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_BrineyJoinedUs
en: DOCK: Hi! MR. BRINEY's joined us to lend us his help.
et: DOCK: Tere! MR. BRINEY on meiega liitunud, et laenata meile oma abi.

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_BrineyJoinedUs
en: Thanks to the veteran sailor, the ferry is steadily coming together.
et: Tänu veteranpurjetajale tuleb praam pidevalt kokku.

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_FerryIsReady
en: DOCK: The ferry is finally ready!
et: DOCK: Praam on lõpuks valmis!

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_FerryIsReady
en: The new S.S. TIDAL is truly a marvel of technology!
et: Uus S.S. TIDAL on tõeliselt imeline tehnoloogia!

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_FerryIsReady
en: But, I get the feeling that we can make something even better.
et: Aga, mul tekib tunne, et me saame midagi veel paremaks teha.

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_FerryIsReady
en: You know, there's never an end to technology's march.
et: Tead, tehnoloogia marsil ei ole kunagi lõppu.

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_DecidedToHelpDock
en: MR. BRINEY: Ah, {PLAYER}{KUN}! It's been too long!
et: MR. BRINEY: Ah, {PLAYER}{KUN}! See on olnud liiga pikk aeg!

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_DecidedToHelpDock
en: Aye, since I met you, this old sea dog's been feeling frisky!
et: Aye, kuna ma sinuga kohtusin, siis on see vana merikoer end tuimalt tundnud!

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_DecidedToHelpDock
en: So I've decided to help DOCK make a ferry.
et: Seega olen otsustanud aidata DOCK praami teha.

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_DecidedToHelpDock
en: Aye, after all, a ferry would be able to carry a lot of people.
et: Aye, praamiga saaks ju palju rahvast vedada.

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_DecidedToHelpDock
en: But, you know, that DOCK is really something special.
et: Aga tead, et DOCK on tõesti midagi erilist.

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_DecidedToHelpDock
en: With his knack for technology and my experience, I'm sure that we can build one great ship, aye!
et: Oma nupukusega tehnoloogiale ja oma kogemusega olen kindel, et saame ehitada ühe vahva laeva, aye!

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_SeaIsLikeLivingThing
en: The seasons, the weather, where the moon sits in the sky…
et: Aastaajad, ilm, kus kuu istub taevas...

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_SeaIsLikeLivingThing
en: These and other conditions make the sea change its expression.
et: Need ja muud tingimused panevad mere oma väljendust muutma.

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_SeaIsLikeLivingThing
en: That's right! The sea is like a living thing!
et: See on õige! Meri on nagu elus asi!

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_GetSeasickEasily
en: I get seasick real easily. So I get to help out here instead.
et: Ma saan merehaigeks lihtsalt. Nii et ma saan siin hoopis abiks olla.

label: SeafloorCavern_Entrance_Text_HearMagmaNearMossdeep
en: Hey! I remember your face!
et: Hei! Ma mäletan su nägu!

label: SeafloorCavern_Entrance_Text_HearMagmaNearMossdeep
en: If you're here, it must mean that you're about to mess with us again!
et: Kui sa oled siin, siis see peab tähendama, et sa hakkad meiega jälle jamama!

label: SeafloorCavern_Entrance_Text_HearMagmaNearMossdeep
en: A punk like you, do you really think you can take on TEAM AQUA?
et: Sinusugune punkar, kas sa tõesti arvad, et saad TEAM AQUA vastu võtta?

label: SeafloorCavern_Entrance_Text_HearMagmaNearMossdeep
en: I'd say you're too early by about a trillion years!
et: Ma ütleks, et sa oled umbes triljoniks aastaks liiga vara!

label: SeafloorCavern_Entrance_Text_HearMagmaNearMossdeep
en: You're a perfect fit for the likes of TEAM MAGMA!
et: Oled ideaalne sobivus TEAM MAGMA sarnastele!

label: SeafloorCavern_Entrance_Text_HearMagmaNearMossdeep
en: Speaking of TEAM MAGMA, I hear they were spotted near MOSSDEEP.
et: Rääkides TEAM MAGMA, kuulen, et neid märgati MOSSDEEP lähedal.

label: SeafloorCavern_Entrance_Text_HearMagmaNearMossdeep
en: That bunch of goons, they sure don't look good near the sea!
et: See hunnik tolasid, nad kindlasti ei näe mere lähedal head välja!

label: SeafloorCavern_Entrance_Text_HearMagmaNearMossdeepShort
en: A punk like you, do you really think you can take on TEAM AQUA?
et: Sinusugune punkar, kas sa tõesti arvad, et saad TEAM AQUA vastu võtta?

label: SeafloorCavern_Entrance_Text_HearMagmaNearMossdeepShort
en: I'd say you're too early by about a trillion years!
et: Ma ütleks, et sa oled umbes triljoniks aastaks liiga vara!

label: SeafloorCavern_Entrance_Text_HearMagmaNearMossdeepShort
en: You're a perfect fit for the likes of TEAM MAGMA!
et: Oled ideaalne sobivus TEAM MAGMA sarnastele!

label: SeafloorCavern_Entrance_Text_HearMagmaNearMossdeepShort
en: Speaking of TEAM MAGMA, I hear they were spotted near MOSSDEEP.
et: Rääkides TEAM MAGMA, kuulen, et neid märgati MOSSDEEP lähedal.

label: SeafloorCavern_Entrance_Text_HearMagmaNearMossdeepShort
en: That bunch of goons, they sure don't look good near the sea!
et: See hunnik tolasid, nad kindlasti ei näe mere lähedal head välja!

label: Route111_Text_BattleOurFamily
en: Hello! I take it you're a traveler.
et: Tere! Ma võtan, et sa oled rännumees.

label: Route111_Text_BattleOurFamily
en: How's this? What do you say to taking on our family of four in a series of POKéMON battles?
et: Kuidas see on? Mida sa ütled, et võtta meie neljaliikmeline perekond vastu ridamisi POKéMON lahinguid?

label: Route111_Text_IsThatSo
en: Is that so? Drop in, if you change your mind!
et: On see nii? Astuge sisse, kui te meelt muudate!

label: Route111_Text_VictorIntro
en: That's the spirit! I like you!
et: See on vaim! Sa meeldid mulle!

label: Route111_Text_VictorDefeat
en: Aiyah! You're a lot tougher than I expected!
et: Aiyah! Sa oled palju karmim, kui ma ootasin!

label: Route111_Text_VictorPostBattle
en: Hey, all! I've found a pretty strong TRAINER!
et: Hei, kõik! Olen leidnud päris tugeva TRAINER!

label: Route111_Text_VictoriaIntro
en: Oh, my goodness! Aren't you young?
et: Oh, mu headus! Kas sa pole noor?

label: Route111_Text_VictoriaIntro
en: You must be quite the TRAINER to beat my husband, though.
et: Sa oled vist päris see TRAINER, et mu meest siiski võita.

label: Route111_Text_VictoriaIntro
en: It's my turn to battle now!
et: Nüüd on minu kord lahingusse minna!

label: Route111_Text_VictoriaDefeat
en: Oh, gosh! I can't get over how strong you are!
et: Oh issand! Ma ei saa üle, kui tugev sa oled!

label: Route111_Text_VictoriaPostBattle
en: There's a strong TRAINER here! This one's really strong!
et: Siin on tugev TRAINER! See on tõesti tugev!

label: Route111_Text_ViviIntro
en: You're stronger than Mommy? Wow!
et: Sa oled tugevam kui emme? Vau!

label: Route111_Text_ViviIntro
en: But I'm strong, too! Really! Honestly!
et: Aga ma olen ka tugev! Tõesti! Ausalt!

label: Route111_Text_ViviDefeat
en: Huh? Did I just lose?
et: Huh? Kas ma lihtsalt kaotasin?

label: Route111_Text_ViviPostBattle
en: This stinks…
et: See haiseb...

label: Route111_Text_ViviPostBattle
en: …Snivel… Grandma!
et: ...Snivel... vanaema!

label: Route111_Text_VickyIntro
en: How dare you make my granddaughter cry!
et: Kuidas sa julged mu lapselast nutma panna!

label: Route111_Text_VickyIntro
en: For that, I'm going to smack you! Prepare to lose!
et: Selle eest ma lömastan sind! Valmistu kaotama!

label: Route111_Text_VickyDefeat
en: Kwah! You are strong… My granddaughter was right…
et: Kwah! Sa oled tugev... mu lapselapsel oli õigus...

label: Route111_Text_VickyPostBattle
en: If you're not in any hurry, visit with us awhile.
et: Kui teil pole kiiret, külastage koos meiega awhile.

label: Route111_Text_ToughToKeepWinningUpTheRanks
en: If you don't raise your POKéMON some more, it could be tough to keep winning up through the ranks.
et: Kui sa ei tõsta oma POKéMON mõned veel, siis võib olla raske jätkata võitmist läbi ridade.

label: Route111_Text_ToughToKeepWinningUpTheRanks
en: I've heard the POKéMON LEAGUE's ELITE FOUR are far stronger than any GYM LEADER.
et: Olen kuulnud, et POKéMON LIIGA ELITE FOUR on tunduvalt tugevamad kui mistahes SAALI JUHT.

label: Route111_Text_WinstrateFamilyDestroyedMe
en: I challenged the WINSTRATE family, but four matches in a row is tough going… They destroyed me.
et: Ma vaidlustasin WINSTRATE perekonna, kuid neli matši järjest on raske minna... Nad hävitasid mu.

en: ROUTE 111 {DOWN_ARROW} MAUVILLE CITY

en: “Our family's hearts beat as one!” THE WINSTRATE'S HOUSE
et: "Meie pere südamed peksavad ühena!" THE WINSTRATE'S HOUSE

en: ROUTE 111 {LEFT_ARROW} ROUTE 112
et: ROUTE 111 {LEFT_ARROW} ROUTE 112

en: ROUTE 111 {LEFT_ARROW} ROUTE 113
