en: OLD LADY'S REST STOP “Come in and rest your tired bones.”
et: OLD LADY'S REST STOP "Tulge sisse ja puhake oma väsinud luud".

label: Route111_Text_TrainerTipsSpAtkSpDef
en: TRAINER TIPS
et: TREENERI NIPID

label: Route111_Text_TrainerTipsSpAtkSpDef
en: One of the indicators of a POKéMON's powerfulness is SP. ATK. It stands for “SPECIAL ATTACK.”
et: Üheks POKéMON võimsuse näitajaks on SP. ATK. See tähistab "SPECIAL ATTACK".

label: Route111_Text_TrainerTipsSpAtkSpDef
en: Likewise, SP. DEF stands for “SPECIAL DEFENSE.”
et: Samamoodi SP. DEF tähistab "SPECIAL DEFENSE".

label: Route111_Text_ShouldBeMirageTowerAroundHere
en: There should be a tower made of sand around here somewhere.
et: Siin kuskil peaks olema liivast torn.

label: Route111_Text_ShouldBeMirageTowerAroundHere
en: But for some reason, it can be seen sometimes, and sometimes not.
et: Aga millegipärast on seda vahel näha ja vahel ka mitte.

label: Route111_Text_ShouldBeMirageTowerAroundHere
en: That's why I call it the MIRAGE TOWER.
et: Sellepärast nimetan seda MIRAGE TOWER-ks.

label: Route111_Text_MirageTowerClearlyVisible
en: I see it! The tower of sand!
et: Ma näen seda! Liiva torn!

label: Route111_Text_MirageTowerClearlyVisible
en: The sand tower they called a mirage is clearly visible!
et: Liivatorn, mida nad nimetasid miraažiks, on selgelt nähtav!

label: Route111_Text_MirageTowerClearlyVisible
en: But it looks so fragile… It could crumble away anytime…
et: Aga see näeb nii habras välja... see võib ära mureneda igal ajal...

label: Route111_Text_MirageTowerClearlyVisible
en: I want to go inside it, but I can't get my courage up for it…
et: Ma tahan sinna sisse minna, aga ma ei saa selle nimel oma julgust üles...

label: Route111_Text_ThatWasShockingSandRainedDown
en: Whoa… That was shocking.
et: See oli šokeeriv.

label: Route111_Text_ThatWasShockingSandRainedDown
en: Sand rained down in chunks all of a sudden.
et: Liiv sadas järsku tükikaupa maha.

label: Route111_Text_ThatWasShockingSandRainedDown
en: What was it like inside? Were there sandy ghosts and such?
et: Mis tunne see sees oli? Kas olid liivased kummitused ja sellised?

label: Route111_Text_MirageTowerHasntBeenSeenSince
en: Since I spoke to you, the tower of sand hasn't been seen.
et: Alates sellest, kui ma teiega rääkisin, pole liivatorni nähtud.

label: Route111_Text_MirageTowerHasntBeenSeenSince
en: Perhaps it really was the MIRAGE TOWER…
et: Võib-olla tõesti oli see MIRAGE TOWER...

label: Route111_Text_ClawFossilDisappeared
en: The CLAW FOSSIL disappeared into the sand…
et: CLAW FOSSIL kadus liiva...

label: Route111_Text_RootFossilDisappeared
en: The ROOT FOSSIL disappeared into the sand…
et: ROOT FOSSIL kadus liiva...

label: Route111_Text_MauvilleUncleToldMeToTakeRockSmash
en: Oh, no!
et: Oh ei!

label: Route111_Text_MauvilleUncleToldMeToTakeRockSmash
en: My uncle in MAUVILLE told me to take ROCK SMASH with me if I was going to ROUTE 111!
et: Minu onu MAUVILLE käskis mul ROCK SMASH kaasa võtta, kui ma lähen ROUTE 111!

label: Route111_Text_MauvilleUncleToldMeToTakeRockSmash
en: My uncle? He lives across from the bike shop in MAUVILLE.
et: Mu onu? Ta elab rattapoe vastas MAUVILLE.

label: Route111_Text_TrainerHillSign
en: {RIGHT_ARROW} TRAINER HILL ENTRANCE
et: {RIGHT_ARROW} TRAINER HILL ENTRANCE

label: Route111_Text_TrainerHillSign
en: “Scale the heights, you hot-blooded TRAINERS!”
et: "Masta kõrgusi, sa kuumavereline TRAINERS!"

label: SootopolisCity_House5_Text_SootopolisMtPyreConnection
en: There appears to be some connection between SOOTOPOLIS and MT. PYRE.
et: Tundub, et SOOTOPOLIS ja MT vahel on mingi seos. PYRE.

label: SootopolisCity_House5_Text_SootopolisMtPyreConnection
en: My friends and I did some research on it at the lab where I used to work.
et: Tegime sõpradega selle kohta mõned uuringud laboris, kus ma varem töötasin.

label: SootopolisCity_House5_Text_BrotherUsedToStudySea
en: My big brother used to study the sea.
et: Mu suur vend uuris kunagi merd.

label: PetalburgCity_Mart_Text_WeakWillGrowStronger
en: Even if a POKéMON is weak now, it will grow stronger.
et: Isegi kui POKéMON on nüüd nõrk, kasvab see tugevamaks.

label: PetalburgCity_Mart_Text_WeakWillGrowStronger
en: The most important thing is love! Love for your POKéMON!
et: Kõige tähtsam on armastus! Armastus oma POKéMON!

label: PetalburgCity_Mart_Text_RepelIsUseful
en: Do you use REPEL? It keeps POKéMON away, so it's useful when you're in a hurry.
et: Kas kasutad REPEL? See hoiab POKéMON eemal, nii et see on kasulik, kui teil on kiire.

label: PetalburgCity_Mart_Text_TakeSomeAntidotesWithYou
en: Do you have any ANTIDOTES with you?
et: Kas sul on mingi ANTIDOTES kaasas?

label: PetalburgCity_Mart_Text_TakeSomeAntidotesWithYou
en: If you walk around with a poisoned POKéMON, it will lose HP until it faints. Take some ANTIDOTES with you.
et: Kui käite ringi mürgitatud POKéMON-ga, kaotab see HP kuni see minestab. Võta mõni ANTIDOTES kaasa.

label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_B1F_Text_DuncanIntro
en: When we go out to sea, we SAILORS always bring our POKéMON. How about a quick battle?
et: Kui me läheme merele, siis me SAILORS alati toome oma POKéMON. Kuidas oleks kiire lahinguga?

label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_B1F_Text_DuncanDefeat
en: Whoops, I'm sunk!
et: Whoops, ma olen uppunud!

label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_B1F_Text_DuncanPostBattle
en: The ship's bottom has sunk into the depths.
et: Laeva põhi on vajunud sügavustesse.

label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_B1F_Text_DuncanPostBattle
en: If a POKéMON knew how to go underwater, we might make some progress…
et: Kui POKéMON oskaks vee alla minna, siis me võiksime teha edusamme...

label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_B1F_Text_YayItsAShip
en: Yay! It's a ship!
et: Yay! See on laev!

label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_B1F_Text_DoorIsLocked
en: The door is locked.
et: Uks on lukus.

label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_B1F_Text_DoorIsLocked
en: “STORAGE” is painted on the door.
et: "STORAGE" on värvitud uksele.

label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_B1F_Text_InsertedStorageKey
en: {PLAYER} inserted and turned the STORAGE KEY.
et: {PLAYER} sisestatud ja keeratud STORAGE KEY.

label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_B1F_Text_InsertedStorageKey
en: The inserted KEY stuck fast, but the door opened.
et: Sisestatud KEY jäi kiiresti kinni, kuid uks avanes.

label: AbandonedShip_Text_TheDoorIsOpen
en: The door is open.
et: Uks on lahti.

label: Route118_Text_StevenQuestions
en: STEVEN: Hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
et: STEVEN: Tere, {PLAYER}{KUN}!

label: Route118_Text_StevenQuestions
en: It's me, STEVEN! We met in the cave near DEWFORD.
et: See olen mina, STEVEN! Kohtusime koopas DEWFORD lähedal.

label: Route118_Text_StevenQuestions
en: Have you met many kinds of POKéMON since I last saw you?
et: Kas oled kohanud mitut sorti POKéMON kuna viimati nägin sind?

label: Route118_Text_StevenQuestions
en: There are many, many kinds of POKéMON in this wide world of ours.
et: Selles laias meie maailmas on palju, palju erinevaid POKéMON.

label: Route118_Text_StevenQuestions
en: If you wanted to raise only your favorites, that's fine.
et: Kui tahtsid tõsta ainult oma lemmikuid, siis pole hullu.

label: Route118_Text_StevenQuestions
en: Perhaps you find it more fun to raise all sorts of POKéMON.
et: Ehk leiad, et lõbusam on igasugu POKéMON tõsta.

label: Route118_Text_StevenQuestions
en: As a TRAINER of POKéMON, what do you think?
et: TRAINER POKéMON, mida sa arvad?

label: Route118_Text_StevenQuestions
en: Of course, it's not any of my business.
et: Loomulikult ei ole see minu asi.

label: Route118_Text_StevenQuestions
en: It would be nice if we were to meet again somewhere.
et: Oleks tore, kui me kuskil uuesti kohtuksime.

label: Route118_Text_YouAgreeGoodRodIsGood
en: Hmm! A GOOD ROD is really good!
et: Hmm! A GOOD ROD on tõesti hea!

label: Route118_Text_YouAgreeGoodRodIsGood
en: Wouldn't you agree?
et: Kas te ei oleks nõus?

label: Route118_Text_IdenticalMindsTakeThis
en: Hmm! We're of identical minds!
et: Hmm! Me oleme identsete mõtetega!

label: Route118_Text_IdenticalMindsTakeThis
en: Hmm! Take this GOOD ROD!
et: Hmm! Võta see GOOD ROD!

label: Route118_Text_TryYourLuckFishing
en: Wherever there's water, try your luck at fishing.
et: Kus iganes vett on, proovi kalal õnne.

label: Route118_Text_DontYouLikeToFish
en: Don't you like to fish?
et: Kas sulle ei meeldi kala püüda?

label: Route118_Text_TryCatchingMonWithGoodRod
en: Try catching all sorts of POKéMON with your GOOD ROD.
et: Proovi püüda igasugu POKéMON oma GOOD ROD-ga.

label: Route118_Text_CanCrossRiversWithSurf
en: Even if there isn't a boat, you can cross rivers and the sea if you have a POKéMON that knows SURF.
et: Isegi kui paati ei ole, võid ületada jõgesid ja merd, kui sul on POKéMON mis teab SURF.

label: Route118_Text_CanCrossRiversWithSurf
en: POKéMON can be counted on to do so much!
et: POKéMON võib arvestada, et teha nii palju!

label: Route118_Text_RouteSignMauville
en: ROUTE 118 {LEFT_ARROW} MAUVILLE CITY
et: ROUTE 118 {LEFT_ARROW} MAUVILLE CITY

label: Route118_Text_RouteSign119
en: ROUTE 118 {UP_ARROW} ROUTE 119
et: ROUTE 118 {UP_ARROW} ROUTE 119

label: Underwater_SeafloorCavern_Text_SubExplorer1
en: “SUBMARINE EXPLORER 1” is painted on the hull.
et: "SUBMARINE EXPLORER 1" on värvitud kere peale.

label: Underwater_SeafloorCavern_Text_SubExplorer1
en: This is the submarine TEAM AQUA stole in SLATEPORT!
et: See on allveelaev TEAM AQUA varastatud sisse SLATEPORT!

label: Underwater_SeafloorCavern_Text_SubExplorer1
en: TEAM AQUA must have gone ashore here.
et: TEAM AQUA läks vist kaldale siia.

label: Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text_Greeting
en: I'm the DIVING TREASURE HUNTER!
et: Mina olen see DIVING TREASURE HUNTER!

label: Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text_Greeting
en: I'm the awesome dude who makes deep-sea dives to gather treasures resting at the bottom.
et: Mina olen see vinge kutt, kes teeb süvamere sukeldusi, et koguda aardeid, mis puhkavad põhjas.

label: Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text_HaveYouSeenAnyShards
en: Tell me, have you seen any SHARDS of tools made in ancient times?
et: Ütle mulle, kas sa oled näinud mõnda SHARDS tööriista, mis on valmistatud iidsel ajal?

label: Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text_YouHaventGotAnyShards
en: You haven't got any treasures for me…
et: Sul pole minu jaoks aardeid...

label: Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text_YouHaventGotAnyShards
en: If you see any SHARDS, like the RED SHARD, you've got to trade it with me!
et: Kui sa näed mingit SHARDS, nagu RED SHARD, siis sa pead selle minuga kauplema!

label: Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text_ThatsAShardIllTradeYou
en: Oh, hey! That… That's a SHARD! I'm looking for those!
et: Oh, kuule! See on SHARD! Otsin neid!

label: Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text_ThatsAShardIllTradeYou
en: Oh, man, you've got to trade that with me! I'll give you something good!
et: Oh, mees, sa pead seda minuga kauplema! Annan sulle midagi head!

label: Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text_WhatDoYouWantToTrade
en: What do you want to trade?
et: Millega soovite kaubelda?

label: Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text_YoullTradeShardForStone
en: You'll trade your {STR_VAR_1} for my {STR_VAR_2}, then?
et: Vahetad siis oma {STR_VAR_1} minu {STR_VAR_2} vastu?

label: Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text_ItsADeal
en: It's a done deal! Use that wisely!
et: See on tehtud tehing! Kasuta seda targalt!

label: Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text_TradeSomethingElse
en: Do you want to trade something else?
et: Kas soovite veel midagi kaubelda?

label: Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text_BagFull
en: Whoops, your BAG's full. Get rid of some items, friend!
et: Whoops, su BAG on täis. Vabane mõnest esemest, sõber!

label: Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text_ComeBackIfYouChangeMind
en: No? That's a downer. Well, if you change your mind, come back.
et: Ei? See on allakäik. No kui meelt muudad, siis tule tagasi.

et: {CLEAR_TO 10} Soovitud toode{CLEAR_TO 124}Trade ese {CLEAR_TO 6}YELLOW SHARD3{LEFT_ARROW}5{CLEAR_TO 115}THUNDERSTONE{CLEAR_TO 200}

label: Route120_Text_StevenGreeting
en: STEVEN: Hm? {PLAYER}{KUN}, hi. It's been a while.
et: STEVEN: Hm? {PLAYER} {KUN}, tere. Sellest on juba tükk aega möödas.

label: Route120_Text_StevenGreeting
en: There's something here that you can't see, right?
et: Siin on midagi, mida sa ei näe, eks?

label: Route120_Text_StevenGreeting
en: Now, if I were to use this device on the invisible obstacle…
et: Kui ma nüüd kasutaksin seda seadet nähtamatul takistusel...

label: Route120_Text_StevenGreeting
en: No, no. Rather than describing it, I should just show you. That would be more fun.
et: Ei, ei. Selle asemel, et seda kirjeldada, peaksin ma teile lihtsalt näitama. See oleks lõbusam.

label: Route120_Text_StevenGreeting
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}, are your POKéMON ready for battle?
et: {PLAYER} {KUN}, kas teie POKéMON on lahinguks valmis?

label: Route120_Text_StevenIllWaitHere
en: STEVEN: No?
et: STEVEN: Ei?

label: Route120_Text_StevenIllWaitHere
en: I'll wait here, so you can get ready.
et: Ootan siin, et saaks valmis.

label: Route120_Text_StevenReadyForBattle
en: STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}, are your POKéMON ready for battle?
et: STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}, kas teie POKéMON on lahinguks valmis?

label: Route120_Text_StevenShowMeYourPower
en: STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}, show me your true power as a TRAINER!
et: STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}, näita mulle oma tõelist jõudu TRAINER!

label: Route120_Text_StevenUsedDevonScope
en: STEVEN used the DEVON SCOPE.
et: STEVEN kasutas DEVON SCOPE.

label: Route120_Text_StevenUsedDevonScope
en: An invisible POKéMON became completely visible!
et: Nähtamatu POKéMON muutus täiesti nähtavaks!

label: Route120_Text_StevenUsedDevonScope
en: The startled POKéMON attacked!
et: Ehmunud POKéMON ründas!

label: Route120_Text_StevenGiveDevonScope
en: STEVEN: I see… Your battle style is intriguing.
et: STEVEN: Ma näen... Sinu lahingustiil on intrigeeriv.

label: Route120_Text_StevenGiveDevonScope
en: Your POKéMON have obviously grown since I first met you in DEWFORD.
et: Sinu POKéMON on ilmselgelt kasvanud, kuna kohtusin sinuga esimest korda DEWFORD.

label: Route120_Text_StevenGiveDevonScope
en: I'd like you to have this DEVON SCOPE.
et: Tahaks, et sul oleks see DEVON SCOPE.

label: Route120_Text_StevenGiveDevonScope
en: Who knows, there may be other concealed POKéMON.
et: Kes teab, võib olla ka teisi varjatud POKéMON.

label: Route120_Text_StevenGoodbye
en: STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}.
et: STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}.

label: Route120_Text_StevenGoodbye
en: I enjoy seeing POKéMON and TRAINERS who strive together.
et: Mulle meeldib näha POKéMON ja TRAINERS kes püüdlevad koos.

label: Route120_Text_StevenGoodbye
en: I think you're doing great.
et: Ma arvan, et sul läheb suurepäraselt.

label: Route120_Text_StevenGoodbye
en: Well, let's meet again somewhere.
et: Noh, kohtume jälle kuskil.

label: Kecleon_Text_SomethingUnseeable
en: Something unseeable is in the way.
et: Midagi nähtamatut on ees.

label: Kecleon_Text_WantToUseDevonScope
en: Something unseeable is in the way.
et: Midagi nähtamatut on ees.

label: Kecleon_Text_WantToUseDevonScope
en: Want to use the DEVON SCOPE?
et: Tahad kasutada DEVON SCOPE?

en: {PLAYER} used the DEVON SCOPE.
et: {PLAYER} kasutas DEVON SCOPE.

label: Kecleon_Text_UseDevonScopeMonAttacked
en: An invisible POKéMON became completely visible!
et: Nähtamatu POKéMON muutus täiesti nähtavaks!

en: The startled POKéMON attacked!
et: Ehmunud POKéMON ründas!

en: ROUTE 120 {LEFT_ARROW} FORTREE CITY
et: ROUTE 120 {LEFT_ARROW} FORTREE CITY

en: {RIGHT_ARROW} ROUTE 121 {LEFT_ARROW} ROUTE 120
et: {RIGHT_ARROW} ROUTE 121 {LEFT_ARROW} ROUTE 120

label: NewMauville_Inside_Text_GeneratorRadiatingHeat
en: The generator is radiating heat that can be felt even at a distance.
et: Generaator kiirgab soojust, mida on tunda ka eemalt.

label: NewMauville_Inside_Text_GeneratorRadiatingHeat
en: It looks like it should be turned off as soon as possible.
et: Tundub, et see tuleks võimalikult kiiresti välja lülitada.

label: NewMauville_Inside_Text_GeneratorQuietedDown
en: The generator quieted down.
et: Generaator vaikis.

label: NewMauville_Inside_Text_SteppedOnSwitchGeneratorStopped
en: {PLAYER} stepped on the switch.
et: {PLAYER} astus lüliti peale.

label: NewMauville_Inside_Text_SteppedOnSwitchGeneratorStopped
en: Click…
et: Kliki...

label: NewMauville_Inside_Text_SteppedOnSwitchGeneratorStopped
en: The generator appears to have stopped…
et: Generaator paistab olevat seiskunud...

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_ThanksForPlayingWithWally
en: You're… Ah, you must be {PLAYER}{KUN}, right?
et: Sa oled... Ah, sa pead olema {PLAYER}{KUN}, eks?

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_ThanksForPlayingWithWally
en: Thank you for playing with WALLY a little while ago.
et: Aitäh, et natuke aega tagasi mängisid WALLY-ga.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_ThanksForPlayingWithWally
en: He's been frail and sickly ever since he was a baby.
et: Ta on lapsest saati olnud tüdinud ja haige.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_ThanksForPlayingWithWally
en: We've sent him to stay with my relatives in VERDANTURF TOWN for a while.
et: Me saatsime ta mõneks ajaks minu sugulaste juurde VERDANTURF TOWN.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_ThanksForPlayingWithWally
en: The air is a lot cleaner there than it is here.
et: Õhk on seal palju puhtam kui siin.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_ThanksForPlayingWithWally
en: What's that? Where's WALLY? He's already left, our WALLY.
et: Mis see on? Kus on WALLY? Ta on juba lahkunud, meie WALLY.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_ThanksForPlayingWithWally
en: I wonder where he could have gotten by now?
et: Huvitav, kuhu ta praeguseks oleks saanud?

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WonderHowWallyIsDoing
en: I wonder how our WALLY is doing?
et: Huvitav, kuidas meie WALLY läheb?

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_PleaseExcuseUs
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}! Please excuse us for dragging you here this way.
et: {PLAYER}{KUN}! Palun vabandage meid, et vedasite teid siia nii.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_PleaseExcuseUs
en: But our WALLY's become very healthy since he went to VERDANTURF TOWN.
et: Aga meie WALLY on muutunud väga terveks, kuna ta läks VERDANTURF TOWN.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_PleaseExcuseUs
en: We owe it all to you!
et: Me võlgneme selle kõik teile!

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_PleaseExcuseUs
en: When WALLY left town, you helped him catch a POKéMON, right?
et: Kui WALLY lahkus linnast, siis aitasid tal tabada POKéMON, eks?

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_PleaseExcuseUs
en: I think that made WALLY really happy.
et: Ma arvan, et see tegi WALLY tõeliselt õnnelikuks.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_PleaseExcuseUs
en: Actually, not just WALLY. It made me, his father, happy too.
et: Tegelikult mitte ainult WALLY. See tegi mind, tema isa, ka õnnelikuks.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_PleaseExcuseUs
en: Happy that he's gained such a great friend as you.
et: Õnnelik, et ta on saanud endale nii suure sõbra nagu sina.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_PleaseExcuseUs
en: This isn't a bribe or anything, but I'd really like you to have this.
et: See ei ole altkäemaks ega midagi, aga ma väga tahaksin, et teil oleks selline asi.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_SurfGoAllSortsOfPlaces
en: If your POKéMON can SURF, you'll be able to go to all sorts of places.
et: Kui teie POKéMON saab SURF, siis saate minna kõikvõimalikesse kohtadesse.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WallyIsComingHomeSoon
en: WALLY's coming home soon. I'm looking forward to that.
et: WALLY tuleb varsti koju. Ootan seda väga.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_YouMetWallyInEverGrandeCity
en: Oh? You met WALLY in EVER GRANDE CITY?
et: Oh? Kohtusid WALLY in EVER GRANDE CITY?

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_YouMetWallyInEverGrandeCity
en: Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}, don't be silly.
et: Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}, ära ole rumal.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_YouMetWallyInEverGrandeCity
en: He may have gotten healthy, but he can't go somewhere far away like that all by himself.
et: Ta võib-olla sai terveks, aga ta ei saa üksi niimoodi kuhugi kaugele minna.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WallyWasReallyHappy
en: WALLY was really happy when he told us that he caught a POKéMON.
et: WALLY oli tõesti õnnelik, kui ta ütles meile, et ta püüdis POKéMON.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WallyWasReallyHappy
en: It's been ages since I've seen him smile like that.
et: Sellest ajast, kui ma olen teda niimoodi naeratamas näinud, on möödas igavikulised ajad.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WallyLeftWithoutTelling
en: I want you to keep this a secret from my husband…
et: Ma tahan, et sa hoiaksid seda saladust mu mehe eest...

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WallyLeftWithoutTelling
en: But our WALLY left VERDANTURF TOWN without telling anyone.
et: Aga meie WALLY lahkus VERDANTURF TOWN ilma kellelegi ütlemata.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WallyLeftWithoutTelling
en: You know, WALLY is frail, but he's surprisingly strong-willed.
et: Tead, WALLY on nõrk, aga ta on üllatavalt tugeva tahtega.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WallyLeftWithoutTelling
en: I'm sure that he'll come back safe and sound one day!
et: Kindlasti tuleb ta ühel päeval turvaliselt tagasi ja kõlab!

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
en: WALLACE: Welcome, {PLAYER}{KUN}.
et: WALLACE: Tere tulemast, {PLAYER}{KUN}.

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
en: That incident in SOOTOPOLIS CITY… That was superb work, putting an end to that crisis all by yourself.
et: See intsident SOOTOPOLIS CITY... See oli suurepärane töö, mis lõpetas selle kriisi iseenesest.

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
en: Oops!
et: Oops!

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
en: It wouldn't be fair to say that you alone ended the crisis.
et: Ei oleks aus öelda, et sina üksi lõpetasid kriisi.

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
en: You overcame that difficult situation by working as one with your POKéMON.
et: Sa said sellest raskest olukorrast üle, töötades ühena oma POKéMON-ga.

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
en: We TRAINERS raise POKéMON by giving them items and by teaching them new techniques for battle.
et: Me TRAINERS tõsta POKéMON andes neile esemeid ja õpetades neile uusi tehnikaid lahing.

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
en: But we ourselves also learn many things from POKéMON.
et: Aga me ise õpime ka palju asju POKéMON pealt.

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
en: And this is where your achievements are put to the test against what others like you have achieved.
et: Ja siin pannakse teie saavutused proovile selle vastu, mida teised teiesugused on saavutanud.

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
en: Now!
et: Nüüd!

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
en: Who can most elegantly dance with their POKéMON in HOENN?
et: Kes saab kõige elegantsemalt tantsida oma POKéMON in HOENN?

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
en: Show me right here and now!
et: Näita mulle kohe siin ja praegu!

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_Defeat
en: I, the CHAMPION, fall in defeat…
et: Mina, TŠEMPION, langen kaotusseisust...

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_Defeat
en: That was wonderful work. You were elegant, infuriatingly so. And yet it was utterly glorious!
et: See oli imeline töö. Sa olid elegantne, vihaselt nii. Ja ometi oli see täiesti hiilgav!

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_Defeat
en: Kudos to you, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
et: Kudos sulle, {PLAYER}{KUN}!

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_Defeat
en: You are a truly noble POKéMON TRAINER!
et: Oled tõeliselt üllas POKéMON TRAINER!

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_PostBattleSpeech
en: WALLACE: The POKéMON you sent into battle…
et: WALLACE: POKéMON sa saatsid lahingusse...

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_PostBattleSpeech
en: At times they danced like a spring breeze, and at times they struck like lightning.
et: Kohati tantsiti nagu kevadist tuult ja kohati löödi nagu välku.

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_PostBattleSpeech
en: It was with light, yet surefooted, elegance that you led your POKéMON.
et: See oli kerge, kuid kindel elegants, et sa juhtisid oma POKéMON.

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_PostBattleSpeech
en: Even I felt bedazzled by your masterful performance!
et: Isegi mina tundsin end su meisterlikust esitusest pimestatuna!

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_PostBattleSpeech
en: You now stand at the glorious peak of the POKéMON LEAGUE.
et: Nüüd seisate hiilgavas tipus POKéMON LIIGA.

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_PostBattleSpeech
en: I now proclaim you to be the new HOENN region…
et: Kuulutan teid nüüd uueks HOENN piirkonnaks...

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_MayAdvice
en: MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}!
et: MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}!

en: MAY: Huh? What, what, what?
et: MAY: Huh? Mida, mida, mida?

et: BRENDAN: {PLAYER}!

et: Kuidas sooviksid nõu enne TŠEMPION vaidlustamist?...

en: BRENDAN: {PLAYER}…
et: BRENDAN: {PLAYER}...

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BrendanYouveWon
en: Are you trying to tell me… You've beaten the CHAMPION?
et: Kas sa üritad mulle öelda, et sa oled TŠEMPION peksa saanud?

en: PROF. BIRCH: See? What did I tell you, {RIVAL}?
et: PROF. BIRCH: Näete? Mida ma sulle ütlesin, {RIVAL}?

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BirchArriveRatePokedex
en: Didn't I tell you that you don't need to worry about {PLAYER}{KUN}?
et: Kas ma ei öelnud sulle, et sa ei pea muretsema {PLAYER}{KUN}?

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BirchArriveRatePokedex
en: … … … … … … … … {PLAYER}{KUN}, you've finally done it.
et: ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... {PLAYER}{KUN}, sa oled selle lõpuks ära teinud.

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BirchArriveRatePokedex
en: When I heard that you defeated your own father at the PETALBURG GYM, I thought perhaps you had a chance…
et: Kui kuulsin, et võitsid oma isa PETALBURG SAAL juures, arvasin, et ehk on sul võimalus...

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BirchArriveRatePokedex
en: But to think you've actually become the CHAMPION!
et: Aga arvata, et sinust on tegelikult saanud TŠEMPION!

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BirchArriveRatePokedex
en: Ah, yes!
et: Ah jaa!

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BirchArriveRatePokedex
en: What became of your POKéDEX? Here, let me see.
et: Mis sai sinu POKéDEX? Siin, las ma näen.

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BirchCongratulations
en: PROF. BIRCH: Anyways, congratulations!
et: PROF. BIRCH: Igatahes, palju õnne!

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BirchCongratulations
en: Now, go proudly into the final room!
et: Mine nüüd uhkelt finaaltuppa!

en: WALLACE: {PLAYER}{KUN}…
et: WALLACE: {PLAYER}{KUN}...

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_WallaceComeWithMe
en: No, let me rephrase that properly.
et: Ei, las ma sõnastan selle korralikult ümber.

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_WallaceComeWithMe
en: The new CHAMPION!
et: Uus TŠEMPION!

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_WallaceComeWithMe
en: Come with me.
et: Tule minuga kaasa.

en: WALLACE: I'm sorry, but…
et: WALLACE: Vabandust, aga...

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_WallaceWaitOutside

et: Siit edasi võivad siseneda ainult need TRAINERS, kellest on saanud TŠEMPIONS.

en: MAY: Groan…
et: MAY: Groan...

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_MayCongratulations
en: I'm just joking! That's okay! That's the rule!
et: Ma lihtsalt teen nalja! Pole hullu! See on reegel!

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_MayCongratulations
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}! Honestly, congratulations!
et: {PLAYER}{KUN}! Ausalt, palju õnne!

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BrendanCongratulations
en: It can't be helped if that's the rule.
et: Seda ei saa aidata, kui see on reegel.

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BrendanCongratulations
en: {PLAYER}, way to go! Congratulations!
et: {PLAYER}, kuidas minna! Palju õnne!

label: PacifidlogTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_AncestorsLivedOnBoats
en: The ancestors of the people in PACIFIDLOG were said to have been born on boats and then lived and died aboard them.

label: PacifidlogTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_AncestorsLivedOnBoats
en: I understand that they lived that way because they were searching for something.

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle2_Text_WroteSecretCodeLockOpened
en: {PLAYER} wrote down the secret code on the door.
et: {PLAYER} kirjutas üles uksel oleva salakoodi.

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle2_Text_TedIntro
en: Which switch closes which hole?
et: Milline lüliti sulgeb millise augu?

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle2_Text_TedDefeat
en: After that battle, I'm even more confused!
et: Peale seda lahingut olen veel rohkem segaduses!

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle2_Text_TedPostBattle
en: Can I get you to push all the buttons for me?
et: Kas sa saad mulle kõik nupud peale suruda?

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle2_Text_PaulIntro
en: Oh! You're on your second TRICK HOUSE challenge!
et: Oh! Oled oma teisel TRICK HOUSE väljakutsel!

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle2_Text_PaulDefeat
en: You're good at battling too?
et: Ka sina oled osav võitlema?

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle2_Text_PaulPostBattle
en: The TRICK MASTER rigged all the tricks in this house all by himself.
et: TRICK MASTER taglas kõik trikid siin majas kõik ise.

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle2_Text_GeorgiaIntro
en: I want to make my own GYM one day. So, I'm studying how to set traps.
et: Tahan ühel päeval ise teha SAAL. Seega, uurin, kuidas püüniseid paika panna.

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle2_Text_GeorgiaDefeat
en: I didn't study battling enough!
et: Ma ei uurinud piisavalt võitlemist!

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle2_Text_GeorgiaPostBattle
en: You're strong, aren't you? Maybe even enough to be a GYM LEADER!
et: Sa oled ju tugev? Võib-olla isegi piisavalt, et olla SAALI JUHT!

en: My husband is waiting at home. What would make a good gift for him?
et: Mu mees ootab kodus. Mis teeks talle hea kingituse?

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_2F_Text_StockUpOnItems
en: I'm leaving on a long journey soon. I need to stock up on items.
et: Lahkun peagi pikale teekonnale. Mul on vaja asju varuda.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: Yo, how's it going, CHAMPION-bound {PLAYER}?
et: Yo, kuidas läheb, TŠEMPION-bound {PLAYER}?

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: The GYM LEADERS here use PSYCHIC-type POKéMON.
et: Siinne SAALI JUHTS kasutab Vaimne-tüüpi POKéMON.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: If you go up against them with FIGHTING- or POISON-type POKéMON, they'll inflict horrible damage!
et: Kui minna neile vastu FIGHTING- või Mürgi-tüüpi POKéMON-ga, tekitavad nad jubedaid kahjustusi!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: Plus, they'll come at you with outstanding combination attacks.
et: Lisaks tulevad nad sulle vastu silmapaistvate kombinatsioonirünnakutega.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: If you want to win, you'll need to show them how tight you are with your POKéMON. Go for it!
et: Kui tahad võita, pead neile näitama, kui tihe sa oma POKéMON-ga oled. Mine selle järele!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictory
en: Wow, you're astounding! You're one great TRAINER!
et: Vau, sa oled rabav! Sa oled üks suurepärane TRAINER!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_PrestonIntro
en: Battles hinge on the strength of your spirit! The weak-spirited will never win!
et: Lahingud hingestavad sinu vaimu tugevust! Nõrga vaimuga ei võida kunagi!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_PrestonDefeat
en: I lost! I must temper my spirit again!
et: Kaotasin! Ma pean jälle oma vaimu karastama!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_PrestonPostBattle
en: The indecisive lose. That's my warning to you.
et: Otsustamatud kaotavad. See on minu hoiatus teile.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_VirgilIntro
en: Let me see your talent!
et: Las ma näen su annet!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_VirgilDefeat
en: You possess spectacular talent!
et: Sul on suurejooneline talent!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_VirgilPostBattle
en: If there are prodigies in the world, then our GYM LEADERS are them!
et: Kui maailmas on imelapsi, siis meie SAALI JUHTS on need!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_VirgilPostBattle
en: However, you may be even more talented than them…
et: Siiski võid olla neist veelgi andekam...

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_BlakeIntro
en: Fufufufu… Watch me levitate a POKé BALL telekinetically!
et: Fufufufufu... Vaata, kuidas ma levitan POKé BALL telekineetiliselt!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_BlakeIntro
en: Wrooooooooaaaar! … … … … … … …

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_BlakeIntro
en: Sometimes, I'm out of sync…
et: Vahel olen sünkroonist väljas...

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_BlakeDefeat
en: My POKéMON battling skills are out of sync, too!
et: Minu POKéMON võitlusoskused on ka sünkroonist väljas!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_BlakePostBattle
en: A POKé BALL was too heavy to lift psychically. But this dust bunny…
et: A POKé BALL oli liiga raske, et psüühiliselt tõsta. Aga see tolmujänku...

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_BlakePostBattle
en: Whoooooooooooooooh! … … … … … …
et: Whoooooooooooooooh! ... ... ... ... ... ...

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_BlakePostBattle
en: No, I'm not cheating! I didn't blow on it! Honestly!
et: Ei, ma ei peta! Ma ei puhunud selle peale! Ausalt!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_HannahIntro
en: When you lose to me, don't be too hard on yourself.
et: Kui sa kaotad mulle, ära ole enda vastu liiga raske.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_HannahIntro
en: It's not that you're weak--I'm just too strong!
et: Asi ei ole selles, et sa oled nõrk--olen lihtsalt liiga tugev!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_HannahDefeat
en: You're just too strong!
et: Sa oled lihtsalt liiga tugev!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_HannahPostBattle
en: I'm not going to get down on myself for losing. I just need to train harder.
et: Ma ei hakka kaotamise pärast enda peale laskuma. Ma pean lihtsalt rohkem treenima.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_HannahPostBattle
en: Positive thinking--that's my strong point!
et: Positiivne mõtlemine--see on minu tugev külg!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SamanthaIntro
en: I see it… I see your future…
et: Ma näen seda... ma näen su tulevikku...

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SamanthaIntro
en: If you can beat me, I will tell you your future!
et: Kui te suudate mind võita, siis ma ütlen teile teie tuleviku!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SamanthaDefeat
en: I surrender!
et: Ma alistun!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SamanthaPostBattle
en: You will wage a terrifically intense battle with our GYM LEADERS…
et: Te peate hirmuäratavalt intensiivset lahingut meie SAALI JUHTS...

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SamanthaPostBattle
en: The result… You won't hear it from me!
et: Tulemus... sa ei kuule seda minult!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MauraIntro
en: The roads you have traveled… What you have experienced…
et: Need teed, mida oled reisinud... Mida oled kogenud...

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MauraIntro
en: Come at me with everything you've learned!
et: Tule mulle kõigega, mida oled õppinud!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MauraDefeat
en: You've traveled a path of greatness!
et: Oled rännanud ülevuse teed!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MauraPostBattle
en: A bright future awaits those who have worked diligently.
et: Usinalt töötanud inimesi ootab ees helge tulevik.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MauraPostBattle
en: For those who lazed idly, there is only despair at the end.
et: Neile, kes laisklesid käed rüpes, on lõpus vaid meeleheide.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MauraPostBattle
en: What goes around comes around…
et: See, mis ümberringi käib, tuleb ümber...

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SylviaIntro
en: Even at the risk of life, I will win this battle!
et: Isegi eluohus võidan selle lahingu!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SylviaDefeat
en: What you do… It horrifies me…
et: See kohutab mind...

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SylviaPostBattle
en: How dare you beat me…
et: Kuidas sa julged mind võita...

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SylviaPostBattle
en: It won't be my fault if something horrible befalls you…
et: See ei ole minu süü, kui midagi jubedat sulle ette satub...

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_NateIntro
en: Hohoho.
et: Hohoho.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_NateIntro
en: You need me to show you how tenacious the PSYCHIC type can be.
et: Sa vajad mind, et näidata, kui visa Vaimne tüüp võib olla.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_NateDefeat
en: Oh! My, my! Your battle style is fantastic!
et: Oh! Minu, minu! Sinu lahingustiil on fantastiline!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_NatePostBattle
en: I… I don't let defeat rattle m-me, however b-badly.
et: Ma... ma ei lase lüüa raginal m-meil, aga b-halvasti.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_KathleenIntro
en: Let me show you a perfectly awful, horrifying time!
et: Las ma näitan teile täiesti kohutavat, õudset aega!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_KathleenDefeat
en: N-nooooo!
et: N-nooooo!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_KathleenPostBattle
en: Your vitality is contagious! Get away from me quickly!
et: Sinu vitaalsus on nakkav! Astuge minust kiiresti eemale!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_CliffordIntro
en: I may be past my prime, but I suggest you not patronize me.
et: Ma võin olla oma priimusest möödas, kuid ma soovitan sul mind mitte üleolevalt kohelda.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_CliffordDefeat
en: Ah, you overflow with the power of youth!
et: Ah, sa voolad üle nooruse väest!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_CliffordPostBattle
en: It seems that I could not overcome your youthful energy.
et: Tundub, et ma ei suutnud sinu nooruslikust energiast üle saada.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MaceyIntro
en: You're not getting through to the end! Not if I can help it!
et: Sa ei saa lõpuni läbi! Mitte siis, kui saan aidata!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MaceyDefeat
en: How could you be so ludicrously strong?
et: Kuidas sa said olla nii naeruväärselt tugev?

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MaceyPostBattle
en: Humph! You may be strong, but you're not suitable for the PSYCHIC type!
et: Humph! Võite olla tugev, kuid te ei sobi Vaimne tüübile!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MaceyPostBattle
en: The way you battle is somehow brutal!
et: See, kuidas sa võitled, on kuidagi jõhker!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_NicholasIntro
en: Wroooar! Have a taste of my super POKéMON hard-battling power!
et: Wrooear! Omage maitset minu super POKéMON kõvavõitu!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_NicholasDefeat
en: Oh! Done in!
et: Oh! Tehtud sisse!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_NicholasPostBattle
en: All right! I think I'll develop a special invincible POKéMON power next.
et: Hea küll! Ma arvan, et ma arendan järgmisena välja spetsiaalse võitmatu POKéMON võimu.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaIntro
en: TATE: Hehehe… Were you surprised?
et: TATE: Hehehe... Kas sa olid üllatunud?

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaIntro
en: LIZA: Fufufu… Were you surprised?
et: LIZA: Fufufu... Kas sa olid üllatunud?

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaIntro
en: TATE: That there are two GYM LEADERS? LIZA: That there are two GYM LEADERS?
et: TATE: Et on kaks SAALI JUHTS? LIZA: Et on kaks SAALI JUHTS?

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaIntro
en: TATE: We're twins! LIZA: We're twins!
et: TATE: Me oleme kaksikud! LIZA: Me oleme kaksikud!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaIntro
en: TATE: We don't need to talk because… LIZA: We can each determine what…
et: TATE: Me ei pea rääkima, sest... LIZA: Me saame igaüks määrata, mida...

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaIntro
en: TATE: The other is thinking… LIZA: All in our minds!
et: TATE: Teine mõtleb... LIZA: Kõik meie mõtetes!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaIntro
en: TATE: This combination of ours… LIZA: Can you beat it?
et: TATE: See kombinatsioon meie... LIZA: Kas te võite seda võita?

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaDefeat
en: TATE: What?! Our combination… LIZA: Was shattered!
et: TATE: Mis?! Meie kombinatsioon... LIZA: Oli purunenud!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaDefeat
en: TATE: It can't be helped. You've won… LIZA: So, in recognition, take this.
et: TATE: Seda ei saa aidata. Sa oled võitnud... LIZA: Seega tunnustuseks võta see.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedMindBadge
en: {PLAYER} received the MIND BADGE from TATE and LIZA.
et: {PLAYER} sai MIND MÄRK alates TATE ja LIZA.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_ExplainMindBadgeTakeThis
en: TATE: The MIND BADGE enhances the SP. ATK and SP. DEF of POKéMON.
et: TATE: MIND MÄRK suurendab SP. ATK ja SP. DEF of POKéMON.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_ExplainMindBadgeTakeThis

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_IWantRematch2
en: I'm registering you in my POKéNAV!
et: Registreerin sind oma POKéNAV!

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_MyPokemonHaveGrown
en: My BUG POKéMON have grown. I'll be popular again.
et: Minu BUG POKéMON on kasvanud. Ma olen jälle populaarne.

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_CantBePopularIfLose
en: I can't be popular if I lose.
et: Ma ei saa olla populaarne, kui ma kaotan.

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_IveBeenTrainingHard
en: You get to be popular if you have strong POKéMON, right? So, I've been training hard.
et: Sa saad olla populaarne, kui sul on tugev POKéMON, eks? Seega, olen kõvasti treeninud.

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_StayOutOfTallGrass
en: Yo, there! Your POKéMON doing okay?
et: Kuule, seal! Sinu POKéMON teeb hästi?

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_StayOutOfTallGrass
en: If your POKéMON are weak and you want to avoid battles, you should stay out of tall grass.
et: Kui teie POKéMON on nõrgad ja soovite lahinguid vältida, peaksite kõrgest rohust eemale hoidma.

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_HiddenItemsExplanation
en: Sometimes, there are things on the ground even if you can't see them.
et: Vahel on kohapeal asju ka siis, kui neid ei näe.

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_HiddenItemsExplanation
en: That's why I always check where I'm walking.
et: Seepärast kontrollin alati, kus ma kõnnin.

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_TryUsingThisItem
en: Oh, neat! That's the BADGE from RUSTBORO GYM!
et: Oh, korralik! See on MÄRK alates RUSTBORO SAAL!

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_TryUsingThisItem
en: You must be a TRAINER. You should try using this item.
et: Sa pead olema TRAINER. Te peaksite proovima seda eset kasutada.

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_MiracleSeedExplanation
en: It's a MIRACLE SEED. If a POKéMON holds that item, its GRASS-type moves become stronger.
et: See on MIRACLE SEED. Kui POKéMON hoiab seda eset, muutuvad selle Rohu tüüpi käigud tugevamaks.

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_MiracleSeedExplanation
en: Besides MIRACLE SEED, I think there are other convenient items for POKéMON to hold.
et: Peale MIRACLE SEED on minu arvates ka muid mugavaid esemeid POKéMON hoidmiseks.

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_TrainerTipsExperience
en: TRAINER TIPS
et: TREENERI NIPID

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_TrainerTipsExperience
en: Any POKéMON that appears even once in a battle is awarded EXP Points.
et: Iga POKéMON mis ilmub isegi üks kord lahingus antakse EXP P punkte.

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_TrainerTipsExperience
en: To raise a weak POKéMON, put it at the left of the team list.
et: Nõrga POKéMON tõstmiseks pange see meeskonna nimekirjast vasakule.

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_TrainerTipsExperience
en: As soon as a battle starts, switch it out. It will earn EXP Points without being exposed to any harm.
et: Niipea, kui algab lahing, lülitage see välja. See teenib EXP P Võidab ilma ühegi kahjuga kokku puutumata.

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_TrainerTipsPP
en: TRAINER TIPS
et: TREENERI NIPID

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_TrainerTipsPP
en: In addition to Hit Points (HP), POKéMON have Power Points (PP) that are used to make moves during battle.
et: Lisaks Hit Pointsidele (HP) on POKéMON Power Pointsidel (PP), mida kasutatakse lahingu ajal käikude tegemiseks.

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_TrainerTipsPP
en: If a POKéMON runs out of PP, it must be taken to a POKéMON CENTER.
et: Kui POKéMON saab otsa PP, tuleb see viia POKéMON CENTER.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomFinal_Text_CongratsThisWayPlease
en: Congratulations… Now, this way, please…
et: Palju õnne... Nüüd, nii, palun...

label: SkyPillar_Outside_Text_DoorIsClosed
en: The door is closed.
et: Uks on suletud.

label: SkyPillar_Outside_Text_OpenedDoorToSkyPillar
en: WALLACE: Oh, my, I'm terribly sorry!
et: WALLACE: Oh, minu, mul on kohutavalt kahju!

label: SkyPillar_Outside_Text_OpenedDoorToSkyPillar
en: In my haste, I didn't notice that I'd left you behind!
et: Kiirustades ei pannud ma tähelegi, et olin su maha jätnud!

label: SkyPillar_Outside_Text_OpenedDoorToSkyPillar
en: I've opened the locked door of the SKY PILLAR.
et: Olen avanud SKY PILLAR lukustatud ukse.

label: SkyPillar_Outside_Text_OpenedDoorToSkyPillar
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}, let's be on our way!
et: {PLAYER} {KUN}, asume teele!

label: SkyPillar_Outside_Text_EarthquakeNotMomentToWaste
en: WALLACE: It's an earthquake!
et: WALLACE: See on maavärin!

label: SkyPillar_Outside_Text_EarthquakeNotMomentToWaste
en: There's not a moment to waste! We've got to hurry!
et: Pole hetkegi raisata! Me peame kiirustama!

label: SkyPillar_Outside_Text_SituationGettingWorse
en: WALLACE: Hmm… The situation is getting worse…
et: WALLACE: Hmm... olukord läheb hullemaks...

label: SkyPillar_Outside_Text_GotToGoBackForSootopolis
en: WALLACE: This isn't good…
et: WALLACE: See pole hea...

label: SkyPillar_Outside_Text_GotToGoBackForSootopolis
en: The weather distortion is spreading even here…
et: Ilmamoonutused levivad isegi siin...

label: SkyPillar_Outside_Text_GotToGoBackForSootopolis
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}.
et: {PLAYER} {KUN}.

label: SkyPillar_Outside_Text_GotToGoBackForSootopolis
en: RAYQUAZA should be farther up from here.
et: RAYQUAZA peaks siit kaugemal olema.

label: SkyPillar_Outside_Text_GotToGoBackForSootopolis
en: I'm worried about SOOTOPOLIS. I've got to go back.
et: Olen mures SOOTOPOLIS pärast. Ma pean tagasi minema.

label: SkyPillar_Outside_Text_GotToGoBackForSootopolis
en: Everything is in your hands now. Don't fail us!
et: Kõik on nüüd sinu kätes. Ära vea meid alt!

label: PetalburgCity_House2_Text_NormanBecameGymLeader
en: NORMAN became our town's new GYM LEADER.
et: NORMAN sai meie linna uueks SAALI JUHT.

label: PetalburgCity_House2_Text_NormanBecameGymLeader
en: I think he called his family over from somewhere far away.
et: Ma arvan, et ta kutsus oma pere kuskilt kaugelt üle.

label: PetalburgCity_House2_Text_BattledNormanOnce
en: I battled NORMAN once, but, whew, he was way too strong.
et: Ma võitlesin kunagi NORMAN aga, vadak, ta oli liiga tugev.

label: PetalburgCity_House2_Text_BattledNormanOnce
en: How would I put it?
et: Kuidas ma selle paneks?

label: PetalburgCity_House2_Text_BattledNormanOnce
en: I just got the feeling that he lives for POKéMON.
et: Mul tekkis just tunne, et ta elab POKéMON eest.

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_WelcomeToDeptStore
en: Welcome to LILYCOVE DEPARTMENT STORE.
et: Tere tulemast LILYCOVE DEPARTMENT STORE.

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_IBuyAllSortsOfThings
en: Whenever I come to the DEPARTMENT STORE, I always end up buying all sorts of things because it's so fun.
et: Alati, kui ma tulen DEPARTMENT STORE, siis ma alati lõpuks ostan igasuguseid asju, sest see on nii lõbus.

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_MomBuyingMeFurniture
en: Today, my mom is going to buy me some nice furniture.
et: Täna läheb ema mulle mõnusat mööblit ostma.

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_BuyingSomethingForAzumarill
en: I'm buying something for my AZUMARILL as a reward for winning a CONTEST.
et: Ostan midagi oma AZUMARILL eest tasuks CONTEST võitmise eest.

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_Azumarill
en: AZUMARILL: Maririroo!
et: AZUMARILL: Maririroo!

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_FloorNamesSign
en: 1F: SERVICE COUNTER LOTTERY CORNER
et: 1F: SERVICE COUNTER LOTTERY CORNER

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_FloorNamesSign
en: 2F: TRAINER'S ZONE
et: 2F: TRAINER'S ZONE

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_FloorNamesSign
en: 3F: BATTLE COLLECTION
et: 3F: BATTLE COLLECTION

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_FloorNamesSign
en: 4F: TM CORNER
et: 4F: TM CORNER

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_FloorNamesSign
en: 5F: POKé DOLL FLOOR
et: 5F: POKé DOLL FLOOR

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_FloorNamesSign
en: ROOFTOP: ROOFTOP PLAZA
et: ROOFTOP: ROOFTOP PLAZA

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_WirelessCommIsFun
en: Wireless Communication is a lot of fun, isn't it?
et: Juhtmevaba suhtlus on ju väga lõbus?

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_WirelessCommIsFun
en: I think it lets you do things that weren't possible before.
et: Ma arvan, et see laseb sul teha asju, mis varem polnud võimalikud.

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_WirelessCommIsFun
en: For instance, you can now trade with people you couldn't before.
et: Näiteks saab nüüd kaubelda inimestega, keda varem ei saanud.

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_WirelessCommIsFun
en: I think it's going to be exciting!
et: Ma arvan, et see saab olema põnev!

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_SpreadWordAboutWirelessComm
en: I want to spread the word about how fun Wireless Communication can be.
et: Tahan levitada sõna sellest, kui lõbus võib olla Wireless Communication.

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_EverythingClutteredKeepThis
en: LANETTE: Oh! {PLAYER}{KUN}!
et: LANETTE: Oh! {PLAYER}{KUN}!

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_EverythingClutteredKeepThis
en: I'm sorry everything is so cluttered… When I get engrossed in research, things end up this way…
et: Mul on kahju, et kõik on nii risustatud... kui ma uurimisse haaratud olen, jõuavad asjad nii...

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_EverythingClutteredKeepThis
en: This is embarrassing… Please keep this a secret in exchange for this.
et: See on piinlik, palun hoia seda saladust selle eest.

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_OrganizeYourBoxes
en: May I offer advice about my POKéMON Storage System?
et: Kas ma võin pakkuda nõu oma POKéMON Storage Systemi kohta?

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_OrganizeYourBoxes
en: You should organize your BOXES so you can tell which POKéMON are in them.
et: Sa peaksid oma BOXES korrastama, et saaksid öelda, millised POKéMON neis on.

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_ResearchNotesPage1
en: It's LANETTE's research notes. There's information about BOXES.
et: See on LANETTE teadustöö märkmed. Seal on infot BOXES kohta.

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_ResearchNotesPage1
en: Design BOXES to hold 30 POKéMON each.
et: Disain BOXES hoida 30 POKéMON iga.

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_ResearchNotesPage1
en: Each TRAINER should be able to store 420 POKéMON on the PC system.
et: Iga TRAINER peaks saama salvestada 420 POKéMON süsteemi PC.

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_ResearchNotesPage1
en: Keep reading?
et: Loe edasi?

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_ResearchNotesPage2
en: A marking system should be added to make POKéMON easier to organize.
et: Lisada tuleks markeerimissüsteem, et POKéMON oleks lihtsam korraldada.

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_ResearchNotesPage2
en: The name and wallpaper design of each BOX will be made changeable to please the stored POKéMON.
et: Iga BOX nimi ja tapeedi kujundus tehakse muudetavaks, et talletatud POKéMON-le meeldida.

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_ResearchNotesPage2
en: Keep reading?
et: Loe edasi?

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_ResearchNotesPage3
en: When storing a POKéMON, it should be sent to the BOX inspected last.
et: POKéMON salvestamisel tuleks see saata viimasena kontrollitud BOX-le.

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_ResearchNotesPage3
en: If that BOX is full, the received POKéMON is stored in the next BOX.
et: Kui see BOX on täis, salvestatakse saadud POKéMON järgmises BOX.

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_ResearchNotesPage3
en: In other words, when a BOX is examined, it is automatically selected as the BOX to which POKéMON are sent.
et: Teisisõnu, kui BOX uuritakse, valitakse see automaatselt BOX-ks, millele saadetakse POKéMON.

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_ClosedTheNotebook
en: {PLAYER} closed the notebook.
et: {PLAYER} sulges märkmiku.

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_EmailFromBill
en: There's an e-mail from someone on the PC.
et: Seal on kellegi e-mail peal PC.

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_EmailFromBill
en: “Your Storage System offers more convenience than mine.
et: "Teie salvestussüsteem pakub rohkem mugavust kui minu oma.

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_EmailFromBill
en: “It has a lot of user-friendly features that make it fun and useful, too.
et: "Seal on palju kasutajasõbralikke funktsioone, mis teevad selle ka lõbusaks ja kasulikuks.

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_EmailFromBill
en: “It makes me proud that I played a part in its development.
et: "See teeb mind uhkeks, et mängisin oma osa selle arengus.

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_EmailFromBill
en: “Here's hoping that you'll continue research in Storage Systems.
et: "Siin loodetakse, et jätkate uurimistööd Storage Systemsis.

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_EmailFromBill
en: “From BILL … … … … … … … …”

label: MossdeepCity_House4_Text_BrotherLikesToFindBases
en: My little brother says he likes to go find people's SECRET BASES.
et: Mu väikevend ütleb, et talle meeldib minna otsima inimeste SECRET BASES.

label: MossdeepCity_House4_Text_BrotherLikesToVisitBasesAndBattle
en: My little brother says he likes to visit people's SECRET BASES and have POKéMON battles.
et: Mu väikevend ütleb, et talle meeldib külastada inimeste SECRET BASES ja pidada POKéMON lahinguid.

label: MossdeepCity_House4_Text_YouMadeSecretBaseNearX
en: Was it you who made a SECRET BASE near {STR_VAR_1}?
et: Kas see olid sina, kes tegid SECRET BASE  lähedal {STR_VAR_1}?

label: MossdeepCity_House4_Text_MakeSecretBase
en: You should make a SECRET BASE somewhere. I'll go find it!
et: Peaksid kuskil SECRET BASE tegema. Ma lähen otsin selle üles!

label: MossdeepCity_House4_Text_Skitty
en: SKITTY: Miyaan?
et: SKITTY: Miyaan?

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_AdviceForContests
en: Want a tasty little bit of advice for CONTESTS?
et: Soovid maitsvat natuke nõu CONTESTS?

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_AdviceForContests
en: Using a certain move after another certain kind of move sometimes gets you extra attention.
et: Teatud võtte kasutamine pärast järjekordset teatud liiki võtet pälvib mõnikord lisatähelepanu.

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_AdviceForContests
en: If you know what you're doing, you can score big in appeal.
et: Kui sa tead, mida sa teed, siis sa saad apelleerivalt suure hinde.

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_AdviceForContests
en: Of course, your opponents might try disrupting your POKéMON's showing.
et: Muidugi võivad su vastased proovida sinu POKéMON näitamist häirida.

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_MyPapaIsContestJudge
en: My papa, he's a CONTEST JUDGE.
et: Minu papa, ta on CONTEST JUDGE.

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_MyPapaIsContestJudge
en: I wonder what I should be when I grow up, a JUDGE or a GYM LEADER?
et: Huvitav, mis ma peaks olema, kui ma suureks saan, kas JUDGE või SAALI JUHT?

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_ImLikeMajorlyCheesed
en: Hey, man, I'm like majorly cheesed, you know. Like, you know, I just wanted to know why my POKéMON never won, you know, like, hey?
et: Kuule mees, ma olen nagu suurelt juustud. Nagu sa tead, ma tahtsin lihtsalt teada, miks mu POKéMON kunagi ei võitnud, sa tead, nagu, kuule?

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_ImLikeMajorlyCheesed
en: So, like, I gave the JUDGE my two cents, you know, they're free.
et: Nii et nagu, ma andsin JUDGE oma kaks senti, tead, need on vabad.

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_ImLikeMajorlyCheesed
en: And he wouldn't hear me out, like, hey! So, like, total bummer, man!
et: Ja ta ei kuuleks mind, nagu, kuule! Nii et, nagu, totaalne bummer, mees!

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_ImLikeMajorlyCheesed
en: Hey, like, you! Zip it, you know? Just, you know, take this!
et: Kuule, nagu, sina! Zip it, kas tead? Lihtsalt, tead, võta see!

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_ExplainTorment
en: That's, like, TM41, you know? Hey, it's TORMENT, you hearing me?
et: See tähendab, et TM41, tead? Hei, see on TORMENT, sa kuuled mind?

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_ExplainTorment
en: Like, it won't let the other guy use the same move twice in a row, see?
et: Nagu ei lase see teisel tüübil kaks korda järjest sama võtet kasutada, näed?

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_ExplainTorment
en: Hey, now, you listen here, like, I'm not laying a torment on you!
et: Kuule, nüüd, sa kuulad siin, nagu ma ei pane sulle piina!

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_MCStepUpTakePartInContest
en: MC: Oh, my, my! Now isn't that a dandy of a POKéMON?
et: MC: Oh, my, my! Kas see pole mitte POKéMON dändi?

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_MCStepUpTakePartInContest
en: Please! Do step right up and take part in our splendid CONTESTS!
et: Palun! Astuge kohe üles ja osalege meie suurepärases CONTESTS!

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_MCStepUpTakePartInContest
en: You'll do well! I'm sure of it! My eyes have never failed me!
et: Sul läheb hästi! Olen selles kindel! Mu silmad ei ole mind kunagi alt vedanud!

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_JudgeWouldntDoToMissContest
en: JUDGE: Well, hello there! I see that you're a TRAINER!
et: JUDGE: No tere seal! Ma näen, et sa oled TRAINER!

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_JudgeWouldntDoToMissContest
en: Then, it just wouldn't do for you to miss a POKéMON CONTEST!
et: Siis see lihtsalt ei teeks seda, et sa jätad vahele POKéMON CONTEST!

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_JudgeWouldntDoToMissContest
en: Get a CONTEST PASS in VERDANTURF CITY and enter anytime!
et: Saada CONTEST PASS sisse VERDANTURF CITY ja sisesta igal ajal!

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_ItsAppealTime
en: It's appeal time! What should I lead with?
et: On pöördumise aeg! Millega ma peaksin juhtima?

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_DidntPayAttentionToAppeal
en: They didn't pay much attention to my POKéMON's appeal…
et: Nad ei pööranud eriti tähelepanu minu POKéMON üleskutsele...

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_DidntPayAttentionToAppeal
en: Humph, that JUDGE, he doesn't know a good thing when he sees it.
et: Humph, see JUDGE, ta ei tea head asja, kui seda näeb.

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_RewardWithSageAdvice
en: Oh, hi! You must be a serious fan to get this close to the action.
et: Oi, tere! Sa pead olema tõsine fänn, et jõuda nii lähedale tegevusele.

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_RewardWithSageAdvice
en: I'll reward your enthusiasm with this sage advice.
et: Ma premeerin teie entusiasmi selle salvei nõuga.

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_RewardWithSageAdvice
en: If a move goes over really well, the audience will get excited.
et: Kui käik läheb tõesti hästi üle, erutub publik.

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_RewardWithSageAdvice
en: The POKéMON that makes its appeal right when everyone's excited…
et: See POKéMON mis teeb oma veetluse õigeks, kui kõik on elevil...

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_RewardWithSageAdvice
en: Well, you'd think something good has to happen!
et: Võiks ju arvata, et midagi head peab juhtuma!

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_MoreFreakedOutThanMon
en: I can't do this! I'm more freaked out than my POKéMON.
et: Ma ei saa seda teha! Ma olen rohkem ehmunud kui mu POKéMON.

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_MoreFreakedOutThanMon
en: I'm shivering and my heart is racing!
et: Ma värisen ja mu süda kihutab!

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_BattleAndContestAlike
en: A battle and a CONTEST aren't the same, but they are alike, too.
et: Lahing ja CONTEST ei ole ühesugused, aga ka nemad on sarnased.

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_BattleAndContestAlike
en: You need to work hard and believe in the POKéMON you've raised.
et: Sa pead kõvasti vaeva nägema ja uskuma POKéMON mida sa oled tõstnud.

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_MonLooksOnTopOfGame
en: That POKéMON looks like it's on top of its game, huh?
et: See POKéMON näeb välja nagu oleks oma mängu peal, mis?

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_MonLooksOnTopOfGame
en: A POKéMON that does good in the secondary judging seems to be more relaxed when it's doing appeals.
et: A POKéMON mis teeb head teiseses kohtumõistmises tundub olevat lõdvem, kui ta teeb pöördumisi.

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_MyMonBetterThanThatLot
en: Will you look at that sorry sight?
et: Kas sa vaatad seda haledat vaatepilti?

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_MyMonBetterThanThatLot
en: Heh, my POKéMON's absolutely better than that lot!
et: Heh, minu POKéMON on absoluutselt parem kui see partii!

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_GetUrgeToMoveWithMon
en: Don't you get the urge to move with POKéMON if they're putting on an energetic appeal?
et: Kas sul ei teki tungi liikuda POKéMON-ga, kui nad panevad energilise pöördumise peale?

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_HyperRankStage
en: POKéMON CONTESTS HYPER RANK STAGE!
et: POKéMON CONTESTS HYPER RANK STAGE!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_ReadyForRound1
en: Your 1st-round match is next. Are you ready?
et: Sinu 1. ringi matš on järgmine. Kas oled valmis?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_ReadyForRound2
en: Your 2nd-round match is next. Are you ready?
et: Sinu 2. ringi matš on järgmine. Kas oled valmis?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_ReadyForSemifinals
en: Your semifinal match is next. Are you ready?
et: Sinu poolfinaalmatš on järgmine. Kas oled valmis?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_ReadyForFinals
en: Your final match is next. Are you ready?
et: Sinu viimane matš on järgmine. Kas oled valmis?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_ChooseTwoMons

et: Palun valige kaks POKéMON, mis peavad ilmuma lahingus.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_RightThisWay

et: Niimoodi, palun.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_RestoreMonsToFullHealth

et: Aitäh võistlemise eest!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_RestoreMonsToFullHealth

et: Ma taastan su POKéMON täie tervise juurde.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_CongratsReadyForRound2

et: Palju õnne 1. vooru läbimise eest.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_CongratsReadyForRound2

et: 2. voor on järgmine. Kas oled valmis?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_CongratsReadyForSemifinals

et: Palju õnne poolfinaalidesse edasijõudmise eest.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_CongratsReadyForSemifinals
en: The best four teams meet in this round. Are you ready?
et: Selles voorus kohtuvad neli parimat meeskonda. Kas oled valmis?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_CongratsReadyForFinals
en: Congratulations for advancing to the final match.
et: Palju õnne finaalmängule edasijõudmise eest.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_CongratsReadyForFinals
en: You're one win from the championship. Are you ready?
et: Sa oled üks võit meistrivõistlustelt. Kas oled valmis?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_PlayersNextOpponentIsTrainer
en: {PLAYER}'s next opponent is this TRAINER.
et: {PLAYER} järgmine vastane on see TRAINER.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_TourneyInRound1

et: Turniir on 1. ringis.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_TourneyInRound2

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_TourneyInFinals

et: Soovid mängu salvestada ja pooleli jätta?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_RetireYourChallenge

et: Soovid oma Lahinguturniiri väljakutsest pensionile jääda?

en: I am saving your data. Please wait.
et: Ma salvestan teie andmeid. Palun oodake.

en: Should I record your last match on your FRONTIER PASS?
et: Kas peaksin salvestama teie viimase matši teie FRONTIER PASS?
