label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_IsThatTheItemForYou
en: A {STR_VAR_1}, huff-puff? Is that the one for you, huff-puff?
et: A {STR_VAR_1}, huff-puff? Kas see on sinu jaoks, huff-puff?

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_WhichWouldYouLike
en: Which one would you like, huff-puff?
et: Kumba sa tahaksid, huff-puff?

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_IllMakeItemForYou
en: A {STR_VAR_1} it is, then, huff-puff!
et: A {STR_VAR_1} see on siis huff-puff!

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_IllMakeItemForYou
en: Okay! I'll make it for you, huff-puff. Just wait a little while, huff-puff.
et: Olgu! Ma teen selle sulle, huff-puff. Lihtsalt oota natuke, huff-puff.

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_NotEnoughAshToMakeItem
en: A {STR_VAR_1}, huff-puff?
et: A {STR_VAR_1}, huff-puff?

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_NotEnoughAshToMakeItem
en: There's not enough ash here to make that, though, huff-puff.
et: Siin ei ole piisavalt tuhka, et seda siiski teha, huff-puff.

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_NotEnoughAshToMakeItem
en: Let's see… {STR_VAR_2} is the number of steps you'll need to walk through volcanic ash for me to make that item, huff-puff.
et: Vaatame... {STR_VAR_2} on sammude arv, mida peate läbi vulkaanilise tuha kõndima minu jaoks, et teha see ese, huff-puff.

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_NotEnoughAshToMakeItem
en: Which item would you rather have me make instead, huff-puff?
et: Millist eset sa pigem laseks mul teha selle asemel, huff-puff?

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_AllThatAshButDontWantAnything
en: You've collected all that ash, but you don't want anything, huff-puff?
et: Sa oled kogu selle tuha kokku kogunud, aga sa ei taha midagi, huff-puff?

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_IveFinishedGlassItem
en: Ah, I've finished your {STR_VAR_1}. Take it, huff-puff.
et: Ah, ma lõpetasin su {STR_VAR_1}. Võta, huff-puff.

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_NoRoomInBag
en: Oh? You've no room in your BAG, huff-puff.
et: Oh? Sul pole ruumi oma BAG, huff-puff.

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_NoRoomInBag
en: I'll hold on to it, so come back later, huff-puff.
et: Ma hoian sellest kinni, nii et tule hiljem tagasi, huff-puff.

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_NoRoomInPC
en: Oh? You've no room in your PC, huff-puff?
et: Oh? Sul pole ruumi oma PC, huff-puff?

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_NoRoomInPC
en: I'll hold on to it, so come back later, huff-puff.
et: Ma hoian sellest kinni, nii et tule hiljem tagasi, huff-puff.

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_HaventGotYourSootSack
en: Hah? You haven't got your SOOT SACK with you, huff-puff.
et: Hah? Sa pole oma SOOT SACK kaasa saanud, huff-puff.

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_HaventGotYourSootSack
en: You have to keep it with you to collect volcanic ash, huff-puff.
et: Seda tuleb kaasas hoida, et koguda vulkaanilist tuhka, huff-puffi.

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_FunToBlowGlassFlute
en: It's fun to blow a glass flute while my boss is talking.
et: Lõbus on puhuda klaasflööti sel ajal, kui mu ülemus räägib.

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_FunToBlowGlassFlute
en: Huff-huff! Puff-puff!
et: Huff-huff! Puff-puff!

label: PacifidlogTown_Text_FastRunningCurrent
en: The sea between PACIFIDLOG and SLATEPORT has a fast-running tide.
et: Merel PACIFIDLOG ja SLATEPORT vahel on kiire tõus.

label: PacifidlogTown_Text_FastRunningCurrent
en: If you decide to SURF, you could end up swept away somewhere else.
et: Kui otsustad SURF, võid lõpuks kuskilt mujalt minema pühkida.

label: PacifidlogTown_Text_NeatHousesOnWater
en: See, isn't it neat? These houses are on water!
et: Näed, kas pole korras? Need majad on vee peal!

label: PacifidlogTown_Text_NeatHousesOnWater
en: I was born here!
et: Ma sündisin siin!

label: PacifidlogTown_Text_SkyPillarTooScary
en: The SKY PILLAR?
et: SKY PILLAR?

label: PacifidlogTown_Text_SkyPillarTooScary
en: …Oh, you must mean that tall, tall tower a little further out.
et: ...Oh, sa pead silmas seda pikka ja pikka torni veidi kaugemal.

label: PacifidlogTown_Text_SkyPillarTooScary
en: If you asked me, I wouldn't climb it. It's too scary to get up that high.
et: Kui sa küsiksid, siis ma ei roniks sinna. Liiga hirmus, et nii kõrgele tõusta.

label: PacifidlogTown_Text_SkyPillarTooScary
en: Life at sea level in PACIFIDLOG, that suits me fine.
et: Elu merepinnal PACIFIDLOG, mis sobib mulle hästi.

label: PacifidlogTown_Text_TownSign
en: PACIFIDLOG TOWN
et: PACIFIDLOG TOWN

label: PacifidlogTown_Text_TownSign
en: “Where the morning sun smiles upon the waters.”
et: "Kus hommikupäike naeratab vetele."

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_SamuelIntro
en: The thought that I'm getting closer to the POKéMON LEAGUE…
et: Mõte, et ma jõuan lähemale POKéMON LIIGA...

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_SamuelIntro
en: I'm getting stage fright…
et: Mul tekib lavahirm...

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_SamuelDefeat
en: I couldn't do a thing…
et: Ma ei suutnud midagi teha...

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_SamuelPostBattle
en: The POKéMON LEAGUE became distant again… What a letdown…
et: POKéMON LIIGA jäi jälle kaugeks... Missugune allakäik...

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_ShannonIntro
en: To win your way through the POKéMON LEAGUE, you need the trust of your POKéMON.
et: Selleks, et võita oma tee läbi POKéMON LIIGA, on vaja oma POKéMON usaldust.

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_ShannonDefeat
en: Your relationship is based on solid trust.
et: Su suhe põhineb kindlal usaldusel.

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_ShannonPostBattle
en: By being together all the time, trust grows between POKéMON and TRAINERS.
et: Olles kogu aeg koos, kasvab usaldus POKéMON ja TRAINERS vahel.

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_MichelleIntro
en: This isn't the goal. It's only a place on the way to the POKéMON LEAGUE.
et: See pole eesmärk. See on ainult koht teel POKéMON LIIGA.

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_MichelleDefeat
en: That's the way!
et: Nii see on!

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_MichellePostBattle
en: You'll do fine, for sure! Your POKéMON are all eager to go!
et: Sul läheb hästi, kindlasti! Sinu POKéMON on kõik innukad minema!

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_MitchellIntro
en: My POKéMON are cosmically awe inspiring!
et: Minu POKéMON on kosmiliselt aukartustäratavad!

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_MitchellDefeat
en: I've never met anyone like you before.
et: Ma pole varem kohanud kedagi sinusugust.

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_MitchellPostBattle
en: Even outside of battle, I sense incredible power emanating from you and your POKéMON.
et: Isegi väljaspool lahingut tajun ma uskumatut väge, mis kiirgab sinust ja sinu POKéMON-st.

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_HalleIntro
en: Okay, no need to get your back up! Relax, let's take it easy!
et: Olgu, pole vaja seljatagust üles saada! Lõõgastu, võtame rahulikult!

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_HalleDefeat
en: Whoa! Wonderful!
et: Vot! Imeline!

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_HallePostBattle
en: Sure, this is VICTORY ROAD.
et: Muidugi, see on VICTORY ROAD.

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_HallePostBattle
en: But it's not all that different from the path you've taken so far.
et: Aga see kõik ei erine nii palju sellest teest, mis sa seni oled võtnud.

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_HallePostBattle
en: Try to enjoy things the rest of the way!
et: Püüa nautida asju ka ülejäänud viisil!

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_FerryServiceUnavailable
en: I beg your pardon? You're looking for a ship?
et: Ma anun su armu? Otsid laeva?

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_FerryServiceUnavailable
en: I'm sorry, the ferry service isn't available at present…
et: Vabandust, praamiliiklus ei ole hetkel kättesaadav...

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_MayISeeYourTicket
en: Hello, are you here for the ferry? May I see your TICKET?
et: Tere, kas olete siin praami pärast? Kas ma võin näha sinu TICKET?

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_YouMustHaveTicket
en: {PLAYER} doesn't have the TICKET…
et: {PLAYER} ei ole TICKET...

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_YouMustHaveTicket
en: I'm terribly sorry.
et: Mul on kohutavalt kahju.

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_YouMustHaveTicket
en: You must have a TICKET to board the ferry.
et: Sul peab olema TICKET praamile minekuks.

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_FlashedTicketWhereTo
en: {PLAYER} flashed the TICKET.
et: {PLAYER} vilgutas TICKET.

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_FlashedTicketWhereTo
en: Perfect! That's all you need!
et: Täiuslik! Muud polegi vaja!

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_FlashedTicketWhereTo
en: And where would you like to go?
et: Ja kuhu tahaksid minna?

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_SailAnotherTime
en: Please sail with us another time!
et: Palun purjetage meiega veel üks kord!

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_LilycoveItIs
en: LILYCOVE CITY it is, then!
et: LILYCOVE CITY see on siis!

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_BattleFrontierItIs
en: BATTLE FRONTIER it is, then!
et: BATTLE FRONTIER see on siis!

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_PleaseBoardFerry
en: Please board the ferry and wait for departure.
et: Palun astuge praamile ja oodake ärasõitu.

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_WhereWouldYouLikeToGo
en: Then, where would you like to go?
et: Kuhu sa siis minna tahaksid?

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_LoveToGoDeepUnderwaterSomeday
en: A journey to the bottom of the sea… I wonder what it'd be like?
et: Teekond merepõhja... huvitav, mis tunne see oleks?

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_LoveToGoDeepUnderwaterSomeday
en: I'd love to go deep underwater like that someday.
et: Läheksin hea meelega kunagi niimoodi sügavale vee alla.

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_AbnormalWeather
en: For a ship to sail safely, we need to know about the weather!
et: Et laev saaks ohutult sõita, peame ilmast teadma!

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_AbnormalWeather
en: Speaking of weather, I heard something from a guy at the WEATHER INSTITUTE.
et: Ilmast rääkides kuulsin WEATHER INSTITUTE kutilt midagi.

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_AbnormalWeather
en: He was saying abnormal weather has been reported all over the place!
et: Ta rääkis, et ebanormaalsetest ilmadest on igal pool teatatud!

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_AbnormalWeather
en: You should visit the WEATHER INSTITUTE and ask around!
et: Peaksid külastama WEATHER INSTITUTE ja küsima ringi!

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_SubTooSmallForMe
en: I wanted to go with CAPT. STERN on the ocean floor exploration.
et: Tahtsin minna CAPT-ga. STERN ookeanipõhja uuringutel.

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_SubTooSmallForMe
en: But the sub's too small for me.
et: Aga sub on minu jaoks liiga väike.

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_SubTooSmallForMe
en: If I squeezed in, there wouldn't be any room for the CAPTAIN…
et: Kui ma sisse pressiksin, siis poleks ruumi CAPTAIN...

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_SameThugsTriedToRobAtMuseum
en: CAPT. STERN: Those thugs…
et: CAPT. STERN: Need pätid...

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_SameThugsTriedToRobAtMuseum
en: They're the same lot who tried to rob the DEVON GOODS at the MUSEUM.
et: Nad on sama palju, kes üritasid DEVON GOODS  ́l röövida.

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_ArchieYouAgainHideoutInLilycove
en: ARCHIE: Oh? Not you again…
et: ARCHIE: Oh? Mitte sina jälle...

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_ArchieYouAgainHideoutInLilycove
en: You are tenacious to track us here, that much I will give you.
et: Sa oled visa meid siin jälitama, seda palju ma sulle annan.

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_ArchieYouAgainHideoutInLilycove
en: But now… No one can stop us! No one!
et: Aga nüüd... keegi ei saa meid takistada! Mitte keegi!

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_ArchieYouAgainHideoutInLilycove
en: Or, will you follow us back to our HIDEOUT in LILYCOVE CITY?
et: Või kas sa järgid meid tagasi meie HIDEOUT in LILYCOVE CITY?

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_ArchieYouAgainHideoutInLilycove
en: Fwahahahaha…
et: Fwahahahaha...

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_CaptSternWhyStealMySubmarine
en: CAPT. STERN: Why…
et: CAPT. STERN: Miks...

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_CaptSternWhyStealMySubmarine
en: Why would TEAM AQUA steal my SUBMARINE EXPLORER 1?
et: Miks peaks TEAM AQUA varastama minu SUBMARINE EXPLORER 1?

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_CaptSternWhyStealMySubmarine
en: They can't be after the slumbering POKéMON at the bottom of the sea…
et: Nad ei saa olla pärast uinutavat POKéMON merepõhjas...

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_CaptSternWhyStealMySubmarine
en: But even if I were to chase them, I don't stand a chance against them…
et: Aga isegi kui ma neid taga ajaksin, ei seisa ma nende vastu võimalust...

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_TeamAquaLeftNeedDive
en: CAPT. STERN: Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}…
et: CAPT. STERN: Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}...

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_TeamAquaLeftNeedDive
en: Okay… So TEAM AQUA left before you could stop them…
et: Nii et TEAM AQUA lahkus enne, kui sa suutsid need peatada...

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_TeamAquaLeftNeedDive
en: Oh, no, don't blame yourself. You're not responsible for this.
et: Oh ei, ära süüdista ennast. Sa ei vastuta selle eest.

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_TeamAquaLeftNeedDive
en: Trying to catch a submarine… It's impossible for most people.
et: Püüdes tabada allveelaeva, on see enamikel inimestel võimatu.

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_TeamAquaLeftNeedDive
en: You would need a POKéMON that knows how to DIVE…
et: Oleks vaja POKéMON mis teab kuidas DIVE...

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_TeamAquaLeftNeedDive
en: Perhaps if you went out to MOSSDEEP CITY…
et: Ehk kui sa läksid välja MOSSDEEP CITY...

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_TeamAquaLeftNeedDive
en: A lot of divers live out there, so someone might teach you…
et: Seal elab palju sukeldujaid, nii et keegi võib sind õpetada...

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_NeedDiveToCatchSub
en: CAPT. STERN: Trying to catch a submarine… It's impossible.
et: CAPT. STERN: Proovin püüda allveelaeva... see on võimatu.

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_NeedDiveToCatchSub
en: You would need a POKéMON that knows how to DIVE…
et: Oleks vaja POKéMON mis teab kuidas DIVE...

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_NeedDiveToCatchSub
en: Perhaps if you went out to MOSSDEEP CITY…
et: Ehk kui sa läksid välja MOSSDEEP CITY...

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_NeedDiveToCatchSub
en: A lot of divers live out there, so someone might teach you…
et: Seal elab palju sukeldujaid, nii et keegi võib sind õpetada...

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_WontBeLongBeforeWeFinishFerry
en: CAPT. STERN: Oh, yes. MR. BRINEY came to our SHIPYARD.
et: CAPT. STERN: Oh jah. MR. BRINEY tuli meie SHIPYARD juurde.

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_WontBeLongBeforeWeFinishFerry
en: It won't be long now before we finish making the ferry!
et: Nüüd ei lähe kaua aega, kui lõpetame praami tegemise!

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_FinishedMakingFerry
en: CAPT. STERN: {PLAYER}{KUN}!
et: CAPT. STERN: {PLAYER}{KUN}!

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_FinishedMakingFerry
en: We finally finished making the ferry S.S. TIDAL!
et: Lõpetasime lõpuks praami S.S. tegemise TIDAL!

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_FinishedMakingFerry
en: We couldn't have done it without your friend MR. BRINEY.
et: Me poleks saanud seda teha ilma sinu sõbrata MR. BRINEY.

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_FinishedMakingFerry
en: Please go for a short cruise on it!
et: Palun minge sellele lühikesele kruiisile!

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_WouldYouTradeScanner
en: CAPT. STERN: Oh? {PLAYER}{KUN}, that item you have…
et: CAPT. STERN: Oh? {PLAYER} {KUN}, see ese, mis teil on...

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_WouldYouTradeScanner
en: That's a SCANNER! That would sure help us on our explorations.
et: See on SCANNER! See aitaks meid kindlasti meie uurimustes.

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_WouldYouTradeScanner
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}, would you trade your SCANNER for something?
et: {PLAYER} {KUN}, kas te vahetaksite oma SCANNER millegi vastu?

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_WouldYouTradeScanner
en: Like, say, a DEEPSEATOOTH or a DEEPSEASCALE that I have?
et: Nagu näiteks DEEPSEATOOTH või DEEPSEASCALE mis mul on?

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_IfYouWantToTradeLetMeKnow
en: CAPT. STERN: Are you certain? It's useless to you, {PLAYER}{KUN}…
et: CAPT. STERN: Oled sa kindel? See on sulle kasutu, {PLAYER}{KUN}...

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_IfYouWantToTradeLetMeKnow
en: Well, okay, then. If you want to trade your SCANNER, let me know.
et: Noh, okei siis. Kui soovid kaubelda oma SCANNER, siis anna teada.

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_TradeForDeepSeaTooth
en: CAPT. STERN: So you'll trade it for my DEEPSEATOOTH?
et: CAPT. STERN: Seega vahetad selle minu DEEPSEATOOTH vastu?

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_TradeForDeepSeaScale
en: CAPT. STERN: So you'll trade it for my DEEPSEASCALE?
et: CAPT. STERN: Seega vahetad selle minu DEEPSEASCALE vastu?

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_WhichOneDoYouWant
en: CAPT. STERN: Which one do you want?
et: CAPT. STERN: Kumba soovite?

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_HandedScannerToStern
en: {PLAYER} handed the SCANNER to CAPT. STERN.
et: {PLAYER} ulatas SCANNER to CAPT. STERN.

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_ThisWillHelpResearch
en: CAPT. STERN: Thanks, {PLAYER}{KUN}! This will help our research a lot!
et: CAPT. STERN: Tänud, {PLAYER}{KUN}! See aitab meie uurimistööd palju!

label: DewfordTown_Text_TinyIslandCommunity
en: DEWFORD is a tiny island community. If something gets trendy here, everyone picks up on it right away.
et: DEWFORD on pisike saare kogukond. Kui siin midagi trendikaks läheb, siis korjavad kõik selle peale kohe üles.

label: DewfordTown_Text_TownSign
en: DEWFORD TOWN “A tiny island in the blue sea.”
et: DEWFORD TOWN "Pisike saar sinises meres".

label: DewfordTown_Text_GymSign
en: DEWFORD TOWN POKéMON GYM LEADER: BRAWLY “A big wave in fighting!”
et: DEWFORD TOWN POKéMON SAALI JUHT: BRAWLY "Suur laine võitluses!"

label: DewfordTown_Text_HallSign
en: DEWFORD HALL “Everyone's information exchange!”
et: DEWFORD HALL "Igaühe infovahetus!"

label: Route104_Text_LandedInDewfordDeliverLetter
en: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy! We've hit land in DEWFORD.
et: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy! Maad oleme tabanud DEWFORD.

label: Route104_Text_LandedInDewfordDeliverLetter
en: I suppose you're off to deliver that LETTER to, who was it now, STEVEN!
et: Ma oletan, et sa oled ära, et toimetada see LETTER, kes see nüüd oli, STEVEN!

label: DewfordTown_Text_SetSailBackToPetalburg
en: MR. BRINEY: Have you delivered your LETTER?
et: MR. BRINEY: Kas olete oma LETTER tarninud?

label: DewfordTown_Text_SetSailBackToPetalburg
en: Or were you meaning to sail back to PETALBURG?
et: Või kas sa mõtlesid purjetada tagasi PETALBURG?

label: DewfordTown_Text_PetalburgWereSettingSail2
en: MR. BRINEY: PETALBURG it is, then!
et: MR. BRINEY: PETALBURG see on, siis!

label: DewfordTown_Text_PetalburgWereSettingSail2
en: Anchors aweigh! PEEKO, we're setting sail, my darling!
et: Ankrud aukartust äratavad! PEEKO, me seame purje, mu kallis!

label: DewfordTown_Text_GoDeliverIllBeWaiting
en: MR. BRINEY: Then you go on and deliver the LETTER. I'll be waiting.
et: MR. BRINEY: Siis lähed edasi ja toimetad LETTER. Jään ootama.

label: DewfordTown_Text_BrineyLandedInDewford
en: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy! We've hit land in DEWFORD!
et: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy! Oleme tabanud maad DEWFORD!

label: DewfordTown_Text_BrineyLandedInDewford
en: You just go on and tell me whenever you want to set sail again!
et: Sa lihtsalt lähed edasi ja ütled mulle, millal tahad uuesti purjetada!

label: DewfordTown_Text_WhereAreWeBound
en: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy! For you, I'll go out to sea anytime!
et: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy! Sinu jaoks lähen igal ajal merele!

label: DewfordTown_Text_WhereAreWeBound
en: Now, my friend, where are we bound?
et: Nüüd, mu sõber, kuhu me oleme seotud?

label: DewfordTown_Text_PetalburgWereSettingSail
en: MR. BRINEY: PETALBURG, is it?
et: MR. BRINEY: PETALBURG, kas on?

label: DewfordTown_Text_PetalburgWereSettingSail
en: Anchors aweigh! PEEKO, we're setting sail, my darling!
et: Ankrud aukartust äratavad! PEEKO, me seame purje, mu kallis!

label: DewfordTown_Text_SlateportWereSettingSail
en: MR. BRINEY: SLATEPORT, is it?
et: MR. BRINEY: SLATEPORT, kas on?

label: DewfordTown_Text_SlateportWereSettingSail
en: Anchors aweigh! PEEKO, we're setting sail, my darling!
et: Ankrud aukartust äratavad! PEEKO, me seame purje, mu kallis!

label: DewfordTown_Text_JustTellMeWhenYouNeedToSetSail
en: MR. BRINEY: You just tell me whenever you need to set sail again!
et: MR. BRINEY: Sa lihtsalt ütled mulle, millal sul on vaja uuesti purjetada!

label: DewfordTown_Text_GettingItchToFish
en: This is a renowned fishing spot. Are you getting the itch to fish?
et: See on tuntud kalapüügikoht. Kas saad sügeluse kalale?

label: DewfordTown_Text_GiveYouOneOfMyRods
en: I hear you, and I like what you're saying!
et: Ma kuulen sind ja mulle meeldib see, mida sa räägid!

label: DewfordTown_Text_GiveYouOneOfMyRods
en: I'll give you one of my fishing RODS.
et: Annan sulle ühe oma kalapüügist RODS.

label: DewfordTown_Text_ThrowInFishingAdvice
en: And, as an added bonus, I'll even throw in a little fishing advice!
et: Ja lisaboonusena viskan isegi väikese püüginõu sisse!

label: DewfordTown_Text_ThrowInFishingAdvice
en: First, you want to face the water, then use the ROD.
et: Esmalt tahad veega silmitsi seista, seejärel kasuta ROD.

label: DewfordTown_Text_ThrowInFishingAdvice
en: Focus your mind… If you get a bite, pull on the ROD.
et: Keskendu oma mõistusele... kui saad hammustuse, tõmba peale ROD.

label: DewfordTown_Text_ThrowInFishingAdvice
en: Sometimes you can snag something immediately, but with bigger catches, you need to time the pulls on your ROD to haul them in.
et: Vahel saab kohe midagi näppida, aga suuremate saagidega on vaja oma ROD tõmmetele aega anda, et need sisse vedada.

label: DewfordTown_Text_ThatsTooBadThen
en: Oh, is that so? That's too bad, then.
et: Kas see on nii? See on siis liiga halb.

label: DewfordTown_Text_HowsYourFishing
en: Yo! How's your fishing?
et: Yo! Kuidas sul kalapüük läheb?

label: DewfordTown_Text_GreatHaulInSomeBigOnes
en: Is that right! That's great! Haul in some big ones!
et: Kas see on õige! Väga vahva! Haul mõnes suures!

label: DewfordTown_Text_FishingAdvice
en: Oh, hey, don't get down on yourself! I'll give you a little fishing advice.
et: Oh, kuule, ära lasku enda peale! Annan teile väikese kalastusnõu.

label: DewfordTown_Text_FishingAdvice
en: First, you want to face the water, then use the ROD.
et: Esmalt tahad veega silmitsi seista, seejärel kasuta ROD.

label: DewfordTown_Text_FishingAdvice
en: Focus your mind… If you get a bite, pull the ROD.
et: Keskendu oma mõistusele... kui saad hammustuse, tõmba ROD.

label: DewfordTown_Text_FishingAdvice
en: Sometimes you can snag something immediately, but with bigger catches, you need to time the pulls on your ROD to haul them in.
et: Vahel saab kohe midagi näppida, aga suuremate saagidega on vaja oma ROD tõmmetele aega anda, et need sisse vedada.

label: DewfordTown_Text_XIsTheBiggestHappeningThingRight
en: I like what's hip, happening, and trendy. I'm always checking it out.
et: Mulle meeldib see, mis on puus, juhtub ja trendikas. Ma kontrollin seda alati.

label: DewfordTown_Text_XIsTheBiggestHappeningThingRight
en: Listen, have you heard about this new “{STR_VAR_1}”?
et: Kuule, kas sa oled kuulnud sellest uuest "{STR_VAR_1}"?

label: DewfordTown_Text_XIsTheBiggestHappeningThingRight
en: That's right! Of course you know!
et: See on õige! Muidugi tead!

label: DewfordTown_Text_XIsTheBiggestHappeningThingRight
en: I mean, sheesh, “{STR_VAR_1}”… It's the hottest thing in cool!
et: Tähendab, sheesh, "{STR_VAR_1}"... see on kõige kuumem asi jahedas!

label: DewfordTown_Text_XIsTheBiggestHappeningThingRight
en: Wherever you're from, “{STR_VAR_1}” is the biggest happening thing, right?
et: Kust iganes sa pärit oled, on "{STR_VAR_1}" kõige suurem juhtumine, eks?

label: DewfordTown_Text_TellMeWhatsNewAndIn
en: Hunh? It's not the hip and happening thing?
et: Hunh? Asi pole puusas ja juhtumises?

label: DewfordTown_Text_TellMeWhatsNewAndIn
en: Well, hey, you have to tell me, what's new and what's “in”?
et: No kuule, sa pead mulle ütlema, mis on uus ja mis on "sisse"?

label: DewfordTown_Text_OfCourseIKnowAboutThat
en: Hunh? “{STR_VAR_2}”?
et: Hunh? "{STR_VAR_2}"?

label: DewfordTown_Text_OfCourseIKnowAboutThat
en: …Uh… Yeah! That's right! Yeah, I knew that! Knew it all along!
et: ...Uh... jah! See on õige! Jah, ma teadsin seda! Teadke seda kogu aeg!

label: DewfordTown_Text_OfCourseIKnowAboutThat
en: Of course I know about that! “{STR_VAR_2},” right?
et: Muidugi ma tean sellest! "{STR_VAR_2}", eks?

label: DewfordTown_Text_OfCourseIKnowAboutThat
en: Yeah, that's it, it's there! Isn't “{STR_VAR_2}” the coolest, or what?
et: Jah, see on kõik, see on olemas! Kas "{STR_VAR_2}" pole mitte kõige lahedam või mis?

label: DewfordTown_Text_OfCourseIKnowAboutThat
en: It's the hippest thing in hip. You think I'd not know about it?
et: See on kõige hipim asi puusas. Arvad, et ma ei teaks sellest?

label: DewfordTown_Text_OfCourseIKnowAboutThat
en: “{STR_VAR_1}”… It's, like, so five minutes ago.
et: "{STR_VAR_1}"... See on nagu viis minutit tagasi.

label: DewfordTown_Text_OfCourseIKnowAboutThat
en: Now, “{STR_VAR_2}” is what's vital and in tune with the times!
et: Nüüd on "{STR_VAR_2}" see, mis on eluliselt tähtis ja ajaga kooskõlas!

label: DewfordTown_Text_XHuhIThinkYIsCool
en: Hmm… “{STR_VAR_2},” huh?
et: Hmm... "{STR_VAR_2}", mis?

label: DewfordTown_Text_XHuhIThinkYIsCool
en: But personally, I think “{STR_VAR_1}” is what's real in cool.
et: Aga isiklikult arvan, et "{STR_VAR_1}" on see, mis lahedas reaalselt on.

label: DewfordTown_Text_HearOfAnyTrendsComeShareWithMe
en: Well, if you hear of any happening new trends, come share them with me, okay?
et: No kui kuuled mõnest juhtuvast uuest trendist, siis tule jaga neid minuga, eks?

label: DewfordTown_Text_YeahDefinitionOfInRightNow
en: Yeah, absolutely right!
et: Jah, täiesti õige!

label: DewfordTown_Text_YeahDefinitionOfInRightNow
en: “{STR_VAR_1}” is the definition of “in” right now.
et: "{STR_VAR_1}" on mõiste "in" praegu.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_WithThisMeteorite
en: Hehehe!
et: Hehehe!

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_WithThisMeteorite
en: With this METEORITE, that thing in MT. CHIMNEY will…
et: Sellega METEORITE, see asi MT. CHIMNEY hakkab...

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_DontExpectMercyFromMagma
en: Heh?
et: Heh?

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_DontExpectMercyFromMagma
en: I don't know who you are, but if you get in the way of TEAM MAGMA, don't expect any mercy!
et: Ma ei tea, kes sa oled, aga kui sulle jääb ette TEAM MAGMA, siis ära oota mingit halastust!

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_HoldItRightThereMagma
en: Hold it right there, TEAM MAGMA!
et: Hoia seda sealsamas, TEAM MAGMA!

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_HoldItRightThereMagma
en: You're badly mistaken if you think you can have your way with the world!
et: Eksid rängalt, kui arvad, et saad maailmaga oma tee!

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_BeSeeingYouTeamAqua
en: Hehehe! Even TEAM AQUA joins us!
et: Hehehe! Isegi TEAM AQUA liitub meiega!

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_BeSeeingYouTeamAqua
en: But it's too much trouble to deal with you all…
et: Aga see on liiga suur vaev, et teiega kõigiga tegeleda...

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_BeSeeingYouTeamAqua
en: Heh, it doesn't matter!
et: Heh, vahet pole!

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_BeSeeingYouTeamAqua
en: We've got the METEORITE, so off to MT. CHIMNEY we go!
et: Meil on METEORITE, nii et MT. CHIMNEY me läheme!

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_BeSeeingYouTeamAqua
en: Hehehe! Be seeing you, you TEAM AQUA dingbats!
et: Hehehe! Ole sinuga kohtumas, sa TEAM AQUA dingbats!

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_ArchieSeenYouBefore
en: ARCHIE: Didn't I see you before? At SLATEPORT's MUSEUM?
et: ARCHIE: Kas ma sind enne ei näinud? SLATEPORT on MUSEUM?

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_ArchieSeenYouBefore
en: Ah, so your name is {PLAYER}.
et: Ah, nii et sinu nimi on {PLAYER}.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_ArchieSeenYouBefore
en: At the time, I thought you were one of TEAM MAGMA's goons.
et: Tol ajal arvasin, et oled üks TEAM MAGMA toladest.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_ArchieSeenYouBefore
en: Humph… You're one odd kid.
et: Sa oled üks veider laps.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_ArchieSeenYouBefore
en: TEAM MAGMA is a dangerous group of total fanatics.
et: TEAM MAGMA on ohtlik grupp totaalseid fanaatikuid.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_ArchieSeenYouBefore
en: They engage in destruction, claiming to expand the land mass.
et: Nad tegelevad hävitustööga, väites, et laiendavad maamassi.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_ArchieSeenYouBefore
en: They are the rivals to us, the sea-loving TEAM AQUA!
et: Nad on meile rivaalid, merelembesed TEAM AQUA!

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_BossWeShouldChaseMagma
en: BOSS, we should give chase to TEAM MAGMA…
et: BOSS, me peaksime andma tagaajamise TEAM MAGMA...

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_ArchieYesNoTellingWhatMagmaWillDo
en: ARCHIE: Yes, yes, we must! We've got to hurry.
et: ARCHIE: Jah, jah, me peame! Me peame kiirustama.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_ArchieYesNoTellingWhatMagmaWillDo
en: There's no telling what TEAM MAGMA will do at MT. CHIMNEY!
et: Pole öelda, mida TEAM MAGMA teeb MT juures. CHIMNEY!

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_ArchieFarewell
en: ARCHIE: {PLAYER}, you should keep an eye out for TEAM MAGMA, too.
et: ARCHIE: {PLAYER}, peaks silma peal hoidma TEAM MAGMA ka.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_ArchieFarewell
en: Farewell!
et: Hüvasti!

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_MeetProfCozmo
en: I… I'm COZMO… I'm a PROFESSOR…
et: Ma olen COZMO... ma olen PROFESSOR...

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_MeetProfCozmo
en: TEAM MAGMA asked me to guide them to METEOR FALLS…
et: TEAM MAGMA palus mul neid suunata METEOR FALLS...

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_MeetProfCozmo
en: But they tricked me. They even took my METEORITE away…
et: Aga nad trikitasid mind. Nad võtsid isegi minu METEORITE ära...

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_MeetProfCozmo
en: And then another similar bunch, TEAM AQUA showed up.
et: Ja siis ilmus veel üks sarnane punt, TEAM AQUA.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_MeetProfCozmo
en: After that… I don't understand any of it.
et: Pärast seda... ma ei saa ühestki asjast aru.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_MeetProfCozmo
en: But that TEAM MAGMA…
et: Aga see TEAM MAGMA...

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_MeetProfCozmo
en: What are they going to do with that METEORITE at MT. CHIMNEY?
et: Mida nad selle METEORITE juures MT tegema hakkavad. CHIMNEY?

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_WhatsTeamMagmaDoingAtMtChimney

en: Like child, like father.
et: Nagu laps, nagu isa.

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_LikeChildLikeFather
en: My husband is as wild about POKéMON as our child.
et: Minu mees on sama metsik umbes POKéMON kui meie laps.

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_LikeChildLikeFather
en: If he's not at his LAB, he's likely scrabbling about in grassy places.
et: Kui ta ei ole oma LAB juures, siis ta tõenäoliselt kraabib umbes rohtunud kohtades.

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_TooBusyToNoticeVisit
en: That {RIVAL}!
et: Et {RIVAL}!

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_TooBusyToNoticeVisit
en: I guess our child is too busy with POKéMON to notice that you came to visit, {PLAYER}{KUN}.
et: Ma arvan, et meie laps on liiga hõivatud POKéMON märkamaks, et sa tulid külla, {PLAYER}{KUN}.

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_WentOutToRoute103
en: Oh, {RIVAL} went out to ROUTE 103 just a little while ago.
et: Oh, {RIVAL} läks välja ROUTE 103 just natuke aega tagasi.

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_WentOutToRoute103
en: Like father, like child. {RIVAL} can't stay quietly at home.
et: Nagu isa, nagu laps. {RIVAL} ei suuda vaikselt kodus püsida.

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_ShouldGoHomeEverySoOften
en: I think it's wonderful for people to travel with POKéMON.
et: Minu meelest on tore, kui inimesed reisivad POKéMON-ga.

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_ShouldGoHomeEverySoOften
en: But you should go home every so often to let your mother know you're okay.
et: Aga sa peaksid iga kord nii tihti koju minema, et emale teada anda, et sinuga on kõik korras.

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_ShouldGoHomeEverySoOften
en: She might not say it, but I'm sure she worries about you, {PLAYER}{KUN}.
et: Ta ei pruugi seda öelda, kuid ma olen kindel, et ta muretseb sinu pärast, {PLAYER} {KUN}.

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_MayWhoAreYou
en: Huh? Who… Who are you?
et: Huh? Kes sa oled?

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_MayWhoAreYou
en: Oh, you're {PLAYER}{KUN}. So your move was today.
et: Oh, sa oled {PLAYER}{KUN}. Nii et teie käik oli täna.

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_MayWhoAreYou
en: Um… I'm MAY. Glad to meet you!
et: Ma olen MAY. Rõõm kohtuda!

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_MayWhoAreYou
en: I… I have this dream of becoming friends with POKéMON all over the world.
et: Mul on unistus saada sõbraks POKéMON kogu maailmas.

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_MayWhoAreYou
en: I… I heard about you, {PLAYER}{KUN}, from my dad, PROF. BIRCH.
et: Ma... kuulsin sinust, {PLAYER}{KUN}, oma isalt, PROF. BIRCH.

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_MayWhoAreYou
en: I was hoping that you would be nice, {PLAYER}{KUN}, and that we could be friends.
et: Ma lootsin, et sa oled kena, {PLAYER}{KUN} ja et me võiksime olla sõbrad.

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_MayWhoAreYou
en: Oh, this is silly, isn't it? I… I've just met you, {PLAYER}{KUN}.
et: See on rumal, kas pole? Ma olen sinuga just kohtunud, {PLAYER}{KUN}.

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_MayWhoAreYou
en: Eheheh…
et: Eheheh...

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_MayWhoAreYou
en: Oh, no! I forgot!
et: Oh ei! Unustasin!

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_MayWhoAreYou
en: I was supposed to go help Dad catch some wild POKéMON!
et: Ma pidin minema, et aidata isal püüda mingit metsikut POKéMON!

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_MayWhoAreYou
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}, I'll catch you later!
et: {PLAYER} {KUN}, ma taban sind hiljem!

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_BrendanWhoAreYou
en: Hey! You…
et: Hei! Sa...

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_BrendanWhoAreYou
en: Who are you?
et: Kes Sa oled?

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_BrendanWhoAreYou
en: Oh, you're {PLAYER}, aren't you? Moved in next door, right?
et: Oh, sa oled ju {PLAYER}? Kolinud kõrvalmajas, eks?

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_BrendanWhoAreYou
en: I didn't know that you're a girl.
et: Ma ei teadnud, et sa oled tüdruk.

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_BrendanWhoAreYou
en: Dad, PROF. BIRCH, said that our new next-door neighbor is a GYM LEADER's kid, so I assumed you'd be a guy.
et: Isa, PROF. BIRCH, ütles, et meie uus lähinaaber on SAALI JUHT laps, seega eeldasin, et sinust saab mees.

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_BrendanWhoAreYou
en: My name's BRENDAN. So, hi, neighbor!
et: Minu nimi on BRENDAN. Nii et tere, naabrimees!

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_BrendanWhoAreYou
en: Huh? Hey, {PLAYER}, don't you have a POKéMON?
et: Huh? Hei, {PLAYER}, kas sul ei ole POKéMON?

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_BrendanWhoAreYou
en: Do you want me to go catch you one?
et: Kas sa tahad, et ma läheksin sind püüdma?

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_BrendanWhoAreYou
en: Aw, darn, I forgot…
et: Aw, Darn, ma unustasin...

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_BrendanWhoAreYou
en: I'm supposed to go help my dad catch some wild POKéMON.
et: Ma peaksin minema, et aidata mu isal püüda mingit metsikut POKéMON.

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_BrendanWhoAreYou
en: Some other time, okay?
et: Mõni teine kord, eks?

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_DoYouHavePokemon
en: Hi, neighbor!
et: Tere, naabrimees!

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_DoYouHavePokemon
en: Do you already have your own POKéMON?
et: Kas sul on juba oma POKéMON?

label: PacifidlogTown_House1_Text_RegiStory
en: In the HOENN region, there are three POKéMON that represent the power of rock, ice, and steel.
et: HOENN piirkonnas on kolm POKéMON mis esindavad kivimi, jää ja terase võimsust.

label: PacifidlogTown_House1_Text_RegiStory
en: Each of them is said to hide away deep inside caves.
et: Igaüks neist olevat end sügaval koobaste sees ära peitnud.

label: PacifidlogTown_House1_Text_RegiStory
en: That's the story I heard when I was just a little kid.
et: Seda lugu kuulsin siis, kui olin alles väike laps.

label: PacifidlogTown_House1_Text_SixDotsOpenThreeDoors
en: “Six dots open three doors.”
et: "Kuus täppi avavad kolm ust."

label: PacifidlogTown_House1_Text_SixDotsOpenThreeDoors
en: Grandpa used to say that, but I don't know what he meant.
et: Vanaisa ütles seda kunagi, aga ma ei tea, mida ta mõtles.

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_WroteSecretCodeLockOpened
en: {PLAYER} wrote down the secret code on the door.
et: {PLAYER} kirjutas üles uksel oleva salakoodi.

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_WroteSecretCodeLockOpened
en: “TRICK MASTER is my life.” … … … … … … … …
et: "TRICK MASTER on minu elu." ... ... ... ... ... ...

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_WroteSecretCodeLockOpened
en: The lock clicked open!
et: Lukk klõpsis lahti!

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_SophiaIntro
en: When I heard there was a strange house, I had to check it out.
et: Kui kuulsin, et seal on kummaline maja, pidin selle üle vaatama.

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_SophiaDefeat
en: I've discovered a tough TRAINER!
et: Olen avastanud sitke TRAINER!

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_SophiaPostBattle
en: I'm sure having a good time checking this place out.
et: Kindlasti on hea aega seda kohta kontrollida.

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_SophiaPostBattle
en: It's a challenge I've found worth repeating!
et: See on väljakutse, mida olen leidnud väärt kordamist!

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_BennyIntro
en: Maybe I could get my BIRD POKéMON to fly over the wall…
et: Ehk saaksin oma BIRD POKéMON üle seina lennata...

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_BennyDefeat
en: Gwaaah! I blew it!
et: Gwaaah! Ma puhusin selle läbi!

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_BennyPostBattle
en: Ehehehe… I guess I lost because I was trying to cheat.
et: Ehehehe... vist kaotasin, sest üritasin petta.

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_SebastianIntro
en: I'm getting dizzy from these rotating doors…
et: Ma muutun nendest pöörlevatest ustest uimaseks...

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_SebastianDefeat
en: Everything's spinning around and around. I can't take this anymore…
et: Kõik keerleb ringi ja ümber. Ma ei saa seda enam võtta...

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_SebastianPostBattle
en: You don't seem to be affected at all. Or do you have your poker face on?
et: Tundub, et sind ei mõjuta üldse. Või on sul pokkerinägu seljas?

label: ShoalCave_LowTideLowerRoom_Text_CanOvercomeColdWithFocus
en: The penetrating cold around these parts is an impediment to training.
et: Läbitungiv külm nende osade ümber on treeningu takistuseks.

label: ShoalCave_LowTideLowerRoom_Text_CanOvercomeColdWithFocus
en: But with focus, one can overcome!
et: Aga fookusega saab üle!

label: ShoalCave_LowTideLowerRoom_Text_CanOvercomeColdWithFocus
en: With this FOCUS BAND, buckle down and withstand the cold!
et: Selle FOCUS BAND abil lukusta alla ja talu külma!

label: ShoalCave_LowTideLowerRoom_Text_EverythingStartsWithFocus
en: Everything starts with focus!
et: Kõik saab alguse fookusest!

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_WelcomeToDevonCorp
en: Hello and welcome to the DEVON CORPORATION.
et: Tere ja tere tulemast DEVON CORPORATION.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_WelcomeToDevonCorp
en: We're proud producers of items and medicine that enhance your life.
et: Oleme uhked toodete ja meditsiini tootjad, mis suurendavad teie elu.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_StaffGotRobbed
en: One of our research staff stupidly got robbed of an important parcel.
et: Üks meie teadustöötaja sai rumalalt röövitud tähtsa paki.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_ThoseShoesAreOurProduct
en: Hey, those RUNNING SHOES! They're one of our products!
et: Hei, need RUNNING SHOES! Need on ühed meie tooted!

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_ThoseShoesAreOurProduct
en: It makes me happy when I see someone using something we made.
et: See teeb mind õnnelikuks, kui näen, et keegi kasutab midagi, mille me tegime.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_RobberWasntVeryBright
en: That stolen parcel…
et: See varastatud pakk...

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_RobberWasntVeryBright
en: Well, sure it's important, but it's not anything that anyone can use.
et: Noh, kindel, et see on oluline, aga see pole midagi, mida keegi saaks kasutada.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_RobberWasntVeryBright
en: In my estimation, that robber must not have been very bright.
et: Minu hinnangul ei pruukinud see röövel väga helge olla.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_SoundsLikeStolenGoodsRecovered
en: It sounds like they've recovered the ripped-off DEVON GOODS.
et: Tundub, et nad on rebenenud DEVON GOODS tagasi saanud.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_OnlyAuthorizedPeopleEnter
en: I'm sorry, only authorized people are allowed to enter here.
et: Vabandust, siia on lubatud siseneda ainult volitatud inimestel.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_HowCouldWeGetRobbed
en: It's beyond stupid. How could we get robbed?
et: See on üle lolluse. Kuidas saaks meid röövida?

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_YoureAlwaysWelcomeHere
en: Hi, there! You're always welcome here!
et: Tere, seal! Olete siia alati oodatud!

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_RocksMetalDisplay
en: Samples of rocks and metal are displayed in the glass case.
et: Klaaskohvris on eksponeeritud kivimite ja metalli näidised.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_RocksMetalDisplay
en: There's a panel with some writing on it…
et: Seal on paneel, kus on mingi kirjutis peal...

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_RocksMetalDisplay
en: “DEVON CORPORATION got its start as a producer of stones from quarries.
et: "DEVON CORPORATION sai oma alguse kivitootjana karjääridest.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_RocksMetalDisplay
en: “The company also produced iron from filings in the sand.
et: "Ettevõte tootis rauda ka liivas olevatest fileedest.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_RocksMetalDisplay
en: “From that humble start as a producer of raw materials, DEVON developed.
et: "Sellest tagasihoidlikust algusest tooraine tootjana arenes välja DEVON.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_RocksMetalDisplay
en: “DEVON is now a manufacturer of a wide range of industrial products.”
et: "DEVON on nüüd laia tööstuslike toodete tootja."

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_ProductDisplay
en: Prototypes and test products fill the glass display case.
et: Klaasist vitriini täidavad prototüübid ja katsetooted.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_ProductDisplay
en: There's a panel with a description…
et: On olemas paneel koos kirjeldusega...

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_ProductDisplay
en: “In addition to industrial products, DEVON now markets sundries and pharmaceuticals for better lifestyles.
et: "Lisaks tööstustoodetele turustab DEVON nüüd paremate eluviiside nimel päikeseenergiat ja farmaatsiatooteid.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_ProductDisplay
en: “Recently, DEVON has begun marketing tools for POKéMON TRAINERS, including POKé BALLS and POKéNAV systems.”
et: "Hiljuti on DEVON alustanud turundusvahendeid POKéMON TRAINERS, sealhulgas POKé BALLS ja POKéNAV süsteemidele."

label: PetalburgCity_House1_Text_TravelingIsWonderful
en: Traveling is wonderful!
et: Reisimine on imeline!

label: PetalburgCity_House1_Text_TravelingIsWonderful
en: When I was young, I roamed the seas and the mountains!
et: Noorena hulkusin meredel ja mägedes!

label: PetalburgCity_House1_Text_GoOnAdventure
en: Sigh…
et: Ohates...

label: PetalburgCity_House1_Text_GoOnAdventure
en: I wish I could go on an adventure with some POKéMON…
et: Soovin, et saaksin seiklema minna mingi POKéMON...

label: PetalburgCity_House1_Text_GoOnAdventure
en: Crawl through some damp grass… Climb rocky, rugged mountains…
et: Ronige läbi niiske rohu, ronige kaljustele ja karmidele mägedele...

label: PetalburgCity_House1_Text_GoOnAdventure
en: Cross the raging seas… Wander about in dark caves…
et: Ületa raevukaid meresid... tiirutada umbes tumedates koobastes...

label: PetalburgCity_House1_Text_GoOnAdventure
en: And, sometimes, even get a little homesick…
et: Ja vahel isegi natuke koduigatsust...

label: PetalburgCity_House1_Text_GoOnAdventure
en: It must be fabulous to travel!
et: Reisimine peab olema vapustav!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_GetAMoveOn
en: Hey, hey! Get a move on!
et: Hei, kuule! Võta samm edasi!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_NolandImFactoryHead
en: Hey, my name's NOLAND! I'm basically in charge of this place, which is why I'm the FACTORY HEAD!
et: Hei, minu nimi on NOLAND! Mina vastutan põhimõtteliselt selle koha eest, mistõttu olen mina FACTORY HEAD!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_NolandImFactoryHead
en: I had a look at your Battle Swap data.
et: Vaatasin su Battle Swapi andmeid.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_NolandImFactoryHead
en: You seem to have the right idea, but you're still square in your head!
et: Tundub, et sul on õige mõte, aga sa oled ikka oma peas kandiline!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_NolandImFactoryHead
en: Listen up, okay? Knowledge isn't only about reading books or doing desk work.
et: Kuulake, eks? Teadmised ei seisne ainult raamatute lugemises või lauatöö tegemises.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_NolandImFactoryHead
en: Just doing that sort of thing… It may as well be useless!
et: See võib sama hästi kasutu olla!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_NolandImFactoryHead
en: You have to experience things with your heart and your body, understand?
et: Tuleb kogeda asju oma südame ja kehaga, mõista?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_NolandImFactoryHead
en: I'll take you on under the same conditions as you.
et: Ma võtan su enda peale samadel tingimustel nagu sina.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_NolandImFactoryHead
en: I'll be using rental POKéMON, too!
et: Kasutan ka renti POKéMON!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_ShakeOutKnowledgeBringItOn
en: Shake out every last bit of your knowledge and bring it on!
et: Raputa välja iga viimnegi oma teadmistepagas ja too see edasi!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_NolandLetsSeeFrontierPass
en: NOLAND: Smart going! Let's see your FRONTIER PASS.
et: NOLAND: Tark minek! Vaatame teie FRONTIER PASS.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_ReceivedKnowledgeSymbol
en: The Knowledge Symbol was embossed on the FRONTIER PASS!
et: Teadmiste sümbol oli reljeefne FRONTIER PASS!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_NextTimeNoHoldsBarred
en: Heh… You're a pretty bright spark…
et: Sa oled päris särav säde...

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_NextTimeNoHoldsBarred
en: Next time, I'll come after you hard. No holds barred, understand?
et: Järgmine kord tulen sulle kõvasti järele. Ei hoia keelatud, mõista?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_NextTimeNoHoldsBarred
en: You keep up your studies!
et: Jätkate õpinguid!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_HarderLookThanLastTime
en: NOLAND: Hey, hey! How's it going? You keeping up with your studies?
et: NOLAND: Hei, kuule! Kuidas läheb? Kas oled õpingutega kursis?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_HarderLookThanLastTime
en: …Oh?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_HarderLookThanLastTime
en: You've taken on a harder look than the last time I saw you.
et: Sa oled võtnud raskema välimuse kui viimati, kui ma sind nägin.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_HarderLookThanLastTime
en: Now, this should be fun! I'm getting excited, hey!
et: See peaks olema lõbus! Ma erutun, kuule!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_AllRightBringItOn
en: All right! Bring it on!
et: Hea küll! Tooge see edasi!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_OutOfMyLeagueLetsSeePass
en: NOLAND: What the… You're getting out of my league!
et: NOLAND: Mis see on... Sa väljud minu liigast!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_OutOfMyLeagueLetsSeePass
en: Sheesh! Let's see that FRONTIER PASS!
et: Sheesh! Vaatame, et FRONTIER PASS!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_KnowledgeSymbolTookGoldenShine
en: The Knowledge Symbol took on a golden shine!
et: Teadmiste sümbol võttis kuldse sära!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_LastTimeILoseToYou
en: Pfft, man!
et: Pfft, mees!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_LastTimeILoseToYou
en: That's absolutely the last time I lose to you!
et: See on absoluutselt viimane kord, kui ma sulle kaotan!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_LastTimeILoseToYou
en: We have to do this again, hey?
et: Me peame seda uuesti tegema, kuule?

label: MeteorFalls_StevensCave_Text_ShouldKnowHowGoodIAmExpectWorst
en: STEVEN: Oh, wow, {PLAYER}{KUN}. I'm amazed you knew where to find me.
et: STEVEN: Oh, vau, {PLAYER}{KUN}. Mind hämmastab, et sa teadsid, kust mind leida.

label: MeteorFalls_StevensCave_Text_ShouldKnowHowGoodIAmExpectWorst
en: Do you, uh…maybe think of me as just a rock maniac?
et: Kas sa... võib-olla pead mind lihtsalt kivimaniakiks?

label: MeteorFalls_StevensCave_Text_ShouldKnowHowGoodIAmExpectWorst
en: No, that can't be right.
et: Ei, see ei saa õige olla.

label: MeteorFalls_StevensCave_Text_ShouldKnowHowGoodIAmExpectWorst
en: We battled alongside each other at the SOOTOPOLIS SPACE CENTER.
et: Võitlesime üksteise kõrval SOOTOPOLIS SPACE CENTER.

label: MeteorFalls_StevensCave_Text_ShouldKnowHowGoodIAmExpectWorst
en: You should have a very good idea about how good I am.
et: Sul peaks olema väga hea mõte, kui hea ma olen.

label: MeteorFalls_StevensCave_Text_ShouldKnowHowGoodIAmExpectWorst
en: Okay, {PLAYER}{KUN}, if you're going to mount a serious challenge, expect the worst!
et: Ok, {PLAYER}{KUN}, kui kavatsed püstitada tõsise väljakutse, siis oota halvimat!

label: MeteorFalls_StevensCave_Text_StevenDefeat
en: You… I had no idea you'd become so strong…
et: Mul polnud aimugi, et sa nii tugevaks saad...

label: MeteorFalls_StevensCave_Text_MyPredictionCameTrue
en: STEVEN: Come to think of it, ever since our paths first crossed in GRANITE CAVE in DEWFORD, I had this feeling.
et: STEVEN: Tule seda mõtlema, sest meie teed ristusid esimest korda GRANITE CAVE in DEWFORD, mul oli selline tunne.

label: MeteorFalls_StevensCave_Text_MyPredictionCameTrue
en: I thought that you would eventually become the CHAMPION.
et: Ma arvasin, et sinust saab lõpuks TŠEMPION.

label: MeteorFalls_StevensCave_Text_MyPredictionCameTrue
en: My predictions usually come true.
et: Minu ennustused lähevad tavaliselt täide.

label: MeteorFalls_StevensCave_Text_MyPredictionCameTrue
en: And where will you go from here?
et: Ja kuhu sa siit edasi lähed?

label: MeteorFalls_StevensCave_Text_MyPredictionCameTrue
en: Fufufu, even I couldn't tell you that.
et: Fufufu, isegi mina ei osanud seda öelda.

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt2Intro
en: If you want to know the secret about our HIDEOUT, you have me to beat!
et: Kui sa tahad teada saladust meie HIDEOUT kohta, siis sa pead mind peksma!

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
en: I can't win at all…
et: Ma ei suuda üldse võita...

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
en: Our HIDEOUT's secret?
et: Meie HIDEOUT saladus?

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
en: Well, let's just say… There's a submarine at the far end!
et: Ütleme nii, et kaugemas otsas on allveelaev!

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
en: But, by now… Kekekeke…
et: Aga nüüdseks... Kekekeke...

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt3Intro
en: Fuel supply loaded A-OK! In-cruise snacks loaded A-OK!
et: Kütusevarustus laetud A-OK! Kruiisisisesed suupisted laetud A-OK!

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt3Intro
en: Nothing left to do but KO a pesky meddler!
et: Ei jäänud muud üle, kui KO pingsale vahelesegajale!

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt3Defeat
en: I took a serious licking!
et: Võtsin tõsise lakkumise!

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt3PostBattle
en: Humph! This was supposed to happen!
et: Humph! See pidi juhtuma!

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt3PostBattle
en: My mission was to just hold you up!
et: Minu ülesanne oli sind lihtsalt üleval hoida!

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt5Intro
en: Yawn… Keeping watch over the HIDEOUT bores me. I'll take you on.
et: Yawn... valvamine HIDEOUT üle põrkab mind. Võtan su enda peale.

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt5Defeat
en: Yawn… Oh, I lost…
et: Oh, ma kaotasin...

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt5PostBattle
en: If you scurry too much, other TEAM AQUA members might get you.
et: Kui liiga palju kräunuda, võivad teised TEAM AQUA liikmed sind kätte saada.

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt7Intro
en: Hey! You there!
et: Hei! Sina seal!

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt7Intro
en: Which do you think is cooler? TEAM AQUA's uniform or TEAM MAGMA's?
et: Kumb on teie arvates lahedam? TEAM AQUA on ühtlane või TEAM MAGMA on?

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt7Defeat
en: I lost in a cool way…
et: Kaotasin lahedalt...

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt7PostBattle
en: If you have a cool uniform, you look good even in a loss, don't you think?
et: Kui sul on lahe vorm, siis näed sa isegi kaotuses hea välja, kas pole?

label: AbandonedShip_HiddenFloorRooms_Text_BrightShinyTrash
en: It's bright and shiny! But it's just trash…
et: See on särav ja läikiv! Aga see on lihtsalt prügikast...

label: MtChimney_Text_MeteoriteWillActivateVolcano
en: The power contained in the METEORITE…
et: Võimsus, mis sisaldub METEORITE...

label: MtChimney_Text_MeteoriteWillActivateVolcano
en: By amplifying its power with this machine, MT. CHIMNEY's volcanic activity will instantly intensify…
et: Võimendades selle masinaga selle võimsust, MT. CHIMNEY vulkaaniline tegevus intensiivistub koheselt...

label: MtChimney_Text_MeteoriteWillActivateVolcano
en: Its energy will grow deep inside the crater and… Fufufu…
et: Selle energia kasvab sügaval kraatri sees ja... Fufufu...

label: MtChimney_Text_MaxieIntro
en: MAXIE: Hm? Who are you?
et: MAXIE: Hm? Kes sa oled?

label: MtChimney_Text_MaxieIntro
en: I'd heard ARCHIE bemoaning a child who's been meddling in TEAM AQUA's affairs.
et: Ma olin kuulnud ARCHIE nurisevat last, kes on sekkunud TEAM AQUA asjadesse.

label: MtChimney_Text_MaxieIntro
en: It must be you he meant.
et: See oled vist sina, keda ta silmas pidas.

label: MtChimney_Text_MaxieIntro
en: Humph! So you're thinking of interfering with us, TEAM MAGMA?
et: Humph! Nii et sa mõtled meid segada, TEAM MAGMA?

label: MtChimney_Text_MaxieIntro
en: Now you listen. Long ago, living things used the land to live and grow.
et: Nüüd kuulad. Ammu kasutasid elusolendid maad elamiseks ja kasvamiseks.

label: MtChimney_Text_MaxieIntro
en: That is why land is all important! It is the cradle of all!
et: Sellepärast on maa kõik oluline! See on kõigi häll!

label: MtChimney_Text_MaxieIntro
en: That is why TEAM MAGMA is dedicated to the expansion of the land mass.
et: Seepärast on TEAM MAGMA pühendatud maamassi laiendamisele.

label: MtChimney_Text_MaxieIntro
en: It is for further advancement of humankind and POKéMON!
et: See on inimkonna edasiseks edendamiseks ja POKéMON!

label: MtChimney_Text_MaxieIntro
en: And for that, we need the power of what sleeps within this mountain…
et: Ja selleks on meil vaja jõudu, mis selle mäe sees magab...

label: MtChimney_Text_MaxieIntro
en: Oh! There was no need for you to learn that much.
et: Oh! Sul polnud vaja nii palju õppida.

label: MtChimney_Text_MaxieIntro
en: But, no matter! I'll teach you the consequences of meddling in our grand design!
et: Aga, vahet pole! Õpetan teile meie suurejoonelisse disaini sekkumisega kaasnevaid tagajärgi!

label: MtChimney_Text_MaxieDefeat
en: What?!
et: Mida?!

label: MtChimney_Text_MaxieDefeat
en: I, MAXIE, was caught off guard?!
et: Mina, MAXIE, jäin valve alt välja?!

label: MtChimney_Text_MaxieYouHaventSeenLastOfMagma
en: MAXIE: But, enough. I will back off this time.
et: MAXIE: Aga, aitab. Ma lähen seekord tagasi.

label: MtChimney_Text_MaxieYouHaventSeenLastOfMagma
en: But don't think that this is the last you've seen of TEAM MAGMA.
et: Aga ärge arvake, et see on viimane, mida te olete TEAM MAGMA näinud.

label: MtChimney_Text_MaxieYouHaventSeenLastOfMagma
en: Fufufu…
et: Fufufu...

label: MtChimney_Text_MaxieYouHaventSeenLastOfMagma
en: Even without the METEORITE, if we obtain that ORB… Fufufu…
et: Isegi ilma METEORITE, kui me saame, et ORB... Fufufu...

label: MtChimney_Text_TabithaIntro
en: Hehehe!
et: Hehehe!

label: MtChimney_Text_TabithaIntro
en: So you've come all the way here!
et: Nii et te olete siia jõudnud!

label: MtChimney_Text_TabithaIntro
en: But you're too late! I've already delivered the METEORITE from METEOR FALLS to the BOSS!
et: Aga sa oled hiljaks jäänud! Ma juba toimetasin METEORITE alates METEOR FALLS kuni BOSS!

label: MtChimney_Text_TabithaDefeat
en: Hehehe…
et: Hehehe...

label: MtChimney_Text_TabithaDefeat
en: Even though I've lost, if our leader awakens that thing…
et: Kuigi ma olen kaotanud, kui meie juht selle asja äratab...

label: MtChimney_Text_TabithaPostBattle
en: BOSS, hurry! Give it the METEORITE's energy!
et: BOSS, kiirustage! Anna sellele METEORITE energiat!

label: MtChimney_Text_TabithaPostBattle
en: Hehehe…
et: Hehehe...

label: MtChimney_Text_Grunt2Intro
en: We of TEAM MAGMA are working hard for everyone's sake.
et: Meie TEAM MAGMA teeme kõigi huvides kõvasti tööd.

label: MtChimney_Text_Grunt2Intro
en: Like, if that thing's power made more land, there'd be more places to live.
et: Nagu, kui selle asja võim teeks rohkem maad, siis oleks rohkem kohti, kus elada.

label: MtChimney_Text_Grunt2Intro
en: Everyone'd be happy!
et: Kõik oleksid õnnelikud!

label: MtChimney_Text_Grunt2Defeat
en: Hunh? What do you mean I lost?
et: Hunh? Mis mõttes ma kaotasin?

label: MtChimney_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
en: Our BOSS says, “It will make everyone happy.”
et: Meie BOSS ütleb: "See teeb kõik õnnelikuks".

label: MtChimney_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
en: But why does everyone keep getting in our way?
et: Aga miks kõik meile pidevalt jalgu jäävad?

label: MtChimney_Text_Grunt1Intro
en: If there were more land, I'd be able to get a big house of my own!
et: Kui maad oleks rohkem, siis ma saaks omale suure maja!

label: MtChimney_Text_Grunt1Intro
en: I'm going to build it on hardened lava!
et: Ehitan selle karastatud lavale!

label: MtChimney_Text_Grunt1Defeat
en: My dream of a big house…
et: Minu unistus suurest majast...

label: MtChimney_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
en: A kid like you, you ought to be splashing about in the waves!
et: Sinusugune laps, sa peaksid lainetes pritsima!

label: MtChimney_Text_TeamAquaAlwaysMessingWithPlans
en: That annoying TEAM AQUA… They always mess with our plans!
et: See tüütu TEAM AQUA... Nad alati jamavad meie plaanidega!

label: MtChimney_Text_MeteoritesPackAmazingPower
en: METEORITES pack amazing power!
et: METEORITES pakkige hämmastav võimsus!

label: MtChimney_Text_YouBetterNotMessWithUs
en: You'd better not mess with us!
et: Parem ärge jamage meiega!

label: MtChimney_Text_YouBetterNotMessWithUs
en: We're trying to awaken that thing for the benefit of everyone!
et: Me üritame seda asja äratada kõigi hüvanguks!

label: MtChimney_Text_AquasNameSimilar
en: We're TEAM MAGMA!
et: Oleme TEAM MAGMA!

label: MtChimney_Text_AquasNameSimilar
en: They're TEAM AQUA!
et: Need on TEAM AQUA!

label: MtChimney_Text_AquasNameSimilar
en: It totally annoys me that they'd use a name like ours!
et: See ajab mind täiesti närvi, et nad kasutaksid sellist nime nagu meie oma!

label: MtChimney_Text_DouseThemInFire
en: Yeah! Douse them in fire!
et: Jah! Purusta need tules!

label: MtChimney_Text_KeepMakingMoreLand
en: We're going to keep making more land!
et: Edasi teeme maad juurde!

label: MtChimney_Text_Bufoh
en: Bufoh!
et: Bufoh!

label: MtChimney_Text_ArchieGoStopTeamMagma
en: ARCHIE: Grr, {PLAYER}! I should've guessed you'd show up!
et: ARCHIE: Grr, {PLAYER}! Ma oleks pidanud arvama, et sa ilmuksid kohale!

label: MtChimney_Text_ArchieGoStopTeamMagma
en: See for yourself what the fanatics of TEAM MAGMA are up to!
et: Vaata ise, millised on TEAM MAGMA fanaatikud!

label: MtChimney_Text_ArchieGoStopTeamMagma
en: They're trying to inject the stolen METEORITE's power into the volcano!
et: Nad üritavad varastatud METEORITE võimu vulkaani sisse süstida!

label: MtChimney_Text_ArchieGoStopTeamMagma
en: Doing something like that will cause the volcano's eruption!
et: Millegi sellise tegemine põhjustab vulkaani purske!

label: MtChimney_Text_ArchieIHaveMyHandsFull
en: ARCHIE: Grrr…
et: ARCHIE: Grrr...

label: MtChimney_Text_ArchieIHaveMyHandsFull
en: I want to stop that MAXIE, but I can't!
et: Ma tahan selle MAXIE peatada, aga ma ei saa!

label: MtChimney_Text_ArchieIHaveMyHandsFull
en: Not when I have my hands full battling three opponents at once!
et: Mitte siis, kui mul on käed täis võideldes kolm vastast korraga!

label: MtChimney_Text_ArchieThankYou
en: ARCHIE: {PLAYER}! Thank you!
et: ARCHIE: {PLAYER}! Aitäh!

label: MtChimney_Text_ArchieThankYou
en: With your help, we thwarted TEAM MAGMA's destructive plan!
et: Teie abiga nurjasime TEAM MAGMA hävitava plaani!

label: MtChimney_Text_ArchieThankYou
en: But… You… Whose side are you on?
et: Aga, kelle poolel sa oled?

label: MtChimney_Text_ArchieThankYou
en: Ah, it doesn't matter.
et: Ah, vahet pole.

label: MtChimney_Text_ArchieThankYou
en: We will remain vigilant and keep up our pursuit of TEAM MAGMA.
et: Jääme valvsaks ja hoiame oma püüdlust TEAM MAGMA.

label: MtChimney_Text_ArchieThankYou
en: {PLAYER}, we shall meet again!
et: {PLAYER}, kohtume uuesti!

label: MtChimney_Text_MagmaOutnumbersUs
en: Darn… TEAM MAGMA outnumbers us! We can't keep up with them!
et: Darn... TEAM MAGMA ületab meid! Me ei saa nendega sammu pidada!

label: MtChimney_Text_LessHabitatForWaterPokemon
en: If they expand the land, there'll be less habitats for WATER POKéMON!
et: Kui nad maad laiendavad, on vähem elupaiku WATER POKéMON!

label: MtChimney_Text_MagmasNameSimilar
en: We're TEAM AQUA!
et: Oleme TEAM AQUA!

label: MtChimney_Text_MagmasNameSimilar
en: They're TEAM MAGMA!
et: Need on TEAM MAGMA!

label: MtChimney_Text_MagmasNameSimilar
en: It burns me up that they'd use such a confusing name!
et: See põletab mind ära, et nad kasutaksid nii segast nime!

label: MtChimney_Text_Bushaa
en: Bushaa!
et: Bušaa!

label: MtChimney_Text_LavaCookiesJust200
en: LAVA COOKIES are MT. CHIMNEY's local specialty.
et: LAVA COOKIES on MT. CHIMNEY kohaliku eriala.

label: MtChimney_Text_LavaCookiesJust200
en: Try one. It's just ¥200.
et: Proovi ühte. See on kõigest $200.

label: MtChimney_Text_ThankYouDear
en: Thank you, dear!
et: Aitäh, kallis!

label: MtChimney_Text_YouveNotGotTheMoney
en: Oh, dear. You can't buy a thing if you've not got the money.
et: Oh, kallis. Asja ei saa osta, kui raha pole kätte saanud.

label: MtChimney_Text_OhFineThen
en: Oh, fine then.
et: No olgu.

label: MtChimney_Text_MeteoriteFittedOnMachine
en: A METEORITE is fitted on a mysterious machine…
et: Müstilisele masinale on paigaldatud METEORITE...

label: MtChimney_Text_MeteoriteFittedOnMachine
en: The machine seems to be storing energy in the METEORITE.
et: Masin tundub salvestavat energiat METEORITE.

label: MtChimney_Text_RemoveTheMeteorite
en: A METEORITE is fitted on a mysterious machine…
et: Müstilisele masinale on paigaldatud METEORITE...

label: MtChimney_Text_RemoveTheMeteorite
en: Do you want to remove the METEORITE?
et: Kas soovite eemaldada METEORITE?

label: MtChimney_Text_PlayerRemovedMeteorite
en: {PLAYER} removed the METEORITE from the mysterious machine.
et: {PLAYER} eemaldas salapärasest masinast METEORITE.

label: MtChimney_Text_PlayerLeftMeteorite
en: {PLAYER} left the METEORITE where it was.
et: {PLAYER} jättis METEORITE sinna, kus see oli.

label: MtChimney_Text_MachineMakesNoResponse
en: This mysterious machine… It makes no response whatsoever.
et: See salapärane masin ei anna mingit vastust.

label: MtChimney_Text_RouteSign
en: {DOWN_ARROW} JAGGED PATH LAVARIDGE TOWN AHEAD
et: {DOWN_ARROW} JAGGED PATH LAVARIDGE TOWN AHEAD

label: MtChimney_Text_ShelbyIntro
en: I've been to the hot springs and refreshed my tired bones. Right now I'm feeling strong!
et: Olen käinud kuumaveeallikates ja värskendanud oma väsinud konte. Praegu tunnen end tugevana!

label: MtChimney_Text_ShelbyDefeat
en: Oh, my goodness. Now, aren't you something!
et: Oh, mu headus. Kas sa pole mitte midagi!

label: MtChimney_Text_ShelbyPostBattle
en: Well, well, I've lost. I can't call myself an EXPERT now, can I?
et: Noh, ma olen kaotanud. Ma ei saa ju ennast nüüd EXPERT'ks nimetada?

label: MtChimney_Text_ShelbyRegister
en: Thank you, child. It was fun, as if I were battling my own grandchild.
et: Aitäh, laps. Lõbus oli, nagu võitleksin omaenda lapselapsega.

label: MtChimney_Text_ShelbyRegister
en: Please, come see me again for a rematch.
et: Palun, tule minuga uuesti korduskohtumisele.

label: MtChimney_Text_ShelbyRematchIntro
en: If you can mesh your heart with those of your POKéMON, why, you should be able to achieve great things.
et: Kui saate oma südame võrgutada oma POKéMON-ga, siis miks, peaksite suutma saavutada suuri asju.

label: MtChimney_Text_ShelbyRematchDefeat
en: Oh, my goodness. Now, aren't you something!
et: Oh, mu headus. Kas sa pole mitte midagi!

label: MtChimney_Text_ShelbyPostRematch
en: Perhaps your heart has become one with the hearts of your POKéMON.
et: Võib-olla on sinu süda saanud üheks sinu POKéMON südametega.

label: MtChimney_Text_MelissaIntro
en: I've got the fire in me, baby. I can't stand it! I have to battle!
et: Mul on tuli sees, kullake. Ma ei talu seda! Ma pean võitlema!

label: MtChimney_Text_MelissaDefeat
en: Ooh, that was a scorching-hot match!
et: Oi, see oli kõrvetav-kuum matš!

label: MtChimney_Text_MelissaPostBattle
en: The heat of MT. CHIMNEY warms me up, baby!
et: Kuumus MT. CHIMNEY soojendab mind, kullake!

label: MtChimney_Text_SheilaIntro
en: I've finally made it to MT. CHIMNEY. I want to make my POKéMON battle!
et: Olen lõpuks jõudnud MT-ni. CHIMNEY. Tahan teha oma POKéMON lahingu!

label: MtChimney_Text_SheilaDefeat
en: The way you battle… It's like a MT. CHIMNEY eruption!
et: Kuidas sa võitled... see on nagu MT. CHIMNEY purse!

label: MtChimney_Text_SheilaPostBattle
en: Like I said, I've finally made it to MT. CHIMNEY. It would be a shame if I only do a little sightseeing…
et: Nagu ma ütlesin, olen ma lõpuks jõudnud MT-ni. CHIMNEY. Kahju oleks, kui ma teeks ainult natuke vaatamisväärsusi...

label: MtChimney_Text_SheilaPostBattle
en: I want to get in some battles and buy COOKIES as souvenirs.
et: Tahan saada mõnedes lahingutes ja osta COOKIES suveniiridena.

label: MtChimney_Text_ShirleyIntro
en: Since I bathed in the hot springs, I've been feeling great! I'm sure I'm going to win!
et: Kuna suplesin kuumaveeallikates, siis olen end suurepäraselt tundnud! Kindlasti lähen võitma!

label: MtChimney_Text_ShirleyDefeat
en: Yowch! I'm getting a chill out of the water.
et: Yowch! Mul tuleb külmavärin veest välja.

label: MtChimney_Text_ShirleyPostBattle
en: I'll have to take another dip in the hot springs. Want to join me?
et: Pean veel ühe supluse kuumaveeallikatesse tegema. Tahad minuga ühineda?

label: MtChimney_Text_ShirleyPostBattle
en: Just joking!
et: Lihtsalt naljategemine!

label: MtChimney_Text_SawyerIntro
en: This is one fine mountain! Plenty of hot people around for company!
et: See on üks tore mägi! Külluslikult kuumi inimesi seltsiks!

label: MtChimney_Text_SawyerDefeat
en: Oh, you're a real firebrand, too!
et: Oh, sa oled ka tõeline tulevärk!

label: MtChimney_Text_SawyerPostBattle
en: I think I need a dip in LAVARIDGE HOT SPRING with the locals!
et: Ma arvan, et mul on vaja sukelduda LAVARIDGE HOT SPRING kohalikega!

label: MtChimney_Text_SawyerRegister
en: I like little fireballs like you. Let me register you in my POKéNAV.
et: Mulle meeldivad sinusugused väikesed tulepallid. Las ma registreerin su oma POKéNAV.

label: MtChimney_Text_SawyerRematchIntro
en: I'm happily surrounded by hot people around these parts. I won't lose!
et: Mind ümbritsevad rõõmsalt kuumad inimesed nende osade ümber. Ma ei kaota!

label: MtChimney_Text_SawyerRematchDefeat
en: Gosh, you're still the same firebrand as before!
et: issand, sa oled ikka samasugune tulevärk nagu enne!

label: MtChimney_Text_SawyerPostRematch
en: Actually, it really is hot here. I'm overdressed for these parts.
et: Tegelikult on siin tõesti palav. Ma olen nende osade jaoks ülepingutatud.

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyNotGoingToLoseAnymore
en: WALLY: Hi! {PLAYER}!
et: WALLY: Tere! {PLAYER}!

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyNotGoingToLoseAnymore
en: I bet you're surprised to see me here!
et: Vean kihla, et sa oled üllatunud, kui mind siin näed!

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyNotGoingToLoseAnymore
en: I made it all the way here, and it's all thanks to you!
et: Ma jõudsin siia terve tee ja see kõik on tänu teile!

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyNotGoingToLoseAnymore
en: {PLAYER}, losing to you that time made me stronger!
et: {PLAYER}, kaotades sulle, et aeg tegi mind tugevamaks!

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyNotGoingToLoseAnymore
en: But I'm not going to lose anymore!
et: Aga ma ei kaota enam!

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyNotGoingToLoseAnymore
en: I'm going to win! For the POKéMON who gave me courage and strength!
et: Ma võidan! POKéMON eest, kes andis mulle julgust ja jõudu!

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyNotGoingToLoseAnymore
en: Okay… Here I come!
et: Olgu, siia ma tulen!

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyEntranceDefeat
en: Wow! {PLAYER}, you are strong, after all!
et: Vau! {PLAYER}, sa oled ju tugev!

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyPostEntranceBattle
en: WALLY: I couldn't beat you today, {PLAYER}, but one of these days, I'll catch up to you!
et: WALLY: Ma ei suutnud sind täna võita, {PLAYER}, aga ühel neist päevadest jõuan ma sulle järele!

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyIntro
en: WALLY: Hi! {PLAYER}!
et: WALLY: Tere! {PLAYER}!

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyIntro
en: I've gotten stronger since that last time! I wanted to show you, {PLAYER}!
et: Olen sellest möödunud korrast tugevamaks saanud! Tahtsin näidata, {PLAYER}!

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyIntro
en: Okay… Here I come!
et: Olgu, siia ma tulen!

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyDefeat
en: Wow! {PLAYER}, you are strong, after all!
et: Vau! {PLAYER}, sa oled ju tugev!

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyPostBattle
en: WALLY: I couldn't beat you this time, too… But one of these days, {PLAYER}, I'm going to catch up to you…
et: WALLY: Ma ei suutnud ka seekord sind võita... aga üks neist päevadest, {PLAYER}, ma jõuan sulle järele...

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyPostBattle
en: And challenge the POKéMON LEAGUE!
et: Ja väljakutse POKéMON LIIGA!

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_EdgarIntro
en: I've made it this far a couple times, but the last stretch is so long…
et: Olen paar korda nii kaugele jõudnud, aga viimane venitus on nii pikk...

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_EdgarDefeat
en: My dream ends here again…
et: Minu unistus lõpeb siin jälle...

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_EdgarPostBattle
en: You've made it this far. Keep the momentum going and become the CHAMPION! If anyone can, it's you!
et: Sa oled nii kaugele jõudnud. Hoia hoogu edasi ja saa TŠEMPION! Kui keegi oskab, siis see oled sina!

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_AlbertIntro
en: I didn't come all this way to lose now. That possibility doesn't exist!
et: Ma ei tulnud kogu seda teed, et nüüd kaotada. Seda võimalust ei ole olemas!

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_AlbertDefeat
en: Impossible… I lost?
et: Võimatu... ma kaotasin?

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_AlbertPostBattle
en: I lost here…
et: Kaotasin siin...

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_AlbertPostBattle
en: That means I lack the qualifications to become the CHAMPION…
et: See tähendab, et mul puudub kvalifikatsioon, et saada TŠEMPION...

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_HopeIntro
en: This seemingly infinite and harsh road lives up to its name of VICTORY.
et: See pealtnäha lõpmatu ja karm tee elab oma nime järgi VICTORY.

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_HopeDefeat
en: Your battle style is fantastic…
et: Sinu lahingustiil on fantastiline...

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_HopePostBattle
en: You seem to have the potential for becoming the CHAMPION.
et: Tundub, et sul on potentsiaali saada TŠEMPION.

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_QuincyIntro
en: What is the VICTORY ROAD? I'll tell you if you win!
et: Mis on VICTORY ROAD? Ma ütlen, kas sa võidad!

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_QuincyDefeat
en: Okay! Well done!
et: Olgu! Hästi tehtud!

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_QuincyPostBattle
en: Getting through here safely--that's the final test for any TRAINER aiming to become the POKéMON CHAMPION.
et: Siit ohutult läbi saamine--see on viimane test iga TRAINER eesmärk on saada POKéMON TŠEMPION.

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_QuincyPostBattle
en: That's why it's called the VICTORY ROAD.
et: Sellepärast seda kutsutaksegi VICTORY ROAD.

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_KatelynnIntro
en: I have nothing to say to anyone that's come this far. Come on!
et: Mul ei ole kellelegi, kes on nii kaugele jõudnud, midagi öelda. Tule nüüd!

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_KatelynnDefeat
en: This is a disgrace…
et: See on häbiasi...

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_KatelynnPostBattle
en: Humph, go right on ahead. See if I care.
et: Humph, mine kohe edasi. Vaata, kas ma hoolin.

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_VitoIntro
en: I trained together with my whole family, every one of us! I'm not losing to anyone!
et: Treenisin koos kogu perega, igaüks meist! Ma ei kaota kellelegi!

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_VitoDefeat
en: Better than my family?! Is that possible?!
et: Parem kui minu pere?! Kas see on võimalik?!

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_VitoPostBattle
en: I was better than everyone in my family. I've never lost before…
et: Olin parem kui kõik mu pereliikmed. Ma pole kunagi varem kaotanud...

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_VitoPostBattle
en: I've lost my confidence… Maybe I'll go home…
et: Ma olen enesekindluse kaotanud...ehk lähen koju...

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_OwenIntro
en: I'd heard that there was a tough little kid around. Do they mean you?
et: Olin kuulnud, et ümberringi on üks kõva väike laps. Kas nad mõtlevad sind?

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_OwenDefeat
en: The little shrimp is tough!
et: Väike krevetid on sitked!

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_OwenPostBattle
en: The rumors I heard, that tough little kid is from PETALBURG CITY.
et: Kuulujutud, mida ma kuulsin, et see karm väike laps on pärit PETALBURG CITY.

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_CarolineIntro
en: You must be getting a little tired.
et: Sa oled vist natuke väsinud.

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_CarolineDefeat
en: No signs of tiring at all!
et: Väsimuse märke pole üldse!

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_CarolinePostBattle
en: VICTORY ROAD and the POKéMON LEAGUE are long and grueling challenges. Beware of fatigue!
et: VICTORY ROAD ja POKéMON LIIGA on pikad ja kurnavad väljakutsed. Hoidu väsimusest!

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_JulieIntro
en: You shouldn't get complacent just because you have a lot of GYM BADGES.
et: Sa ei tohiks saada rahulolu ainult sellepärast, et sul on palju SAAL MÄRGID.

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_JulieIntro
en: There's always going to be someone who's better than you!
et: Alati tuleb keegi, kes on sinust parem!

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_JulieDefeat
en: You're better than me!
et: Sa oled minust parem!

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_JuliePostBattle
en: Gaze on your collected BADGES and remember the TRAINERS you've faced.
et: Vaata oma kogutud MÄRGID ja pea meeles TRAINERS sa oled silmitsi.

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_FelixIntro
en: I've come this far, but the tension's giving me awful stomach pain…
et: Olen nii kaugele jõudnud, aga pinge tekitab kohutavat kõhuvalu...

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_FelixDefeat
en: Ooh… It hurts…
et: See teeb haiget...

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_FelixPostBattle
en: I can't help getting all tense knowing that I'm nearing the POKéMON LEAGUE.
et: Ma ei saa aidata saada kõik pinges teadmine, et ma lähenen POKéMON LIIGA.

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_FelixPostBattle
en: It's all I can do to feign calm.
et: See on kõik, mida ma saan teha rahulikuks tembeldamiseks.

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_DianneIntro
en: The elite among the elite gather in this cave.
et: Eliit eliidi seas koguneb siia koopasse.

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_DianneIntro
en: How are you finding it?
et: Kuidas sa selle leiad?

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_DianneDefeat
en: Not rattled in the least bit!
et: Ei ragisenud vähimalgi määral!

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_DiannePostBattle
en: You do have guts! I like that! Keep it going!
et: Sul on julgust! Mulle meeldib see! Hoidke seda edasi!

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasIntro
en: This is where we DRAGON users do our training.
et: See on koht, kus me DRAGON kasutajad teevad meie koolitust.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasIntro
en: The CHAMPION even visits. Now do you see how special it is here?
et: TŠEMPION isegi külastab. Kas te nüüd näete, kui eriline see siin on?

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasDefeat
en: Urgh! I didn't expect you to be so strong!
et: Urgh! Ma ei oodanud, et sa nii tugev oled!

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasPostBattle
en: The road ahead remains long and harsh.
et: Edasine tee jääb pikaks ja karmiks.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasPostBattle
en: When will my POKéMON and I become the best?
et: Millal saab minu POKéMON ja minust parim?

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasRegister
en: I want to know more about your power. Let me register you in my POKéNAV.
et: Ma tahan sinu võimust rohkem teada. Las ma registreerin su oma POKéNAV.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasRematchIntro
en: Since we met, we have trained hard with our sights on number one.
et: Kohtumisest saadik oleme kõvasti treeninud oma vaatamisväärsustega number ühel.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasRematchIntro
en: Help us see how much stronger we've become!
et: Aita meil näha, kui palju tugevamaks oleme muutunud!

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasRematchDefeat
en: Urgh! I didn't expect you to be so strong!
et: Urgh! Ma ei oodanud, et sa nii tugev oled!

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasPostRematch
en: You've obviously kept up your POKéMON training.
et: Sa oled ilmselgelt oma POKéMON treeningut üleval hoidnud.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasPostRematch
en: So long as you remain strong, I, too, can become stronger!
et: Niikaua, kuni sa jääd tugevaks, võin ka mina tugevamaks muutuda!

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnIntro
en: JOHN: We've always battled POKéMON together as a twosome. We've confidence in ourselves.
et: JOHN: Oleme alati kahevahel koos võidelnud POKéMON. Me usaldame ennast.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnDefeat
en: JOHN: Oh, my. We've lost, dear wife.
et: JOHN: Oh, my. Me oleme kaotanud, kallis naine.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnPostBattle
en: JOHN: We've been married for fifty years.
et: JOHN: Oleme olnud abielus viiskümmend aastat.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnPostBattle
en: Come to think of it, I've yet to beat my dear wife in a battle.
et: Tule sellele mõtlema, ma pole veel oma kallist naist lahingus võitnud.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnNotEnoughMons
en: JOHN: Well, well, what a young TRAINER!
et: JOHN: Noh, mis noor TRAINER!

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnNotEnoughMons
en: Will you battle with us? If so, you'll have to return with more POKéMON.
et: Kas sa võitled meiega? Kui jah, siis tuleb tagasi tulla rohkem POKéMON-ga.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnRegister
en: JOHN: Young TRAINER, if the chance arises, will you battle with us again?
et: JOHN: Noored TRAINER, kui tekib võimalus, kas te võitlete meiega uuesti?

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayIntro
en: JAY: We've been married for fifty years.
