et: JAY: Oleme olnud abielus viiskümmend aastat.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayIntro
en: The bond we share as a couple could never be broken.
et: Seda võlakirja, mida me paarina jagame, ei saanud kunagi murda.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayDefeat
en: JAY: Oh, dear. We've lost, my dear husband.
et: JAY: Oh, kallis. Me oleme kaotanud, mu kallis abikaasa.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayPostBattle
en: JAY: Fifty years of marriage…
et: JAY: Viiskümmend aastat abielu...

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayPostBattle
en: If we ever argued, we always settled it with a POKéMON battle…
et: Kui me kunagi vaidlesime, siis lahendasime selle alati POKéMON lahinguga...

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayNotEnoughMons
en: JAY: Well, well, aren't you a young TRAINER?
et: JAY: Noh, kas sa pole mitte noor TRAINER?

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayNotEnoughMons
en: If you'd care to battle with us, you'll have to come back with more POKéMON.
et: Kui sa viitsiksid meiega lahinguid pidada, siis pead sa rohkem POKéMON tagasi tulema.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnRematchIntro
en: JOHN: We've always battled POKéMON together as a twosome. We've confidence in ourselves.
et: JOHN: Oleme alati kahevahel koos võidelnud POKéMON. Me usaldame ennast.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnRematchDefeat
en: JOHN: Oh, my. We've lost, dear wife.
et: JOHN: Oh, my. Me oleme kaotanud, kallis naine.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnPostRematch
en: JOHN: Married for fifty years…
et: JOHN: Abielus viiskümmend aastat...

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnPostRematch
en: On reflection, the dear wife and I, we battled day in and day out…
et: Mõtiskluse peale, kalli naisega, võitlesime päevast päeva...

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnRematchNotEnoughMons
en: JOHN: Well, well, what a young TRAINER!
et: JOHN: Noh, mis noor TRAINER!

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnRematchNotEnoughMons
en: Will you battle with us? If so, you'll have to return with more POKéMON.
et: Kas sa võitled meiega? Kui jah, siis tuleb tagasi tulla rohkem POKéMON-ga.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayRematchIntro
en: JAY: We've been married for fifty years.
et: JAY: Oleme olnud abielus viiskümmend aastat.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayRematchIntro
en: We've supported each other all that time. We've made ourselves strong.
et: Oleme kogu selle aja üksteist toetanud. Oleme end tugevaks teinud.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayRematchDefeat
en: JAY: Oh, dear. We've lost, my dear husband.
et: JAY: Oh, kallis. Me oleme kaotanud, mu kallis abikaasa.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayPostRematch
en: JAY: Fifty years of marriage… Many things have happened.
et: JAY: Viiskümmend aastat abielu... palju asju on juhtunud.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayPostRematch
en: I hope that we will continue to make happy memories together.
et: Loodan, et jätkame koos õnnelike mälestuste tegemist.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayRematchNotEnoughMons
en: JAY: Well, well, aren't you a young TRAINER?
et: JAY: Noh, kas sa pole mitte noor TRAINER?

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayRematchNotEnoughMons
en: If you'd care to battle with us, you'll have to come back with more POKéMON.
et: Kui sa viitsiksid meiega lahinguid pidada, siis pead sa rohkem POKéMON tagasi tulema.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_UncleHesTooPeppy
en: UNCLE: It's because of POKéMON that this boy's got more pep, I suppose… But he's become a bit too peppy…
et: UNCLE: Just POKéMON tõttu on sellel poisil rohkem peppi, ma oletan... aga ta on muutunud natuke liiga pepiks...

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyWantToChallengeGym
en: WALLY: Aww, UNCLE, please?
et: WALLY: Aww, UNCLE, palun?

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyWantToChallengeGym
en: I want to challenge this GYM and see how much better I've become.
et: Tahan seda SAAL vaidlustada ja vaadata, kui palju paremaks olen muutunud.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyWantToChallengeGym
en: Please? May I, please?
et: Palun? Kas ma võin, palun?

label: MauvilleCity_Text_UncleYourePushingIt
en: UNCLE: Now hold on, WALLY.
et: UNCLE: Nüüd hoidke kinni, WALLY.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_UncleYourePushingIt
en: Since you started living with POKéMON, you have grown quite a lot stronger.
et: Kuna hakkasid elama POKéMON-ga, siis oled üsna palju tugevamaks muutunud.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_UncleYourePushingIt
en: But don't you think you're pushing it to suddenly challenge a GYM?
et: Aga kas sa ei arva, et sa surud selle peale, et äkki esitada väljakutse SAAL?

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyWeCanBeatAnyone
en: WALLY: I'm not pushing it.
et: WALLY: Ma ei suru seda peale.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyWeCanBeatAnyone
en: If I combine forces with RALTS, we can beat anyone!
et: Kui ühendan jõud RALTS-ga, võime võita ükskõik keda!

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyWillYouBattleMe
en: WALLY: Oh! Hi, {PLAYER}!
et: WALLY: Oh! Tere, {PLAYER}!

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyWillYouBattleMe
en: I've gotten a lot stronger since we met.
et: Ma olen palju tugevamaks muutunud sellest ajast, kui me kohtusime.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyWillYouBattleMe
en: {PLAYER}, I want you and my UNCLE to understand that.
et: {PLAYER}, ma tahan, et sa ja minu UNCLE sellest aru saaksid.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyWillYouBattleMe
en: {PLAYER}, please, will you have a battle with me?
et: {PLAYER}, palun, kas teil on minuga lahing?

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyMyUncleWontKnowImStrong
en: WALLY: Oh… If you won't battle me, {PLAYER}, my UNCLE won't know that I've become really strong.
et: WALLY: Oh... Kui sa minuga ei võitle, {PLAYER}, siis mu UNCLE ei tea, et ma olen muutunud väga tugevaks.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_UncleCanYouBattleWally
en: UNCLE: {PLAYER}{KUN}, was it? On WALLY's behalf, can I ask you to battle with him just this once?
et: UNCLE: {PLAYER}{KUN}, kas oli? WALLY nimel, kas ma võin paluda, et sa temaga vaid selle korra võitleksid?

label: MauvilleCity_Text_UncleCanYouBattleWally
en: I don't think he's going to listen to any reason the way he is now.
et: Ma arvan, et ta ei hakka mingit põhjust kuulama nii, nagu ta praegu on.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyPleaseBattleMe
en: WALLY: {PLAYER}, please! Battle with me, please.
et: WALLY: {PLAYER}, palun! Võitle minuga, palun.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyHereICome
en: WALLY: {PLAYER}, thank you.
et: WALLY: {PLAYER}, aitäh.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyHereICome
en: Okay… Here I come!
et: Olgu, siia ma tulen!

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyDefeat
en: I lost…
et: Kaotasin...

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyIllGoBackToVerdanturf
en: WALLY: UNCLE… I'll go back to VERDANTURF…
et: WALLY: UNCLE... lähen tagasi VERDANTURF...

label: MauvilleCity_Text_ThankYouNotEnoughToBattle
en: {PLAYER}, thank you. Being a TRAINER is tough, isn't it?
et: {PLAYER}, aitäh. Olla TRAINER on karm, kas pole?

label: MauvilleCity_Text_ThankYouNotEnoughToBattle
en: It's not enough just to have POKéMON and make them battle. That isn't what being a real TRAINER is about.
et: Ei piisa ainult sellest, et oleks POKéMON ja paneks nad lahingusse. See ei ole päris TRAINER olemine.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_UncleNoNeedToBeDown
en: UNCLE: WALLY, there's no need to be so down on yourself.
et: UNCLE: WALLY, pole vaja olla nii maas iseendale.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_UncleNoNeedToBeDown
en: Why, what's keeping you from becoming stronger and stronger?
et: Miks, mis hoiab sind muutumast tugevamaks ja tugevamaks?

label: MauvilleCity_Text_UncleNoNeedToBeDown
en: Come on, let's go home. Everyone's waiting for you.
et: Tule, lähme koju. Kõik ootavad sind.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_UncleVisitUsSometime
en: UNCLE: {PLAYER}{KUN}, it just dawned on me that you must be the TRAINER who kept an eye out for WALLY when he caught his POKéMON.
et: UNCLE: {PLAYER}{KUN}, see lihtsalt koitis mulle, et sa pead olema see TRAINER kes hoidis silma peal WALLY kui ta püüdis oma POKéMON.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_UncleVisitUsSometime
en: Why don't you visit us in VERDANTURF sometime? I'm sure WALLY would enjoy it.
et: Äkki külastad meid VERDANTURF millalgi? Kindlasti WALLY naudiks seda.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyPokenavCall
en: WALLY: Oh, hello, {PLAYER}!
et: WALLY: Oh, tere, {PLAYER}!

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyPokenavCall
en: I just wanted to tell you that my uncle bought me a POKéNAV!
et: Tahtsin lihtsalt öelda, et onu ostis mulle POKéNAV!

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyPokenavCall
en: Now I can get in touch with you anytime, {PLAYER}!
et: Nüüd saan sinuga igal ajal ühendust võtta, {PLAYER}!

label: MauvilleCity_Text_RegisteredWally
en: Registered WALLY in the POKéNAV.
et: Registreerunud WALLY POKéNAV.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_ScottYouDidntHoldBack
en: SCOTT: Hehe… I was watching that match!
et: SCOTT: Hehe... ma vaatasin seda vastet!

label: MauvilleCity_Text_ScottYouDidntHoldBack
en: You're friends with that boy WALLY, aren't you?
et: Sa oled ju selle poisiga sõber WALLY?

label: MauvilleCity_Text_ScottYouDidntHoldBack
en: But you didn't hold anything back and beat him impressively.
et: Aga sa ei hoidnud midagi tagasi ja peksid teda muljetavaldavalt.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_ScottYouDidntHoldBack
en: Yeah! That's what a real POKéMON battle is all about!
et: Jah! Selles seisnebki tõeline POKéMON lahing!

label: MauvilleCity_Text_ScottYouDidntHoldBack
en: I idolize TRAINERS like that!
et: Idoliseerin TRAINERS nii!

label: MauvilleCity_Text_ScottYouDidntHoldBack
en: … … … … … … I'll be cheering for you!
et: ... ... ... ... ... ma rõõmustan sinu pärast!

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WattsonNeedFavorTakeKey
en: WATTSON: Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}! You look like you have a lot of zip! That's a good thing, wahahahaha!
et: WATTSON: Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}! Sa näed välja nagu sul oleks palju zipi! See on hea, wahahaha!

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WattsonNeedFavorTakeKey
en: Fine! I've decided! I need a favor, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
et: Hea küll! Olen otsustanud! Vajan teenet, {PLAYER}{KUN}!

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WattsonNeedFavorTakeKey
en: MAUVILLE CITY has an underground sector called NEW MAUVILLE.
et: MAUVILLE CITY on põrandaalune sektor nimega NEW MAUVILLE.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WattsonNeedFavorTakeKey
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}, I'd like you to go there and switch off the GENERATOR.
et: {PLAYER} {KUN}, ma tahaksin, et te läheksite sinna ja lülitaksite välja GENERATOR.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WattsonNeedFavorTakeKey
en: The GENERATOR has been running a bit haywire. It's getting unsafe.
et: GENERATOR on natuke heinajuhet jooksnud. See muutub ebaturvaliseks.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WattsonNeedFavorTakeKey
en: Here, this is the KEY to get into NEW MAUVILLE.
et: Siin on see KEY sisse pääsemiseks NEW MAUVILLE.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WattsonWontBeChallenge
en: WATTSON: Don't you worry about it. It won't be a challenge to you.
et: WATTSON: Ära muretse selle pärast. See ei ole sulle väljakutse.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WattsonWontBeChallenge
en: The entrance to NEW MAUVILLE is just a short SURF away from ROUTE 110.
et: Sissepääs NEW MAUVILLE on lihtsalt lühike SURF eemal ROUTE 110.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WattsonWontBeChallenge
en: That's it, then, you have my trust! Wahahahaha!
et: See on siis kõik, sul on minu usaldus! Wahahahaha!

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WattsonThanksTakeTM
en: WATTSON: Wahahahaha!
et: WATTSON: Wahahahaha!

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WattsonThanksTakeTM
en: I knew it, {PLAYER}{KUN}! I knew I'd made the right choice asking you!
et: Teadsin seda, {PLAYER}{KUN}! Teadsin, et olen teinud õige valiku, küsides sinult!

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WattsonThanksTakeTM
en: This is my thanks--a TM containing THUNDERBOLT!
et: See on minu tänu--a TM sisaldab THUNDERBOLT!

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WattsonThanksTakeTM
en: Go on, you've earned it!
et: Mine edasi, sa oled selle välja teeninud!

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WattsonYoungTakeCharge
en: WATTSON: Wahahahaha!
et: WATTSON: Wahahahaha!

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WattsonYoungTakeCharge
en: It pleases me to no end to see the young step up and take charge!
et: Meeldib, et mul ei ole lõppu näha, kuidas noor astub üles ja võtab ohjad enda kätte!

label: MauvilleCity_Text_NurseHurtMonBackToHealth
en: You know, it's cool to have POKéMON battles and stuff…
et: Tead, lahe on pidada POKéMON lahinguid ja muud...

label: MauvilleCity_Text_NurseHurtMonBackToHealth
en: But if your POKéMON gets hurt, you have to nurse it back to health.
et: Aga kui su POKéMON saab haiget, siis pead selle uuesti tervise juurde põetama.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_AllSortsOfPeopleComeThrough
en: The roads of this town stretch north and south, and east and west.
et: Selle linna teed ulatuvad põhja ja lõunasse ning itta ja läände.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_AllSortsOfPeopleComeThrough
en: Because of that, we get all sorts of people coming through.
et: Selle tõttu tuleb meil igasugu inimesi läbi.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_RydelVeryGenerous
en: Have you been to RYDEL'S CYCLES yet?
et: Kas oled juba RYDEL'S CYCLES juures käinud?

label: MauvilleCity_Text_RydelVeryGenerous
en: RYDEL, the owner, is a very generous man.
et: RYDEL, omanik, on väga helde mees.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_PokemonCanJumpYouOnBike
en: Even if you're riding a BIKE, wild POKéMON could jump you.
et: Isegi kui sõidad BIKE, võib metsik POKéMON sind hüpata.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_CitySign
en: MAUVILLE CITY “The bright and shiny city of fun!”
et: MAUVILLE CITY "Lõbus ja läikiv linn!"

label: MauvilleCity_Text_GymSign
en: MAUVILLE CITY POKéMON GYM LEADER: WATTSON “The cheerfully electrifying man!”
et: MAUVILLE CITY POKéMON SAALI JUHT: WATTSON "Rõõmsalt elektriseeriv mees!"

label: MauvilleCity_Text_BikeShopSign
en: “Ride in gravel and shake up your soul!” RYDEL'S CYCLES
et: "Sõida kruusa sisse ja raputa hinge!" RYDEL'S CYCLES

label: MauvilleCity_Text_GameCornerSign
en: “The play spot for all!” MAUVILLE GAME CORNER
et: "Mängukoht kõigile!" MAUVILLE GAME CORNER

label: MauvilleCity_Text_ExplainTV
en: Hi, do you check out TV at all?
et: Tere, kas te üldse tutvute TV?

label: MauvilleCity_Text_ExplainTV
en: They've added a bunch of cool new shows recently.
et: Nad on viimasel ajal lisanud hunniku lahedaid uusi saateid.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_ExplainTV
en: TV is so cool. I've seen my friends on TV just out of the blue.
et: TV on nii lahe. Olen näinud oma sõpru TV peal lihtsalt silmast silma.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_ExplainTV
en: And, sometimes, they even put you on TV without telling you.
et: Ja mõnikord panevad nad su isegi TV peale, sulle ütlemata.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_ExplainTV
en: I wish I would be on TV sometime.
et: Soovin, et oleksin millalgi TV peal.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_ExplainTV
en: That's why I think you should check out TVs whenever you can.
et: Sellepärast peakski vist TV-d igal võimalikul juhul üle vaatama.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_BeenCheckingOutTV
en: Hi, have you been checking out TVs?
et: Tere, kas olete tutvunud TV-dega?

label: PlayersHouse_2F_Text_ClockIsStopped
en: The clock is stopped…
et: Kell peatatakse...

label: PlayersHouse_2F_Text_ClockIsStopped
en: Better set it and start it!
et: Pange parem paika ja alustage!

label: PlayersHouse_2F_Text_HowDoYouLikeYourRoom
en: MOM: {PLAYER}, how do you like your new room?
et: MOM: {PLAYER}, kuidas teile meeldib teie uus tuba?

label: PlayersHouse_2F_Text_HowDoYouLikeYourRoom
en: Good! Everything's put away neatly!
et: Tubli! Kõik on kenasti ära pandud!

label: PlayersHouse_2F_Text_HowDoYouLikeYourRoom
en: They finished moving everything in downstairs, too.
et: Nad lõpetasid ka allkorrusel kõige kolimise.

label: PlayersHouse_2F_Text_HowDoYouLikeYourRoom
en: POKéMON movers are so convenient!
et: POKéMON liikurid on nii mugavad!

label: PlayersHouse_2F_Text_HowDoYouLikeYourRoom
en: Oh, you should make sure that everything's all there on your desk.
et: Oh, sa peaksid jälgima, et kõik oleks sinu laual olemas.

label: PlayersHouse_2F_Text_Notebook
en: {PLAYER} flipped open the notebook.
et: {PLAYER} keeras märkmiku lahti.

label: PlayersHouse_2F_Text_Notebook
en: ADVENTURE RULE NO. 1 Open the MENU with START.
et: ADVENTURE RULE NO. 1 Avage MENU koos START.

label: PlayersHouse_2F_Text_Notebook
en: ADVENTURE RULE NO. 2 Record your progress with SAVE.
et: ADVENTURE RULE NO. 2 Salvestage oma edusammud SAVE-ga.

label: PlayersHouse_2F_Text_Notebook
en: The remaining pages are blank…
et: Ülejäänud lehed on tühjad...

label: Common_Text_LookCloserAtMap
en: {PLAYER} took a closer look at the HOENN region map.
et: {PLAYER} uuris lähemalt HOENN piirkonna kaarti.

label: PlayersHouse_2F_Text_ItsAGameCube
en: It's a Nintendo GameCube.
et: See on Nintendo GameCube.

label: PlayersHouse_2F_Text_ItsAGameCube
en: A Game Boy Advance is connected to serve as the Controller.
et: A Game Boy Advance on ühendatud, et olla Kontroller.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_WelcomeToBattlePyramid
en: Where the courage of TRAINERS is put to the test!
et: Kus pannakse proovile TRAINERS julgus!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_WelcomeToBattlePyramid
en: Welcome to the BATTLE PYRAMID!
et: Tere tulemast BATTLE PYRAMID!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_WelcomeToBattlePyramid
en: I am your guide to the Battle Quest.
et: Ma olen sinu teejuht Battle Questile.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_EmbarkOnChallenge
en: Have you the courage to embark on the Battle Quest challenge?
et: Kas teil on julgust asuda Battle Questi väljakutsele?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_AwaitFutureChallenge
en: We await your challenge in the future!
et: Ootame teie väljakutset ka tulevikus!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainBattlePyramid
en: The Battle Quest is a battling event in which you must explore the PYRAMID and try to reach the top.
et: Battle Quest on võitlusüritus, kus tuleb uurida PYRAMID ja püüda jõuda tippu.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainBattlePyramid
en: In the PYRAMID are seven floors of mazes, all of them filled with not only skilled TRAINERS but also wild POKéMON.
et: PYRAMID on seitse korrust maze, kõik need on täidetud mitte ainult vilunud TRAINERS vaid ka metsik POKéMON.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainBattlePyramid
en: You must enter with three POKéMON, none of them holding an item.
et: Sa pead sisenema kolme POKéMON, ükski neist ei hoia eset.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainBattlePyramid
en: On your ascent, you will be provided with a BATTLE BAG for items.
et: Teie tõusul on teile ette nähtud BATTLE BAG esemete jaoks.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainBattlePyramid
en: If you fail in your challenge, any item placed in the BATTLE BAG disappears.
et: Kui te ebaõnnestute oma väljakutses, kaob iga objekt, mis on paigutatud BATTLE BAG.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainBattlePyramid
en: If you want to interrupt your challenge, you must select “REST” and save the game.
et: Kui soovite oma väljakutse katkestada, peate valima "REST" ja salvestama mängu.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainBattlePyramid
en: If you don't save before interrupting, you will be disqualified.
et: Kui enne katkestamist ei salvesta, siis diskvalifitseeritakse.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_WhichLevelMode
en: The PYRAMID offers two courses, Level 50 and Open Level. Which will you enter?
et: PYRAMID pakub kahte kursust, taset 50 ja avatud taset. Millisesse te sisenete?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_SelectThreeMons
en: Very good. Now, please select the three POKéMON you wish to accompany you.
et: Väga hea. Nüüd palun valige kolm POKéMON, mida soovite endaga kaasas kanda.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen
en: A slight problem, adventurer!
et: Kerge probleem, seikleja!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen
en: You seem to not have the three POKéMON qualified for the challenge.
et: Tundub, et teil ei ole kolme POKéMON kvalifitseeritud väljakutse.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen
en: Please also remember to take all items from your POKéMON.
et: Palun pidage meeles võtta kõik esemed oma POKéMON.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen
en: EGGS{STR_VAR_1} ineligible.
et: EGGS{STR_VAR_1} kõlbmatu.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen
en: When you are ready, please have a word with me.
et: Kui oled valmis, siis palun võta minuga sõna.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
en: A slight problem, adventurer!
et: Kerge probleem, seikleja!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
en: You seem to not have the three POKéMON qualified for the challenge.
et: Tundub, et teil ei ole kolme POKéMON kvalifitseeritud väljakutse.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
en: The three POKéMON must be different and each no higher than Level 50.
et: Kolm POKéMON peavad olema erinevad ja kumbki mitte kõrgemad kui tase 50.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
en: Please also remember to take all items from your POKéMON.
et: Palun pidage meeles võtta kõik esemed oma POKéMON.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
en: EGGS{STR_VAR_1} ineligible.
et: EGGS{STR_VAR_1} kõlbmatu.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
en: When you are ready, please have a word with me.
et: Kui oled valmis, siis palun võta minuga sõna.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_OkayToSaveBeforeChallenge
en: Before you enter the BATTLE PYRAMID, the game must be saved. Is that okay?
et: Enne BATTLE PYRAMID sisenemist tuleb mäng salvestada. Kas sellega on kõik korras?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ShowYouIntoPyramid
en: Very good. I will now show you into the BATTLE PYRAMID.
et: Väga hea. Näitan teile nüüd BATTLE PYRAMID.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_WeWillHoldBagForSafekeeping
en: We will hold your BAG for safekeeping, {PLAYER}, while you are exploring.
et: Me hoiame teie BAG hoiustamiseks, {PLAYER}, samal ajal kui te uurite.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_PleaseTakePreviousBattleBag
en: In exchange, please take this BATTLE BAG, the one you used previously.
et: Vastutasuks võtke palun see BATTLE BAG, see, mida te varem kasutasite.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_PleaseTakeThisBattleBag
en: In exchange, please take this BATTLE BAG.
et: Vastutasuks võtke palun see BATTLE BAG.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExchangedBagForBattleBag
en: {PLAYER} exchanged the BAG for the BATTLE BAG.
et: {PLAYER} vahetas BAG BATTLE BAG vastu.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_StepOnFloorPanel
en: When you step on this floor panel, you will be transported to a higher floor in the PYRAMID.
et: Kui astud sellele põrandapaneelile, transporditakse sind kõrgemale korrusele PYRAMID.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_StepOnFloorPanel
en: I hope for your sake that your quest goes safely!
et: Loodan teie pärast, et teie püüdlus läheb turvaliselt!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_DidntSaveBeforeQuittingTakeBag
en: A major problem, explorer!
et: Suur probleem, maadeavastaja!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_DidntSaveBeforeQuittingTakeBag
en: You did not save before ending your challenge the last time.
et: Sa ei säästnud enne väljakutse lõpetamist viimast korda.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_DidntSaveBeforeQuittingTakeBag
en: Consequently, your challenge has been disqualified, I'm sorry to say.
et: Järelikult on teie väljakutse diskvalifitseeritud, vabandan öelda.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_DidntSaveBeforeQuittingTakeBag
en: Here is the BAG we've been holding for you.
et: Siin on see BAG, mida me oleme sinu jaoks hoidnud.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_DidntSaveBeforeQuittingTakeBag
en: {PLAYER} got the BAG back.
et: {PLAYER} sai BAG tagasi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_YouveConqueredPyramid
en: Excellent to see you back!
et: Suurepärane, et sind tagasi näha!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_YouveConqueredPyramid
en: You've conquered the PYRAMID! How splendid!
et: Sa oled vallutanud PYRAMID! Kui suurepärane!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_MonHoldingItemCannotTake
en: Ah, a slight problem.
et: Ah, kerge probleem.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_MonHoldingItemCannotTake
en: At least one POKéMON is holding an item.
et: Vähemalt üks POKéMON hoiab eset.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_MonHoldingItemCannotTake
en: I'm sorry to say, items obtained in the PYRAMID cannot be taken away.
et: Vabandust öelda, et PYRAMID-s saadud esemeid ei saa ära võtta.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HeldItemsMovedToBag
en: All items held by your POKéMON will be moved to your BATTLE BAG, {PLAYER}.
et: Kõik teie POKéMON valduses olevad esemed viiakse teie BATTLE BAG, {PLAYER}.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_BagCannotHoldPickItemsToKeep
en: The BATTLE BAG cannot hold all your items, I'm sorry to say.
et: BATTLE BAG ei saa hoida kõiki oma esemeid, vabandan öelda.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_BagCannotHoldPickItemsToKeep
en: Please pick the items you'll keep in the BATTLE BAG, and with your POKéMON.
et: Palun valige esemed, mida te hoiate BATTLE BAG ja oma POKéMON-ga.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_LeastOneMonHoldingItem
en: At least one POKéMON is still holding an item.
et: Vähemalt üks POKéMON hoiab ikka eset.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_PickItemsToKeep
en: Please pick the items you'll keep in the BATTLE BAG, and with your POKéMON.
et: Palun valige esemed, mida te hoiate BATTLE BAG ja oma POKéMON-ga.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ReturnedEverythingMonsHeld
en: {PLAYER} returned everything that the POKéMON held.
et: {PLAYER} tagastas kõik, mida POKéMON hoidis.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_UsedBattleBagWillBeKept
en: The BATTLE BAG you used will be kept in readiness for your next challenge.
et: Teie kasutatud BATTLE BAG hoitakse valmisolekus teie järgmiseks väljakutseks.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_UsedBattleBagWillBeKept
en: {PLAYER} turned the BATTLE BAG over for the BAG's return.
et: {PLAYER} keeras BATTLE BAG  tagasitulekuks üle.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_RecordResultsWait
en: I must record your results. Please wait.
et: Ma pean teie tulemused kirja panema. Palun oodake.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ForConqueringPyramidTakeThis
en: As a memento for conquering the BATTLE PYRAMID, please take this.
et: Meenutuseks BATTLE PYRAMID vallutamiseks võtke palun see.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ReceivedPrizeItem
en: {PLAYER} received the prize {STR_VAR_1}.
et: {PLAYER} sai auhinna {STR_VAR_1}.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_BagIsFull
en: …Ah… Your BAG appears to be filled.
et: ...Ah... Sinu BAG tundub olevat täidetud.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_BagIsFull
en: Please return after you've organized your BAG's contents.
et: Palun naasege pärast seda, kui olete oma BAG sisu organiseerinud.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_DisappointingHereIsBag
en: How disappointing for you…
et: Kui pettumust valmistavad teile...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_DisappointingHereIsBag
en: Here is the BAG we've been holding for you.
et: Siin on see BAG, mida me oleme sinu jaoks hoidnud.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_DisappointingHereIsBag
en: {PLAYER} got the BAG back.
et: {PLAYER} sai BAG tagasi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_LookForwardToNextChallenge
en: We look forward to your next challenge!
et: Ootame teie järgmist väljakutset!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HereIsPrize
en: We have been looking forward to your arrival!
et: Oleme oodanud teie saabumist!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HereIsPrize
en: Here is your prize for conquering the PYRAMID.
et: Siin on teie auhind PYRAMID vallutamise eest.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_TellYouWhatMisfortunesAwait
en: Welcome…
et: Tere tulemast...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_TellYouWhatMisfortunesAwait
en: I shall be pleased to tell you what misfortunes await in the PYRAMID…
et: Mul on hea meel teile öelda, millised õnnetused ootavad ees PYRAMID...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintParalysis
en: I see a shower of sparks…
et: Näen sädemete dušši...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintParalysis
en: …And in it, I see your POKéMON struggling with paralysis…
et: ...ja selles näen ma su POKéMON hädas halvatusega...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintPoison
en: I see poison…
et: Ma näen mürki...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintPoison
en: …And, I see your POKéMON suffering from the effects of poison…
et: ...Ja, ma näen, et su POKéMON kannatab mürgi mõju all...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintBurn
en: I see bright red flames…
et: Näen erepunaseid leeke...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintBurn
en: …And, I see your POKéMON suffering from burns…
et: ...ja, ma näen su POKéMON kannatab põletuste käes...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintPPWaste
en: I sense the tremendous pressure of unrequited anger…
et: Tajun nõutu viha tohutut survet...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintPPWaste
en: It is a curse…
et: See on needus...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintPPWaste
en: …And, I see your POKéMON drained of Power Points and having no recourse but to use STRUGGLE…
et: ...Ja, ma näen teie POKéMON kuivendatud Power Points ja millel ei ole muud võimalust kui kasutada STRUGGLE...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintLevitate
en: I see POKéMON loftily airborne…
et: Näen POKéMON ülevalt õhu kaudu...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintLevitate
en: …And, I see your POKéMON frustrated by powerless GROUND-type moves…
et: ...Ja, ma näen su POKéMON pettunud jõuetu Maa-tüüpi võtted...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintTrapAbility
en: I sense terrific energy rising from the ground below…
et: Ma tajun allolevast maast tõusvat hirmuäratavat energiat...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintTrapAbility
en: …And, I see your POKéMON unable to escape the power's clutches…
et: ...ja, ma näen, et su POKéMON ei suuda võimu siduritest pääseda...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintIce
en: I see ICE-type POKéMON…
et: Näen Jää-tüüpi POKéMON...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintIce
en: …And, I see your POKéMON fighting the freezing effects of ice…
et: ...ja, ma näen su POKéMON võitlemas jää külmumise mõjudega...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintExplosion
en: I see a flurry of moves that imperil the user…
et: Näen hoogsat võtteid, mis häirivad kasutajat...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintExplosion
en: …And, I see your POKéMON falling to them…
et: ...ja, ma näen, et su POKéMON langeb neile...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintPsychic
en: I see PSYCHIC-type POKéMON…
et: Näen Vaimne-tüüpi POKéMON...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintPsychic
en: …And, I see your POKéMON in torment from PSYCHIC moves…
et: ...Ja, ma näen su POKéMON piinades alates PSYCHIC liigub...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintRock
en: I see ROCK-type POKéMON…
et: Näen Kivi-tüüpi POKéMON...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintRock
en: …And, I see your POKéMON suffering from ROCK moves…
et: ...Ja, ma näen, et sinu POKéMON kannatab ROCK liigub...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintFighting
en: I see FIGHTING-type POKéMON…
et: Näen Kaklus-tüüpi POKéMON...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintFighting
en: …And, I see your POKéMON pummeled by FIGHTING moves…
et: ...Ja, ma näen su POKéMON kummutatud FIGHTING võtted...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintWeather
en: RAIN DANCE… SUNNY DAY… SANDSTORM… HAIL…
et: RAIN DANCE... SUNNY DAY... SANDSTORM... HAIL...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintWeather
en: I see POKéMON that become stronger with the weather…
et: Näen POKéMON mis muutuvad ilmaga tugevamaks...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintWeather
en: …And, I see your POKéMON confounded by different types of moves…
et: ...Ja, ma näen, et teie POKéMON on segadusse ajanud erinevat tüüpi käigud...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintBug
en: I see BUG-type POKéMON…
et: Näen Putuk-tüüpi POKéMON...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintBug
en: …And, I see your POKéMON suffering from different kinds of attacks…
et: ...Ja, ma näen teie POKéMON kannatavad erinevat tüüpi rünnakute...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintDark
en: I see DARK-type POKéMON…
et: Näen Pime-tüüpi POKéMON...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintDark
en: …And, I see your POKéMON suffering from DARK-type moves…
et: ...Ja, ma näen, et sinu POKéMON kannatab Pime-tüüpi võtteid...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintWater
en: I see WATER-type POKéMON…
et: Näen Vee-tüüpi POKéMON...

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintWater

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_TrainersNoticeRunning

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_YouveDefeatedPyramidKing
en: Welcome back! You've done the unthinkable!
et: Tere tulemast tagasi! Sa oled teinud mõeldamatut!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_YouveDefeatedPyramidKing
en: You've defeated the PYRAMID KING and conquered the BATTLE PYRAMID!
et: Sa oled alistanud PYRAMID KING ja vallutanud BATTLE PYRAMID!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_GiveYouTheseBattlePoints
en: Young explorer! In commendation of your courage, we give you these Battle Point(s)!
et: Noor maadeuurija! Kiites teie julgust, anname teile need Battle Point (d)!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_RulesAreListed

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ReadWhichHeading
en: Which heading do you want to read?
et: Kumba poolt sa tahad lugeda?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainMonRules
en: When the PYRAMID is conquered, the wild POKéMON that appear in it are replaced by different kinds.
et: Kui PYRAMID vallutatakse, asendatakse selles ilmnev metsik POKéMON eri liiki.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainMonRules
en: Explore, observe, and learn what kinds of wild POKéMON you may encounter.
et: Uurige, jälgige ja õppige, milliseid metsikuid POKéMON võite kokku puutuda.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainTrainerRules
en: TRAINERS are lying in wait for you inside the PYRAMID.
et: TRAINERS lamavad oodates sind sees PYRAMID.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainTrainerRules
en: On each floor, there are up to eight TRAINERS.
et: Igal korrusel on kuni kaheksa TRAINERS.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainTrainerRules
en: When you defeat a TRAINER, you will get a helpful hint for your adventure.
et: Kui võidad TRAINER, saad abistava vihje oma seiklusele.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainMazeRules
en: The mazes in the PYRAMID rearrange themselves every time you enter it.
et: Mazid PYRAMID reorganiseerivad end iga kord, kui sinna sisened.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainMazeRules
en: The mazes are poorly lit. You must advance with caution.
et: Mazid on halvasti valgustatud. Sa pead ettevaatlikult edasi liikuma.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainMazeRules
en: The light grows brighter whenever you defeat a wild POKéMON or a TRAINER.
et: Valgus kasvab heledamaks alati, kui võidad metsiku POKéMON või TRAINER.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainBagRules
en: The BATTLE BAG serves as your BAG while in the PYRAMID.
et: BATTLE BAG toimib teie BAG ajal PYRAMID.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainBagRules
en: There are two separate BATTLE BAGS-one each for the Level 50 and Open Level adventures.
et: Level 50 ja Open Level seikluste jaoks on kaks eraldi BATTLE BAGS-üks.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainBagRules
en: They each can hold up to 99 pieces of ten kinds of items.
et: Need igaüks mahutavad kuni 99 tükki kümmet sorti esemeid.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainBagRules
en: The contents of the BATTLE BAG are lost if you fail in your quest.
et: BATTLE BAG sisu on kadunud, kui te ebaõnnestute oma otsingutes.

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_JoshuaIntro
en: The TRICK MASTER always vanishes like smoke. How does he do it?
et: TRICK MASTER haihtub alati nagu suits. Kuidas ta seda teeb?

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_JoshuaDefeat
en: Aiyeeeh! You're much too strong! How do you do it?
et: Aiyeeeh! Sa oled liiga tugev! Kuidas seda teha?

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_JoshuaPostBattle
en: I wish I could appear and disappear as if I were smoke, too.
et: Soovin, et saaksin ilmuda ja kaduda nagu oleksin ka suitsuks.

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_PatriciaIntro
en: Going around the same spot… It begets ill fortune…
et: Läheb sama koha peal ringi... see ennustab halba varandust...

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_PatriciaDefeat
en: Defeated! It's a bad sign…
et: Võidetud! See on halb märk...

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_PatriciaPostBattle
en: I've circled the same spot over ten times now… It's ill fortune…
et: Ma tiirutasin nüüd üle kümne korra sama koha ümber... see on halb varandus...

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_AlexisIntro
en: Whoever wins will get through here first. That's the feeling I get.
et: Kes võidab, saab siit enne läbi. Selline tunne tekib mul.

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_AlexisDefeat
en: Oh! Well, go ahead, then!
et: Oh! No laske käia siis!

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_AlexisPostBattle
en: You're solving all the puzzles in the TRICK HOUSE. That's the feeling I get.
et: Sa lahendad kõik mõistatused TRICK HOUSE. Selline tunne tekib mul.

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_MarielaIntro
en: Nufufufu, here at last! Let's get right with it!
et: Nufufufu, siin lõpuks ometi! Asume asja kallale!

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_MarielaDefeat
en: You're so casual about winning!
et: Sa oled nii juhuslik, et võidad!

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_MarielaPostBattle
en: Humph! I'm not upset! Not me!
et: Humph! Ma ei ole pahane! Mitte mina!

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_AlvaroIntro
en: I ever so closely watched you coming!
et: Ma olen sind kunagi nii tähelepanelikult jälginud!

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_AlvaroDefeat
en: This outcome I didn't see coming…
et: Seda tulemust ma ei näinud tulemas...

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_AlvaroPostBattle
en: Well, anyway, we both picked a weird place to get acquainted.
et: No igatahes valisime mõlemad veidra koha, kus tutvuda.

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_AlvaroPostBattle
en: As one weirdo to another, let's do our best!
et: Ühe veidrikuna teisele anname endast parima!

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_EverettIntro
en: It's awfully cramped in here…
et: Siin on kohutavalt kitsas...

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_EverettDefeat
en: Oh, yes, strong you are.
et: Oh jah, tugev sa oled.

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_EverettPostBattle
en: I was hoping to switch places with you when I beat you, but…
et: Lootsin sinuga kohti vahetada, kui sind pekstan, aga...

label: DewfordTown_House2_Text_WantYouToHaveSilkScarf

et: Kurna silmi selle peale!

label: DewfordTown_House2_Text_WantYouToHaveSilkScarf
en: It's a SILK SCARF. It's right at the cutting edge of fashion, yeah!
et: See on SILK SCARF. See on kohe moe tipptasemel, jah!

label: DewfordTown_House2_Text_WantYouToHaveSilkScarf
en: Oh, I can see your eyes twinkling! You appreciate my dazzling style!
et: Oh, ma näen, kuidas su silmad vilksatavad! Sa hindad mu pimestavat stiili!

label: DewfordTown_House2_Text_WantYouToHaveSilkScarf

et: Oh, sa oled rõõmustav! Siin sa käid. Ma tahan, et sul oleks see olemas!

label: DewfordTown_House2_Text_NoRoom
en: Oh, you don't have room?
et: Oh, sul pole ruumi?

label: DewfordTown_House2_Text_NoRoom
en: Now, listen tight, this SCARF is a musthave! Why, I would sell all my items in order to get it!
et: Kuula nüüd kõvasti, see SCARF on musthave! Miks, müüksin kõik oma esemed maha, et see kätte saada!

label: DewfordTown_House2_Text_ExplainSilkScarf

label: DewfordTown_House2_Text_ExplainSilkScarf

label: DewfordTown_House2_Text_BrawlySoCool

et: Wow, sa vaevusid üle mere minema, et külastada DEWFORD?

label: DewfordTown_House2_Text_BrawlySoCool

et: Kas sa äkki tulid siia, sest kuulsid BRAWLY kohta?

label: DewfordTown_House2_Text_BrawlySoCool

et: Ta on nii lahe, et kõik iidolistavad teda.

et: Seal on nii palju erinevaid TM käike.

et: Aga ega meil suurt edu pole olnud...

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DevelopingNewBalls
en: I'm developing new kinds of POKé BALLS…
et: Arendan uut tüüpi POKé BALLS...

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DevelopingNewBalls
en: But I haven't made much headway…
et: Aga ma pole eriti peateed teinud...

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WeFinallyMadeNewBalls
en: We finally made new kinds of POKé BALLS!
et: Tegime lõpuks uutmoodi POKé BALLS!

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WeFinallyMadeNewBalls
en: The REPEAT BALL makes it easier to catch POKéMON you've caught before.
et: REPEAT BALL muudab varem tabatud POKéMON püüdmise lihtsamaks.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WeFinallyMadeNewBalls
en: The TIMER BALL gets better at catching POKéMON the longer a battle runs.
et: TIMER BALL läheb paremini püüdmisel POKéMON mida kauem lahing jookseb.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WeFinallyMadeNewBalls
en: Both are proudly developed by the DEVON CORPORATION.
et: Mõlemad on uhkelt välja töötatud DEVON CORPORATION.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WeFinallyMadeNewBalls
en: Please give them a try!
et: Palun andke neile proovida!

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_IMadePokenav
en: I made the POKéNAV!
et: Tegin POKéNAV!

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_IMadePokenav
en: As an engineer, I feel blessed to have made something so great!
et: Insenerina tunnen, et olen õnnistatud, et olen midagi nii suurt teinud!

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WowThatsAPokenav
en: Oh, wow! That's a POKéNAV!
et: Oh, vau! See on POKéNAV!

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WowThatsAPokenav
en: It came about as a result of our PRESIDENT's desire to learn about the feelings of POKéMON.
et: See tekkis tänu meie PRESIDENT soovile õppida tundma POKéMON tundeid.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WowThatsAPokenav
en: Would you like me to describe its features in detail?
et: Kas sa tahaksid, et ma kirjeldaksin selle omadusi üksikasjalikult?

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WowThatsAPokenav
en: No, no. I think you'll find out just by trying the POKéNAV out.
et: Ei, ei. Ma arvan, et sa saad teada lihtsalt proovides POKéNAV välja.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DeviceToVisualizePokemonDreams
en: I'm trying to develop a device that visually reproduces the dreams of POKéMON…
et: Üritan välja töötada seadme, mis visuaalselt taasesitab unenägusid POKéMON...

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DeviceToVisualizePokemonDreams
en: But it's not going well.
et: Aga hästi ei lähe.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DevelopDeviceToResurrectFossils
en: I've been trying to develop a device that resurrects POKéMON from fossils…
et: Olen üritanud välja töötada seadet, mis äratab üles POKéMON fossiilidest...

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DevelopDeviceToResurrectFossils
en: And, it's working!
et: Ja, see töötab!

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WantToBringFossilBackToLife
en: Wait! That thing you have there… Is that a POKéMON fossil?
et: Oota! See asi, mis sul seal on, on see POKéMON fossiil?

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WantToBringFossilBackToLife
en: Would you like to bring that POKéMON back to life?
et: Kas sa tahaksid selle POKéMON ellu äratada?

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WantToBringFossilBackToLife
en: I can with my newly developed FOSSIL REGENERATOR.
et: Saan oma äsja väljatöötatud FOSSIL REGENERATOR-ga.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_OhIsThatSo
en: Oh, is that so?
et: Kas see on nii?

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_OhIsThatSo
en: DEVON's technological expertise is outstanding, I tell you.
et: DEVON tehnoloogiline asjatundlikkus on silmapaistev, ma ütlen teile.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_TwoFossilsPickOne
en: Oh, now that's a surprise! You have not one, but two, fossils?
et: Oi, nüüd on see üllatus! Sul ei ole mitte üks, vaid kaks, kivistised?

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_TwoFossilsPickOne
en: Unfortunately, my machine can only regenerate one POKéMON at a time.
et: Kahjuks suudab minu masin taastada ainult ühe POKéMON korraga.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_TwoFossilsPickOne
en: Would you like to pick one of your fossils for regeneration?
et: Kas soovite valida ühe oma kivistise uuendamiseks?

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_HandedFossilToResearcher
en: Excellent! Let's do this right away.
et: Suurepärane! Teeme seda kohe.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_HandedFossilToResearcher
en: {PLAYER} handed the {STR_VAR_1} to the DEVON RESEARCHER.
et: {PLAYER} ulatas {STR_VAR_1} DEVON RESEARCHER-le.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_FossilRegeneratorTakesTime
en: The FOSSIL REGENERATOR, which I made, is incredible.
et: FOSSIL REGENERATOR, mille ma tegin, on uskumatu.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_FossilRegeneratorTakesTime
en: But it has one drawback--it takes a long time to work.
et: Aga sellel on üks puudus-töö võtab kaua aega.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_FossilRegeneratorTakesTime
en: So, uh… How about you go for a stroll and look around for a while?
et: Kuidas oleks, kui läheksid jalutama ja vaataksid mõnda aega ringi?

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_FossilizedMonBroughtBackToLife
en: Thanks for waiting!
et: Tänud ootamise eest!

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_FossilizedMonBroughtBackToLife
en: Your fossilized POKéMON has been brought back to life!
et: Sinu kivistunud POKéMON on ellu äratatud!

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_FossilizedMonBroughtBackToLife
en: The fossil was an ancient POKéMON. {STR_VAR_2}, it was!
et: Fossiil oli iidne POKéMON. {STR_VAR_2}, see oli!

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_ReceivedMonFromResearcher
en: {PLAYER} received {STR_VAR_2} from the DEVON RESEARCHER.
et: {PLAYER} sai {STR_VAR_2} DEVON RESEARCHER pealt.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_TooManyPokemon
en: Uh-oh, you've got too many POKéMON. You have no room for this one.
et: Uh-oh, sul on liiga palju POKéMON. Sul ei ole sellele ruumi.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DevelopNewPokenavFeature
en: I'm trying to develop a new feature for the POKéNAV…
et: Üritan välja töötada uue funktsiooni POKéNAV...

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DevelopNewPokenavFeature
en: But it's not going well.
et: Aga hästi ei lähe.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WhatToWorkOnNext
en: Well, now what shall I work on developing next?
et: No mis ma nüüd edasi arendamisega tegelen?

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WhatToWorkOnNext
en: Our company allows us to make our inspirations into reality.
et: Meie ettevõte võimaldab meil teha oma inspiratsioonid reaalsuseks.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WhatToWorkOnNext
en: One couldn't ask for a better environment as an engineer.
et: Insenerina ei saanud paremat keskkonda küsida.

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_MayWhoAreYou
en: Huh? Who… Who are you?
et: Huh? Kes sa oled?

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_MayWhoAreYou
en: Oh, you're {PLAYER}{KUN}. So your move was today.
et: Oh, sa oled {PLAYER}{KUN}. Nii et teie käik oli täna.

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_MayWhoAreYou
en: Um… I'm MAY. Glad to meet you!
et: Ma olen MAY. Rõõm kohtuda!

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_MayWhoAreYou
en: I… I have this dream of becoming friends with POKéMON all over the world.
et: Mul on unistus saada sõbraks POKéMON kogu maailmas.

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_MayWhoAreYou
en: I… I heard about you, {PLAYER}{KUN}, from my dad, PROF. BIRCH.
et: Ma... kuulsin sinust, {PLAYER}{KUN}, oma isalt, PROF. BIRCH.

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_MayWhoAreYou
en: I was hoping that you would be nice, {PLAYER}{KUN}, and that we could be friends.
et: Ma lootsin, et sa oled kena, {PLAYER}{KUN} ja et me võiksime olla sõbrad.

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_MayWhoAreYou
en: Oh, this is silly, isn't it? I… I've just met you, {PLAYER}{KUN}.
et: See on rumal, kas pole? Ma olen sinuga just kohtunud, {PLAYER}{KUN}.

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_MayWhoAreYou
en: Eheheh…
et: Eheheh...

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_MayWhoAreYou
en: Oh, no! I forgot!
et: Oh ei! Unustasin!

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_MayWhoAreYou
en: I was supposed to go help Dad catch some wild POKéMON!
et: Ma pidin minema, et aidata isal püüda mingit metsikut POKéMON!

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_MayWhoAreYou
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}, I'll catch you later!
et: {PLAYER} {KUN}, ma taban sind hiljem!

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_MayGettingReady
en: POKéMON fully restored! Items ready, and…
et: POKéMON täielikult taastatud! Esemed valmis ja...

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_BrendanWhoAreYou
en: Hey! You…
et: Hei! Sa...

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_BrendanWhoAreYou
en: Who are you?
et: Kes Sa oled?

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_BrendanWhoAreYou
en: Oh, you're {PLAYER}, aren't you? Moved in next door, right?
et: Oh, sa oled ju {PLAYER}? Kolinud kõrvalmajas, eks?

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_BrendanWhoAreYou
en: I didn't know that you're a girl.
et: Ma ei teadnud, et sa oled tüdruk.

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_BrendanWhoAreYou
en: Dad, PROF. BIRCH, said that our new next-door neighbor is a GYM LEADER's kid, so I assumed you'd be a guy.
et: Isa, PROF. BIRCH, ütles, et meie uus lähinaaber on SAALI JUHT laps, seega eeldasin, et sinust saab mees.

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_BrendanWhoAreYou
en: My name's BRENDAN. So, hi, neighbor!
et: Minu nimi on BRENDAN. Nii et tere, naabrimees!

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_BrendanWhoAreYou
en: Huh? Hey, {PLAYER}, don't you have a POKéMON?
et: Huh? Hei, {PLAYER}, kas sul ei ole POKéMON?

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_BrendanWhoAreYou
en: Do you want me to go catch you one?
et: Kas sa tahad, et ma läheksin sind püüdma?

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_BrendanWhoAreYou
en: Aw, darn, I forgot…
et: Aw, Darn, ma unustasin...

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_BrendanWhoAreYou
en: I'm supposed to go help my dad catch some wild POKéMON.
et: Ma peaksin minema, et aidata mu isal püüda mingit metsikut POKéMON.

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_BrendanWhoAreYou
en: Some other time, okay?
et: Mõni teine kord, eks?

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_BrendanGettingReady
en: POKéMON fully restored… Items all packed, and…
et: POKéMON täielikult taastatud... Esemed kõik pakitud, ja...

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_ItsRivalsPokeBall
en: It's {RIVAL}'s POKé BALL!
et: See on {RIVAL} POKé BALL!

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_ItsRivalsPokeBall
en: Better leave it right where it is.
et: Parem jätke see sinna, kus see on.

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_MayJustCheckingMyPokedex
en: MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}!
et: MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}!

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_MayJustCheckingMyPokedex
en: I was just checking my POKéDEX.
et: Ma just kontrollisin oma POKéDEX.

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_MayJustCheckingMyPokedex
en: There's still a lot of POKéMON that I've seen but haven't caught.
et: Seal on ikka väga palju POKéMON mida olen näinud aga pole vahele jäänud.

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_MayJustCheckingMyPokedex
en: And there are many others that I think will evolve.
et: Ja on ka palju teisi, mis minu arvates arenevad.

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_MayJustCheckingMyPokedex
en: I wonder where I should go catch some POKéMON next?
et: Huvitav, kuhu ma peaksin järgmisena mingi POKéMON püüdma minema?

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_MayWhereShouldIGoNext
en: MAY: I wonder where I should go catch some POKéMON next?
et: MAY: Huvitav, kuhu ma peaksin järgmisena mingi POKéMON püüdma minema?

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_MayWhereShouldIGoNext
en: Wouldn't it be funny if we ran into each other, {PLAYER}{KUN}?
et: Kas poleks naljakas, kui me omavahel kokku jookseksime, {PLAYER}{KUN}?

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_BrendanJustCheckingMyPokedex
en: BRENDAN: Hey, it's {PLAYER}.
et: BRENDAN: Hei, see on {PLAYER}.

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_BrendanJustCheckingMyPokedex
en: I was just checking out my POKéDEX.
et: Vaatasin just oma POKéDEX üle.

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_BrendanJustCheckingMyPokedex
en: There are still many POKéMON that I need to catch, I know, but this is looking pretty good.
et: On ikka palju POKéMON mida pean püüdma, tean, aga see näeb päris hea välja.

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_BrendanJustCheckingMyPokedex
en: Checking this POKéDEX out gives me the urge to hit the road again.
et: Selle POKéDEX välja kontrollimine annab mulle tungi uuesti teele vastu sõita.

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_BrendanWhereShouldIGoNext
en: BRENDAN: I'm having a hard time deciding where I should catch POKéMON next.
et: BRENDAN: Mul on raske otsustada, kus ma peaksin järgmisena püüdma POKéMON.

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_BrendanWhereShouldIGoNext
en: Hey, {PLAYER}, if I see you while I'm out catching POKéMON, I can pitch you a battle if you'd like.
et: Hei, {PLAYER}, kui ma näen sind, kui ma olen väljas POKéMON püüdmas, võin ma sulle lahingu välja pigistada, kui sa tahaksid.

label: BerryBlender_Text_WantToMakePokeblocks
en: Oh? Did you want to make some {POKEBLOCK}S with this old-timer?
et: Oh? Kas sa tahtsid selle vanavaraga mingi {POKEBLOCK}S teha?

label: BerryBlender_Text_Excellent
en: Excellent!
et: Suurepärane!

label: BerryBlender_Text_MadeOldTimerSad
en: Oh… You've made this old-timer sad…
et: Sa oled selle vanaaja kurvaks teinud...

label: BerryBlender_Text_KnowHowToMakePokeblocks
en: Do you know how to make a {POKEBLOCK}?
et: Kas te oskate teha {POKEBLOCK}?

label: BerryBlender_Text_LetsBerryBlender
en: Let's get started, then!
et: Alustame siis!

label: BerryBlender_Text_LetsBerryBlender
en: Let's BERRY BLENDER!
et: Teeme BERRY BLENDER!

label: BerryBlender_Text_ExplainBerryBlending
en: Okay, a little explanation, then.
et: Olgu, väike seletus siis.

label: BerryBlender_Text_ExplainBerryBlending
en: Oh, don't worry, it's quite simple.
et: Oh, ära muretse, see on üsna lihtne.

label: BerryBlender_Text_ExplainBerryBlending
en: When the BLENDER's arrow comes to your marker, just press the A Button.
et: Kui BLENDER nool tuleb teie markerile, vajutage lihtsalt A-nuppu.

label: BerryBlender_Text_ExplainBerryBlending
en: That's all you have to do. You'll see how easy it is when you try.
et: Muud polegi vaja teha. Sa näed, kui lihtne see on, kui sa proovid.

label: BerryBlender_Text_DontHaveAnyBerries
en: Oh? You don't have any BERRIES?
et: Oh? Sul ei ole mingit BERRIES?

label: BerryBlender_Text_DontHaveAnyBerries
en: If you don't have any BERRIES, you can't make any {POKEBLOCK}S.
et: Kui sul ei ole ühtegi BERRIES, siis sa ei saa teha ühtegi {POKEBLOCK}S.

label: BerryBlender_Text_CanHaveOneOfMyBerries
en: Well, that won't do at all now, will it?
et: Noh, see nüüd ei tee üldse, eks?

label: BerryBlender_Text_CanHaveOneOfMyBerries
en: If you don't mind leftovers, you can have one of my BERRIES.
et: Kui sa ei pahanda ülejääkide vastu, võib sul olla üks minu BERRIES.

label: BerryBlender_Text_CanHaveOneOfMyBerries
en: That way, we could make some {POKEBLOCK}S together using the BERRY BLENDER.
et: Nii saaksime teha mõned {POKEBLOCK}S koos BERRY BLENDER abil.

label: BerryBlender_Text_DontHaveAnyBerriesToSpare
en: If I had some BERRIES left over, I'd gladly give you one…
et: Kui mul oleks mõni BERRIES üle jäänud, annaksin hea meelega ühe...

label: BerryBlender_Text_DontHaveAnyBerriesToSpare
en: But, I don't have any to spare today. We'll have to do this another time.
et: Aga, mul ei ole täna mingit varu. Me peame seda veel üks kord tegema.

label: BerryBlender_Text_PokeblockCaseIsFull
en: But your {POKEBLOCK} CASE is full.
et: Aga sinu {POKEBLOCK} CASE on täis.

label: BerryBlender_Text_PokeblockCaseIsFull
en: You should use some {POKEBLOCK}S before you come see me again.
et: Sa peaksid kasutama mõnda {POKEBLOCK}S-i, enne kui tuled mind uuesti vaatama.

label: BerryBlender_Text_DontHavePokeblockCase
en: But you don't have a {POKEBLOCK} CASE.
et: Aga sul ei ole {POKEBLOCK} CASE.

label: BerryBlender_Text_DontHavePokeblockCase
en: You should get a {POKEBLOCK} CASE and then come see me.
et: Sa peaksid saama {POKEBLOCK} CASE ja siis tulema mind vaatama.

label: BerryBlender_Text_LetsGetBlendingAlready
en: Let's get blending already!
et: Hakkame juba segama!

label: BerryBlender_Text_WhatKindOfPokeblockWillIGet
en: I wonder what kind of {POKEBLOCK} I'll get? This is so exciting!
et: Huvitav, mis {POKEBLOCK} ma saan? See on nii põnev!

label: BerryBlender_Text_WantToBlendPokeblocksWithUs
en: Hi, there! Did you want to blend some {POKEBLOCK}S with us?
et: Tere, seal! Kas sa tahtsid meiega mingid {POKEBLOCK}S'id kokku sulatada?

label: BerryBlender_Text_Okay
en: Okay!
et: Sedapsi!

label: BerryBlender_Text_ThatsTooBad
en: That's too bad…
et: See on liiga halb...

label: BerryBlender_Text_ThatsTooBad
en: But we'll always be around whenever you get the urge to blend!
et: Aga me oleme alati kohal alati, kui tekib tung sulanduda!

label: BerryBlender_Text_KnowHowToMakePokeblocks2
en: Of course, you do know how to blend {POKEBLOCK}S, don't you?
et: Sa muidugi tead, kuidas {POKEBLOCK}S'i sulandada, kas pole?

label: BerryBlender_Text_LetsBerryBlender2
en: Let's get started, then!
et: Alustame siis!

label: BerryBlender_Text_LetsBerryBlender2
en: Let's BERRY BLENDER!
et: Teeme BERRY BLENDER!

label: BerryBlender_Text_ExplainBerryBlending2
en: Okay! Let me explain it to you!
et: Olgu! Las ma selgitan seda teile!

label: BerryBlender_Text_ExplainBerryBlending2
en: When the spinning BLENDER's arrow reaches your marker, just press the A Button.
et: Kui keerlev BLENDER nool jõuab teie markerini, vajutage lihtsalt A-nuppu.

label: BerryBlender_Text_ExplainBerryBlending2
en: That's all it takes. Pretty easy, don't you think?
et: Muud polegi vaja. Päris lihtne, kas pole?

label: BerryBlender_Text_DontHaveAnyBerries2
en: Oh, but wait a second here… You don't have any BERRIES.
et: Oh, aga oota korraks siin... sul ei ole mingit BERRIES.

label: BerryBlender_Text_DontHaveAnyBerries2
en: You can't make any {POKEBLOCK}S without BERRIES…
et: Sa ei saa teha ühtegi {POKEBLOCK}S ilma BERRIES...

label: BerryBlender_Text_DontHaveAnyBerries2
en: We'll always be around whenever you get hold of some BERRIES to blend.
et: Me oleme alati kohal alati, kui sa saad kätte mõne BERRIES, et seguneda.

label: BerryBlender_Text_PokeblockCaseIsFull2
en: Oh, but wait a second here… Your {POKEBLOCK} CASE is full.
et: Oh, aga oota korraks siin... Sinu {POKEBLOCK} CASE on täis.

label: BerryBlender_Text_PokeblockCaseIsFull2
en: You should use some {POKEBLOCK}S and then come back.
et: Sa peaksid kasutama mõnda {POKEBLOCK}S ja siis tagasi tulema.

label: BerryBlender_Text_DontHavePokeblockCase2
en: Oh, but wait a second here… You don't have a {POKEBLOCK} CASE.
et: Oh, aga oota korraks siin... sul ei ole {POKEBLOCK} CASE.

label: BerryBlender_Text_DontHavePokeblockCase2
en: You should get a {POKEBLOCK} CASE and then come back.
et: Peaksid saama {POKEBLOCK} CASE ja siis tagasi tulema.

label: BerryBlender_Text_MakePokeblocksWithOurGroup
en: Oh, hello! Did you want to make some {POKEBLOCK}S with our little group?
et: Oh, tere! Kas sa tahtsid meie väikese grupiga mingit {POKEBLOCK}S'i teha?

label: BerryBlender_Text_OhDear
en: Oh, dear!
et: Oh, kallis!

label: BerryBlender_Text_LeftUsInShock
en: Oh, dear me…
et: Oh, kallis mina...

label: BerryBlender_Text_LeftUsInShock
en: You've left us in shock!
et: Sa jätsid meid šokki!

label: BerryBlender_Text_KnowHowToMakePokeblocks3
en: Naturally, you know how to make {POKEBLOCK}S, don't you?
et: Otseloomulikult sa ju tead, kuidas teha {POKEBLOCK}S?

label: BerryBlender_Text_LetsBerryBlender3
en: Okay, dear! Let's get started!
et: Olgu, kallis! Hakkame pihta!

label: BerryBlender_Text_LetsBerryBlender3
en: Let's BERRY BLENDER!
et: Teeme BERRY BLENDER!

label: BerryBlender_Text_ExplainBerryBlending3
en: Oh, dear!
et: Oh, kallis!

label: BerryBlender_Text_ExplainBerryBlending3
en: Then, I'll explain it to you nicely.
et: Siis seletan selle sulle ilusti lahti.

label: BerryBlender_Text_ExplainBerryBlending3
en: When the BLENDER's arrow spins to your marker, press the A Button.
et: Kui BLENDER nooleke keerutab teie markerile, vajutage nuppu A.

label: BerryBlender_Text_ExplainBerryBlending3
en: That's all it takes. Isn't it simple?
et: Muud polegi vaja. Kas pole lihtne?

label: BerryBlender_Text_DontHaveAnyBerries3
en: You don't have any BERRIES, do you?
et: Sul pole ju mingit BERRIES?

label: BerryBlender_Text_DontHaveAnyBerries3
en: If you don't have any BERRIES, you can't make any {POKEBLOCK}S.
et: Kui sul ei ole ühtegi BERRIES, siis sa ei saa teha ühtegi {POKEBLOCK}S.

label: BerryBlender_Text_DontHaveAnyBerries3
en: We'll always be making {POKEBLOCK}S here, so let's make some together when you get a BERRY or two.
et: Me teeme siin alati {POKEBLOCK}S, nii et teeme mõned kokku, kui saad BERRY või kaks.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainContests

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainContests
en: A CONTEST has two stages of judging, primary and secondary.
et: A CONTEST on kaks etappi hindamine, esmane ja teisene.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainContests
en: Primary judging is a popularity poll involving the audience.
et: Esmane otsustamine on publikut kaasav populaarsusküsitlus.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainContests
en: Secondary judging features appeals by the POKéMON using their moves.
et: Sekundaarsed hindamisfunktsioonid meeldivad POKéMON abil nende käikudele.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainContests

et: Plaan meeldib hoolikalt teenida kõige rohkem tähelepanu JUDGE ja erutada publikut. Anna endast parim, et silma paista.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainContests

et: Lõpus lisanduvad esmased ja teisesed hinded.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainContests

et: Võitjaks kuulutatakse kõrgeimat hinnet koguv POKéMON.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainContestTypes

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainContestTypes

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainLinkContest
en: This is a CONTEST for two to four players linked using a Wireless Adapter or a GBA Game Link cable.
et: See on CONTEST kahele kuni neljale mängijale, kes on lingitud juhtmevaba adapteri või GBA Game Link kaabli abil.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainLinkContest
en: Participants are first asked to choose the mode they wish to enter.
et: Esimesena palutakse osalejatel valida sisseastumiseks soovitud režiim.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainLinkContest

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainLinkContest
en: E-MODE (EMERALD MODE) is for two to four players, each with a POKéMON Emerald Game Pak.
et: E-MODE (EMERALD MODE) on kahele kuni neljale mängijale, igaühel on POKéMON Smaragdmängu Pak.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainLinkContest
en: G-MODE (GLOBAL MODE) is only for four players, each with a POKéMON Emerald, Ruby, or Sapphire Game Pak.
et: G-MODE (GLOBAL MODE) on ainult neljale mängijale, igaühel on POKéMON Smaragd, Ruby või Sapphire Game Pak.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainLinkContest
en: The players should discuss which mode they want, then choose the same mode.
et: Mängijad peaksid arutama, millist režiimi nad soovivad, seejärel valima sama režiimi.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainLinkContest
en: Once all the players have chosen the same CONTEST in the same mode, the entry registration is complete.
et: Kui kõik mängijad on valinud sama CONTEST samas režiimis, on sisseastumisregistreerimine täielik.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainLinkContest

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainEMode
en: In E-MODE (EMERALD MODE), a LINK CONTEST can be held with two to four players. Each player must have a POKéMON Emerald Game Pak.
et: E-MODE (EMERALD MODE) saab LINK CONTEST hoida kahe kuni nelja mängijaga. Igal mängijal peab olema POKéMON Smaragdmängu Pak.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainEMode
en: The players must be linked with each other using Wireless Adapters or GBA Game Link cables.
et: Mängijad peavad olema omavahel seotud juhtmevabade adapterite või GBA Game Link kaablite abil.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainEMode
en: If there are fewer than four players, TRAINERS in the hall will join to fill the 4-player CONTEST lineup.
et: Kui mängijaid on vähem kui neli, liitub TRAINERS saalis 4-mängija CONTEST rivistuse täitmiseks.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainEMode
en: Please be aware that E-MODE is not available in POKéMON Ruby or Sapphire.
et: Palun ole teadlik, et E-MODE ei ole saadaval POKéMON Ruby või Sapphire.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainGMode
en: G-MODE (GLOBAL MODE) is specifically for four players who are linked using GBA Game Link cables.
et: G-MODE (GLOBAL MODE) on spetsiaalselt neljale mängijale, kes on seotud GBA Game Link kaablite abil.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainGMode
en: Each player must have a POKéMON Emerald, Ruby, or Sapphire Game Pak.
et: Igal mängijal peab olema POKéMON Smaragd, Ruby või Sapphire Game Pak.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainGMode
en: The CONTEST starts after all players choose G-MODE (POKéMON Emerald) or enter through the 4-player reception counter (POKéMON Ruby or Sapphire).
et: CONTEST algab pärast seda, kui kõik mängijad valivad G-MODE (POKéMON Smaragd) või sisenevad 4-mängija vastuvõtu leti kaudu (POKéMON Ruby või Sapphire).

et: Mul on kohutavalt kahju.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_NoWirelessAdapterInGMode

et: G-MODE ei toimi juhtmevabade adapteritega.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_NoWirelessAdapterInGMode

label: MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CouldThereBeOtherLegends

label: MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_NotWorthyOfLegend

label: ProfileMan_Text_CollectTrainerProfiles
en: Hello there, TRAINER! You've got a wonderful smile, there.
et: Tere seal, TRAINER! Sul on imeline naeratus, seal.

label: ProfileMan_Text_CollectTrainerProfiles
en: I have a hobby--collecting the profiles of POKéMON TRAINERS.
et: Mul on hobi--kogudes profiile POKéMON TRAINERS.

label: ProfileMan_Text_MayISeeYourProfile
en: So, how about it? May I see your profile?
et: Kuidas siis oleks? Kas ma võin su profiili näha?

label: ProfileMan_Text_EasyChatExplanation
en: You make your own profile by putting together four words or phrases.
et: Te teete oma profiili, pannes kokku neli sõna või fraasi.

label: ProfileMan_Text_EasyChatExplanation
en: Here, I'll show you an example of a profile using four pieces of text.
et: Siin ma näitan teile näidet profiilist, kus kasutatakse nelja tekstitükki.

label: ProfileMan_Text_EasyChatExplanation
en: You can switch those four pieces with other text pieces any which way you like to make your own profile.
et: Neid nelja tükki saad vahetada teiste tekstijuppidega ükskõik, mis viisil sulle meeldib oma profiili teha.

label: ProfileMan_Text_EasyChatExplanation
en: There are a lot of text pieces that you can use.
et: Tekstijuppe, mida saab kasutada, on palju.

label: ProfileMan_Text_EasyChatExplanation
en: They are arranged in groups like POKéMON, lifestyles, and hobbies so it is easier to look them up.
et: Need on paigutatud gruppidesse nagu POKéMON, elustiilid ja hobid, et neid oleks lihtsam üles otsida.

label: ProfileMan_Text_EasyChatExplanation
en: So, first, choose the group of text pieces to display a list of choices.
et: Niisiis, kõigepealt valige valikute loendi kuvamiseks tekstijuppide rühm.

label: ProfileMan_Text_EasyChatExplanation
en: Then, pick the choice you want.
et: Seejärel vali soovitud valik.

label: ProfileMan_Text_EasyChatExplanation
en: Repeat for the remaining text choices, and you'll have your very own profile.
et: Korda ülejäänud tekstivalikuid ja sul on oma profiil.

label: ProfileMan_Text_LetsSeeItThen
en: Yes! Thank you! So, let's see it, then.
et: Jah! Aitäh! Seega, vaatame siis.

label: ProfileMan_Text_ImagineYouWouldHaveWonderfulProfile
en: Oh, no, really?
et: Ah ei, tõesti?

label: ProfileMan_Text_ImagineYouWouldHaveWonderfulProfile
en: I imagine someone like you would have a wonderful profile…
et: Kujutan ette, et sinusugusel oleks imeline profiil...

label: ProfileMan_Text_NotIntoItRightNow
en: Oh? You're not into it right now?
et: Oh? Sa ei puutu sellesse praegu?

label: ProfileMan_Text_NotIntoItRightNow
en: Well, anytime is good by me!
et: No iga kell on minu poolt hea!

label: ProfileMan_Text_YouHaveWonderfulSmile
en: Hello there, TRAINER! You've got a wonderful smile.
et: Tere seal, TRAINER! Sul on imeline naeratus.

label: ProfileMan_Text_MayISeeYourNewProfile
en: May I see your new profile?
et: Kas ma võin su uut profiili näha?

label: ProfileMan_Text_EvenBetterThanLastProfile
en: Yes! Thank you!
et: Jah! Aitäh!

label: ProfileMan_Text_EvenBetterThanLastProfile
en: I hope it's even better than the profile you showed me before.
et: Loodan, et see on veel parem kui see profiil, mida sa mulle enne näitasid.

label: ProfileMan_Text_LikeProfileWayItIs
en: Oh, you like your profile the way it is.
et: Oh, sulle meeldib sinu profiil nii, nagu ta on.

label: ProfileMan_Text_LikeProfileWayItIs
en: I don't blame you--it's a wonderful profile the way it is now.
et: Ma ei süüdista sind - see on imeline profiil nii, nagu ta praegu on.

label: ProfileMan_Text_FantasticProfile
en: F-fantastic!
et: F-fantastiline!

label: ProfileMan_Text_FantasticProfile
en: Your profile, it's wonderful! It really says what you're about.
et: Sinu profiil, see on imeline! Seal on tõesti kirjas, millest sa räägid.

label: ProfileMan_Text_FantasticProfile
en: Why, anyone hearing this profile would be captivated by you!
et: Miks, kõik, kes seda profiili kuulevad, oleksid sinust võlutud!

label: ProfileMan_Text_FantasticProfile
en: Thank you!
et: Aitäh!

label: ProfileMan_Text_YouKnowSecretSaying

et: Oh? Sa tead salajast ütlust!

label: ProfileMan_Text_YouKnowSecretSaying
