label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_WelcomeToSafariZone
en: Welcome to the SAFARI ZONE!
et: Tere tulemast SAFARI ALASSE!

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_WelcomeToSafariZone
en: Here, you may witness many kinds of POKéMON rarely seen in HOENN.
et: Siin võite olla tunnistajaks palju erinevaid POKéMON harva näha HOENN.

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_WelcomeToSafariZone
en: And, you'll see them in their wild, untamed state in natural habitats.
et: Ja, sa näed neid nende looduses, taltsutamata olekus looduslikes elupaikades.

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_WelcomeToSafariZone
en: What's more, we've thrown open the gates to POKéMON TRAINERS.
et: Veelgi enam, oleme väravad lahti visanud POKéMON TRAINERS.

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_WelcomeToSafariZone
en: You're encouraged to catch POKéMON for keeps!
et: Sind julgustatakse püüdma POKéMON hoidiste eest!

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_WelcomeToSafariZone
en: Come in and enjoy the SAFARI ZONE!
et: Tule ja naudi SAFARI ZONE!

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_WelcomeFirstTime
en: Welcome to the SAFARI ZONE! Is it your first time here?
et: Tere tulemast SAFARI ZONE! Kas see on teie esimene kord siin?

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_ComeInAndEnjoy
en: Come in and enjoy the SAFARI ZONE!
et: Tule ja naudi SAFARI ZONE!

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_FirstTimeInfo
en: When you enter the SAFARI ZONE, you start with 30 SAFARI BALLS for catching POKéMON.
et: Kui sisestate SAFARI ZONE, alustate 30 SAFARI BALLS püüdmiseks POKéMON.

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_FirstTimeInfo
en: The SAFARI Game is over when you run out of SAFARI BALLS, or when you've walked 500 steps.
et: SAFARI Game on läbi, kui saad otsa SAFARI BALLS või kui oled kõndinud 500 sammu.

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_FirstTimeInfo
en: Come in and enjoy the SAFARI ZONE!
et: Tule ja naudi SAFARI ZONE!

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_WouldYouLikeToPlay
en: Welcome to the SAFARI ZONE!
et: Tere tulemast SAFARI ALASSE!

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_WouldYouLikeToPlay
en: All you can catch for just ¥500! Would you like to play a SAFARI Game?
et: Kõik, mida saad püüda vaid $500 eest! Sooviks mängida SAFARI Game?

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_PlayAnotherTime
en: Okay. Please play another time!
et: Olgu. Palun mängige veel üks kord!

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_NotEnoughMoney
en: You don't have enough money. Sorry.
et: Sul pole piisavalt raha. Vabandust.

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_ThatWillBe500Please
en: That will be ¥500, please.
et: See on $500, palun.

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_HereAreYourSafariBalls
en: Here are your SAFARI BALLS.
et: Siin on teie SAFARI BALLS.

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_Received30SafariBalls
en: {PLAYER} received 30 SAFARI BALLS.
et: {PLAYER} sai 30 SAFARI BALLS.

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_PleaseEnjoyYourself
en: We'll let you know when your game is over.
et: Anname teada, kui sinu mäng on läbi.

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_PleaseEnjoyYourself
en: So, until then, enjoy yourself, please! Off you go on your wild excursion!
et: Nii et seni nautige ennast, palun! Off sa lähed oma metsikule ekskursioonile!

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_PCIsFull
en: Excuse me! Your PC BOX is full.
et: Vabandage mind! Sinu PC BOX on täis.

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_YouNeedPokeblockCase
en: Excuse me! You seem to be without a {POKEBLOCK} CASE.
et: Vabandage mind! Tundub, et oled ilma {POKEBLOCK} CASE.

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_YouNeedPokeblockCase
en: Your SAFARI Game will be much more fruitful if you use {POKEBLOCK}S.
et: Sinu SAFARI Game on palju viljakam, kui kasutad {POKEBLOCK}S.

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_YouNeedPokeblockCase
en: Please come back with a {POKEBLOCK} CASE.
et: Palun tule tagasi {POKEBLOCK} CASE.

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_YouNeedPokeblockCase
en: You may obtain a {POKEBLOCK} CASE from the LILYCOVE CONTEST HALL.
et: Võite saada {POKEBLOCK} CASE  LILYCOVE CONTEST HALL.

label: SafariZone_South_Text_StillHaveTimeExit
en: You still have time left. Would you like to exit the SAFARI ZONE now?
et: Sul on veel aega. Sooviks nüüd väljuda SAFARI ZONE?

label: SafariZone_South_Text_EnjoyTheRestOfYourAdventure
en: Please enjoy the rest of your wild adventure!
et: Palun nautige ülejäänud oma metsikut seiklust!

label: SafariZone_South_Text_ExitEarlyThankYouForPlaying
en: Okay.
et: Olgu.

label: SafariZone_South_Text_ExitEarlyThankYouForPlaying
en: I'll take back your remaining SAFARI BALLS.
et: Võtan tagasi sinu allesjäänud SAFARI BALLS.

label: SafariZone_South_Text_ExitEarlyThankYouForPlaying
en: Thank you for playing. We hope to see you again.
et: Tänan mängimast. Loodame sind veel näha.

label: SafariZone_South_Text_GoodLuck
en: Good luck!
et: Edu!

label: SafariZone_South_Text_GoodLuck
en: If you need anything, don't hesitate to tell me, please!
et: Kui sul on midagi vaja, siis ära kõhkle mulle ütlemast, palun!

label: SafariZone_South_Text_Boy
en: Did you know?
et: Kas teadsid?

label: SafariZone_South_Text_Boy
en: If you put a {POKEBLOCK} in that square box, POKéMON gather around.
et: Kui paned {POKEBLOCK} sinna kandilisse kasti, siis POKéMON kogune ümber.

label: SafariZone_South_Text_Man
en: I want to keep going deeper, but I forgot to bring a BIKE.
et: Tahan jätkata sügavamalt, kuid unustasin kaasa võtta BIKE.

label: SafariZone_South_Text_Man
en: Something tells me that rare POKéMON live in the outlying areas.
et: Miski ütleb mulle, et haruldased POKéMON elavad äärealadel.

label: SafariZone_Southwest_Text_Woman
en: Sometimes, when I toss a {POKEBLOCK} at POKéMON, it gets ignored.
et: Mõnikord, kui ma viskan {POKEBLOCK} juures POKéMON, ignoreeritakse seda.

label: SafariZone_Southwest_Text_Woman
en: Do POKéMON have likes and dislikes about what they eat?
et: Kas POKéMON on meeldimisi ja ei meeldi, mida nad söövad?

label: SafariZone_Northwest_Text_Man
en: Gasp… Gasp… I…made it out here…but…
et: Gasp... Gasp... ma tegin selle siin välja... aga...

label: SafariZone_Northwest_Text_Man
en: I'm exhausted… I don't have the energy to catch POKéMON…
et: Ma olen kurnatud... mul pole energiat, et püüda POKéMON...

label: SafariZone_North_Text_Fisherman
en: I'm on a mission to find WATER POKéMON you don't see in HOENN.
et: Olen missioonil, et leida WATER POKéMON te ei näe HOENN.

label: SafariZone_North_Text_Fisherman
en: Do you have any idea where the lake is?
et: Kas teil on aimu, kus on järv?

label: SafariZone_North_Text_Man
en: I'm going to catch a lot of rare POKéMON here and trade them with my friends!
et: Püüan siin palju haruldasi POKéMON ja vahetan neid oma sõpradega!

label: SafariZone_South_Text_Youngster
en: I put a {POKEBLOCK} on the {POKEBLOCK} FEEDER. But it seems to have disappeared.
et: Panin {POKEBLOCK} peale {POKEBLOCK} FEEDER. Aga tundub, et see on kadunud.

label: SafariZone_South_Text_Youngster
en: I guess POKéMON must have eaten it without me noticing.
et: Ma arvan, et POKéMON on selle vist ära söönud ilma, et ma tähele paneks.

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_TrainerTip
en: SAFARI ZONE TRAINER TIP!
et: SAFARI ZONE TRAINER TIP!

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_TrainerTip
en: Throw {POKEBLOCK}S at wild POKéMON to make them less likely to flee.
et: Viska {POKEBLOCK}S wild POKéMON, et nad vähem tõenäoline põgeneda.

label: SafariZone_Southwest_Text_RestHouseSign
en: “Relieve your tired feet.” REST HOUSE
et: "Uskuge oma väsinud jalgu". REST HOUSE

label: SafariZone_RestHouse_Text_Youngster
en: I don't have any {POKEBLOCK}S, but I caught a good number of POKéMON.
et: Mul ei ole ühtegi {POKEBLOCK}S, aga tabasin hea hulga POKéMON.

label: SafariZone_RestHouse_Text_Youngster
en: You can improve your chances of making a catch by getting closer to them before throwing a SAFARI BALL.
et: Saad parandada oma võimalusi saagi tegemiseks, jõudes neile lähemale enne SAFARI BALL viskamist.

label: SafariZone_RestHouse_Text_PsychicM
en: If you use {POKEBLOCK}S, wild POKéMON won't be so quick to run away.
et: Kui kasutad {POKEBLOCK}S, siis wild POKéMON ei ole nii kiire, et ära joosta.

label: SafariZone_RestHouse_Text_PsychicM
en: It's not much use to give {POKEBLOCK}S to POKéMON that don't flee easily.
et: See ei ole eriti kasulik anda {POKEBLOCK}S to POKéMON mis ei põgene lihtsalt.

label: SafariZone_RestHouse_Text_FatMan
en: If you put a {POKEBLOCK} on the FEEDER, POKéMON are attracted to it.
et: Kui paned {POKEBLOCK} FEEDER peale, siis POKéMON on sellest meelitatud.

label: SafariZone_RestHouse_Text_FatMan
en: I think POKéMON with the same sort of nature are drawn by a certain {POKEBLOCK}.
et: Ma arvan, et POKéMON sama laadi loodusega on joonistatud teatud {POKEBLOCK} poolt.

label: SafariZone_South_Text_AreaOffLimits1
en: This area is still under construction. It's off-limits, sorry!
et: See valdkond on alles ehitamisel. See on piiranguteta, sorry!

label: SafariZone_Southeast_Text_ExpansionIsFinished
en: The SAFARI ZONE's expansion project is finished now.
et: SAFARI ZONE laiendusprojekt on nüüd lõpetatud.

label: SafariZone_Southeast_Text_ExpansionIsFinished
en: We hope you will enjoy the new area.
et: Loodame, et naudite uut ala.

label: SafariZone_South_Text_AreaOffLimits2
en: This area is still under construction. It's off-limits, sorry!
et: See valdkond on alles ehitamisel. See on piiranguteta, sorry!

label: SafariZone_Southeast_Text_LittleGirl
en: Wow! Whee! I haven't seen any of these POKéMON before!
et: Vau! Whee! Ma pole varem ühtegi sellist POKéMON näinud!

label: SafariZone_Southeast_Text_FatMan
en: The POKéMON in this area are all new to me.
et: POKéMON selles valdkonnas on kõik minu jaoks uued.

label: SafariZone_Southeast_Text_FatMan
en: And I'm allowed to catch these rare POKéMON! Too cool!
et: Ja mul on lubatud püüda neid haruldasi POKéMON! Liiga lahe!

label: SafariZone_Southeast_Text_RichBoy
en: The POKéMON around here seem to be from somewhere other than HOENN.
et: POKéMON siinkandis tundub olevat kuskilt mujalt kui HOENN.

label: SafariZone_Northeast_Text_Boy
en: I only have a couple SAFARI BALLS left.
et: Mul on ainult paar SAFARI BALLS alles.

label: SafariZone_Northeast_Text_Boy
en: I'm having a hard time trying to decide what I should catch.
et: Mul on raske otsustada, mida peaksin püüdma.

label: SafariZone_Northeast_Text_Woman
en: I heard that you can see PIKACHU here. Where might one be?
et: Kuulsin, et siin on näha PIKACHU. Kus üks võiks olla?

label: SafariZone_Northeast_Text_Girl
en: Oh, boo! I can't seem to catch anything!
et: Oi, virise! Tundub, et ma ei saa midagi kätte!

label: SafariZone_Northeast_Text_Girl
en: I'll end up wasting the admission price if I don't catch something!
et: Lõpetan vastuvõtuhinna raiskamise, kui midagi kätte ei saa!

label: SecretBase_Text_TreeCanBeClimbed
en: If some vines drop down, this tree can be climbed.
et: Kui mõned viinapuud alla kukuvad, saab sellele puule ronida.

label: SecretBase_Text_TreeUseSecretPower
en: If some vines drop down, this tree can be climbed.
et: Kui mõned viinapuud alla kukuvad, saab sellele puule ronida.

et: Paks viinapuu kukkus alla!

label: SecretBase_Text_ClumpOfGrass
en: If this clump of grass can be moved, it might be possible to go inside.
et: Kui seda muruklompi saab liigutada, siis oleks ehk võimalik ka sisse minna.

label: SecretBase_Text_ClumpUseSecretPower
en: If this clump of grass can be moved, it might be possible to go inside.
et: Kui seda muruklompi saab liigutada, siis oleks ehk võimalik ka sisse minna.

et: Kasuta SECRET POWER?

en: Discovered a small entrance!
et: Avastati väike sissepääs!

label: SecretBase_Text_AllDecorationsWillBeReturned
en: All decorations and furniture in your SECRET BASE will be returned to your PC.
et: Kõik kaunistused ja mööbel teie SECRET BASE tagastatakse teie PC.

label: SecretBase_Text_AllDecorationsWillBeReturned
en: Is that okay?
et: Kas see on OK?

label: SecretBase_Text_WantToRegisterSecretBase
en: Do you want to register {STR_VAR_1}'s SECRET BASE?
et: Kas soovite registreerida {STR_VAR_1}'s SECRET BASE?

label: SecretBase_Text_AlreadyRegisteredDelete
en: This data is already registered. Would you like to delete it?
et: Need andmed on juba registreeritud. Kas soovite selle kustutada?

label: SecretBase_Text_TooManyBasesDeleteSome
en: Up to 10 locations can be registered.
et: Registreerida saab kuni 10 asukohta.

label: SecretBase_Text_TooManyBasesDeleteSome
en: Delete a location if you want to register another location.
et: Kustuta asukoht, kui soovid registreerida mõne muu asukoha.

label: SecretBase_Text_RegistrationCompleted
en: Registration completed.
et: Registreerimine lõpetatud.

label: SecretBase_Text_DataUnregistered
en: Data has been unregistered.
et: Andmed on registreerimata.

label: SecretBase_Text_BootUpPC
en: {PLAYER} booted up the PC.
et: {PLAYER} käivitas PC.

label: SecretBase_Text_WhatWouldYouLikeToDo
en: What would you like to do?
et: Mida tahaksid teha?

label: SecretBase_Text_RegistryInfo
en: Once registered, a SECRET BASE will not disappear unless the other TRAINER moves it to a different location.
et: Registreerununa ei kao SECRET BASE ära, kui teine TRAINER ei liiguta seda teise asukohta.

label: SecretBase_Text_RegistryInfo
en: If a SECRET BASE is deleted from the registered list, another one may take its place.
et: Kui registreeritud nimekirjast kustutatakse SECRET BASE, võib selle asemele tulla teine.

label: SecretBase_Text_RegistryInfo
en: Up to ten SECRET BASE locations may be registered.
et: Registreerida võib kuni kümme SECRET BASE asukohta.

label: SecretBase_Text_BattleTowerShield
en: A shield of {STR_VAR_2} that marks winning {STR_VAR_1} times in a row at the BATTLE TOWER.
et: Kilp {STR_VAR_2} mis tähistab võitu {STR_VAR_1} korda järjest BATTLE TOWER.

label: SecretBase_Text_ToyTV
en: A realistic toy TV. It could be easily mistaken for the real thing.
et: Realistlik mänguasi TV. See võib kergesti eksida päris asja vastu.

label: SecretBase_Text_SeedotTV
en: A toy TV shaped like a SEEDOT. It looks ready to roll away on its own…
et: Mänguasi TV kujuline SEEDOT. Tundub, et on valmis ise minema veerema...

label: SecretBase_Text_SkittyTV
en: A toy TV shaped like a SKITTY. It looks ready to stroll away…
et: Mänguasi TV kujuline SKITTY. See paistab valmis minema jalutama...

label: SecretBase_Text_WouldYouLikeToMoveBases
en: You may only make one SECRET BASE.
et: Te võite teha ainult ühe SECRET BASE.

label: SecretBase_Text_WouldYouLikeToMoveBases
en: Would you like to move from the SECRET BASE near {STR_VAR_1}?
et: Sooviks liikuda SECRET BASE lähedalt {STR_VAR_1}?

label: SecretBase_Text_MovingCompletedUseSecretPower
en: Moving completed.
et: Kolimine lõpetatud.

label: SecretBase_Text_MovingCompletedUseSecretPower
en: Would you like to use the SECRET POWER?
et: Sooviks kasutada SECRET POWER?

label: Route111_Text_MakingRoomUseTMToMakeYourOwn
en: What's that? What am I doing?
et: Mis see on? Mida ma teen?

label: Route111_Text_MakingRoomUseTMToMakeYourOwn
en: I'm thinking about making my own room here using a POKéMON move.
et: Mõtlen siin teha oma tuba kasutades POKéMON võtet.

label: Route111_Text_MakingRoomUseTMToMakeYourOwn
en: I know! I'll give you this TM. Will you use it to make your own room?
et: Ma tean! Annan sulle selle TM. Kas sa kasutad seda oma toa tegemiseks?

label: Route111_Text_ExplainSecretPower
en: Find a big tree that looks like it might drop some vines.
et: Leia suur puu, mis näeb välja, nagu võiks mõne viinapuu maha pillata.

label: Route111_Text_ExplainSecretPower
en: Use SECRET POWER in front of the tree. Some vines should get free and drop down, so you can climb the tree.
et: Kasuta SECRET POWER puu ees. Mõned viinapuud peaksid vabanema ja alla kukkuma, nii et saab puu otsa ronida.

label: Route111_Text_ExplainSecretPower
en: You'll find a lot of space for putting your favorite things.
et: Leiad palju ruumi oma lemmikute asjade panekuks.

label: Route111_Text_ExplainSecretPower
en: It'll be your own secret room… A SECRET BASE!
et: Sellest saab sinu enda salatuba... A SECRET BASE!

label: Route111_Text_ExplainSecretPower
en: You should make one, too.
et: Peaksid ka ühe tegema.

label: Route111_Text_ExplainSecretPower
en: Another thing, you don't always have to make your SECRET BASE in a tree.
et: Teine asi, alati ei pea oma SECRET BASE puu otsa tegema.

label: Route111_Text_ExplainSecretPower
en: Try using SECRET POWER on rock walls that have small indents in them.
et: Proovi kasutada SECRET POWER kivimüüridel, millel on neis väikesed tained.

label: Route111_Text_ExplainSecretPower
en: I'm going to look for other places, too. Okay, bye!
et: Ma hakkan ka teisi kohti otsima. Olgu, nägemist!

label: Route111_Text_DontWantThis
en: Oh, you don't want this? If you change your mind, tell me, okay?
et: Sa ei taha seda? Kui sa meelt muudad, ütle mulle, eks?

label: Route111_Text_DontHaveAnyRoom
en: Oh, you don't have any room for this.
et: Oh, sul pole selleks ruumi.

label: Route111_Text_DontHaveAnyRoom
en: I'll hold on to it, so come back for it another time, okay?
et: Ma hoian sellest kinni, nii et tule teine kord tagasi, eks?

label: SecretBase_Text_SmallIndentInWall
en: There's a small indent in the wall.
et: Seina sees on väike taand.

label: SecretBase_Text_IndentUseSecretPower
en: There's a small indent in the wall.
et: Seina sees on väike taand.

label: SecretBase_Text_IndentUseSecretPower

et: Kasuta SECRET POWER?

en: Discovered a small cavern!
et: Avastati väike koobas!

en: Want to make your SECRET BASE here?
et: Soovid siin oma SECRET BASE teha?

label: gDummyPokedexText
en: This is a newly discovered POKéMON. It is currently under investigation. No detailed information is available at this time.
et: See on äsja avastatud POKéMON. Praegu on see uurimise all. Detailset infot sel ajal ei ole.
raw:
This is a newly discovered POKéMON.
It is currently under investigation.
No detailed information is available
at this time.

label: gBulbasaurPokedexText
en: BULBASAUR can be seen napping in bright sunlight. There is a seed on its back. By soaking up the sun's rays, the seed grows progressively larger.
et: BULBASAUR on näha tukkumas eredas päikesevalguses. Seljas on seeme. Päikesekiiri leotades kasvab seeme järk-järgult suuremaks.
raw:
BULBASAUR can be seen napping in bright
sunlight. There is a seed on its back.
By soaking up the sun's rays, the seed
grows progressively larger.

label: gIvysaurPokedexText
en: To support its bulb, IVYSAUR's legs grow sturdy. If it spends more time lying in the sunlight, the bud will soon bloom into a large flower.
et: Selle pirni toetamiseks kasvavad IVYSAUR jalad tugevaks. Kui see veedab päikesevalguse käes vedeledes rohkem aega, õitseb pung peagi suureks lilleks.
raw:
To support its bulb, IVYSAUR's legs
grow sturdy. If it spends more time lying in
the sunlight, the bud will soon bloom into
a large flower.

label: gVenusaurPokedexText
en: VENUSAUR's flower is said to take on vivid colors if it gets plenty of nutrition and sunlight. The flower's aroma soothes the emotions of people.
et: Öeldakse, et VENUSAUR lill võtab endale erksad värvid, kui see saab rohkelt toitumist ja päikesevalgust. Lille aroom rahustab inimeste emotsioone.
raw:
VENUSAUR's flower is said to take on vivid
colors if it gets plenty of nutrition and
sunlight. The flower's aroma soothes the
emotions of people.

label: gCharmanderPokedexText
en: The flame that burns at the tip of its tail is an indication of its emotions. The flame wavers when CHARMANDER is happy, and blazes when it is enraged.
et: Leek, mis põleb sabaotsas, näitab selle emotsioone. Leek lainetab, kui CHARMANDER on õnnelik, ja lõõmab, kui see on raevunud.
raw:
The flame that burns at the tip of its
tail is an indication of its emotions.
The flame wavers when CHARMANDER is
happy, and blazes when it is enraged.

label: gCharmeleonPokedexText
en: Without pity, its sharp claws destroy foes. If it encounters a strong enemy, it becomes agitated, and the flame on its tail flares with a bluish white color.
et: Ilma haletsuseta hävitavad selle teravad küünised vaenlasi. Kui see kohtab tugevat vaenlast, muutub see agiteerituks ja leegid tema sabal leegitsevad sinakasvalge värviga.
raw:
Without pity, its sharp claws destroy foes.
If it encounters a strong enemy, it
becomes agitated, and the flame on its
tail flares with a bluish white color.

label: gCharizardPokedexText
en: A CHARIZARD flies about in search of strong opponents. It breathes intense flames that can melt any material. However, it will never torch a weaker foe.
et: A CHARIZARD lendab umbes otsides tugevaid vastaseid. See hingab intensiivseid leeke, mis võivad sulatada mis tahes materjali. Nõrgemat vaenlast see aga kunagi tõrvama ei hakka.
raw:
A CHARIZARD flies about in search of
strong opponents. It breathes intense
flames that can melt any material. However,
it will never torch a weaker foe.

label: gSquirtlePokedexText
en: Its shell is not just for protection. Its rounded shape and the grooves on its surface minimize resistance in water, enabling SQUIRTLE to swim at high speeds.
et: Selle kest ei ole ainult kaitseks. Selle ümara kujuga ja selle pinnal olevad sooned minimeerivad vastupidavust vees, võimaldades SQUIRTLE ujuda suurtel kiirustel.
raw:
Its shell is not just for protection.
Its rounded shape and the grooves on its
surface minimize resistance in water,
enabling SQUIRTLE to swim at high speeds.

label: gWartortlePokedexText
en: Its large tail is covered with rich, thick fur that deepens in color with age. The scratches on its shell are evidence of this POKéMON's toughness in battle.
et: Selle suur saba on kaetud rikkaliku, paksu karvastikuga, mis süveneb vanusega värvi. Selle kestal olevad kriimud on tõendid selle POKéMON sitkuse kohta lahingus.
raw:
Its large tail is covered with rich, thick
fur that deepens in color with age.
The scratches on its shell are evidence
of this POKéMON's toughness in battle.

label: gBlastoisePokedexText
en: The waterspouts that protrude from its shell are highly accurate. Their bullets of water can precisely nail tin cans from a distance of over 160 feet.
et: Selle kestast väljaulatuvad veeväljad on väga täpsed. Nende veekuulid võivad täpselt küünistada plekkpurke üle 160 jala kauguselt.
raw:
The waterspouts that protrude from its
shell are highly accurate. Their bullets of
water can precisely nail tin cans from
a distance of over 160 feet.

label: gCaterpiePokedexText
en: Its voracious appetite compels it to devour leaves bigger than itself without hesitation. It releases a terribly strong odor from its antennae.
et: Selle apsakas isu sunnib seda kõhklemata endast suuremaid lehti õgima. See vabastab oma antennidest kohutavalt tugeva lõhna.
raw:
Its voracious appetite compels it to
devour leaves bigger than itself without
hesitation. It releases a terribly strong
odor from its antennae.

label: gMetapodPokedexText
en: Its shell is as hard as an iron slab. A METAPOD does not move very much because it is preparing its soft innards for evolution inside the shell.
et: Selle kest on sama kõva kui raudplaat. A METAPOD ei liigu väga palju, sest ta valmistab oma pehmed sisemused evolutsiooniks kesta sees.
raw:
Its shell is as hard as an iron slab.
A METAPOD does not move very much
because it is preparing its soft innards
for evolution inside the shell.

label: gButterfreePokedexText
en: It has a superior ability to search for delicious honey from flowers. It can seek, extract, and carry honey from flowers blooming over six miles away.
et: Sellel on ülev oskus otsida lilledest maitsvat mett. See võib otsida, ekstraheerida ja kanda mett üle kuue miili kaugusel õitsevatelt lilledelt.
raw:
It has a superior ability to search for
delicious honey from flowers. It can seek,
extract, and carry honey from flowers
blooming over six miles away.

label: gWeedlePokedexText
en: A WEEDLE has an extremely acute sense of smell. It distinguishes its favorite kinds of leaves from those it dislikes by sniffing with its big red proboscis (nose).
et: A WEEDLE on äärmiselt terav lõhnataju. See eristab oma lemmikut sorti lehti neist, mis talle ei meeldi, nuusutades oma suure punase proboscisega (nina).
raw:
A WEEDLE has an extremely acute sense
of smell. It distinguishes its favorite
kinds of leaves from those it dislikes by
sniffing with its big red proboscis (nose).

label: gKakunaPokedexText
en: It remains virtually immobile while it clings to a tree. However, on the inside, it busily prepares for evolution. This is evident from how hot its shell becomes.
et: See jääb puu külge klammerdudes praktiliselt liikumatuks. Seestpoolt valmistub see aga usinalt evolutsiooniks. See ilmneb sellest, kui kuumaks selle kest muutub.
raw:
It remains virtually immobile while it
clings to a tree. However, on the inside,
it busily prepares for evolution. This is
evident from how hot its shell becomes.

label: gBeedrillPokedexText
en: A BEEDRILL is extremely territorial. For safety reasons, no one should ever approach its nest. If angered, they will attack in a swarm.
et: A BEEDRILL on äärmiselt territoriaalne. Ohutuse huvides ei tohiks keegi kunagi selle pesale läheneda. Kui nad vihastavad, ründavad nad parves.
raw:
A BEEDRILL is extremely territorial.
For safety reasons, no one should 
ever approach its nest. If angered,
they will attack in a swarm.

label: gPidgeyPokedexText
en: It has an extremely sharp sense of direction. It can unerringly return home to its nest, however far it may be removed from its familiar surroundings.
et: Sellel on äärmiselt terav suunatunnetus. Ta võib erru minnes naasta koju oma pessa, kuigi kaugele võib ta oma tuttavast ümbrusest eemalduda.
raw:
It has an extremely sharp sense of
direction. It can unerringly return home to
its nest, however far it may be removed
from its familiar surroundings.

label: gPidgeottoPokedexText
en: This POKéMON flies around, patrolling its large territory. If its living space is violated, it shows no mercy in thoroughly punishing the foe with its sharp claws.
et: See POKéMON lendab ringi, patrullides oma suurel territooriumil. Kui selle eluruumi rikutakse, ei näita see üles halastust, kui karistatakse põhjalikult vaenlast oma teravate küünistega.
raw:
This POKéMON flies around, patrolling its
large territory. If its living space is
violated, it shows no mercy in thoroughly
punishing the foe with its sharp claws.

label: gPidgeotPokedexText
en: This POKéMON has gorgeous, glossy feathers. Many TRAINERS are so captivated by the beautiful feathers on its head that they choose PIDGEOT as their POKéMON.
et: Sellel POKéMON on uhked, läikivad suled. Paljud TRAINERS on nii võlutud ilus suled peas, et nad valivad PIDGEOT kui nende POKéMON.
raw:
This POKéMON has gorgeous, glossy
feathers. Many TRAINERS are so captivated
by the beautiful feathers on its head that
they choose PIDGEOT as their POKéMON.

label: gRattataPokedexText
en: A RATTATA is cautious in the extreme. Even while it is asleep, it constantly moves its ears and listens for danger. It will make its nest anywhere.
et: A RATTATA on äärmisel juhul ettevaatlik. Isegi magamise ajal liigutab ta pidevalt kõrvu ja kuulab ohtu. See teeb oma pesa ükskõik kuhu.
raw:
A RATTATA is cautious in the extreme.
Even while it is asleep, it constantly
moves its ears and listens for danger.
It will make its nest anywhere.

label: gRaticatePokedexText
en: A RATICATE's sturdy fangs grow steadily. To keep them ground down, it gnaws on rocks and logs. It may even chew on the walls of houses.
et: A RATICATE tugevad kiharad kasvavad pidevalt. Et neid maas hoida, närib see kividele ja palkidele. See võib isegi majade seintel närida.
raw:
A RATICATE's sturdy fangs grow steadily.
To keep them ground down, it gnaws on
rocks and logs. It may even chew on the
walls of houses.

label: gSpearowPokedexText
en: Its loud cry can be heard over half a mile away. If its high, keening cry is heard echoing all around, it is a sign that they are warning each other of danger.
et: Selle valju kisa on kuulda üle poole miili kaugusel. Kui on kuulda selle kõrget, ketendavat nuttu ümberringi kajamas, on see märk sellest, et nad hoiatavad üksteist ohu eest.
raw:
Its loud cry can be heard over half a mile
away. If its high, keening cry is heard
echoing all around, it is a sign that they
are warning each other of danger.

label: gFearowPokedexText
en: Its long neck and elongated beak are ideal for catching prey in soil or water. It deftly moves this extended and skinny beak to pluck prey.
et: Selle pikk kael ja piklik nokk sobivad ideaalselt saagi püüdmiseks mullas või vees. See liigutab osavalt seda laiendatud ja kõhna nokka saaki kitkuma.
raw:
Its long neck and elongated beak are
ideal for catching prey in soil or water.
It deftly moves this extended and skinny
beak to pluck prey.

label: gEkansPokedexText
en: An EKANS curls itself up in a spiral while it rests. This position allows it to quickly respond to an enemy from any direction with a threat from its upraised head.
et: EKANS lokib end spiraalis üles, kuni see puhkab. See asend võimaldab tal kiiresti vastanduda vaenlasele ükskõik millisest suunast, millel on oht tema ülestõstetud peast.
raw:
An EKANS curls itself up in a spiral while
it rests. This position allows it to quickly
respond to an enemy from any direction
with a threat from its upraised head.

label: gArbokPokedexText
en: This POKéMON has a terrifically strong constricting power. It can even flatten steel oil drums. Once it wraps its body around its foe, escaping is impossible.
et: Sellel POKéMON on hirmuäratavalt tugev ahendav jõud. See võib isegi terasest õlitrumme lapitada. Kui ta on oma keha ümber vaenlase mässinud, on põgenemine võimatu.
raw:
This POKéMON has a terrifically strong
constricting power. It can even flatten
steel oil drums. Once it wraps its body
around its foe, escaping is impossible.

label: gPikachuPokedexText
en: It stores electricity in the electric sacs on its cheeks. When it releases pent-up energy in a burst, the electric power is equal to a lightning bolt.
et: See salvestab elektripakkidele elektrit põskedele. Kui see vabastab lõhkemisel pent-up-energiat, on elektrivõimsus võrdne välgunooliga.
raw:
It stores electricity in the electric sacs
on its cheeks. When it releases pent-up
energy in a burst, the electric power is
equal to a lightning bolt.

label: gRaichuPokedexText
en: If it stores too much electricity, its behavior turns aggressive. To avoid this, it occasionally discharges excess energy and calms itself down.
et: Kui see talletab liiga palju elektrit, muutub selle käitumine agressiivseks. Selle vältimiseks väljutab see aeg-ajalt üleliigset energiat ja rahustab ennast.
raw:
If it stores too much electricity, its
behavior turns aggressive. To avoid this,
it occasionally discharges excess energy
and calms itself down.

label: gSandshrewPokedexText
en: When it curls up in a ball, it can make any attack bounce off harmlessly. Its hide has turned tough and solid as a result of living in the desert.
et: Kui see pallis lokib, võib see iga rünnaku kahjutult ära põrgata. Selle peitus on kõrbes elamise tagajärjel muutunud sitkeks ja soliidseks.
raw:
When it curls up in a ball, it can make any
attack bounce off harmlessly. Its hide has
turned tough and solid as a result of
living in the desert.

label: gSandslashPokedexText
en: It curls up in a ball to protect itself from enemy attacks. It also curls up to prevent heatstroke during the daytime when temperatures rise sharply.
et: See lokib pallis, et kaitsta end vaenlase rünnakute eest. Samuti lokib see üles, et vältida kuumarabandust päevasel ajal, kui temperatuur järsult tõuseb.
raw:
It curls up in a ball to protect itself from
enemy attacks. It also curls up to prevent
heatstroke during the daytime when
temperatures rise sharply.

label: gNidoranFPokedexText
en: Its highly toxic barbs are thought to have developed as protection for this smallbodied POKéMON. When enraged, it releases a horrible toxin from its horn.
et: Arvatakse, et selle väga mürgised barbid on välja kujunenud selle väikese kehaehitusega POKéMON kaitsena. Raevudes vabastab see oma sarvest jubeda toksiini.
raw:
Its highly toxic barbs are thought to have
developed as protection for this small-
bodied POKéMON. When enraged, it releases
a horrible toxin from its horn.

label: gNidorinaPokedexText
en: When it is with its friends or family, its barbs are tucked away to prevent injury. It appears to become nervous if separated from the others.
et: Kui see on oma sõprade või perega, siis tõmmatakse selle barbused ära, et vältida vigastusi. Paistab, et see muutub närviliseks, kui teistest eralduda.
raw:
When it is with its friends or
family, its barbs are tucked away to
prevent injury. It appears to become
nervous if separated from the others.

label: gNidoqueenPokedexText
en: It is adept at sending foes flying with harsh tackles using its tough, scaly body. This POKéMON is at its strongest when it is defending its young.
et: Ta on vilunud saatma vaenlasi, kes lendavad karmide takjatega, kasutades oma sitket, ketendavat keha. See POKéMON on kõige tugevam, kui ta kaitseb oma noori.
raw:
It is adept at sending foes flying with
harsh tackles using its tough, scaly body.
This POKéMON is at its strongest when
it is defending its young.

label: gNidoranMPokedexText
en: The male NIDORAN has developed muscles that freely move its ears in any direction. Even the slightest sound does not escape this POKéMON's notice.
et: Isasel NIDORAN on tekkinud lihased, mis vabalt liigutavad oma kõrvu mis tahes suunas. Isegi vähimgi heli ei pääse sellest POKéMON märkusest.
raw:
The male NIDORAN has developed muscles
that freely move its ears in any direction.
Even the slightest sound does not escape
this POKéMON's notice.

label: gNidorinoPokedexText
en: Its horn is harder than a diamond. If it senses a hostile presence, all the barbs on its back bristle up at once, and it challenges the foe with all its might.
et: Selle sarv on raskem kui teemant. Kui ta tajub vaenulikku kohalolekut, siis kõik barbid seljal harjavad korraga üles ja see esitab vaenlasele kogu oma jõuga väljakutse.
raw:
Its horn is harder than a diamond.
If it senses a hostile presence, all the
barbs on its back bristle up at once, and it
challenges the foe with all its might.

label: gNidokingPokedexText
en: A NIDOKING's thick tail packs enormously destructive power capable of toppling a metal transmission tower. Once it goes on a rampage, there is no stopping it.
et: NIDOKING paks saba pakib tohutult hävitava jõu, mis on võimeline kukutama metallist ülekandetorni. Kui see kord märatsema hakkab, ei peata seda enam.
raw:
A NIDOKING's thick tail packs enormously
destructive power capable of toppling
a metal transmission tower. Once it goes
on a rampage, there is no stopping it.

label: gClefairyPokedexText
en: On every night of a full moon, they come out to play. When dawn arrives, the tired CLEFAIRY go to sleep nestled up against each other in deep and quiet mountains.
et: Igal täiskuu ööl tullakse välja mängima. Koidu saabudes lähevad väsinud CLEFAIRY magama, pesitsedes üksteise vastu sügavates ja vaiksetes mägedes.
raw:
On every night of a full moon, they come
out to play. When dawn arrives, the tired
CLEFAIRY go to sleep nestled up against
each other in deep and quiet mountains.

label: gClefablePokedexText
en: A CLEFABLE uses its wings to skip lightly as if it were flying. Its bouncy step lets it even walk on water. On quiet, moonlit nights, it strolls on lakes.
et: A CLEFABLE kasutab oma tiibu, et kergelt vahele jätta, nagu lendaks. Selle vetruv samm laseb sellel isegi vee peal kõndida. Vaiksetel kuuvalgel öödel jalutab järvedel.
raw:
A CLEFABLE uses its wings to skip lightly 
as if it were flying. Its bouncy step
lets it even walk on water. On quiet,
moonlit nights, it strolls on lakes.

label: gVulpixPokedexText
en: It can freely control fire, making fiery orbs fly like will-o'-the-wisps. Just before evolution, its six tails grow hot as if on fire.
et: See võib vabalt juhtida tuld, pannes tulised orbid lendama nagu tahe-o'-the-wisps. Vahetult enne evolutsiooni kasvavad selle kuus saba kuumaks justkui tulel.
raw:
It can freely control fire, making fiery
orbs fly like will-o'-the-wisps. Just
before evolution, its six tails grow hot 
as if on fire.

label: gNinetalesPokedexText
en: It has long been said that each of the nine tails embody an enchanted power. A long-lived NINETALES will have fur that shines like gold.
et: Juba ammu on räägitud, et igaüks üheksast sabast kehastab nõiutud väge. Pikaealisel NINETALES saab olema karusnahk, mis särab nagu kuld.
raw:
It has long been said that each of the
nine tails embody an enchanted power.
A long-lived NINETALES will have fur that
shines like gold.

label: gJigglypuffPokedexText
en: Nothing can avoid falling asleep hearing a JIGGLYPUFF's song. The sound waves of its singing voice match the brain waves of someone in a deep sleep.
et: Miski ei saa vältida uinumist kuuldes JIGGLYPUFF laulu. Selle laulva hääle helilained ühtivad sügava unega kellegi ajulainetega.
raw:
Nothing can avoid falling asleep hearing a
JIGGLYPUFF's song. The sound waves of its
singing voice match the brain waves of
someone in a deep sleep.

label: gWigglytuffPokedexText
en: Its fur is the ultimate in luxuriousness. Sleeping alongside a WIGGLYTUFF is simply divine. Its body expands seemingly without end when it inhales.
et: Selle kasukas on luksuslikkuse ülim. Magamine WIGGLYTUFF kõrval on lihtsalt jumalik. Selle keha paisub sisse hingates pealtnäha lõputult.
raw:
Its fur is the ultimate in luxuriousness.
Sleeping alongside a WIGGLYTUFF is simply
divine. Its body expands seemingly without
end when it inhales.

label: gZubatPokedexText
en: While living in pitch-black caverns, their eyes gradually grew shut and deprived them of vision. They use ultrasonic waves to detect obstacles.
et: Pigimustades koobastes elades kasvasid nende silmad tasapisi kinni ja võtsid nägemisest ilma. Nad kasutavad takistuste avastamiseks ultrahelilaineid.
raw:
While living in pitch-black caverns, their
eyes gradually grew shut and deprived
them of vision. They use ultrasonic waves
to detect obstacles.

label: gGolbatPokedexText
en: Its fangs easily puncture even thick animal hide. It loves to feast on the blood of people and POKéMON. It flits about in darkness and strikes from behind.
et: Selle kiharad torkavad kergesti isegi paksu looma peitu. See armastab pidutseda inimeste vere ja POKéMON. See flirdib pimeduses ja lööb tagant.
raw:
Its fangs easily puncture even thick
animal hide. It loves to feast on the blood
of people and POKéMON. It flits about in
darkness and strikes from behind.

label: gOddishPokedexText
en: This POKéMON grows by absorbing moonlight. During the daytime, it buries itself in the ground, leaving only its leaves exposed to avoid detection by its enemies.
et: See POKéMON kasvab neelates kuuvalgust. Päeval matab ta end maasse, jättes vaid oma lehed kokku puutumata, et vältida vaenlaste avastamist.
raw:
This POKéMON grows by absorbing moonlight.
During the daytime, it buries itself in the
ground, leaving only its leaves exposed to
avoid detection by its enemies.

label: gGloomPokedexText
en: A horribly noxious honey drools from its mouth. One whiff of the honey can result in memory loss. Some fans are said to enjoy this overwhelming stink, however.
et: Õudselt mühakas mesi ilastab suust. Üks mee virisemine võib kaasa tuua mälukaotuse. Väidetavalt naudivad mõned fännid siiski seda ülekaalukat haisu.
raw:
A horribly noxious honey drools from its
mouth. One whiff of the honey can result
in memory loss. Some fans are said to
enjoy this overwhelming stink, however.

label: gVileplumePokedexText
en: In seasons when it produces more pollen, the air around a VILEPLUME turns yellow with the powder as it walks. The pollen is highly toxic and causes paralysis.
et: Hooaegadel, mil see toodab rohkem õietolmu, muutub õhk VILEPLUME ümber käies pulbriga kollaseks. Õietolm on väga mürgine ja põhjustab halvatust.
raw:
In seasons when it produces more pollen,
the air around a VILEPLUME turns yellow
with the powder as it walks. The pollen is
highly toxic and causes paralysis.

label: gParasPokedexText
en: A PARAS has parasitic tochukaso mushrooms growing on its back. They grow by drawing nutrients from the host. They are valued as a medicine for long life.
et: A PARAS-l on parasiitsed totšukaso seened, mis kasvavad selili. Nad kasvavad, ammutades peremehelt toitaineid. Neid hinnatakse pika eluea ravimiks.
raw:
A PARAS has parasitic tochukaso
mushrooms growing on its back. They grow
by drawing nutrients from the host. They
are valued as a medicine for long life.

label: gParasectPokedexText
en: PARASECT are known to infest the roots of large trees en masse and drain nutrients. When an infested tree dies, they move onto another tree all at once.
et: PARASECT on teada, et nakatab suurte puude juuri massiliselt ja tühjendab toitaineid. Kui saastunud puu sureb, liiguvad nad korraga teisele puule.
raw:
PARASECT are known to infest the roots of
large trees en masse and drain nutrients.
When an infested tree dies, they move
onto another tree all at once.

label: gVenonatPokedexText
en: Its coat of thin, stiff hair that covers its entire body is said to have evolved for protection. Its large eyes never fail to spot even miniscule prey.
et: Väidetavalt on selle õhukestest, jäikadest juustest karvkate, mis katab kogu tema keha, arenenud kaitseks. Selle suured silmad ei jäta kunagi märkamata isegi minisaaki.
raw:
Its coat of thin, stiff hair that covers
its entire body is said to have evolved
for protection. Its large eyes never fail
to spot even miniscule prey.

label: gVenomothPokedexText
en: VENOMOTH are nocturnal--they only are active at night. Their favorite prey are insects that gather around streetlights, attracted by the light in the darkness.
et: VENOMOTH on öised--nad on aktiivsed ainult öösel. Nende lemmiksaagiks on tänavavalgustite ümber kogunevad putukad, keda pimeduses meelitab valgus.
raw:
VENOMOTH are nocturnal--they only are
active at night. Their favorite prey are
insects that gather around streetlights,
attracted by the light in the darkness.

label: gDiglettPokedexText
en: DIGLETT are raised in most farms. The reason is simple--wherever they burrow, the soil is left perfectly tilled for growing delicious crops.
et: DIGLETT on kasvatatud enamikes taludes. Põhjus on lihtne--kus iganes nad urgitsevad, jääb muld imemaitsvate kultuuride kasvatamiseks ideaalselt plaaditud.
raw:
DIGLETT are raised in most farms.
The reason is simple--wherever they
burrow, the soil is left perfectly tilled
for growing delicious crops.

label: gDugtrioPokedexText
en: Because the triplets originally split from one body, they think exactly alike. They work cooperatively to burrow endlessly through the ground.
et: Kuna kolmikud läksid algselt lahku ühest kehast, mõtlevad nad täpselt samamoodi. Nad teevad koostööd, et urguda lõputult läbi maa.
raw:
Because the triplets originally split from
one body, they think exactly alike.
They work cooperatively to burrow
endlessly through the ground.

label: gMeowthPokedexText
en: MEOWTH withdraw their sharp claws into their paws to silently sneak about. For some reason, this POKéMON loves shiny coins that glitter with light.
et: MEOWTH võta oma teravad küünised käppadesse, et vaikselt ligi hiilida. Millegipärast armastab see POKéMON läikivaid münte, mis säravad valgusega.
raw:
MEOWTH withdraw their sharp claws into
their paws to silently sneak about.
For some reason, this POKéMON loves
shiny coins that glitter with light.

label: gPersianPokedexText
en: A PERSIAN's six bold whiskers sense air movements to determine what is in its vicinity. It becomes docile if grabbed by the whiskers.
et: A PERSIAN kuus julget vurri tunnetavad õhuvõtteid, et teha kindlaks, mis on selle läheduses. See muutub kuulekaks, kui vurridest kinni haarata.
raw:
A PERSIAN's six bold whiskers sense air
movements to determine what is in its
vicinity. It becomes docile if grabbed
by the whiskers.

label: gPsyduckPokedexText
en: When its headache intensifies, it starts using strange powers. However, it has no recollection of its powers, so it always looks befuddled and bewildered.
et: Kui selle peavalu intensiivistub, hakkab ta kasutama kummalisi võimeid. Siiski ei meenuta see oma võimeid, nii et see tundub alati hämmeldunud ja hämmingus.
raw:
When its headache intensifies, it starts
using strange powers. However, it has no
recollection of its powers, so it always
looks befuddled and bewildered.

label: gGolduckPokedexText
en: A GOLDUCK is an adept swimmer. It sometimes joins competitive swimmers in training. It uses psychic powers when its forehead shimmers with light.
et: A GOLDUCK on vilunud ujuja. Vahel liitub see võistlustulle astujatega ka treeningutel. See kasutab psüühilisi võimeid, kui selle otsaesine särab valgusega.
raw:
A GOLDUCK is an adept swimmer.
It sometimes joins competitive swimmers
in training. It uses psychic powers when
its forehead shimmers with light.

label: gMankeyPokedexText
en: When it starts shaking and its nasal breathing turns rough, it's a sure sign of anger. However, since this happens instantly, there is no time to flee.
et: Kui see hakkab värisema ja selle ninahingamine muutub karedaks, on see kindel märk vihast. Kuna see juhtub aga koheselt, ei ole aega põgeneda.
raw:
When it starts shaking and its nasal
breathing turns rough, it's a sure sign
of anger. However, since this happens
instantly, there is no time to flee.

label: gPrimeapePokedexText
en: When it becomes furious, its blood circulation becomes more robust, and its muscles are made stronger. But it also becomes much less intelligent.
et: Maruvihaseks muutudes muutub selle vereringe jõulisemaks ja lihased tugevamaks. Aga see muutub ka palju vähem intelligentseks.
raw:
When it becomes furious, its blood
circulation becomes more robust, and
its muscles are made stronger. But it
also becomes much less intelligent.

label: gGrowlithePokedexText
en: Its superb sense of smell ensures that this POKéMON won't forget any scent, no matter what. It uses its sense of smell to detect the emotions of others.
et: Selle suurepärane lõhnataju tagab, et see POKéMON ei unusta ühtegi lõhna, olenemata sellest. See kasutab oma lõhnatunnet teiste emotsioonide avastamiseks.
raw:
Its superb sense of smell ensures that
this POKéMON won't forget any scent,
no matter what. It uses its sense of smell
to detect the emotions of others.

label: gArcaninePokedexText
en: This fleet-footed POKéMON is said to run over 6,200 miles in a single day and night. The fire that blazes wildly within its body is its source of power.
et: Väidetavalt sõidab see laevastikujalgne POKéMON ühe päevaga ja ööga üle 6200 miili. Tuli, mis põleb metsikult oma keha sees, on selle jõuallikas.
raw:
This fleet-footed POKéMON is said to run
over 6,200 miles in a single day and night.
The fire that blazes wildly within its body
is its source of power.

label: gPoliwagPokedexText
en: It is possible to see this POKéMON's spiral innards right through its thin skin. However, the skin is also very flexible. Even sharp fangs bounce right off it.
et: Seda POKéMON spiraalset sisemust on võimalik näha otse läbi oma õhukese naha. Samas on nahk ka väga painduv. Isegi teravad kiharad põrkavad sealt otse välja.
raw:
It is possible to see this POKéMON's spiral
innards right through its thin skin.
However, the skin is also very flexible.
Even sharp fangs bounce right off it.

label: gPoliwhirlPokedexText
en: Its body surface is always wet and slick with an oily fluid. Because of this greasy covering, it can easily slip and slide out of the clutches of any enemy in battle.
et: Selle kehapind on alati märg ja õlise vedelikuga libe. Selle rasvase katte tõttu võib see kergesti libastuda ja libiseda välja mistahes lahingus viibiva vaenlase siduritest.
raw:
Its body surface is always wet and slick
with an oily fluid. Because of this greasy
covering, it can easily slip and slide out
of the clutches of any enemy in battle.

label: gPoliwrathPokedexText
en: Its highly developed muscles never grow fatigued, however much it exercises. This POKéMON can swim back and forth across the Pacific Ocean without effort.
et: Selle kõrgelt arenenud lihased ei kasva kunagi väsinuna, ükskõik kui palju ta ka ei harjutaks. See POKéMON võib ilma vaevata ujuda edasi-tagasi üle Vaikse ookeani.
raw:
Its highly developed muscles never grow
fatigued, however much it exercises.
This POKéMON can swim back and forth
across the Pacific Ocean without effort.

label: gAbraPokedexText
en: A POKéMON that sleeps 18 hours a day. Observation revealed that it uses TELEPORT to change its location once every hour.
et: A POKéMON mis magab 18 tundi päevas. Vaatluse käigus selgus, et ta kasutab TELEPORT, et muuta oma asukohta üks kord tunnis.
raw:
A POKéMON that sleeps 18 hours a day.
Observation revealed that it uses
TELEPORT to change its location once
every hour.

label: gKadabraPokedexText
en: It is rumored that a boy with psychic abilities suddenly transformed into KADABRA while he was assisting research into extrasensory powers.
et: Kuuldavasti muutus psüühiliste võimetega poiss äkki KADABRA samal ajal, kui ta oli abiks uurimaks ekstrasensoorseid võimeid.
raw:
It is rumored that a boy with psychic
abilities suddenly transformed into
KADABRA while he was assisting research
into extrasensory powers.

label: gAlakazamPokedexText
en: While it has strong psychic abilities and high intelligence, an ALAKAZAM's muscles are very weak. It uses psychic power to move its body.
et: Kuigi sellel on tugevad psüühilised võimed ja kõrge intelligentsus, on ALAKAZAM lihased väga nõrgad. See kasutab psüühilist jõudu oma keha liigutamiseks.
raw:
While it has strong psychic abilities and
high intelligence, an ALAKAZAM's muscles
are very weak. It uses psychic power to
move its body.

label: gMachopPokedexText
en: It continually undertakes strenuous training to master all forms of martial arts. Its strength lets it easily hoist a sumo wrestler onto its shoulders.
et: Ta võtab pidevalt ette pingelise väljaõppe, et omandada kõik võitluskunstide vormid. Selle tugevus laseb sellel kergesti tõsta sumomaadleja õlgadele.
raw:
It continually undertakes strenuous
training to master all forms of martial
arts. Its strength lets it easily hoist
a sumo wrestler onto its shoulders.

label: gMachokePokedexText
en: A belt is worn by a MACHOKE to keep its overwhelming power under control. Because it is so dangerous, no one has ever removed the belt.
et: Rihma kannab MACHOKE, et hoida selle ülekaalukas jõud kontrolli all. Kuna see on nii ohtlik, pole keegi kunagi vööd eemaldanud.
raw:
A belt is worn by a MACHOKE to keep its
overwhelming power under control.
Because it is so dangerous, no one has
ever removed the belt.

label: gMachampPokedexText
en: It is impossible to defend against punches and chops doled out by its four arms. Its fighting spirit flares up when it faces a tough opponent.
et: Võimatu on kaitsta löökide ja hakkide eest, mida doleerivad välja oma neli kätt. Selle võitlusvaim ägeneb, kui seisab silmitsi karmi vastasega.
raw:
It is impossible to defend against punches
and chops doled out by its four arms.
Its fighting spirit flares up when it faces
a tough opponent.

label: gBellsproutPokedexText
en: A BELLSPROUT's thin and flexible body lets it bend and sway to avoid any attack, however strong it may be. From its mouth, it leaks a fluid that melts even iron.
et: BELLSPROUT õhuke ja painduv keha laseb sellel painutada ja kõigutada, et vältida mis tahes rünnakut, kui tugev see ka ei oleks. Selle suust lekib vedelikku, mis sulatab isegi rauda.
raw:
A BELLSPROUT's thin and flexible body lets
it bend and sway to avoid any attack,
however strong it may be. From its mouth,
it leaks a fluid that melts even iron.

label: gWeepinbellPokedexText
en: At night, a WEEPINBELL hangs on to a tree branch with its hooked rear and sleeps. If it moves around in its sleep, it may wake up to find itself on the ground.
et: Öösel ripub WEEPINBELL puuoksa küljes oma konksuga tagumine ja magab. Kui ta unes ringi liigub, võib ta ärgata, et end maast üles leida.
raw:
At night, a WEEPINBELL hangs on to a tree
branch with its hooked rear and sleeps.
If it moves around in its sleep, it may
wake up to find itself on the ground.

label: gVictreebelPokedexText
en: The long vine extending from its head is waved about as if it were a living thing to attract prey. When an unsuspecting victim approaches, it is swallowed whole.
et: Peast ulatuv pikk viinapuu lehvib umbes nii, nagu oleks see elusolend saagi ligimeelitamiseks. Kui läheneb pahaaimamatu ohver, neelatakse see tervelt alla.
raw:
The long vine extending from its head is
waved about as if it were a living thing to
attract prey. When an unsuspecting victim
approaches, it is swallowed whole.

label: gTentacoolPokedexText
en: Its body is almost entirely composed of water. It ensnares its foe with its two long tentacles, then stabs with the poison stingers at their tips.
et: Selle keha koosneb peaaegu täielikult veest. See orjastab oma vaenlast oma kahe pika kombitsaga, seejärel torkab mürgipistetega nende otsa.
raw:
Its body is almost entirely composed of
water. It ensnares its foe with its two
long tentacles, then stabs with the poison
stingers at their tips.

label: gTentacruelPokedexText
en: It lives in complex rock formations on the ocean floor and traps prey using its 80 tentacles. Its red orbs glow when it grows excited or agitated.
et: Ta elab keerulistes kivimimoodustistes ookeanipõhjas ja püüab saaki, kasutades oma 80 kombitsat. Selle punased orbiidid kumavad, kui see kasvab erutunult või ärritunult.
raw:
It lives in complex rock formations on
the ocean floor and traps prey using its
80 tentacles. Its red orbs glow when it
grows excited or agitated.

label: gGeodudePokedexText
en: It climbs mountain paths using only the power of its arms. Because they look just like boulders lining paths, hikers may step on them without noticing.
et: See ronib mägiteedele, kasutades ainult oma käte jõudu. Kuna nad näevad välja just nagu rändrahnud, kes vooderdavad radu, võivad matkajad neile märkamatult peale astuda.
raw:
It climbs mountain paths using only the
power of its arms. Because they look just
like boulders lining paths, hikers may step
on them without noticing.

label: gGravelerPokedexText
en: They descend from mountains by tumbling down steep slopes. They are so brutal, they smash aside obstructing trees and massive boulders with thunderous tackles.
et: Nad laskuvad mägedest alla, komistades mööda järske nõlvu. Nad on nii jõhkrad, et löövad äikeseliste takerdustega kõrvale takistavaid puid ja massiivseid rahne.
raw:
They descend from mountains by tumbling
down steep slopes. They are so brutal,
they smash aside obstructing trees and
massive boulders with thunderous tackles.

label: gGolemPokedexText
en: It is said to live in volcanic craters on mountain peaks. Once a year, it sheds its hide and grows larger. The shed hide crumbles and returns to the soil.
et: Väidetavalt elab see vulkaanilistes kraatrites mäetippudel. Kord aastas heidab oma peitu ja kasvab suuremaks. Kuur varjab murenemist ja naaseb mulda.
raw:
It is said to live in volcanic craters
on mountain peaks. Once a year, it sheds
its hide and grows larger. The shed hide
crumbles and returns to the soil.

label: gPonytaPokedexText
en: A PONYTA is very weak at birth. It can barely stand up. Its legs become stronger as it stumbles and falls while trying to keep up with its parent.
et: A PONYTA on sündides väga nõrk. See võib vaevu püsti tõusta. Selle jalad muutuvad tugevamaks komistades ja kukkudes, püüdes samal ajal vanemaga sammu pidada.
raw:
A PONYTA is very weak at birth. It can
barely stand up. Its legs become stronger
as it stumbles and falls while trying to
keep up with its parent.

label: gRapidashPokedexText
en: It usually canters casually in the fields and plains. But once a RAPIDASH turns serious, its fiery manes flare and blaze as it gallops its way up to 150 mph.
et: Tavaliselt kastab see juhuslikult põldudel ja tasandikel. Aga kui kord RAPIDASH muutub tõsiseks, selle tulised manid leegitsevad ja leegitsevad, kui see galopeerib oma teed kuni 150 mph.
raw:
It usually canters casually in the fields
and plains. But once a RAPIDASH turns
serious, its fiery manes flare and blaze
as it gallops its way up to 150 mph.

label: gSlowpokePokedexText
en: It catches prey by dipping its tail in water at the side of a river. But it often forgets what it is doing and spends entire days just loafing at water's edge.
et: Ta püüab saaki, kastes jõe ääres saba vette. Aga tihti unustatakse ära, mida ta teeb ja veedetakse terveid päevi lihtsalt vee ääres pätsitades.
raw:
It catches prey by dipping its tail in
water at the side of a river. But it often
forgets what it is doing and spends entire
days just loafing at water's edge.

label: gSlowbroPokedexText
en: Its tail has a SHELLDER firmly attached with a bite. As a result, the tail can't be used for fishing anymore. This forces it to reluctantly swim and catch prey.
et: Selle saba on SHELLDER kindlalt kinnitatud hammustusega. Selle tulemusena ei saa saba enam kalapüügiks kasutada. See sunnib teda vastumeelselt ujuma ja saaki püüdma.
raw:
Its tail has a SHELLDER firmly attached
with a bite. As a result, the tail can't be
used for fishing anymore. This forces it
to reluctantly swim and catch prey.

label: gMagnemitePokedexText
en: The units at its sides are extremely powerful magnets. They generate enough magnetism to draw in iron objects from over 300 feet away.
et: Selle külgedel olevad üksused on äärmiselt võimsad magnetid. Nad genereerivad piisavalt magnetismi, et ammutada rauast esemeid üle 300 meetri kauguselt.
raw:
The units at its sides are extremely
powerful magnets. They generate enough
magnetism to draw in iron objects from
over 300 feet away.

label: gMagnetonPokedexText
en: It is actually three MAGNEMITE linked by magnetism. It generates powerful radio waves that raise temperatures by 3.6 degrees F within a 3,300-foot radius.
et: See on tegelikult kolm MAGNEMITE seotud magnetism. See tekitab võimsaid raadiolaineid, mis tõstavad temperatuuri 3,6 kraadi F võrra 3300-meetrise raadiuse piires.
raw:
It is actually three MAGNEMITE linked
by magnetism. It generates powerful radio
waves that raise temperatures by 3.6
degrees F within a 3,300-foot radius.

label: gFarfetchdPokedexText
en: It is always seen with a stick from a plant. Apparently, there are good sticks and bad sticks. This POKéMON occasionally fights with others over choice sticks.
et: Seda on alati näha pulgaga taimelt. Ilmselt on head pulgad ja halvad pulgad. See POKéMON võitleb aeg-ajalt teistega valikupulkade pärast.
raw:
It is always seen with a stick from a plant.
Apparently, there are good sticks and bad
sticks. This POKéMON occasionally fights
with others over choice sticks.

label: gDoduoPokedexText
en: Even while eating or sleeping, one of the heads remains always vigilant for any sign of danger. When threatened, it flees at over 60 miles per hour.
et: Isegi süües või magades jääb üks pea alati valvsaks igasuguse ohumärgi suhtes. Ohustatuna põgeneb see üle 60 miili tunnis.
raw:
Even while eating or sleeping, one of the
heads remains always vigilant for any sign
of danger. When threatened, it flees at
over 60 miles per hour.

label: gDodrioPokedexText
en: A peculiar POKéMON species with three heads. It vigorously races across grassy plains even in arid seasons with little rainfall.
et: Omapärane POKéMON liik kolme peaga. See rassib jõuliselt üle rohtunud tasandike ka põuahooaegadel vähese sajuga.
raw:
A peculiar POKéMON species with three
heads. It vigorously races across grassy
plains even in arid seasons with little
rainfall.

label: gSeelPokedexText
en: SEEL hunt for prey in frigid, ice-covered seas. When it needs to breathe, it punches a hole through the ice with the sharply protruding section of its head.
et: SEEL jahib saaki tardunud, jääga kaetud meredes. Kui tal on vaja hingata, lööb ta teravalt väljaulatuva peaosaga augu läbi jää.
raw:
SEEL hunt for prey in frigid, ice-covered
seas. When it needs to breathe, it punches
a hole through the ice with the sharply
protruding section of its head.

label: gDewgongPokedexText
en: It loves to snooze on bitterly cold ice. The sight of this POKéMON sleeping on a glacier was mistakenly thought to be a mermaid by a mariner long ago.
et: Meeldib mõrudalt külmal jääl tukkuda. Selle POKéMON liustikul magamise vaatepilt arvati ekslikult meremehe poolt juba ammu näkineiuks.
raw:
It loves to snooze on bitterly cold ice.
The sight of this POKéMON sleeping on
a glacier was mistakenly thought to be
a mermaid by a mariner long ago.

label: gGrimerPokedexText
en: Born from polluted sludge in the sea, GRIMER's favorite food is anything filthy. They feed on wastewater pumped out from factories.
et: Sündinud reostunud mudast meres, on GRIMER lemmiktoit midagi räpast. Nad toituvad tehastest välja pumbatud reoveest.
raw:
Born from polluted sludge in the sea,
GRIMER's favorite food is anything filthy.
They feed on wastewater pumped out from
factories.

label: gMukPokedexText
en: It prefers warm and humid habitats. In the summertime, the toxic substances in its body intensify, making MUK reek like putrid kitchen garbage.
et: Eelistab sooje ja niiskeid elupaiku. Suvisel ajal intensiivistuvad tema kehas olevad mürgised ained, mis teevad MUK reeki nagu putriidne köögiprügi.
raw:
It prefers warm and humid habitats.
In the summertime, the toxic substances
in its body intensify, making MUK reek like
putrid kitchen garbage.

label: gShellderPokedexText
en: At night, it burrows a hole in the seafloor with its broad tongue to make a place to sleep. While asleep, it closes its shell, but leaves its tongue hanging out.
et: Öösel urgitseb see oma laia keelega merepõhja augu, et teha magamiskoht. Magades sulgeb ta oma kesta, kuid jätab keele rippuma.
raw:
At night, it burrows a hole in the seafloor
with its broad tongue to make a place to
sleep. While asleep, it closes its shell,
but leaves its tongue hanging out.

label: gCloysterPokedexText
en: It swims in the sea by swallowing water, then jetting it out toward the rear. The CLOYSTER shoots spikes from its shell using the same system.
et: See ujub meres vett alla neelates, ajades selle siis tagumise poole välja. CLOYSTER laseb sama süsteemi abil oma kestast naelu.
raw:
It swims in the sea by swallowing water,
then jetting it out toward the rear.
The CLOYSTER shoots spikes from its
shell using the same system.

label: gGastlyPokedexText
en: When exposed to a strong wind, a GASTLY's gaseous body quickly dwindles away. They cluster under the eaves of houses to escape the ravages of wind.
et: Tugeva tuulega kokku puutudes kahaneb GASTLY gaasiline keha kiiresti ära. Nad kobrutavad majade räästa all, et pääseda tuulerahetest.
raw:
When exposed to a strong wind, a GASTLY's
gaseous body quickly dwindles away.
They cluster under the eaves of houses
to escape the ravages of wind.

label: gHaunterPokedexText
en: If a HAUNTER beckons you while it is floating in darkness, don't approach it. This POKéMON will try to lick you with its tongue and steal your life away.
et: Kui HAUNTER viipab sulle, kui ta pimeduses hõljub, ära lähene sellele. See POKéMON püüab sind keelega lakkuda ja su elu ära varastada.
raw:
If a HAUNTER beckons you while it is
floating in darkness, don't approach it.
This POKéMON will try to lick you with its
tongue and steal your life away.

label: gGengarPokedexText
en: Deep in the night, your shadow cast by a streetlight may suddenly overtake you. It is actually a GENGAR running past you, pretending to be your shadow.
et: Sügaval öösel võib sinu tänavavalgustuse poolt heidetud vari sinust ootamatult mööduda. See on tegelikult GENGAR jookseb sinust mööda, teeseldes, et on sinu vari.
raw:
Deep in the night, your shadow cast by
a streetlight may suddenly overtake you.
It is actually a GENGAR running past
you, pretending to be your shadow.

label: gOnixPokedexText
en: There is a magnet in its brain that prevents an ONIX from losing direction while tunneling. As it grows older, its body becomes steadily rounder and smoother.
et: Selle ajus on magnet, mis ei lase ONIX'l tunnelites suunda kaotada. Vanemaks saades muutub tema keha pidevalt ümaramaks ja siledamaks.
raw:
There is a magnet in its brain that
prevents an ONIX from losing direction
while tunneling. As it grows older, its body
becomes steadily rounder and smoother.

label: gDrowzeePokedexText
en: If your nose becomes itchy while you are sleeping, it's a sure sign that a DROWZEE is standing above your pillow and trying to eat your dream through your nostrils.
et: Kui su nina muutub magamise ajal sügelevaks, on see kindel märk, et DROWZEE seisab su padja kohal ja püüab su unistust läbi ninasõõrmete süüa.
raw:
If your nose becomes itchy while you are
sleeping, it's a sure sign that a DROWZEE is
standing above your pillow and trying to
eat your dream through your nostrils.

label: gHypnoPokedexText
en: The arcing movement and glitter of the pendulum in a HYPNO's hand lull the foe into deep hypnosis. While searching for prey, it polishes the pendulum.
et: Pendli kaarduv liikumine ja sädelus HYPNO käes luristab vaenlase sügavasse hüpnoosi. Saaki otsides poleerib see pendlit.
raw:
The arcing movement and glitter of the
pendulum in a HYPNO's hand lull the foe
into deep hypnosis. While searching for
prey, it polishes the pendulum.

label: gKrabbyPokedexText
en: KRABBY live in holes dug into beaches. On sandy shores with little in the way of food, they can be seen squabbling with each other over territory.
et: KRABBY elage randadesse kaevatud aukudes. Liivastel kallastel, kus toiduteed on vähe, võib neid näha omavahel territooriumi kohal näägutamas.
raw:
KRABBY live in holes dug into beaches.
On sandy shores with little in the way
of food, they can be seen squabbling with
each other over territory.

label: gKinglerPokedexText
en: It waves its huge, oversized claw in the air to communicate with others. But since the claw is so heavy, this POKéMON quickly tires.
et: Ta lehvitab oma tohutut, ülearust küünist õhus, et teistega suhelda. Aga kuna küünis on nii raske, siis see POKéMON kiiresti rehvid.
raw:
It waves its huge, oversized claw in the
air to communicate with others.
But since the claw is so heavy, this
POKéMON quickly tires.

label: gVoltorbPokedexText
en: It bears an uncanny and unexplained resemblance to a POKé BALL. Because it explodes at the slightest shock, even veteran TRAINERS treat it with caution.
et: See kannab vankumatut ja seletamatut sarnasust POKé BALL-ga. Sest see plahvatab vähimalgi šokil, isegi veteran TRAINERS kohtle seda ettevaatlikult.
raw:
It bears an uncanny and unexplained
resemblance to a POKé BALL. Because it
explodes at the slightest shock, even
veteran TRAINERS treat it with caution.

label: gElectrodePokedexText
en: They appear in great numbers at electric power plants. Because they feed on electricity, they cause massive and chaotic blackouts in nearby cities.
et: Need ilmuvad elektrijaamades suure hulgana. Kuna nad toituvad elektrist, põhjustavad nad lähedal asuvates linnades massiivseid ja kaootilisi elektrikatkestusi.
raw:
They appear in great numbers at electric
power plants. Because they feed on
electricity, they cause massive and
chaotic blackouts in nearby cities.

label: gExeggcutePokedexText
en: It consists of six eggs that care for each other. The eggs attract each other and spin around. When cracks increasingly appear, it is close to evolution.
et: Koosneb kuuest munast, mis hoolivad üksteisest. Munad meelitavad üksteist ligi ja keerutavad ringi. Kui praod ilmuvad üha enam, on see evolutsioonile lähedal.
raw:
It consists of six eggs that care for each
other. The eggs attract each other and
spin around. When cracks increasingly
appear, it is close to evolution.

label: gExeggutorPokedexText
en: Originally from the tropics, EXEGGUTOR's heads grow larger from exposure to strong sunlight. It is said that when the heads fall, they group to form an EXEGGCUTE.
et: Algselt troopikast kasvavad EXEGGUTOR pead suuremaks kokkupuutest tugeva päikesevalgusega. Räägitakse, et kui pead kukuvad, siis nad grupeerivad, et moodustada EXEGGCUTE.
raw:
Originally from the tropics, EXEGGUTOR's
heads grow larger from exposure to strong
sunlight. It is said that when the heads
fall, they group to form an EXEGGCUTE.

label: gCubonePokedexText
en: It pines for the mother it will never see again. Seeing a likeness of its mother in the full moon, it cries. The stains on the skull it wears are from its tears.
et: See männib emale, mida ta enam kunagi ei näe. Nähes oma ema sarnasust täiskuu ajal, nutab see. Plekid pealuule, mida ta kannab, on tema pisaratest.
raw:
It pines for the mother it will never see
again. Seeing a likeness of its mother in
the full moon, it cries. The stains on the
skull it wears are from its tears.

label: gMarowakPokedexText
en: A MAROWAK is the evolved form of a CUBONE that has grown tough by overcoming the grief of losing its mother. Its tempered and hardened spirit is not easily broken.
et: A MAROWAK on arenenud vorm CUBONE, mis on muutunud karmiks, ületades leina kaotada oma ema. Selle karastunud ja paadunud vaim ei ole kergesti murtud.
raw:
A MAROWAK is the evolved form of a CUBONE
that has grown tough by overcoming the
grief of losing its mother. Its tempered
and hardened spirit is not easily broken.

label: gHitmonleePokedexText
en: Its legs freely stretch and contract. Using these springlike limbs, it bowls over foes with devastating kicks. After battle, it rubs down its tired legs.
et: Selle jalad venivad vabalt ja tõmbuvad kokku. Neid kevadisi jäsemeid kasutades kaussitab see hävitavate löökidega üle vaenlaste. Pärast lahingut hõõrub see oma väsinud jalad alla.
raw:
Its legs freely stretch and contract.
Using these springlike limbs, it bowls over
foes with devastating kicks. After battle,
it rubs down its tired legs.

label: gHitmonchanPokedexText
en: A HITMONCHAN is said to possess the spirit of a boxer who aimed to become the world champion. Having an indomitable spirit means that it will never give up.
et: Öeldakse, et HITMONCHAN omab poksija vaimu, kelle eesmärk oli tulla maailmameistriks. Omades laitmatut vaimu, tähendab see, et ta ei anna kunagi alla.
raw:
A HITMONCHAN is said to possess the
spirit of a boxer who aimed to become the
world champion. Having an indomitable
spirit means that it will never give up.

label: gLickitungPokedexText
en: Whenever it sees something unfamiliar, it always licks the object because it memorizes things by texture and taste. It is somewhat put off by sour things.
et: Alati, kui ta näeb midagi harjumatut, lakub ta objekti alati, sest jätab asjad tekstuuri ja maitse järgi meelde. Seda lükkavad mõnevõrra edasi hapud asjad.
raw:
Whenever it sees something unfamiliar,
it always licks the object because it
memorizes things by texture and taste.
It is somewhat put off by sour things.

label: gKoffingPokedexText
en: Getting up close to a KOFFING will give you a chance to observe, through its thin skin, the toxic gases swirling inside. It blows up at the slightest stimulation.
et: KOFFING lähedale jõudmine annab teile võimaluse jälgida oma õhukese naha kaudu sees keerlevaid mürgiseid gaase. See õhkab vähimagi stimulatsiooni korral.
raw:
Getting up close to a KOFFING will give
you a chance to observe, through its thin
skin, the toxic gases swirling inside. It
blows up at the slightest stimulation.

label: gWeezingPokedexText
en: By diluting its toxic gases with a special process, the highest grade of perfume can be extracted. To WEEZING, gases emanating from garbage are the ultimate feast.
et: Lahjendades oma mürgiseid gaase spetsiaalse protsessiga, saab eraldada kõrgeima klassi parfüümi. Et WEEZING, on prügist eralduvad gaasid ülim pidu.
raw:
By diluting its toxic gases with a special
process, the highest grade of perfume can
be extracted. To WEEZING, gases emanating
from garbage are the ultimate feast.

label: gRhyhornPokedexText
en: Once it starts running, it doesn't stop. Its tiny brain makes it so stupid that it can't remember why it started running in the first place.
et: Kui see hakkab jooksma, siis see ei peatu. Selle tilluke aju teeb selle nii lolliks, et ei mäletagi, miks ta üldse jooksma hakkas.
raw:
Once it starts running, it doesn't stop.
Its tiny brain makes it so stupid that it
can't remember why it started running in
the first place.

label: gRhydonPokedexText
en: Its horn, which rotates like a drill, destroys tall buildings with one strike. It stands on its hind legs, and its brain is well developed.
et: Selle sarv, mis pöörleb nagu puur, hävitab ühe hooga kõrged hooned. See seisab tagajalgadel ja selle aju on hästi arenenud.
raw:
Its horn, which rotates like a drill,
destroys tall buildings with one strike.
It stands on its hind legs, and its brain
is well developed.

label: gChanseyPokedexText
en: CHANSEY lay nutritionally excellent eggs every day. The eggs are so delicious, they are eagerly devoured by even those people who have lost their appetite.
et: CHANSEY munevad toitumuslikult suurepärased munad iga päev. Munad on nii maitsvad, et neid õgivad innukalt isegi need inimesed, kes on isu kaotanud.
raw:
CHANSEY lay nutritionally excellent eggs
every day. The eggs are so delicious, they
are eagerly devoured by even those people
who have lost their appetite.

label: gTangelaPokedexText
en: Its vines snap off easily and painlessly if they are grabbed, allowing it to make a quick getaway. The lost vines are replaced by new growth the very next day.
et: Selle vineerid tõmbuvad kergesti ja valutult ära, kui neid haaratakse, võimaldades sel teha kiire pääsemise. Kadunud viinapuud asenduvad uue kasvuga juba järgmisel päeval.
raw:
Its vines snap off easily and painlessly
if they are grabbed, allowing it to make a
quick getaway. The lost vines are replaced
by new growth the very next day.

label: gKangaskhanPokedexText
en: If you come across a young KANGASKHAN playing by itself, never try to catch it. The baby's parent is sure to be in the area, and it will become violently enraged.
et: Kui satud ise mängiva noore KANGASKHAN peale, siis ära kunagi ürita seda tabada. Beebi vanem on kindlasti sealkandis ja see muutub vägivaldselt raevukaks.
raw:
If you come across a young KANGASKHAN
playing by itself, never try to catch it.
The baby's parent is sure to be in the area,
and it will become violently enraged.

label: gHorseaPokedexText
en: By cleverly flicking the fins on its back side to side, it moves in any direction while facing forward. It spits ink to escape if it senses danger.
et: Tagumise külje pealt uimede kavalalt küljele virutamisega liigub see igas suunas, olles samal ajal ettepoole suunatud. See sülitab tinti, et põgeneda, kui see tajub ohtu.
raw:
By cleverly flicking the fins on its back
side to side, it moves in any direction
while facing forward. It spits ink to
escape if it senses danger.

label: gSeadraPokedexText
en: The poisonous barbs all over its body are highly valued as ingredients for making traditional herbal medicine. It shows no mercy to anything approaching its nest.
et: Mürgised barbid üle kogu oma keha on kõrgelt hinnatud kui traditsioonilise taimse meditsiini valmistamise koostisosad. See ei näita üles halastust millelegi, mis läheneb tema pesale.
raw:
The poisonous barbs all over its body are
highly valued as ingredients for making
traditional herbal medicine. It shows no
mercy to anything approaching its nest.

label: gGoldeenPokedexText
en: In the springtime, schools of GOLDEEN can be seen swimming up falls and rivers. It metes out staggering damage with its single horn.
et: Kevadel võib näha GOLDEEN koole üles ujumas kukkumisi ja jõgesid. See kohtab vapustavaid kahjustusi oma ühesarvega.
raw:
In the springtime, schools of GOLDEEN
can be seen swimming up falls and rivers.
It metes out staggering damage with its
single horn.

label: gSeakingPokedexText
en: It punches holes in boulders on streambeds. This is a clever innovation that prevents its eggs from being attacked or washed away by the current.
et: See lööb ojapeenardel rahnudesse augud sisse. Tegemist on kavala uuendusega, mis ei lase oma mune hoovusel rünnata ega ära pesta.
raw:
It punches holes in boulders on stream-
beds. This is a clever innovation that
prevents its eggs from being attacked or
washed away by the current.

label: gStaryuPokedexText
en: It gathers with others in the night and makes its red core glow on and off with the twinkling stars. It can regenerate limbs if they are severed from its body.
et: See koguneb koos teistega öösel ja paneb oma punase südamiku vilkuvate tähtedega sisse-välja kumama. See võib regenereerida jäsemeid, kui need on tema kehast eraldunud.
raw:
It gathers with others in the night and
makes its red core glow on and off with
the twinkling stars. It can regenerate
limbs if they are severed from its body.

label: gStarmiePokedexText
en: People in ancient times imagined that STARMIE were transformed from the reflections of stars that twinkled on gentle waves at night.
et: Iidsetel aegadel inimesed kujutasid ette, et STARMIE muundusid öösel õrnadel lainetel vilksatanud tähtede peegeldustest.
raw:
People in ancient times imagined that
STARMIE were transformed from the
reflections of stars that twinkled on
gentle waves at night.

label: gMrMimePokedexText
en: A MR. MIME is a master of pantomime. It can convince others that something unseeable actually exists. Once believed, the imaginary object does become real.
et: A MR. MIME on pantomiimi meister. See võib veenda teisi, et midagi nähtamatut on tegelikult olemas. Kui on usutud, muutub kujuteldav objekt siiski reaalseks.
raw:
A MR. MIME is a master of pantomime. It can
convince others that something unseeable
actually exists. Once believed, the
imaginary object does become real.

label: gScytherPokedexText
en: Its blindingly fast speed adds to the sharpness of its twin forearm scythes. The scythes can slice through thick logs in one wicked stroke.
et: Selle pimestavalt kiire kiirus lisab oma kaksikküünarvarre küünarnukkide teravust. Mütsid võivad läbi paksude palkide viilida ühe kurja hoobiga.
raw:
Its blindingly fast speed adds to the
sharpness of its twin forearm scythes.
The scythes can slice through thick logs
in one wicked stroke.

label: gJynxPokedexText
en: A JYNX sashays rhythmically as if it were dancing. Its motions are so bouncingly alluring, people seeing it are compelled to shake their hips without noticing.
et: A JYNX sašeerub rütmiliselt nagu tantsiks. Selle võtted on nii põrutavalt ahvatlevad, et seda näevad inimesed on sunnitud märkamatult puusasid raputama.
raw:
A JYNX sashays rhythmically as if it were
dancing. Its motions are so bouncingly
alluring, people seeing it are compelled to
shake their hips without noticing.

label: gElectabuzzPokedexText
en: When a storm approaches, it competes with others to scale heights that are likely to be stricken by lightning. Some towns use ELECTABUZZ in place of lightning rods.
et: Kui torm läheneb, konkureerib see teistega, et skaleerida kõrgusi, mida tõenäoliselt pikselöök kimbutab. Mõned linnad kasutavad ELECTABUZZ välguvarraste asemele.
raw:
When a storm approaches, it competes with
others to scale heights that are likely to
be stricken by lightning. Some towns use
ELECTABUZZ in place of lightning rods.

label: gMagmarPokedexText
en: In battle, it blows out intense flames from all over its body to intimidate its foe. These fiery bursts create heat waves that ignite grass and trees in the area.
