et: Lahingus puhub see välja intensiivseid leeke kogu oma kehast, et hirmutada oma vaenlast. Need tulised pursked tekitavad kuumalaineid, mis sütitavad piirkonnas rohtu ja puid.
raw:
In battle, it blows out intense flames from
all over its body to intimidate its foe.
These fiery bursts create heat waves that
ignite grass and trees in the area.

label: gPinsirPokedexText
en: Their pincers are strong enough to shatter thick logs. Because they dislike cold, PINSIR burrow and sleep under the ground on chilly nights.
et: Nende näpitsad on piisavalt tugevad, et pakse palke purustada. Sest neile ei meeldi külm, PINSIR uru ja magavad külmadel öödel maa all.
raw:
Their pincers are strong enough to
shatter thick logs. Because they dislike
cold, PINSIR burrow and sleep under
the ground on chilly nights.

label: gTaurosPokedexText
en: It is not satisfied unless it is rampaging at all times. If there is no opponent for TAUROS to battle, it will charge at thick trees and knock them down to calm itself.
et: See ei ole rahul, kui see ei rauge kogu aeg. Kui ei ole vastast TAUROS lahing, see laeb paksud puud ja koputab neid maha, et rahuneda ise.
raw:
It is not satisfied unless it is rampaging
at all times. If there is no opponent for
TAUROS to battle, it will charge at thick
trees and knock them down to calm itself.

label: gMagikarpPokedexText
en: Its swimming muscles are weak, so it is easily washed away by currents. In places where water pools, you can see many MAGIKARP deposited there by the flow.
et: Selle ujumislihased on nõrgad, mistõttu uhutakse see hoovuste poolt kergesti ära. Kohtades, kus veebasseinid, on näha palju MAGIKARP sinna vooluga ladestunud.
raw:
Its swimming muscles are weak, so it is
easily washed away by currents. In places
where water pools, you can see many
MAGIKARP deposited there by the flow.

label: gGyaradosPokedexText
en: It is an extremely vicious and violent POKéMON. When humans begin to fight, it will appear and burn everything to the ground with intensely hot flames.
et: See on äärmiselt tige ja vägivaldne POKéMON. Kui inimesed hakkavad võitlema, ilmub see välja ja põletab kõik intensiivselt kuumade leekidega maani maha.
raw:
It is an extremely vicious and violent
POKéMON. When humans begin to fight,
it will appear and burn everything to the
ground with intensely hot flames.

label: gLaprasPokedexText
en: People have driven LAPRAS almost to the point of extinction. In the evenings, it is said to sing plaintively as it seeks what few others of its kind still remain.
et: Inimesed on sõitnud LAPRAS peaaegu väljasuremiseni. Õhtuti öeldakse, et lauldakse haledalt, kuna otsitakse seda, mida veel vähesed omataolised alles jäävad.
raw:
People have driven LAPRAS almost to the
point of extinction. In the evenings,
it is said to sing plaintively as it seeks
what few others of its kind still remain.

label: gDittoPokedexText
en: A DITTO rearranges its cell structure to transform itself. However, if it tries to change based on its memory, it will get details wrong.
et: A DITTO korraldab ümber oma raku struktuuri, et muuta ennast. Kui ta aga üritab oma mälu põhjal muutuda, saab ta detailid valesti aru.
raw:
A DITTO rearranges its cell structure to
transform itself. However, if it tries to
change based on its memory, it will get
details wrong.

label: gEeveePokedexText
en: An EEVEE has an unstable genetic makeup that suddenly mutates due to its environment. Radiation from various STONES causes this POKéMON to evolve.
et: EEVEE on ebastabiilne geneetiline meik, mis muteerub äkitselt tänu oma keskkonnale. Kiirgus erinevatest STONES põhjustab selle POKéMON arenemise.
raw:
An EEVEE has an unstable genetic makeup
that suddenly mutates due to its
environment. Radiation from various
STONES causes this POKéMON to evolve.

label: gVaporeonPokedexText
en: VAPOREON underwent a spontaneous mutation and grew fins and gills that allow them to live underwater. They have the ability to freely control water.
et: VAPOREON läbis spontaanse mutatsiooni ning kasvatas uimed ja lõpused, mis võimaldavad neil vee all elada. Neil on võime vabalt vett juhtida.
raw:
VAPOREON underwent a spontaneous
mutation and grew fins and gills that
allow them to live underwater. They have
the ability to freely control water.

label: gJolteonPokedexText
en: Its cells generate weak power that is amplified by its fur's static electricity to drop thunderbolts. The bristling fur is made of electrically charged needles.
et: Selle rakud tekitavad nõrka võimsust, mida võimendab karusnaha staatiline elekter äikesepoltide langetamiseks. Harjastav kasukas on valmistatud elektriliselt laetud nõeltest.
raw:
Its cells generate weak power that is
amplified by its fur's static electricity
to drop thunderbolts. The bristling fur is
made of electrically charged needles.

label: gFlareonPokedexText
en: FLAREON's fluffy fur releases heat into the air so that its body does not get excessively hot. Its body temperature can rise to a maximum of 1,650 degrees F.
et: FLAREON kohev kasukas vabastab soojuse õhku, et tema keha ei muutuks liigselt kuumaks. Selle kehatemperatuur võib tõusta maksimaalselt 1650 kraadini F.
raw:
FLAREON's fluffy fur releases heat into
the air so that its body does not get
excessively hot. Its body temperature can
rise to a maximum of 1,650 degrees F.

label: gPorygonPokedexText
en: It is capable of reverting itself entirely back to program data in order to enter cyberspace. A PORYGON is copyprotected so it cannot be duplicated.
et: See on võimeline taasavama end täielikult tagasi programmi andmete juurde, et siseneda küberruumi. A PORYGON on copyprotected, nii et seda ei saa dubleerida.
raw:
It is capable of reverting itself entirely
back to program data in order to enter
cyberspace. A PORYGON is copy-
protected so it cannot be duplicated.

label: gOmanytePokedexText
en: One of the ancient and long-since-extinct POKéMON that have been regenerated from fossils by humans. If attacked, it withdraws into its hard shell.
et: Üks iidsetest ja ammu väljasurnud POKéMON, mis on inimeste poolt kivististest regenereeritud. Kui rünnatakse, taandub see oma kõva kesta sisse.
raw:
One of the ancient and long-since-extinct
POKéMON that have been regenerated
from fossils by humans. If attacked,
it withdraws into its hard shell.

label: gOmastarPokedexText
en: An OMASTAR uses its tentacles to capture its prey. It is believed to have become extinct because its shell grew too large, making its movements slow and ponderous.
et: OMASTAR kasutab oma kombitsaid oma saagi tabamiseks. Arvatakse, et see on välja surnud, sest selle kest kasvas liiga suureks, muutes selle võtted aeglaseks ja mõtisklevaks.
raw:
An OMASTAR uses its tentacles to capture
its prey. It is believed to have become
extinct because its shell grew too large,
making its movements slow and ponderous.

label: gKabutoPokedexText
en: It is a POKéMON that has been regenerated from a fossil. However, in rare cases, living examples have been discovered. KABUTO have not changed for 300 million years.
et: See on POKéMON mis on regenereeritud fossiilsest. Harvadel juhtudel on aga avastatud elavaid näiteid. KABUTO ei ole muutunud 300 miljonit aastat.
raw:
It is a POKéMON that has been regenerated
from a fossil. However, in rare cases, living
examples have been discovered. KABUTO
have not changed for 300 million years.

label: gKabutopsPokedexText
en: KABUTOPS once swam underwater to hunt for prey. It was apparently evolving from being a water dweller to living on land as evident from changes in its gills and legs.
et: KABUTOPS kord ujus vee all saaki jahtima. See arenes nähtavasti veeelanikuks olemisest maal elamiseni, mis ilmnes selle lõpuste ja jalgade muutustest.
raw:
KABUTOPS once swam underwater to hunt 
for prey. It was apparently evolving from
being a water dweller to living on land as
evident from changes in its gills and legs.

label: gAerodactylPokedexText
en: AERODACTYL is a POKéMON from the age of dinosaurs. It was regenerated from DNA extracted from amber. It is imagined to have been the king of the skies.
et: AERODACTYL on POKéMON alates dinosauruste east. See taastati merevaigust ekstraheeritud DNA-st. Kujutatakse ette, et ta on olnud taeva kuningas.
raw:
AERODACTYL is a POKéMON from the age
of dinosaurs. It was regenerated from DNA
extracted from amber. It is imagined to
have been the king of the skies.

label: gSnorlaxPokedexText
en: SNORLAX's typical day consists of nothing more than eating and sleeping. It is such a docile POKéMON that there are children who use its big belly as a place to play.
et: SNORLAX tüüpiline päev ei koosne muust kui söömisest ja magamisest. See on nii kuulekas POKéMON, et on lapsi, kes kasutavad oma suurt kõhtu mängukohana.
raw:
SNORLAX's typical day consists of nothing
more than eating and sleeping. It is such
a docile POKéMON that there are children
who use its big belly as a place to play.

label: gArticunoPokedexText
en: ARTICUNO is a legendary bird POKéMON that can control ice. The flapping of its wings chills the air. As a result, it is said that when this POKéMON flies, snow will fall.
et: ARTICUNO on legendaarne lind POKéMON mis suudab kontrollida jääd. Tiibade lehvimine jahutab õhku. Selle tulemusena öeldakse, et kui see POKéMON lendab, siis sajab lund.
raw:
ARTICUNO is a legendary bird POKéMON that
can control ice. The flapping of its wings
chills the air. As a result, it is said that
when this POKéMON flies, snow will fall.

label: gZapdosPokedexText
en: ZAPDOS is a legendary bird POKéMON that has the ability to control electricity. It usually lives in thunderclouds. It gains power if it is stricken by lightning bolts.
et: ZAPDOS on legendaarne lind POKéMON millel on võime juhtida elektrit. Tavaliselt elab see äikesepilvedes. See saab võimu juurde, kui see on piksepoltide poolt riivatud.
raw:
ZAPDOS is a legendary bird POKéMON that
has the ability to control electricity.
It usually lives in thunderclouds. It gains
power if it is stricken by lightning bolts.

label: gMoltresPokedexText
en: MOLTRES is a legendary bird POKéMON that can control fire. If injured, it is said to dip its body in the molten magma of a volcano to burn and heal itself.
et: MOLTRES on legendaarne lind POKéMON mis suudab juhtida tuld. Vigastuse korral kastab väidetavalt oma keha vulkaani sulamagmasse, et end põletada ja tervendada.
raw:
MOLTRES is a legendary bird POKéMON
that can control fire. If injured, it is said
to dip its body in the molten magma of
a volcano to burn and heal itself.

label: gDratiniPokedexText
en: A DRATINI continually molts and sloughs off its old skin. It does so because the life energy within its body steadily builds to reach uncontrollable levels.
et: A DRATINI pidevalt sulatab ja liguneb maha oma vana naha. Ta teeb seda seetõttu, et tema kehasisene eluenergia koguneb pidevalt, et saavutada kontrollimatu tase.
raw:
A DRATINI continually molts and sloughs
off its old skin. It does so because the
life energy within its body steadily builds
to reach uncontrollable levels.

label: gDragonairPokedexText
en: A DRAGONAIR stores an enormous amount of energy inside its body. It is said to alter the weather around it by loosing energy from the crystals on its neck and tail.
et: A DRAGONAIR salvestab tohutu hulga energiat oma keha sisse. Väidetavalt muudab see ümbritsevat ilma, loopides energiat kaela ja saba kristallidest.
raw:
A DRAGONAIR stores an enormous amount of
energy inside its body. It is said to alter
the weather around it by loosing energy
from the crystals on its neck and tail.

label: gDragonitePokedexText
en: It can circle the globe in just 16 hours. It is a kindhearted POKéMON that leads lost and foundering ships in a storm to the safety of land.
et: See võib maakerale ringi peale teha vaid 16 tunniga. See on heasüdamlik POKéMON, mis viib tormiga kadunud ja allajäävad laevad maa turvalisuseni.
raw:
It can circle the globe in just 16 hours.
It is a kindhearted POKéMON that leads
lost and foundering ships in a storm
to the safety of land.

label: gMewtwoPokedexText
en: A POKéMON that was created by genetic manipulation. However, even though the scientific power of humans made its body, they failed to give it a warm heart.
et: POKéMON mis loodi geneetilise manipuleerimise teel. Kuigi inimeste teaduslik jõud tegi oma keha, ei suutnud nad sellele siiski sooja südant anda.
raw:
A POKéMON that was created by genetic
manipulation. However, even though the
scientific power of humans made its body,
they failed to give it a warm heart.

label: gMewPokedexText
en: A MEW is said to possess the genes of all POKéMON. It is capable of making itself invisible at will, so it entirely avoids notice even if it approaches people.
et: Öeldakse, et MEW omab kõigi POKéMON geenid. Ta on võimeline tegema end soovi korral nähtamatuks, mistõttu väldib ta täielikult märkamist ka siis, kui ta läheneb inimestele.
raw:
A MEW is said to possess the genes of all
POKéMON. It is capable of making itself
invisible at will, so it entirely avoids
notice even if it approaches people.

label: gChikoritaPokedexText
en: It waves its leaf around to keep foes at bay. However, a sweet fragrance also wafts from the leaf, creating a friendly atmosphere that becalms the battlers.
et: Ta lehvitab oma lehte ümber, et hoida vaos vaenlasi. Lehest lainetab aga ka magus aroom, mis loob sõbraliku õhkkonna, mis võitlejaid bekatab.
raw:
It waves its leaf around to keep foes
at bay. However, a sweet fragrance also
wafts from the leaf, creating a friendly
atmosphere that becalms the battlers.

label: gBayleefPokedexText
en: A BAYLEEF's neck is ringed by curled-up leaves. Inside each leaf is a small tree shoot. The fragrance of this shoot makes people peppy.
et: BAYLEEF kaela helisevad lokkis lehed. Iga lehe sees on väike puulaskmine. Selle võtte aroom teeb inimesed pepiks.
raw:
A BAYLEEF's neck is ringed by curled-up
leaves. Inside each leaf is a small tree
shoot. The fragrance of this shoot
makes people peppy.

label: gMeganiumPokedexText
en: The fragrance of a MEGANIUM's flower soothes and calms emotions. In battle, it gives off more of its becalming scent to blunt the foe's fighting spirit.
et: MEGANIUM lille aroom rahustab ja rahustab emotsioone. Lahingus annab see välja rohkem oma bekalmistavat lõhna, et nüristada vaenlase võitlusvaimu.
raw:
The fragrance of a MEGANIUM's flower
soothes and calms emotions. In battle,
it gives off more of its becalming scent
to blunt the foe's fighting spirit.

label: gCyndaquilPokedexText
en: It flares flames from its back to protect itself. The fire burns vigorously if the POKéMON is angry. When it is tired, it sputters with incomplete combustion.
et: See sütitab leegid seljast, et end kaitsta. Tuli põleb jõuliselt, kui POKéMON on vihane. Kui see on väsinud, sülitab see puuduliku põlemisega.
raw:
It flares flames from its back to protect
itself. The fire burns vigorously if the
POKéMON is angry. When it is tired,
it sputters with incomplete combustion.

label: gQuilavaPokedexText
en: It intimidates foes with intense gusts of flames and superheated air. Its quick nimbleness lets it dodge attacks even while scorching an enemy.
et: See hirmutab vaenlasi intensiivsete leegipuhangute ja ülekuumenenud õhuga. Selle kiire nipsakus laseb tal kõrvale põigata rünnakutest isegi vaenlast kõrvetades.
raw:
It intimidates foes with intense gusts of
flames and superheated air. Its quick
nimbleness lets it dodge attacks even
while scorching an enemy.

label: gTyphlosionPokedexText
en: It can hide behind a shimmering heat haze that it creates using its intense flames. TYPHLOSION create blazing explosive blasts that burn everything to cinders.
et: See võib varjuda sädeleva kuumaudu taha, mille ta tekitab, kasutades oma intensiivseid leeke. TYPHLOSION luua lõõmavad lõhkekehad, mis põletavad kõik silindritesse.
raw:
It can hide behind a shimmering heat haze
that it creates using its intense flames.
TYPHLOSION create blazing explosive
blasts that burn everything to cinders.

label: gTotodilePokedexText
en: Despite its small body, TOTODILE's jaws are very powerful. While it may think it is just playfully nipping, its bite has enough strength to cause serious injury.
et: Vaatamata oma väikesele kehale on TOTODILE lõuad väga võimsad. Kuigi võib arvata, et see on lihtsalt mänguliselt nikerdamine, on selle hammustusel piisavalt jõudu, et tõsiseid vigastusi tekitada.
raw:
Despite its small body, TOTODILE's jaws
are very powerful. While it may think it is
just playfully nipping, its bite has enough
strength to cause serious injury.

label: gCroconawPokedexText
en: Once its jaws clamp down on its foe, it will absolutely not let go. Because the tips of its fangs are forked back like fishhooks, they become irremovably embedded.
et: Kui lõuad on oma vaenlasele alla klammerdunud, ei lase see absoluutselt lahti. Kuna selle kihvade tipud on kahvlitega tagasi nagu kalakonksud, muutuvad need eemaldamatult kinniseks.
raw:
Once its jaws clamp down on its foe, it will
absolutely not let go. Because the tips of
its fangs are forked back like fishhooks,
they become irremovably embedded.

label: gFeraligatrPokedexText
en: It opens its huge mouth to intimidate enemies. In battle, it runs using its thick and powerful hind legs to charge the foe with incredible speed.
et: See avab oma tohutu suu vaenlaste hirmutamiseks. Lahingus jookseb ta oma paksude ja võimsate tagajalgade abil, et laadida vaenlast uskumatu kiirusega.
raw:
It opens its huge mouth to intimidate
enemies. In battle, it runs using its thick
and powerful hind legs to charge the
foe with incredible speed.

label: gSentretPokedexText
en: They take turns standing guard when it is time to sleep. The sentry awakens the others if it senses danger. If one becomes separated, it turns sleepless with fear.
et: Nad seisavad kordamööda valvel, kui on aeg magada. Saatus äratab teisi, kui see tajub ohtu. Kui üks eraldub, muutub see hirmuga unetuks.
raw:
They take turns standing guard when it
is time to sleep. The sentry awakens the
others if it senses danger. If one becomes
separated, it turns sleepless with fear.

label: gFurretPokedexText
en: A FURRET has a very slim build. When under attack, it can squirm through narrow spaces and get away. In spite of its short limbs, it is very nimble and fleet.
et: A FURRET on väga saleda ehitusega. Rünnaku all olles võib see läbi kitsaste ruumide kiskuda ja minema pääseda. Vaatamata oma lühikestele jäsemetele on see väga krapsakas ja laevastik.
raw:
A FURRET has a very slim build. When under
attack, it can squirm through narrow
spaces and get away. In spite of its short
limbs, it is very nimble and fleet.

label: gHoothootPokedexText
en: It has an internal organ that senses the earth's rotation. Using this special organ, a HOOTHOOT begins hooting at precisely the same time every day.
et: Sellel on sisemine elund, mis tunnetab maakera pöörlemist. Seda spetsiaalset orelit kasutades hakkab a HOOTHOOT iga päev täpselt samal ajal huilgama.
raw:
It has an internal organ that senses
the earth's rotation. Using this special
organ, a HOOTHOOT begins hooting at
precisely the same time every day.

label: gNoctowlPokedexText
en: It unfailingly catches prey in darkness. NOCTOWL owe their success to superior vision that allows them to see in minimal light, and to their supple and silent wings.
et: See püüab pimeduses saaki tabamatult. NOCTOWL võlgneb oma edu ülevale nägemisele, mis võimaldab neil näha minimaalses valguses ning nende nõtketele ja vaikivatele tiibadele.
raw:
It unfailingly catches prey in darkness.
NOCTOWL owe their success to superior
vision that allows them to see in minimal
light, and to their supple and silent wings.

label: gLedybaPokedexText
en: LEDYBA communicate using a fluid that they secrete from where the legs join the body. They are said to convey feelings to others by altering the fluid's scent.
et: LEDYBA suhtlema vedeliku abil, mida nad eritavad sealt, kus jalad kehaga ühinevad. Väidetavalt annavad nad tundeid edasi teistele, muutes vedeliku lõhna.
raw:
LEDYBA communicate using a fluid that
they secrete from where the legs join the
body. They are said to convey feelings to
others by altering the fluid's scent.

label: gLedianPokedexText
en: It is said that in lands with clean air, where the stars fill the sky, there live many LEDIAN. For good reason, they use the light of the stars as energy.
et: Räägitakse, et puhta õhuga maadel, kus tähed täidavad taevast, elab palju LEDIAN. Mõjuval põhjusel kasutavad nad energiana tähtede valgust.
raw:
It is said that in lands with clean air,
where the stars fill the sky, there live
many LEDIAN. For good reason, they use
the light of the stars as energy.

label: gSpinarakPokedexText
en: The web it spins can be considered its second nervous system. It is said that a SPINARAK determines its prey by the tiny vibrations it feels through the web.
et: Veebi, mida ta keerutab, võib pidada selle teiseks närvisüsteemiks. Öeldakse, et SPINARAK määrab oma saagi pisikeste vibratsioonidega, mida ta läbi veebi tunneb.
raw:
The web it spins can be considered its
second nervous system. It is said that a
SPINARAK determines its prey by the tiny
vibrations it feels through the web.

label: gAriadosPokedexText
en: Its feet are tipped with tiny hooked claws that enable it to scuttle on ceilings and vertical walls. It constricts its foe with thin and strong silk webbing.
et: Selle jalad on kallutatud pisikeste konksudega küünistega, mis võimaldavad sellel lagedel ja vertikaalsetel seintel kõditada. See ahendab oma vaenlast õhukese ja tugeva siidsidemega.
raw:
Its feet are tipped with tiny hooked claws
that enable it to scuttle on ceilings and
vertical walls. It constricts its foe with
thin and strong silk webbing.

label: gCrobatPokedexText
en: Over the course of evolution, its hind legs turned into wings. By alternately resting its front and rear wings, it can fly all day without having to stop.
et: Evolutsiooni käigus muutusid selle tagajalad tiibadeks. Puhkades vaheldumisi oma esi- ja tagatiibu, võib see lennata terve päeva, ilma et peaks peatuma.
raw:
Over the course of evolution, its hind legs
turned into wings. By alternately resting
its front and rear wings, it can fly all day
without having to stop.

label: gChinchouPokedexText
en: When it senses danger, it discharges positive and negative electricity from its two antennae. It lives in depths beyond sunlight's reach.
et: Kui ta tajub ohtu, väljutab ta oma kahest antennist positiivset ja negatiivset elektrit. See elab sügavuses, mis ületab päikesevalguse käeulatuse.
raw:
When it senses danger, it discharges
positive and negative electricity from its
two antennae. It lives in depths beyond
sunlight's reach.

label: gLanturnPokedexText
en: The light-emitting orbs on its back are very bright. They are formed from a part of its dorsal fin. This POKéMON illuminates the inky darkness of deep seas.
et: Seljal olevad valgust kiirgavad orbid on väga eredad. Need moodustuvad selle seljauime osast. See POKéMON valgustab sügavate merede sisemist pimedust.
raw:
The light-emitting orbs on its back are
very bright. They are formed from a part of
its dorsal fin. This POKéMON illuminates
the inky darkness of deep seas.

label: gPichuPokedexText
en: It is still inept at retaining electricity. When it is startled, it discharges power accidentally. It gets better at holding power as it grows older.
et: See on endiselt saamatu elektri säilitamisel. Kui see on ehmunud, väljutab see voolu kogemata. Jõudu hoides läheb vanemaks saades paremaks.
raw:
It is still inept at retaining electricity.
When it is startled, it discharges power
accidentally. It gets better at holding
power as it grows older.

label: gCleffaPokedexText
en: On nights with many shooting stars, CLEFFA can be seen dancing in a ring. They dance until daybreak, when they quench their thirst with the morning dew.
et: Öödel, kus on palju pildistamistähti, võib CLEFFA näha tantsimas ringis. Tantsitakse kuni päevavaheajani, mil kustutatakse janu hommikukastmega.
raw:
On nights with many shooting stars,
CLEFFA can be seen dancing in a ring.
They dance until daybreak, when they
quench their thirst with the morning dew.

label: gIgglybuffPokedexText
en: Its soft and pliable body is very bouncy. When it sings continuously with all its might, its body steadily turns a deepening pink color.
et: Selle pehme ja plekiline keha on väga hüplev. Kui ta laulab pidevalt kogu oma väega, pöörab ta keha pidevalt süvenevat roosat värvi.
raw:
Its soft and pliable body is very bouncy.
When it sings continuously with all its
might, its body steadily turns a deepening
pink color.

label: gTogepiPokedexText
en: As its energy, it uses the feelings of compassion and pleasure exuded by people and POKéMON. It stores up happy feelings in its shell, then shares them out.
et: Oma energiana kasutab see inimeste poolt õhku paisatud kaastunde- ja mõnutunnet ning POKéMON. See salvestab oma kesta õnnelikud tunded, siis jagab need välja.
raw:
As its energy, it uses the feelings of
compassion and pleasure exuded by
people and POKéMON. It stores up happy
feelings in its shell, then shares them out.

label: gTogeticPokedexText
en: It is said to be a POKéMON that brings good fortune. When it spots someone who is pure of heart, a TOGETIC appears and shares its happiness with that person.
et: Väidetavalt on tegemist POKéMON-ga, mis toob head õnne. Kui see märkab kedagi, kes on südamest puhas, ilmub TOGETIC ja jagab selle inimesega oma õnne.
raw:
It is said to be a POKéMON that brings good
fortune. When it spots someone who is pure
of heart, a TOGETIC appears and shares its
happiness with that person.

label: gNatuPokedexText
en: It runs up short trees that grow on the savanna to peck at new shoots. A NATU's eyes look as if they are always observing something.
et: See jookseb üles lühikesi puid, mis kasvavad savannil, et nokitseda uute võrsete kallal. A NATU silmad näevad välja nagu nad alati jälgiksid midagi.
raw:
It runs up short trees that grow on the
savanna to peck at new shoots.
A NATU's eyes look as if they are
always observing something.

label: gXatuPokedexText
en: It has the enigmatic power of foreseeing the future. Some people in different lands have long believed that XATU are emissaries from another world.
et: Sellel on mõistatuslik jõud tulevikku ette näha. Mõned inimesed erinevatel maadel on juba ammu uskunud, et XATU on teisest maailmast pärit emissarid.
raw:
It has the enigmatic power of foreseeing
the future. Some people in different lands
have long believed that XATU are
emissaries from another world.

label: gMareepPokedexText
en: Its fluffy wool rubs together and builds a static charge. The more energy is charged, the more brightly the lightbulb at the tip of its tail glows.
et: Selle kohev vill hõõrub kokku ja ehitab staatilise laengu. Mida rohkem energiat laetakse, seda eredamalt hõõgub lambipirn sabaotsas.
raw:
Its fluffy wool rubs together and builds
a static charge. The more energy is
charged, the more brightly the lightbulb
at the tip of its tail glows.

label: gFlaaffyPokedexText
en: Its fleece quality changes to generate strong static electricity with a small amount of wool. The bare, slick parts of its hide are shielded against electricity.
et: Selle fliisikvaliteet muutub, et toota tugevat staatilist elektrit väikese villakogusega. Selle peidiku paljad, libedad osad on varjestatud elektri eest.
raw:
Its fleece quality changes to generate
strong static electricity with a small
amount of wool. The bare, slick parts of its
hide are shielded against electricity.

label: gAmpharosPokedexText
en: It gives off so much light that it can be seen even from space. People in the old days used its light to send signals back and forth with others far away.
et: See annab nii palju valgust ära, et seda on näha isegi kosmosest. Vanasti kasutasid inimesed oma valgust, et saata kaugele teistega signaale edasi-tagasi.
raw:
It gives off so much light that it can be
seen even from space. People in the old
days used its light to send signals back
and forth with others far away.

label: gBellossomPokedexText
en: Its flower petals deepen in color through exposure to sunlight. When cloudy weather persists, it does a dance that is thought to be a ritual for summoning the sun.
et: Selle õie kroonlehed süvenevad värvis päikesevalgusega kokkupuutumise kaudu. Kui püsib pilves ilm, teeb see tantsu, mida arvatakse olevat rituaal päikese väljakutsumiseks.
raw:
Its flower petals deepen in color through
exposure to sunlight. When cloudy weather
persists, it does a dance that is thought
to be a ritual for summoning the sun.

label: gMarillPokedexText
en: Its body is covered with water-repellent fur. Because of the fur, it can swim through water at high speed without being slowed by the water's resistance.
et: Selle keha on kaetud vetthülgava kasukaga. Karvase tõttu saab ta suurel kiirusel läbi vee ujuda, ilma et vee takistus seda pidurdaks.
raw:
Its body is covered with water-repellent
fur. Because of the fur, it can swim
through water at high speed without being
slowed by the water's resistance.

label: gAzumarillPokedexText
en: It lives in water virtually all day long. Its body color and pattern act as camouflage that makes it tough for enemies to spot in water.
et: See elab praktiliselt kogu päeva vees. Selle kehavärv ja muster toimivad maskeeringuna, mis teeb vaenlastele vees märkamise raskeks.
raw:
It lives in water virtually all day long.
Its body color and pattern act as
camouflage that makes it tough for
enemies to spot in water.

label: gSudowoodoPokedexText
en: It mimics a tree to avoid being attacked by enemies. But since its forelegs remain green throughout the year, it is easily identified as a fake in the winter.
et: See matkib puud, et vältida vaenlaste rünnakut. Aga kuna selle esijalad jäävad aastaringselt roheliseks, siis on see talvel kergesti tuvastatav võltsinguna.
raw:
It mimics a tree to avoid being attacked
by enemies. But since its forelegs
remain green throughout the year, it is
easily identified as a fake in the winter.

label: gPolitoedPokedexText
en: The curled hair on its head proves its status as a king. It is said that the longer and curlier the hair, the more respect it earns from its peers.
et: Lokkis juuksed peas tõestavad oma staatust kuningana. Räägitakse, et mida pikemad ja lokkis juuksed, seda rohkem respekti see eakaaslastelt teenib.
raw:
The curled hair on its head proves its
status as a king. It is said that the
longer and curlier the hair, the more
respect it earns from its peers.

label: gHoppipPokedexText
en: This POKéMON drifts and floats with the wind. If it senses the approach of strong winds, a HOPPIP links leaves with others to prepare against being blown away.
et: See POKéMON triivib ja hõljub tuulega. Kui see tajub tugeva tuule lähenemist, siis HOPPIP seob teistega, et valmistuda ärapuhumise vastu.
raw:
This POKéMON drifts and floats with the
wind. If it senses the approach of strong
winds, a HOPPIP links leaves with others
to prepare against being blown away.

label: gSkiploomPokedexText
en: It blossoms when the temperature rises above 64 degrees F. Because its flower's blooming changes with the temperature, it is sometimes used as a thermometer.
et: Õitseb, kui temperatuur tõuseb üle 64 kraadi F. Kuna tema lille õitsemine muutub koos temperatuuriga, kasutatakse seda mõnikord termomeetrina.
raw:
It blossoms when the temperature rises
above 64 degrees F. Because its flower's
blooming changes with the temperature,
it is sometimes used as a thermometer.

label: gJumpluffPokedexText
en: JUMPLUFF ride warm southern winds to cross the sea and fly to foreign lands. This POKéMON lands when it encounters cold air while it is floating.
et: JUMPLUFF sõita sooja lõunatuulega, et ületada meri ja lennata võõrastele maadele. See POKéMON maandub, kui see kohtab külma õhku ujumise ajal.
raw:
JUMPLUFF ride warm southern winds to
cross the sea and fly to foreign lands.
This POKéMON lands when it encounters
cold air while it is floating.

label: gAipomPokedexText
en: Its tail ends with a dexterous, handlike appendage. However, because it uses the tail so much, AIPOM's real hands have become rather clumsy.
et: Selle saba lõpeb osava, käelise lisandiga. Kuna ta aga saba nii palju kasutab, siis on AIPOM päris käed üsna kohmakaks muutunud.
raw:
Its tail ends with a dexterous, handlike
appendage. However, because it uses the
tail so much, AIPOM's real hands have
become rather clumsy.

label: gSunkernPokedexText
en: SUNKERN try to minimize movement to conserve the nutrients they have stored in their bodies for evolution. They will not eat, subsisting only on morning dew.
et: SUNKERN püüdke minimeerida liikumist, et säästa toitaineid, mida nad on säilitanud oma kehas evolutsiooniks. Nad ei söö, vaibudes ainult hommikuse kaste peale.
raw:
SUNKERN try to minimize movement to
conserve the nutrients they have stored
in their bodies for evolution. They will
not eat, subsisting only on morning dew.

label: gSunfloraPokedexText
en: SUNFLORA convert solar energy into nutrition. They are highly active in the warm daytime but suddenly stop moving as soon as the sun sets.
et: SUNFLORA muundada päikeseenergia toitumiseks. Nad on väga aktiivsed soojal päevasel ajal, kuid lõpetavad äkitselt liikumise kohe, kui päike loojub.
raw:
SUNFLORA convert solar energy into
nutrition. They are highly active in the
warm daytime but suddenly stop moving as
soon as the sun sets.

label: gYanmaPokedexText
en: It can see 360 degrees without moving its eyes. It is a great flier capable of making sudden stops and turning midair to quickly chase down targeted prey.
et: Ta näeb 360 kraadi ilma silmi liigutamata. See on suurepärane lendaja, kes on võimeline tegema äkilisi peatusi ja keerama midaairi, et kiiresti sihitud saaki taga ajada.
raw:
It can see 360 degrees without moving
its eyes. It is a great flier capable of
making sudden stops and turning midair to
quickly chase down targeted prey.

label: gWooperPokedexText
en: WOOPER usually live in water but come out onto land seeking food occasionally. On land, they coat their bodies with a gooey, toxic film.
et: WOOPER tavaliselt elavad vees, kuid tulevad välja maale, kus aeg-ajalt toitu otsitakse. Maal katavad nad oma keha gooey, mürgise kilega.
raw:
WOOPER usually live in water but come
out onto land seeking food occasionally.
On land, they coat their bodies with a
gooey, toxic film.

label: gQuagsirePokedexText
en: A QUAGSIRE hunts by leaving its mouth wide open in water and waiting for its prey to blunder in. Because it doesn't move, it does not get very hungry.
et: A QUAGSIRE jahib, jättes suu vees avatuks ja oodates, millal selle saak sisse lömastab. Kuna see ei liigu, siis väga nälga ei jää.
raw:
A QUAGSIRE hunts by leaving its mouth wide
open in water and waiting for its prey to
blunder in. Because it doesn't move, it
does not get very hungry.

label: gEspeonPokedexText
en: An ESPEON is extremely loyal to any TRAINER it considers to be worthy. It is said to have developed precognitive powers to protect its TRAINER from harm.
et: ESPEON on äärmiselt lojaalne mis tahes TRAINER see peab vääriliseks. Väidetavalt on välja kujunenud prekognitiivsed võimed, et kaitsta oma TRAINER kahju eest.
raw:
An ESPEON is extremely loyal to any
TRAINER it considers to be worthy. It is
said to have developed precognitive
powers to protect its TRAINER from harm.

label: gUmbreonPokedexText
en: UMBREON evolved from exposure to the moon's energy pulses. It lurks in darkness and waits for its foes to move. The rings on its body glow when it leaps to attack.
et: UMBREON arenes kokkupuutest Kuu energiaimpulssidega. See varitseb pimeduses ja ootab oma vaenlaste liikumist. Rõngad tema kehal hõõguvad, kui see hüppab, et rünnata.
raw:
UMBREON evolved from exposure to the
moon's energy pulses. It lurks in darkness
and waits for its foes to move. The rings
on its body glow when it leaps to attack.

label: gMurkrowPokedexText
en: MURKROW were feared as the alleged bearers of ill fortune. It shows strong interest in anything that sparkles. It will even try to steal rings from women.
et: MURKROW kardeti kui väidetavaid haige varanduse kandjaid. See näitab üles suurt huvi kõige vastu, mis sädeleb. See püüab isegi naistelt sõrmuseid varastada.
raw:
MURKROW were feared as the alleged
bearers of ill fortune. It shows strong
interest in anything that sparkles. It will
even try to steal rings from women.

label: gSlowkingPokedexText
en: It undertakes research every day to solve the mysteries of the world. However, it apparently forgets everything if the SHELLDER on its head comes off.
et: Ta kohustub iga päev uurima, et lahendada maailma müsteeriume. Siiski unustab see ilmselt kõik ära, kui SHELLDER pähe tuleb.
raw:
It undertakes research every day to
solve the mysteries of the world.
However, it apparently forgets everything
if the SHELLDER on its head comes off.

label: gMisdreavusPokedexText
en: A MISDREAVUS frightens people with a creepy, sobbing cry. It apparently uses its red spheres to absorb the fear of foes as its nutrition.
et: A MISDREAVUS hirmutab inimesi jubeda, nuuksuva nutuga. Ilmselt kasutab ta oma punaseid sfääre, et neelata vaenlaste hirmu kui oma toitumist.
raw:
A MISDREAVUS frightens people with a
creepy, sobbing cry. It apparently uses
its red spheres to absorb the fear of foes
as its nutrition.

label: gUnownPokedexText
en: This POKéMON is shaped like ancient text characters. Although research is ongoing, it is a mystery as to which came first, the ancient writings or the various UNOWN.
et: See POKéMON on kujundatud iidsete tekstimärkidena. Kuigi uuringud käivad, on see mõistatus, mis tuli esimesena, iidsed kirjutised või erinevad UNOWN.
raw:
This POKéMON is shaped like ancient text
characters. Although research is ongoing,
it is a mystery as to which came first,
the ancient writings or the various UNOWN.

label: gWobbuffetPokedexText
en: Usually docile, a WOBBUFFET strikes back ferociously if its black tail is attacked. It makes its lair in caves where it waits for nightfall.
et: Tavaliselt kuulekas, a WOBBUFFET lööb metsikult vastu, kui selle musta saba rünnatakse. See teeb oma lairi koobastesse, kus ta ootab öö saabumist.
raw:
Usually docile, a WOBBUFFET strikes back
ferociously if its black tail is attacked.
It makes its lair in caves where it waits
for nightfall.

label: gGirafarigPokedexText
en: A GIRAFARIG is an herbivore--it eats grass and tree shoots. While it is eating, its tail makes chewing and swallowing motions as if it were also eating.
et: A GIRAFARIG on herbivoor--see sööb rohtu ja puuvõrseid. Söömise ajal teeb tema saba närimis- ja neelamisvõtteid, nagu sööks ka.
raw:
A GIRAFARIG is an herbivore--it eats
grass and tree shoots. While it is eating,
its tail makes chewing and swallowing
motions as if it were also eating.

label: gPinecoPokedexText
en: A PINECO hangs from a tree branch and waits for prey. While eating, if it is disturbed by someone shaking its tree, it falls on the ground and suddenly explodes.
et: A PINECO ripub puuoksa küljes ja ootab saaki. Söömise ajal, kui seda häirib keegi oma puud raputades, kukub see maha ja plahvatab äkki.
raw:
A PINECO hangs from a tree branch and
waits for prey. While eating, if it is
disturbed by someone shaking its tree, it
falls on the ground and suddenly explodes.

label: gForretressPokedexText
en: It keeps itself inside its steel shell. The shell is opened when it is catching prey, but it is so quick that the shell's inside cannot be seen.
et: See hoiab end oma teraskesta sees. Koor avatakse saagi püüdmisel, kuid see on nii kiire, et kesta seespool ei ole näha.
raw:
It keeps itself inside its steel shell.
The shell is opened when it is catching
prey, but it is so quick that the shell's
inside cannot be seen.

label: gDunsparcePokedexText
en: Its drill-tipped tail is used to burrow into the ground backwards. This POKéMON is known to make its nest in complex shapes deep under the ground.
et: Selle puuritud otsaga saba kasutatakse maasse tagurpidi ukerdamiseks. See POKéMON on teada, et teeb oma pesa keeruliste kujudega sügaval maa all.
raw:
Its drill-tipped tail is used to burrow into
the ground backwards. This POKéMON is
known to make its nest in complex shapes
deep under the ground.

label: gGligarPokedexText
en: It glides without making a single sound. It grasps the face of its foe using its hind and large front claws, then stabs with its poison barb.
et: See liugleb ilma ainsatki häält tegemata. See riivab oma vaenlase nägu, kasutades oma taga- ja suuri esiküüniseid, siis torkab oma mürgivarrega.
raw:
It glides without making a single sound.
It grasps the face of its foe using its
hind and large front claws, then stabs
with its poison barb.

label: gSteelixPokedexText
en: STEELIX live even further underground than ONIX. This POKéMON is known to dig toward the earth's core, reaching a depth of over six-tenths of a mile underground.
et: STEELIX elada veelgi maa all kui ONIX. Teatavasti kaevab see POKéMON maakera tuumiku poole, jõudes maa alla üle kuue kümnendiku miili sügavuseni.
raw:
STEELIX live even further underground
than ONIX. This POKéMON is known to dig
toward the earth's core, reaching a depth
of over six-tenths of a mile underground.

label: gSnubbullPokedexText
en: By baring its fangs and making a scary face, it sends smaller POKéMON scurrying in terror. The SNUBBULL does seem a little sad at making its foes flee.
et: Põrnitsedes oma kiharaid ja tehes hirmuäratavat nägu, saadab see väiksema POKéMON hirmuäratavalt. SNUBBULL tundub natuke kurb oma vaenlasi põgenema panna.
raw:
By baring its fangs and making a scary
face, it sends smaller POKéMON scurrying
in terror. The SNUBBULL does seem a
little sad at making its foes flee.

label: gGranbullPokedexText
en: It has a particularly well-developed lower jaw. The huge fangs are heavy, causing it to tilt its head. Unless it is startled, it will not try to bite.
et: Sellel on eriti hästi arenenud alalõug. Tohutud kiharad on rasked, mistõttu kallutab see pead. Kui see just ära ei ehmata, siis ei ürita hammustada.
raw:
It has a particularly well-developed lower
jaw. The huge fangs are heavy, causing
it to tilt its head. Unless it is startled, it
will not try to bite.

label: gQwilfishPokedexText
en: A QWILFISH uses the pressure of water it swallows to shoot toxic quills all at once from all over its body. It finds swimming to be somewhat challenging.
et: A QWILFISH kasutab vee survet, mida see neelab, et tulistada toksilisi tekliid korraga kogu oma kehast. See leiab, et ujumine on mõnevõrra väljakutsuv.
raw:
A QWILFISH uses the pressure of water
it swallows to shoot toxic quills all at
once from all over its body. It finds
swimming to be somewhat challenging.

label: gScizorPokedexText
en: A SCIZOR has a body with the hardness of steel. It is not easily fazed by ordinary sorts of attacks. It flaps its wings to regulate its body temperature.
et: A SCIZOR on kere kõvadusega terasest. Seda ei kõiguta kergesti tavalised rünnakute liigid. Ta klapib tiibadega, et reguleerida oma kehatemperatuuri.
raw:
A SCIZOR has a body with the hardness of
steel. It is not easily fazed by ordinary
sorts of attacks. It flaps its wings to
regulate its body temperature.

label: gShucklePokedexText
en: A SHUCKLE hides under rocks, keeping its body concealed inside its shell while eating stored berries. The berries mix with its body fluids to become a juice.
et: A SHUCKLE peidab end kivide all, hoides oma keha varjatuna oma kesta sees, süües samal ajal talletatud marju. Marjad segunevad oma kehavedelikega, et saada mahlaks.
raw:
A SHUCKLE hides under rocks, keeping its
body concealed inside its shell while
eating stored berries. The berries mix with
its body fluids to become a juice.

label: gHeracrossPokedexText
en: They gather in forests seeking the sweet sap of trees. It is completely clad in a steel-hard shell. It is proud of its horn, which it uses to fling foes.
et: Nad kogunevad metsadesse, otsides puude magusat mappi. See on täielikult kaetud teras-kõva kestaga. Ta on uhke oma sarve üle, mida ta kasutab vaenlaste paugutamiseks.
raw:
They gather in forests seeking the sweet
sap of trees. It is completely clad in a
steel-hard shell. It is proud of its horn,
which it uses to fling foes.

label: gSneaselPokedexText
en: A SNEASEL scales trees by punching its hooked claws into the bark. It seeks out unguarded nests and steals eggs for food while the parents are away.
et: A SNEASEL kaalud puud, löödes selle konksuga küünised koore sisse. See otsib välja valveta pesasid ja varastab mune toiduks, kui vanemad on eemal.
raw:
A SNEASEL scales trees by punching its
hooked claws into the bark. It seeks out
unguarded nests and steals eggs for food
while the parents are away.

label: gTeddiursaPokedexText
en: It licks its palms that are sweetened by being soaked in honey. A TEDDIURSA makes its own honey by blending fruits and pollen collected by BEEDRILL.
et: See lakub oma peopesad, mida maiustab mee sees leotamine. A TEDDIURSA teeb oma mee, segades vilju ja õietolmu, mis on kogutud BEEDRILL poolt.
raw:
It licks its palms that are sweetened by
being soaked in honey. A TEDDIURSA makes
its own honey by blending fruits and pollen
collected by BEEDRILL.

label: gUrsaringPokedexText
en: In forests, it is said that there are many streams and towering trees where an URSARING gathers food. It walks through its forest collecting food every day.
et: Metsades räägitakse, et on palju ojasid ja kõrguvaid puid, kus URSARING kogub toitu. See kõnnib läbi oma metsa, kogudes iga päev toitu.
raw:
In forests, it is said that there are many
streams and towering trees where an
URSARING gathers food. It walks through
its forest collecting food every day.

label: gSlugmaPokedexText
en: It is a species of POKéMON that lives in volcanic areas. If its body cools, its skin hardens and immobilizes it. To avoid that, it sleeps near magma.
et: See on POKéMON liik, mis elab vulkaanilistes piirkondades. Kui tema keha jahtub, siis nahk karastab ja immobiliseerib seda. Et seda vältida, magatakse magma lähedal.
raw:
It is a species of POKéMON that lives in
volcanic areas. If its body cools, its skin
hardens and immobilizes it. To avoid that,
it sleeps near magma.

label: gMagcargoPokedexText
en: The shell on its back is made of hardened magma. Tens of thousands of years spent living in volcanic craters have turned MAGCARGO's bodies into magma.
et: Selle seljal olev kest on valmistatud karastatud magmast. Kümned tuhanded aastad vulkaanilistes kraatrites elades on muutnud MAGCARGO kehad magmaks.
raw:
The shell on its back is made of hardened
magma. Tens of thousands of years spent
living in volcanic craters have turned
MAGCARGO's bodies into magma.

label: gSwinubPokedexText
en: It roots for food by rubbing its snout against the ground. Its favorite food is a mushroom that grows under dried grass. It occasionally roots out hot springs.
et: See juurdub toiduks, hõõrudes oma nohu vastu maad. Selle lemmiktoit on seeneline, mis kasvab kuivanud rohu all. See juurib aeg-ajalt välja kuumaveeallikad.
raw:
It roots for food by rubbing its snout
against the ground. Its favorite food is a
mushroom that grows under dried grass.
It occasionally roots out hot springs.

label: gPiloswinePokedexText
en: A PILOSWINE is covered by a thick coat of long hair for enduring freezing cold. It uses its tusks to dig up food that has been buried under ice.
et: PILOSWINE on kaetud pikkade juustega paksu kasukaga, mis tagab külma jäätumise. See kasutab oma kiharaid jää alla mattunud toidu väljakaevamiseks.
raw:
A PILOSWINE is covered by a thick coat
of long hair for enduring freezing cold.
It uses its tusks to dig up food that has
been buried under ice.

label: gCorsolaPokedexText
en: CORSOLA live in warm southern seas. If the sea becomes polluted, the beautiful coral stalks become discolored and crumble away in tatters.
et: CORSOLA ela soojas lõunameres. Kui meri saastub, muutuvad kaunid korallivarred värvimuutusteks ja murenevad tattides ära.
raw:
CORSOLA live in warm southern seas.
If the sea becomes polluted, the beautiful
coral stalks become discolored and crumble
away in tatters.

label: gRemoraidPokedexText
en: A REMORAID uses its abdominal muscles to forcefully expel swallowed water, then shoot down flying prey. When evolution approaches, it travels down rivers.
et: A REMORAID kasutab oma kõhulihaseid, et allaneelatud vett jõuliselt välja ajada, seejärel lendavat saaki alla lasta. Kui evolutsioon läheneb, rändab see mööda jõgesid.
raw:
A REMORAID uses its abdominal muscles
to forcefully expel swallowed water, then
shoot down flying prey. When evolution
approaches, it travels down rivers.

label: gOctilleryPokedexText
en: It ensnares its foe with its suctioncupped tentacles before delivering the finishing blow. If the foe turns out to be too strong, it spews ink to escape.
et: See orjastab oma vaenlase oma iminapaga kombitsatega enne viimistluslöögi andmist. Kui vaenlane osutub liiga tugevaks, paiskab ta põgenemiseks tinti.
raw:
It ensnares its foe with its suction-
cupped tentacles before delivering the
finishing blow. If the foe turns out to be
too strong, it spews ink to escape.

label: gDelibirdPokedexText
en: It carries food bundled up in its tail. There was a famous explorer who managed to scale Mt. Everest thanks to a DELIBIRD sharing its food.
et: See kannab sabas komplekteeritud toitu. Oli üks kuulus maadeavastaja, kellel õnnestus Mt skaleerida. Everest tänu DELIBIRD jagamisele oma toitu.
raw:
It carries food bundled up in its tail.
There was a famous explorer who
managed to scale Mt. Everest thanks
to a DELIBIRD sharing its food.

label: gMantinePokedexText
en: On sunny days, schools of MANTINE can be seen elegantly leaping over the waves. It is not bothered by the REMORAID that hitches rides.
et: Päikesepaistelistel päevadel võib MANTINE koolkondi näha elegantselt üle lainete hüplemas. Seda ei häiri REMORAID mis löögid sõidavad.
raw:
On sunny days, schools of MANTINE can be
seen elegantly leaping over the waves.
It is not bothered by the REMORAID that
hitches rides.

label: gSkarmoryPokedexText
en: A POKéMON that has a body and wings of steel. People in the past used feathers fallen from SKARMORY to make swords and knives.
et: A POKéMON millel on kere ja tiivad terasest. Varasemad inimesed kasutasid mõõkade ja nugade valmistamiseks SKARMORY alt kukkunud sulgi.
raw:
A POKéMON that has a body and wings of
steel. People in the past used feathers
fallen from SKARMORY to make swords and
knives.

label: gHoundourPokedexText
en: HOUNDOUR communicate with each other using a variety of cries to corner their prey. This POKéMON's remarkable teamwork is simply unparalleled.
et: HOUNDOUR suhtle omavahel, kasutades erinevaid nutte, et oma saaki nurka ajada. See POKéMON tähelepanuväärne meeskonnatöö on lihtsalt võrratu.
raw:
HOUNDOUR communicate with each other
using a variety of cries to corner their
prey. This POKéMON's remarkable teamwork
is simply unparalleled.

label: gHoundoomPokedexText
en: In a HOUNDOOM pack, the one with its horns raked sharply back serves a leadership role. They choose their leader by fighting among themselves.
et: HOUNDOOM pakis teenib liidrirolli see, kelle sarved on järsult tagasi riisutud. Nad valivad oma juhi, võideldes omavahel.
raw:
In a HOUNDOOM pack, the one with its horns
raked sharply back serves a leadership
role. They choose their leader by fighting
among themselves.

label: gKingdraPokedexText
en: It sleeps quietly, deep on the seafloor. When it comes up to the surface, it creates a huge whirlpool that can swallow even ships.
et: Magab vaikselt, sügaval merepõhjas. Pealispinnani jõudes tekitab see hiigelsuure mullivanni, mis suudab alla neelata isegi laevu.
raw:
It sleeps quietly, deep on the seafloor.
When it comes up to the surface, it
creates a huge whirlpool that can swallow
even ships.

label: gPhanpyPokedexText
en: PHANPY's big ears serve as broad fans. When it becomes hot, it flaps the ears busily to cool down. Even the young are very strong.
et: PHANPY suured kõrvad toimivad laiade fännidena. Kui kuumaks läheb, klapib see õhinal kõrvu, et maha jahtuda. Isegi noored on väga tugevad.
raw:
PHANPY's big ears serve as broad fans.
When it becomes hot, it flaps the ears
busily to cool down. Even the young are
very strong.

label: gDonphanPokedexText
en: A DONPHAN is so strong it can easily haul a dump truck. Its hide has toughened to a rock-hard state. An ordinary sort of attack won't even leave a scratch.
et: A DONPHAN on nii tugev, et see võib kergesti kallurit vedada. Selle varjant on kivikõva olekuga karmistunud. Tavaline omamoodi rünnak ei jäta isegi kriimu.
raw:
A DONPHAN is so strong it can easily haul
a dump truck. Its hide has toughened to a
rock-hard state. An ordinary sort of
attack won't even leave a scratch.

label: gPorygon2PokedexText
en: It was created by humans using the power of science. It has been given artificial intelligence that enables it to learn new gestures and emotions on its own.
et: Selle lõid inimesed, kasutades teaduse jõudu. Talle on antud tehisintellekt, mis võimaldab tal iseseisvalt õppida uusi žeste ja emotsioone.
raw:
It was created by humans using the power
of science. It has been given artificial
intelligence that enables it to learn new
gestures and emotions on its own.

label: gStantlerPokedexText
en: STANTLER's magnificent antlers were once traded at high prices as works of art. As a result, this POKéMON was hunted close to extinction.
et: STANTLER võrratute sarvedega kaubeldi kunagi kõrgete hindadega kui kunstiteostega. Selle tulemusena kütiti see POKéMON väljasuremise lähedal.
raw:
STANTLER's magnificent antlers were
once traded at high prices as works of art.
As a result, this POKéMON was hunted
close to extinction.

label: gSmearglePokedexText
en: A SMEARGLE marks its territory using a fluid that leaks out from the tip of its tail. About 5,000 different marks left by this POKéMON have been found.
et: A SMEARGLE tähistab oma territooriumi, kasutades vedelikku, mis lekib saba otsast välja. Leitud on umbes 5000 erinevat marka, mis sellest POKéMON alles on jäänud.
raw:
A SMEARGLE marks its territory using a
fluid that leaks out from the tip of its
tail. About 5,000 different marks left by
this POKéMON have been found.

label: gTyroguePokedexText
en: TYROGUE become stressed out if they do not get to train every day. When raising this POKéMON, the TRAINER must establish a regular training schedule.
et: TYROGUE muutuvad stressis, kui nad ei jõua iga päev treenida. Selle POKéMON tõstmisel peab TRAINER kehtestama regulaarse treeninggraafiku.
raw:
TYROGUE become stressed out if they do
not get to train every day. When raising
this POKéMON, the TRAINER must establish
a regular training schedule.

label: gHitmontopPokedexText
en: Its technique of kicking while spinning is a remarkable mix of both offense and defense. HITMONTOP travel faster spinning than they do walking.
et: Selle võte ketramise ajal on tähelepanuväärne segu nii solvumisest kui ka kaitsest. HITMONTOP reisige kiiremini keerutades, kui nad kõndides.
raw:
Its technique of kicking while spinning is
a remarkable mix of both offense and
defense. HITMONTOP travel faster
spinning than they do walking.

label: gSmoochumPokedexText
en: It actively runs about, but also falls often. Whenever it falls, it will check its reflection on a lake's surface to make sure its face hasn't become dirty.
et: See jookseb aktiivselt umbes, kuid langeb ka sageli. Alati, kui see langeb, kontrollib ta selle peegeldust järve pinnal, et ta nägu ei oleks määrdunud.
raw:
It actively runs about, but also falls
often. Whenever it falls, it will check its
reflection on a lake's surface to make
sure its face hasn't become dirty.

label: gElekidPokedexText
en: If it touches metal and discharges the electricity it has stored in its body, an ELEKID begins swinging its arms in circles to recharge itself.
et: Kui see puudutab metalli ja tühjendab selle kehasse talletatud elektri, hakkab ELEKID oma käsi ringiratast kiikama, et ennast laadida.
raw:
If it touches metal and discharges the
electricity it has stored in its body, an
ELEKID begins swinging its arms in circles
to recharge itself.

label: gMagbyPokedexText
en: If a MAGBY is spouting yellow flames from its mouth, it is in good health. When it is fatigued, black smoke will be mixed in with the flames.
et: Kui MAGBY ajab suust välja kollaseid leeke, on see hea tervise juures. Kui see on ära väsitatud, segatakse leekidega sisse must suits.
raw:
If a MAGBY is spouting yellow flames from
its mouth, it is in good health. When it is
fatigued, black smoke will be mixed in with
the flames.

label: gMiltankPokedexText
en: It gives over five gallons of milk daily. Its sweet milk is enjoyed by children and grown-ups alike. People who can't drink milk turn it into yogurt and eat it instead.
et: See annab iga päev üle viie galloni piima. Selle magusat piima naudivad nii lapsed kui ka täiskasvanud. Inimesed, kes ei suuda piima juua, muudavad selle jogurtiks ja söövad hoopis ära.
raw:
It gives over five gallons of milk daily.
Its sweet milk is enjoyed by children and
grown-ups alike. People who can't drink
milk turn it into yogurt and eat it instead.

label: gBlisseyPokedexText
en: If it senses sadness with its fluffy fur, a BLISSEY will rush over to the sad person, however far away, to share an egg of happiness that brings a smile to any face.
et: Kui see tunnetab kurbust oma koheva kasukaga, tormab BLISSEY kurva inimese juurde, kuitahes kaugele, jagama õnnemuna, mis toob naeratuse igale näole.
raw:
If it senses sadness with its fluffy fur,
a BLISSEY will rush over to the sad person,
however far away, to share an egg of
happiness that brings a smile to any face.

label: gRaikouPokedexText
en: RAIKOU embodies the speed of lightning. Its roars send shock waves shuddering through the air and ground as if lightning bolts were crashing down.
et: RAIKOU kehastab välgu kiirust. Selle möirgamised saadavad läbi õhu ja maapinna värisevaid lööklaineid, nagu oleks piksepoldid alla kukkunud.
raw:
RAIKOU embodies the speed of lightning.
Its roars send shock waves shuddering
through the air and ground as if
lightning bolts were crashing down.

label: gEnteiPokedexText
en: ENTEI embodies the passion of magma. It is thought to have been born in the eruption of a volcano. It blasts fire that consumes all that it touches.
et: ENTEI kehastab magma kirge. Arvatakse, et see on sündinud vulkaani purskes. See õhkab tuld, mis tarbib kõike seda, mida see puudutab.
raw:
ENTEI embodies the passion of magma.
It is thought to have been born in the
eruption of a volcano. It blasts fire that
consumes all that it touches.

label: gSuicunePokedexText
en: SUICUNE embodies the compassion of a pure spring of water. It runs across the land with gliding elegance. It has the power to purify dirty water.
et: SUICUNE kehastab puhta veeallika kaastunnet. See kulgeb üle maa liugleva elegantsiga. Sellel on võim puhastada määrdunud vett.
raw:
SUICUNE embodies the compassion of
a pure spring of water. It runs across
the land with gliding elegance. It has the
power to purify dirty water.

label: gLarvitarPokedexText
en: A LARVITAR is born deep under the ground. It must eat its way through the soil above and reach the surface for it to see its parents' faces.
et: A LARVITAR sünnib sügaval maa all. Ta peab sööma oma tee läbi ülaloleva pinnase ja jõudma pinnale, et näha oma vanemate nägusid.
raw:
A LARVITAR is born deep under the ground.
It must eat its way through the soil above
and reach the surface for it to see its
parents' faces.

label: gPupitarPokedexText
en: A PUPITAR creates a gas inside its body that it ejects under compression to propel itself like a jet. Its body can withstand a collision with solid steel.
et: A PUPITAR loob oma keha sees gaasi, mida ta väljutab kompressiooni all, et ennast liikuma saada nagu jet. Selle kere talub kokkupõrget tahke terasega.
raw:
A PUPITAR creates a gas inside its body
that it ejects under compression to propel
itself like a jet. Its body can withstand
a collision with solid steel.

label: gTyranitarPokedexText
en: A TYRANITAR is so overwhelmingly powerful, it can bring down a whole mountain to make its nest. It roams in mountains seeking new opponents to fight.
et: A TYRANITAR on nii ülekaalukalt võimas, et võib oma pesa tegemiseks terve mäe alla tuua. See uitab mägedes, otsides uusi vastaseid, kellega võidelda.
raw:
A TYRANITAR is so overwhelmingly powerful,
it can bring down a whole mountain to make
its nest. It roams in mountains seeking
new opponents to fight.

label: gLugiaPokedexText
en: LUGIA is so powerful even a light fluttering of its wings can blow apart houses. As a result, it chooses to live out of sight deep under the sea.
et: LUGIA on nii võimas isegi kerge laperdamine oma tiivad võib puhuda lõhki maju. Selle tulemusena otsustab ta elada silma alt ära sügaval mere all.
raw:
LUGIA is so powerful even a light
fluttering of its wings can blow apart
houses. As a result, it chooses to live out
of sight deep under the sea.

label: gHoOhPokedexText
en: Its feathers--which glow in seven colors depending on the angle at which they are struck by light--are thought to bring joy. It is said to live at the foot of a rainbow.
et: Selle suled--mis helendavad seitsmes värvitoonis sõltuvalt nurgast, mille juures neid valgus tabab--arvatakse, et see toob rõõmu. Väidetavalt elatakse vikerkaare jalamil.
raw:
Its feathers--which glow in seven colors
depending on the angle at which they are
struck by light--are thought to bring joy.
It is said to live at the foot of a rainbow.

label: gCelebiPokedexText
en: This POKéMON came from the future by crossing over time. It is thought that so long as CELEBI appears, a bright and shining future awaits us.
et: See POKéMON tuli tulevikust aja jooksul ületades. Arvatakse, et nii kaua, kuni ilmub CELEBI, ootab meid helge ja särav tulevik.
raw:
This POKéMON came from the future by
crossing over time. It is thought that so
long as CELEBI appears, a bright and
shining future awaits us.

label: gTreeckoPokedexText
en: It makes its nest in a giant tree in the forest. It ferociously guards against anything nearing its territory. It is said to be the protector of the forest's trees.
et: See teeb oma pesa metsa hiiglaslikku puusse. Ta valvab metsikult kõige selle eest, mis tema territooriumile läheneb. Väidetavalt on see metsa puude kaitsja.
raw:
It makes its nest in a giant tree in the
forest. It ferociously guards against
anything nearing its territory. It is said
to be the protector of the forest's trees.

label: gGrovylePokedexText
en: Leaves grow out of this POKéMON's body. They help obscure a GROVYLE from the eyes of its enemies while it is in a thickly overgrown forest.
et: Lehed kasvavad sellest POKéMON kehast välja. Need aitavad varjata GROVYLE silmadest oma vaenlasi samal ajal, kui see on paksult ülekasvanud metsas.
raw:
Leaves grow out of this POKéMON's body.
They help obscure a GROVYLE from the eyes
of its enemies while it is in a thickly
overgrown forest.

label: gSceptilePokedexText
en: In the jungle, its power is without equal. This POKéMON carefully grows trees and plants. It regulates its body temperature by basking in sunlight.
et: Džunglis on selle jõud ilma võrdsuseta. See POKéMON kasvatab hoolikalt puid ja taimi. See reguleerib oma kehatemperatuuri, peesitades päikesevalguse käes.
raw:
In the jungle, its power is without equal.
This POKéMON carefully grows trees and
plants. It regulates its body temperature
by basking in sunlight.

label: gTorchicPokedexText
en: If attacked, it strikes back by spitting balls of fire it forms in its stomach. A TORCHIC dislikes darkness because it can't see its surroundings.
et: Kui rünnatakse, lööb see vastu, sülitades tulekerasid, moodustub see tema kõhtu. A TORCHIC ei meeldi pimedus, sest ta ei näe oma ümbrust.
raw:
If attacked, it strikes back by spitting
balls of fire it forms in its stomach.
A TORCHIC dislikes darkness because it
can't see its surroundings.

label: gCombuskenPokedexText
en: It lashes out with 10 kicks per second. Its strong fighting instinct compels it to keep up its offensive until the opponent gives up.
et: See sorib välja 10 löögiga sekundis. Selle tugev võitlusinstinkt sunnib seda hoidma oma pealetungi, kuni vastane loobub.
raw:
It lashes out with 10 kicks per second.
Its strong fighting instinct compels it
to keep up its offensive until the
opponent gives up.

label: gBlazikenPokedexText
en: It learns martial arts that use punches and kicks. Every several years, its old feathers burn off, and new, supple feathers grow back in their place.
et: Õpitakse võitluskunste, mis kasutavad lööke ja lööke. Iga mitme aasta tagant põlevad ära selle vanad suled ja asemele kasvavad tagasi uued, nõtked suled.
raw:
It learns martial arts that use punches
and kicks. Every several years, its old
feathers burn off, and new, supple
feathers grow back in their place.

label: gMudkipPokedexText
en: On land, it can powerfully lift large boulders by planting its four feet and heaving. It sleeps by burying itself in soil at the water's edge.
et: Maal saab ta võimsalt tõsta suuri rahne, istutades oma neli jalga ja kuhjates. Magab, kui matab end veeservas mulda.
raw:
On land, it can powerfully lift large
boulders by planting its four feet and
heaving. It sleeps by burying itself in soil
at the water's edge.

label: gMarshtompPokedexText
en: Its toughened hind legs enable it to stand upright. Because it weakens if its skin dries out, it replenishes fluids by playing in mud.
et: Selle kõvenenud tagajalad võimaldavad tal püsti seista. Kuna see nõrgeneb, kui selle nahk kuivab, siis täiendab ta mudas mängides vedelikke.
raw:
Its toughened hind legs enable it to stand
upright. Because it weakens if its skin
dries out, it replenishes fluids by playing
in mud.

label: gSwampertPokedexText
en: If it senses the approach of a storm and a tidal wave, it protects its seaside nest by piling up boulders. It swims as fast as a jet ski.
et: Kui ta tajub tormi ja loodelaine lähenemist, kaitseb ta oma mereäärset pesa rahnude kuhjamisega. See ujub sama kiiresti kui jetisuusatamine.
raw:
If it senses the approach of a storm and
a tidal wave, it protects its seaside nest
by piling up boulders. It swims as fast as
a jet ski.

label: gPoochyenaPokedexText
en: It savagely threatens foes with bared fangs. It chases after fleeing targets tenaciously. It turns tail and runs, however, if the foe strikes back.
et: See ähvardab metsikult tõrvaseid kihvadega. See jälitab pärast sihtmärkide eest visalt põgenemist. Keerab saba ja jookseb aga siis, kui vaenlane vastu lööb.
raw:
It savagely threatens foes with bared
fangs. It chases after fleeing targets
tenaciously. It turns tail and runs,
however, if the foe strikes back.

label: gMightyenaPokedexText
en: In the wild, MIGHTYENA live in a pack. They never defy their leader's orders. They defeat foes with perfectly coordinated teamwork.
et: Looduses elab MIGHTYENA pakis. Nad ei trotsi kunagi oma juhi käske. Nad võidavad vaenlasi täiuslikult koordineeritud meeskonnatööga.
raw:
In the wild, MIGHTYENA live in a pack.
They never defy their leader's orders.
They defeat foes with perfectly
coordinated teamwork.

label: gZigzagoonPokedexText
en: Rubbing its nose against the ground, it always wanders about back and forth in search of something. It is distinguished by the zigzag footprints it leaves.
et: Hõõrudes nina vastu maad, eksleb ta alati midagi otsides edasi-tagasi. Seda eristavad siksakilised jalajäljed, mille ta jätab.
raw:
Rubbing its nose against the ground, it
always wanders about back and forth in
search of something. It is distinguished
by the zigzag footprints it leaves.

label: gLinoonePokedexText
en: It is exceedingly fast if it only has to run in a straight line. When it spots ponddwelling prey underwater, it quickly leaps in and catches it with its sharp claws.
et: On äärmiselt kiire, kui ta peab jooksma ainult sirgjooneliselt. Kui ta märkab tiigis elavaid saaki vee all, hüppab ta kiiresti sisse ja püüab selle oma teravate küünistega kinni.
raw:
It is exceedingly fast if it only has to run
in a straight line. When it spots pond-
dwelling prey underwater, it quickly leaps
in and catches it with its sharp claws.

label: gWurmplePokedexText
en: It sticks to tree branches and eats leaves. The thread it spits from its mouth, which becomes gooey when it touches air, slows the movement of its foes.
et: See kleepub puuokste külge ja sööb lehti. Niit, mille ta suust sülitab, mis muutub õhku puudutades gooeyks, aeglustab oma vaenlaste liikumist.
raw:
It sticks to tree branches and eats
leaves. The thread it spits from its mouth,
which becomes gooey when it touches
air, slows the movement of its foes.

label: gSilcoonPokedexText
en: It prepares for evolution using the energy it stored while it was a WURMPLE. It keeps watch over the surroundings with its two eyes.
et: See valmistub evolutsiooniks, kasutades energiat, mida ta talletas samal ajal, kui see oli WURMPLE. See hoiab oma kahe silmaga ümbruse üle valvet.
raw:
It prepares for evolution using the
energy it stored while it was a WURMPLE.
It keeps watch over the surroundings with
its two eyes.

label: gBeautiflyPokedexText
en: Its colorfully patterned wings are its most prominent feature. It flies through flower-covered fields collecting pollen. It attacks ferociously when angered.
et: Selle värviliselt mustrilised tiivad on selle silmapaistvaim omadus. See lendab läbi õietolmu koguvate lilledega kaetud põldude. See ründab vihastades metsikult.
raw:
Its colorfully patterned wings are its
most prominent feature. It flies through
flower-covered fields collecting pollen.
It attacks ferociously when angered.

label: gCascoonPokedexText
en: To avoid detection by its enemies, it hides motionlessly beneath large leaves and in the gaps of branches. It also attaches dead leaves to its body for camouflage.
et: Et vältida vaenlaste poolt avastamist, peidab see end liikumatult suurte lehtede alla ja okste vahedesse. Samuti kinnitub see oma keha külge surnud lehti maskeerimiseks.
raw:
To avoid detection by its enemies, it hides
motionlessly beneath large leaves and in
the gaps of branches. It also attaches
dead leaves to its body for camouflage.

label: gDustoxPokedexText
en: It is a nocturnal POKéMON that flies from fields and mountains to the attraction of streetlights at night. It looses highly toxic powder from its wings.
et: See on öine POKéMON mis lendab põldudelt ja mägedelt öösiti tänavavalgustite atraktsioonile. See laseb tiibadest lahti väga mürgise pulbri.
raw:
It is a nocturnal POKéMON that flies from
fields and mountains to the attraction of
streetlights at night. It looses highly
toxic powder from its wings.

label: gLotadPokedexText
en: This POKéMON lives in ponds with clean water. It is known to ferry small POKéMON across ponds by carrying them on the broad leaf on its head.
et: See POKéMON elab puhta veega tiikides. On teada, et praami väike POKéMON üle tiikide, kandes neid laia lehe peal oma peas.
raw:
This POKéMON lives in ponds with clean
water. It is known to ferry small POKéMON
across ponds by carrying them on the
broad leaf on its head.

label: gLombrePokedexText
en: In the evening, it takes great delight in popping out of rivers and startling people. It feeds on aquatic moss that grows on rocks in the riverbed.
et: Õhtul teeb suurt rõõmu jõgedest välja hüppamine ja inimeste ehmatamine. Toitub veesamblast, mis kasvab jõesängis kivimitel.
raw:
In the evening, it takes great delight in
popping out of rivers and startling people.
It feeds on aquatic moss that grows on
rocks in the riverbed.

label: gLudicoloPokedexText
en: When it hears festive music, all the cells in its body become stimulated, and it begins moving in rhythm. It does not quail even when it faces a tough opponent.
et: Kui see kuuleb pidulikku muusikat, siis stimuleeritakse kõiki selle keha rakke ja see hakkab liikuma rütmis. See ei vuhise isegi siis, kui seisab silmitsi kõva vastasega.
raw:
When it hears festive music, all the cells
in its body become stimulated, and it
begins moving in rhythm. It does not
quail even when it faces a tough opponent.

label: gSeedotPokedexText
en: It hangs off branches and absorbs nutrients. When it finishes eating, its body becomes so heavy that it drops to the ground with a thump.
et: See ripub okste küljest lahti ja neelab toitaineid. Kui ta lõpetab söömise, muutub tema keha nii raskeks, et langeb müksuga maha.
raw:
It hangs off branches and absorbs
nutrients. When it finishes eating, its
body becomes so heavy that it drops to
the ground with a thump.

label: gNuzleafPokedexText
en: A forest-dwelling POKéMON that is skilled at climbing trees. Its long and pointed nose is its weak point. It loses power if the nose is gripped.
et: Metsas elav POKéMON, mis on osav puude ronimises. Selle pikk ja terav nina on selle nõrk koht. See kaotab võimu, kui nina on haaratud.
raw:
A forest-dwelling POKéMON that is skilled
at climbing trees. Its long and pointed
nose is its weak point. It loses power if
the nose is gripped.

label: gShiftryPokedexText
en: It is said to arrive on chilly, wintry winds. Feared from long ago as the guardian of forests, this POKéMON lives in a deep forest where people do not venture.
et: Väidetavalt saabub see jahedal, talvisel tuulel. Pealtnäha ammu metsade eestkostjana elab see POKéMON sügavas metsas, kus inimesed ei julge.
raw:
It is said to arrive on chilly, wintry winds.
Feared from long ago as the guardian of
forests, this POKéMON lives in a deep
forest where people do not venture.

label: gTaillowPokedexText
en: Although it is small, it is very courageous. It will take on a larger SKARMORY on an equal footing. However, its will weakens if it becomes hungry.
et: Kuigi see on väike, on see väga julge. See võtab endale suurema SKARMORY võrdsetel alustel. Selle tahe aga nõrgeneb, kui see muutub näljaseks.
raw:
Although it is small, it is very courageous.
It will take on a larger SKARMORY on an
equal footing. However, its will weakens if
it becomes hungry.

label: gSwellowPokedexText
en: A SWELLOW dives upon prey from far above. It never misses its targets. It takes to the skies in search of lands with a warm climate.
et: A SWELLOW sukeldub saagile kaugelt ülevalt. See ei jäta kunagi oma sihtmärke märkamata. Taevasse läheb sooja kliimaga maid otsides.
raw:
A SWELLOW dives upon prey from far above.
It never misses its targets. It takes to
the skies in search of lands with a warm
climate.

label: gWingullPokedexText
en: It makes its nest on a sheer cliff at the edge of the sea. It has trouble keeping its wings flapping in flight. Instead, it soars on updrafts.
et: See teeb oma pesa mereservas asuvale puhtale kaljule. Tal on raskusi tiibade lenksu hoidmisega. Selle asemel tõuseb see hoopis uuendustele.
raw:
It makes its nest on a sheer cliff at the
edge of the sea. It has trouble keeping
its wings flapping in flight. Instead, it
soars on updrafts.

label: gPelipperPokedexText
en: It skims the tops of waves as it flies. When it spots prey, it uses its large beak to scoop up the victim with water. It protects its eggs in its beak.
et: See uisutab lainete tippe, kui lendab. Saaki märgates kasutab ta oma suurt nokka, et kannatanu veega üles kühveldada. See kaitseb oma mune nokas.
raw:
It skims the tops of waves as it flies.
When it spots prey, it uses its large beak
to scoop up the victim with water.
It protects its eggs in its beak.

label: gRaltsPokedexText
en: A RALTS has the power to sense the emotions of people and POKéMON with the horns on its head. It takes cover if it senses any hostility.
et: A RALTS on võim tunnetada inimeste emotsioone ja POKéMON sarved peas. See võtab katte, kui tajub mingit vaenulikkust.
raw:
A RALTS has the power to sense the
emotions of people and POKéMON with the
horns on its head. It takes cover if it
senses any hostility.

label: gKirliaPokedexText
en: A KIRLIA has the psychic power to create a rip in the dimensions and see into the future. It is said to dance with pleasure on sunny mornings.
et: A KIRLIA omab psüühilist jõudu, et luua dimensioonides ripp ja näha tulevikku. Väidetavalt tantsitakse mõnuga päikselistel hommikutel.
raw:
A KIRLIA has the psychic power to create 
a rip in the dimensions and see into the
future. It is said to dance with pleasure
on sunny mornings.

label: gGardevoirPokedexText
en: It apparently does not feel the pull of gravity because it supports itself with psychic power. It will give its life to protect its TRAINER.
et: See ilmselt ei tunne gravitatsioonitõmmet, sest toetab end psüühilise jõuga. See annab oma elu kaitsta oma TRAINER.
raw:
It apparently does not feel the pull of
gravity because it supports itself with
psychic power. It will give its life to
protect its TRAINER.

label: gSurskitPokedexText
en: They gather on puddles after evening downpours, gliding across the surface of water as if sliding. It secretes honey with a sweet aroma from its head.
et: Nad kogunevad õhtuste paduvihmade järel lompidele, liugledes üle veepinna justkui liugledes. See eritab peast magusa aroomiga mett.
raw:
They gather on puddles after evening
downpours, gliding across the surface
of water as if sliding. It secretes honey
with a sweet aroma from its head.

label: gMasquerainPokedexText
en: It intimidates foes with the large eyelike patterns on its antennae. Because it can't fly if its wings get wet, it shelters itself from rain under large trees and eaves.
et: See hirmutab vaenlasi suurte silmalaugude mustritega oma antennidel. Kuna ta ei saa lennata, kui tiivad märjaks saavad, varjutab ta end vihma eest suurte puude ja räästa alla.
raw:
It intimidates foes with the large eyelike
patterns on its antennae. Because it can't
fly if its wings get wet, it shelters itself
from rain under large trees and eaves.

label: gShroomishPokedexText
en: It loves to eat damp, composted soil in forests. If you enter a forest after a long rain, you can see many SHROOMISH feasting on composted soil.
et: Talle meeldib metsades süüa niisket, kompostitud mulda. Kui sisened pärast pikka vihma metsa, näed palju SHROOMISH pidusööke kompostitud pinnasel.
raw:
It loves to eat damp, composted soil in
forests. If you enter a forest after a
long rain, you can see many SHROOMISH
feasting on composted soil.

label: gBreloomPokedexText
en: It scatters spores from holes in the cap on its head. It loves warm and humid climates. It feeds on trees and plants in fields and forests.
et: See scatters eostab augud kork peas. See armastab sooja ja niisket kliimat. Toitub puudest ja taimedest põldudel ja metsades.
raw:
It scatters spores from holes in the cap
on its head. It loves warm and humid
climates. It feeds on trees and plants in
fields and forests.

label: gSlakothPokedexText
en: It sleeps virtually all day and night long. It doesn't change its nest its entire life, but it sometimes travels great distances by swimming in rivers.
et: Magab praktiliselt terve päeva ja öö. See ei muuda oma pesa kogu elu, vaid läbib vahel suuri vahemaid jõgedes ujudes.
raw:
It sleeps virtually all day and night long.
It doesn't change its nest its entire life,
but it sometimes travels great distances
by swimming in rivers.

label: gVigorothPokedexText
en: It can't keep still because its blood boils with energy. It runs through the fields and mountains all day to calm itself. If it doesn't, it can't sleep at night.
et: See ei saa paigal püsida, sest selle veri keeb energiaga. See jookseb terve päeva läbi põldude ja mägede, et end rahustada. Kui ei tule, siis öösel magada ei saa.
raw:
It can't keep still because its blood boils
with energy. It runs through the fields
and mountains all day to calm itself. If it
doesn't, it can't sleep at night.

label: gSlakingPokedexText
