en: Hordes of SLAKING gather around trees when fruits come into season. They wait around patiently for ripened fruits to fall out of the trees.
et: Hordid SLAKING kogunevad puude ümber, kui viljad tulevad aastaaega. Nad ootavad kannatlikult ringi, kuni valmivad viljad puudest välja kukuvad.
raw:
Hordes of SLAKING gather around trees
when fruits come into season. They wait
around patiently for ripened fruits to fall
out of the trees.

label: gNincadaPokedexText
en: It makes its nest at the roots of a mighty tree. Using its whiskerlike antennae, it probes its surroundings in the pitch-black darkness of soil.
et: See teeb oma pesa vägeva puu juurte juurde. Kasutades oma vurritaolist antenni, sondeerib ta oma ümbrust mulla pigimustas pimeduses.
raw:
It makes its nest at the roots of a mighty
tree. Using its whiskerlike antennae, it
probes its surroundings in the
pitch-black darkness of soil.

label: gNinjaskPokedexText
en: Because it darts about vigorously at high speed, it is very difficult to see. Hearing its distinctive cries for too long induces a headache.
et: Kuna see noolab suurel kiirusel umbes jõuliselt, on seda väga raske näha. Selle omanäoliste nuttude kuulmine liiga pikaks ajaks kutsub esile peavalu.
raw:
Because it darts about vigorously at high
speed, it is very difficult to see. Hearing
its distinctive cries for too long induces
a headache.

label: gShedinjaPokedexText
en: A peculiar POKéMON that floats in air even though its wings remain completely still. The inside of its body is hollow and utterly dark.
et: Omapärane POKéMON mis hõljub õhus kuigi selle tiivad jäävad täiesti paigal. Tema keha sisemus on õõnes ja üdini tume.
raw:
A peculiar POKéMON that floats in air even
though its wings remain completely still.
The inside of its body is hollow and
utterly dark.

label: gWhismurPokedexText
en: Its cries equal a jet plane in volume. It inhales through its ear canals. Because of this system, it can cry continually without having to catch its breath.
et: Selle nutused võrduvad mahult reaktiivlennukiga. See hingab läbi kõrvakanalite sisse. Selle süsteemi tõttu võib ta pidevalt nutta, ilma et peaks hinge kinni hoidma.
raw:
Its cries equal a jet plane in volume.
It inhales through its ear canals. Because
of this system, it can cry continually
without having to catch its breath.

label: gLoudredPokedexText
en: It positions the round speakers on its head to assail foes with ultrasonic waves at massive volume. It builds power by stomping the ground.
et: See asetab ümmargused kõlarid pea peale, et ründada vaenlasi ultraheli lainetega massiivsel helitugevusel. See ehitab jõudu maapinna trampimisega.
raw:
It positions the round speakers on its
head to assail foes with ultrasonic waves
at massive volume. It builds power by
stomping the ground.

label: gExploudPokedexText
en: It has sound-generating organs all over its body. It communicates with others by adjusting the tone and volume of the cries it emits.
et: Tal on heli tekitavaid organeid üle kogu keha. See suhtleb teistega, kohandades seda kiirgavate nuttude tooni ja mahtu.
raw:
It has sound-generating organs all over
its body. It communicates with others by
adjusting the tone and volume of the cries
it emits.

label: gMakuhitaPokedexText
en: It loves to toughen up its body above all else. If you hear quaking rumbles in a cave, it is the sound of MAKUHITA undertaking strenuous training.
et: See armastab oma keha üle kõige karmistada. Kui kuuled koopas värisevaid kolinaid, on see MAKUHITA ettevõtmise pingelise treeningu heli.
raw:
It loves to toughen up its body above all
else. If you hear quaking rumbles in a cave,
it is the sound of MAKUHITA undertaking
strenuous training.

label: gHariyamaPokedexText
en: It has the habit of challenging others without hesitation to tests of strength. It's been known to stand on train tracks and stop trains using forearm thrusts.
et: Tal on komme teistele jõuproovidele kõhklemata väljakutse esitada. Teadaolevalt on seisnud rongiradadel ja peatanud rongid, kasutades küünarvarre tõukeid.
raw:
It has the habit of challenging others
without hesitation to tests of strength.
It's been known to stand on train tracks
and stop trains using forearm thrusts.

label: gAzurillPokedexText
en: Its tail, which is packed with nutrition, is very bouncy like a rubber ball. On sunny days they gather at the edge of water and splash about for fun.
et: Toitumisest pakatav saba on väga hüplev nagu kummipall. Päikselistel päevadel kogunetakse vee äärde ja pritsitakse umbes lõbu pärast.
raw:
Its tail, which is packed with nutrition,
is very bouncy like a rubber ball. On sunny
days they gather at the edge of water and
splash about for fun.

label: gNosepassPokedexText
en: Its body emits a powerful magnetism. It feeds on prey that is pulled in by the force. Its magnetism is stronger in cold seasons.
et: Selle keha kiirgab võimsat magnetismi. See toitub saagist, mis jõuga sisse tõmmatakse. Selle magnetism on tugevam külmadel aastaaegadel.
raw:
Its body emits a powerful magnetism.
It feeds on prey that is pulled in by the
force. Its magnetism is stronger in cold
seasons.

label: gSkittyPokedexText
en: A SKITTY's adorably cute behavior makes it highly popular. In battle, it makes its tail puff out. It threatens foes with a sharp growl.
et: A SKITTY ehedalt armas käitumine teeb selle väga populaarseks. Lahingus paneb see saba välja puperdama. See ähvardab vaenlasi terava urinaga.
raw:
A SKITTY's adorably cute behavior makes it
highly popular. In battle, it makes its tail
puff out. It threatens foes with a sharp
growl.

label: gDelcattyPokedexText
en: Rather than keeping a permanent lair, it habitually seeks comfortable spots and sleeps there. It is nocturnal and becomes active at dusk.
et: Püsikure pidamise asemel otsib ta harjumuspäraselt mugavaid laike ja magab seal. See on öine ja muutub aktiivseks hämaras.
raw:
Rather than keeping a permanent lair,
it habitually seeks comfortable spots and
sleeps there. It is nocturnal and becomes
active at dusk.

label: gSableyePokedexText
en: It digs branching holes in caves using its sharp claws in search of food--raw gems. A SABLEYE lurks in darkness and is seen only rarely.
et: See kaevab koobastesse hargnevaid auke, kasutades oma teravaid küüniseid toidu otsimisel - tooreid kalliskive. A SABLEYE varitseb pimeduses ja seda näeb vaid harva.
raw:
It digs branching holes in caves using its
sharp claws in search of food--raw gems.
A SABLEYE lurks in darkness and is seen
only rarely.

label: gMawilePokedexText
en: Its giant jaws are actually steel horns that transformed. It fools foes into complacency with its adorable gestures, then chomps them with its huge jaws.
et: Selle hiigellõuad on tegelikult terasest sarved, mis muundusid. See narrib oma armsate žestidega rahuloluks, siis komistab neid oma hiigelsuurte lõugadega.
raw:
Its giant jaws are actually steel horns
that transformed. It fools foes into
complacency with its adorable gestures,
then chomps them with its huge jaws.

label: gAronPokedexText
en: A POKéMON that is clad in steel armor. A new suit of armor is made when it evolves. The old, discarded armor is salvaged as metal for making iron products.
et: A POKéMON mis on kaetud terasest raudrüüga. Uus ülikond raudrüüd tehakse siis, kui see areneb. Vana, äravisatud soomusrüüd salvatakse metallina rauast toodete valmistamiseks.
raw:
A POKéMON that is clad in steel armor.
A new suit of armor is made when it evolves.
The old, discarded armor is salvaged as
metal for making iron products.

label: gLaironPokedexText
en: When two LAIRON meet in the wild, they fight for territory by bashing into each other with their steel bodies. The sound of their collision carries for miles.
et: Kui kaks LAIRON kohtuvad looduses, võitlevad nad territooriumi eest, peesitades omavahel oma teraskehadega. Nende kokkupõrke heli kannab kilomeetreid.
raw:
When two LAIRON meet in the wild, they
fight for territory by bashing into each
other with their steel bodies. The sound
of their collision carries for miles.

label: gAggronPokedexText
en: Its iron horns grow longer a little at a time. They are used to determine the AGGRON's age. The gouges in its armor are worn with pride as mementos from battles.
et: Selle raudsarved kasvavad korraga veidi pikemaks. Neid kasutatakse AGGRON vanuse määramiseks. Oma raudrüüs olevaid guage kantakse uhkusega kui lahingutest tulevaid meeneid.
raw:
Its iron horns grow longer a little at
a time. They are used to determine the
AGGRON's age. The gouges in its armor are
worn with pride as mementos from battles.

label: gMedititePokedexText
en: It continually meditates for hours every day. As a result of rigorous and dedicated yoga training, it has tempered its spiritual power so much it can fly.
et: See mediteerib pidevalt tunde iga päev. Range ja pühendunud joogakoolituse tulemusena on see karastanud oma vaimset jõudu nii palju, et see võib lennata.
raw:
It continually meditates for hours every
day. As a result of rigorous and dedicated
yoga training, it has tempered its
spiritual power so much it can fly.

label: gMedichamPokedexText
en: Through crushingly harsh yoga training, it gained the power to foretell its foe's actions. It battles with elegant, dancelike movement.
et: Läbi purustavalt karmi joogatreeningu sai see võimu oma vaenlase tegude ettekuulutamiseks. See võitleb elegantse, tantsulise liikumisega.
raw:
Through crushingly harsh yoga training, it
gained the power to foretell its foe's
actions. It battles with elegant, dance-
like movement.

label: gElectrikePokedexText
en: It generates electricity using friction from the atmosphere. In seasons with especially arid air, its entire body blazes with violent showers of sparks.
et: See tekitab elektrit, kasutades atmosfääri hõõrdumist. Eriti kuiva õhuga aastaaegadel bleiseerib kogu selle keha vägivaldsete sädemete duššidega.
raw:
It generates electricity using friction
from the atmosphere. In seasons with
especially arid air, its entire body blazes
with violent showers of sparks.

label: gManectricPokedexText
en: Because lightning falls in their vicinities, MANECTRIC were thought to have been born from lightning. In battle, they create thunderclouds.
et: Kuna välk langeb nende vintsidesse, arvati, et MANECTRIC on sündinud välgust. Lahingus tekitavad nad äikesepilvi.
raw:
Because lightning falls in their vicinities,
MANECTRIC were thought to have been born
from lightning. In battle, they create
thunderclouds.

label: gPluslePokedexText
en: It has the trait of cheering on its fellow POKéMON. By shorting out the electricity it releases from its paws, it creates pom-poms for cheering.
et: Sellel on omadus hõisata oma kaaslast POKéMON. Lühistades käppadest vabaneva elektri, tekitab see rõõmustamiseks pom-pomme.
raw:
It has the trait of cheering on its fellow
POKéMON. By shorting out the electricity
it releases from its paws, it creates
pom-poms for cheering.

label: gMinunPokedexText
en: At a meeting of POKéMON academics, it was announced that simultaneous exposure to electricity from a PLUSLE and MINUN will promote circulation and boost vitality.
et: Koosolekul POKéMON akadeemikud, teatati, et üheaegne kokkupuude elektriga PLUSLE ja MINUN soodustab ringlust ja elavdab elujõudu.
raw:
At a meeting of POKéMON academics, it was
announced that simultaneous exposure to
electricity from a PLUSLE and MINUN will
promote circulation and boost vitality.

label: gVolbeatPokedexText
en: With their taillights lit, VOLBEAT fly in a swarm, drawing geometric designs in the night sky. They move their nests if their pond water becomes dirty.
et: Nende tagatulede süütamisega lendab VOLBEAT parves, joonistades geomeetrilisi kujundusi öises taevas. Nad liigutavad oma pesasid, kui nende tiigivesi määrdub.
raw:
With their taillights lit, VOLBEAT fly in
a swarm, drawing geometric designs in the
night sky. They move their nests if their
pond water becomes dirty.

label: gIllumisePokedexText
en: A nocturnal POKéMON that becomes active upon nightfall. It leads a VOLBEAT swarm to draw patterns in the night sky. Over 200 different patterns have been confirmed.
et: Öine POKéMON, mis muutub aktiivseks öisel ajal. See viib VOLBEAT sülemi joonistama mustreid öötaevasse. Kinnitust on saanud üle 200 erineva mustri.
raw:
A nocturnal POKéMON that becomes active
upon nightfall. It leads a VOLBEAT swarm
to draw patterns in the night sky. Over 200
different patterns have been confirmed.

label: gRoseliaPokedexText
en: A ROSELIA that drinks nutritionally rich springwater blooms with lovely flowers. The fragrance of its flowers has the effect of making its foes careless.
et: A ROSELIA mis joob toitumuslikult rikkalikku allikavett õitseb armsate lilledega. Oma lillede aroomil on mõju muuta oma vaenlased hooletuks.
raw:
A ROSELIA that drinks nutritionally rich
springwater blooms with lovely flowers.
The fragrance of its flowers has the
effect of making its foes careless.

label: gGulpinPokedexText
en: This POKéMON's stomach fluid can even digest scrap iron. In one gulp, it can swallow something that is as large as itself.
et: See POKéMON maovedelik võib isegi vanarauda seedida. Ühes kulbis võib see alla neelata midagi, mis on sama suur kui ise.
raw:
This POKéMON's stomach fluid can even
digest scrap iron. In one gulp, it can
swallow something that is as large as
itself.

label: gSwalotPokedexText
en: Its powerful stomach acid is capable of digesting almost anything. The one thing in the whole world a SWALOT can't digest is its own stomach.
et: Selle võimas maohape on võimeline seedima peaaegu kõike. Üks asi kogu maailmas a SWALOT ei suuda seedida on oma kõht.
raw:
Its powerful stomach acid is capable of
digesting almost anything. The one thing
in the whole world a SWALOT can't digest is
its own stomach.

label: gCarvanhaPokedexText
en: CARVANHA attack ships in swarms, making them sink. Although it is said to be a very vicious POKéMON, it timidly flees as soon as it finds itself alone.
et: CARVANHA ründa parvedes laevu, mistõttu need vajuvad. Kuigi väidetavalt on tegemist väga tigeda POKéMON-ga, põgeneb see arglikult kohe, kui leiab end üksi.
raw:
CARVANHA attack ships in swarms, making
them sink. Although it is said to be a very
vicious POKéMON, it timidly flees as soon
as it finds itself alone.

label: gSharpedoPokedexText
en: The vicious and sly gangster of the sea. Its skin is specially textured to minimize drag in water. Its speed tops out at over 75 miles per hour.
et: Õel ja kavala mere gangster. Selle nahk on spetsiaalselt tekstuuriga, et minimeerida vees lohistamist. Selle kiirus tõuseb üle 75 miili tunnis.
raw:
The vicious and sly gangster of the sea.
Its skin is specially textured to minimize
drag in water. Its speed tops out at over
75 miles per hour.

label: gWailmerPokedexText
en: While this POKéMON usually lives in the sea, it can survive on land, although not too long. It loses vitality if its body becomes dried out.
et: Kuigi see POKéMON elab tavaliselt meres, võib see maismaal püsima jääda, kuigi mitte liiga kaua. See kaotab elujõu, kui tema keha muutub kuivaks.
raw:
While this POKéMON usually lives in the sea,
it can survive on land, although not too
long. It loses vitality if its body becomes
dried out.

label: gWailordPokedexText
en: It breathes through nostrils that it raises above the sea. By inhaling to its maximum capacity, a WAILORD can dive close to 10,000 feet beneath the waves.
et: See hingab läbi ninasõõrmete, mida ta mere kohale tõstab. Sisse hingates oma maksimaalse mahutavuseni võib WAILORD sukelduda 10 000 jala lähedale lainete alla.
raw:
It breathes through nostrils that it
raises above the sea. By inhaling to its
maximum capacity, a WAILORD can dive close
to 10,000 feet beneath the waves.

label: gNumelPokedexText
en: A NUMEL stores boiling magma in the hump on its back. It is a hardy POKéMON that can transport a 220-pound load. It has served humans at work since long ago.
et: A NUMEL salvestab keeva magma küürus selili. See on kõva POKéMON mis suudab transportida 220-kilost koormust. See on teeninud inimesi tööl juba ammu.
raw:
A NUMEL stores boiling magma in the hump
on its back. It is a hardy POKéMON that can
transport a 220-pound load. It has served
humans at work since long ago.

label: gCameruptPokedexText
en: A POKéMON that lives in the crater of a volcano. Every 10 years, the volcanoes on its back erupt violently. Research is under way on the cause of eruption.
et: A POKéMON mis elab vulkaani kraatris. Iga 10 aasta tagant purskavad vulkaanid selili vägivaldselt. Käimas on uuringud purske põhjuse kohta.
raw:
A POKéMON that lives in the crater of
a volcano. Every 10 years, the volcanoes
on its back erupt violently. Research is
under way on the cause of eruption.

label: gTorkoalPokedexText
en: It battles using energy it gets from burning coal. When loosing smoke from its nostrils, it lets off a sound that is similar to a locomotive's horn.
et: See võitleb energia abil, mis saadakse söe põletamisest. Suitsu ninasõõrmetest lahti lastes laseb see välja heli, mis sarnaneb veduri sarvega.
raw:
It battles using energy it gets from
burning coal. When loosing smoke from its
nostrils, it lets off a sound that is
similar to a locomotive's horn.

label: gSpoinkPokedexText
en: A POKéMON that manipulates psychic power at will. It doesn't stop bouncing even when it is asleep. It loves eating mushrooms that grow underground.
et: POKéMON mis manipuleerib psüühilise võimuga omal soovil. See ei lõpeta põrkamist isegi siis, kui ta magab. See armastab süüa seeni, mis kasvavad maa all.
raw:
A POKéMON that manipulates psychic power
at will. It doesn't stop bouncing even when
it is asleep. It loves eating mushrooms
that grow underground.

label: gGrumpigPokedexText
en: It stores power in the black pearls on its forehead. When it uses psychic power, it performs an odd dance step. Its style of dancing became hugely popular overseas.
et: See salvestab võimu mustades pärlites oma otsaesisele. Kui ta kasutab psüühilist jõudu, teeb ta veidra tantsusammu. Selle tantsimisstiil muutus ülemere ülipopulaarseks.
raw:
It stores power in the black pearls on its
forehead. When it uses psychic power, it
performs an odd dance step. Its style of
dancing became hugely popular overseas.

label: gSpindaPokedexText
en: It is distinguished by a pattern of spots that is always different. Its unsteady, tottering walk has the effect of fouling its foe's aim.
et: Seda eristab laikude muster, mis on alati erinev. Selle ebakindel, totterdav jalutuskäik mõjub oma vaenlase eesmärgi rikkumisele.
raw:
It is distinguished by a pattern of
spots that is always different. Its
unsteady, tottering walk has the
effect of fouling its foe's aim.

label: gTrapinchPokedexText
en: Its big jaws crunch through boulders. Because its head is so big, it has a hard time getting back upright if it tips over onto its back.
et: Selle suured lõuad krõbisevad läbi rahnude. Kuna ta pea on nii suur, on tal raske püsti tagasi saada, kui see seljale üle tiksub.
raw:
Its big jaws crunch through boulders.
Because its head is so big, it has a hard
time getting back upright if it tips over
onto its back.

label: gVibravaPokedexText
en: It looses ultrasonic waves by rubbing its wings together. Since a VIBRAVA's wings are still in the process of growing, it can only fly short distances.
et: See laseb lahti ultrahelilained, hõõrudes tiivad kokku. Kuna VIBRAVA tiivad on alles kasvamas, saab see lennata vaid lühikesi vahemaid.
raw:
It looses ultrasonic waves by rubbing its
wings together. Since a VIBRAVA's wings
are still in the process of growing, it can
only fly short distances.

label: gFlygonPokedexText
en: The flapping of its wings sounds like singing. To prevent detection by enemies, it hides itself by flapping up a cloud of desert sand.
et: Tiibade lehvimine kõlab nagu laulmine. Et vältida vaenlaste avastamist, peidab see end kõrbeliiva pilve lehvides.
raw:
The flapping of its wings sounds like
singing. To prevent detection by enemies,
it hides itself by flapping up a cloud of
desert sand.

label: gCacneaPokedexText
en: CACNEA live in deserts with virtually no rainfall. It battles by swinging its thick, spiked arms. Once a year, a yellow flower blooms.
et: CACNEA elada kõrbetes, kus praktiliselt pole sademeid. See võitleb oma paksude, ogarate käte õõtsutamisega. Kord aastas õitseb kollane lill.
raw:
CACNEA live in deserts with virtually no
rainfall. It battles by swinging its thick,
spiked arms. Once a year, a yellow flower
blooms.

label: gCacturnePokedexText
en: After spending thousands of years in harsh deserts, its blood transformed into the same substances as sand. It is nocturnal, so it hunts at night.
et: Olles veetnud tuhandeid aastaid karmides kõrbetes, muutus tema veri samadeks aineteks nagu liiv. See on öine, nii et jahib öösel.
raw:
After spending thousands of years in
harsh deserts, its blood transformed into
the same substances as sand. It is
nocturnal, so it hunts at night.

label: gSwabluPokedexText
en: A POKéMON that has wings like cottony clouds. After enduring winter, in which little food is available, SWABLU flocks move closer to towns in the spring.
et: A POKéMON millel on tiivad nagu cottony pilved. Pärast kestvat talve, milles on vähe toitu, liiguvad SWABLU karjad kevadel linnadele lähemale.
raw:
A POKéMON that has wings like cottony
clouds. After enduring winter, in which
little food is available, SWABLU flocks
move closer to towns in the spring.

label: gAltariaPokedexText
en: It hums in a beautiful soprano voice. It flies among white clouds in the blue sky. It launches intensely hot fireballs from its mouth.
et: See ümiseb ilusal sopranihäälel. See lendab valgete pilvede vahel sinises taevas. See käivitab suust intensiivselt kuumi tulekerasid.
raw:
It hums in a beautiful soprano voice.
It flies among white clouds in the blue
sky. It launches intensely hot fireballs
from its mouth.

label: gZangoosePokedexText
en: When it battles, it stands on its hind legs and attacks with its sharply clawed forelegs. Its fur bristles if it encounters any SEVIPER.
et: Kui ta võitleb, seisab ta tagajalgadel ja ründab oma järsult küünistatud esijalgadega. Selle karusnaha harjased, kui see puutub kokku mis tahes SEVIPER.
raw:
When it battles, it stands on its hind legs
and attacks with its sharply clawed
forelegs. Its fur bristles if it encounters
any SEVIPER.

label: gSeviperPokedexText
en: SEVIPER and ZANGOOSE are eternal rivals. It counters a ZANGOOSE's dazzling agility with its swordlike tail, which also oozes a horrible poison.
et: SEVIPER ja ZANGOOSE on igavesed rivaalid. See letitab ZANGOOSE pimestavat agilityt oma mõõgataolise sabaga, mis ka jubedat mürki joodab.
raw:
SEVIPER and ZANGOOSE are eternal rivals.
It counters a ZANGOOSE's dazzling agility
with its swordlike tail, which also oozes
a horrible poison.

label: gLunatonePokedexText
en: It becomes very active on the night of a full moon. This POKéMON was first discovered 40 years ago at the site of a meteor strike.
et: See muutub täiskuu ööl väga aktiivseks. See POKéMON avastati esmakordselt 40 aastat tagasi meteoriidirünnaku kohas.
raw:
It becomes very active on the night of
a full moon. This POKéMON was first
discovered 40 years ago at the site of
a meteor strike.

label: gSolrockPokedexText
en: Solar energy is the source of this POKéMON's power. On sunny days, groups of SOLROCK line up facing the sun and absorb its light.
et: Päikeseenergia on selle POKéMON võimsuse allikaks. Päikeselistel päevadel rivistuvad SOLROCK rühmad päikese poole ja neelavad selle valgust.
raw:
Solar energy is the source of this 
POKéMON's power. On sunny days, groups of
SOLROCK line up facing the sun and absorb
its light.

label: gBarboachPokedexText
en: Its body is covered with a slimy film. The film acts as a barrier to prevent germs in muddy water from entering the BARBOACH's body.
et: Selle keha on kaetud limase kilega. Kile toimib tõkkena, et vältida mudases vees olevate pisikute sattumist BARBOACH kehasse.
raw:
Its body is covered with a slimy film.
The film acts as a barrier to prevent germs
in muddy water from entering the
BARBOACH's body.

label: gWhiscashPokedexText
en: Mysteriously, it can foretell earthquakes. In the daytime, it sleeps in mud at the bottom of a pond. When it awakens, it continually feeds throughout the night.
et: Salapärasel kombel võib see ette ennustada maavärinaid. Päeval magab tiigi põhjas mudas. Kui see ärkab, toitub see pidevalt kogu öö.
raw:
Mysteriously, it can foretell earthquakes.
In the daytime, it sleeps in mud at the
bottom of a pond. When it awakens, it
continually feeds throughout the night.

label: gCorphishPokedexText
en: Once it grips prey with its large pincers, it will never let go, no matter what. It is a hardy POKéMON that can thrive in any environment.
et: Kui ta oma suurte näpitsatega saagi haarab, ei lase ta kunagi lahti, ükskõik mis. See on kõva POKéMON, mis võib areneda igas keskkonnas.
raw:
Once it grips prey with its large pincers,
it will never let go, no matter what.
It is a hardy POKéMON that can thrive
in any environment.

label: gCrawdauntPokedexText
en: A brutish POKéMON that loves to battle. A veteran CRAWDAUNT that has prevailed in hundreds of battles has giant pincers marked with countless scars.
et: Jõhker POKéMON, mis armastab võidelda. Veteranil CRAWDAUNT, mis on valitsenud sadades lahingutes, on hiiglaslikud näpitsad, mis on tähistatud lugematute armidega.
raw:
A brutish POKéMON that loves to battle.
A veteran CRAWDAUNT that has prevailed in
hundreds of battles has giant pincers
marked with countless scars.

label: gBaltoyPokedexText
en: A BALTOY moves by spinning on its single foot. It has been depicted in murals adorning the walls of a once-bustling city in an ancient age.
et: BALTOY liigub keerutades oma ühe jala peal. Seda on kujutatud seinamaalingutes, mis kaunistavad kunagi põlise linna müüre muinasajal.
raw:
A BALTOY moves by spinning on its single
foot. It has been depicted in murals 
adorning the walls of a once-bustling city
in an ancient age.

label: gClaydolPokedexText
en: A CLAYDOL sleeps while hovering in midair. Its arms are separate from its body. They are kept floating by the POKéMON's manipulation of psychic power.
et: A CLAYDOL magab samal ajal, kui hõljub midairis. Selle käed on kehast eraldi. Neid hoiab ujumas POKéMON manipuleerimine psüühilise jõuga.
raw:
A CLAYDOL sleeps while hovering in midair.
Its arms are separate from its body.
They are kept floating by the POKéMON's
manipulation of psychic power.

label: gLileepPokedexText
en: It disguises itself as seaweed by making its tentacles sway. Unsuspecting prey that come too close are swallowed whole. It became extinct 100 million years ago.
et: See maskeerub merevetikaks, pannes oma kombitsad kõikuma. Liiga lähedale jõudnud pahaaimamatu saak neelatakse tervelt alla. See suri välja 100 miljonit aastat tagasi.
raw:
It disguises itself as seaweed by making
its tentacles sway. Unsuspecting prey
that come too close are swallowed whole.
It became extinct 100 million years ago.

label: gCradilyPokedexText
en: It drags its heavy body along the seafloor. It makes its nest in the shallows of warm seas. CRADILY can be seen on beaches when the tide goes out.
et: See lohistab oma raske keha mööda mereäärt. See teeb oma pesa soojade merede madalikesse. CRADILY on näha randades, kui tõus kustub.
raw:
It drags its heavy body along the
seafloor. It makes its nest in the shallows
of warm seas. CRADILY can be seen on
beaches when the tide goes out.

label: gAnorithPokedexText
en: It was resurrected from a fossil using the power of science. It swims by undulating the eight wings at its sides. They were feet that adapted to life in the sea.
et: See äratati üles fossiililt, kasutades teaduse väge. Ujub kaheksa tiiba selle külgedel lahti harutades. Need olid jalad, mis kohanesid eluga meres.
raw:
It was resurrected from a fossil using the
power of science. It swims by undulating
the eight wings at its sides. They were
feet that adapted to life in the sea.

label: gArmaldoPokedexText
en: ARMALDO usually lives on land. However, when it hunts for prey, it dives beneath the ocean. It swims around using its two large wings.
et: ARMALDO elab tavaliselt maal. Saaki jahtides sukeldub see aga ookeani alla. See ujub ringi, kasutades oma kahte suurt tiiba.
raw:
ARMALDO usually lives on land. However,
when it hunts for prey, it dives beneath
the ocean. It swims around using its two
large wings.

label: gFeebasPokedexText
en: FEEBAS live in ponds that are heavily infested with weeds. Because of its hopelessly shabby appearance, it seems as if few TRAINERS raise it.
et: FEEBAS elavad tiikides, mis on tugevalt nakatunud umbrohtudega. Lootusetult räbaldunud välimuse tõttu tundub, nagu tõstaks seda vähesed TRAINERS.
raw:
FEEBAS live in ponds that are heavily
infested with weeds. Because of its
hopelessly shabby appearance, it
seems as if few TRAINERS raise it.

label: gMiloticPokedexText
en: It is said to live at the bottom of large lakes. Considered to be the most beautiful of all POKéMON, it has been depicted in paintings and statues.
et: Väidetavalt elab see suurte järvede põhjas. Peetakse ilusaimaks kõigist POKéMON, seda on kujutatud maalidel ja kujudel.
raw:
It is said to live at the bottom of
large lakes. Considered to be the most
beautiful of all POKéMON, it has been
depicted in paintings and statues.

label: gCastformPokedexText
en: It alters its form depending on the weather. Changes in the climate such as the temperature and humidity appear to affect its cellular structure.
et: Muudab oma vormi sõltuvalt ilmast. Kliimamuutused nagu temperatuur ja õhuniiskus näivad mõjutavat selle rakulist struktuuri.
raw:
It alters its form depending on the
weather. Changes in the climate such as
the temperature and humidity appear to
affect its cellular structure.

label: gKecleonPokedexText
en: A POKéMON that has the ability to alter its body colors to match its surroundings. A KECLEON reverts to its original colors if it is startled.
et: A POKéMON, millel on võime muuta oma kehavärve, et sobituda selle ümbrusega. A KECLEON pöördub tagasi oma originaalvärvidesse, kui see on ehmunud.
raw:
A POKéMON that has the ability to alter its
body colors to match its surroundings.
A KECLEON reverts to its original colors if
it is startled.

label: gShuppetPokedexText
en: This POKéMON roams about deep in the night seeking such negative emotions as grudges and envy. It retreats to its nest when the sun begins to rise.
et: See POKéMON hulgub umbes sügaval öös, otsides selliseid negatiivseid emotsioone nagu vimm ja kadedus. Ta taandub oma pessa, kui päike hakkab tõusma.
raw:
This POKéMON roams about deep in the
night seeking such negative emotions as
grudges and envy. It retreats to its nest
when the sun begins to rise.

label: gBanettePokedexText
en: An abandoned plush doll became this POKéMON. They are said to live in garbage dumps and wander about in search of the children that threw them away.
et: Mahajäetud plüüsnukust sai see POKéMON. Öeldakse, et nad elavad prügimägedes ja uitavad ringi, otsides lapsi, kes nad minema viskasid.
raw:
An abandoned plush doll became this
POKéMON. They are said to live in garbage
dumps and wander about in search of the
children that threw them away.

label: gDuskullPokedexText
en: A glare from its single scarlet eye makes even burly grown-ups freeze in utter fear. It is a nocturnal POKéMON that roams about under the cloak of darkness.
et: Pilk oma üksikust sarlakisilmast paneb isegi tulised täiskasvanud täielikus hirmus tarduma. See on öine POKéMON mis uitab umbes pimeduse varjandi all.
raw:
A glare from its single scarlet eye makes
even burly grown-ups freeze in utter fear.
It is a nocturnal POKéMON that roams
about under the cloak of darkness.

label: gDusclopsPokedexText
en: It is thought that its body is hollow with only a spectral ball of fire burning inside. However, no one has been able to confirm this theory as fact.
et: Arvatakse, et tema keha on õõnes, mille sees põleb vaid spektraalne tulekera. Seda teooriat ei ole aga keegi suutnud faktina kinnitada.
raw:
It is thought that its body is hollow with
only a spectral ball of fire burning inside.
However, no one has been able to
confirm this theory as fact.

label: gTropiusPokedexText
en: It flies by flapping its broad leaves. The bunch of fruit that grows around its neck is deliciously sweet. In the spring, it scatters pollen from its neck.
et: See lendab oma laiade lehtede lehvitamisega. Kaela ümber kasvav puuviljapundar on maitsvalt magus. Kevadel sodib ta kaelast õietolmu.
raw:
It flies by flapping its broad leaves.
The bunch of fruit that grows around its
neck is deliciously sweet. In the spring,
it scatters pollen from its neck.

label: gChimechoPokedexText
en: They fly about very actively when the hot season arrives. They communicate among themselves using seven different and distinguishing cries.
et: Nad lendavad umbes väga aktiivselt, kui saabub kuum hooaeg. Nad suhtlevad omavahel, kasutades seitset erinevat ja eristades nuttu.
raw:
They fly about very actively when the hot
season arrives. They communicate among
themselves using seven different and
distinguishing cries.

label: gAbsolPokedexText
en: It sharply senses even subtle changes in the sky and the land to predict natural disasters. It is a long-lived POKéMON that has a life-span of 100 years.
et: See tajub teravalt isegi peeneid muutusi taevas ja maal, et ennustada looduskatastroofe. Tegemist on pikaealise POKéMON-ga, mille eluiga on 100 aastat.
raw:
It sharply senses even subtle changes in
the sky and the land to predict natural
disasters. It is a long-lived POKéMON that
has a life-span of 100 years.

label: gWynautPokedexText
en: A WYNAUT loves to eat sweet fruits. It cleverly picks fruits using its earlike arms. They gather in fruit gardens, drawn by the fragrance.
et: A WYNAUT armastab süüa magusaid puuvilju. See korjab nutikalt vilju, kasutades selleks oma krahvilikke käsivarsi. Nad kogunevad puuviljaaedadesse, mis on lõhna järgi joonistatud.
raw:
A WYNAUT loves to eat sweet fruits.
It cleverly picks fruits using its earlike
arms. They gather in fruit gardens, drawn
by the fragrance.

label: gSnoruntPokedexText
en: They tend to move about in groups of around five SNORUNT. In snowy regions, it is said that when they are seen late at night, snowfall will arrive by morning.
et: Nad kipuvad liikuma umbes viie SNORUNT rühmades. Lumistes piirkondades räägitakse, et kui neid näeb hilisõhtul, saabub hommikuks lumesadu.
raw:
They tend to move about in groups of
around five SNORUNT. In snowy regions,
it is said that when they are seen late at
night, snowfall will arrive by morning.

label: gGlaliePokedexText
en: A GLALIE has the power to instantaneously freeze moisture in the atmosphere. A dazzling cloud of diamondlike ice crystals forms around its body.
et: A GLALIE on võim koheselt külmutada niiskust atmosfääris. Tema keha ümber moodustub pimestav pilv teemantilaadsetest jääkristallidest.
raw:
A GLALIE has the power to instantaneously
freeze moisture in the atmosphere.
A dazzling cloud of diamondlike ice
crystals forms around its body.

label: gSphealPokedexText
en: It is completely covered with plushy fur. As a result, it never feels the cold even when it is rolling about on ice floes or diving in the sea.
et: See on täielikult kaetud plushi karvaga. Selle tulemusena ei tunne see kunagi külma ka siis, kui see veereb umbes jääflöötidel või meres sukeldudes.
raw:
It is completely covered with plushy fur.
As a result, it never feels the cold even
when it is rolling about on ice floes or
diving in the sea.

label: gSealeoPokedexText
en: SEALEO live in herds on ice floes. Using its powerful flippers, it shatters ice. It dives into the sea to hunt prey five times a day.
et: SEALEO elavad karjades jääflöötidel. Kasutades oma võimsaid lestasid, purustab see jääd. See sukeldub merre, et jahtida saaki viis korda päevas.
raw:
SEALEO live in herds on ice floes. Using its
powerful flippers, it shatters ice.
It dives into the sea to hunt prey five
times a day.

label: gWalreinPokedexText
en: To protect its herd, the leader battles anything that invades its territory, even at the cost of its life. Its tusks may snap off in battle.
et: Oma karja kaitseks võitleb juht kõigega, mis tema territooriumile tungib, isegi oma elu hinnaga. Selle kiharad võivad lahingus ära tõmbuda.
raw:
To protect its herd, the leader battles
anything that invades its territory, even
at the cost of its life. Its tusks may snap
off in battle.

label: gClamperlPokedexText
en: A CLAMPERL slams its shell closed on prey to prevent escape. The pearl it creates upon evolution is said to be infused with a mysterious energy.
et: A CLAMPERL lööb oma kesta saakloomadele suletud, et vältida põgenemist. See pärl, mille ta evolutsiooni peale tekitab, olevat infundeeritud salapärase energiaga.
raw:
A CLAMPERL slams its shell closed on prey
to prevent escape. The pearl it creates
upon evolution is said to be infused with
a mysterious energy.

label: gHuntailPokedexText
en: To withstand the crushing pressure of water deep under the sea, its spine is very thick and sturdy. Its tail, which is shaped like a small fish, has eyes that light up.
et: Et taluda sügaval mere all vee purustussurvet, on selle selgroog väga paks ja toekas. Selle sabal, mis on kujult nagu väike kala, on silmad, mis süttivad.
raw:
To withstand the crushing pressure of
water deep under the sea, its spine is very
thick and sturdy. Its tail, which is shaped
like a small fish, has eyes that light up.

label: gGorebyssPokedexText
en: A GOREBYSS siphons the body fluids of prey through its thin, tubular mouth. Its light pink body color turns vivid when it finishes feeding.
et: A GOREBYSS sifoonib saakloomade kehavedelikke läbi oma õhukese torukujulise suu. Selle heleroosa kehavärv muutub toitmise lõpetamisel erksaks.
raw:
A GOREBYSS siphons the body fluids of prey
through its thin, tubular mouth. Its light
pink body color turns vivid when it
finishes feeding.

label: gRelicanthPokedexText
en: A POKéMON that was once believed to have been extinct. The species has not changed its form for 100 million years. It walks on the seafloor using its pectoral fins.
et: A POKéMON mis kunagi arvati olevat välja surnud. Liik ei ole 100 miljonit aastat oma vormi muutnud. See kõnnib merepõhjas, kasutades oma rinnauimesid.
raw:
A POKéMON that was once believed to have
been extinct. The species has not changed
its form for 100 million years. It walks on
the seafloor using its pectoral fins.

label: gLuvdiscPokedexText
en: LUVDISC make the branches of CORSOLA their nests. There is a custom from long ago of giving a LUVDISC as a gift to express one's feelings of love.
et: LUVDISC teha oksad CORSOLA nende pesad. On kombeks juba ammu kinkida LUVDISC kingituseks, et väljendada oma armastuse tundeid.
raw:
LUVDISC make the branches of CORSOLA
their nests. There is a custom from long
ago of giving a LUVDISC as a gift to
express one's feelings of love.

label: gBagonPokedexText
en: Although it is small, this POKéMON is very powerful because its body is a bundle of muscles. It launches head-butts with its ironlike skull.
et: Kuigi see on väike, on see POKéMON väga võimas, sest selle keha on lihaste kimp. See käivitab peanupud oma raudse koljuga.
raw:
Although it is small, this POKéMON is very
powerful because its body is a bundle of
muscles. It launches head-butts with its
ironlike skull.

label: gShelgonPokedexText
en: It hardly eats while it awaits evolution. It becomes hardier by enduring hunger. Its shell peels off the instant it begins to evolve.
et: Vaevalt ta sööb, kuni ootab evolutsiooni. Kõvemaks muutub see nälja talumisega. Selle kest koorub maha kohe, kui see hakkab arenema.
raw:
It hardly eats while it awaits evolution.
It becomes hardier by enduring hunger.
Its shell peels off the instant it begins
to evolve.

label: gSalamencePokedexText
en: After many long years, its cellular structure underwent a sudden mutation to grow wings. When angered, it loses all thought and rampages out of control.
et: Pärast pikki aastaid läbis selle rakuline struktuur äkilise mutatsiooni tiibade kasvatamiseks. Kui vihastada, kaotab see kõik mõtte ja raugeb kontrolli alt välja.
raw:
After many long years, its cellular
structure underwent a sudden mutation to
grow wings. When angered, it loses all
thought and rampages out of control.

label: gBeldumPokedexText
en: When BELDUM gather in a swarm, they move in perfect unison as if they were but one POKéMON. They communicate with each other using brain waves.
et: Kui BELDUM kogunevad sülemisse, liiguvad nad täiuslikus unioonis, nagu oleksid nad vaid üks POKéMON. Nad suhtlevad omavahel, kasutades ajulaineid.
raw:
When BELDUM gather in a swarm, they move
in perfect unison as if they were but one
POKéMON. They communicate with each other
using brain waves.

label: gMetangPokedexText
en: The claws tipping its arms pack the destructive power to tear through thick iron sheets as if they were silk. It flies at over 60 miles per hour.
et: Käsivarsi kallutavad küünised pakivad hävitava jõu, et paksudest raudlehtedest justkui siidi läbi rebida. See lendab üle 60 miili tunnis.
raw:
The claws tipping its arms pack the
destructive power to tear through thick
iron sheets as if they were silk. It flies
at over 60 miles per hour.

label: gMetagrossPokedexText
en: METAGROSS has four brains that are joined by a complex neural network. As a result of integration, this POKéMON is smarter than a supercomputer.
et: METAGROSS on neli aju, mida ühendab keeruline närvivõrk. Integratsiooni tulemusena on see POKéMON targem kui superarvuti.
raw:
METAGROSS has four brains that are joined
by a complex neural network. As a result of
integration, this POKéMON is smarter than
a supercomputer.

label: gRegirockPokedexText
en: A POKéMON that is made entirely of rocks and boulders. If parts of its body chip off in battle, REGIROCK repairs itself by adding new rocks.
et: A POKéMON mis on valmistatud täielikult kividest ja rahnudest. Kui selle kehaosad lahingus ära kiibistada, parandab REGIROCK end uute kivimite lisamisega.
raw:
A POKéMON that is made entirely of rocks
and boulders. If parts of its body chip off
in battle, REGIROCK repairs itself by
adding new rocks.

label: gRegicePokedexText
en: Its entire body is made of Antarctic ice. After extensive studies, researchers believe the ice was formed during an ice age.
et: Kogu selle keha on valmistatud Antarktika jääst. Pärast ulatuslikke uuringuid usuvad teadlased, et jää tekkis jääajal.
raw:
Its entire body is made of Antarctic ice.
After extensive studies, researchers
believe the ice was formed during an
ice age.

label: gRegisteelPokedexText
en: Its body is harder than any other kind of metal. The body metal is composed of a mysterious substance. Not only is it hard, it shrinks and stretches flexibly.
et: Selle kere on kõvem kui mistahes muud sorti metall. Keremetall koosneb salapärasest ainest. See ei ole mitte ainult raske, vaid kahaneb ja venib paindlikult.
raw:
Its body is harder than any other kind of
metal. The body metal is composed of a
mysterious substance. Not only is it hard,
it shrinks and stretches flexibly.

label: gLatiasPokedexText
en: They make a small herd of only several members. They rarely make contact with people or other POKéMON. They disappear if they sense enemies.
et: Nad teevad vaid mitmeliikmelise väikese karja. Nad puutuvad harva kokku inimeste või muu POKéMON-ga. Nad kaovad, kui tajuvad vaenlasi.
raw:
They make a small herd of only several
members. They rarely make contact with
people or other POKéMON. They disappear
if they sense enemies.

label: gLatiosPokedexText
en: Even in hiding, it can detect the locations of others and sense their emotions since it has telepathy. Its intelligence allows it to understand human languages.
et: Isegi peidus olles suudab see tuvastada teiste asukohti ja tunnetada nende emotsioone, kuna sellel on telepaatia. Selle intelligentsus võimaldab tal mõista inimkeeli.
raw:
Even in hiding, it can detect the locations
of others and sense their emotions since
it has telepathy. Its intelligence allows
it to understand human languages.

label: gKyogrePokedexText
en: KYOGRE has appeared in mythology as the creator of the sea. After long years of feuding with GROUDON, it took to sleep at the bottom of the sea.
et: KYOGRE on ilmunud mütoloogias mere loojana. Pärast pikki aastaid kestnud vaenulikkust GROUDON-ga kulus merepõhjas magamiseks.
raw:
KYOGRE has appeared in mythology as the
creator of the sea. After long years of
feuding with GROUDON, it took to sleep at
the bottom of the sea.

label: gGroudonPokedexText
en: GROUDON has appeared in mythology as the creator of the land. It sleeps in magma underground and is said to make volcanoes erupt on awakening.
et: GROUDON on ilmunud mütoloogias maa loojana. See magab magmas maa all ja väidetavalt paneb vulkaanid ärkamisele purskama.
raw:
GROUDON has appeared in mythology as the
creator of the land. It sleeps in magma
underground and is said to make volcanoes
erupt on awakening.

label: gRayquazaPokedexText
en: A POKéMON that flies endlessly in the ozone layer. It is said it would descend to the ground if KYOGRE and GROUDON were to fight.
et: A POKéMON mis lendab lõputult osoonikihis. Öeldakse, et see laskuks maapinnale, kui KYOGRE ja GROUDON peaksid võitlema.
raw:
A POKéMON that flies endlessly in the
ozone layer. It is said it would descend
to the ground if KYOGRE and GROUDON
were to fight.

label: gJirachiPokedexText
en: JIRACHI is said to make wishes come true. While it sleeps, a tough crystalline shell envelops the body to protect it from enemies.
et: Öeldakse, et JIRACHI viib soovid täide. Samal ajal, kui ta magab, ümbritseb sitke kristalne kest keha, et kaitsta seda vaenlaste eest.
raw:
JIRACHI is said to make wishes come true.
While it sleeps, a tough crystalline shell
envelops the body to protect it from
enemies.

label: gDeoxysPokedexText
en: A POKéMON that mutated from an extraterrestrial virus exposed to a laser beam. Its body is configured for superior agility and speed.
et: POKéMON mis muteerus maavälisest viirusest, mis oli avatud laserkiirega. Selle keha on seadistatud ülimaks agilityks ja kiiruseks.
raw:
A POKéMON that mutated from an
extraterrestrial virus exposed to a laser
beam. Its body is configured for superior
agility and speed.
